```bat
        try { [void][Windows.Forms.MessageBox]::Show("$m`r`n`r`nThe log is $LogPath. Running GT5-Installer.bat with GT5_INSTALL_NOGUI=1 works without the window.", "GT5 Recomp - installer") } catch {}
        if ($script:U.Proc) { Stop-Engine }
    }
    exit 0
}
Invoke-Engine

```

```txt
    # (src/gt5_framerate.cpp): only when the mod applies to this EBOOT, so that its switch exists.

# Scoped so the huge PPU TUs keep their cached compile commands. /GS-: no stack-cookie check in
# every lifted SPU function (most are a basic block long; their locals hold no guest-sized buffers).
if(SPU_SOURCES)
    set_source_files_properties(${SPU_SOURCES} PROPERTIES
        INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/spu"
        COMPILE_DEFINITIONS SPU_USE_DISPATCH_MT
        COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2;/w;/GS-;-mavx2;-mfma;-ffp-contract=off;-DSPU_X86_RZ_ALWAYS=1")
endif()
# GT5's sound job: its numbers are samples, and it was about 10% short of real time with a full grid.
# jD58063CD is the disc's; game update 2.17 replaces it with jCB9BD024 (spu_jobs_from_eboot.py, UPDATED).
# Only the mixer: the downmix module (jFDFFAAC1) filled the mix with NaN under these rules (15 Nov),
# since the SPU reads exponent-255 words as large numbers where the host sees infinity or NaN.
foreach(_sound_job jD58063CD jCB9BD024)
    set_source_files_properties("${SPU_DIR}/jobs/${_sound_job}/spu_recomp.c" "${SPU_DIR}/jobs/${_sound_job}/spu_anyaddr.c" PROPERTIES
        COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2;/w;/GS-;-mavx2;-mfma;-ffp-contract=off;-DSPU_X86_RZ_ALWAYS=1;-DSPU_X86_FAST_FLOAT=1")
endforeach()
# The EQ module (socepdideq: jEB79FDFC on the disc, jE3FDDA10 from 2.01) does its FFT's phase steps in
# double precision, three ops per pass, and switching the rounding mode around each one costs ten
# times the op: its doubles round toward zero instead (SPU_X86_FAST_DOUBLE, spu_helpers.h).
foreach(_eq_job jEB79FDFC jE3FDDA10)
    set_source_files_properties("${SPU_DIR}/jobs/${_eq_job}/spu_recomp.c" "${SPU_DIR}/jobs/${_eq_job}/spu_anyaddr.c" PROPERTIES
        COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2;/w;/GS-;-mavx2;-mfma;-ffp-contract=off;-DSPU_X86_RZ_ALWAYS=1;-DSPU_X86_FAST_DOUBLE=1")
endforeach()

# Native replacements of hot SPU functions (src/native/natives.txt: image, address, symbol, source).
# The lifted job file is compiled from a patched copy in which the listed function is renamed and a
# switch with its old name picks native or lifted at run time (scripts/spu_native_patch.py), so no
# re-lift is needed and every caller is unchanged. GT5_SPU_NATIVE=0 runs the lifted code as before.
set(GT5_NATIVE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/native")
# Direct branches (scripts/spu_native_patch.py --direct-bi, src/native/gt5_direct_bi.c): in the lifted code of
# every WWS job and of the WWS job manager, a branch or call to a register holding one of the image's own
# entries goes there without the runtime's dispatcher wherever the dispatcher would choose the same (the
# rest is unchanged). GT5_DIRECT_BI=0 at run time: as before; 2: each one checked against the dispatcher;
# GT5_DIRECT_BI_OFF=<image,...>: those images as before. Off here: none of it is built.
option(GT5_SPU_DIRECT_BI "direct branches in the lifted SPU job images" ON)
set(_dbi_args "")
set(_dbi_deps "")
if(GT5_SPU_DIRECT_BI AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/gen/spu_jobs.c")
    set(_dbi_args --direct-bi "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/gen/spu_jobs.c")
    set(_dbi_deps "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/gen/spu_jobs.c")
endif()
if(EXISTS "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/natives.txt" AND SPU_JOB_SOURCES)
    find_program(GT5_PYTHON NAMES python python3
                 HINTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../venv/Scripts" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../venv/bin")
    file(STRINGS "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/natives.txt" _nat_lines REGEX "^[A-Za-z0-9]")
    # Three-field lines say something about an image and are read first:
    #   <image> lift-sha1 <hex>   its native functions were written against exactly this lifted file;
    #                               with any other (another release, another lifter) the image stays lifted
    #   <image> generate <script>   src/native/<script> <lifted file> <build folder> writes files the
    #                               native source includes (statements cut from this copy's own lift)
    set(_nat_skip "")
    foreach(_l ${_nat_lines})
        separate_arguments(_f UNIX_COMMAND "${_l}")
        list(LENGTH _f _fn)
        if(NOT _fn EQUAL 3)
            continue()
        endif()
        list(GET _f 0 _img)
        list(GET _f 1 _kind)
        list(GET _f 2 _val)
        set(_in "${SPU_DIR}/jobs/${_img}/spu_recomp.c")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${_in}")
            continue()
        endif()
        if(_kind STREQUAL "lift-sha1")
            set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${_in}")
            file(SHA1 "${_in}" _sha)
            if(NOT _sha STREQUAL _val AND NOT _img IN_LIST _nat_skip)
                list(APPEND _nat_skip ${_img})
                message(STATUS "Native SPU:      ${_img} stays lifted (its lifted code is not the one the native functions were written for)")
            endif()
        elseif(_kind STREQUAL "generate")
            list(APPEND _nat_gen_${_img} "${_val}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    # -DGT5_CULL_PROF=ON (testing builds only): the w018CAD00 job profiler -- src/native/natives_prof.txt's
    # hooks and the profiler code in native_w018CAD00.c (GT5_CULL_PROF=1 at run time prints "[cull-prof]").
    # Off (the default, every player build): none of its hooks is in the game.
    option(GT5_CULL_PROF "w018CAD00 job profiler hooks (testing builds only)" OFF)
    set(_nat_lists "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/natives.txt")
    if(GT5_CULL_PROF AND EXISTS "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/natives_prof.txt")
        list(APPEND _nat_lists "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/natives_prof.txt")
    endif()
    # -DGT5_NATIVE_STATS=ON (testing): the geometry natives count what they do and print it every 5 s.
    set(_nat_stats "")
    if(GT5_NATIVE_STATS)
        set(_nat_stats ";NATIVE_STATS")
    endif()
    set(_nat_any OFF)
    set(_nat_done "")
    foreach(_l ${_nat_lines})
        separate_arguments(_f UNIX_COMMAND "${_l}")
        list(LENGTH _f _fn)
        if(_fn LESS 4)
            continue()
        endif()
        list(GET _f 0 _img)
        list(GET _f 3 _src)
        set(_in "${SPU_DIR}/jobs/${_img}/spu_recomp.c")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${_in}" OR NOT GT5_PYTHON OR _img IN_LIST _nat_skip)
            continue()   # this copy of the game has no such job (another release): nothing to replace
        endif()
        get_source_file_property(_opts "${_in}" COMPILE_OPTIONS)
        set(_incs "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/spu;${SPU_DIR}/jobs/${_img};${GT5_NATIVE_DIR};${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/spu_native/${_img}")
        set(_stamp "")
        if(DEFINED _nat_gen_${_img})
            set(_stamp "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/spu_native/${_img}/generated.stamp")
        endif()
        if(_stamp AND NOT _img IN_LIST _nat_done)
            set(_gen_cmds "")
            set(_gen_deps "${_in}")
            foreach(_g ${_nat_gen_${_img}})
                list(APPEND _gen_cmds COMMAND "${GT5_PYTHON}" "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/${_g}" "${_in}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/spu_native/${_img}")
                list(APPEND _gen_deps "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/${_g}")
            endforeach()
            add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${_stamp}"
                ${_gen_cmds}
                COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E touch "${_stamp}"
                DEPENDS ${_gen_deps}
                COMMENT "Native SPU: statements of ${_img} for its native functions" VERBATIM)
            target_sources(gt5 PRIVATE "${_stamp}")
        endif()
        if(NOT _img IN_LIST _nat_done)
            list(APPEND _nat_done ${_img})
            set(_out "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/spu_native/${_img}/spu_recomp.c")
            add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${_out}"
                COMMAND "${GT5_PYTHON}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/spu_native_patch.py" "${_in}" "${_out}" ${_img} ${_nat_lists} ${_dbi_args}
                DEPENDS "${_in}" ${_nat_lists} ${_dbi_deps} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/spu_native_patch.py"
                COMMENT "Native SPU functions for ${_img}" VERBATIM)
            file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/spu_native/${_img}")
            set_source_files_properties("${_in}" PROPERTIES HEADER_FILE_ONLY ON)
            target_sources(gt5 PRIVATE "${_out}")
            set_source_files_properties("${_out}" PROPERTIES
                INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${_incs}" COMPILE_DEFINITIONS SPU_USE_DISPATCH_MT COMPILE_OPTIONS "${_opts}")
        endif()
        get_source_file_property(_have "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/${_src}" COMPILE_OPTIONS)
        if(NOT _have)
            target_sources(gt5 PRIVATE "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/${_src}")
            set(_nat_defs "SPU_USE_DISPATCH_MT;NATIVE_HOOKED")
            if(_src MATCHES "^native_w")   # the geometry natives; the sound ones keep their counters for the harness
                string(APPEND _nat_defs "${_nat_stats}")
            endif()
            if(GT5_CULL_PROF AND _src STREQUAL "native_w018CAD00.c")
                string(APPEND _nat_defs ";GT5_CULL_PROF_HOOKS")
            endif()
            set_source_files_properties("${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/${_src}" PROPERTIES
                INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${_incs}" COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "${_nat_defs}" COMPILE_OPTIONS "${_opts}")
            if(_stamp)
                set_source_files_properties("${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/${_src}" PROPERTIES OBJECT_DEPENDS "${_stamp}")
            endif()
        endif()
        set(_nat_any ON)
    endforeach()
    if(_nat_any)
        target_sources(gt5 PRIVATE "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/spu_native.c")
        set_source_files_properties("${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/spu_native.c" PROPERTIES
            INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/spu"
            COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2;/w;/GS-;-mavx2;-mfma")
        if(EXISTS "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/native_snd.c")
            target_sources(gt5 PRIVATE "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/native_snd.c")
            set_source_files_properties("${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/native_snd.c" PROPERTIES
                INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/spu" COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2;/w;/GS-;-mavx2;-mfma")
        endif()
        if(EXISTS "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/native_geo_switch.c")
            target_sources(gt5 PRIVATE "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/native_geo_switch.c")
            set_source_files_properties("${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/native_geo_switch.c" PROPERTIES
                INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/spu;${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}" COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "NATIVE_GEO_SWITCH${_nat_stats}" COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2;/w;/GS-;-mavx2;-mfma")
        endif()
        list(LENGTH _nat_done _nat_n)
        message(STATUS "Native SPU:      ${_nat_n} image(s) with native functions")
    endif()
endif()
if(SPU_JOB_SOURCES AND EXISTS "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/gt5_direct_bi.c")
    # the run-time half (also what the natives' in-run A/B calls), with or without the option
    target_sources(gt5 PRIVATE "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/gt5_direct_bi.c")
    set_source_files_properties("${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/gt5_direct_bi.c" PROPERTIES
        INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/spu;${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}" COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2;/w;/GS-;-mavx2;-mfma")
endif()
if(_dbi_args AND SPU_JOB_SOURCES)
    find_program(GT5_PYTHON NAMES python python3
                 HINTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../venv/Scripts" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../venv/bin")
    if(GT5_PYTHON)
        # The images with native functions got theirs in the natives patch above; every other job image is
        # compiled from a copy made here (the script copies an image that takes no direct branches unchanged).
        set(_dbi_n 0)
        foreach(_in ${SPU_JOB_SOURCES})
            get_filename_component(_dir "${_in}" DIRECTORY)
            get_filename_component(_img "${_dir}" NAME)
            if(_img IN_LIST _nat_done)
                continue()
            endif()
            set(_out "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/spu_dbi/${_img}/spu_recomp.c")
            add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${_out}"
                COMMAND "${GT5_PYTHON}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/spu_native_patch.py" "${_in}" "${_out}" ${_img} ${_dbi_args}
                DEPENDS "${_in}" ${_dbi_deps} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/spu_native_patch.py"
                COMMENT "Direct branches for ${_img}" VERBATIM)
            file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/spu_dbi/${_img}")
            get_source_file_property(_opts "${_in}" COMPILE_OPTIONS)
            set_source_files_properties("${_in}" PROPERTIES HEADER_FILE_ONLY ON)
            target_sources(gt5 PRIVATE "${_out}")
            set_source_files_properties("${_out}" PROPERTIES
                INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/spu;${_dir};${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}"
                COMPILE_DEFINITIONS SPU_USE_DISPATCH_MT COMPILE_OPTIONS "${_opts}")
            math(EXPR _dbi_n "${_dbi_n} + 1")
        endforeach()
        message(STATUS "Direct branches: on (the WWS jobs' code and job manager; ${_dbi_n} job file(s) copied for it)")
    endif()
endif()

target_include_directories(gt5 PRIVATE
    "${RECOMP_DIR}"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/include"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/ppu"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/spu"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/memory"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/syscalls"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/platform"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/libs/video"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
)

target_link_libraries(gt5 PRIVATE ps3recomp_runtime dbghelp user32 gdi32 winmm)
# Line numbers for the runtime too, so a profile names the RSX thread's hot lines (used to be a hand edit
# of build.ninja that every CMake regeneration lost).
target_compile_options(ps3recomp_runtime PRIVATE /Z7)
# The DLLs the runtime opens sit next to the exe.
if(PS3RECOMP_FFMPEG_RUNTIME)
    add_custom_command(TARGET gt5 POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
        "${GT5_FFMPEG_DIR}/bin/avcodec-63.dll" "${GT5_FFMPEG_DIR}/bin/avutil-61.dll" "${GT5_FFMPEG_DIR}/bin/swresample-7.dll"
        "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:gt5>")
endif()
if(PS3RECOMP_RSX_VULKAN)
    # The runtime keeps the definition to itself (so the generated code isn't rebuilt); the boot harness
    # picks the Vulkan backend on it when RSX_LIVE_DRAW is off.
    set_property(SOURCE "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/ppu/tests/boot_main.cpp" APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS PS3RECOMP_RSX_VULKAN)
    # SDL2 loads only when Vulkan runs, so DirectX 12 starts even without SDL2.dll.
    target_link_options(gt5 PRIVATE /DELAYLOAD:SDL2.dll)
    target_link_libraries(gt5 PRIVATE delayimp)
    find_file(GT5_SDL2_DLL SDL2.dll PATH_SUFFIXES bin REQUIRED)
    add_custom_command(TARGET gt5 POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${GT5_SDL2_DLL}" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:gt5>")
else()
    # SDL2.dll next to gt5.exe tells the launcher and play.bat the exe has Vulkan: not this one.
    add_custom_command(TARGET gt5 POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E rm -f "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:gt5>/SDL2.dll")
endif()
set_target_properties(gt5 PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)

target_compile_options(gt5 PRIVATE /W3 /wd4100 /wd4244 /wd4267 /Zc:__cplusplus -fno-strict-aliasing -fwrapv)
target_compile_definitions(gt5 PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)

# Machine-generated: warnings off, and /bigobj because one TU passes the default
# object format's section limit. -O1 keeps these TUs' build time and memory sane;
# the last -O on the line wins, so this overrides Release's /O2 for them alone.
# -O2 with this CPU's instructions (2026-11-05): the largest chunk builds in 71 s against 67 s at -O1, under 1 GB.
# MOVBE folds the byte swap of every big-endian guest load and store into the access itself.
# No FMA contraction, so floating-point results match the -O1 build. -mfma lets ppu_vmx.h do
# vmaddfp/vnmsubfp four lanes at once with the same results (every AVX2 CPU has FMA; contraction
# stays off, so nothing else changes).
set(GT5_RECOMP_OPTIONS "/w;/bigobj;-O2;-mavx2;-mfma;-mbmi;-mbmi2;-mmovbe;-mlzcnt;-mpopcnt;-ffp-contract=off")
set_source_files_properties(${RECOMP_SOURCES} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "${GT5_RECOMP_OPTIONS}")

# Native PPU functions (src/native/ppu_natives.txt, scripts/ppu_native_patch.py, src/native/gen_ppu_leaf.py): a
# lifted file that holds a listed function is compiled from a copy in which that function is renamed
# func_<ADDR>_lifted and a switch with the old name picks the native form or the lifted one at run time
# (GT5_PPU_NATIVE: 1 native, the default; 0 lifted, as before; 2 compare both, differences logged). The native
# form is made at build time from this lift's own text of the function, and only where that text is the one it
# was proven on (its SHA-1 in the list): every other function, and another release or update of the game, keeps
# its lifted code. No re-lift; every caller and the function table keep the old name. -DGT5_PPU_NATIVE=OFF: none
# of it is built.
option(GT5_PPU_NATIVE "native PPU functions (src/native/ppu_natives.txt)" ON)
set(_ppu_nat_list "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/ppu_natives.txt")
if(GT5_PPU_NATIVE AND EXISTS "${_ppu_nat_list}")
    find_program(GT5_PYTHON NAMES python python3
                 HINTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../venv/Scripts" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../venv/bin")
    set(_ppu_nat_files "")
    if(GT5_PYTHON)
        set(_ppu_nat_script "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/ppu_native_patch.py")
        set(_ppu_nat_gen "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/gen_ppu_leaf.py")
        # The lifted files holding a listed function with the proven text; a re-lift rewrites ppu_recomp.h, so
        # configuring again then looks again.
        set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
            "${_ppu_nat_list}" "${RECOMP_DIR}/ppu_recomp.h" "${_ppu_nat_script}" "${_ppu_nat_gen}")
        execute_process(COMMAND "${GT5_PYTHON}" "${_ppu_nat_script}" --where "${_ppu_nat_list}" "${RECOMP_DIR}"
                        OUTPUT_VARIABLE _ppu_nat_files RESULT_VARIABLE _ppu_nat_rc OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE)
        if(NOT _ppu_nat_rc EQUAL 0)
            set(_ppu_nat_files "")
        endif()
    endif()
    foreach(_f ${_ppu_nat_files})
        set(_in "${RECOMP_DIR}/${_f}")
        set(_out "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ppu_native/${_f}")
        add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${_out}"
            COMMAND "${GT5_PYTHON}" "${_ppu_nat_script}" "${_in}" "${_out}" "${_ppu_nat_list}"
            DEPENDS "${_in}" "${_ppu_nat_list}" "${_ppu_nat_script}" "${_ppu_nat_gen}"
            COMMENT "Native PPU functions in ${_f}" VERBATIM)
        set_source_files_properties("${_in}" PROPERTIES HEADER_FILE_ONLY ON)
        target_sources(gt5 PRIVATE "${_out}")
        set_source_files_properties("${_out}" PROPERTIES
            INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}" COMPILE_OPTIONS "${GT5_RECOMP_OPTIONS}")
    endforeach()
    if(_ppu_nat_files)
        file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ppu_native")
        target_sources(gt5 PRIVATE "${GT5_NATIVE_DIR}/ppu_native.cpp")
        list(LENGTH _ppu_nat_files _ppu_nat_n)
        message(STATUS "Native PPU:      functions in ${_ppu_nat_n} lifted file(s) (GT5_PPU_NATIVE=0 at run time: as before)")
    else()
        message(STATUS "Native PPU:      none for this copy of the game")
    endif()
endif()

# Keep symbols so crash RVAs can be symbolized.
target_compile_options(gt5 PRIVATE /Z7)
target_link_options(gt5 PRIVATE /DEBUG /INCREMENTAL:NO)

```

`GT5/linux/CMakeLists.txt`:

```txt
# Gran Turismo 5 recomp: the Linux (x86-64) build.
#
# A separate project from GT5/CMakeLists.txt (the Windows build), so nothing here can change the
# Windows exe. It builds the same sources -- the lifted PPU code, the lifted SPU images, the boot
# harness and the ps3recomp runtime -- into one program, GT5/build-linux/gt5, which play.sh starts.
#
# Rendering: the runtime's Vulkan backend and its register-file draw engine, the same renderer as
# the Android port (the Direct3D 12 renderer the Windows build uses is Windows-only). Window,
# keyboard, controllers and sound: SDL2. Movies and music: the system's FFmpeg, loaded at run time.
#
# setup.sh configures and builds this; by hand:
#   cmake -S GT5/linux -B GT5/build-linux -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
#         -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++
#   cmake --build GT5/build-linux
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(gt5_linux LANGUAGES C CXX)

if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" OR ANDROID)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "GT5/linux is the Linux build. Windows: GT5/CMakeLists.txt (setup.ps1). Android: GT5/android.")
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang" OR NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The game code needs Clang (the SPU code's tail calls are a Clang feature). "
        "Install clang and configure with -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ (setup.sh does).")
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "x86_64|AMD64|amd64")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Only x86-64 Linux is supported so far (this is ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}).")
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

get_filename_component(GT5_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.." ABSOLUTE)

# The renderer: Vulkan. libvulkan is loaded at run time, so only the headers are needed here
# (Debian/Ubuntu: libvulkan-dev). glslang turns the game's shaders into SPIR-V (glslang-dev).
set(PS3RECOMP_RSX_VULKAN ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

if(NOT glslang_FOUND)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "glslang not found: it turns the game's shaders into Vulkan's. "
        "Debian/Ubuntu/Mint: sudo apt install glslang-dev glslang-tools. Fedora: glslang-devel. Arch: glslang.")
endif()

# FFmpeg (movies, and the ATRAC3plus music some loading screens wait for), loaded at run time from
# the system's libavcodec. Its headers decide which libavcodec.so.N the game opens. 6.1 or newer.
find_path(GT5_FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR libavcodec/avcodec.h PATH_SUFFIXES ffmpeg)
if(NOT GT5_FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "FFmpeg's headers were not found. Debian/Ubuntu/Mint: sudo apt install libavcodec-dev. "
        "Fedora: ffmpeg-free-devel (or ffmpeg-devel from RPM Fusion). Arch: ffmpeg.")
endif()
include(CheckSymbolExists)

if(NOT GT5_FFMPEG_61)

        "(Ubuntu 24.04 / Mint 22 / Debian 13 and later have it).")
endif()
set(PS3RECOMP_FFMPEG_RUNTIME ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PS3RECOMP_FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR "${GT5_FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR}" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)

add_subdirectory("${PS3RECOMP_DIR}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ps3recomp_sdk" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

file(GLOB RECOMP_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${RECOMP_DIR}/*.cpp")
list(LENGTH RECOMP_SOURCES RECOMP_SOURCE_COUNT)
message(STATUS "Lifted sources:  ${RECOMP_SOURCE_COUNT} file(s)")

set(HLE_NID_TABLE "${GT5_DIR}/src/gen/ppu_hle_nids.cpp")
set(PS3RECOMP_SCAFFOLD
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/ppu/tests/boot_main.cpp"

    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/thread_stack.c"

)
file(GLOB GT5_MOD_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${GT5_DIR}/src/gen/mods.cpp")
if(GT5_MOD_SOURCES)
    target_sources(gt5 PRIVATE ${GT5_MOD_SOURCES})
endif()

target_include_directories(gt5 PRIVATE
    "${RECOMP_DIR}"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/include"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/ppu"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/spu"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/memory"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/syscalls"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/platform"
    "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/libs/video"
    "${GT5_DIR}"
)
target_compile_options(gt5 PRIVATE -fno-strict-aliasing -fwrapv -Wno-everything)

# The same code generation as the Windows build, so both run the game the same way: the lifted PPU
# code at -O2 with the instructions every AVX2 CPU has (MOVBE folds the byte swap of each big-endian
# guest access into the access), SPU code with AVX2/FMA and the PS3's round-toward-zero floats. No
# FMA contraction anywhere: floating-point results match the Windows build's. -mfma lets ppu_vmx.h
# do vmaddfp/vnmsubfp four lanes at once with the same results (contraction stays off).
set_source_files_properties(${RECOMP_SOURCES} PROPERTIES
    COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2;-w;-mavx2;-mfma;-mbmi;-mbmi2;-mmovbe;-mlzcnt;-mpopcnt;-ffp-contract=off")
if(SPU_SOURCES)
    set_source_files_properties(${SPU_SOURCES} PROPERTIES
        INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${PS3RECOMP_DIR}/runtime/spu"
        COMPILE_DEFINITIONS SPU_USE_DISPATCH_MT
        COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2;-w;-mavx2;-mfma;-ffp-contract=off;-DSPU_X86_RZ_ALWAYS=1")
endif()
# GT5's sound job: its numbers are samples, and it needs every bit of speed to keep up. jD58063CD is
# the disc's; game update 2.17 replaces it with jCB9BD024 (spu_jobs_from_eboot.py, UPDATED).
foreach(_sound_job jD58063CD jCB9BD024)
    foreach(_f spu_recomp.c spu_anyaddr.c)
        if(EXISTS "${SPU_DIR}/jobs/${_sound_job}/${_f}")
            set_source_files_properties("${SPU_DIR}/jobs/${_sound_job}/${_f}" PROPERTIES
                COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2;-w;-mavx2;-mfma;-ffp-contract=off;-DSPU_X86_RZ_ALWAYS=1;-DSPU_X86_FAST_FLOAT=1")
        endif()
    endforeach()
endforeach()
# The EQ module (socepdideq: jEB79FDFC, jE3FDDA10 from 2.01) does its FFT's phase steps in double
# precision, and switching the rounding mode around each double op costs ten times the op: its doubles
# round toward zero instead (SPU_X86_FAST_DOUBLE, spu_helpers.h), as in the Windows build.
foreach(_eq_job jEB79FDFC jE3FDDA10)
    foreach(_f spu_recomp.c spu_anyaddr.c)
        if(EXISTS "${SPU_DIR}/jobs/${_eq_job}/${_f}")
            set_source_files_properties("${SPU_DIR}/jobs/${_eq_job}/${_f}" PROPERTIES
                COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2;-w;-mavx2;-mfma;-ffp-contract=off;-DSPU_X86_RZ_ALWAYS=1;-DSPU_X86_FAST_DOUBLE=1")
        endif()
    endforeach()
endforeach()

target_link_libraries(gt5 PRIVATE ps3recomp_runtime SDL2::SDL2 ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS} m pthread)
# thread_stack.c's pthread_create has to be in the program's dynamic symbols so that SDL's calls reach it. The
# linker puts it there anyway because libSDL2 uses pthread_create; this says so outright where the linker can.
include(CheckLinkerFlag)
check_linker_flag(C "LINKER:--export-dynamic-symbol=pthread_create" GT5_LINK_EXPORT_SYMBOL)
if(GT5_LINK_EXPORT_SYMBOL)
    target_link_options(gt5 PRIVATE "LINKER:--export-dynamic-symbol=pthread_create")
endif()
set_target_properties(gt5 PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
```

`GT5/linux/thread_stack.c`:

```c
/* Linux only: thread stacks that are too small for this program get a second try with a bigger one.
 *
 * GT5's per-thread data (static TLS) is large, so glibc's smallest thread stack in this program is about
 * 344 KiB. A library that asks for less gets EINVAL from pthread_create. SDL 2.30.0's PulseAudio hotplug thread
 * asks for 256 KiB and then waits forever for a thread that never started, so the game stayed on a black screen
 * at start with sound through PulseAudio or PipeWire (GitHub #20; found by melroy89, SDL fixed it in 2.30.12).
 *
 * This pthread_create is the program's own, and a program's symbol comes before libc's for every library it
 * loads, SDL included. It passes each call on unchanged; only when that fails with EINVAL does it try once more
 * with the same settings and a bigger stack (1 MiB, or twice the request if that is more), and says so in the
 * log. A call that is fine the first time behaves exactly as before. */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <sched.h>
#include <stdio.h>

typedef int (*gt5_create_fn)(pthread_t*, const pthread_attr_t*, void* (*)(void*), void*);

__attribute__((visibility("default")))
int pthread_create(pthread_t* thread, const pthread_attr_t* attr, void* (*start)(void*), void* arg)
{
    static gt5_create_fn real;
    gt5_create_fn fn = __atomic_load_n(&real, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (!fn) {
        fn = (gt5_create_fn)dlsym(RTLD_NEXT, "pthread_create");
        if (!fn) return EAGAIN;
        __atomic_store_n(&real, fn, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    int rc = fn(thread, attr, start, arg);
    if (rc != EINVAL || !attr) return rc;

    size_t asked = 0;
    if (pthread_attr_getstacksize(attr, &asked) != 0) return rc;
    const size_t bigger = asked * 2 > ((size_t)1 << 20) ? asked * 2 : ((size_t)1 << 20);

    pthread_attr_t again;
    if (pthread_attr_init(&again) != 0) return rc;
    int v = 0;
    size_t guard = 0;
    struct sched_param param;
    if (pthread_attr_getdetachstate(attr, &v) == 0) pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&again, v);
    if (pthread_attr_getguardsize(attr, &guard) == 0) pthread_attr_setguardsize(&again, guard);
    if (pthread_attr_getscope(attr, &v) == 0) pthread_attr_setscope(&again, v);
    if (pthread_attr_getinheritsched(attr, &v) == 0) {
        pthread_attr_setinheritsched(&again, v);
        if (v == PTHREAD_EXPLICIT_SCHED) {
            if (pthread_attr_getschedpolicy(attr, &v) == 0) pthread_attr_setschedpolicy(&again, v);
            if (pthread_attr_getschedparam(attr, &param) == 0) pthread_attr_setschedparam(&again, &param);
        }
    }
    pthread_attr_setstacksize(&again, bigger);
    int rc2 = fn(thread, &again, start, arg);
    pthread_attr_destroy(&again);
    if (rc2 == 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "[threads] a library asked for a %zu KiB thread stack, under this program's smallest (its "
                        "per-thread data is large): started it with %zu KiB instead\n", asked >> 10, bigger >> 10);
    return rc2 == 0 ? 0 : rc;
}
```

`GT5/patches/gather_fast.h`:

```h
/* Big-endian indices to vertex references, 8 (16-bit) or 4 (32-bit) at a time, until a block holds
 * the restart value or fewer than a block remain. Returns how many were done; the caller does the
 * rest one at a time, so a restart is always handled by the ordinary path. */
static u32 ld_gather_fast(const u8* src, u32 count, int is_u32, int restart_enabled, u32 restart_value,
                          u32 base_index, rsx_vertex_ref* out)
{
    u32 i = 0;
    const __m128i base = _mm_set1_epi32((int)base_index);
    if (!is_u32) {
        const __m128i sw = _mm_setr_epi8(1, 0, 3, 2, 5, 4, 7, 6, 9, 8, 11, 10, 13, 12, 15, 14);
        const int chk = restart_enabled && restart_value <= 0xFFFFu;
        const __m128i rv = _mm_set1_epi16((short)(restart_value & 0xFFFFu));
        for (; i + 8 <= count; i += 8) {
            const __m128i x = _mm_shuffle_epi8(_mm_loadu_si128((const __m128i*)(src + (size_t)i * 2u)), sw);
            if (chk && _mm_movemask_epi8(_mm_cmpeq_epi16(x, rv))) break;
            const __m128i lo = _mm_cvtepu16_epi32(x);
            const __m128i hi = _mm_cvtepu16_epi32(_mm_srli_si128(x, 8));
            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)(out + i), _mm_unpacklo_epi32(lo, base));
            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)(out + i + 2), _mm_unpackhi_epi32(lo, base));
            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)(out + i + 4), _mm_unpacklo_epi32(hi, base));
            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)(out + i + 6), _mm_unpackhi_epi32(hi, base));
        }
    } else {
        const __m128i sw = _mm_setr_epi8(3, 2, 1, 0, 7, 6, 5, 4, 11, 10, 9, 8, 15, 14, 13, 12);
        const __m128i rv = _mm_set1_epi32((int)restart_value);
        for (; i + 4 <= count; i += 4) {
            const __m128i x = _mm_shuffle_epi8(_mm_loadu_si128((const __m128i*)(src + (size_t)i * 4u)), sw);
            if (restart_enabled && _mm_movemask_epi8(_mm_cmpeq_epi32(x, rv))) break;
            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)(out + i), _mm_unpacklo_epi32(x, base));
            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)(out + i + 2), _mm_unpackhi_epi32(x, base));
        }
    }
    return i;
}
```

```patch
+/* ps3_thread_on_fast_cores: for a host thread with a real-time deadline (audio). On a CPU with
+ * performance and efficiency cores, Windows puts a busy thread of a background window on an
+ * efficiency core, at about half the speed, and an audio job that fits in its 5.33 ms on one
+ * does not fit on the other. Keeps the thread on the fastest class of core and out of EcoQoS.
+ * The calls are looked up at run time; where they are missing, or all cores are alike, it only
+ * raises the priority. */
+#ifdef _WIN32
+static inline void ps3_thread_on_fast_cores(void)
+{
+    typedef BOOL (WINAPI *get_sets_fn)(void*, ULONG, PULONG, HANDLE, ULONG);
+    typedef BOOL (WINAPI *set_sets_fn)(HANDLE, const ULONG*, ULONG);
+    typedef BOOL (WINAPI *set_info_fn)(HANDLE, int, void*, DWORD);
+    HMODULE k = GetModuleHandleA("kernel32.dll");
+    get_sets_fn get_sets = (get_sets_fn)(void*)GetProcAddress(k, "GetSystemCpuSetInformation");
+    set_sets_fn set_sets = (set_sets_fn)(void*)GetProcAddress(k, "SetThreadSelectedCpuSets");
+    set_info_fn set_info = (set_info_fn)(void*)GetProcAddress(k, "SetThreadInformation");
+    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_ABOVE_NORMAL);
+    if (set_info) {
+        struct { ULONG version, control, state; } off = { 1, 1 /* execution speed */, 0 };
+        set_info(GetCurrentThread(), 3 /* ThreadPowerThrottling */, &off, sizeof off);
+    }
+    if (!get_sets || !set_sets) return;
+    static unsigned char buf[32768];   /* filled once; a duplicate fill writes the same bytes */
+    ULONG len = 0;
+    if (!get_sets(buf, sizeof buf, &len, GetCurrentProcess(), 0)) return;
+    int best = -1, worst = 256;
+    ULONG ids[256], n = 0;
+    for (ULONG o = 0; o < len; ) {
+        const SYSTEM_CPU_SET_INFORMATION* c = (const SYSTEM_CPU_SET_INFORMATION*)(buf + o);
+        if (c->Size == 0) break;
+        if (c->Type == CpuSetInformation) {
+            const int e = c->CpuSet.EfficiencyClass;
+            if (e < worst) worst = e;
+            if (e > best) { best = e; n = 0; }
+            if (e == best && n < 256) ids[n++] = c->CpuSet.Id;
+        }
+        o += c->Size;
+    }
+    if (n && best != worst) set_sets(GetCurrentThread(), ids, n);
+}
+#else
+static inline void ps3_thread_on_fast_cores(void) {}
+#endif
+
 #endif /* PS3EMU_THREAD_NAME_H */

+static int atrac_open(AdecSlot* a)
+{
+    atrac_close(a);
+    a->ff = ps3_ffmpeg_get();
+    if (!a->ff) return 0;
+    const AVCodec* c = a->ff->avcodec_find_decoder(AV_CODEC_ID_ATRAC3P);

+}
+
+/* Write a decoded frame into a slot's PCM area, big-endian, interleaved. Returns the size. */
+static u32 atrac_store(const AdecSlot* a, const AVFrame* f, u32 pcm_ea)
+{
+    const u32 nch = a->nchOut ? a->nchOut : (u32)f->ch_layout.nb_channels;
+    const u32 samples = (u32)f->nb_samples > 2048u ? 2048u : (u32)f->nb_samples;
+    const u32 have = (u32)f->ch_layout.nb_channels;
+    u8* out = vm_base + pcm_ea;
+    const u32 bytes = a->wordFmt == ATX_WORD_16BIT ? 2u : a->wordFmt == ATX_WORD_24BIT ? 3u : 4u;
+    for (u32 s = 0; s < samples; s++) {
+        for (u32 c = 0; c < nch && c < 8; c++) {
+            const float v = c < have ? ((const float*)f->extended_data[c])[s] : 0.0f;
+            u32 w;
+            if (a->wordFmt == ATX_WORD_FLOAT || !a->wordFmt) {
+                memcpy(&w, &v, 4);
+            } else {
+                const float k = v > 1.0f ? 1.0f : v < -1.0f ? -1.0f : v;
+                w = (u32)(s32)(k * (a->wordFmt == ATX_WORD_16BIT ? 32767.0f : a->wordFmt == ATX_WORD_24BIT ? 8388607.0f : 2147483647.0f));
+            }
+            for (u32 b = 0; b < bytes; b++)
+                out[b] = (u8)(w >> (8 * (bytes - 1 - b)));
+            out += bytes;
+        }
+    }
+    return samples * nch * bytes;
+}
+
+/* Decode one access unit; 1 and its size if a block came out. */
+static int atrac_decode(AdecSlot* a, u32 addr, u32 size, u32 pcm_ea, u32* pcm_size)
+{
+    const u8* p = vm_base + addr;
+    /* The 8-byte ATS header, if the demuxer left it on: sync 0FD0, then 3 bits of sample rate,
+     * 3 of channel configuration and 10 of frame size. A title can leave all of them out of
+     * cellAdecStartSeq (GT5 passes 0 for both) and the decoder takes them from here. */
+    if (size >= 8 && p[0] == 0x0F && p[1] == 0xD0) {
+        static const u32 rates[8] = { 32000, 44100, 48000, 88200, 96000, 48000, 48000, 48000 };
+        const u32 v = (u32)p[2] << 8 | p[3];
+        const u32 cfg = v >> 10 & 7, nbytes = ((v & 0x3FF) + 1) * 8, rate = rates[v >> 13];
+        if (!a->av || cfg != a->chConfig || nbytes != a->nbytes || rate != a->sampleRate) {
+            a->chConfig = cfg;
+            a->nbytes = nbytes;
+            a->sampleRate = rate;
+            const int ok = atrac_open(a);
+            fprintf(stderr, "[cellAdec] ATRAC3plus stream %u Hz cfg=%u nbytes=%u decoder=%d%c", rate, cfg, nbytes, ok, 10);
+        }
+        p += 8;
+        size -= 8;
+    }
+    if (!a->av) return 0;
+    /* The decoder reads past the end of a packet, so it can't see guest memory directly. */
+    u8* copy = (u8*)malloc(size + AV_INPUT_BUFFER_PADDING_SIZE);
+    if (!copy) return 0;
+    memcpy(copy, p, size);
+    memset(copy + size, 0, AV_INPUT_BUFFER_PADDING_SIZE);
+    a->pkt->data = copy;
+    a->pkt->size = (int)size;
+    int got = 0;
+    if (a->ff->avcodec_send_packet(a->av, a->pkt) >= 0) {
+        while (a->ff->avcodec_receive_frame(a->av, a->frame) >= 0) {
+            *pcm_size = atrac_store(a, a->frame, pcm_ea);
+            got = 1;
+            a->ff->av_frame_unref(a->frame);
+        }
+    }
+    a->pkt->data = NULL;
+    a->pkt->size = 0;
+    free(copy);
+    return got;
+}
+#endif
+
+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * Decoder thread
+ * -----------------------------------------------------------------------*/
+
+static void adec_kick(AdecSlot* a)
+{
+#ifdef _WIN32
+    if (a->wake) SetEvent(a->wake);
+#else
+    (void)a;
+#endif
+}
+
+/* Lock held. */
+static void adec_post(AdecSlot* a, const AdecJob* job)
+{
+    a->jobs[(a->jobHead + a->jobCount) % ADEC_JOBS] = *job;
+    a->jobCount++;
+    adec_kick(a);
+}
+
+static void adec_run_au(CellAdecHandle handle, const AdecJob* job)
+{
+    AdecSlot* a = &s_adec[handle];
+    const u32 it = adec_slot_ea(a, a->written);
+    u32 pcm_size = 0;
+    int have = 0;
+#ifdef PS3RECOMP_FFMPEG_RUNTIME
+    if (adec_is_atrac(a->codecType))
+        have = atrac_decode(a, job->addr, job->size, it + SLOT_PCM, &pcm_size);
+#endif
+    if (!have) {
+        pcm_size = ADEC_SILENCE_BYTES;
+        for (u32 o = 0; o < pcm_size; o += 4) vm_write32(it + SLOT_PCM + o, 0);
+    }
+
+    a->auCount++;
+    vm_write32(it + PCMITEM_PCM_HANDLE, (u32)handle);
+    vm_write32(it + PCMITEM_STATUS,     0);              /* CELL_OK */
+    vm_write32(it + PCMITEM_START_ADDR, it + SLOT_PCM);
+    vm_write32(it + PCMITEM_SIZE,       pcm_size);
+    /* bsiInfo must point at a codec info block, not be null. Resistance:
+     * Fall of Man sizes each AC3 block from bsiInfo+0x14; with a null
+     * pointer that read address 0x14 and came back 0, so its ring buffer
+     * never filled, it never started its audio port, and its movie player
+     * waited forever. For ATRAC3plus it is { samplingFreq, channelConfigIndex, nbytes }. */
+    const u32 bsi = it + SLOT_BSI;
+    for (u32 o = 0; o < 0x40u; o += 4) vm_write32(bsi + o, 0);
+    if (adec_is_atrac(a->codecType)) {
+        vm_write32(bsi + 0x00, a->sampleRate ? a->sampleRate : 48000);
+        vm_write32(bsi + 0x04, a->chConfig);
+        vm_write32(bsi + 0x08, a->nbytes);
+    } else {
+        vm_write32(bsi + 0x14, pcm_size);
+    }
+    vm_write32(it + PCMITEM_BSI_INFO, bsi);
+    /* Echo the AU back, which is what a real decoder does -- the guest
+     * matches returned PCM against the AU it submitted. */
+    vm_write32(it + PCMITEM_AU_START,        job->addr);
+    vm_write32(it + PCMITEM_AU_SIZE,         job->size);
+    vm_write32(it + PCMITEM_AU_PTS_HI,       job->ptsHi);
+    vm_write32(it + PCMITEM_AU_PTS_LO,       job->ptsLo);
+    vm_write32(it + PCMITEM_AU_USERDATA,     job->userHi);
+    vm_write32(it + PCMITEM_AU_USERDATA + 4, job->userLo);
+    a->written++;
+
+    /* msgData is the AU INFO ADDRESS, not a status -- see RPCS3 Modules/cellAdec.cpp:1345.
+     * A decoder that tracks its outstanding AUs by address gets a null back otherwise. */
+    adec_notify(handle, CELL_ADEC_MSG_TYPE_AUDONE, (s32)job->auEa);
+    adec_notify(handle, CELL_ADEC_MSG_TYPE_PCMOUT, CELL_OK);
+}
+
+static void adec_worker_loop(CellAdecHandle handle)
+{
+    AdecSlot* a = &s_adec[handle];
+    for (;;) {
+        ADEC_LOCK();
+        if (a->workerStop) {
+            ADEC_UNLOCK();
+            return;
+        }
+        if (!a->jobCount) {
+            ADEC_UNLOCK();
+#ifdef _WIN32
+            WaitForSingleObject(a->wake, 50);
+#else
+            usleep(1000);
+#endif
+            continue;
+        }
+        const AdecJob job = a->jobs[a->jobHead];
+        a->jobHead = (a->jobHead + 1) % ADEC_JOBS;
+        a->jobCount--;
+        ADEC_UNLOCK();
+        switch (job.kind) {
+        case ADEC_JOB_AU:
+            adec_run_au(handle, &job);
+            break;
+        case ADEC_JOB_START: {
+#ifdef PS3RECOMP_FFMPEG_RUNTIME
+            const int ok = a->nbytes && a->chConfig ? atrac_open(a) : 0;
+#else
+            const int ok = 0;
+#endif
+            fprintf(stderr, "[cellAdec] ATRAC3plus cfg=%u nch_out=%u nbytes=%u fmt=0x%X decoder=%d%c", a->chConfig, a->nchOut,
+                    a->nbytes, a->wordFmt, ok, 10);
+            break;
+        }
+        default:
+            adec_notify(handle, CELL_ADEC_MSG_TYPE_SEQDONE, CELL_OK);
+            break;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#ifdef _WIN32
+static DWORD WINAPI adec_worker_thread(LPVOID arg)
+{
+    ps3_thread_name("cellAdec %u", (u32)(uintptr_t)arg);
+    ps3_thread_on_fast_cores();   /* a block is due every 43 ms */
+    adec_worker_loop((CellAdecHandle)(uintptr_t)arg);
+    return 0;
+}
+#else
+static void* adec_worker_thread(void* arg)
+{
+    adec_worker_loop((CellAdecHandle)(uintptr_t)arg);
+    return NULL;
+}
+#endif

+ *
+ *   pack header (00 00 01 BA), stuffing, optional system header (00 00 01 BB)
+ *   and private stream 2 (00 00 01 BF, names the video stream whose next access
+ *   unit is a random access point), then a PES packet: stream id, length, flags,
+ *   header length, timestamps, payload.

+ * the next 10 bits, plus an 8-byte header of its own.

+static int process_pack(u32 dslot, const u8* pack, u64 userData)
+{
+    const u32 code = (u32)pack[0] << 24 | pack[1] << 16 | pack[2] << 8 | pack[3];
+    if (code == 0x000001B9u) return 0;
+    if (code != 0x000001BAu) return 1;
+    u32 o = 14 + (pack[13] & 7);
+    /* System header, then maybe a private stream 2 naming the next random access point. */
+    if (o + 6 < PACK_SIZE && pack[o] == 0 && pack[o + 1] == 0 && pack[o + 2] == 1 && pack[o + 3] == 0xBB) {
+        o += 6 + ((u32)pack[o + 4] << 8 | pack[o + 5]);
+        if (o + 8 < PACK_SIZE && pack[o] == 0 && pack[o + 1] == 0 && pack[o + 2] == 1 && pack[o + 3] == 0xBF) {
+            const int es = find_es(dslot, pack[o + 6], 0);
+            if (es >= 0) s_es[es].nextRap = 1;
+            o += 6 + ((u32)pack[o + 4] << 8 | pack[o + 5]);
+        }
+    }
+    if (o + 9 >= PACK_SIZE || pack[o] != 0 || pack[o + 1] != 0 || pack[o + 2] != 1) return 1;
+    const u32 id = pack[o + 3];
+    const u32 pes_len = ((u32)pack[o + 4] << 8 | pack[o + 5]) + 6;
+    const u32 hdr_len = (u32)pack[o + 8] + 9;
+    if (o + pes_len > PACK_SIZE || pes_len <= hdr_len) return 1;
+    const u8* data = pack + o + hdr_len;
+    u32 size = pes_len - hdr_len;
+

+    if (id == 0xBD) {
+        if (size < 4) return 1;
+        es = find_es(dslot, 0xBD, data[0]);
+        if (es < 0) return 1;
+        data += 4;

+    } else if ((id & 0xF0) == 0xE0) {
+        es = find_es(dslot, id, 0);
+    }
+    if (es < 0) return 1;

+    const u8 flags = pack[o + 7];
+    if (flags & 0x80) e->nextPts = read_ts(pack + o + 9);

+ * offsets; the reader itself lives in the 128-byte CellPamfReader the title
+ * allocates, so nothing is kept on the host side.
+ *
+ * Header layout (offsets from the start of the file):
+ *   0x00 "PAMF", 0x04 version "0040"/"0041", 0x08 header size, 0x0C data size
+ *        (both in units of 2048 bytes)
+ *   0x50 sequence info: 0x56 start pts, 0x5C end pts (u16 high, u32 low),
+ *        0x62 mux rate bound (units of 50 bytes/s), 0x6E total stream count
+ *   0x70 grouping period, 0x82 group, 0x87 stream count of the group
+ *   0x88 stream headers, 48 bytes each
+ * Stream header: 0 coding type, 4 stream id, 5 private stream id, 8 offset of its
+ *   entry points in the file, 12 entry point count, 16 codec-specific info.
  */

+s32 cellPamfEpIteratorMove(u32 pIt, s32 steps, u32 pEp)
+{
+    const u32 index = vm_read32(pIt + 4), num = vm_read32(pIt + 8);
+    s32 target = (s32)index + steps;
+    if (target < 0) target = 0;
+    if (target >= (s32)num) target = (s32)num - 1;
+    steps = target - (s32)index;
+    vm_write32(pIt + 4, (u32)target);
+    vm_write32(pIt + 12, vm_read32(pIt + 12) + (u32)(steps * EP_SIZE));
+    if (pEp)
+        ep_unpack(vm_read32(pIt + 12), pEp);
+    return steps;
+}

 /*
  * ps3recomp - cellUsbd HLE implementation
  *
- * Stub. Init/term work, no USB devices are enumerated.
- * Games that require specific USB peripherals will need
- * proper device emulation.
+ * See cellUsbd.h. With no steering wheel on the PC (or PS3_WHEEL=off) this is
+ * what it always was: Init/End succeed and the bus stays empty.
+ *
+ * With a wheel, one emulated Logitech G27 (dev_id 1) sits on the bus. A worker
+ * thread plays libusbd's part: once a game driver is registered for 046D:C29B
+ * it calls the driver's probe and attach, answers its control transfers
+ * (standard requests; HID SET_REPORT goes to the force-feedback decoder),
+ * takes its interrupt OUT writes (force feedback), and completes its interrupt
+ * IN reads with the wheel's current report -- when the report changes, at most
+ * every 2 ms (the G27's bInterval), and every 8 ms regardless. Unplugging the
+ * PC wheel detaches the G27 and plugging it back attaches it again.
+ *
+ * Every callback into the game runs on the worker, never inside the call that
+ * queued the transfer: GT5's attach queues SET_CONFIGURATION and expects to
+ * finish attaching before the completion arrives, as on the console.
+ *
+ * GT5's callbacks only post an event to its USB thread's queue (40 events),
+ * and that thread queues the next read once it has handled a report. On a
+ * small PC at full load the thread falls behind, the queue fills with
+ * force-feedback completions, and a report's event can be dropped: the game
+ * then never asks for another and keeps the last one, the car steering and
+ * accelerating (or braking) on its own. So only one report at a time waits
+ * to be taken, and one not taken in 1.5 s goes again (a player's laptop at
+ * 20 fps, 15 Nov 2026; seen here with PS3_WHEEL=virtual, jitter=1 on four
+ * E-cores). PS3_WHEEL_TRACE=1 logs counts every 10 s.
+ *
+ * GT5 (BCES00569) walk-through, for the next person: probe 0xC21588 checks the
+ * device descriptor's VID:PID; attach 0xC21878 scans config/interface/endpoint
+ * descriptors, opens the control and both interrupt pipes, registers a custom
+ * pad (cellPadLddRegisterController) and sends SET_CONFIGURATION; its USB
+ * event thread (0xC20DC0) then starts the IN reads, decodes each report
+ * (0xC1EA58) into the custom pad and the game's wheel state, and sends force
+ * feedback through 0xC208E0 / 0xC20890.
  */

+    usbd_lock(&s_lock);

+    UsbdLdd* l = &s_ldd[s_ldd_count++];
+    l->ops = ops; l->vid = vid; l->pmin = pmin; l->pmax = pmax; l->any = any;
+    usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+    return CELL_OK;
+}

+/* The driver that wants our G27, or 0. Called with the lock held. */

+{

+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * Transfers

+static void complete(const UsbdXfer* x, s32 result, s32 count)
+{
+    if (!x->cb) return;
+    const unsigned long long t0 = usbd_now_us();
+    ppu_guest_call(x->cb, (uint64_t)(int64_t)result, (uint64_t)(int64_t)count, x->arg, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
+    /* A callback should only post an event to the driver's thread; a slow one holds up every
+     * report behind it (the wheel looks stuck in the game). */
+    const unsigned long long took = usbd_now_us() - t0;
+    static unsigned said;
+    if (took >= 100000 && said < 20) {
+        said++;
+        fprintf(stderr, "[cellUsbd] the game's %s callback took %llu ms\n",
+                x->ep == 0 ? "control" : (x->ep & 0x80) ? "report" : "force-feedback", took / 1000);
+    }
+}

+static s32 do_control(const UsbdXfer* x, s32* count)
+{
+    const u8 bm = x->setup[0], req = x->setup[1];
+    const u16 wValue = (u16)((x->setup[2] << 8) | x->setup[3]);
+    const u16 wLength = (u16)((x->setup[6] << 8) | x->setup[7]);
+    u8 out[256];
+    u32 n = 0;
+    *count = 0;
+    if (trace())
+        fprintf(stderr, "[cellUsbd] control %02X %02X value=%04X index=%02X%02X length=%u\n",
+                bm, req, wValue, x->setup[4], x->setup[5], wLength);
+    if (bm == 0x80 && req == 0x06) {                 /* GET_DESCRIPTOR */
+        const int type = wValue >> 8;
+        u8 blob[128];
+        const u32 len = wheel_g27_descriptors(blob, sizeof blob);
+        if (type == 1)      { n = 18; memcpy(out, blob, n); }
+        else if (type == 2) { n = len - 18; memcpy(out, blob + 18, n); }
+        else if (type == 3) { n = string_desc(wValue & 0xFF, out, sizeof out); if (!n) return CELL_USBD_EHCI_CC_HALTED; }
+        else return CELL_USBD_EHCI_CC_HALTED;
+    } else if (bm == 0x00 && req == 0x09) {          /* SET_CONFIGURATION */
+    } else if (bm == 0x01 && req == 0x0B) {          /* SET_INTERFACE */
+    } else if (bm == 0x21 && req == 0x0A) {          /* HID SET_IDLE */
+    } else if (bm == 0x21 && req == 0x09) {          /* HID SET_REPORT: an output report */
+        u8 data[64];
+        u32 len = wLength < sizeof data ? wLength : sizeof data;
+        if (x->buf && len) { vm_memcpy_from(data, x->buf, len); wheel_g27_output(data, len); }
+        *count = (s32)wLength;
+        return CELL_USBD_HC_CC_NOERR;
+    } else if (bm == 0xA1 && req == 0x01) {          /* HID GET_REPORT */
+        WheelInput in; wheel_host_read(&in);
+        n = (u32)wheel_g27_report(&in, out);
+    } else if (bm == 0x80 && req == 0x00) {          /* GET_STATUS */
+        out[0] = out[1] = 0; n = 2;
+    } else if (bm == 0x80 && req == 0x08) {          /* GET_CONFIGURATION */
+        out[0] = 1; n = 1;
+    } else {
+        if (trace()) fprintf(stderr, "[cellUsbd]   -> stall (not a request a G27 answers)\n");
+        return CELL_USBD_EHCI_CC_HALTED;
+    }
+    if (n > wLength) n = wLength;
+    if (n && x->buf) vm_memcpy_to(x->buf, out, n);
+    *count = (s32)n;
+    return CELL_USBD_HC_CC_NOERR;
+}

+static s32 queue_xfer(s32 pipe_id, const u8* setup, u32 buf, s32 len, u32 cb, u32 arg, int want_ctrl)
+{
+    if (!s_initialized) return (s32)CELL_USBD_ERROR_NOT_INITIALIZED;
+    usbd_lock(&s_lock);
+    if (pipe_id < 0 || pipe_id >= CELL_USBD_MAX_PIPES || !s_pipe[pipe_id].used || !s_present) {
+        usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+        return (s32)CELL_USBD_ERROR_PIPE_NOT_FOUND;
+    }
+    const UsbdPipe* p = &s_pipe[pipe_id];
+    if (want_ctrl != (p->ep == 0)) { usbd_unlock(&s_lock); return (s32)CELL_USBD_ERROR_INVALID_TRANSFER_TYPE; }
+    UsbdXfer x; memset(&x, 0, sizeof x);
+    x.pipe = pipe_id; x.ep = p->ep; x.buf = buf; x.len = len; x.cb = cb; x.arg = arg;
+    if (setup) memcpy(x.setup, setup, 8);
+    s32 rc = CELL_OK;
+    if (p->ep & 0x80) {
+        if (s_in_n < INCAP) { s_in[s_in_n++] = x; s_in_asks++; }
+        else rc = (s32)CELL_USBD_ERROR_IOREQ_NOT_ALLOCATED;
+        if (s_in_n > s_in_peak) s_in_peak = s_in_n;
+    } else {
+        if (s_q_n < QCAP) { s_q[(s_q_head + s_q_n) % QCAP] = x; s_q_n++; }
+        else rc = (s32)CELL_USBD_ERROR_IOREQ_NOT_ALLOCATED;
+    }
+    usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+    return rc;
+}

+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * Worker: libusbd's own thread
+ * -------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
+static void drop_device_state(void)
+{
+    usbd_lock(&s_lock);
+    s_present = 0;
+    s_attached = 0;
+    s_bound_ops = 0;
+    s_priv = 0;
+    memset(s_pipe, 0, sizeof s_pipe);
+    s_q_head = s_q_n = 0;   /* a gone device's transfers are not completed: the driver is gone too */
+    s_in_n = 0;
+    s_in_last_ok = 0;
+    usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+}
+
+static void try_attach(void)
+{
+    usbd_lock(&s_lock);
+    const u32 ops = ldd_for_wheel();
+    usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+    if (!ops || !desc_prepare()) return;
+    const u32 probe = vm_read32(ops + 4), attach = vm_read32(ops + 8);
+    static int refusals;   /* retried every few seconds: say so a few times, not forever */
+    s_present = 1;
+    s32 r = probe ? (s32)ppu_guest_call(probe, USBD_DEV_ID, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) : 0;
+    if (r != 0) {
+        if (refusals++ < 3) fprintf(stderr, "[cellUsbd] the game's driver turned the G27 down (probe -> %d)\n", r);
+        drop_device_state();
+        return;
+    }
+    usbd_lock(&s_lock);
+    s_bound_ops = ops;
+    usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+    r = attach ? (s32)ppu_guest_call(attach, USBD_DEV_ID, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) : -1;
+    if (r != 0) {
+        if (refusals++ < 3) fprintf(stderr, "[cellUsbd] the game's driver failed to attach the G27 (attach -> %d)\n", r);
+        drop_device_state();
+        return;
+    }
+    usbd_lock(&s_lock);
+    s_attached = 1;
+    usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+    fprintf(stderr, "[cellUsbd] Logitech G27 (emulated) attached to the game's driver\n");
+    fflush(stdout);
+}
+
+static void do_detach(void)
+{
+    usbd_lock(&s_lock);
+    const u32 ops = s_bound_ops;
+    /* Pending reads die with the device; the driver hears about it in detach. */
+    s_in_n = 0;
+    s_q_head = s_q_n = 0;
+    usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+    const u32 detach = ops ? vm_read32(ops + 12) : 0;
+    if (detach) ppu_guest_call(detach, USBD_DEV_ID, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
+    drop_device_state();
+    fprintf(stderr, "[cellUsbd] Logitech G27 (emulated) detached: the PC wheel went away\n");
+    fflush(stdout);
+}
+
+static void worker_step(unsigned long long* next_attach_us, unsigned long long* last_in_us,
+                        u8* last_report, int* have_last)
+{
+    WheelInput in;
+    const int conn = wheel_host_read(&in);
+    const unsigned long long now = usbd_now_us();
+
+    usbd_lock(&s_lock);
+    const int attached = s_attached, present = s_present, have_ldd = s_ldd_count > 0;
+    usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+    if (conn && !present && have_ldd && now >= *next_attach_us) {
+        *next_attach_us = now + 3000000ull;   /* if it fails, try again in a while */
+        try_attach();
+        *have_last = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    if (!conn && attached) { do_detach(); return; }
+    if (!present) return;
+
+    /* Control and OUT transfers, in order. The lock is never held across a
+     * call into the game: its callbacks queue the next transfer. */
+    for (;;) {
+        UsbdXfer x;
+        usbd_lock(&s_lock);
+        if (!s_q_n) { usbd_unlock(&s_lock); break; }
+        x = s_q[s_q_head];
+        s_q_head = (s_q_head + 1) % QCAP;
+        s_q_n--;
+        usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+        if (x.ep == 0) {
+            s32 count = 0;
+            const s32 res = do_control(&x, &count);
+            complete(&x, res, count);
+            s_done_ctl++;
+        } else {
+            s_done_out++;
+            u8 data[64];
+            const u32 len = (u32)(x.len < 0 ? 0 : (x.len > 64 ? 64 : x.len));
+            if (x.buf && len) { vm_memcpy_from(data, x.buf, len); wheel_g27_output(data, len); }
+            complete(&x, CELL_USBD_HC_CC_NOERR, x.len);
+        }
+    }
+
+    /* IN reads: a new report as soon as it changes (2 ms apart at most, the
+     * G27's polling interval), and the same one again every 8 ms. */
+    u8 rep[USBD_REPORT_LEN];
+    wheel_g27_report(&in, rep);
+    const int changed = !*have_last || memcmp(rep, last_report, USBD_REPORT_LEN) != 0;
+    const unsigned long long since = now - *last_in_us;
+    if (!((changed && since >= 2000) || since >= 8000)) return;
+    /* The game asks for the next report once its USB thread has taken the last one's "done"
+     * event from its queue; until then it keeps the last report, the rim and pedals where they
+     * were. When that event is lost (its queue was full) it never asks again and the wheel is
+     * stuck for good, so after 1.5 s the report goes again: on a read the game had queued
+     * besides, or on the last one once more. Only one report at a time waits to be taken, so
+     * one sent again can't double the rate. Both are said in the log. */
+    static int waiting_said;
+    static unsigned waits, resends;
+    UsbdXfer x;
+    int resend = 0;
+    usbd_lock(&s_lock);
+    const int taken = !s_in_last_ok || s_in_asks != s_in_asks_at_done;
+    if (!taken || !s_in_n) {
+        if (!taken && attached && since >= 1500000) {
+            resend = 1;
+            if (s_in_n) {
+                x = s_in[0];
+                memmove(&s_in[0], &s_in[1], (size_t)(s_in_n - 1) * sizeof s_in[0]);
+                s_in_n--;
+            } else x = s_in_last;
+        }
+        usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+        if (!resend) {
+            if (*have_last && attached && since >= 400000 && !waiting_said && waits < 20) {
+                waiting_said = 1; waits++;
+                fprintf(stderr, "[cellUsbd] the game has not asked for a wheel report for %llu ms: it keeps the last "
+                                "one (rim and pedals stuck there) until it does\n", since / 1000);
+            }
+            return;
+        }
+        if (resends++ < 20)
+            fprintf(stderr, "[cellUsbd] the game's USB thread never took the last wheel report (%llu ms): sending "
+                            "it again\n", since / 1000);
+    } else {
+        if (waiting_said) {
+            waiting_said = 0;
+            fprintf(stderr, "[cellUsbd] the game asks for wheel reports again, after %llu ms\n", since / 1000);
+        }
+        x = s_in[0];
+        memmove(&s_in[0], &s_in[1], (size_t)(s_in_n - 1) * sizeof s_in[0]);
+        s_in_n--;
+        usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+    }
+    usbd_lock(&s_lock);
+    s_in_last = x;
+    s_in_last_ok = 1;
+    s_in_asks_at_done = s_in_asks;
+    usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+    s32 n = x.len < USBD_REPORT_LEN ? x.len : USBD_REPORT_LEN;
+    if (n < 0) n = 0;
+    if (x.buf && n) vm_memcpy_to(x.buf, rep, (size_t)n);
+    memcpy(last_report, rep, USBD_REPORT_LEN);
+    *have_last = 1;
+    *last_in_us = now;
+    if (trace()) {
+        static unsigned lines;
+        if (lines++ < 40)
+            fprintf(stderr, "[cellUsbd] report %02X %02X %02X %02X %02X %02X %02X %02X %02X %02X %02X\n",
+                    rep[0], rep[1], rep[2], rep[3], rep[4], rep[5], rep[6], rep[7], rep[8], rep[9], rep[10]);
+        /* Every 10 s: how many reports the game took, and how many of them were new. */
+        static unsigned long long stat_from;
+        static unsigned taken, fresh, stat_lines;
+        taken++; fresh += changed;
+        if (!stat_from) stat_from = now;
+        if (now - stat_from >= 10000000ull) {
+            usbd_lock(&s_lock);
+            const int peak = s_in_peak;
+            s_in_peak = s_in_n;
+            usbd_unlock(&s_lock);
+            if (stat_lines++ < 360)
+                fprintf(stderr, "[cellUsbd] the game took %u wheel reports in %llu s, %u of them new; up to %d reads "
+                                "asked for at once; %u force-feedback writes, %u control transfers\n",
+                        taken, (now - stat_from) / 1000000ull, fresh, peak, s_done_out, s_done_ctl);
+            stat_from = now; taken = fresh = 0; s_done_out = s_done_ctl = 0;
+        }
+    }
+    /* PS3_WHEEL_TEST_LOSE=N (tests): every Nth report's "done" never reaches the game, as when
+     * its event queue is full, to check that the wheel comes back by itself. */
+    static long lose_every = -1;
+    static unsigned long reports;
+    if (lose_every < 0) { const char* e = getenv("PS3_WHEEL_TEST_LOSE"); lose_every = e ? atol(e) : 0; }
+    if (lose_every > 0 && !resend && ++reports % (unsigned long)lose_every == 0) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[cellUsbd] test: report %lu's \"done\" left out (PS3_WHEEL_TEST_LOSE)\n", reports);
+        return;
+    }
+    complete(&x, CELL_USBD_HC_CC_NOERR, n);
+}

+/* The next descriptor of `type` after the one at ptr_ea (from the start when
+ * ptr_ea is 0), or 0. */
+u32 cellUsbdScanStaticDescriptor(s32 dev_id, u32 ptr_ea, u8 type)
+{
+    if (dev_id != USBD_DEV_ID || !s_present || !s_desc_ready) return 0;
+    const u32 begin = USBD_DESC_EA, end = USBD_DESC_EA + s_desc_len;
+    u32 p = begin;
+    if (ptr_ea) {
+        if (ptr_ea < begin || ptr_ea >= end) return 0;
+        const u8 len = vm_read8(ptr_ea);
+        if (!len) return 0;
+        p = ptr_ea + len;
+    }
+    while (p + 2 <= end) {
+        const u8 len = vm_read8(p);
+        if (len < 2) break;
+        if (vm_read8(p + 1) == type) return p;
+        p += len;
+    }
+    return 0;
+}

+    if (!s_initialized) return (s32)CELL_USBD_ERROR_NOT_INITIALIZED;
+    usbd_lock(&s_lock);

+        for (int i = 0; i < s_in_n; ) {
+            if (s_in[i].pipe == pipe_id) {

+                s_in_n--;

+        rc = CELL_OK;

+    usbd_unlock(&s_lock);

 /*
  * ps3recomp - cellUsbd HLE
  *
- * USB device access. Stub — init/term work, device enumeration
- * returns empty, transfers return NOT_FOUND.
+ * USB device access for a game's own device drivers (LDDs). A game registers
+ * a CellUsbdLddOps {name, probe, attach, detach}; libusbd calls probe and then
+ * attach for each device that matches, on a thread of its own, and the driver
+ * then opens pipes and runs control / interrupt transfers whose completion
+ * callbacks also come from that thread.
+ *
+ * The only device here is an emulated Logitech G27 racing wheel, and only
+ * when a steering wheel is found on the PC (see wheel.h). Otherwise the bus
+ * is empty, as before.
+ *
+ * Every pointer argument is a guest effective address. Callbacks are guest
+ * OPDs: probe/attach/detach(int32 dev_id) -> int, and transfer completion
+ * done(int32 result, int32 count, void* arg).

+/*
+ * ps3recomp - the emulated Logitech G27 (see wheel.h)
+ *
+ * Descriptors: a G27 in its native mode (046D:C29B, bcdDevice 0x1350), as GT5
+ * expects to find one. GT5's attach (0xC21878) reads them through
+ * cellUsbdScanStaticDescriptor and opens the interrupt pipes it finds; its
+ * "genuine device" check after SET_CONFIGURATION wants bMaxPacketSize0 > 8.
+ *
+ * Input report, 11 bytes, as GT5's decoder (0xC1FCE8) reads it:
+ *   0  bits 0-3 hat (8 = centred), 4 cross, 5 square, 6 circle, 7 triangle
+ *   1  R1, L1, R2, L2, select, start, R3, L3 (bits 0-7)
+ *   2  bits 0-5 gears 1-6, 6 dial clockwise, 7 dial anticlockwise
+ *   3  bit 0 plus, bit 1 minus, bits 2-7 steering bits 0-5
+ *   4  steering bits 6-13 (0 = full left, 0x2000 centre, 0x3FFF full right)
+ *   5  throttle, 6 brake, 7 clutch (0xFF released, 0x00 floored)
+ *   8  shifter X, 9 shifter Y
+ *   10 bit 0 reverse, 1 pedals detached, 2 powered, 3 shifter attached,
+ *      4 always set, 6 shifter pressed down, 7 range above 360 degrees
+ *
+ * Output: Logitech's "classic" force-feedback protocol, 7-byte commands. The
+ * high nibble of byte 0 picks force slots 0-3, the low nibble is the command;
+ * 0xF8 starts an extended command (byte 1). The decoder keeps the four slots
+ * and the default spring in a WheelFfb, which the host side mirrors onto the
+ * PC wheel's own effects.
+ */
+#include "wheel.h"
+#include <stdio.h>
+#include <stdlib.h>
+#include <string.h>
+#include <time.h>
+
+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * A small lock: the game's USB event thread writes commands, the host wheel
+ * thread takes snapshots.
+ * -------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
+static volatile char s_lock;
+static void g27_lock(void)   { while (__atomic_test_and_set(&s_lock, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) { } }
+static void g27_unlock(void) { __atomic_clear(&s_lock, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); }
+
+static WheelFfb s_ffb;
+
+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * Descriptors
+ * -------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
+static const u8 k_g27_desc[] = {
+    /* device */
+    18, 0x01, 0x00, 0x02,       /* USB 2.0 */
+    0x00, 0x00, 0x00,           /* class per interface */
+    16,                         /* bMaxPacketSize0 */
+    0x6D, 0x04, 0x9B, 0xC2,     /* 046D:C29B */
+    0x50, 0x13,                 /* bcdDevice 13.50 */
+    1, 2, 0,                    /* manufacturer, product, no serial */
+    1,                          /* one configuration */
+    /* configuration */
+    9, 0x02, 41, 0x00, 1, 1, 4, 0x80, 0x31,
+    /* interface 0: HID, two endpoints */
+    9, 0x04, 0, 0, 2, 0x03, 0x00, 0x00, 0,
+    /* HID 1.11, report descriptor 133 bytes */
+    9, 0x21, 0x11, 0x01, 0x21, 1, 0x22, 0x85, 0x00,
+    /* interrupt IN 0x81 and OUT 0x01, 16 bytes, every 2 ms */
+    7, 0x05, 0x81, 0x03, 16, 0, 2,
+    7, 0x05, 0x01, 0x03, 16, 0, 2,
+};
+
+u32 wheel_g27_descriptors(u8* out, u32 cap)
+{
+    u32 n = (u32)sizeof(k_g27_desc);
+    if (n > cap) n = cap;
+    memcpy(out, k_g27_desc, n);
+    return n;
+}
+
+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * Input report
+ * -------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
+static int env_int(const char* name, int def)
+{
+    const char* e = getenv(name);
+    return (e && *e) ? atoi(e) : def;
+}
+
+/* Lever position per gear, as a G27 shifter reports it. */
+static const u8 k_shift_xy[8][2] = {
+    { 0x80, 0x80 },                 /* neutral */
+    { 0x30, 0xB7 }, { 0x30, 0x32 }, /* 1, 2 */
+    { 0x80, 0xB7 }, { 0x80, 0x32 }, /* 3, 4 */
+    { 0xB3, 0xB7 }, { 0xB3, 0x32 }, /* 5, 6 */
+    { 0xAA, 0x32 },                 /* reverse */
+};
+
+static u8 pedal_byte(float v)
+{
+    if (v < 0.f) v = 0.f;
+    if (v > 1.f) v = 1.f;
+    return (u8)(255 - (int)(v * 255.f + 0.5f));
+}
+
+int wheel_g27_report(const WheelInput* in, u8 r[11])
+{
+    static int host_range = -1;
+    if (host_range < 0) {
+        host_range = env_int("PS3_WHEEL_RANGE", 900);
+        if (host_range < 90 || host_range > 3600) host_range = 900;
+    }
+    memset(r, 0, 11);
+    const u32 b = in->buttons;
+    const int hat = (in->hat >= 0 && in->hat < 8) ? in->hat : 8;
+    r[0] = (u8)(hat | ((b & 0xF) << 4));                       /* cross..triangle */
+    r[1] = (u8)((b >> WHEEL_BTN_R1) & 0xFF);                   /* R1..L3 */
+    r[2] = (u8)(((b >> WHEEL_BTN_GEAR1) & 0x3F)
+              | (((b >> WHEEL_BTN_DIAL_CW) & 1) << 6)
+              | (((b >> WHEEL_BTN_DIAL_CCW) & 1) << 7));
+
+    /* The game's rotation, if it set one: the G27 reports full lock at half its
+     * range, so a 900-degree PC wheel driving a 200-degree G27 reaches the stop
+     * at 100 degrees and saturates past it, as the real wheel would. */
+    int game_range = __atomic_load_n(&s_ffb.range_deg, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
+    if (game_range < 40 || game_range > 3600) game_range = host_range;
+    float s = in->steer_g27 ? in->steer : in->steer * (float)host_range / (float)game_range;
+    if (s < -1.f) s = -1.f;
+    if (s > 1.f) s = 1.f;
+    int st = 0x2000 + (int)(s * 8192.f);
+    if (st < 0) st = 0;
+    if (st > 0x3FFF) st = 0x3FFF;
+    r[3] = (u8)(((b >> WHEEL_BTN_PLUS) & 1) | (((b >> WHEEL_BTN_MINUS) & 1) << 1) | ((st & 0x3F) << 2));
+    r[4] = (u8)(st >> 6);
+
+    r[5] = pedal_byte(in->throttle);
+    r[6] = pedal_byte(in->brake);
+    r[7] = pedal_byte(in->clutch);
+
+    int gear = 0;
+    for (int g = 0; g < 6; g++) if (b & (1u << (WHEEL_BTN_GEAR1 + g))) gear = g + 1;
+    const int rev = (b >> WHEEL_BTN_GEAR_R) & 1;
+    if (rev) gear = 7;
+    r[8] = k_shift_xy[gear][0];
+    r[9] = k_shift_xy[gear][1];
+    r[10] = (u8)(rev | 0x04 | (in->shifter ? 0x08 : 0) | 0x10 | (rev ? 0x40 : 0)
+               | (game_range > 360 ? 0x80 : 0));
+    return 11;
+}
+
+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * Force feedback
+ * -------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
+static float f_level(u8 v)     /* 0x80 is no force; 0x7F counts as none too */
+{
+    if (v == 0x7F || v == 0x80) return 0.f;
+    float f = ((float)v - 128.f) / 127.f;
+    return f < -1.f ? -1.f : (f > 1.f ? 1.f : f);
+}
+static float f_pos8(u8 v)      { return ((float)v - 127.5f) / 127.5f; }
+static float f_pos11(int v)    { return ((float)v - 1023.5f) / 1023.5f; }
+static float f_k(int k, int sign, int bits)
+{
+    const float max = (float)((1 << bits) - 1);
+    float f = (float)k / max;
+    return sign ? -f : f;
+}
+
+static void spring_from(WheelEffect* e, float d1, float d2, float k1, float k2, float sat)
+{
+    e->type = WHEEL_FX_SPRING;
+    if (d2 < d1) { float t = d1; d1 = d2; d2 = t; }
+    e->center = (d1 + d2) * 0.5f;
+    e->deadband = (d2 - d1) * 0.5f;
+    e->k_neg = k1;
+    e->k_pos = k2;
+    e->sat = sat;
+}
+
+/* Byte 1 is the force type, bytes 2-6 its parameters. `slot` matters for the
+ * constant force (each slot has its own level byte) and the variable force. */
+static int decode_effect(const u8* c, int slot, WheelEffect* e)
+{
+    const int playing = e->playing;
+    memset(e, 0, sizeof(*e));
+    e->playing = playing;
+    switch (c[1]) {
+    case 0x00:  /* constant: level per slot in bytes 2-5 */
+        e->type = WHEEL_FX_CONSTANT;
+        e->level = f_level(c[2 + (slot & 3)]);
+        return 1;
+    case 0x01:  /* spring: dead band D1/D2, K1/K2 (3 bits), S1/S2, clip */
+        spring_from(e, f_pos8(c[2]), f_pos8(c[3]),
+                    f_k(c[4] & 7, c[5] & 1, 3), f_k((c[4] >> 4) & 7, (c[5] >> 4) & 1, 3),
+                    (float)c[6] / 255.f);
+        return 1;
+    case 0x0B: { /* high-resolution spring: 11-bit dead band, 4-bit K */
+        const int d1 = (c[2] << 3) | ((c[5] >> 1) & 7);
+        const int d2 = (c[3] << 3) | ((c[5] >> 5) & 7);
+        spring_from(e, f_pos11(d1), f_pos11(d2),
+                    f_k(c[4] & 15, c[5] & 1, 4), f_k((c[4] >> 4) & 15, (c[5] >> 4) & 1, 4),
+                    (float)c[6] / 255.f);
+        return 1; }
+    case 0x03:  /* auto-centre spring: K1/K2 (3 bits), clip */
+        spring_from(e, 0.f, 0.f, f_k(c[2] & 7, 0, 3), f_k(c[3] & 7, 0, 3), (float)c[4] / 255.f);
+        return 1;
+    case 0x0D:  /* high-resolution auto-centre spring */
+        spring_from(e, 0.f, 0.f, f_k(c[2] & 15, 0, 4), f_k(c[3] & 15, 0, 4), (float)c[4] / 255.f);
+        return 1;
+    case 0x02:  /* damper: K1, S1, K2, S2 (3 bits), no clip */
+        e->type = WHEEL_FX_DAMPER;
+        e->k_neg = f_k(c[2] & 7, c[3] & 1, 3);
+        e->k_pos = f_k(c[4] & 7, c[5] & 1, 3);
+        e->sat = 1.f;
+        return 1;
+    case 0x0C:  /* high-resolution damper: 4-bit K, clip */
+        e->type = WHEEL_FX_DAMPER;
+        e->k_neg = f_k(c[2] & 15, c[3] & 1, 4);
+        e->k_pos = f_k(c[4] & 15, c[5] & 1, 4);
+        e->sat = (float)c[6] / 255.f;
+        return 1;
+    case 0x0E:  /* friction: K1, K2 (8 bits), clip, S1/S2 */
+        e->type = WHEEL_FX_FRICTION;
+        e->k_neg = f_k(c[2], c[5] & 1, 8);
+        e->k_pos = f_k(c[3], (c[5] >> 4) & 1, 8);
+        e->sat = (float)c[4] / 255.f;
+        return 1;
+    case 0x04:  /* sawtooth up / down: L1 high, L2 low, L0 start, T/I in byte 6 */
+    case 0x05: {
+        const int hi = c[2], lo = c[3];
+        const int t = (c[6] >> 4) & 15, inc = c[6] & 15;
+        e->type = c[1] == 0x04 ? WHEEL_FX_SAW_UP : WHEEL_FX_SAW_DOWN;
+        e->magnitude = (float)abs(hi - lo) / 255.f;
+        e->offset = f_level((u8)((hi + lo) / 2));
+        e->period_ms = (u32)(abs(hi - lo) / (inc ? inc : 1) * (t ? t : 1) * 2);
+        return 1; }
+    case 0x06:  /* trapezoid: L1, L2, T1 at L1, T2 at L2, slope in byte 6 */
+    case 0x07: { /* rectangle: L1, L2, T1, T2, phase */
+        const int hi = c[2], lo = c[3];
+        e->type = c[1] == 0x06 ? WHEEL_FX_TRIANGLE : WHEEL_FX_SQUARE;
+        e->magnitude = (float)abs(hi - lo) / 255.f;
+        e->offset = f_level((u8)((hi + lo) / 2));
+        e->period_ms = (u32)((c[4] + c[5]) * 2);
+        return 1; }
+    case 0x0A:  /* square: amplitude, 16-bit half period, count */
+        e->type = WHEEL_FX_SQUARE;
+        e->magnitude = (float)c[2] / 255.f;
+        e->period_ms = (u32)((c[3] | (c[4] << 8)) * 2);
+        return 1;
+    case 0x08:  /* variable force: slots 0 and 2 only, level L1 / L2 */
+    case 0x09:  /* ramp: start from L1 */
+        e->type = WHEEL_FX_CONSTANT;
+        e->level = f_level((slot & 2) ? c[3] : c[2]);
+        return 1;
+    default:
+        return 0;
+    }
+}
+
+/* Logging, so a player's logs\play.err says what the game asked of the wheel:
+ * every command once it is decoded, except the two the game repeats many times
+ * a second in a race (the steering force and the rev lights), which are summed
+ * up every 30 s instead. PS3_WHEEL_TRACE=1 logs those one by one as well. */
+static unsigned s_trace_lines;
+static struct { unsigned n, leds; float lo, hi; time_t t0; } s_sum;
+
+static void sum_flush(int force)
+{
+    const time_t now = time(NULL);
+    if (!s_sum.t0) s_sum.t0 = now;
+    if (!force && now - s_sum.t0 < 30) return;
+    if (s_sum.n || s_sum.leds)
+        fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] ffb last %lds: %u steering-force updates (level %+.2f..%+.2f), %u rev-light updates\n",
+                (long)(now - s_sum.t0), s_sum.n, s_sum.n ? s_sum.lo : 0.f, s_sum.n ? s_sum.hi : 0.f, s_sum.leds);
+    memset(&s_sum, 0, sizeof s_sum);
+    s_sum.t0 = now;
+}
+
+static void trace_cmd(const char* what, const u8* c)
+{
+    if (s_trace_lines >= (wheel_trace_on() ? 20000u : 400u)) return;
+    s_trace_lines++;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] ffb %-10s %02X %02X %02X %02X %02X %02X %02X\n",
+            what, c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4], c[5], c[6]);
+}
+
+/* The steering force and rev lights: one by one only with PS3_WHEEL_TRACE. */
+static void note_frequent(const char* what, const u8* c, int is_force, float level)
+{
+    if (is_force) {
+        if (!s_sum.n || level < s_sum.lo) s_sum.lo = level;
+        if (!s_sum.n || level > s_sum.hi) s_sum.hi = level;
+        s_sum.n++;
+    } else {
+        s_sum.leds++;
+    }
+    if (wheel_trace_on()) trace_cmd(what, c);
+    sum_flush(0);
+}
+
+/* One 7-byte command. Returns 1 if the effect state changed. */
+static int g27_command(const u8* c)
+{
+    if (c[0] == 0xF8) {   /* extended */
+        switch (c[1]) {
+        case 0x02: s_ffb.range_deg = 200; trace_cmd("range200", c); return 1;
+        case 0x03: s_ffb.range_deg = 900; trace_cmd("range900", c); return 1;
+        case 0x81: s_ffb.range_deg = c[2] | (c[3] << 8); trace_cmd("range", c); return 1;
+        case 0x12: note_frequent("leds", c, 0, 0.f); return 0;   /* rev lights */
+        default:   trace_cmd("ext", c); return 0;           /* mode switches: already native */
+        }
+    }
+    const int cmd = c[0] & 0x0F, mask = c[0] >> 4;
+    int changed = 0;
+    switch (cmd) {
+    case 0x0:   /* download */
+    case 0x1:   /* download and play */
+    case 0xC:   /* refresh */
+        for (int s = 0; s < WHEEL_FFB_SLOTS; s++) {
+            if (!(mask & (1 << s))) continue;
+            WheelEffect* e = &s_ffb.slot[s];
+            const int was = e->type;
+            if (!decode_effect(c, s, e)) { trace_cmd("type?", c); continue; }
+            if (cmd == 0x0) e->playing = 0;
+            if (cmd == 0x1) e->playing = 1;
+            if (cmd == 0xC && was == WHEEL_FX_NONE) e->playing = 1;  /* refresh of an empty slot starts it */
+            changed = 1;
+        }
+        if (changed) {
+            const char* what = cmd == 0 ? "download" : cmd == 1 ? "dl+play" : "refresh";
+            /* Constant / variable / ramp: the race's steering force, many a second. */
+            if (c[1] == 0x00 || c[1] == 0x08 || c[1] == 0x09) {
+                int s = 0;
+                while (s < WHEEL_FFB_SLOTS - 1 && !(mask & (1 << s))) s++;
+                note_frequent(what, c, 1, s_ffb.slot[s].level);
+            } else {
+                trace_cmd(what, c);
+            }
+        }
+        break;
+    case 0x2:   /* play */
+    case 0x3:   /* stop */
+        for (int s = 0; s < WHEEL_FFB_SLOTS; s++)
+            if (mask & (1 << s)) { s_ffb.slot[s].playing = cmd == 0x2; changed = 1; }
+        trace_cmd(cmd == 2 ? "play" : "stop", c);
+        break;
+    case 0x4:   /* default spring on */
+    case 0x5:   /* default spring off */
+        s_ffb.def_spring_on = cmd == 0x4;
+        changed = 1;
+        trace_cmd(cmd == 4 ? "defspr on" : "defspr off", c);
+        break;
+    case 0xE:   /* set default spring: K1, K2 (3 bits), clip */
+        spring_from(&s_ffb.def_spring, 0.f, 0.f, f_k(c[2] & 7, 0, 3), f_k(c[3] & 7, 0, 3),
+                    (float)c[4] / 255.f);
+        changed = 1;
+        trace_cmd("defspr set", c);
+        break;
+    default:    /* 0x8 normal mode, 0x9 LED, 0xA watchdog, 0xB raw, 0xD loop, 0xF dead band */
+        trace_cmd("other", c);
+        break;
+    }
+    return changed;
+}
+
+void wheel_g27_output(const u8* data, u32 len)
+{
+    if (!data || len < 7) return;
+    /* Refreshes of the constant force are most of the traffic in a race;
+     * trace the first few and then only every 64th, so the log stays small. */
+    static unsigned n;
+    if (wheel_trace_on() && (n++ < 64 || (n & 63) == 0) && s_trace_lines < 4000) {
+        s_trace_lines++;
+        fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] out len=%u:", len);
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < len && i < 16; i++) fprintf(stderr, " %02X", data[i]);
+        fprintf(stderr, "\n");
+    }
+    g27_lock();
+    int changed = g27_command(data);
+    if (changed) s_ffb.gen++;
+    g27_unlock();
+    if (changed) wheel_host_ffb_changed();
+}
+
+/* Is the game at its menus? GT5 keeps a centring spring playing in a slot there
+ * (`21 0B 7F 7F 77 00 80`, from the moment its driver takes the wheel) and stops it as a race
+ * loads (`23 0B ...`); in the race it only plays the steering force (`11 08 xx 80`), which it
+ * also stops and restarts now and then, and through the start countdown. So the spring, not
+ * the steering force, tells menus from driving. The host side uses this to let a wheel with
+ * no d-pad move through menus without touching the race (wheel_host_win.c). */
+int wheel_g27_in_menus(void)
+{
+    int on = 0;
+    g27_lock();
+    for (int s = 0; s < WHEEL_FFB_SLOTS; s++)
+        if (s_ffb.slot[s].playing && s_ffb.slot[s].type == WHEEL_FX_SPRING) on = 1;
+    g27_unlock();
+    return on;
+}
+
+void wheel_g27_ffb_snapshot(WheelFfb* out)
+{
+    g27_lock();
+    *out = s_ffb;
+    g27_unlock();
+}
+
+void wheel_g27_reset(void)
+{
+    g27_lock();
+    const u32 gen = s_ffb.gen;
+    memset(&s_ffb, 0, sizeof(s_ffb));
+    /* Power-on: the wheel's own centring spring is on until a game turns it off. */
+    spring_from(&s_ffb.def_spring, 0.f, 0.f, f_k(3, 0, 3), f_k(3, 0, 3), 1.f);
+    s_ffb.def_spring_on = 1;
+    s_ffb.gen = gen + 1;
+    g27_unlock();
+    wheel_host_ffb_changed();
+}
```
