+/* Guest size -> image size at scale rs, and a guest edge -> an image edge (the same rounding for every edge, so
+ * rectangles that meet still meet). Both return their argument for rs == 1. */
+static u32 eng_rs_hs(u32 v, float rs)
+{
+    if (rs == 1.0f) return v;
+    const u32 r = (u32)((float)v * rs + 0.5f);
+    return r ? r : (v ? 1u : 0u);
+}
+static u32 eng_rs_he(u32 v, float rs)
+{
+    return rs == 1.0f ? v : (u32)((float)v * rs + 0.5f);
+}
+/* A guest rectangle (x, y, w, h) of a target at scale rs as image texels, by its edges, inside iw x ih. */
+static void eng_rs_rect(const u32 in[4], float rs, u32 iw, u32 ih, u32 out[4])
+{
+    u32 x0 = eng_rs_he(in[0], rs), y0 = eng_rs_he(in[1], rs);
+    u32 x1 = eng_rs_he(in[0] + in[2], rs), y1 = eng_rs_he(in[1] + in[3], rs);
+    if (x1 > iw) x1 = iw;
+    if (y1 > ih) y1 = ih;
+    if (x0 > x1) x0 = x1;
+    if (y0 > y1) y0 = y1;
+    out[0] = x0; out[1] = y0; out[2] = x1 - x0; out[3] = y1 - y0;
+}
+static float eng_rs_clamp(float s)
+{
+    if (!(s > 0.0f)) return 1.0f;                    /* 0, negative, NaN */
+    if (s < ENG_RS_MIN_SCALE) s = ENG_RS_MIN_SCALE;
+    if (s > ENG_RS_MAX_SCALE) s = ENG_RS_MAX_SCALE;
+    if (s > 0.999f && s < 1.001f) s = 1.0f;
+    return s;
+}
+static int eng_rs_allowed(void) { return g.be && g.be->rs_max_dim; }
+static u32 eng_rs_parse_offsets(const char* e, u32* out, u32 cap)
+{
+    u32 n = 0;
+    while (e && *e && n < cap) {
+        char* end = NULL;
+        const unsigned long v = strtoul(e, &end, 16);
+        if (end == e) break;
+        out[n++] = (u32)v;
+        e = end;
+        while (*e == ',' || *e == ' ' || *e == ';') e++;
+    }
+    return n;
+}
+/* The test switches, as DirectX 12 has them (read once):
+ *   LD_RES_AA=1           a 2x2 antialiased target's grid is multiplied too (supersampling);
+ *   LD_RES_MIN=<w>x<h>    the smallest guest pixel size scaled (default half the mode's width by 4/5 of its height);
+ *   LD_RES_SKIP / LD_RES_ONLY=<hex offset>[,...]   surfaces left at / the only ones taken off the guest's size;
+ *   LD_RES_ZSYNC=0        a zeta's entries are not kept at one guest size;
+ *   LD_RES_DEPTH_RULE=0   passes that write no colour run at their colour target's scale whatever their clip;
+ *   LD_RES_PASSLOG=0      no "[res-scale] pass" lines;
+ *   LD_RES_CYCLE=<s>      switch between the scale asked for (2 when none) and 1 every s seconds. */
+static void eng_rs_switches(void)
+{
+    if (s_rs.read) return;
+    s_rs.read = 1;
+    const char* e;
+    s_rs.aa_mul = (e = getenv("LD_RES_AA")) != NULL && atoi(e) != 0;
+    unsigned mw = 0, mh = 0;
+    if ((e = getenv("LD_RES_MIN")) != NULL && sscanf(e, "%ux%u", &mw, &mh) == 2 && mw && mh) { s_rs.min_w = mw; s_rs.min_h = mh; }
+    s_rs.depth_rule = !((e = getenv("LD_RES_DEPTH_RULE")) != NULL && e[0] == '0');
+    s_rs.zsync = !((e = getenv("LD_RES_ZSYNC")) != NULL && e[0] == '0');
+    s_rs.passlog = !((e = getenv("LD_RES_PASSLOG")) != NULL && e[0] == '0');
+    s_rs.n_skip = eng_rs_parse_offsets(getenv("LD_RES_SKIP"), s_rs.skip, 16u);
+    s_rs.n_only = eng_rs_parse_offsets(getenv("LD_RES_ONLY"), s_rs.only, 16u);
+    s_rs.cycle_ms = (e = getenv("LD_RES_CYCLE")) != NULL && atoi(e) > 0 ? (u32)atoi(e) * 1000u : 0u;
+}
+/* The scale a NEW surface of guest size w x h is made at (rsx_live_draw.c ld_rs_pick, the same rule); aa_sx x aa_sy
+ * is its sample grid. Scaled: at least 4/5 of the video mode's height and half its width, counted in pixels (GT5: the
+ * display buffers, the scene inside its display margin, the 2048-wide post-processing targets that hold the whole
+ * picture); not both sides powers of two (shadow maps, cube faces, lookup tables). A 2x2 grid already holds twice the
+ * pixels each way, so the scale counts from pixels there (LD_RES_AA=1: multiplied as well). No image wider or taller
+ * than the backend's limit or larger than ENG_RS_MAX_TEXELS: such a surface gets the largest scale that fits. */
+static float eng_rs_pick(u32 location, u32 w, u32 h, u32 aa_sx, u32 aa_sy)
+{
+    (void)location;
+    if (!s_rs.on || !w || !h) return 1.0f;
+    if (!aa_sx) aa_sx = 1u;
+    if (!aa_sy) aa_sy = 1u;
+    const u32 pw = w / aa_sx, ph = h / aa_sy;
+    const u32 min_w = s_rs.min_w ? s_rs.min_w : g.width / 2u;
+    const u32 min_h = s_rs.min_h ? s_rs.min_h : g.height * 4u / 5u;
+    if (pw < min_w || ph < min_h) return 1.0f;
+    if (!(pw & (pw - 1u)) && !(ph & (ph - 1u))) return 1.0f;
+    float rs = s_rs.user;
+    if (rs > 1.0f && !s_rs.aa_mul && aa_sx > 1u && aa_sy > 1u) {
+        rs /= (float)(aa_sx < aa_sy ? aa_sx : aa_sy);
+        if (rs < 1.0f) rs = 1.0f;
+    }
+    const u32 lim = g.be->rs_max_dim;
+    const float side = (float)lim / (float)(w > h ? w : h);
+    if (rs > side) rs = side;
+    const float texels = (float)w * (float)h;
+    if (rs * rs * texels > (float)ENG_RS_MAX_TEXELS) rs = sqrtf((float)ENG_RS_MAX_TEXELS / texels);
+    if (s_rs.user > 1.0f && rs < 1.0f) rs = 1.0f;    /* the limits never shrink a surface */
+    if (rs > 0.999f && rs < 1.001f) rs = 1.0f;
+    return rs;
+}
+static float eng_rs_pick_at(u32 location, u32 offset, u32 w, u32 h, u32 aa_sx, u32 aa_sy)
+{
+    if (s_rs.scene_on && location == s_rs.scene_loc && offset == s_rs.scene_off && w == s_rs.scene_w && h == s_rs.scene_h)
+        return s_rs.scene_rs;                          /* [up] the upscaler's render size (or LD_RES_SCENE's) */
+    if (!s_rs.on) return 1.0f;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_rs.n_skip; i++)
+        if (s_rs.skip[i] == offset) return 1.0f;
+    if (s_rs.n_only) {
+        u32 i = 0;
+        while (i < s_rs.n_only && s_rs.only[i] != offset) i++;
+        if (i == s_rs.n_only) return 1.0f;
+    }
+    return eng_rs_pick(location, w, h, aa_sx, aa_sy);
+}
+/* The scale a draw or a clear runs at (rsx_live_draw.c ld_rs_pass): its colour target's, with one exception. A pass
+ * that writes no colour is not sized by the surface its colour registers happen to name: GT5 leaves a display or
+ * post-processing buffer's address there for its shadow map and for the glyph polygons of text it composes off
+ * screen. Such a pass keeps the target's scale only when it looks like part of a scaled picture: its clip is a size
+ * eng_rs_pick scales, and its zeta has an entry at that scale a colour-writing pass used (a depth pre-pass, the
+ * glyphs of on-screen text) or no entry at guest size yet. Otherwise it runs at guest size (LD_RES_DEPTH_RULE=0:
+ * always the target's scale). */
+static float eng_rs_pass(const rsx_dsp_surface* sf, float trs, int writes_colour)
+{
+    if (trs == 1.0f || writes_colour || !s_rs.depth_rule) return trs;
+    /* [up] A depth-only pass of the scene at its own scale (its depth pre-pass) runs where the scene's colour draws
+     * run: its clip is not a size eng_rs_pick scales when no Resolution is asked for. */
+    if (s_rs.scene_on && sf->color_location[0] == s_rs.scene_loc && sf->color_offset[0] == s_rs.scene_off &&
+        sf->clip_w == s_rs.scene_cw && sf->clip_h == s_rs.scene_ch) return trs;
+    if (eng_rs_pick(sf->color_location[0], sf->clip_w ? sf->clip_w : g.width, sf->clip_h ? sf->clip_h : g.height,
+                    sf->aa_sx, sf->aa_sy) == 1.0f) return 1.0f;
+    int at_guest_size = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_zdepths; i++) {
+        const eng_zdepth* z = &g.zdepths[i];
+        if (!z->handle || z->location != sf->zeta_location || z->offset != sf->zeta_offset) continue;
+        if (z->rs == trs && z->with_colour) return trs;
+        if (z->rs == 1.0f) at_guest_size = 1;
+    }
+    return at_guest_size ? 1.0f : trs;
+}
+/* What a texture over a zeta's memory reads of it (rsx_live_draw.c ld_zread_of_remap): a depth format the depth; a
+ * colour format the packed D24S8 bytes, depth in A, R, G and the stencil in B, so by its remap which of the two (a
+ * channel whose op is ZERO or ONE reads nothing); both when it cannot be told. */
+#define ENG_ZREAD_DEPTH   1u
+#define ENG_ZREAD_STENCIL 2u
+static u32 eng_rs_zread_what(const rsx_dsp_texture* t)
+{
+    const u32 base = t->format & RSX_TEX_FMT_BASE_MASK & ~(u32)RSX_TEX_FMT_UNNORM;
+    if (base >= 0x90u && base <= 0x93u) return ENG_ZREAD_DEPTH;
+    const u32 remap = t->remap;
+    u32 what = 0;
+    for (u32 comp = 0; comp < 4u; comp++) {
+        if (((remap >> (8u + comp * 2u)) & 3u) < 2u) continue;
+        what |= ((remap >> (comp * 2u)) & 3u) == 3u ? ENG_ZREAD_STENCIL : ENG_ZREAD_DEPTH;
+    }
+    return what ? what : (ENG_ZREAD_DEPTH | ENG_ZREAD_STENCIL);
+}
+static u64 eng_rs_zage(const eng_zdepth* z, u32 what)
+{
+    const u64 d = (what & ENG_ZREAD_DEPTH) && z->had_write ? z->dser : 0u;
+    const u64 s = (what & ENG_ZREAD_STENCIL) ? z->sser : 0u;
+    return s > d ? s : d;
+}
+/* Of the entries zeta slot i's address has (one per scale it is drawn at, so nearly always only i), the one a read
+ * through t takes (rsx_live_draw.c ld_zdepth_reads): the newest of what it reads; between equals the zeta of the
+ * draw being set up, then the first. GT5's text: glyph polygons invert stencil bits in one pass and a later draw
+ * reads them as colour, maybe under another target at another scale with that same zeta bound. */
+static u32 eng_rs_zread(u32 i, const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u32 current_zslot)
+{
+    const eng_zdepth* z = &g.zdepths[i];
+    u32 best = i, n = 0;
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < g.n_zdepths; k++)
+        if (g.zdepths[k].handle && g.zdepths[k].location == z->location && g.zdepths[k].offset == z->offset) n++;
+    if (n < 2u) return i;
+    const u32 what = eng_rs_zread_what(t);
+    u64 best_age = 0; int have = 0;
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < g.n_zdepths; k++) {
+        const eng_zdepth* o = &g.zdepths[k];
+        if (!o->handle || o->location != z->location || o->offset != z->offset) continue;
+        const u64 age = eng_rs_zage(o, what);
+        if (!have || age > best_age || (age == best_age && k == current_zslot)) { best = k; best_age = age; have = 1; }
+    }
+    if (s_rs.read_logs < 24u && best != i) {
+        s_rs.read_logs++;
+        fprintf(stderr, "[res-scale] frame %u: zeta %u:0x%X read as %s %ux%u (remap 0x%04X): the x%.3f entry, not the"
+                        " x%.3f one\n", g.frames, z->location, z->offset,
+                what == ENG_ZREAD_STENCIL ? "stencil" : what == ENG_ZREAD_DEPTH ? "depth" : "depth+stencil",
+                t->width, t->height, t->remap & 0xFFFFu, (double)g.zdepths[best].rs, (double)z->rs);
+    }
+    return best;
+}

+/* Time spent on new pipelines, texture decodes/uploads and full texture hashes
+ * since the backend last asked (rsx_draw_engine_hitch_take): what a backend's
+ * slow-frame report splits a long frame into. Walker thread only. */
+enum { ENG_HX_PIPELINE, ENG_HX_TEXTURE, ENG_HX_HASH, ENG_HX_COUNT };
+static unsigned long long s_eng_hx_ns[ENG_HX_COUNT];
+static unsigned s_eng_hx_n[ENG_HX_COUNT];
+static u64 eng_hitch_now(void)
+{
+    struct timespec ts;
+#if defined(_WIN32)
+    timespec_get(&ts, TIME_UTC);
+#else
+    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
+#endif
+    return (u64)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (u64)ts.tv_nsec;
+}
+static void eng_hitch_add(int id, u64 t0)
+{
+    const u64 t = eng_hitch_now();
+    if (t > t0) s_eng_hx_ns[id] += t - t0;
+    s_eng_hx_n[id]++;
+}
+void rsx_draw_engine_hitch_take(unsigned long long ns[3], unsigned n[3])

+/* [res] Rows of w x h texels (bpp bytes each) as the image texels of the rectangle with guest edges x0..x0+w,
+ * y0..y0+h at scale rs (eng_rs_he): each image texel takes the guest texel under its centre. Into *out (grown as
+ * needed); its size in *ow x *oh. 0 when it cannot. */
+static u8* s_rs_rows;
+static size_t s_rs_rows_cap;
+static int eng_rs_expand(const u8* src, u32 src_row, u32 w, u32 h, u32 bpp, float rs, u32 x0, u32 y0,
+                         const u8** out, u32* ow, u32* oh)
+{
+    const u32 hx0 = eng_rs_he(x0, rs), hy0 = eng_rs_he(y0, rs);

+        }

+/* VK_RB_ASYNC (on on Windows, =0 off; =1 elsewhere; with a backend that has readback_async): a small
+ * read the title repeats every frame lands late instead of stopping the walker until the GPU is idle,
+ * as the D3D12 renderer's (ld_readback_streaming in rsx_live_draw.c,
+ * where the reasons are): GT5 reads a 16x8 auto-exposure sample every frame from a ring of three and
+ * expects it late, and its brightness chain (63x31 down to 3x1) the same way. Each was a wait for
+ * the GPU to finish everything queued, ten or so a game frame. A rect becomes asynchronous once it
+ * has been read in 12 frames in a row (Photo Mode's Auto Focus reads one patch for nine frames and
+ * needs each at once). With the exposure windows read from the right target (eng_inner_window), a
+ * race alternating it every 20 s kept the same brightness (frames 94 vs 83 mean, 4% over 180 either
+ * way) at 26 instead of 15 game frames a second on a loaded PC (+12% on a quiet one).
+ * PS3_AB_WHAT=vkrb alternates it (tests). */
+typedef struct {
+    u32 location, offset, pitch, h, bytes, skip, n, bpp;
+    /* [res] From a surface at a scale: the rows come back as hw x hh image texels from (hx0, hy0) and are reduced
+     * to the n x h guest texels from (x, y) (eng_rs_reduce). rs 1: as they are. */
+    float rs;
+    u32 x, y, hx0, hy0, hw, hh;
+    int box;
+} eng_rb_req;
+
+/* [res] hw x hh image texels (bpp bytes each) read back from (hx0, hy0) of a surface at scale rs, as the n x h guest
+ * texels from (x, y): the image texel under each guest texel's centre (DirectX 12: rectangles of up to 1024 texels,
+ * GT5's 16x8 exposure sample and Auto Focus' 16x16 of packed depth, whose bytes must not be averaged; and every
+ * format but RGBA8), or with box, the mean of the texels each guest texel covers, per byte (larger RGBA8 rectangles:
+ * photos, thumbnails). Into a buffer of its own, returned; NULL when it can't have one. */
+static u8* s_rs_red;
+static size_t s_rs_red_cap;
+static u8* eng_rs_reduce(const u8* host, u32 hw, u32 hh, u32 bpp, float rs, u32 x, u32 y, u32 n, u32 h,
+                         u32 hx0, u32 hy0, int box)
+{
+    const size_t need = (size_t)n * h * bpp;
+    if (!need || !hw || !hh) return NULL;
+    if (s_rs_red_cap < need) {
+        u8* p = (u8*)realloc(s_rs_red, need);
+        if (!p) return NULL;
+        s_rs_red = p; s_rs_red_cap = need;
+    }
+    for (u32 r = 0; r < h; r++) {
+        u8* drow = s_rs_red + (size_t)r * n * bpp;
+        const u32 gy = y + r;
+        if (!box) {
+            u32 hy = (u32)(((float)gy + 0.5f) * rs);
+            hy = hy > hy0 ? hy - hy0 : 0u;
+            if (hy >= hh) hy = hh - 1u;
+            for (u32 c = 0; c < n; c++) {
+                u32 hx = (u32)(((float)(x + c) + 0.5f) * rs);
+                hx = hx > hx0 ? hx - hx0 : 0u;
+                if (hx >= hw) hx = hw - 1u;
+                memcpy(drow + (size_t)c * bpp, host + ((size_t)hy * hw + hx) * bpp, bpp);
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+        u32 ya = eng_rs_he(gy, rs), yb = eng_rs_he(gy + 1u, rs);
+        ya = ya > hy0 ? ya - hy0 : 0u; yb = yb > hy0 ? yb - hy0 : 0u;
+        if (yb > hh) yb = hh;
+        if (ya >= yb) { ya = yb ? yb - 1u : 0u; yb = ya + 1u; }
+        for (u32 c = 0; c < n; c++) {
+            u32 xa = eng_rs_he(x + c, rs), xb = eng_rs_he(x + c + 1u, rs);
+            xa = xa > hx0 ? xa - hx0 : 0u; xb = xb > hx0 ? xb - hx0 : 0u;
+            if (xb > hw) xb = hw;
+            if (xa >= xb) { xa = xb ? xb - 1u : 0u; xb = xa + 1u; }
+            u32 sum[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }, k = 0;
+            for (u32 yy = ya; yy < yb; yy++)
+                for (u32 xx = xa; xx < xb; xx++, k++) {
+                    const u8* p = host + ((size_t)yy * hw + xx) * bpp;
+                    for (u32 b = 0; b < 4u; b++) sum[b] += p[b];
+                }
+            for (u32 b = 0; b < 4u; b++) drow[(size_t)c * bpp + b] = (u8)((sum[b] + k / 2u) / (k ? k : 1u));
+        }
+    }
+    return s_rs_red;
+}
+
+static int eng_rb_async_on(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+#ifdef _WIN32
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("VK_RB_ASYNC"); on = !e || atoi(e) != 0; }   /* =0 off */
+#else
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("VK_RB_ASYNC"); on = e && atoi(e) != 0; }
+#endif
+    if (!on) return 0;
+    extern int ps3_ab_on(const char* what);
+    return ps3_ab_on("vkrb") != 0;
+}
+
+static int eng_rb_streaming(u32 loc, u32 off, u32 w, u32 h)
+{
+    static struct { u32 loc, off, w, h, frame, run; } t[8];
+    static u32 next;
+    int k = -1;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
+        if (t[i].run && t[i].loc == loc && t[i].off == off && t[i].w == w && t[i].h == h) { k = i; break; }
+    if (k < 0) {
+        k = (int)(next++ & 7u);
+        t[k].loc = loc; t[k].off = off; t[k].w = w; t[k].h = h; t[k].frame = g.frames; t[k].run = 1;
+    } else if (t[k].frame != g.frames) {
+        t[k].run = t[k].frame + 1u == g.frames ? t[k].run + 1u : 1u;
+        t[k].frame = g.frames;
+    }
+    return t[k].run >= 12u;
+}
+
+/* VK_RB_LOG=<k> (tests, as the D3D12 renderer's LD_RB_LOG): every k-th small readback (GT5's 16x8
+ * auto-exposure sample, its brightness chain) logs the mean of each byte lane, R,G,B,A as read back. */
+static void eng_rb_meter(u32 location, u32 offset, u32 w, u32 h, const u8* rows, u32 n, u32 bpp, int late)
+{
+    static int every = -1; static u32 key[8], cnt[8], lines;
+    if (every < 0) { const char* e = getenv("VK_RB_LOG"); every = e ? (atoi(e) > 0 ? atoi(e) : 1) : 0; }
+    if (!every || bpp != 4u || w * h > 256u || lines >= 40000u) return;
+    u32 slot = 0;   /* counted per address: the reads come in a fixed order each frame */
+    while (slot < 8u && key[slot] && key[slot] != offset + 1u) slot++;
+    if (slot == 8u) return;
+    key[slot] = offset + 1u;
+    if ((cnt[slot]++ % (u32)every) != 0) return;
+    double m[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < n * h; i++)
+        for (u32 c = 0; c < 4u; c++) m[c] += rows[(size_t)i * 4u + c];
+    const double k = 1.0 / (double)(n * h);
+    lines++;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[rb-meter] f=%u %u:0x%08X %ux%u%s mean %.1f %.1f %.1f a %.1f\n", g.frames, location, offset,
+            w, h, late ? " late" : "", m[0] * k, m[1] * k, m[2] * k, m[3] * k);
+}
+
+/* The rows read back (R,G,B,A per surface pixel), stored into guest memory as the guest expects them. */
+static void eng_rb_store(const eng_rb_req* q, u8* rows)
+{
+    eng_rb_meter(q->location, q->offset, q->n, q->h, rows, q->n, q->bpp, 1);
+    const int rgba = rsx_texture_argb_is_rgba();
+    for (u32 r = 0; r < q->h; r++) {
+        u8* dst = (u8*)eng_guest_ptr(NULL, q->location, q->offset + r * q->pitch, q->bytes);
+        if (!dst) return;
+        u8* src = rows + (size_t)r * q->n * q->bpp;
+        if (q->bpp == 8u) {
+            for (u32 c = 0; c < q->n * 4u; c++) {
+                const u8 t = src[2 * c]; src[2 * c] = src[2 * c + 1]; src[2 * c + 1] = t;
+            }
+        } else if (!rgba) {
+            eng_row_convert(src, src, q->n, 0, 1);
+        }
+        memcpy(dst, src + q->skip, q->bytes);
+    }
+}
+
+/* The backend's callback, on the walker, when an asynchronous read has landed. */
+static void eng_rb_done(void* ctx, u8* rows)
+{
+    eng_rb_req* q = (eng_rb_req*)ctx;
+    if (rows && q->rs != 1.0f)   /* [res] at the surface's scale: to the guest's size first */
+        rows = eng_rs_reduce(rows, q->hw, q->hh, q->bpp, q->rs, q->x, q->y, q->n, q->h, q->hx0, q->hy0, q->box);
+    if (rows) eng_rb_store(q, rows);
+    free(q);
+}

+/* [res] WPOS on a target at a resolution scale (and maybe a sample grid sx x sy too): SV_POSITION counts image
+ * pixels, the program wants guest pixels (rsx_live_draw.c ld_rs_apply_wpos, the same line). It goes where
+ * rsx_fp_apply_wpos_grid puts its own, first in main, and only into a program that reads WPOS: any other keeps its
+ * exact text. fp_alpha.w holds 1 / scale (sink_end). Continuous, not floored to the guest's pixel: a program that
+ * turns it into a texture coordinate gets a different one in every image pixel, which is the point of the scale;
+ * one that tests the pixel's parity (a dither) gets the guest's pattern, each cell scale x scale pixels.
+ * 1 patched, 0 nothing to do, -1 (text untouched) when the entry point isn't found. */
+static int eng_rs_apply_wpos(char* hlsl, u32 capacity, u32 sx, u32 sy)
+{
+    static const char wpos_read[] = "_rsx_wpos(input.position)";
+    static const char* const entries[] = { "main(PSInput input) : SV_TARGET {\n",
+                                           "main(PSInput input) {\n" };
+    if (!hlsl || !capacity || !sx || !sy) return -1;
+    size_t len = 0;
+    while (len < capacity && hlsl[len]) ++len;
+    if (len == capacity) return -1;
+    if (!strstr(hlsl, wpos_read)) return 0;
+    if (strstr(hlsl, "input.position.xy = ")) return -1;
+    char* body = NULL;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof entries / sizeof entries[0] && !body; ++i) {
+        char* at = strstr(hlsl, entries[i]);
+        if (at) body = at + strlen(entries[i]);
+    }
+    if (!body) return -1;
+    char line[128];
+    const int n = snprintf(line, sizeof line,
+        "    input.position.xy = input.position.xy * fp_alpha.w / float2(%u, %u);\n", sx, sy);
+    if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof line || len + (size_t)n + 1 > capacity) return -1;
+    memmove(body + n, body, len - (size_t)(body - hlsl) + 1);
+    memcpy(body, line, (size_t)n);
+    return 1;
+}
+/* [res] A depth compare in texel coordinates of a zeta whose entry the read takes is at a scale: the decompiler's
+ * helper normalizes them by the bound map's size, so they are multiplied by it (rsx_fp_shadow_desc.scale, as for a
+ * shadow map drawn larger: [shadow]). 2 or 4 only (what the decompiler takes); another scale is left as it is (said
+ * once). GT5's compares are of its shadow map, which is never scaled; this is for a title that compares against a
+ * scene's depth by texel. */
+static void eng_rs_shadow_desc(const rsx_dsp_texture* t, rsx_fp_shadow_desc* d)
+{
+    if (d->enabled != 1 || !d->unnormalized || !s_rs.on) return;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_zdepths; i++) {
+        const eng_zdepth* z = &g.zdepths[i];
+        if (!z->handle || z->location != t->location || z->offset != t->offset) continue;
+        const eng_zdepth* r = &g.zdepths[eng_rs_zread(i, t, ENG_INVALID)];
+        if (r->rs == 1.0f) return;
+        if (r->rs == 2.0f || r->rs == 4.0f) { d->scale = (u8)r->rs; return; }
+        static int said;
+        if (!said) {
+            said = 1;
+            fprintf(stderr, "[res-scale] a depth compare in texel coordinates of zeta %u:0x%X at x%.3f: neither x2"
+                            " nor x4, read as if at the guest's size\n", t->location, t->offset, (double)r->rs);
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+}

+/* ---- VK_VCACHE: converted draws kept across frames (Windows; on unless VK_VCACHE=0) ------------
+ * The D3D12 renderer's LD_VCACHE (rsx_live_draw.c, where the reasoning is), for this engine. GT5
+ * draws the same car and track meshes every frame from memory nothing rewrites, and each draw
+ * gathered its indices, de-duplicated them, converted every vertex and copied it all into the
+ * backend's ring again. Here a draw's result -- its float vertices and its index list -- is kept in
+ * the backend's arena (rsx_draw_backend.arena_alloc), keyed by everything that decides it, and
+ * drawn from there while the guest pages it was read from are unwritten: Windows' write tracking
+ * on the guest reservation (MEM_WRITE_WATCH, boot_main.cpp) says whether they were. A key is
+ * recorded the second time it is seen, stored the third (its pages still clean), drawn from the
+ * arena after that; a key whose pages keep being written is left to the ordinary path after two
+ * strikes. VK_VCACHE_MB sizes the arena (the backend's); PS3_AB_WHAT=vcache alternates it (tests). */
+#if defined(_WIN32)
+#include <stdint.h>
+__declspec(dllimport) unsigned int __stdcall GetWriteWatch(unsigned long flags, void* base, size_t size,
+                                                          void** addrs, unsigned long long* count,
+                                                          unsigned long* granularity);
+extern unsigned long long cellPad_now_ms(void);
+#define ENG_VC_SLOTS 16384u
+#define ENG_VC_SPANS 4u
+#define ENG_VC_SPAN_PAGES 2048u            /* 8 MB: the largest span tracked */
+typedef struct {
+    u32 prim, mask, stride, n_arr, n_idx, idx_loc, idx_off, idx_u32, restart, restart_value,
+        base_index, base_offset, divider, total;
+    eng_batch first;
+    u64 batches_hash;
+    struct { rsx_dsp_vertex_attr d; float def[4]; } a[RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR];
+} eng_vc_key;
+typedef struct {
+    u64 h;
+    eng_vc_key k;
+    u8 state;          /* 0 empty, 1 pages recorded, 2 stored, 3 left alone */
+    u8 strikes, indexed, n_spans;
+    u32 gen;           /* the write generation its pages were last known clean at */
+    u32 last_frame;
+    u32 vb_off, n_verts, ib_off, n_index;
+    const u8* lo[ENG_VC_SPANS];
+    const u8* hi[ENG_VC_SPANS];
+} eng_vc_entry;
+static eng_vc_entry* s_vc;
+static int s_vc_on = -1;
+static u32* s_vc_page_gen;                 /* one per 4 KB of the 4 GB guest space */
+static u32 s_vc_gen = 1;
+static void* s_vc_addr[ENG_VC_SPAN_PAGES];
+static unsigned long long s_vc_stat[8];    /* hit, stored, recorded, dirty, left alone, unkeyable, wipes, failed */
+
+static u64 eng_vc_hash(const void* p, size_t n, u64 h)
+{
+    const u8* b = (const u8*)p;
+    for (; n >= 8; n -= 8, b += 8) { u64 w; memcpy(&w, b, 8); h = (h ^ w) * 0x100000001B3ull; h ^= h >> 29; }
+    for (; n; n--, b++) h = (h ^ *b) * 0x100000001B3ull;
+    return h;
+}
+
+static int eng_vc_enabled(void)
+{
+    if (s_vc_on < 0) {
+        const char* e = getenv("VK_VCACHE");   /* on unless VK_VCACHE=0 (this part is Windows only) */
+        s_vc_on = (!e || atoi(e) != 0) && g.be && g.be->arena_alloc && g.be->arena_reset && g.be->draw_arena && vm_base;
+        if (s_vc_on) {
+            s_vc = (eng_vc_entry*)calloc(ENG_VC_SLOTS, sizeof(eng_vc_entry));
+            s_vc_page_gen = (u32*)calloc(1u << 20, sizeof(u32));
+            if (!s_vc || !s_vc_page_gen) s_vc_on = 0;
+        }
+        fprintf(stderr, "[vcache] %s\n", s_vc_on ? "on: converted draws are kept while their guest pages are unwritten (VK_VCACHE)" : "off");
+    }
+    if (!s_vc_on) return 0;
+    { extern int ps3_ab_on(const char* what); if (ps3_ab_on("vcache") == 0) return 0; }
+    return 1;
+}
+
+static int eng_vc_key_build(eng_vc_key* k, u32 prim, const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* layout)
+{
+    if (dc.n_arr + dc.n_idx == 0 || (dc.n_arr && dc.n_idx) || dc.inl || dc.n_immediate) return 0;
+    memset(k, 0, sizeof *k);
+    k->prim = prim; k->mask = layout->mask; k->stride = layout->stride; k->n_arr = dc.n_arr; k->n_idx = dc.n_idx;
+    const eng_batch* bl = dc.n_idx ? dc.idx : dc.arr;
+    const u32 nb = dc.n_idx ? dc.n_idx : dc.n_arr;
+    k->first = bl[0];
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < nb; i++) k->total += bl[i].count;
+    k->batches_hash = eng_vc_hash(bl, (size_t)nb * sizeof(eng_batch), 0x9E3779B185EBCA87ull);
+    if (dc.n_idx) {
+        rsx_dsp_index_array ia; rsx_dsp_get_index_array(&g.rsx, &ia);
+        k->idx_loc = ia.location; k->idx_off = ia.offset; k->idx_u32 = ia.is_u32;
+        k->restart = (u32)rsx_dsp_restart_index_enabled(&g.rsx, ia.is_u32);
+        k->restart_value = rsx_dsp_restart_index(&g.rsx);
+        k->base_index = rsx_dsp_vertex_data_base_index(&g.rsx);
+    }
+    k->base_offset = rsx_dsp_vertex_data_base_offset(&g.rsx);
+    k->divider = rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, 0x1FC0);
+    for (u32 s = 0; s < layout->count; s++) {
+        const u32 a = layout->attrs[s];
+        rsx_dsp_get_vertex_attr(&g.rsx, a, &k->a[a].d);
+        rsx_dsp_vertex_default(&g.rsx, a, k->a[a].def);
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* The pages' write bits harvested into a generation per guest page (pages are shared between
+ * draws, so one entry resetting a bit must not hide the write from another). */
+static int eng_vc_harvest(const u8* lo, const u8* hi)
+{
+    if ((u64)(hi - lo) > (u64)ENG_VC_SPAN_PAGES * 4096u || lo < vm_base || hi > vm_base + 0x100000000ull) return 0;
+    unsigned long long n = ENG_VC_SPAN_PAGES;
+    unsigned long gran = 0;
+    if (GetWriteWatch(1u /* WRITE_WATCH_FLAG_RESET */, (void*)lo, (size_t)(hi - lo), s_vc_addr, &n, &gran) != 0) return 0;
+    if (n) {
+        const u32 gen = ++s_vc_gen;
+        for (unsigned long long i = 0; i < n; i++)
+            s_vc_page_gen[(u32)(((const u8*)s_vc_addr[i] - vm_base) >> 12)] = gen;
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* 1: none of the entry's pages written since its generation; 0: written; -1: cannot tell. */
+static int eng_vc_clean(const eng_vc_entry* e)
+{
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < e->n_spans; i++)
+        if (!eng_vc_harvest(e->lo[i], e->hi[i])) return -1;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < e->n_spans; i++)
+        for (const u8* pg = e->lo[i]; pg < e->hi[i]; pg += 4096)
+            if (s_vc_page_gen[(u32)((pg - vm_base) >> 12)] > e->gen) return 0;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* The guest pages this draw read, page-aligned, merged, at most ENG_VC_SPANS, harvested. */
+static int eng_vc_record(eng_vc_entry* e)
+{
+    const u8* lo[RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR + 1]; const u8* hi[RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR + 1]; u32 n = 0;
+    if (dc.n_idx) {
+        rsx_dsp_index_array ia; rsx_dsp_get_index_array(&g.rsx, &ia);
+        const u32 es = ia.is_u32 ? 4u : 2u;
+        const u32 ia_loc = ia.location ? RSX_LOCATION_MAIN : RSX_LOCATION_LOCAL;   /* as dc_fetch reads it */
+        u64 first = ~0ull, end = 0;
+        for (u32 bi = 0; bi < dc.n_idx; bi++) {
+            const u64 start = (u64)ia.offset + (u64)dc.idx[bi].first * es, bytes = (u64)dc.idx[bi].count * es;
+            if (!bytes) continue;
+            if (start < first) first = start;
+            if (start + bytes > end) end = start + bytes;
+        }
+        if (end > first) {
+            if (end > 0x100000000ull || end - first > (16u << 20)) return 0;
+            const u8* q = eng_guest_ptr(NULL, ia_loc, (u32)first, (u32)(end - first));
+            if (!q) return 0;
+            lo[n] = q; hi[n] = q + (end - first); n++;
+        }
+    }
+    for (u32 s = 0; s < dc.layout.count; s++) {
+        const rsx_vertex_fetch_attr* f = &dc.fetch_plan.attr[dc.layout.attrs[s]];
+        if (!f->desc.type || !f->desc.size) continue;          /* its default is in the key */
+        if (!f->stable_base || f->stable_last < f->stable_first) return 0;
+        lo[n] = f->stable_base;
+        hi[n] = f->stable_base + (u64)(f->stable_last - f->stable_first) * f->stride + f->elem_size;
+        n++;
+    }
+    if (!n) return 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < n; i++) {
+        lo[i] = (const u8*)((uintptr_t)lo[i] & ~(uintptr_t)4095);
+        hi[i] = (const u8*)(((uintptr_t)hi[i] + 4095) & ~(uintptr_t)4095);
+    }
+    for (u32 i = 1; i < n; i++)
+        for (u32 j = i; j > 0 && lo[j] < lo[j - 1]; j--) {
+            const u8* t = lo[j]; lo[j] = lo[j - 1]; lo[j - 1] = t;
+            t = hi[j]; hi[j] = hi[j - 1]; hi[j - 1] = t;
+        }
+    u32 m = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < n; i++) {
+        if (m && lo[i] <= hi[m - 1] + 16384) { if (hi[i] > hi[m - 1]) hi[m - 1] = hi[i]; continue; }
+        lo[m] = lo[i]; hi[m] = hi[i]; m++;
+    }
+    if (m > ENG_VC_SPANS) {
+        if (hi[m - 1] - lo[0] > (8u << 20)) return 0;
+        hi[0] = hi[m - 1]; m = 1;
+    }
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < m; i++) {
+        if (!eng_vc_harvest(lo[i], hi[i])) return 0;
+        e->lo[i] = lo[i]; e->hi[i] = hi[i];
+    }
+    e->n_spans = (u8)m;
+    e->gen = s_vc_gen;   /* writes from here on show as newer */
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* What to do with this draw: 0 the ordinary path, 1 ordinary then record its pages,
+ * 2 ordinary and stored into the arena, 3 drawn from the arena. */
+static int eng_vc_find(u32 prim, const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* layout, eng_vc_entry** out)
+{
+    *out = NULL;
+    if (!eng_vc_enabled()) return 0;
+    eng_vc_key k;
+    if (!eng_vc_key_build(&k, prim, layout)) { s_vc_stat[5]++; return 0; }
+    const u64 h = eng_vc_hash(&k, sizeof k, 0x51ED270B27D4EB4Full) | 1u;
+    u32 i = (u32)(h >> 17) & (ENG_VC_SLOTS - 1u);
+    eng_vc_entry* empty = NULL;
+    eng_vc_entry* oldest = NULL;
+    for (u32 probe = 0; probe < 32; probe++, i = (i + 1u) & (ENG_VC_SLOTS - 1u)) {
+        eng_vc_entry* e = &s_vc[i];
+        if (!e->state) { if (!empty) empty = e; break; }
+        if (!oldest || e->last_frame < oldest->last_frame) oldest = e;
+        if (e->h != h || memcmp(&e->k, &k, sizeof k) != 0) continue;
+        e->last_frame = g.frames;
+        if (e->state == 3) { s_vc_stat[4]++; return 0; }
+        *out = e;
+        if (!e->n_spans) return 1;
+        const int c = eng_vc_clean(e);
+        if (c < 0) { e->state = 3; s_vc_stat[7]++; *out = NULL; return 0; }
+        if (c == 0) {
+            s_vc_stat[3]++;
+            if (++e->strikes >= 2) { e->state = 3; *out = NULL; return 0; }
+            e->state = 1; e->n_spans = 0;
+            return 1;
+        }
+        if (e->state == 2) { s_vc_stat[0]++; return 3; }
+        return 2;
+    }
+    /* A key gets a slot only when seen a second time: a draw from a ring buffer has a new address
+     * every frame and would fill the table with keys that never come back. */
+    static u64 s_vc_seen[1u << 16];
+    u64* seen = &s_vc_seen[(u32)(h >> 7) & 0xFFFFu];
+    if (*seen != h) { *seen = h; s_vc_stat[5]++; return 0; }
+    eng_vc_entry* e = empty ? empty : oldest;
+    if (!e) { s_vc_stat[5]++; return 0; }
+    memset(e, 0, sizeof *e);
+    e->h = h; e->k = k; e->state = 1; e->last_frame = g.frames;
+    *out = e;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* Room in the arena; a full arena is emptied once the GPU is done with it, and every entry with it.
+ * NULL (the draw takes the ordinary path) when it was just emptied or the backend can't. */
+static u8* eng_vc_alloc(u32 bytes, u32* off)
+{
+    *off = 0;
+    u8* p = g.be->arena_alloc(g.be->user, bytes, off);
+    if (p) return p;
+    if (*off == ~0u) return NULL;           /* too big to keep, or no arena now: not full */
+    g.be->arena_reset(g.be->user);
+    memset(s_vc, 0, (size_t)ENG_VC_SLOTS * sizeof(eng_vc_entry));
+    s_vc_stat[6]++;
+    return NULL;
+}
+
+static void eng_vc_report(void)
+{
+    static unsigned long long t0, f0, last[8];
+    if (!s_vc_on) return;
+    const unsigned long long now = cellPad_now_ms();
+    if (!t0) { t0 = now; f0 = g.frames; return; }
+    if (now - t0 < 5000) return;
+    const double fr = g.frames > f0 ? (double)(g.frames - f0) : 1.0;
+    double d[8];
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { d[i] = (double)(s_vc_stat[i] - last[i]); last[i] = s_vc_stat[i]; }
+    fprintf(stderr, "[vcache] per drawn frame: %.0f drawn from the arena, %.0f stored, %.0f recorded, %.0f rewritten,"
+                    " %.0f left alone, %.0f not cacheable; %.0f failed, %llu wipes\n",
+            d[0] / fr, d[1] / fr, d[2] / fr, d[3] / fr, d[4] / fr, d[5] / fr, d[7] / fr, s_vc_stat[6]);
+    t0 = now; f0 = g.frames;
+}
+#else
+typedef struct { u8 indexed; u32 vb_off, n_verts, ib_off, n_index, gen; u8 state; } eng_vc_entry;
+static int eng_vc_find(u32 prim, const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* layout, eng_vc_entry** out)
+{ (void)prim; (void)layout; *out = NULL; return 0; }
+static int eng_vc_record(eng_vc_entry* e) { (void)e; return 0; }
+static u8* eng_vc_alloc(u32 bytes, u32* off) { (void)bytes; (void)off; return NULL; }
+static void eng_vc_report(void) {}
+static unsigned long long s_vc_stat[8];
+static u32 s_vc_gen;
+#endif

+/* The cube texture a cube unit samples when its faces are colour targets:
+ * face f starts at offset + f * stride (stride = the face with its mip chain
+ * in the rows below it, at the texture pitch, for a linear texture), in a
+ * target at that address or one whose rows contain it at the same pitch (GT5
+ * draws a 32x32 half-float cube as one 32x192 target), with room for the face. Built and refreshed with color_cube; 0 when no
+ * face is a target, a face is a current attachment, or the backend lacks it. */
+static u32 eng_cube_from_targets(const rsx_dsp_texture* t, const u32* target_slots, u32 n_targets)
+{
+    if (!g.be->color_cube || !t->width || t->width != t->height) return 0;
+    u32 mips = 1, rows = t->height;
+    for (u32 mh = t->height; mips < (t->mipmaps ? t->mipmaps : 1u) && mips < 14u && mh > 1u; mips++) {
+        mh >>= 1;
+        rows += mh;
+    }
+    const u32 stride = ((t->format & RSX_TEX_FMT_LINEAR) && t->pitch)
+        ? rows * t->pitch
+        : rsx_texture_cube_face_stride(t->format, t->width, t->height, mips, t->pitch);
+    if (!stride) return 0;
+    int face[6];
+    u32 face_y[6] = {0};
+    int any = 0;
+    const int linear = (t->format & RSX_TEX_FMT_LINEAR) && t->pitch;
+    for (u32 f = 0; f < 6; f++) {
+        face[f] = -1;
+        const u32 a = t->offset + f * stride;
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_surfaces; i++) {
+            const eng_surface* s = &g.surfaces[i];
+            if (!s->handle || s->location != t->location || s->offset > a || !s->color_serial ||
+                s->w < t->width)
+                continue;
+            if (s->rs != 1.0f) continue;   /* [res] faces are copied texel for texel: a scaled one is refused */
+            u32 y = 0;
+            if (s->offset != a) {   /* a face further down a taller target */
+                if (!linear || !s->pitch || s->pitch != t->pitch || (a - s->offset) % s->pitch) continue;
+                y = (a - s->offset) / s->pitch;
+            }
+            if (y + t->height > s->h) continue;
+            for (u32 k = 0; k < n_targets; k++) if (target_slots[k] == i) return 0;
+            if (face[f] < 0 || s->color_serial > g.surfaces[face[f]].color_serial) {
+                face[f] = (int)i;
+                face_y[f] = y;
+            }
+        }
+        any |= face[f] >= 0;
+    }
+    if (!any) return 0;
+    eng_cube* c = NULL;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < ENG_MAX_CUBES && !c; i++) {
+        eng_cube* e = &g.cubes[i];
+        if (e->handle && e->location == t->location && e->offset == t->offset &&
+            e->size == t->width && e->mips == mips && e->remap == (t->remap & 0xFFFFu) &&
+            e->format == t->format)
+            c = e;
+    }
+    if (!c) {   /* a free slot, else the least recently used */
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < ENG_MAX_CUBES; i++)
+            if (!c || !g.cubes[i].handle ||
+                (c->handle && g.cubes[i].last_use < c->last_use)) c = &g.cubes[i];
+        if (c->handle) g.be->texture_release(g.be->user, c->handle);
+        memset(c, 0, sizeof *c);
+        c->location = t->location; c->offset = t->offset; c->size = t->width; c->mips = mips;
+        c->remap = t->remap & 0xFFFFu; c->format = t->format;
+    }
+    c->last_use = g.frames;
+    u32 copy[6] = {0};
+    int stale = !c->handle;
+    for (u32 f = 0; f < 6; f++) {
+        if (face[f] < 0) continue;
+        g.surfaces[face[f]].last_use = g.frames;
+        if (g.surfaces[face[f]].color_serial != c->face_serial[f]) { copy[f] = g.surfaces[face[f]].handle; stale = 1; }
+    }
+    if (!stale) return c->handle;
+    {   /* PS3RECOMP_CUBE_DUMP=<dir>: the faces of the 40th refresh of a cube of
+         * 16+ texels, raw RGBA8, plus one line on what the texture asked for. */
+        static int n_refresh;
+        const char* dir = getenv("PS3RECOMP_CUBE_DUMP");
+        if (dir && t->width >= 16u && ++n_refresh == 40 && g.be->readback) {
+            g.be->submit_and_wait(g.be->user, RSX_BE_FLUSH_GUEST_REFERENCE);
+            for (u32 f = 0; f < 6; f++) {
+                if (face[f] < 0) continue;
+                const eng_surface* s = &g.surfaces[face[f]];
+                if (s->fmt != RSX_BE_FMT_R8G8B8A8) continue;
+                u8* raw = (u8*)malloc((size_t)s->w * s->h * 4u);
+                if (!raw) continue;
+                g.be->readback(g.be->user, s->handle, 0, 0, s->w, s->h, raw, s->w * 4u);
+                char path[1024];
+                snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/face%u_%ux%u.rgba", dir, f, s->w, s->h);
+                FILE* fp = fopen(path, "wb");
+                if (fp) { fwrite(raw, 1, (size_t)s->w * s->h * 4u, fp); fclose(fp); }
+                free(raw);
+            }
+            fprintf(stderr, "[cube-dump] 0x%08X fmt 0x%02X remap 0x%04X %ux%u mips %u pitch %u faces",
+                    t->offset, t->format, t->remap & 0xFFFFu, t->width, t->height, t->mipmaps, t->pitch);
+            for (u32 f = 0; f < 6; f++)
+                if (face[f] >= 0) fprintf(stderr, " [%u %ux%u p%u fmt %d]", f, g.surfaces[face[f]].w,
+                                          g.surfaces[face[f]].h, g.surfaces[face[f]].pitch,
+                                          (int)g.surfaces[face[f]].fmt);
+            fprintf(stderr, "\n");
+        }
+    }
+    u32 h = g.be->color_cube(g.be->user, c->handle, copy, face_y, c->size, mips, c->remap, t->format);
+    if (!h && c->handle) {   /* the faces changed format: start over */
+        g.be->texture_release(g.be->user, c->handle);
+        c->handle = 0;
+        memset(c->face_serial, 0, sizeof c->face_serial);
+        for (u32 f = 0; f < 6; f++) if (face[f] >= 0) copy[f] = g.surfaces[face[f]].handle;
+        h = g.be->color_cube(g.be->user, 0, copy, face_y, c->size, mips, c->remap, t->format);
+    }
+    if (!h) { memset(c, 0, sizeof *c); return 0; }
+    if (!c->handle) {
+        u32 n = 0;
+        for (u32 f = 0; f < 6; f++) n += face[f] >= 0;
+        fprintf(stderr, "[rsx-engine] cube from targets: %u:0x%08X %ux%u mips %u stride 0x%X faces %u\n",
+                t->location, t->offset, t->width, t->height, mips, stride, n);
+    }
+    c->handle = h;
+    for (u32 f = 0; f < 6; f++)
+        if (copy[f]) c->face_serial[f] = g.surfaces[face[f]].color_serial;
+    return h;
+}

+/* A swizzled cube with a border (format bit 3 clear) is stored with each level
+ * at the next power of two above its size plus two, the image centred in it,
+ * and each face padded to 128 bytes -- rsx_live_draw.c texture_source_span and
+ * its cube upload. GT5's 8x8 half-float car ambient cubes are these, 0x800
+ * bytes a face; read as plain 8x8 they landed on unwritten memory (NaNs, huge
+ * and negative values), the car paint's flat red, green and blue bands.
+ * Cached per address and re-uploaded when the bytes change. 0 when not one. */
+static u32 eng_border_pad(u32 v)
+{
+    u32 p = 1;
+    while (p < v + 2u) p <<= 1;
+    return p;
+}
+
+static u32 eng_bordered_cube(const rsx_dsp_texture* t)
+{
+    const u32 w = t->width;
+    if (!w || w != t->height || w > 2048u) return 0;
+    rsx_tex_level lv[RSX_MAX_TEXTURE_LEVELS];
+    const u32 nlv = rsx_texture_mip_chain(t->format, w, w, t->mipmaps, 0, lv);
+    if (!nlv || lv[0].tl.compressed || !lv[0].tl.bytes_per_texel) return 0;
+    const u32 bpp = lv[0].tl.bytes_per_texel;
+    u32 level_off[RSX_MAX_TEXTURE_LEVELS], face = 0;
+    for (u32 m = 0; m < nlv; m++) {
+        level_off[m] = face;
+        face += eng_border_pad(lv[m].w) * eng_border_pad(lv[m].h) * bpp;
+    }
+    face = (face + 127u) & ~127u;
+    const u32 remap = t->remap & 0xFFFFu;
+    eng_cube* c = NULL;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < ENG_MAX_BCUBES && !c; i++) {
+        eng_cube* e = &g.bcubes[i];
+        if (e->handle && e->location == t->location && e->offset == t->offset && e->size == w &&
+            e->mips == nlv && e->remap == remap && e->format == t->format)
+            c = e;
+    }
+    /* Checked once a frame, as the texture cache checks a texture: every draw of a car binds its
+     * cube, and hashing the six faces byte by byte at each bind was most of texture binding's time
+     * on a Steam Deck. The hash goes 8 bytes at a time (a face is padded to 128 bytes). */
+    if (c && c->checked == g.frames + 1u) { c->last_use = g.frames; return c->handle; }
+    const u8* src = eng_guest_ptr(NULL, t->location, t->offset, face * 6u);
+    if (!src) return 0;
+    u64 hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i + 8u <= face * 6u; i += 8u) {
+        u64 word;
+        memcpy(&word, src + i, sizeof word);
+        hash = (hash ^ word) * 1099511628211ull;
+    }
+    if (c && c->face_serial[0] == hash) { c->checked = g.frames + 1u; c->last_use = g.frames; return c->handle; }
+    if (!c) {   /* a free slot, else the least recently used */
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < ENG_MAX_BCUBES; i++)
+            if (!c || !g.bcubes[i].handle ||
+                (c->handle && g.bcubes[i].last_use < c->last_use)) c = &g.bcubes[i];
+        if (c->handle) g.be->texture_release(g.be->user, c->handle);
+        memset(c, 0, sizeof *c);
+        c->location = t->location; c->offset = t->offset; c->size = w; c->mips = nlv;
+        c->remap = remap; c->format = t->format;
+        c->handle = g.be->texture_create(g.be->user, eng_texfmt(lv[0].tl.fmt), w, w, nlv, 6u,
+                                         remap, t->format);
+        if (!c->handle) { memset(c, 0, sizeof *c); return 0; }
+    }
+    for (u32 f = 0; f < 6; f++)
+        for (u32 m = 0; m < nlv; m++) {
+            const u32 lw = lv[m].w, lh = lv[m].h;
+            const u32 pw = eng_border_pad(lw), ph = eng_border_pad(lh);
+            const u32 ox = (pw - lw) / 2u, oy = (ph - lh) / 2u;
+            const u32 l2w = rsx_log2_ceil(pw), l2h = rsx_log2_ceil(ph);
+            rsx_tex_layout ltl = lv[m].tl;
+            ltl.swizzled = 0;
+            ltl.row_bytes = lw * bpp;
+            const u32 out = ltl.dst_row_bytes * ltl.rows;
+            if (!eng_staging_reserve(out + lw * lh * bpp)) return c->handle;
+            u8* lin = g.tex_staging + out;
+            const u8* level_src = src + (size_t)f * face + level_off[m];
+            for (u32 y = 0; y < lh; y++)
+                for (u32 x = 0; x < lw; x++)
+                    memcpy(lin + ((size_t)y * lw + x) * bpp,
+                           level_src + (size_t)rsx_swizzle_offset(x + ox, y + oy, l2w, l2h) * bpp, bpp);
+            rsx_texture_decode(g.tex_staging, ltl.dst_row_bytes, lin, lw, lh, &ltl,
+                               rsx_texture_argb_is_rgba());
+            g.be->texture_upload(g.be->user, c->handle, f, m, lw, lh, g.tex_staging,
+                                 ltl.dst_row_bytes, ltl.rows);
+        }
+    c->face_serial[0] = hash;
+    c->checked = g.frames + 1u;
+    c->last_use = g.frames;
+    return c->handle;

+
+/* A texture starting inside a colour target, the target being drawn included:
+ * the window it reads, as a copy made in command order (color_region at x, y),
+ * as rsx_live_draw.c's surface_window does. GT5 measures a scene's brightness
+ * by halving it level by level into rows further down one 2048x1293 target and
+ * reads each level back by its address; looked up only by a target's first
+ * byte, those levels came from stale guest memory, the exposure came out
+ * wrong, and title scenes and races were washed out or banded. A pitch-linear
+ * texture with the target's pitch and texel size only. 0 when none holds it.
+ * at_base: a texture at the target's own first byte too (only ever the target
+ * being drawn, the caller's feedback case): smaller than the target, it is that
+ * corner. GT5 builds each 256x256 reflection face's mip chain in the rows below
+ * it (a 256x511 target) and draws the 128x128 level reading the face itself:
+ * refused as feedback, that level was never drawn, and every smaller level
+ * (each read from the one above) was made from whatever those rows held. */
+static u32 eng_inner_window(const rsx_dsp_texture* t, int at_base)
+{
+    /* One texel at the target's first byte is that texel whatever the layout (GT5's shadow pass
+     * binds a 1x1 swizzled texture at its own colour target's address). */
+    const int one_texel = at_base && t->width == 1 && t->height == 1;
+    if (!g.be->color_region || !t->width || !t->height || t->cubemap || t->dimension == 3 ||
+        (!one_texel && (!(t->format & RSX_TEX_FMT_LINEAR) || !t->pitch)))
+        return 0;
+    const u32 base = t->format & 0x9Fu;
+    const u32 tb = (base == 0x85u || base == 0x9Eu) ? 4u : base == 0x9Au ? 8u : 0u;
+    if (!tb) return 0;
+    /* The CLOSEST base at or below the address, the newest write on a tie (eng_surface_at's rule):
+     * surfaces' guest ranges overlap. GT5 halves its 1080p race into rows 64 and 80 of the 2048x1938
+     * target at 0x02EC0000 and reads the 16x8 at row 80 back to set the exposure; the first surface
+     * in the table holding those rows was an older, taller one from an earlier scene, so each level
+     * was made from a frozen patch of it and races came out washed out (or dark) by whatever it
+     * held. VK_WIN_FIRST=1 takes the first one again; PS3_AB_WHAT=vkwin alternates (tests). */
+    static int first_env = -1;
+    if (first_env < 0) { const char* e = getenv("VK_WIN_FIRST"); first_env = e && atoi(e) != 0; }
+    extern int ps3_ab_on(const char* what);
+    const int ab = ps3_ab_on("vkwin");
+    const int closest = ab < 0 ? !first_env : ab;
+    int best = -1, first = -1;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_surfaces; i++) {
+        const eng_surface* s = &g.surfaces[i];
+        if (!s->handle || s->location != t->location || eng_transfer_bpp(s->fmt) != tb ||
+            (!s->color_serial && !at_base))
+            continue;
+        if (one_texel) {
+            if (t->offset != s->offset) continue;
+        } else if (!s->pitch || s->pitch != t->pitch || t->offset < s->offset ||
+                   (u64)(t->offset - s->offset) >= (u64)s->pitch * s->h) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        if (t->offset == s->offset && (!at_base || (t->width >= s->w && t->height >= s->h)))
+            continue;
+        const u32 d = t->offset - s->offset;
+        const u32 x0 = one_texel ? 0u : (d % s->pitch) / tb, y0 = one_texel ? 0u : d / s->pitch;
+        if ((!one_texel && (d % s->pitch) % tb) || x0 + t->width > s->w || y0 + t->height > s->h) continue;
+        if (first < 0) first = (int)i;
+        if (best < 0 || s->offset > g.surfaces[best].offset ||
+            (s->offset == g.surfaces[best].offset && s->color_serial > g.surfaces[best].color_serial))
+            best = (int)i;
+    }
+    if (!closest) best = first;
+    if (best < 0) return 0;
+    if (best != first) {
+        static int n_log;
+        if (n_log++ < 12)
+            fprintf(stderr, "[rsx-engine] window %ux%u at 0x%08X: from target 0x%08X %ux%u, not the first"
+                            " holding it (0x%08X %ux%u)\n", t->width, t->height, t->offset,
+                    g.surfaces[best].offset, g.surfaces[best].w, g.surfaces[best].h,
+                    g.surfaces[first].offset, g.surfaces[first].w, g.surfaces[first].h);
+    }
+    {
+        eng_surface* s = &g.surfaces[best];
+        if (at_base) {
+            static int n_log;
+            if (n_log++ < 4)
+                fprintf(stderr, "[rsx-engine] corner %ux%u of the target being drawn 0x%08X %ux%u,"
+                                " copied for this draw\n", t->width, t->height, s->offset, s->w, s->h);
+        }
+        const u32 d = t->offset - s->offset;
+        const u32 x0 = one_texel ? 0u : (d % s->pitch) / tb, y0 = one_texel ? 0u : d / s->pitch;
+        s->last_use = g.frames;
+        u32 k = 24, lru = 0;
+        for (u32 j = 0; j < 24; j++) {
+            if (g.inner[j].copy && g.inner[j].src == s->handle && g.inner[j].x == x0 &&
+                g.inner[j].y == y0 && g.inner[j].w == t->width && g.inner[j].h == t->height) { k = j; break; }
+            if (!g.inner[j].copy || (g.inner[lru].copy && g.inner[j].used < g.inner[lru].used)) lru = j;
+        }
+        if (k == 24 || g.inner[k].serial != s->color_serial) {
+            /* [res] of a surface at a scale, the same window at its scale (by its edges) */
+            const u32 copy = s->rs == 1.0f
+                ? g.be->color_region(g.be->user, s->handle, x0, y0, t->width, t->height)
+                : g.be->color_region(g.be->user, s->handle, eng_rs_he(x0, s->rs), eng_rs_he(y0, s->rs),
+                                     eng_rs_he(x0 + t->width, s->rs) - eng_rs_he(x0, s->rs),
+                                     eng_rs_he(y0 + t->height, s->rs) - eng_rs_he(y0, s->rs));
+            if (!copy) return 0;
+            if (k == 24) k = lru;
+            if (g.inner[k].copy) g.be->texture_release(g.be->user, g.inner[k].copy);
+            g.inner[k].src = s->handle; g.inner[k].x = x0; g.inner[k].y = y0;
+            g.inner[k].w = t->width; g.inner[k].h = t->height; g.inner[k].copy = copy;
+            g.inner[k].serial = s->color_serial;
+            static int n_log;
+            if (n_log++ < 16)
+                fprintf(stderr, "[rsx-engine] window %ux%u at %u,%u of target 0x%08X %ux%u\n",
+                        t->width, t->height, x0, y0, s->offset, s->w, s->h);
+        }
+        g.inner[k].used = ++g.inner_clock;
+        const u32 view = g.be->surface_view
+            ? g.be->surface_view(g.be->user, g.inner[k].copy, t->remap & 0xFFFFu, t->format) : 0;
+        return view ? view : g.inner[k].copy;
+    }
 }

+/* ---- Watch mode: draw fewer frames while nobody is driving -------------------
+ * The same idea as the live D3D12 engine's watch mode (rsx_live_draw.c, ld_watch_skip), for the
+ * hosts that draw through this engine -- GT5's Android port first of all, where it is what lets a
+ * B-Spec race run to the finish on a phone with the screen dimmed or off. The game is untouched:
+ * every frame's commands still run, flips, fences, labels and readbacks as before; only the drawing
+ * of some frames is left out, and a frame that was left out is not presented, so the screen holds
+ * the last drawn one.
+ *   - hidden (the host says nothing is on screen: an Android app in the background, screen off):
+ *     nothing is drawn;
+ *   - watching: one game frame in LD_WATCH_DRAW (default 2) is drawn, the drawn phase moving on by
+ *     one every 64 frames, so passes the game spreads over alternate frames still all get drawn.
+ *     A pass (colour target + zeta) the game does not draw every frame -- a label texture, a cube
+ *     face in turn -- always runs, since later frames sample it.
+ * LD_WATCH=0 off, 1 on by itself after LD_WATCH_IDLE_S (default 10) seconds with no pad input (any
+ * input ends it), 2 always. rsx_draw_engine_watch_toggle() switches it on and off by hand. */
+extern unsigned long long cellPad_last_activity_ms(void);
+extern unsigned long long cellPad_now_ms(void);
+extern u32 cellGcm_flip_serial(void);
+static struct {
+    int mode, draw_n, manual, hidden, state, skip, track;
+    unsigned long long idle_ms, start, k, frames, left_out, kept, rep;
+    u32 frame;
+    void (*listener)(int state);
+} w = { .mode = -1, .draw_n = 2, .idle_ms = 10000, .frame = 1 };
+#define W_PASS_SLOTS 1024u
+static struct { u64 key; u32 frame, hot; } w_pass[W_PASS_SLOTS];
+
+/* 1 when the current draw or clear's pass was also drawn in the frame before this one. */
+static int w_pass_hot(void)
+{
+    rsx_dsp_surface sf;
+    rsx_dsp_get_surface(&g.rsx, &sf);
+    const u64 key = ((u64)((sf.color_location[0] << 31) | (sf.color_offset[0] & 0x7FFFFFFFu)) << 32) |
+                    (u64)((sf.zeta_location << 31) | (sf.zeta_offset & 0x7FFFFFFFu));
+    u32 h = (u32)((key * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) >> 54) & (W_PASS_SLOTS - 1u);
+    int spare = -1;
+    for (u32 probe = 0; probe < 16; probe++, h = (h + 1u) & (W_PASS_SLOTS - 1u)) {
+        if (w_pass[h].frame && w_pass[h].key == key) {
+            if (w_pass[h].frame != w.frame) {
+                w_pass[h].hot = w_pass[h].frame + 1u == w.frame;
+                w_pass[h].frame = w.frame;
+            }
+            return (int)w_pass[h].hot;
+        }
+        if (spare < 0 && (!w_pass[h].frame || w_pass[h].frame + 1u < w.frame)) spare = (int)h;
+    }
+    if (spare >= 0) { w_pass[spare].key = key; w_pass[spare].frame = w.frame; w_pass[spare].hot = 0; }
+    return 0;
+}
+
+/* Game frames and drawn frames since the start, for the window title's FPS (rsx_vulkan_backend.c). */
+static volatile unsigned long long s_title_game, s_title_drawn;
+void rsx_draw_engine_frame_counts(unsigned long long* game, unsigned long long* drawn)
+{
+    *game = s_title_game;
+    *drawn = s_title_drawn;
+}
+
+static void w_frame_boundary(void)
+{
+    /* PS3_AB_PERIOD's per-segment report. The D3D12 path counts its frames in rsx_live_draw.c; this
+     * engine runs only when that one doesn't (Vulkan, Metal), so no frame is counted twice. */
+    { extern void ps3_ab_frame(void); ps3_ab_frame(); }
+    if (w.mode < 0) {
+        const char* e = getenv("LD_WATCH_IDLE_S"); if (e && atoi(e) >= 0) w.idle_ms = (unsigned long long)atoi(e) * 1000ull;
+    }
+    {   /* Watch mode and how many frames it draws come through the settings registry, as in the DirectX 12
+         * engine (rsx_live_draw.c), so a change is followed while the game runs. (The launcher's old 30 fps
+         * Speed setting read as LD_WATCH=2 and LD_WATCH_DRAW=2; Frame rate's 30 is the game's own half rate.) */
+        static unsigned gen = ~0u;
+        if (gen != gt5_settings_gen()) {
+            gen = gt5_settings_gen();
+            w.mode = gt5_setting_int("LD_WATCH", 0);
+            const int dn = gt5_setting_int("LD_WATCH_DRAW", 2);
+            w.draw_n = dn >= 1 ? dn : 2;
+        }
+    }
+    const unsigned long long now = cellPad_now_ms(), last = cellPad_last_activity_ms();
+    if (!w.start) w.start = now;
+    const unsigned long long quiet_since = last ? last : w.start;
+    const int watching = w.manual || w.mode == 2 || (w.mode == 1 && now - quiet_since >= w.idle_ms);
+    const int state = w.hidden ? 2 : watching;
+    w.track = state != 0;
+    if (state != w.state) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[watch] %s\n", state == 2 ? "hidden: nothing drawn" :
+                state ? "on: drawing fewer frames" : "off: drawing every frame");
+        w.state = state;
+        if (w.listener) w.listener(state);
+    }
+    w.frame++;
+    if (state == 2)     w.skip = 1;
+    else if (!watching) w.skip = 0;
+    else { w.k++; w.skip = ((w.k + w.k / 64u) % (unsigned long long)w.draw_n) != 0; }
+    w.frames++;
+    if (w.skip) w.left_out++;
+    s_title_game++;
+    if (!w.skip) s_title_drawn++;
+    if (!w.rep) w.rep = now;
+    if (now - w.rep >= 5000) {
+        if (w.left_out)
+            fprintf(stderr, "[watch] %llu of %llu game frames drawn; %llu draws and clears of passes "
+                            "not redrawn every frame run in the others\n",
+                    w.frames - w.left_out, w.frames, w.kept);
+        w.frames = w.left_out = w.kept = 0;
+        w.rep = now;
+    }
+}
+
+/* 1: leave the current draw or clear out (the first one after a flip decides for the frame). */
+static int w_leave_out(void)
+{
+    static u32 last;
+    const u32 s = cellGcm_flip_serial();
+    if (s != last) { last = s; w_frame_boundary(); }
+    if (!w.skip && !w.track) return 0;
+    const int hot = w_pass_hot();
+    if (!w.skip || w.state == 2) return w.skip;
+    if (hot) return 1;
+    w.kept++;
+    return 0;
+}

+void rsx_draw_engine_set_hidden(int hidden) { w.hidden = hidden != 0; }
+void rsx_draw_engine_watch_toggle(void)
+{
+    w.manual = !w.manual;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[watch] switched %s by hand\n", w.manual ? "on" : "off");
+}
+int  rsx_draw_engine_watch_state(void) { return w.state; }
+void rsx_draw_engine_set_watch_listener(void (*fn)(int state)) { w.listener = fn; }
