+/* ---- [shadow] Shadows High / Ultra (LD_SHADOWS) ---------------------------------------------------------
+ * The DirectX 12 renderer's [shadow2] (rsx_live_draw.c), for a backend that says it can
+ * (rsx_draw_backend.sm_scale_ok: Vulkan). A shadow map is drawn at 2x (High, the default) or 4x (Ultra)
+ * its size per axis and compare reads of it go through the decompiler's soft filter
+ * (rsx_fp_shadow_desc.soft): finer, smoother shadow edges where the PS3's map was blocky. Standard: the
+ * PS3's map, as before.
+ * Which zetas, by DirectX 12's rule: one a fragment program reads with the depth compare on
+ * (rsx_fp_shadow_desc enabled == 1: DEPTH16 or DEPTH24, 2D, one level) through a texture exactly the size
+ * its passes drew, at least 64x64. Found in one frame, drawn larger from the next flip, so all of a frame's
+ * casters are at one scale. Never one that a colour-writing draw depth- or stencil-tests against (a scene's
+ * depth), one read as a colour texture, one drawn with an antialiasing sample grid or several colour
+ * targets, one whose larger targets can't be made, nor one read through a texture of another size or in a
+ * way the larger map can't serve: those stay at the guest's size ("[shadow-scale] ... stays at guest size").
+ * Its passes (no colour written) run at the scale into a depth target of their own (eng_zdepth.sm_*, the
+ * map's extent times the scale, not padded to the frame) with a colour target of that size the engine keeps
+ * for them (the backends' pipelines are made for one colour attachment, and an attachment smaller than the
+ * pass would cut it); the viewport, scissor and clear rectangles are scaled, and polygon offset's slope with
+ * them (its constant part is depth). The guest-size target is kept, so going back to Standard is seamless.
+ * Reads take the larger target at the larger size (a DEPTH24 snapshot, a DEPTH16 conversion): normalized
+ * coordinates sample it in place; texel coordinates are guest texels, multiplied by the scale in the shader
+ * (rsx_fp_shadow_desc.scale); compare reads go through the soft filter.
+ * PS3RECOMP_ENG_SHADOW_MAPS=0: the guest's size whatever the setting says, as before.
+ * Sizes: GT5's 1024x2048 map is 2048x4096 at High and 4096x8192 at Ultra; a map past 4096x8192 texels or
+ * ENG_MAX_SURFACE_DIM a side at the scale asked for gets the largest that fits.
+ * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
+#define ENG_SM_MAX 8
+#define ENG_SM_MAX_TEXELS (4096ull * 8192ull)
+enum { ENG_SM_FREE = 0, ENG_SM_FOUND, ENG_SM_ACTIVE, ENG_SM_VETO };
+typedef struct { u32 loc, off, w, h, scale; u8 state; } eng_sm_map;
+static struct {
+    eng_sm_map map[ENG_SM_MAX];
+    u32 n;
+    u32 want;                       /* the scale the setting asks for: 1, 2, 4 */
+    int level;                      /* 0 Standard, 1 High, 2 Ultra */
+    int on;                         /* some map is drawn larger */
+    int release;                    /* targets of a scale no longer drawn at go at the next flip */
+    unsigned gen; int have_gen;
+    u32 logs, skip_logs;
+    u32 scratch[2], scratch_w[2], scratch_h[2];   /* the passes' colour targets */
+    rsx_be_format scratch_fmt[2];
+} s_sm = { .want = 1u };
+#define eng_sm_log(...) do { if (s_sm.logs < 24u) { s_sm.logs++; fprintf(stderr, "[shadow-scale] " __VA_ARGS__); } } while (0)
+
+static int eng_sm_allowed(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("PS3RECOMP_ENG_SHADOW_MAPS"); on = !(e && e[0] == '0'); }
+    return on && g.be && g.be->sm_scale_ok;
+}
+static eng_sm_map* eng_sm_find(u32 loc, u32 off)
+{
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_sm.n; i++)
+        if (s_sm.map[i].state != ENG_SM_FREE && s_sm.map[i].loc == loc && s_sm.map[i].off == off) return &s_sm.map[i];
+    return NULL;
+}
+/* The scale a pass or a read of loc:off finds the map at (1: not a map drawn larger). */
+static u32 eng_sm_scale_of(u32 loc, u32 off)
+{
+    if (!s_sm.on) return 1u;
+    const eng_sm_map* m = eng_sm_find(loc, off);
+    return m && m->state == ENG_SM_ACTIVE && m->scale > 1u ? m->scale : 1u;
+}
+/* eng_pipeline_get: a compare read of loc:off through the soft filter, texel coordinates times the scale. */
+static void eng_sm_shadow_desc(u32 loc, u32 off, rsx_fp_shadow_desc* d)
+{
+    if (d->enabled != 1 || !s_sm.on) return;
+    const u32 s = eng_sm_scale_of(loc, off);
+    if (s <= 1u) return;
+    if (s_sm.level >= 1) d->soft = 1;
+    if (d->unnormalized) d->scale = (u8)s;
+}
+/* The largest of want, want/2, ... 1 a w x h map can be drawn at. */
+static u32 eng_sm_fit(u32 mw, u32 mh, u32 want)
+{
+    u32 s = want;
+    while (s > 1u) {
+        const unsigned long long hw = (unsigned long long)mw * s, hh = (unsigned long long)mh * s;
+        if (hw <= ENG_MAX_SURFACE_DIM && hh <= ENG_MAX_SURFACE_DIM && hw * hh <= ENG_SM_MAX_TEXELS) break;
+        s /= 2u;
+    }
+    return s < 1u ? 1u : s;
+}
+static void eng_sm_release_zeta(eng_zdepth* z)
+{
+    if (z->sm_snap && g.be->texture_release) g.be->texture_release(g.be->user, z->sm_snap);
+    if (z->sm_conv && g.be->texture_release) g.be->texture_release(g.be->user, z->sm_conv);
+    if (z->sm_handle) g.be->depth_target_release(g.be->user, z->sm_handle);
+    z->sm_handle = z->sm_w = z->sm_h = z->sm_s = 0;
+    z->sm_cleared = z->sm_had_write = 0;
+    z->sm_snap = z->sm_snap_w = z->sm_snap_h = 0;
+    z->sm_snap_valid = 0;
+    z->sm_conv = z->sm_conv_w = z->sm_conv_h = z->sm_conv_fmt = 0;
+    z->sm_conv_serial = 0;
+}
+/* loc:off is not a shadow map to draw larger: from now on its passes run at the guest's size. */
+static void eng_sm_veto(u32 loc, u32 off, const char* why)
+{
+    eng_sm_map* m = eng_sm_find(loc, off);
+    if (m && m->state == ENG_SM_VETO) return;
+    if (!m) {
+        if (s_sm.n == ENG_SM_MAX) return;
+        m = &s_sm.map[s_sm.n++];
+        memset(m, 0, sizeof *m);
+        m->loc = loc; m->off = off;
+    }
+    const int was_on = m->state == ENG_SM_ACTIVE && m->scale > 1u;
+    m->state = ENG_SM_VETO;
+    m->scale = 1u;
+    if (was_on) {
+        s_sm.release = 1;
+        s_sm.on = 0;
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < s_sm.n; i++)
+            if (s_sm.map[i].state == ENG_SM_ACTIVE && s_sm.map[i].scale > 1u) s_sm.on = 1;
+    }
+    eng_sm_log("frame %u: zeta %u:0x%X stays at guest size: %s\n", g.frames, loc, off, why);
+}
+/* A draw that writes colour depth- or stencil-tests against zeta slot zi (sink_end). */
+static void eng_sm_colour_pass(u32 zi)
+{
+    eng_zdepth* z = &g.zdepths[zi];
+    if (z->sm_colour || !eng_sm_allowed()) return;
+    z->sm_colour = 1;
+    const eng_sm_map* m = eng_sm_find(z->location, z->offset);
+    if (m && m->state != ENG_SM_VETO) eng_sm_veto(z->location, z->offset, "a draw that writes colour tests against it");
+}
+/* A texture unit reads zeta slot zi through t (sink_bind_textures): finds shadow maps, and vetoes the reads
+ * a larger map can't serve. */
+static void eng_sm_note_read(const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u32 zi, u32 unit)
+{
+    if (!eng_sm_allowed()) return;
+    eng_zdepth* z = &g.zdepths[zi];
+    const u32 base = t->format & RSX_TEX_FMT_BASE_MASK;
+    eng_sm_map* m = eng_sm_find(t->location, t->offset);
+    if (base < 0x90u || base > 0x93u) {               /* read as colour (the D24S8 bytes) */
+        if (z->sm_colour) return;
+        z->sm_colour = 1;
+        if (m && m->state != ENG_SM_VETO) eng_sm_veto(t->location, t->offset, "read as a colour texture");
+        return;
+    }
+    if (m && m->state == ENG_SM_VETO) return;
+    if (m && m->state == ENG_SM_ACTIVE) {
+        if (t->width != m->w || t->height != m->h)
+            eng_sm_veto(t->location, t->offset, "read through a texture of another size than drawn");
+        return;                                        /* the usual case, every frame */
+    }
+    eng_sm_setting();                                  /* before the first flip too */
+    if (s_sm.want <= 1u) return;
+    rsx_fp_shadow_desc d;
+    rsx_fp_shadow_desc_from_texture(&d, t->format, t->dimension, t->cubemap, t->mipmaps, t->filter, t->wrap, t->control0);
+    if (d.enabled != 1) return;                        /* not a compare: any scale serves it */
+    if (m) return;                                     /* found this frame already */
+    const u32 ew = z->ext_w, eh = z->ext_h;
+    const char* why = z->sm_colour ? "used with colour (a draw that writes colour tests against it, or a colour read)"
+                    : (t->width != ew || t->height != eh) ? "read through a texture of another size than drawn"
+                    : (ew < 64u || eh < 64u) ? "smaller than 64 x 64" : NULL;
+    if (why) {
+        if (s_sm.skip_logs < 8u) {
+            s_sm.skip_logs++;
+            fprintf(stderr, "[shadow-scale] frame %u: depth compare on zeta %u:0x%X %ux%u (texture %ux%u, unit %u) not "
+                            "scaled: %s\n", g.frames, t->location, t->offset, ew, eh, t->width, t->height, unit, why);
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+    if (s_sm.n == ENG_SM_MAX) return;
+    m = &s_sm.map[s_sm.n++];
+    memset(m, 0, sizeof *m);
+    m->loc = t->location; m->off = t->offset; m->w = ew; m->h = eh; m->scale = 1u; m->state = ENG_SM_FOUND;
+    eng_sm_log("frame %u: shadow map found: zeta %u:0x%X %s %ux%u (unit %u, compare %u%s), drawn at x%u from the next frame\n",
+               g.frames, m->loc, m->off, base >= 0x92u ? "DEPTH16" : "DEPTH24", ew, eh, unit, (unsigned)d.func,
+               d.linear ? ", linear" : "", eng_sm_fit(ew, eh, s_sm.want));
+}
+/* The setting's level: 0 Standard, 1 High (also unset), 2 Ultra (DirectX 12's ld_sm_level_read). */
+static int eng_sm_ieq(const char* a, const char* b)
+{
+    for (; *a && *b; a++, b++) {
+        const char x = (char)(*a >= 'A' && *a <= 'Z' ? *a + 32 : *a), y = (char)(*b >= 'A' && *b <= 'Z' ? *b + 32 : *b);
+        if (x != y) return 0;
+    }
+    return *a == *b;
+}
+static int eng_sm_level_read(void)
+{
+    char v[32];
+    gt5_setting_str("LD_SHADOWS", v, sizeof v);
+    if (!v[0] || eng_sm_ieq(v, "high") || !strcmp(v, "2")) return 1;
+    if (eng_sm_ieq(v, "ultra") || !strcmp(v, "4")) return 2;
+    if (eng_sm_ieq(v, "standard") || eng_sm_ieq(v, "ps3") || eng_sm_ieq(v, "off") || !strcmp(v, "0") || !strcmp(v, "1"))
+        return 0;
+    return 1;
+}
+/* At every flip: the setting, the maps found in the frame that ended, and the targets of scales no longer
+ * drawn at (between two frames). */
+static void eng_sm_setting(void)
+{
+    if (!s_sm.have_gen || s_sm.gen != gt5_settings_gen()) {
+        s_sm.have_gen = 1;
+        s_sm.gen = gt5_settings_gen();
+        const int level = eng_sm_level_read();
+        const u32 want = level == 2 ? 4u : level == 1 ? 2u : 1u;
+        if (want != s_sm.want || level != s_sm.level) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "[shadow-scale] frame %u: Shadows %s (x%u%s)\n", g.frames,
+                    level == 2 ? "Ultra" : level == 1 ? "High" : "Standard", want, level ? ", soft" : "");
+            s_sm.level = level;
+            s_sm.want = want;
+        }
+    }
+}
+static void eng_sm_flip(void)
+{
+    if (!eng_sm_allowed()) return;
+    eng_sm_setting();
+    int any = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_sm.n; i++) {
+        eng_sm_map* m = &s_sm.map[i];
+        if (m->state == ENG_SM_FOUND) m->state = ENG_SM_ACTIVE;
+        if (m->state != ENG_SM_ACTIVE) continue;
+        const u32 s = eng_sm_fit(m->w, m->h, s_sm.want);
+        if (s != m->scale) {
+            if (m->scale > 1u) s_sm.release = 1;
+            m->scale = s;
+            eng_sm_log("frame %u: zeta %u:0x%X %ux%u drawn at x%u = %ux%u\n", g.frames, m->loc, m->off, m->w, m->h, s,
+                       m->w * s, m->h * s);
+        }
+        if (m->scale > 1u) any = 1;
+    }
+    if (s_sm.on && !any) s_sm.release = 1;
+    s_sm.on = any;
+    if (!s_sm.release) return;
+    s_sm.release = 0;
+    u32 n = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_zdepths; i++) {
+        eng_zdepth* z = &g.zdepths[i];
+        if (!z->sm_handle) continue;
+        if (eng_sm_scale_of(z->location, z->offset) == z->sm_s) continue;
+        eng_sm_release_zeta(z);
+        n++;
+    }
+    if (!s_sm.on)
+        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++)
+            if (s_sm.scratch[k]) {
+                g.be->color_target_release(g.be->user, s_sm.scratch[k]);
+                s_sm.scratch[k] = s_sm.scratch_w[k] = s_sm.scratch_h[k] = 0;
+            }
+    if (n) fprintf(stderr, "[shadow-scale] frame %u: %u larger depth target%s of an earlier scale released\n", g.frames, n,
+                   n == 1u ? "" : "s");
+}
+/* A pass into zeta slot zi (sink_end): when it is a map drawn larger and the pass writes no colour, its larger
+ * depth target and a colour target of that size, made or kept, the depth target initialised. Returns the
+ * scale (1: the pass runs as before). */
+static u32 eng_sm_pass(u32 zi, const rsx_be_render_state* rs, u32 n_targets, const rsx_dsp_surface* sf,
+                       rsx_be_format fmt, u32* colour)
+{
+    if (zi == ENG_INVALID || !s_sm.on || rs->color_mask) return 1u;
+    eng_zdepth* z = &g.zdepths[zi];
+    const u32 s = eng_sm_scale_of(z->location, z->offset);
+    if (s <= 1u) return 1u;
+    const eng_sm_map* m = eng_sm_find(z->location, z->offset);
+    if (n_targets != 1u) { eng_sm_veto(z->location, z->offset, "a pass with several colour targets"); return 1u; }
+    if (sf->aa_sx > 1u || sf->aa_sy > 1u) { eng_sm_veto(z->location, z->offset, "drawn with an antialiasing sample grid"); return 1u; }
+    const u32 cw = sf->clip_w ? sf->clip_w : g.width, ch = sf->clip_h ? sf->clip_h : g.height;
+    const u32 gw = cw > m->w ? cw : m->w, gh = ch > m->h ? ch : m->h;
+    const u32 need_w = gw * s, need_h = gh * s;
+    if (!z->sm_handle || z->sm_s != s || z->sm_w < need_w || z->sm_h < need_h) {
+        eng_sm_release_zeta(z);
+        const u32 hd = (need_w <= ENG_MAX_SURFACE_DIM && need_h <= ENG_MAX_SURFACE_DIM)
+                    ? g.be->depth_target_create(g.be->user, need_w, need_h) : 0;
+        if (!hd) { eng_sm_veto(z->location, z->offset, "its larger depth buffer could not be made"); return 1u; }
+        z->sm_handle = hd; z->sm_w = need_w; z->sm_h = need_h; z->sm_s = s;
+        eng_sm_log("frame %u: zeta %u:0x%X: its passes draw at x%u into %ux%u\n", g.frames, z->location, z->offset, s,
+                   need_w, need_h);
+    }
+    int k = -1;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 2 && k < 0; i++)
+        if (s_sm.scratch[i] && s_sm.scratch_fmt[i] == fmt && s_sm.scratch_w[i] == z->sm_w && s_sm.scratch_h[i] == z->sm_h) k = i;
+    if (k < 0) {
+        k = !s_sm.scratch[0] ? 0 : !s_sm.scratch[1] ? 1 : (s_sm.scratch_fmt[0] == fmt ? 0 : 1);
+        if (s_sm.scratch[k]) g.be->color_target_release(g.be->user, s_sm.scratch[k]);
+        s_sm.scratch[k] = g.be->color_target_create(g.be->user, fmt, z->sm_w, z->sm_h, NULL, 0);
+        s_sm.scratch_fmt[k] = fmt; s_sm.scratch_w[k] = z->sm_w; s_sm.scratch_h[k] = z->sm_h;
+        if (!s_sm.scratch[k]) {
+            s_sm.scratch_w[k] = s_sm.scratch_h[k] = 0;
+            eng_sm_veto(z->location, z->offset, "its pass's colour target could not be made");
+            return 1u;
+        }
+    }
+    if (!z->sm_cleared) {
+        g.be->clear_depth_stencil(g.be->user, z->sm_handle, RSX_BE_CLEAR_DEPTH | RSX_BE_CLEAR_STENCIL, 1.0f, 0);
+        z->sm_cleared = 1;
+        z->sm_had_write = 0;
+        z->sm_snap_valid = 0;
+    }
+    *colour = s_sm.scratch[k];
+    return s;
+}
+/* A depth or stencil clear of zeta slot zi (sink_clear): its larger target too, the rectangle scaled. */
+static void eng_sm_clear(u32 zi, const rsx_dsp_surface* sf, u32 flags, float depth, u8 stencil)
+{
+    eng_zdepth* z = &g.zdepths[zi];
+    if (!z->sm_handle || !z->sm_s || eng_sm_scale_of(z->location, z->offset) != z->sm_s) return;
+    const u32 s = z->sm_s;
+    u32 rc[4];
+    const int part = eng_clear_rect(sf, z->sm_w / s, z->sm_h / s, rc);
+    if (!part) return;
+    if (part == 2 && g.be->clear_depth_stencil_rect) {
+        if (!z->sm_cleared)
+            g.be->clear_depth_stencil(g.be->user, z->sm_handle, RSX_BE_CLEAR_DEPTH | RSX_BE_CLEAR_STENCIL, 1.0f, 0);
+        g.be->clear_depth_stencil_rect(g.be->user, z->sm_handle, flags, depth, stencil,
+                                       rc[0] * s, rc[1] * s, rc[2] * s, rc[3] * s);
+    } else {
+        g.be->clear_depth_stencil(g.be->user, z->sm_handle, flags, depth, stencil);
+        if (flags & RSX_BE_CLEAR_DEPTH) z->sm_had_write = 0;
+    }
+    z->sm_cleared = 1;
+    z->sm_snap_valid = 0;
+}
+/* A read of zeta slot zi through t (sink_bind_textures) when it is a map drawn larger: its larger target at
+ * the larger size, or 0 for the reads before (the guest-size target). A read the larger map can't serve
+ * makes it a guest-size map again. */
+static u32 eng_sm_read(u32 zi, const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u32 current_zslot)
+{
+    eng_zdepth* z = &g.zdepths[zi];
+    const u32 s = eng_sm_scale_of(t->location, t->offset);
+    if (s <= 1u || !z->sm_handle || z->sm_s != s || !z->sm_cleared) return 0;
+    const eng_sm_map* m = eng_sm_find(t->location, t->offset);
+    if (!m || t->width != m->w || t->height != m->h) return 0;
+    const u32 tw = m->w * s, th = m->h * s;
+    const u32 base = t->format & RSX_TEX_FMT_BASE_MASK;
+    if (base == RSX_TEX_FMT_DEPTH24_D8 && current_zslot != zi && g.be->depth_snapshot) {
+        if (z->sm_snap_valid && z->sm_snap && z->sm_snap_w == tw && z->sm_snap_h == th) return z->sm_snap;
+        const u32 tex = g.be->depth_snapshot(g.be->user, z->sm_handle, tw, th);
+        if (tex) {
+            if (z->sm_snap && z->sm_snap != tex && g.be->texture_release) g.be->texture_release(g.be->user, z->sm_snap);
+            z->sm_snap = tex; z->sm_snap_w = tw; z->sm_snap_h = th; z->sm_snap_valid = 1;
+            return tex;
+        }
+    } else if (base == RSX_TEX_FMT_DEPTH16 && z->zfmt == 1u && g.be->depth_as_color && g.be->surface_view &&
+               (t->format & RSX_TEX_FMT_LINEAR) && !t->cubemap && t->dimension != 3 && t->mipmaps <= 1 &&
+               t->pitch == z->pitch) {
+        if (!z->sm_conv || z->sm_conv_serial != z->depth_serial || z->sm_conv_fmt != base ||
+            z->sm_conv_w != tw || z->sm_conv_h != th) {
+            const u32 tex = g.be->depth_as_color(g.be->user, z->sm_handle, tw, th, base);
+            if (tex) {
+                if (z->sm_conv) g.be->texture_release(g.be->user, z->sm_conv);
+                z->sm_conv = tex; z->sm_conv_w = tw; z->sm_conv_h = th; z->sm_conv_fmt = base;
+                z->sm_conv_serial = z->depth_serial;
+            }
+        }
+        const u32 v = z->sm_conv ? g.be->surface_view(g.be->user, z->sm_conv, t->remap & 0xFFFFu, t->format) : 0;
+        if (v) return v;
+    }
+    eng_sm_veto(t->location, t->offset, "read in a way the larger map can't serve");
+    return 0;
+}
+/* ---- [shadow] end -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
+
+/* ---- [res] (second block): the colour targets of the engine's own, a change of scale, the setting ------------- */
+/* A colour target for a pass that writes no colour and runs at another scale than the surface its colour registers
+ * name (eng_rs_pass; or a scaled surface its clip doesn't fit in): w x h image texels, the size of its zeta entry,
+ * so the pass's attachments are one size. Four kept, the least recently used goes. 0 when it can't be had. */
+static u32 s_rs_dummy_use[4], s_rs_dummy_clock;
+static u32 s_rs_dummy4[4], s_rs_dummy4_w[4], s_rs_dummy4_h[4];
+static rsx_be_format s_rs_dummy4_fmt[4];
+static u32 eng_rs_dummy(rsx_be_format fmt, u32 dw, u32 dh)
+{
+    int k = -1;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 4 && k < 0; i++)
+        if (s_rs_dummy4[i] && s_rs_dummy4_fmt[i] == fmt && s_rs_dummy4_w[i] == dw && s_rs_dummy4_h[i] == dh) k = i;
+    if (k < 0) {
+        k = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
+            if (!s_rs_dummy4[i]) { k = i; break; }
+            if (s_rs_dummy_use[i] < s_rs_dummy_use[k]) k = i;
+        }
+        if (s_rs_dummy4[k]) g.be->color_target_release(g.be->user, s_rs_dummy4[k]);
+        s_rs_dummy4[k] = g.be->color_target_create(g.be->user, fmt, dw, dh, NULL, 0);
+        s_rs_dummy4_fmt[k] = fmt; s_rs_dummy4_w[k] = s_rs_dummy4[k] ? dw : 0u; s_rs_dummy4_h[k] = s_rs_dummy4[k] ? dh : 0u;
+        if (s_rs_dummy4[k]) eng_rs_log("frame %u: a %ux%u colour target of its own for passes that write no colour\n",
+                                       g.frames, dw, dh);
+    }
+    s_rs_dummy_use[k] = ++s_rs_dummy_clock;
+    return s_rs_dummy4[k];
+}
+static void eng_rs_release_dummies(void)
+{
+    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
+        if (s_rs_dummy4[i] && g.be) g.be->color_target_release(g.be->user, s_rs_dummy4[i]);
+        s_rs_dummy4[i] = s_rs_dummy4_w[i] = s_rs_dummy4_h[i] = 0;
+    }
+}
+/* The copies taken of surface s's image (feedback, region, windows): they go with it. */
+static void eng_rs_drop_copies(eng_surface* s)
+{
+    if (s->feedback) { g.be->texture_release(g.be->user, s->feedback); s->feedback = 0; }
+    if (s->region) { g.be->texture_release(g.be->user, s->region); s->region = 0; }
+    for (u32 j = 0; j < 24; j++)
+        if (g.inner[j].copy && g.inner[j].src == s->handle) {
+            g.be->texture_release(g.be->user, g.inner[j].copy);
+            memset(&g.inner[j], 0, sizeof g.inner[j]);
+        }
+}
+/* Surface i's image made again at scale rs (DirectX 12's ld_rs_resurface). What it shows is drawn across when the
+ * backend can (color_target_blit), so a surface the game draws once and keeps (a backdrop, a menu panel) keeps its
+ * picture; one it draws every frame is simply drawn again. 1 when made. */
+static int eng_rs_resurface(u32 i, float rs)
+{
+    eng_surface* s = &g.surfaces[i];
+    const u32 hw = eng_rs_hs(s->w, rs), hh = eng_rs_hs(s->h, rs);
+    const u32 nh = g.be->color_target_create(g.be->user, s->fmt, hw, hh, NULL, 0);
+    if (!nh) {
+        if (s_rs.fail_logs++ < 8u)
+            fprintf(stderr, "[res-scale] surface %u:0x%08X %ux%u stays at x%.3f: no %ux%u image\n", s->location, s->offset,
+                    s->w, s->h, (double)s->rs, hw, hh);
+        return 0;
+    }
+    const int kept = s->color_serial && g.be->color_target_blit &&
+        g.be->color_target_blit(g.be->user, nh, 0, 0, hw, hh, s->handle, 0, 0, eng_rs_hs(s->w, s->rs), eng_rs_hs(s->h, s->rs));
+    eng_rs_drop_copies(s);
+    g.be->color_target_release(g.be->user, s->handle);
+    s->handle = nh;
+    s->rs = rs;
+    if (s->color_serial) s->color_serial = kept ? ++g.write_serial : 0u;   /* copies of it are stale either way */
+    return 1;
+}
+/* Zeta entry i let go (a change of scale left nothing drawn at its scale). Its slot is taken by the next entry made. */
+static void eng_rs_release_zeta(u32 i)
+{
+    eng_zdepth* z = &g.zdepths[i];
+    eng_sm_release_zeta(z);
+    if (z->snapshot && g.be->texture_release) g.be->texture_release(g.be->user, z->snapshot);
+    if (z->conv) g.be->texture_release(g.be->user, z->conv);
+    if (z->handle) g.be->depth_target_release(g.be->user, z->handle);
+    const u32 last_use = z->last_use;
+    memset(z, 0, sizeof *z);
+    z->location = z->offset = ENG_RS_LOC_DEAD;
+    z->rs = 1.0f;
+    z->last_use = last_use;
+}
+/* A new scale takes effect, between two frames (DirectX 12's ld_rs_apply / ld_rs_remake): every surface whose scale
+ * eng_rs_pick now gives differently is made again, the zeta entries of scales no surface has any more are let go, and
+ * the colour targets of the engine's own with them. */
+/* Every surface whose scale eng_rs_pick_at now gives differently made again, the zeta entries of scales no surface
+ * has any more let go, and the engine's own colour targets with them (DirectX 12's ld_rs_remake). */
+static void eng_rs_remake(u32* n_surfaces, u32* n_zetas, u32* n_failed)
+{
+    u32 ns = 0, nz = 0, nf = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_surfaces; i++) {
+        eng_surface* c = &g.surfaces[i];
+        if (!c->handle) continue;
+        const float want = eng_rs_pick_at(c->location, c->offset, c->w, c->h, c->aa_grid & 0xFFu, (c->aa_grid >> 8) & 0xFFu);
+        if (want == c->rs) continue;
+        if (eng_rs_resurface(i, want)) ns++; else nf++;
+    }
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_zdepths; i++) {
+        eng_zdepth* z = &g.zdepths[i];
+        if (!z->handle || z->rs == 1.0f) continue;
+        int used = 0;
+        for (u32 k = 0; k < g.n_surfaces && !used; k++) used = g.surfaces[k].handle && g.surfaces[k].rs == z->rs;
+        if (used) continue;
+        eng_rs_release_zeta(i);
+        nz++;
+    }
+    eng_rs_release_dummies();
+    s_rs.pass_logs = 0; s_rs.logs = 0;       /* the surfaces and passes of the new scale are said again */
+    if (n_surfaces) *n_surfaces = ns;
+    if (n_zetas) *n_zetas = nz;
+    if (n_failed) *n_failed = nf;
+}
+static void eng_rs_apply(float s)
+{
+    s = eng_rs_clamp(s);
+    if (s == s_rs.user) return;
+    const float was = s_rs.user;
+    s_rs.user = s;
+    s_rs.on = s != 1.0f;
+    u32 ns = 0, nz = 0, nf = 0;
+    eng_rs_remake(&ns, &nz, &nf);
+    if (g.n_surfaces || g.n_zdepths)
+    fprintf(stderr, "[res-scale] x%.3f -> x%.3f at frame %u: %u surfaces made again%s, %u zeta entries released%s\n",
+            (double)was, (double)s, g.frames, ns, g.be->color_target_blit ? " (their pictures kept)" : "", nz,
+            nf ? " (some stay as they were: no image)" : "");
+}
+/* The scale the settings ask for, as DirectX 12 reads the same two: at the start LD_RES_SCALE when it is set (tests,
+ * an old settings.bat), else LD_RES_TARGET as lines of the video mode's height; from then on LD_RES_TARGET whenever it
+ * changes (the menu's Resolution row; "" = the game's own size), as its change callback (ld_menu_res_changed) does. */
+static float eng_rs_setting(int first)
+{
+    static char last[32];
+    char v[32], t[32];
+    gt5_setting_str("LD_RES_TARGET", t, sizeof t);
+    const int changed = strcmp(t, last) != 0;
+    memcpy(last, t, sizeof last);
+    if (first) {
+        gt5_setting_str("LD_RES_SCALE", v, sizeof v);
+        if (v[0]) return eng_rs_clamp((float)atof(v));
+    } else if (!changed) {
+        return s_rs.want;
+    }
+    const int lines = atoi(t);
+    if (lines > 0 && g.height) return eng_rs_clamp((float)lines / (float)g.height);
+    return 1.0f;
+}
+/* At every flip (and at the engine's start, before the first surface): the setting when it changed, and a change of
+ * scale applied here, between two frames. */
+static void eng_rs_flip(void)
+{
+    if (!eng_rs_allowed()) return;
+    eng_rs_switches();
+    if (!s_rs.have_gen || s_rs.gen != gt5_settings_gen()) {
+        const int first = !s_rs.have_gen;
+        s_rs.have_gen = 1;
+        s_rs.gen = gt5_settings_gen();
+        const float want = eng_rs_setting(first);
+        if (want != s_rs.want || (first && want != 1.0f))
+            fprintf(stderr, "[res-scale] frame %u: Resolution x%.3f (%ux%u drawn at %ux%u)\n", g.frames, (double)want,
+                    g.width, g.height, eng_rs_hs(g.width, want), eng_rs_hs(g.height, want));
+        s_rs.want = want;
+    }
+    float want = s_rs.want;
+    if (s_rs.cycle_ms) {   /* LD_RES_CYCLE (tests): the scale asked for (2 when none) and 1 in turn */
+        extern unsigned long long cellPad_now_ms(void);
+        const unsigned long long now = cellPad_now_ms();
+        if (!s_rs.cycle_at) s_rs.cycle_at = now;
+        if (now - s_rs.cycle_at >= s_rs.cycle_ms) { s_rs.cycle_at = now; s_rs.cycle_up = !s_rs.cycle_up; }
+        if (s_rs.cycle_up) want = want != 1.0f ? want : 2.0f;
+        else want = 1.0f;
+    }
+    if (want != s_rs.user) eng_rs_apply(want);
+}
+float rsx_draw_engine_res_scale(void) { return s_rs.user; }
+/* While a scale is in force: each distinct pass once (up to 96; LD_RES_PASSLOG=0 none): its colour target and scale,
+ * its clip, whether it writes colour, the scale it runs at and the zeta entry it takes. */
+static void eng_rs_log_pass(const rsx_dsp_surface* sf, u32 target, float prs, u32 zslot, int writes_colour, int own,
+                            int uncovered)
+{
+    static struct { u32 off, cw, ch, zoff; float prs; int wc; } seen[96];
+    if (!s_rs.on || !s_rs.passlog || s_rs.pass_logs >= 96u) return;
+    const eng_surface* s = &g.surfaces[target];
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < s_rs.pass_logs; k++)
+        if (seen[k].off == s->offset && seen[k].cw == sf->clip_w && seen[k].ch == sf->clip_h &&
+            seen[k].zoff == sf->zeta_offset && seen[k].prs == prs && seen[k].wc == writes_colour) return;
+    seen[s_rs.pass_logs].off = s->offset; seen[s_rs.pass_logs].cw = sf->clip_w; seen[s_rs.pass_logs].ch = sf->clip_h;
+    seen[s_rs.pass_logs].zoff = sf->zeta_offset; seen[s_rs.pass_logs].prs = prs; seen[s_rs.pass_logs].wc = writes_colour;
+    s_rs.pass_logs++;
+    const eng_zdepth* z = zslot != ENG_INVALID ? &g.zdepths[zslot] : NULL;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[res-scale] pass: colour %u:0x%X (%ux%u x%.3f), clip %ux%u grid %ux%u, %s, runs at x%.3f%s; zeta "
+                    "%u:0x%X entry %d x%.3f %ux%u; frame %u\n", s->location, s->offset, s->w, s->h, (double)s->rs,
+            sf->clip_w, sf->clip_h, sf->aa_sx, sf->aa_sy, writes_colour ? "colour written" : "no colour written",
+            (double)prs, own ? (uncovered ? " with a colour target of its own (its clip is past the surface)"
+                                          : " with a colour target of its own") : "",
+            sf->zeta_location, sf->zeta_offset, z ? (int)zslot : -1, z ? (double)z->rs : 0.0, z ? z->w : 0u,
+            z ? z->h : 0u, g.frames);
+}
+/* ---- [res] end (second block) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
+
+/* ---- [scene] [mv] [up] the 3D scene and the HUD, camera jitter, motion vectors, the temporal upscaler -----------
+ * DirectX 12's (rsx_live_draw.c, the blocks of the same names; the comments there say why each rule is what it is),
+ * for a backend that can run an upscaler (rsx_draw_backend.upscale_*, mv_ok and rs_max_dim: Vulkan with the DLSS
+ * plug-in). Line for line where it can be; what differs:
+ *   - the frame is judged at the flip (eng_present) rather than at the next frame's first draw; a frame watch mode
+ *     left out says nothing, as there;
+ *   - the motion-vector targets are colour targets of the engine's own (R16G16F), the per-object vectors come from a
+ *     second attachment of the scene draws' pipeline (RSX_BE_RT_MV) and the camera's vectors from a full-screen pass
+ *     the engine draws through the backend's ordinary calls, with HLSL of its own in the decompilers' dialect;
+ *   - the upscaler is the backend's (upscale_*): the engine hands it handles, it records in command order;
+ *   - left out: the scene dumps and captures (LD_SCENE_DUMP, LD_SCENE_CONSTS, LD_JITTER_TEST), LD_UP_COPY,
+ *     LD_UP_VIEW=1 (the halves; =2, input and output a second each, is in), LD_MV_VIEW, the GPU timestamps.
+ * Nothing here runs, and nothing changes, unless LD_AA asks for the upscaler and the backend has one, or one of the
+ * test switches (LD_SCENE_LOG, LD_JITTER, LD_MV) is set, or LD_RES_SCENE has a Resolution above 1 to follow. */
+extern unsigned long long cellPad_now_ms(void);
+
+enum { ENG_SCN_NONE = 0, ENG_SCN_SCENE, ENG_SCN_HELD, ENG_SCN_BYPASS };
+enum { ENG_SCN_R_NONE = 0, ENG_SCN_R_NO_DISPLAY, ENG_SCN_R_NOT_A_COPY, ENG_SCN_R_NO_SCENE, ENG_SCN_R_ZETA, ENG_SCN_R_HELD };
+typedef struct { u32 loc, off, w, h, zloc, zoff, cw, ch; u8 ax, ay; } eng_scn_sig;
+static struct {
+    int  on, log, rule, zeta_rule, inited;
+    unsigned gen; int have_gen;          /* the settings generation last read */
+    u32  frame, present_no, draws, scene_draws;
+    u32  depth_frame[ENG_MAX_SURFACES], depth_draws[ENG_MAX_SURFACES], depth_zslot[ENG_MAX_SURFACES];   /* zslot: entry + 1 */
+    u32  depth_zloc[ENG_MAX_SURFACES], depth_zoff[ENG_MAX_SURFACES], depth_cw[ENG_MAX_SURFACES], depth_ch[ENG_MAX_SURFACES];
+    u32  depth3d[ENG_MAX_SURFACES];
+    int  disp_seen, held_seen, probe_best, probe_stale, found, reason;
+    u32  b_draw, b_scene, b_display, b_zslot, b_depth_draws;
+    eng_scn_sig b_sig;
+    float b_rs, b_disp_rs;
+    u32  b_vp[4], b_disp_loc, b_disp_off;
+    int  kind, sig_valid;
+    eng_scn_sig sig;
+    float sig_rs;
+    u32  logs;
+} s_scn;
+static struct { int phases, rule, on; float x, y; u32 index, phase; int used; } s_jit;
+
+/* [mv] */
+#define ENG_MV_SENTINEL 30000.0f
+#define ENG_MV_MAX_OBJ  512u
+#define ENG_MV_REGIONS  3u
+#define ENG_MV_GATE     4.0
+#define ENG_MV_CB_BYTES 64u               /* the rows and the jitter after the viewport transform (eng_mv_apply_shaders) */
+typedef struct {
+    u32   c[16]; u32 vp[4]; float xf[8]; float m46[12]; float vel[3]; u64 progs[4]; u64 sig0;
+    u32   draws, verts; int prev; u8 taken, rows_ok; float ndc_w, ndc_h; float rows[12];
+} eng_mv_obj;
+typedef struct { u32 vp[4]; float xf[8]; double m[16]; int ok; float ndc_w, ndc_h; } eng_mv_region;
+static struct {
+    int   mode, user, log;
+    int   tracking, live;
+    u32   frame;
+    eng_mv_obj obj[2][ENG_MV_MAX_OBJ];
+    u32   n_obj[2], cur;
+    eng_mv_region reg[2][ENG_MV_REGIONS];
+    u32   n_reg[2];
+    int   last_obj, prev_valid, out_ok, reset;
+    u32   obj_t, out_t, w, h;             /* the two targets (colour target handles), their size */
+    u32   obj_cleared, done_frame;
+    u32   fill_pipe; int fill_failed;
+    float k[52];
+    u32   st_obj, st_match, st_exact, st_miss, st_full, st_resolved;
+    int   cam_ok, cam_prev_ok;            /* [fgv] for a generator: the main viewport's camera */
+    double cam_f[16], cam_r[16];
+    float cam_ndc_w, cam_ndc_h;
+} s_mv;
+
+/* [up] */
+#define ENG_UP_MAX_FAILS 8u
+#define ENG_UP_MAX_WAITS 240u
+enum { ENG_UP_S_OFF = 0, ENG_UP_S_UNAVAILABLE, ENG_UP_S_RUNNING, ENG_UP_S_HELD, ENG_UP_S_NO_SCENE, ENG_UP_S_WAITING,
+       ENG_UP_S_FAILED, ENG_UP_S_GAVE_UP };
+static struct {
+    int   want, out_scene; float scale_pct; int resolve_fix, lod_bias;
+    u32   vp_w, vp_h; float disp_rs;
+    int   made_quality; u32 lod_code; int preset;
+    int   loaded, avail, on, gave_up, view, log;
+    float sign_x, sign_y;
+    int   made, made_mode, made_preset;
+    u32   rw, rh, ow, oh, out, jit_phases;
+    int   ready, frame_ok, evaluated; u32 phases_now;
+    int   out_valid, reset_next;
+    unsigned long long last_ms;
+    u32   fails, waits, no_scene;
+    volatile int state;
+    char  reason[200], why[200], name[48];
+    u32   opt_ow, opt_oh, opt_rw, opt_rh; int opt_mode;
+    u32   st_eval, st_reset, st_fail;
+} s_up = { .sign_x = 1.0f, .sign_y = 1.0f };
