+/*
+ * ps3recomp - frame generation for the D3D12 live renderer (Windows)
+ *
+ * Watch mode (B-Spec, replays, F9) and the launcher's 30 fps Speed setting leave game frames undrawn
+ * to spare the CPU; the screen then holds each drawn frame for two refreshes. With LD_FRAMEGEN=1 the
+ * renderer fills those refreshes with frames made on the GPU from the drawn frame before and the one
+ * after: a block motion search at 1/16 and 1/4 size, then each pixel taken from both frames halfway
+ * along its motion.
+ *
+ * Presenting moves to a thread of its own. The RSX thread only records the frame into a history slot
+ * (and the motion, when frames went undrawn), submits, hands the frame over and goes on with the game;
+ * the presenter draws the made frames and the drawn one into the window and waits for each refresh.
+ * The first version presented on the RSX thread, twice per drawn frame, and the game itself dropped
+ * from 60 frames a second to about 24 with a busy graphics card.
+ */
+#ifndef RSX_FRAMEGEN_H
+#define RSX_FRAMEGEN_H
+#ifdef _WIN32
+#include <windows.h>
+#include <d3d12.h>
+#include <dxgi1_4.h>
+
+#ifdef __cplusplus
+extern "C" {
+#endif
+
+/* LD_FRAMEGEN turns it on (off by default): 1 = the block search on the finished picture, 2 = version 2
+ * (the renderer's own vectors), fsr = AMD FSR 3, dlss = NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation (the last two take
+ * what version 2 captures and replace only the pass that makes the frame; see "[fgv]" in rsx_framegen.c). */
+int  rsx_fg_enabled(void);
+
+/* Starts the presenter once: it presents into swap's back buffers (with their render target views),
+ * on queue, with sync_interval, holding swap_lock around each back buffer's use and Present. Anyone
+ * else who presents on swap must hold swap_lock too. A Present can wait for the window's thread, so
+ * the caller (that thread) must answer window messages whenever it waits for the presenter: rsx_fg_begin
+ * calls pump while it waits. Returns 1 when it runs. */
+int  rsx_fg_presenter_start(ID3D12CommandQueue* queue, IDXGISwapChain3* swap, ID3D12Resource* const* backbuf,
+                            const D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE* rtv, unsigned n_backbuf, UINT sync_interval,
+                            CRITICAL_SECTION* swap_lock, void (*pump)(void));
+
+/* RSX thread, at a present, before anything else is recorded for it: keeps this frame (src, a
+ * RENDER_TARGET surface of src_w x src_h, of which the top-left w x h is what the window shows) in a
+ * history slot and, when gen > 0 game frames went undrawn since the frame before, finds the motion
+ * between the two, all on list. Returns how many frames will be made (0..3) when the presenter will
+ * show this frame: then submit list and call rsx_fg_hand_off, and present nothing yourself. Returns -1
+ * when the caller presents this frame itself (frame generation off, failed or not fit for it). */
+int  rsx_fg_begin(ID3D12Device* dev, ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list, ID3D12Resource* src,
+                  DXGI_FORMAT src_fmt, unsigned src_w, unsigned src_h, unsigned w, unsigned h, int gen);
+
+/* RSX thread, between rsx_fg_begin and rsx_fg_hand_off: the frames of this hand-over (the made ones, then
+ * the drawn one) are presented us microseconds apart, the first at once. 0 (what rsx_fg_begin leaves) =
+ * each as soon as the one before is presented, the screen's refresh spacing them: right when the screen
+ * runs at the rate the frames fill, wrong when it is faster (a 60 fps game doubled on a 144 or 164 Hz
+ * screen: the made frame and the drawn one would follow each other one refresh apart instead of half a
+ * game frame apart). */
+void rsx_fg_set_pace(unsigned us);
+
+/* 1 once the presenter was started: it holds the swap chain's back buffers from then on, so their size
+ * must not change while it runs (frame generation can be switched off and on again; see rsx_fg_size_reset). */
+int  rsx_fg_presenter_running(void);
+
+/* [win] RSX thread, with every list submitted so far finished on the GPU and the swap chain lock NOT held:
+ * the swap chain is about to change size. Stops the presenter (once it has shown or dropped what it was
+ * handed) and lets go of everything made at the old size; the next rsx_fg_begin makes it again at the
+ * new size, after the caller has started the presenter again with the new back buffers. Returns 0 when
+ * the presenter could not be stopped (the swap chain must then keep its size). */
+int  rsx_fg_size_reset(void);
+
+/* Frames the presenter has shown so far: made ones (by a generator; [fga] the drawn frame shown again in a
+ * made frame's place is NOT counted), and drawn ones. Any thread. */
+void rsx_fg_counts(long long* made, long long* shown);
+
+/* RSX thread, after list was submitted: the presenter takes the frame rsx_fg_begin prepared. */
+void rsx_fg_hand_off(void);
+
+/* The HRESULT of a failed Present on the presenter, 0 while all is well. */
+long rsx_fg_present_error(void);
+
+/* Presentation (see "[fg0]" in rsx_framegen.c). LD_FG_PRESENT=0 keeps the earlier behaviour.
+ * rsx_fg_paced: 1 unless that is set. rsx_fg_set_tearing: the swap chain was made with
+ * DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_FLAG_ALLOW_TEARING, so presents with interval 0 may carry the tearing flag.
+ * rsx_fg_plan (RSX thread, at a present, before rsx_fg_begin): the number of frames to make for this
+ * drawn frame (0..3) and, in *pace_us, the time between presents; from the game's measured frame
+ * interval (dt_ms: since the hand-over before, <= 0 for none), the game frames left undrawn, the
+ * screen's rate and the vertical sync interval. It prints one "[framegen]" line when what it does
+ * changes. rsx_fg_state (any thread): that line, or why nothing is made, for the menu; returns 1
+ * while frames are being made. */
+/* Version 2 (LD_FRAMEGEN=2; see "[fg1]" in rsx_framegen.c): frames made from the renderer's own motion
+ * vectors, depth and the picture without HUD. rsx_fg_version: 0 off, 1 the block search, 2 version 2
+ * (the renderer then has to detect the 3D scene and keep per-object vectors, and call
+ * rsx_fg_scene_frame). rsx_fg_scene_frame (RSX thread, right after the game's copy of the scene into
+ * the display buffer was recorded, before any HUD draw): keeps the frame's picture without HUD, its
+ * vectors and its depth for the frame the next rsx_fg_begin takes. Returns 1 when taken. */
+typedef struct rsx_fg_scene {
+    ID3D12Resource* hudless;     /* RENDER_TARGET, RGBA8: its top-left w x h is the frame, as rsx_fg_begin will get it */
+    ID3D12Resource* motion;      /* R16G16_FLOAT, PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE during the call: scene pixels, this frame -> the one before */
+    ID3D12Resource* depth;       /* R32_FLOAT, PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE during the call: 0 near, 1 far */
+    unsigned w, h;               /* the frame's size: what rsx_fg_begin gets as w, h */
+    float rect[4];               /* the 3D picture inside the frame: left, top, right, bottom, frame pixels */
+    float scene_w, scene_h;      /* the part of motion and depth (from their top-left) that the picture shows, their pixels */
+    int reset;                   /* nothing of the frame before belongs to this one (a cut, a new scene) */
+    /* [fgv] For a vendor's generator (LD_FRAMEGEN=fsr / dlss); version 2 itself reads none of it.
+     * The main viewport's camera of this frame, in the clip space of the 3D picture (x, y in -1..1
+     * across it, y up, depth 0..1, w = the view distance); matrices row-major for row vectors
+     * (clip = view * view_to_clip). cam_ok 0: not known. cam_prev_ok 0: the frame before's is not
+     * (clip_to_prev_clip and its inverse are then the identity). */
+    int   cam_ok, cam_prev_ok;
+    float cam_near, cam_far, cam_fov_y, cam_aspect;
+    float cam_pos[3], cam_right[3], cam_up[3], cam_fwd[3];
+    float view_to_clip[16], clip_to_view[16], clip_to_prev_clip[16], prev_clip_to_clip[16];
+    /* Two calls of the renderer's: a vendor's library records on the real list, not on the recording
+     * thread's stand-in. real_list: everything recorded so far has been replayed on the real list;
+     * that list (what is recorded on `list` afterwards follows it). finish: everything recorded so far
+     * has been submitted and has run on the GPU, so nothing names an object that is about to go; the
+     * list starts afresh (set heaps, root signature and pipeline again); 0 when the device is gone. */
+    ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* (*real_list)(void);
+    int  (*finish)(void);
+    /* [fga] The part of the frame the game's picture fills (left, top, right, bottom, frame pixels): the
+     * whole frame less the bars the window's shape leaves. A vendor's generator is made for this part,
+     * so a 3D picture that moves or changes size inside it (the pre-race box, the race) never makes it
+     * again. All 0: the whole frame. */
+    float view[4];
+} rsx_fg_scene;
+int  rsx_fg_version(void);
+int  rsx_fg_scene_frame(ID3D12Device* dev, ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list, const rsx_fg_scene* scene);
+
+/* [fga] LD_FG_ALWAYS (the settings registry, so GT5_SET_CYCLE can switch it in a run):
+ *   1 (default) frames are made on every screen while frame generation is on: from a 3D picture wherever
+ *     it is in the frame (a box, a race, a replay), and where there is none (2D menus, the pause screen
+ *     over a frozen race, movies) from the pictures alone: a vendor's generator is given the finished
+ *     picture with zero vectors and far depth, the built-in one uses its picture-based search. Only the
+ *     frame after a cut or a vendor's reset is the drawn frame shown again (not counted as made);
+ *   2 as 1, but no frame is made where there is no 3D picture: the drawn frame is shown again there;
+ *   3 as 1, but where there is no 3D picture the built-in picture-based search makes the frames even
+ *     when a vendor's generator is chosen (if theirs smear a 2D screen);
+ *   0 as before (only between two centred 3D scene frames). RSX thread. */
+int  rsx_fg_always(void);
+/* [fga] RSX thread, at every present just before rsx_fg_begin: the part of the frame the game's picture
+ * fills (left, top, right, bottom; all 0: the whole frame) and the renderer's real_list / finish (as in
+ * rsx_fg_scene), for a frame that turns out to have no 3D picture. */
+void rsx_fg_frame_hooks(const float view[4], ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* (*real_list)(void), int (*finish)(void));
+
+/* [fgv] A vendor's generator keeps a context of its own (150 to 400 MB of video memory).
+ * rsx_fg_vendor_stale (RSX thread): 1 when there is one that the setting no longer asks for (another
+ * method was picked, frame generation was switched off, or it failed and version 2 took over).
+ * rsx_fg_vendor_drop (RSX thread, with every list that used it finished on the GPU and the recording
+ * thread idle): releases it. The renderer calls the pair between two frames. */
+int  rsx_fg_vendor_stale(void);
+void rsx_fg_vendor_drop(void);
+
+/* [fgv2] LD_FG_LOG=1 (tests): the renderer's GPU flush at a frame-generation present took flush_ms; the
+ * upscaler's last evaluation took up_gpu_ms on the GPU (-1: no upscaler). RSX thread, after the flush.
+ * Does nothing without LD_FG_LOG. */
+void rsx_fg_log_flush(double flush_ms, double up_gpu_ms);
+
+/* [fgv3] LD_FG_LOG=1 (tests): timed waits and calls, by name, on any thread (see "[fgv3]" in
+ * rsx_framegen.c). rsx_fg_wait_t0 at the start, rsx_fg_wait_end(what, ...) at the end; what is a string
+ * that lives for the run (a literal). rsx_fg_wait_note_ms for a time measured elsewhere.
+ * rsx_fg_log_frame: the present thread, once at every present (frame intervals, the 5-s summary, and
+ * with LD_FG_LOG=2 the stall watcher). All do nothing without LD_FG_LOG. */
+typedef struct { LONGLONG t; ULONG64 c; } rsx_fg_tstamp;
+int  rsx_fg_log_on(void);
+void rsx_fg_wait_t0(rsx_fg_tstamp* s);
+void rsx_fg_wait_end(const char* what, const rsx_fg_tstamp* s);
+void rsx_fg_wait_note_ms(const char* what, double wall_ms, double cpu_ms);
+void rsx_fg_log_frame(void);
+#define RSX_FG_WAIT(var) rsx_fg_tstamp var; rsx_fg_wait_t0(&var)
+/* The same with plain types (no nesting on one thread): 0 when LD_FG_LOG is off. */
+unsigned long long rsx_fg_wait_start(void);
+void rsx_fg_wait_stop(const char* what, unsigned long long start);
+
+int  rsx_fg_paced(void);
+void rsx_fg_set_tearing(int allowed);
+int  rsx_fg_plan(double dt_ms, int undrawn, int hz, unsigned sync, unsigned* pace_us);
+int  rsx_fg_state(char* text, size_t cap);
+
+#ifdef __cplusplus
+}
+#endif
+#endif /* _WIN32 */
+#endif /* RSX_FRAMEGEN_H */

+/* [shreg] RSX_FP_OPT_REGISTER_VARS. The body is made with the arrays' spelling (r[N] / h[N]) and the
+ * register declaration is written at the end, when it is known which registers the program names and
+ * whether it has flow control:
+ *  - no IFE / LOOP / REP block: plain variables, one per register named (rN / hN), zeroed as the loop zeroed
+ *    them; every r[N] / h[N] in the body becomes rN / hN, in place (the text only gets shorter).
+ *  - with one: fxc keeps register arrays written inside flow control in memory (indexable temps) and its
+ *    code for them is not the code it makes for plain variables (other mad contraction, a NaN guard folded
+ *    away), so the arrays stay, but are zeroed one register at a time, only those named, in the loop's
+ *    order (r0, h0, r1, h1, ...). Zeroing all 96 elements of memory arrays was what cost the time.
+ * Over the 34,338 shader texts on the PC it was checked on, both give the old text's bytecode byte for byte.
+ * Only the decompiler's own register references have the r[N] / h[N] shape: the body's other arrays
+ * (rsx_tex[], rsx_samp[], fp_constants[]) have longer names, which the check on the character before
+ * keeps out. */
+static int fp_ident_char(char c)
+{
+    return (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '_';
+}
+/* Length of the register reference "r[N]" / "h[N]" at s + i (0 if there is none), its file and number. */
+static u32 fp_register_ref(const char* s, u32 len, u32 i, int* half, u32* n)
+{
+    if (!((s[i] == 'r' || s[i] == 'h') && i + 1 < len && s[i + 1] == '[' && (i == 0 || !fp_ident_char(s[i - 1]))))
+        return 0;
+    u32 j = i + 2, v = 0;
+    while (j < len && j < i + 6 && s[j] >= '0' && s[j] <= '9') v = v * 10u + (u32)(s[j++] - '0');
+    if (j == i + 2 || j >= len || s[j] != ']') return 0;
+    *half = s[i] == 'h';
+    *n = v;
+    return j + 1 - i;
+}
+/* Which registers the body names; 0 when one is 48 or more (the arrays fail to compile on it: kept). */
+static int fp_registers_used(const char* s, u32 len, u64 used[2])
+{
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
+        int half; u32 n;
+        if (!fp_register_ref(s, len, i, &half, &n)) continue;
+        if (n >= 48u) return 0;
+        used[half] |= 1ull << n;
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+static void fp_registers_rename(char* s, u32* len)
+{
+    u32 w = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < *len;) {
+        int half; u32 n;
+        const u32 k = fp_register_ref(s, *len, i, &half, &n);
+        if (k) {
+            s[w++] = s[i];
+            for (u32 c = i + 2; c < i + k - 1; c++) s[w++] = s[c];
+            i += k;
+        } else
+            s[w++] = s[i++];
+    }
+    s[w] = '\0';
+    *len = w;
+}
+/* Plain variables: all r ascending, then all h, eight to a line. */
+static void fp_register_variables(Out* d, const u64 used[2])
+{
+    u32 on_line = 0;
+    for (int f = 0; f < 2; f++)
+        for (u32 n = 0; n < 48u; n++) {
+            if (!(used[f] & (1ull << n))) continue;
+            char item[32];
+            snprintf(item, sizeof item, "%s%c%u = (float4)0", on_line ? ", " : "    float4 ", f ? 'h' : 'r', n);
+            out_puts(d, item);
+            if (++on_line == 8u) { out_puts(d, ";\n"); on_line = 0; }
+        }
+    if (on_line) out_puts(d, ";\n");
+}
+/* The arrays, zeroed register by register in the old loop's order, eight to a line. */
+static void fp_register_arrays(Out* d, const u64 used[2])
+{
+    u32 on_line = 0;
+    out_puts(d, "    float4 r[48]; float4 h[48];\n");
+    for (u32 n = 0; n < 48u; n++)
+        for (int f = 0; f < 2; f++) {
+            if (!(used[f] & (1ull << n))) continue;
+            char item[32];
+            snprintf(item, sizeof item, "%s%c[%u] = (float4)0;", on_line ? " " : "    ", f ? 'h' : 'r', n);
+            out_puts(d, item);
+            if (++on_line == 8u) { out_puts(d, "\n"); on_line = 0; }
+        }
+    if (on_line) out_puts(d, "\n");
+}

+/* [hang] Every registered guest thread's registers, sampled `samples` times `gap_ms` apart, for the hang report
+ * (boot_main.cpp, hang_watchdog): lr, ctr, cr and r3-r12, and the big-endian word each of those points at when
+ * it is a committed main-memory or stack address. A thread polling a flag in a loop shows the same address with
+ * the same word in every sample; one waiting for another thread shows what it waits on. Sample 0 is printed for
+ * every thread, later samples only for threads whose values changed. Best effort and unlocked, as the lr report:
+ * another thread's context is read while it runs, and lifted code may hold a register in a host register for a
+ * while, so a value can be a little old. Windows only (the peek asks VirtualQuery first, so nothing is
+ * committed or faulted by looking). */
+#ifdef _WIN32
+static int ppu_hang_peek(uint32_t a, uint32_t* out)
+{
+    if (a < 0x10000u || (a & 3u)) return 0;
+    if (!(a < 0x40000000u || (a >= 0xD0000000u && a < 0xE0000000u))) return 0;
+    const uint8_t* p = vm_base + a;
+    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
+    if (!VirtualQuery(p, &mbi, sizeof mbi) || mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT ||
+        (mbi.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD)) ||
+        !(mbi.Protect & (PAGE_READONLY | PAGE_READWRITE | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE)))
+        return 0;
+    *out = ((uint32_t)p[0] << 24) | ((uint32_t)p[1] << 16) | ((uint32_t)p[2] << 8) | (uint32_t)p[3];
+    return 1;
+}
+#endif
+extern "C" void ppu_report_guest_regs(int samples, int gap_ms)
+{
+#ifdef _WIN32
+    enum { NREG = 10 };   /* r3..r12 */
+    struct snap { uint32_t tid, lr, ctr, cr, r[NREG], w[NREG]; uint8_t has[NREG]; };
+    static snap first[PPU_RESV_MAX];
+    long n = g_resv_ctx_n; if (n > PPU_RESV_MAX) n = PPU_RESV_MAX;
+    if (samples < 1) samples = 1;
+    for (int s = 0; s < samples; s++) {
+        if (s) Sleep((DWORD)gap_ms);
+        for (long i = 0; i < n; i++) {
+            ppu_context* c = g_resv_ctxs[i];
+            if (!c) continue;
+            snap now;
+            memset(&now, 0, sizeof now);
+            now.tid = (uint32_t)c->thread_id; now.lr = (uint32_t)c->lr; now.ctr = (uint32_t)c->ctr; now.cr = c->cr;
+            for (int r = 0; r < NREG; r++) {
+                now.r[r] = (uint32_t)c->gpr[3 + r];
+                uint32_t w = 0;
+                if (ppu_hang_peek(now.r[r], &w)) { now.has[r] = 1; now.w[r] = w; }
+            }
+            if (s && memcmp(&now, &first[i], sizeof now) == 0) continue;   /* unchanged since sample 0 */
+            if (!s) first[i] = now;
+            char line[1024];
+            int len = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "[HANG]   sample %d guest-tid %-3u lr=0x%08X ctr=0x%08X cr=0x%08X",
+                               s, now.tid, now.lr, now.ctr, now.cr);
+            for (int r = 0; r < NREG && len > 0 && len < (int)sizeof line - 32; r++) {
+                len += snprintf(line + len, sizeof line - (size_t)len, " r%d=%08X", 3 + r, now.r[r]);
+                if (now.has[r]) len += snprintf(line + len, sizeof line - (size_t)len, "[%08X]", now.w[r]);
+            }
+            fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", line);
+        }
+    }
+    fflush(stderr);
+#else
+    (void)samples; (void)gap_ms;
+#endif
+}

+{

+    const uint32_t g = ppu_prof_resolve_host_slow(ra);

+/* ppu_lookup for indirect calls. The table and its addresses are 3 MB, so the
+ * probe of an indirect call missed the cache: about a fifth of

+    return fn;

+static inline u32 dsp_be32(const u8* p)
+{
+    return ((u32)p[0] << 24) | ((u32)p[1] << 16) | ((u32)p[2] << 8) | (u32)p[3];
+}

+void rsx_dispatch_method_run(rsx_dispatch* rsx, u32 method, const u8* be, u32 count,
+                             int incrementing)
+{
+    /* The transform-constant window is where most of a frame's words go
+     * (libgcm's SetVertexProgramConstants: CONST_ID, then up to 32 words into
+     * 0x1F00..0x1F7C as one incrementing run). The part of a run inside it is
+     * stored at once -- the register file, its write counts and the constants,
+     * exactly what rsx_dispatch_method does for each of those words. The
+     * traces that watch these words take the word-by-word path. */
+    static int traced = -1;
+    if (traced < 0) traced = (getenv("RSX_GROUP_TRACE") || getenv("RSX_CONST_LOG")) ? 1 : 0;
+    u32 i = 0;
+    while (i < count) {
+        const u32 m = (incrementing ? method + 4u * i : method) & 0xFFFFCu;
+        if (incrementing && !traced && m >= M_VP_UPLOAD_CONST && m < M_VP_UPLOAD_CONST + 32u * 4u) {
+            u32 n = (M_VP_UPLOAD_CONST + 32u * 4u - m) >> 2;
+            if (n > count - i) n = count - i;
+            const u32 slot0 = rsx->regs[M_VP_UPLOAD_CONST_ID >> 2];
+            const u32 word0 = (m - M_VP_UPLOAD_CONST) >> 2;
+            const u32 idx0 = m >> 2;
+            for (u32 k = 0; k < n; k++) {
+                const u32 v = dsp_be32(be + 4u * (i + k));
+                const u32 word = word0 + k;
+                const u32 slot = slot0 + (word >> 2);
+                rsx->seen[idx0 + k]++;
+                rsx->regs[idx0 + k] = v;
+                if (slot < RSX_DSP_NUM_CONSTANTS)
+                    rsx->constants[slot][word & 3] = v;
+            }
+            rsx->const_gen++;
+            i += n;
+            continue;
+        }
+        rsx_dispatch_method(rsx, m, dsp_be32(be + 4u * i));
+        i++;
     }
 }

+// ---- the translated text's helpers, written the same way (rsx_fp_decompiler.c) ----------------------
+float4 _rsx_gamma_input(float4 v, uint mask) {
+    float4 lo = v / 12.92;
+    float4 hi = pow(max((v + 0.055) / 1.055, (float4)0), (float4)2.4);
+    float4 decoded = float4(v.r > 0.04045 ? hi.r : lo.r,
+                            v.g > 0.04045 ? hi.g : lo.g,
+                            v.b > 0.04045 ? hi.b : lo.b,
+                            v.a > 0.04045 ? hi.a : lo.a);
+    return float4((mask & 1u) ? decoded.r : v.r,
+                  (mask & 2u) ? decoded.g : v.g,
+                  (mask & 4u) ? decoded.b : v.b,
+                  (mask & 8u) ? decoded.a : v.a);
+}
+float4 _rsx_expand_input(float4 v, uint mask, bool bx2) {
+    float4 e = bx2 ? v * 2.0 - 1.0
+             : (mask & 16u) ? (floor(v * 65535.0 + 0.5) - 32768.0) / 32767.0
+                            : (floor(v * 255.0 + 0.5) - 128.0) / 127.0;
+    return float4((mask & 1u) ? e.r : v.r,
+                  (mask & 2u) ? e.g : v.g,
+                  (mask & 4u) ? e.b : v.b,
+                  (mask & 8u) ? e.a : v.a);
+}
+uint   _rsx_pk4ub(float4 v) { uint4 b = (uint4)round(saturate(v) * 255.0); return b.x | (b.y << 8) | (b.z << 16) | (b.w << 24); }
+float4 _rsx_up4ub(float v) { uint u = asuint(v); return float4(u & 255u, (u >> 8) & 255u, (u >> 16) & 255u, (u >> 24) & 255u) / 255.0; }
+uint   _rsx_pk4b(float4 v) { uint4 b = (uint4)((int4)round(clamp(v, -1.0, 1.0) * 127.0)) & 255u; return b.x | (b.y << 8) | (b.z << 16) | (b.w << 24); }
+float4 _rsx_up4b(float v) { uint u = asuint(v); int4 b = int4(u & 255u, (u >> 8) & 255u, (u >> 16) & 255u, (u >> 24) & 255u); b = (b << 24) >> 24; return clamp((float4)b / 127.0, -1.0, 1.0); }
+uint   _rsx_pk2us(float4 v) { uint2 b = (uint2)round(saturate(v.xy) * 65535.0); return b.x | (b.y << 16); }
+float4 _rsx_up2us(float v) { uint u = asuint(v); return float4(u & 65535u, u >> 16, u & 65535u, u >> 16) / 65535.0; }
+uint   _rsx_pk2h(float4 v) { return f32tof16(v.x) | (f32tof16(v.y) << 16); }
+float4 _rsx_up2h(float v) { uint u = asuint(v); return float4(f16tof32(u & 65535u), f16tof32(u >> 16), f16tof32(u & 65535u), f16tof32(u >> 16)); }
+float4 _rsx_lin2srgb(float4 cl) { cl = saturate(cl); float4 low = cl * 12.92; float4 high = 1.055 * pow(cl, 1.0 / 2.4) - 0.055; return saturate((cl < 0.0031308) ? low : high); }
+float4 _rsx_srgb2lin(float4 cs) { float4 a = cs / 12.92; float4 b = pow(max(cs + 0.055, 0.0) / 1.055, 2.4); return (cs > 0.04045) ? b : a; }
+float4 _rsx_srgb_output(float4 v) {
+    float3 lo = v.rgb * 12.92;
+    float3 hi = 1.055 * pow(max(v.rgb, (float3)0), (float3)(1.0 / 2.4)) - 0.055;
+    float3 rgb = float3(v.r < 0.0031308 ? lo.r : hi.r,
+                         v.g < 0.0031308 ? lo.g : hi.g,
+                         v.b < 0.0031308 ? lo.b : hi.b);
+    return float4(saturate(rgb), v.a);
+}
+
+// ---- depth comparison (fp_shadow_helper), driven by the unit's descriptor ---------------------------
+float si_cmp(uint func, float reference, float depth)
+{
+    [forcecase] switch (func) {
+    case 0u: return 0.0;
+    case 1u: return (float)(depth < reference);
+    case 2u: return (float)(depth == reference);
+    case 3u: return (float)(depth <= reference);
+    case 4u: return (float)(depth > reference);
+    case 5u: return (float)(depth != reference);
+    case 6u: return (float)(depth >= reference);
+    default: return 1.0;
+    }
+}
+float4 si_cmp4(uint func, float reference, float4 depth)
+{
+    return float4(si_cmp(func, reference, depth.x), si_cmp(func, reference, depth.y),
+                  si_cmp(func, reference, depth.z), si_cmp(func, reference, depth.w));
+}
+float4 si_shadow(uint u, uint d, float3 coordinate)
+{
+    const uint func = (d >> 10) & 7u, scale = (d >> 16) & 7u;
+    const bool lin = ((d >> 13) & 1u) != 0u, unn = ((d >> 14) & 1u) != 0u, soft = ((d >> 15) & 1u) != 0u;
+    float reference = saturate(coordinate.z);
+    if (soft) {
+        float2 size = si_dims(u);
+        float2 inv = 1.0 / size;
+        float2 position = (!unn ? coordinate.xy : scale == 4u ? (coordinate.xy * 4.0 * inv) :
+                           scale == 2u ? (coordinate.xy * 2.0 * inv) : (coordinate.xy * inv)) * size - 0.5;
+        float2 base = floor(position); float2 f = position - base;
+        float4 g0 = si_cmp4(func, reference, si_gather(u, (base + float2(0.0, 0.0)) * inv));
+        float4 g1 = si_cmp4(func, reference, si_gather(u, (base + float2(2.0, 0.0)) * inv));
+        float4 g2 = si_cmp4(func, reference, si_gather(u, (base + float2(0.0, 2.0)) * inv));
+        float4 g3 = si_cmp4(func, reference, si_gather(u, (base + float2(2.0, 2.0)) * inv));
+        float4 wx = float4(1.0 - f.x, 1.0, 1.0, f.x);
+        float4 wy = float4(1.0 - f.y, 1.0, 1.0, f.y);
+        float s = dot(g0, float4(wx.x * wy.y, wx.y * wy.y, wx.y * wy.x, wx.x * wy.x))
+                + dot(g1, float4(wx.z * wy.y, wx.w * wy.y, wx.w * wy.x, wx.z * wy.x))
+                + dot(g2, float4(wx.x * wy.w, wx.y * wy.w, wx.y * wy.z, wx.x * wy.z))
+                + dot(g3, float4(wx.z * wy.w, wx.w * wy.w, wx.w * wy.z, wx.z * wy.z));
+        return (float4)(s * (1.0 / 9.0));
+    }
+    float2 size = (float2)1;
+    if (lin || unn) size = si_dims(u);
+    float2 uv = !unn ? coordinate.xy : scale == 4u ? coordinate.xy * 4.0 / size :
+                scale == 2u ? coordinate.xy * 2.0 / size : coordinate.xy / size;
+    if (!lin) {
+        float depth = si_depth(u, uv);
+        return (float4)si_cmp(func, reference, depth);
+    }
+    float2 position = uv * size - 0.5;
+    float2 base = floor(position); float2 fraction = position - base;
+    float c0 = si_cmp(func, reference, si_depth(u, (base + float2(0.5, 0.5)) / size));
+    float c1 = si_cmp(func, reference, si_depth(u, (base + float2(1.5, 0.5)) / size));
+    float c2 = si_cmp(func, reference, si_depth(u, (base + float2(0.5, 1.5)) / size));
+    float c3 = si_cmp(func, reference, si_depth(u, (base + float2(1.5, 1.5)) / size));
+    return (float4)lerp(lerp(c0, c1, fraction.x), lerp(c2, c3, fraction.x), fraction.y);
+}
+
+// ---- the interpreter --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// The register file, the inputs and the condition codes are main's locals: a static array would be zeroed in
+// full for every pixel (96 stores to local memory: that alone was 11 ms of a 1080p pass).
+#define SI_RN 96                        // r0..r47 and h0..h47: register n of file f at 2n + f
+#define SI_RI(i) (i)
+
+float si_c(float4 v, uint i) { return i == 0u ? v.x : i == 1u ? v.y : i == 2u ? v.z : v.w; }
+float4 si_swz(float4 v, uint s)         // 2 bits a lane, x first
+{
+    return float4(si_c(v, s & 3u), si_c(v, (s >> 2) & 3u), si_c(v, (s >> 4) & 3u), si_c(v, (s >> 6) & 3u));
+}
+// exec_if: lt = bit 0, eq = bit 1, gr = bit 2 (7 always, 0 never: the callers test those first)
+float4 si_test(float4 c, uint e)
+{
+    [forcecase] switch (e) {
+    case 6u: return (float4)(c >= (float4)0.0);
+    case 3u: return (float4)(c <= (float4)0.0);
+    case 5u: return (float4)(c != (float4)0.0);
+    case 4u: return (float4)(c >  (float4)0.0);
+    case 1u: return (float4)(c <  (float4)0.0);
+    default: return (float4)(c == (float4)0.0);
+    }
+}
+// An operand: its value as read (register, input or inline constant), then swizzle, abs, negate.
+float4 si_mod(float4 v, uint w, bool absv)
+{
+    v = si_swz(v, (w >> 9) & 255u);
+    if (absv) v = abs(v);
+    if ((w >> 17) & 1u) v = -(v);
+    return v;
+}
+// The input OPDEST.INPUT_SRC names (wpos already has the window convention applied).
+float4 si_in(PSInput input, float4 wpos, uint s)
+{
+    [forcecase] switch (s) {
+    case 0u: return wpos;
+    case 1u: return saturate(input.col0);
+    case 2u: return saturate(input.col1);
+    case 3u: return input.fog;
+    case 4u: return input.tc0;
+    case 5u: return input.tc1;
+    case 6u: return input.tc2;
+    case 7u: return input.tc3;
+    case 8u: return input.tc4;
+    case 9u: return input.tc5;
+    case 10u: return input.tc6;
+    case 11u: return input.tc7;
+    case 12u: return input.tc8;
+    case 13u: return input.tc9;
+    case 14u: return (input._rsx_front ? float4(1,1,1,1) : float4(-1,-1,-1,-1));
+    default: return (float4)0;
+    }
+}
+#define SI_RAW(w) ((((w) & 3u) == 0u) ? R[SI_RI(min(((w) >> 2) & 63u, 47u) * 2u + (((w) >> 8) & 1u))] : (((w) & 3u) == 1u) ? iv : (has_k ? kv : (float4)0))
+
+#if SI_MV
+struct MVOut { float4 c : SV_TARGET0; float4 mv : SV_TARGET1; };
+float4 _si_main(PSInput input)
+#else
+float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_TARGET
+#endif
+{
+    const uint4 hd = k[0];
+    const uint flags = hd.y, n_ops = hd.z;
+    const float4 fp_alpha = asfloat(k[1]);
+    const uint kbase = 19u, obase = 19u + hd.x;
+    if (flags & 4u)         // the WPOS grid (rsx_fp_apply_wpos_grid)
+        input.position.xy = floor(input.position.xy / float2(k[2].x, k[2].y)) + 0.5;
+    else if (flags & 8u)    // the render-scale line (ld_rs_apply_wpos)
+        input.position.xy = input.position.xy * fp_alpha.w / float2(k[2].x, k[2].y);
+    const float4 p = input.position;
+    const float4 wpos = float4(p.x + fp_alpha.z, (fp_alpha.y != 0.0 ? fp_alpha.y - p.y : p.y) + fp_alpha.z, p.z, p.w);
+    const float inv_w = (1.0 / input.position.w);
+    float4 R[SI_RN];
+    [loop] for (uint z = 0u; z < hd.w; z++) R[SI_RI(z)] = (float4)0;   // the registers the program names
+    float4 CC0 = (float4)0, CC1 = (float4)0;
+
+    uint4 LS[4];                        // open loops: counter, end, increment, the op after its end
+    uint lsp = 0u;
+    uint pc = 0u;
+    [loop] for (uint guard = 0u; guard < 1048576u && pc < n_ops; guard++) {
+        const uint4 W = k[obase + pc * 2u];
+        const uint4 X = k[obase + pc * 2u + 1u];
+        pc++;
+        const uint e = (W.y >> 18) & 7u;                     // exec_if lt / eq / gr
+        if (X.x != 0u) {                                     // flow: the first lane of the condition swizzle
+            bool cond = true;
+            if (X.x == 1u || X.x == 4u || X.x == 6u) {
+                if (e == 0u) cond = false;
+                else if (e != 7u) {
+                    const float4 cc = ((W.y >> 31) & 1u) ? CC1 : CC0;
+                    cond = si_test((float4)si_c(cc, (W.y >> 21) & 3u), e).x != 0.0;
+                }
+            }
+            [forcecase] switch (X.x) {
+            case 1u: if (!cond) pc = X.y; break;                      // IF: else or end
+            case 2u: pc = X.y; break;                                 // ELSE reached from the then part
+            case 4u: {                                                // LOOP
+                const uint init = X.z & 255u, endn = (X.z >> 8) & 255u, inc = (X.z >> 16) & 255u;
+                if (!cond || init >= endn || lsp >= 4u) pc = X.y;
+                else { LS[lsp] = uint4(init, endn, inc, X.y); lsp++; }
+                break; }
+            case 5u: {                                                // end of a loop's body
+                if (lsp > 0u) {
+                    const uint4 l = LS[lsp - 1u];
+                    const uint c = l.x + l.z;
+                    if (c < l.y) { LS[lsp - 1u].x = c; pc = X.y; }
+                    else lsp--;
+                }
+                break; }
+            case 6u: if (cond && lsp > 0u) { pc = LS[lsp - 1u].w; lsp--; } break;   // BRK
+            default: break;                                           // ENDIF
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+        const uint w0 = W.x, w1 = W.y, w2 = W.z, w3 = W.w;
+        const uint op = (w0 >> 24) & 63u;
+        const uint input_src = (w0 >> 13) & 15u, unit = (w0 >> 17) & 15u;
+        const bool persp = (w3 >> 31) != 0u;
+        const bool has_k = (X.w & 1u) != 0u;
+        const float4 kv = has_k ? asfloat(k[kbase + X.y]) : (float4)0;
+        float4 iv = si_in(input, wpos, input_src);
+        if (persp && input_src >= 4u && input_src <= 13u) iv = (iv * inv_w);
+        const uint n_src = X.z;                              // sources the opcode reads (the encoder's count)
+        const float4 a = si_mod(SI_RAW(w1), w1, ((w1 >> 29) & 1u) != 0u);
+        float4 b = (float4)0, c = (float4)0;
+        if (n_src >= 2u) b = si_mod(SI_RAW(w2), w2, ((w2 >> 18) & 1u) != 0u);
+        if (n_src >= 3u) c = si_mod(SI_RAW(w3), w3, false);
+        const float4 ccr = ((w1 >> 31) & 1u) ? CC1 : CC0;
+        const uint cswz = (w1 >> 21) & 255u;
+        float4 v = (float4)0;
+        bool handled = true;
+        [forcecase] switch (op) {
+        case 0x01u: v = a; break;
+        case 0x02u: v = (a) * (b); break;
+        case 0x03u: v = (a) + (b); break;
+        case 0x04u: v = (a) * (b) + (c); break;
+        case 0x05u: v = (float4)dot((a).xyz, (b).xyz); break;
+        case 0x06u: v = (float4)dot((a), (b)); break;
+        case 0x08u: v = min((a), (b)); break;
+        case 0x09u: v = max((a), (b)); break;
+        case 0x0Au: v = (float4)((a) <  (b)); break;
+        case 0x0Bu: v = (float4)((a) >= (b)); break;
+        case 0x0Cu: v = (float4)((a) <= (b)); break;
+        case 0x0Du: v = (float4)((a) >  (b)); break;
+        case 0x0Eu: v = (float4)((a) != (b)); break;
+        case 0x0Fu: v = (float4)((a) == (b)); break;
+        case 0x10u: v = frac(a); break;
+        case 0x11u: v = floor(a); break;
+        case 0x12u:                                          // KIL
+            if (e == 7u) discard;
+            else if (e != 0u && any(si_test(si_swz(ccr, cswz), e) != (float4)0.0)) discard;
+            handled = false; break;
+        case 0x13u: v = (float4)asfloat(_rsx_pk4b(a)); break;
+        case 0x14u: v = _rsx_up4b((a).x); break;
+        case 0x1Au: v = (float4)(1.0 / (abs((a).x) > 1e-10 ? (a).x : 1e-10)); break;
+        case 0x1Bu: v = (float4)rsqrt(max(abs((a).x), 1e-10)); break;
+        case 0x1Cu: v = (float4)exp2((a).x); break;
+        case 0x1Du: v = (float4)log2(max(abs((a).x), 1e-10)); break;
+        case 0x1Fu: v = lerp((c), (b), (a)); break;
+        case 0x22u: v = (float4)cos((a).x); break;
+        case 0x23u: v = (float4)sin((a).x); break;
+        case 0x24u: v = (float4)asfloat(_rsx_pk2h(a)); break;
+        case 0x25u: v = _rsx_up2h((a).x); break;
+        case 0x26u: v = (float4)pow(max(abs((a).x), 1e-10), (b).x); break;
+        case 0x27u: v = (float4)asfloat(_rsx_pk4ub(a)); break;
+        case 0x28u: v = _rsx_up4ub((a).x); break;
+        case 0x29u: v = (float4)asfloat(_rsx_pk2us(a)); break;
+        case 0x2Au: v = _rsx_up2us((a).x); break;
+        case 0x2Cu: v = (float4)asfloat(_rsx_pk4ub(_rsx_lin2srgb(a))); break;
+        case 0x2Du: v = _rsx_srgb2lin(_rsx_up4ub((a).x)); break;
+        case 0x38u: v = (float4)dot((a).xy, (b).xy); break;
+        case 0x39u: v = float4(normalize((a).xyz), 1.0); break;
+        case 0x3Au: v = (a) / (abs((b).x) > 1e-10 ? (b).x : 1e-10); break;
+        case 0x3Bu: v = (abs(a) > 0.0 ? (a) / sqrt(abs((b).x)) : (float4)0.0); break;
+        case 0x3Cu: v = float4(1.0, (a).y, (a).y > 0.0 ? exp2((a).w) : 0.0, 1.0); break;
+        case 0x17u: case 0x18u: case 0x2Fu: case 0x31u: {   // TEX TXP TXL TXB
+            const uint4 ud = k[3u + unit];
+            const uint d = ud.x;
+            const bool bx2 = ((w0 >> 21) & 1u) != 0u;
+#if SI_SHADOW
+            if ((d >> 9) & 1u) {                             // depth comparison (TEX / TXP only: refused otherwise)
+                v = si_shadow(unit, d, op == 0x18u ? (a).xyz / (a).w : (a).xyz);
+            } else
+#endif
+            {
+                const bool sep = ((d >> 20) & 3u) != 0u;     // cube or 3D: three coordinates
+                const bool cube = ((d >> 20) & 1u) != 0u;
+                const bool scl = ((d >> 19) & 1u) != 0u;     // texel-addressed: TEX / TXP divided by the size
+                if (op == 0x17u) {
+                    float3 t = (a).xyz;
+                    if (scl) { if (sep) t = (a).xyz * asfloat(ud.yzw); else t.xy = (a).xy * asfloat(ud.yz); }
+                    v = si_fetch(unit, 0u, t, 0.0);
+                } else if (op == 0x18u) {
+                    float3 t;
+                    if (cube) t = (a).xyz;
+                    else if (sep) { t = (a).xyz / (a).w; if (scl) t = (a).xyz / (a).w * asfloat(ud.yzw); }
+                    else { t = float3((a).xy / (a).w, 0.0); if (scl) t.xy = (a).xy / (a).w * asfloat(ud.yz); }
+                    v = si_fetch(unit, 0u, t, 0.0);
+                } else
+                    v = si_fetch(unit, op == 0x31u ? 1u : 2u, (a).xyz, (b).x);
+            }
+            const uint gm = d & 15u;
+            if (gm != 0u && !bx2) v = _rsx_gamma_input(v, gm);
+            if (bx2 || ((d >> 4) & 31u) != 0u) {
+                if (!((d >> 9) & 1u)) {
+                    uint m = bx2 ? 15u : ((d >> 4) & 31u);
+                    if (!bx2) m &= ~gm;
+                    if (m & 15u) v = _rsx_expand_input(v, m, bx2);
+                }
+            }
+            break; }
+        default: handled = false; break;                      // NOP, fences, and what the translation leaves out
+        }
+        if (!handled) continue;
+        const bool set_cond = ((w0 >> 8) & 1u) != 0u;
+        const bool has_dest = ((w0 >> 30) & 1u) == 0u;
+        if (!(has_dest || set_cond)) continue;
+        const uint rs = (w2 >> 28) & 7u;
+        if (rs == 1u) v = v * 2.0; else if (rs == 2u) v = v * 4.0; else if (rs == 3u) v = v * 8.0;
+        else if (rs == 5u) v = v / 2.0; else if (rs == 6u) v = v / 4.0; else if (rs == 7u) v = v / 8.0;
+        if (w0 >> 31) v = saturate(v);
+        uint m = (w0 >> 9) & 15u;
+        if (m == 0u) m = 15u;
+        const uint di = ((w0 >> 1) & 63u) * 2u + ((w0 >> 7) & 1u);
+        if (has_dest && e == 7u && m == 15u && !set_cond) { R[SI_RI(di)] = v; continue; }   // the common write
+        float4 dst = has_dest ? R[SI_RI(di)] : (float4)0;
+        if (has_dest) {
+            if (e != 0u) {
+                float4 sel = (float4)1;
+                if (e != 7u) sel = si_test(si_swz(ccr, cswz), e);
+                dst = float4((m & 1u) && sel.x != 0.0 ? v.x : dst.x, (m & 2u) && sel.y != 0.0 ? v.y : dst.y,
+                             (m & 4u) && sel.z != 0.0 ? v.z : dst.z, (m & 8u) && sel.w != 0.0 ? v.w : dst.w);
+                R[SI_RI(di)] = dst;
+            }
+        }
+        if (set_cond) {
+            const float4 src = has_dest ? dst : v;
+            float4 cc = ((w1 >> 30) & 1u) ? CC1 : CC0;
+            cc = float4((m & 1u) ? src.x : cc.x, (m & 2u) ? src.y : cc.y, (m & 4u) ? src.z : cc.z, (m & 8u) ? src.w : cc.w);
+            if ((w1 >> 30) & 1u) CC1 = cc; else CC0 = cc;
+        }
+    }
+    float4 _o = R[SI_RI(flags & 1u)];       // h0 with 16-bit exports, r0 with 32-bit ones
+    float4 o = (_o == _o) ? _o : (float4)0;
+    if (flags & 2u) o = _rsx_srgb_output(o);
+    if (flags & 16u) {                  // the alpha test (rsx_fp_apply_alpha_test_buffered)
+        const uint cmp = (flags >> 5) & 7u;
+        const float _rsx_alpha_ref = fp_alpha.x;
+        bool ok = false;
+        if (cmp == 1u) ok = o.a < _rsx_alpha_ref;
+        else if (cmp == 2u) ok = o.a == _rsx_alpha_ref;
+        else if (cmp == 3u) ok = o.a <= _rsx_alpha_ref;
+        else if (cmp == 4u) ok = o.a > _rsx_alpha_ref;
+        else if (cmp == 5u) ok = o.a != _rsx_alpha_ref;
+        else if (cmp == 6u) ok = o.a >= _rsx_alpha_ref;
+        if (!(ok)) discard;
+    }
+    return o;
+}
+#if SI_MV
+MVOut main(PSInput input) {
+    MVOut o;
+    o.c = _si_main(input);
+    o.mv = float4(30000.0, 30000.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (input.mvj.z > 0.5 && input.mvp.z > 0.0)
+        o.mv.xy = clamp(input.mvp.xy / input.mvp.z - (input.position.xy - input.mvj.xy), -4096.0, 4096.0);
+    return o;
+}
+#endif

+"// ---- the translated text's helpers, written the same way (rsx_fp_decompiler.c) ----------------------\n"
+"float4 _rsx_gamma_input(float4 v, uint mask) {\n"
+"    float4 lo = v / 12.92;\n"
+"    float4 hi = pow(max((v + 0.055) / 1.055, (float4)0), (float4)2.4);\n"
+"    float4 decoded = float4(v.r > 0.04045 ? hi.r : lo.r,\n"
+"                            v.g > 0.04045 ? hi.g : lo.g,\n"
+"                            v.b > 0.04045 ? hi.b : lo.b,\n"
+"                            v.a > 0.04045 ? hi.a : lo.a);\n"
+"    return float4((mask & 1u) ? decoded.r : v.r,\n"
+"                  (mask & 2u) ? decoded.g : v.g,\n"
+"                  (mask & 4u) ? decoded.b : v.b,\n"
+"                  (mask & 8u) ? decoded.a : v.a);\n"
+"}\n"
+"float4 _rsx_expand_input(float4 v, uint mask, bool bx2) {\n"
+"    float4 e = bx2 ? v * 2.0 - 1.0\n"
+"             : (mask & 16u) ? (floor(v * 65535.0 + 0.5) - 32768.0) / 32767.0\n"
+"                            : (floor(v * 255.0 + 0.5) - 128.0) / 127.0;\n"
+"    return float4((mask & 1u) ? e.r : v.r,\n"
+"                  (mask & 2u) ? e.g : v.g,\n"
+"                  (mask & 4u) ? e.b : v.b,\n"
+"                  (mask & 8u) ? e.a : v.a);\n"
+"}\n"
+"uint   _rsx_pk4ub(float4 v) { uint4 b = (uint4)round(saturate(v) * 255.0); return b.x | (b.y << 8) | (b.z << 16) | (b.w << 24); }\n"
+"float4 _rsx_up4ub(float v) { uint u = asuint(v); return float4(u & 255u, (u >> 8) & 255u, (u >> 16) & 255u, (u >> 24) & 255u) / 255.0; }\n"
+"uint   _rsx_pk4b(float4 v) { uint4 b = (uint4)((int4)round(clamp(v, -1.0, 1.0) * 127.0)) & 255u; return b.x | (b.y << 8) | (b.z << 16) | (b.w << 24); }\n"
+"float4 _rsx_up4b(float v) { uint u = asuint(v); int4 b = int4(u & 255u, (u >> 8) & 255u, (u >> 16) & 255u, (u >> 24) & 255u); b = (b << 24) >> 24; return clamp((float4)b / 127.0, -1.0, 1.0); }\n"
+"uint   _rsx_pk2us(float4 v) { uint2 b = (uint2)round(saturate(v.xy) * 65535.0); return b.x | (b.y << 16); }\n"
+"float4 _rsx_up2us(float v) { uint u = asuint(v); return float4(u & 65535u, u >> 16, u & 65535u, u >> 16) / 65535.0; }\n"
+"uint   _rsx_pk2h(float4 v) { return f32tof16(v.x) | (f32tof16(v.y) << 16); }\n"
+"float4 _rsx_up2h(float v) { uint u = asuint(v); return float4(f16tof32(u & 65535u), f16tof32(u >> 16), f16tof32(u & 65535u), f16tof32(u >> 16)); }\n"
+"float4 _rsx_lin2srgb(float4 cl) { cl = saturate(cl); float4 low = cl * 12.92; float4 high = 1.055 * pow(cl, 1.0 / 2.4) - 0.055; return saturate((cl < 0.0031308) ? low : high); }\n"
+"float4 _rsx_srgb2lin(float4 cs) { float4 a = cs / 12.92; float4 b = pow(max(cs + 0.055, 0.0) / 1.055, 2.4); return (cs > 0.04045) ? b : a; }\n"
+"float4 _rsx_srgb_output(float4 v) {\n"
+"    float3 lo = v.rgb * 12.92;\n"
+"    float3 hi = 1.055 * pow(max(v.rgb, (float3)0), (float3)(1.0 / 2.4)) - 0.055;\n"
+"    float3 rgb = float3(v.r < 0.0031308 ? lo.r : hi.r,\n"
+"                         v.g < 0.0031308 ? lo.g : hi.g,\n"
+"                         v.b < 0.0031308 ? lo.b : hi.b);\n"
+"    return float4(saturate(rgb), v.a);\n"
+"}\n"
+"\n"
+"// ---- depth comparison (fp_shadow_helper), driven by the unit's descriptor ---------------------------\n"
+"float si_cmp(uint func, float reference, float depth)\n"
+"{\n"
+"    [forcecase] switch (func) {\n"
+"    case 0u: return 0.0;\n"
+"    case 1u: return (float)(depth < reference);\n"
+"    case 2u: return (float)(depth == reference);\n"
+"    case 3u: return (float)(depth <= reference);\n"
+"    case 4u: return (float)(depth > reference);\n"
+"    case 5u: return (float)(depth != reference);\n"
+"    case 6u: return (float)(depth >= reference);\n"
+"    default: return 1.0;\n"
+"    }\n"
+"}\n"
+"float4 si_cmp4(uint func, float reference, float4 depth)\n"
+"{\n"
+"    return float4(si_cmp(func, reference, depth.x), si_cmp(func, reference, depth.y),\n"
+"                  si_cmp(func, reference, depth.z), si_cmp(func, reference, depth.w));\n"
+"}\n"
+"float4 si_shadow(uint u, uint d, float3 coordinate)\n"
+"{\n"
+"    const uint func = (d >> 10) & 7u, scale = (d >> 16) & 7u;\n"
+"    const bool lin = ((d >> 13) & 1u) != 0u, unn = ((d >> 14) & 1u) != 0u, soft = ((d >> 15) & 1u) != 0u;\n"
+"    float reference = saturate(coordinate.z);\n"
+"    if (soft) {\n"
+"        float2 size = si_dims(u);\n"
+"        float2 inv = 1.0 / size;\n"
+"        float2 position = (!unn ? coordinate.xy : scale == 4u ? (coordinate.xy * 4.0 * inv) :\n"
+"                           scale == 2u ? (coordinate.xy * 2.0 * inv) : (coordinate.xy * inv)) * size - 0.5;\n"
+"        float2 base = floor(position); float2 f = position - base;\n"
+"        float4 g0 = si_cmp4(func, reference, si_gather(u, (base + float2(0.0, 0.0)) * inv));\n"
+"        float4 g1 = si_cmp4(func, reference, si_gather(u, (base + float2(2.0, 0.0)) * inv));\n"
+"        float4 g2 = si_cmp4(func, reference, si_gather(u, (base + float2(0.0, 2.0)) * inv));\n"
+"        float4 g3 = si_cmp4(func, reference, si_gather(u, (base + float2(2.0, 2.0)) * inv));\n"
+"        float4 wx = float4(1.0 - f.x, 1.0, 1.0, f.x);\n"
+"        float4 wy = float4(1.0 - f.y, 1.0, 1.0, f.y);\n"
+"        float s = dot(g0, float4(wx.x * wy.y, wx.y * wy.y, wx.y * wy.x, wx.x * wy.x))\n"
+"                + dot(g1, float4(wx.z * wy.y, wx.w * wy.y, wx.w * wy.x, wx.z * wy.x))\n"
+"                + dot(g2, float4(wx.x * wy.w, wx.y * wy.w, wx.y * wy.z, wx.x * wy.z))\n"
+"                + dot(g3, float4(wx.z * wy.w, wx.w * wy.w, wx.w * wy.z, wx.z * wy.z));\n"
+"        return (float4)(s * (1.0 / 9.0));\n"
+"    }\n"
+"    float2 size = (float2)1;\n"
+"    if (lin || unn) size = si_dims(u);\n"
+"    float2 uv = !unn ? coordinate.xy : scale == 4u ? coordinate.xy * 4.0 / size :\n"
+"                scale == 2u ? coordinate.xy * 2.0 / size : coordinate.xy / size;\n"
+"    if (!lin) {\n"
+"        float depth = si_depth(u, uv);\n"
+"        return (float4)si_cmp(func, reference, depth);\n"
+"    }\n"
+"    float2 position = uv * size - 0.5;\n"
+"    float2 base = floor(position); float2 fraction = position - base;\n"
+"    float c0 = si_cmp(func, reference, si_depth(u, (base + float2(0.5, 0.5)) / size));\n"
+"    float c1 = si_cmp(func, reference, si_depth(u, (base + float2(1.5, 0.5)) / size));\n"
+"    float c2 = si_cmp(func, reference, si_depth(u, (base + float2(0.5, 1.5)) / size));\n"
+"    float c3 = si_cmp(func, reference, si_depth(u, (base + float2(1.5, 1.5)) / size));\n"
+"    return (float4)lerp(lerp(c0, c1, fraction.x), lerp(c2, c3, fraction.x), fraction.y);\n"
+"}\n"
+"\n"
+"// ---- the interpreter --------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n"
+"// The register file, the inputs and the condition codes are main's locals: a static array would be zeroed in\n"
+"// full for every pixel (96 stores to local memory: that alone was 11 ms of a 1080p pass).\n"
+"#define SI_RN 96                        // r0..r47 and h0..h47: register n of file f at 2n + f\n"
+"#define SI_RI(i) (i)\n"
+"\n"
+"float si_c(float4 v, uint i) { return i == 0u ? v.x : i == 1u ? v.y : i == 2u ? v.z : v.w; }\n"
+"float4 si_swz(float4 v, uint s)         // 2 bits a lane, x first\n"
+"{\n"
+"    return float4(si_c(v, s & 3u), si_c(v, (s >> 2) & 3u), si_c(v, (s >> 4) & 3u), si_c(v, (s >> 6) & 3u));\n"
+"}\n"
+"// exec_if: lt = bit 0, eq = bit 1, gr = bit 2 (7 always, 0 never: the callers test those first)\n"
+"float4 si_test(float4 c, uint e)\n"
+"{\n"
+"    [forcecase] switch (e) {\n"
+"    case 6u: return (float4)(c >= (float4)0.0);\n"
+"    case 3u: return (float4)(c <= (float4)0.0);\n"
+"    case 5u: return (float4)(c != (float4)0.0);\n"
+"    case 4u: return (float4)(c >  (float4)0.0);\n"
+"    case 1u: return (float4)(c <  (float4)0.0);\n"
+"    default: return (float4)(c == (float4)0.0);\n"
+"    }\n"
+"}\n"
+"// An operand: its value as read (register, input or inline constant), then swizzle, abs, negate.\n"
+"float4 si_mod(float4 v, uint w, bool absv)\n"
+"{\n"
+"    v = si_swz(v, (w >> 9) & 255u);\n"
+"    if (absv) v = abs(v);\n"
+"    if ((w >> 17) & 1u) v = -(v);\n"
+"    return v;\n"
+"}\n"
+"// The input OPDEST.INPUT_SRC names (wpos already has the window convention applied).\n"
+"float4 si_in(PSInput input, float4 wpos, uint s)\n"
+"{\n"
+"    [forcecase] switch (s) {\n"
+"    case 0u: return wpos;\n"
+"    case 1u: return saturate(input.col0);\n"
+"    case 2u: return saturate(input.col1);\n"
+"    case 3u: return input.fog;\n"
+"    case 4u: return input.tc0;\n"
+"    case 5u: return input.tc1;\n"
+"    case 6u: return input.tc2;\n"
+"    case 7u: return input.tc3;\n"
+"    case 8u: return input.tc4;\n"
+"    case 9u: return input.tc5;\n"
+"    case 10u: return input.tc6;\n"
+"    case 11u: return input.tc7;\n"
+"    case 12u: return input.tc8;\n"
+"    case 13u: return input.tc9;\n"
+"    case 14u: return (input._rsx_front ? float4(1,1,1,1) : float4(-1,-1,-1,-1));\n"
+"    default: return (float4)0;\n"
+"    }\n"
+"}\n"
+"#define SI_RAW(w) ((((w) & 3u) == 0u) ? R[SI_RI(min(((w) >> 2) & 63u, 47u) * 2u + (((w) >> 8) & 1u))] : (((w) & 3u) == 1u) ? iv : (has_k ? kv : (float4)0))\n"
+"\n"
+"#if SI_MV\n"
+"struct MVOut { float4 c : SV_TARGET0; float4 mv : SV_TARGET1; };\n"
+"float4 _si_main(PSInput input)\n"
+"#else\n"
+"float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_TARGET\n"
+"#endif\n"
+"{\n"
+"    const uint4 hd = k[0];\n"
+"    const uint flags = hd.y, n_ops = hd.z;\n"
+"    const float4 fp_alpha = asfloat(k[1]);\n"
+"    const uint kbase = 19u, obase = 19u + hd.x;\n"
+"    if (flags & 4u)         // the WPOS grid (rsx_fp_apply_wpos_grid)\n"
+"        input.position.xy = floor(input.position.xy / float2(k[2].x, k[2].y)) + 0.5;\n"
+"    else if (flags & 8u)    // the render-scale line (ld_rs_apply_wpos)\n"
+"        input.position.xy = input.position.xy * fp_alpha.w / float2(k[2].x, k[2].y);\n"
+"    const float4 p = input.position;\n"
+"    const float4 wpos = float4(p.x + fp_alpha.z, (fp_alpha.y != 0.0 ? fp_alpha.y - p.y : p.y) + fp_alpha.z, p.z, p.w);\n"
+"    const float inv_w = (1.0 / input.position.w);\n"
+"    float4 R[SI_RN];\n"
+"    [loop] for (uint z = 0u; z < hd.w; z++) R[SI_RI(z)] = (float4)0;   // the registers the program names\n"
+"    float4 CC0 = (float4)0, CC1 = (float4)0;\n"
+"\n"
+"    uint4 LS[4];                        // open loops: counter, end, increment, the op after its end\n"
+"    uint lsp = 0u;\n"
+"    uint pc = 0u;\n"
+"    [loop] for (uint guard = 0u; guard < 1048576u && pc < n_ops; guard++) {\n"
+"        const uint4 W = k[obase + pc * 2u];\n"
+"        const uint4 X = k[obase + pc * 2u + 1u];\n"
+"        pc++;\n"
+"        const uint e = (W.y >> 18) & 7u;                     // exec_if lt / eq / gr\n"
+"        if (X.x != 0u) {                                     // flow: the first lane of the condition swizzle\n"
+"            bool cond = true;\n"
+"            if (X.x == 1u || X.x == 4u || X.x == 6u) {\n"
+"                if (e == 0u) cond = false;\n"
+"                else if (e != 7u) {\n"
+"                    const float4 cc = ((W.y >> 31) & 1u) ? CC1 : CC0;\n"
+"                    cond = si_test((float4)si_c(cc, (W.y >> 21) & 3u), e).x != 0.0;\n"
+"                }\n"
+"            }\n"
+"            [forcecase] switch (X.x) {\n"
+"            case 1u: if (!cond) pc = X.y; break;                      // IF: else or end\n"
+"            case 2u: pc = X.y; break;                                 // ELSE reached from the then part\n"
+"            case 4u: {                                                // LOOP\n"
+"                const uint init = X.z & 255u, endn = (X.z >> 8) & 255u, inc = (X.z >> 16) & 255u;\n"
+"                if (!cond || init >= endn || lsp >= 4u) pc = X.y;\n"
+"                else { LS[lsp] = uint4(init, endn, inc, X.y); lsp++; }\n"
+"                break; }\n"
+"            case 5u: {                                                // end of a loop's body\n"
+"                if (lsp > 0u) {\n"
+"                    const uint4 l = LS[lsp - 1u];\n"
+"                    const uint c = l.x + l.z;\n"
+"                    if (c < l.y) { LS[lsp - 1u].x = c; pc = X.y; }\n"
+"                    else lsp--;\n"
+"                }\n"
+"                break; }\n"
+"            case 6u: if (cond && lsp > 0u) { pc = LS[lsp - 1u].w; lsp--; } break;   // BRK\n"
+"            default: break;                                           // ENDIF\n"
+"            }\n"
+"            continue;\n"
+"        }\n"
+"        const uint w0 = W.x, w1 = W.y, w2 = W.z, w3 = W.w;\n"
+"        const uint op = (w0 >> 24) & 63u;\n"
+"        const uint input_src = (w0 >> 13) & 15u, unit = (w0 >> 17) & 15u;\n"
+"        const bool persp = (w3 >> 31) != 0u;\n"
+"        const bool has_k = (X.w & 1u) != 0u;\n"
+"        const float4 kv = has_k ? asfloat(k[kbase + X.y]) : (float4)0;\n"
+"        float4 iv = si_in(input, wpos, input_src);\n"
+"        if (persp && input_src >= 4u && input_src <= 13u) iv = (iv * inv_w);\n"
+"        const uint n_src = X.z;                              // sources the opcode reads (the encoder's count)\n"
+"        const float4 a = si_mod(SI_RAW(w1), w1, ((w1 >> 29) & 1u) != 0u);\n"
+"        float4 b = (float4)0, c = (float4)0;\n"
+"        if (n_src >= 2u) b = si_mod(SI_RAW(w2), w2, ((w2 >> 18) & 1u) != 0u);\n"
+"        if (n_src >= 3u) c = si_mod(SI_RAW(w3), w3, false);\n"
+"        const float4 ccr = ((w1 >> 31) & 1u) ? CC1 : CC0;\n"
+"        const uint cswz = (w1 >> 21) & 255u;\n"
+"        float4 v = (float4)0;\n"
+"        bool handled = true;\n"
+"        [forcecase] switch (op) {\n"
+"        case 0x01u: v = a; break;\n"
+"        case 0x02u: v = (a) * (b); break;\n"
+"        case 0x03u: v = (a) + (b); break;\n"
+"        case 0x04u: v = (a) * (b) + (c); break;\n"
+"        case 0x05u: v = (float4)dot((a).xyz, (b).xyz); break;\n"
+"        case 0x06u: v = (float4)dot((a), (b)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x08u: v = min((a), (b)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x09u: v = max((a), (b)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x0Au: v = (float4)((a) <  (b)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x0Bu: v = (float4)((a) >= (b)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x0Cu: v = (float4)((a) <= (b)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x0Du: v = (float4)((a) >  (b)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x0Eu: v = (float4)((a) != (b)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x0Fu: v = (float4)((a) == (b)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x10u: v = frac(a); break;\n"
+"        case 0x11u: v = floor(a); break;\n"
+"        case 0x12u:                                          // KIL\n"
+"            if (e == 7u) discard;\n"
+"            else if (e != 0u && any(si_test(si_swz(ccr, cswz), e) != (float4)0.0)) discard;\n"
+"            handled = false; break;\n"
+"        case 0x13u: v = (float4)asfloat(_rsx_pk4b(a)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x14u: v = _rsx_up4b((a).x); break;\n"
+"        case 0x1Au: v = (float4)(1.0 / (abs((a).x) > 1e-10 ? (a).x : 1e-10)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x1Bu: v = (float4)rsqrt(max(abs((a).x), 1e-10)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x1Cu: v = (float4)exp2((a).x); break;\n"
+"        case 0x1Du: v = (float4)log2(max(abs((a).x), 1e-10)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x1Fu: v = lerp((c), (b), (a)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x22u: v = (float4)cos((a).x); break;\n"
+"        case 0x23u: v = (float4)sin((a).x); break;\n"
+"        case 0x24u: v = (float4)asfloat(_rsx_pk2h(a)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x25u: v = _rsx_up2h((a).x); break;\n"
+"        case 0x26u: v = (float4)pow(max(abs((a).x), 1e-10), (b).x); break;\n"
+"        case 0x27u: v = (float4)asfloat(_rsx_pk4ub(a)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x28u: v = _rsx_up4ub((a).x); break;\n"
+"        case 0x29u: v = (float4)asfloat(_rsx_pk2us(a)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x2Au: v = _rsx_up2us((a).x); break;\n"
+"        case 0x2Cu: v = (float4)asfloat(_rsx_pk4ub(_rsx_lin2srgb(a))); break;\n"
+"        case 0x2Du: v = _rsx_srgb2lin(_rsx_up4ub((a).x)); break;\n"
+"        case 0x38u: v = (float4)dot((a).xy, (b).xy); break;\n"
+"        case 0x39u: v = float4(normalize((a).xyz), 1.0); break;\n"
+"        case 0x3Au: v = (a) / (abs((b).x) > 1e-10 ? (b).x : 1e-10); break;\n"
+"        case 0x3Bu: v = (abs(a) > 0.0 ? (a) / sqrt(abs((b).x)) : (float4)0.0); break;\n"
+"        case 0x3Cu: v = float4(1.0, (a).y, (a).y > 0.0 ? exp2((a).w) : 0.0, 1.0); break;\n"
+"        case 0x17u: case 0x18u: case 0x2Fu: case 0x31u: {   // TEX TXP TXL TXB\n"
+"            const uint4 ud = k[3u + unit];\n"
+"            const uint d = ud.x;\n"
+"            const bool bx2 = ((w0 >> 21) & 1u) != 0u;\n"
+"#if SI_SHADOW\n"
+"            if ((d >> 9) & 1u) {                             // depth comparison (TEX / TXP only: refused otherwise)\n"
+"                v = si_shadow(unit, d, op == 0x18u ? (a).xyz / (a).w : (a).xyz);\n"
+"            } else\n"
+"#endif\n"
+"            {\n"
+"                const bool sep = ((d >> 20) & 3u) != 0u;     // cube or 3D: three coordinates\n"
+"                const bool cube = ((d >> 20) & 1u) != 0u;\n"
+"                const bool scl = ((d >> 19) & 1u) != 0u;     // texel-addressed: TEX / TXP divided by the size\n"
+"                if (op == 0x17u) {\n"
+"                    float3 t = (a).xyz;\n"
+"                    if (scl) { if (sep) t = (a).xyz * asfloat(ud.yzw); else t.xy = (a).xy * asfloat(ud.yz); }\n"
+"                    v = si_fetch(unit, 0u, t, 0.0);\n"
+"                } else if (op == 0x18u) {\n"
+"                    float3 t;\n"
+"                    if (cube) t = (a).xyz;\n"
+"                    else if (sep) { t = (a).xyz / (a).w; if (scl) t = (a).xyz / (a).w * asfloat(ud.yzw); }\n"
+"                    else { t = float3((a).xy / (a).w, 0.0); if (scl) t.xy = (a).xy / (a).w * asfloat(ud.yz); }\n"
+"                    v = si_fetch(unit, 0u, t, 0.0);\n"
+"                } else\n"
+"                    v = si_fetch(unit, op == 0x31u ? 1u : 2u, (a).xyz, (b).x);\n"
+"            }\n"
+"            const uint gm = d & 15u;\n"
+"            if (gm != 0u && !bx2) v = _rsx_gamma_input(v, gm);\n"
+"            if (bx2 || ((d >> 4) & 31u) != 0u) {\n"
+"                if (!((d >> 9) & 1u)) {\n"
+"                    uint m = bx2 ? 15u : ((d >> 4) & 31u);\n"
+"                    if (!bx2) m &= ~gm;\n"
+"                    if (m & 15u) v = _rsx_expand_input(v, m, bx2);\n"
+"                }\n"
+"            }\n"
+"            break; }\n"
+"        default: handled = false; break;                      // NOP, fences, and what the translation leaves out\n"
+"        }\n"
+"        if (!handled) continue;\n"
+"        const bool set_cond = ((w0 >> 8) & 1u) != 0u;\n"
+"        const bool has_dest = ((w0 >> 30) & 1u) == 0u;\n"
+"        if (!(has_dest || set_cond)) continue;\n"
+"        const uint rs = (w2 >> 28) & 7u;\n"
+"        if (rs == 1u) v = v * 2.0; else if (rs == 2u) v = v * 4.0; else if (rs == 3u) v = v * 8.0;\n"
+"        else if (rs == 5u) v = v / 2.0; else if (rs == 6u) v = v / 4.0; else if (rs == 7u) v = v / 8.0;\n"
+"        if (w0 >> 31) v = saturate(v);\n"
+"        uint m = (w0 >> 9) & 15u;\n"
+"        if (m == 0u) m = 15u;\n"
+"        const uint di = ((w0 >> 1) & 63u) * 2u + ((w0 >> 7) & 1u);\n"
+"        if (has_dest && e == 7u && m == 15u && !set_cond) { R[SI_RI(di)] = v; continue; }   // the common write\n"
+"        float4 dst = has_dest ? R[SI_RI(di)] : (float4)0;\n"
+"        if (has_dest) {\n"
+"            if (e != 0u) {\n"
+"                float4 sel = (float4)1;\n"
+"                if (e != 7u) sel = si_test(si_swz(ccr, cswz), e);\n"
+"                dst = float4((m & 1u) && sel.x != 0.0 ? v.x : dst.x, (m & 2u) && sel.y != 0.0 ? v.y : dst.y,\n"
+"                             (m & 4u) && sel.z != 0.0 ? v.z : dst.z, (m & 8u) && sel.w != 0.0 ? v.w : dst.w);\n"
+"                R[SI_RI(di)] = dst;\n"
+"            }\n"
+"        }\n"
+"        if (set_cond) {\n"
+"            const float4 src = has_dest ? dst : v;\n"
+"            float4 cc = ((w1 >> 30) & 1u) ? CC1 : CC0;\n"
+"            cc = float4((m & 1u) ? src.x : cc.x, (m & 2u) ? src.y : cc.y, (m & 4u) ? src.z : cc.z, (m & 8u) ? src.w : cc.w);\n"
+"            if ((w1 >> 30) & 1u) CC1 = cc; else CC0 = cc;\n"
+"        }\n"
+"    }\n"
+"    float4 _o = R[SI_RI(flags & 1u)];       // h0 with 16-bit exports, r0 with 32-bit ones\n"
+"    float4 o = (_o == _o) ? _o : (float4)0;\n"
+"    if (flags & 2u) o = _rsx_srgb_output(o);\n"
+"    if (flags & 16u) {                  // the alpha test (rsx_fp_apply_alpha_test_buffered)\n"
+"        const uint cmp = (flags >> 5) & 7u;\n"
+"        const float _rsx_alpha_ref = fp_alpha.x;\n"
+"        bool ok = false;\n"
+"        if (cmp == 1u) ok = o.a < _rsx_alpha_ref;\n"
+"        else if (cmp == 2u) ok = o.a == _rsx_alpha_ref;\n"
+"        else if (cmp == 3u) ok = o.a <= _rsx_alpha_ref;\n"
+"        else if (cmp == 4u) ok = o.a > _rsx_alpha_ref;\n"
+"        else if (cmp == 5u) ok = o.a != _rsx_alpha_ref;\n"
+"        else if (cmp == 6u) ok = o.a >= _rsx_alpha_ref;\n"
+"        if (!(ok)) discard;\n"
+"    }\n"
+"    return o;\n"
+"}\n"
+"#if SI_MV\n"
+"MVOut main(PSInput input) {\n"
+"    MVOut o;\n"
+"    o.c = _si_main(input);\n"
+"    o.mv = float4(30000.0, 30000.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n"
+"    if (input.mvj.z > 0.5 && input.mvp.z > 0.0)\n"
+"        o.mv.xy = clamp(input.mvp.xy / input.mvp.z - (input.position.xy - input.mvj.xy), -4096.0, 4096.0);\n"
+"    return o;\n"
+"}\n"
+"#endif\n"
+"\n"
+;

+// [standin] The stand-in vertex shader: runs an RSX vertex program from its words, as rsx_vp_decompiler.c
+// translates it (same helpers, same expressions, the scalar unit reading its source after the vector unit's
+// writes, the same block / call semantics for BRA BRI CAL CLI RET BRB CLB), for a pipeline whose own vertex
+// shader is not compiled yet. b1 (visible to both stages) holds the stand-in block; k[2].z is the row where the
+// vertex part starts: header (x = micro-ops, y = the inputs the translated shader reads, z = vertex texture
+// units, w = flags: 1 compact inputs), then two rows a micro-op: the instruction's four words and
+// (next pc after a flow op if taken, 1 when a BRB / CLB is taken, 0, 0).
+// SI_MV: the motion-vector variant (two more outputs, two more constant rows).
+#ifndef SI_MV
+#define SI_MV 0
+#endif
+struct VSInput {
+    float4 a0:ATTR0;  float4 a1:ATTR1;  float4 a2:ATTR2;  float4 a3:ATTR3;
+    float4 a4:ATTR4;  float4 a5:ATTR5;  float4 a6:ATTR6;  float4 a7:ATTR7;
+    float4 a8:ATTR8;  float4 a9:ATTR9;  float4 a10:ATTR10; float4 a11:ATTR11;
+    float4 a12:ATTR12; float4 a13:ATTR13; float4 a14:ATTR14; float4 a15:ATTR15;
+};
+struct VSOutput {
+    float4 pos:SV_Position; float4 col0:COLOR0; float4 col1:COLOR1;
+    float4 fog:FOG;
+#if SI_MV
+    float4 mvp:MVPREV; nointerpolation float4 mvj:MVJIT;
+#endif
+    float4 t0:TEXCOORD0; float4 t1:TEXCOORD1; float4 t2:TEXCOORD2; float4 t3:TEXCOORD3;
+    float4 t4:TEXCOORD4; float4 t5:TEXCOORD5; float4 t6:TEXCOORD6; float4 t7:TEXCOORD7;
+    float4 t8:TEXCOORD8; float4 t9:TEXCOORD9;
+};
+cbuffer VPConst : register(b0) {
+    float4 vp_c[512];
+    float4 vp_posscale;
+    float4 vp_posoffset;
+#if SI_MV
+    float4 vp_mv[3];
+    float4 vp_mvjit;
+#endif
+};
+cbuffer SIBlock : register(b1) { uint4 k[4096]; };
+Texture2D rsx_vtex0 : register(t16);
+SamplerState rsx_vsamp0 : register(s0);
+Texture2D rsx_vtex1 : register(t17);
+SamplerState rsx_vsamp1 : register(s1);
+Texture2D rsx_vtex2 : register(t18);
+SamplerState rsx_vsamp2 : register(s2);
+Texture2D rsx_vtex3 : register(t19);
+SamplerState rsx_vsamp3 : register(s3);
+
+float vp_mul1(float a, float b) { return (a == 0.0 || b == 0.0) ? 0.0 : a * b; }
+float4 vp_mul(float4 a, float4 b) { return float4(vp_mul1(a.x, b.x), vp_mul1(a.y, b.y), vp_mul1(a.z, b.z), vp_mul1(a.w, b.w)); }
+float vp_dot3(float4 a, float4 b) { float4 m = vp_mul(a, b); return m.x + m.y + m.z; }
+float vp_dot4(float4 a, float4 b) { float4 m = vp_mul(a, b); return m.x + m.y + m.z + m.w; }
+
+float vs_c(float4 v, uint i) { return i == 0u ? v.x : i == 1u ? v.y : i == 2u ? v.z : v.w; }
+int vs_ci(int4 v, uint i) { return i == 0u ? v.x : i == 1u ? v.y : i == 2u ? v.z : v.w; }
+// cond: 1 LT, 2 EQ, 3 LE, 4 GT, 5 NE, 6 GE (0 and 7 are handled by the callers)
+bool vs_test(float c, uint cond)
+{
+    [forcecase] switch (cond) {
+    case 1u: return c < 0.0;
+    case 2u: return c == 0.0;
+    case 3u: return c <= 0.0;
+    case 4u: return c > 0.0;
+    case 5u: return c != 0.0;
+    default: return c >= 0.0;
+    }
+}
+float4 vs_fetch(uint u, float4 a)
+{
+    [forcecase] switch (u) {
+    case 0u: return rsx_vtex0.SampleLevel(rsx_vsamp0, (a).xy, 0.0);
+    case 1u: return rsx_vtex1.SampleLevel(rsx_vsamp1, (a).xy, 0.0);
+    case 2u: return rsx_vtex2.SampleLevel(rsx_vsamp2, (a).xy, 0.0);
+    default: return rsx_vtex3.SampleLevel(rsx_vsamp3, (a).xy, 0.0);
+    }
+}
+// A source operand (17 bits) into o_: its register, then abs, then swizzle, then negate (the translation's
+// spelling: -abs(base).swz / -(base).swz).
+#define VS_SRC(o_, s, absv) {     const uint s_ = (s); const uint t_ = s_ & 3u; float4 b_;     if (t_ == 2u) b_ = V[input_src & 15u];     else if (t_ == 3u) {         if (index_const) { const int4 a_ = addr_sel ? A1 : A0; b_ = vp_c[(const_src + (uint)vs_ci(a_, addr_swz)) & 511u]; }         else b_ = vp_c[const_src & 511u];     } else b_ = R[(s_ >> 2) & 31u];     if (absv) b_ = abs(b_);     o_ = float4(vs_c(b_, (s_ >> 14) & 3u), vs_c(b_, (s_ >> 12) & 3u), vs_c(b_, (s_ >> 10) & 3u), vs_c(b_, (s_ >> 8) & 3u));     if ((s_ >> 16) & 1u) o_ = -o_; }
+// A masked store, per component under the condition test when there is one (component order x, y, z, w, each
+// test reading the condition register as it is at that moment).
+#define VS_STORE(dst, m) { \
+    if (!test) { if ((m) & 8u) dst.x = vv.x; if ((m) & 4u) dst.y = vv.y; if ((m) & 2u) dst.z = vv.z; if ((m) & 1u) dst.w = vv.w; } \
+    else if (cond != 0u) { \
+        if (((m) & 8u) && vs_test(vs_c(CC[sel], cswz.x), cond)) dst.x = vv.x; \
+        if (((m) & 4u) && vs_test(vs_c(CC[sel], cswz.y), cond)) dst.y = vv.y; \
+        if (((m) & 2u) && vs_test(vs_c(CC[sel], cswz.z), cond)) dst.z = vv.z; \
+        if (((m) & 1u) && vs_test(vs_c(CC[sel], cswz.w), cond)) dst.w = vv.w; } }
+
+VSOutput main(VSInput input)
+{
+    const uint vb = k[2].z;
+    const uint4 vh = k[vb];
+    const uint n_ops = vh.x, present = vh.y, vtex = vh.z;
+    float4 V[16];
+    V[0] = input.a0; V[1] = input.a1; V[2] = input.a2; V[3] = input.a3;
+    V[4] = input.a4; V[5] = input.a5; V[6] = input.a6; V[7] = input.a7;
+    V[8] = input.a8; V[9] = input.a9; V[10] = input.a10; V[11] = input.a11;
+    V[12] = input.a12; V[13] = input.a13; V[14] = input.a14; V[15] = input.a15;
+    [unroll] for (uint q = 0u; q < 16u; q++) if (!((present >> q) & 1u)) V[q] = float4(0, 0, 0, 1);
+    float4 R[32];
+    [unroll] for (uint i = 0u; i < 32u; i++) R[i] = (float4)0;
+    float4 O[16];
+    [unroll] for (uint j = 0u; j < 16u; j++) O[j] = float4(0, 0, 0, 1);
+    int4 A0 = (int4)0, A1 = (int4)0;
+    float4 CC[2]; CC[0] = (float4)0; CC[1] = (float4)0;
+    uint CS[8];
+    [unroll] for (uint z = 0u; z < 8u; z++) CS[z] = 0u;
+    uint csp = 0u;
+    int pc = 0;
+    [loop] for (uint guard = 0u; guard < 65536u && pc >= 0 && (uint)pc < n_ops; guard++) {
+        const uint4 W = k[vb + 1u + 2u * (uint)pc];
+        const uint4 X = k[vb + 2u + 2u * (uint)pc];
+        const uint d0 = W.x, d1 = W.y, d2 = W.z, d3 = W.w;
+        const int next = pc + 1;
+        pc = next;
+        const uint vec_op = (d1 >> 22) & 0x1Fu, sca_op = (d1 >> 27) & 0x1Fu;
+        const uint input_src = (d1 >> 8) & 0xFu, const_src = (d1 >> 12) & 0x3FFu;
+        const bool index_const = ((d3 >> 1) & 1u) != 0u;
+        const uint src0 = ((d2 >> 23) & 0x1FFu) | ((d1 & 0xFFu) << 9);
+        const uint src1 = (d2 >> 6) & 0x1FFFFu;
+        const uint src2 = ((d3 >> 21) & 0x7FFu) | ((d2 & 0x3Fu) << 11);
+        const uint addr_sel = (d0 >> 24) & 1u, addr_swz = d0 & 3u;
+        const bool sat = ((d0 >> 26) & 1u) != 0u;
+        const uint cond = (d0 >> 10) & 7u;
+        const bool test = ((d0 >> 13) & 1u) != 0u && cond != 7u;
+        const uint sel = (d0 >> 25) & 1u;
+        const uint4 cswz = uint4((d0 >> 8) & 3u, (d0 >> 6) & 3u, (d0 >> 4) & 3u, (d0 >> 2) & 3u);
+        const bool cc_update = ((d0 >> 14) & 1u) != 0u && ((d0 >> 29) & 1u) != 0u;
+        const uint dst_tmp = (d0 >> 15) & 0x3Fu, dst_out = (d3 >> 2) & 0x1Fu, sca_dst_tmp = (d3 >> 7) & 0x3Fu;
+        const bool vec_result = ((d0 >> 30) & 1u) != 0u;
+        const uint vm = (d3 >> 13) & 0xFu;    // w z y x in bits 0..3: x = 8
+        const uint sm = (d3 >> 17) & 0xFu;
+        // ---- vector unit ----
+        if (vm != 0u && vec_op != 0u) {
+            float4 a, b, c;
+            VS_SRC(a, src0, ((d0 >> 21) & 1u) != 0u);
+            VS_SRC(b, src1, ((d0 >> 22) & 1u) != 0u);
+            VS_SRC(c, src2, ((d0 >> 23) & 1u) != 0u);
+            float4 vv = (float4)0;
+            bool handled = true;
+            [forcecase] switch (vec_op) {
+            case 0x01u: vv = a; break;
+            case 0x02u: vv = vp_mul((a), (b)); break;
+            case 0x03u: vv = (a) + (c); break;
+            case 0x04u: vv = vp_mul((a), (b)) + (c); break;
+            case 0x05u: vv = (float4)vp_dot3((a), (b)); break;
+            case 0x06u: vv = (float4)(vp_dot3((a), (b)) + (b).w); break;
+            case 0x07u: vv = (float4)vp_dot4((a), (b)); break;
+            case 0x08u: vv = float4(1, (a).y * (b).y, (a).z, (b).w); break;
+            case 0x09u: vv = min((a), (b)); break;
+            case 0x0Au: vv = max((a), (b)); break;
+            case 0x0Bu: vv = (float4)((a) < (b)); break;
+            case 0x0Cu: vv = (float4)((a) >= (b)); break;
+            case 0x0Eu: vv = frac(a); break;
+            case 0x0Fu: vv = floor(a); break;
+            case 0x10u: vv = (float4)((a) == (b)); break;
+            case 0x11u: vv = (float4)0; break;
+            case 0x12u: vv = (float4)((a) > (b)); break;
+            case 0x13u: vv = (float4)((a) <= (b)); break;
+            case 0x14u: vv = (float4)((a) != (b)); break;
+            case 0x15u: vv = float4(1, 1, 1, 1); break;
+            case 0x16u: vv = sign(a); break;
+            case 0x19u: { const uint u = (d2 >> 8) & 3u; vv = ((vtex >> u) & 1u) ? vs_fetch(u, a) : float4(0, 0, 0, 0); break; }
+            case 0x0Du: {                                      // ARL: not under the condition test
+                const int4 ia = (int4)floor(a);
+                int4 t = addr_sel ? A1 : A0;
+                if (vm & 8u) t.x = ia.x; if (vm & 4u) t.y = ia.y; if (vm & 2u) t.z = ia.z; if (vm & 1u) t.w = ia.w;
+                if (addr_sel) A1 = t; else A0 = t;
+                handled = false; break; }
+            default: handled = false; break;
+            }
+            if (handled) {
+                if (sat) vv = saturate(vv);
+                if (vec_result && dst_out != 0x1Fu) { float4 d = O[dst_out & 15u]; VS_STORE(d, vm); O[dst_out & 15u] = d; }
+                if (dst_tmp != 0x3Fu) { float4 d = R[dst_tmp & 31u]; VS_STORE(d, vm); R[dst_tmp & 31u] = d; }
+                if (cc_update) {
+                    float4 d = CC[sel];
+                    if (!test) { if (vm & 8u) d.x = vv.x; if (vm & 4u) d.y = vv.y; if (vm & 2u) d.z = vv.z; if (vm & 1u) d.w = vv.w; }
+                    else if (cond != 0u) {                     // each component tests the register as written so far
+                        if ((vm & 8u) && vs_test(vs_c(d, cswz.x), cond)) d.x = vv.x;
+                        if ((vm & 4u) && vs_test(vs_c(d, cswz.y), cond)) d.y = vv.y;
+                        if ((vm & 2u) && vs_test(vs_c(d, cswz.z), cond)) d.z = vv.z;
+                        if ((vm & 1u) && vs_test(vs_c(d, cswz.w), cond)) d.w = vv.w;
+                    }
+                    CC[sel] = d;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        // ---- scalar unit (reads its source after the vector unit's writes) ----
+        if (sm != 0u && sca_op != 0u) {
+            float4 c;
+            VS_SRC(c, src2, ((d0 >> 23) & 1u) != 0u);
+            float4 vv = (float4)0;
+            bool handled = true;
+            [forcecase] switch (sca_op) {
+            case 0x01u: vv = c; break;
+            case 0x02u: vv = (float4)(1.0 / (c).x); break;
+            case 0x03u: vv = (float4)clamp(1.0 / (c).x, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e19); break;
+            case 0x04u: vv = (float4)rsqrt(max(abs((c).x), 1e-10)); break;
+            case 0x05u: vv = (float4)exp2((c).x); break;
+            case 0x06u: vv = (float4)log2(max(abs((c).x), 1e-10)); break;
+            case 0x0Du: vv = (float4)log2(max(abs((c).x), 1e-10)); break;
+            case 0x0Eu: vv = (float4)exp2((c).x); break;
+            case 0x0Fu: vv = (float4)sin((c).x); break;
+            case 0x10u: vv = (float4)cos((c).x); break;
+            case 0x07u: vv = float4(1.0, max((c).x, 0.0), ((c).x > 0.0) ?
+                                    exp2(clamp((c).w, -127.996, 127.996) * log2(max((c).y, 1e-10))) : 0.0, 1.0); break;
+            default: handled = false; break;
+            }
+            if (handled) {
+                if (sat) vv = saturate(vv);
+                if (!vec_result && dst_out != 0x1Fu) { float4 d = O[dst_out & 15u]; VS_STORE(d, sm); O[dst_out & 15u] = d; }
+                if (sca_dst_tmp != 0x3Fu) { float4 d = R[sca_dst_tmp & 31u]; VS_STORE(d, sm); R[sca_dst_tmp & 31u] = d; }
+            }
+        }
+        // ---- flow (X.x: the target, already made relative; X.y: a BRB / CLB taken) ----
+        if (X.z != 0u) {
+            bool cnd = true;
+            if (cond == 0u) cnd = false;
+            else if (cond != 7u) cnd = vs_test(vs_c(CC[sel], cswz.x), cond);
+            const int tgt = (int)X.x;
+            if (sca_op == 0x09u || sca_op == 0x08u) pc = cnd ? tgt : next;
+            else if (sca_op == 0x0Au || sca_op == 0x0Bu) {
+                if (cnd) { CS[csp] = (uint)next; csp = min(csp + 1u, 7u); pc = tgt; } else pc = next;
+            } else if (sca_op == 0x0Cu) {
+                if (cnd) { if (csp > 0u) { csp--; pc = (int)CS[csp]; } else pc = -1; } else pc = next;
+            } else {
+                if (X.y == 0u) pc = next;
+                else if (sca_op == 0x11u) pc = tgt;
+                else { CS[csp] = (uint)next; csp = min(csp + 1u, 7u); pc = tgt; }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    VSOutput Out;
+    float4 _p = O[0];
+    Out.pos = float4(_p.xyz * vp_posscale.xyz + _p.w * vp_posoffset.xyz, _p.w);
+#if SI_MV
+    Out.mvp = float4(dot(_p, vp_mv[0]), dot(_p, vp_mv[1]), dot(_p, vp_mv[2]), 0.0); Out.mvj = vp_mvjit;
+#endif
+    Out.col0 = O[1]; Out.col1 = O[2]; Out.fog = O[5].xxxx;
+    Out.t0 = O[7];  Out.t1 = O[8];  Out.t2 = O[9];  Out.t3 = O[10];
+    Out.t4 = O[11]; Out.t5 = O[12]; Out.t6 = O[13]; Out.t7 = O[14];
+    Out.t8 = O[15]; Out.t9 = O[6];
+    return Out;
+}
