+"    case 0u: return rsx_vtex0.SampleLevel(rsx_vsamp0, (a).xy, 0.0);\n"
+"    case 1u: return rsx_vtex1.SampleLevel(rsx_vsamp1, (a).xy, 0.0);\n"
+"    case 2u: return rsx_vtex2.SampleLevel(rsx_vsamp2, (a).xy, 0.0);\n"
+"    default: return rsx_vtex3.SampleLevel(rsx_vsamp3, (a).xy, 0.0);\n"
+"    }\n"
+"}\n"
+"// A source operand (17 bits) into o_: its register, then abs, then swizzle, then negate (the translation's\n"
+"// spelling: -abs(base).swz / -(base).swz).\n"
+"#define VS_SRC(o_, s, absv) {     const uint s_ = (s); const uint t_ = s_ & 3u; float4 b_;     if (t_ == 2u) b_ = V[input_src & 15u];     else if (t_ == 3u) {         if (index_const) { const int4 a_ = addr_sel ? A1 : A0; b_ = vp_c[(const_src + (uint)vs_ci(a_, addr_swz)) & 511u]; }         else b_ = vp_c[const_src & 511u];     } else b_ = R[(s_ >> 2) & 31u];     if (absv) b_ = abs(b_);     o_ = float4(vs_c(b_, (s_ >> 14) & 3u), vs_c(b_, (s_ >> 12) & 3u), vs_c(b_, (s_ >> 10) & 3u), vs_c(b_, (s_ >> 8) & 3u));     if ((s_ >> 16) & 1u) o_ = -o_; }\n"
+"// A masked store, per component under the condition test when there is one (component order x, y, z, w, each\n"
+"// test reading the condition register as it is at that moment).\n"
+"#define VS_STORE(dst, m) { \\\n"
+"    if (!test) { if ((m) & 8u) dst.x = vv.x; if ((m) & 4u) dst.y = vv.y; if ((m) & 2u) dst.z = vv.z; if ((m) & 1u) dst.w = vv.w; } \\\n"
+"    else if (cond != 0u) { \\\n"
+"        if (((m) & 8u) && vs_test(vs_c(CC[sel], cswz.x), cond)) dst.x = vv.x; \\\n"
+"        if (((m) & 4u) && vs_test(vs_c(CC[sel], cswz.y), cond)) dst.y = vv.y; \\\n"
+"        if (((m) & 2u) && vs_test(vs_c(CC[sel], cswz.z), cond)) dst.z = vv.z; \\\n"
+"        if (((m) & 1u) && vs_test(vs_c(CC[sel], cswz.w), cond)) dst.w = vv.w; } }\n"
+"\n"
+"VSOutput main(VSInput input)\n"
+"{\n"
+"    const uint vb = k[2].z;\n"
+"    const uint4 vh = k[vb];\n"
+"    const uint n_ops = vh.x, present = vh.y, vtex = vh.z;\n"
+"    float4 V[16];\n"
+"    V[0] = input.a0; V[1] = input.a1; V[2] = input.a2; V[3] = input.a3;\n"
+"    V[4] = input.a4; V[5] = input.a5; V[6] = input.a6; V[7] = input.a7;\n"
+"    V[8] = input.a8; V[9] = input.a9; V[10] = input.a10; V[11] = input.a11;\n"
+"    V[12] = input.a12; V[13] = input.a13; V[14] = input.a14; V[15] = input.a15;\n"
+"    [unroll] for (uint q = 0u; q < 16u; q++) if (!((present >> q) & 1u)) V[q] = float4(0, 0, 0, 1);\n"
+"    float4 R[32];\n"
+"    [unroll] for (uint i = 0u; i < 32u; i++) R[i] = (float4)0;\n"
+"    float4 O[16];\n"
+"    [unroll] for (uint j = 0u; j < 16u; j++) O[j] = float4(0, 0, 0, 1);\n"
+"    int4 A0 = (int4)0, A1 = (int4)0;\n"
+"    float4 CC[2]; CC[0] = (float4)0; CC[1] = (float4)0;\n"
+"    uint CS[8];\n"
+"    [unroll] for (uint z = 0u; z < 8u; z++) CS[z] = 0u;\n"
+"    uint csp = 0u;\n"
+"    int pc = 0;\n"
+"    [loop] for (uint guard = 0u; guard < 65536u && pc >= 0 && (uint)pc < n_ops; guard++) {\n"
+"        const uint4 W = k[vb + 1u + 2u * (uint)pc];\n"
+"        const uint4 X = k[vb + 2u + 2u * (uint)pc];\n"
+"        const uint d0 = W.x, d1 = W.y, d2 = W.z, d3 = W.w;\n"
+"        const int next = pc + 1;\n"
+"        pc = next;\n"
+"        const uint vec_op = (d1 >> 22) & 0x1Fu, sca_op = (d1 >> 27) & 0x1Fu;\n"
+"        const uint input_src = (d1 >> 8) & 0xFu, const_src = (d1 >> 12) & 0x3FFu;\n"
+"        const bool index_const = ((d3 >> 1) & 1u) != 0u;\n"
+"        const uint src0 = ((d2 >> 23) & 0x1FFu) | ((d1 & 0xFFu) << 9);\n"
+"        const uint src1 = (d2 >> 6) & 0x1FFFFu;\n"
+"        const uint src2 = ((d3 >> 21) & 0x7FFu) | ((d2 & 0x3Fu) << 11);\n"
+"        const uint addr_sel = (d0 >> 24) & 1u, addr_swz = d0 & 3u;\n"
+"        const bool sat = ((d0 >> 26) & 1u) != 0u;\n"
+"        const uint cond = (d0 >> 10) & 7u;\n"
+"        const bool test = ((d0 >> 13) & 1u) != 0u && cond != 7u;\n"
+"        const uint sel = (d0 >> 25) & 1u;\n"
+"        const uint4 cswz = uint4((d0 >> 8) & 3u, (d0 >> 6) & 3u, (d0 >> 4) & 3u, (d0 >> 2) & 3u);\n"
+"        const bool cc_update = ((d0 >> 14) & 1u) != 0u && ((d0 >> 29) & 1u) != 0u;\n"
+"        const uint dst_tmp = (d0 >> 15) & 0x3Fu, dst_out = (d3 >> 2) & 0x1Fu, sca_dst_tmp = (d3 >> 7) & 0x3Fu;\n"
+"        const bool vec_result = ((d0 >> 30) & 1u) != 0u;\n"
+"        const uint vm = (d3 >> 13) & 0xFu;    // w z y x in bits 0..3: x = 8\n"
+"        const uint sm = (d3 >> 17) & 0xFu;\n"
+"        // ---- vector unit ----\n"
+"        if (vm != 0u && vec_op != 0u) {\n"
+"            float4 a, b, c;\n"
+"            VS_SRC(a, src0, ((d0 >> 21) & 1u) != 0u);\n"
+"            VS_SRC(b, src1, ((d0 >> 22) & 1u) != 0u);\n"
+"            VS_SRC(c, src2, ((d0 >> 23) & 1u) != 0u);\n"
+"            float4 vv = (float4)0;\n"
+"            bool handled = true;\n"
+"            [forcecase] switch (vec_op) {\n"
+"            case 0x01u: vv = a; break;\n"
+"            case 0x02u: vv = vp_mul((a), (b)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x03u: vv = (a) + (c); break;\n"
+"            case 0x04u: vv = vp_mul((a), (b)) + (c); break;\n"
+"            case 0x05u: vv = (float4)vp_dot3((a), (b)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x06u: vv = (float4)(vp_dot3((a), (b)) + (b).w); break;\n"
+"            case 0x07u: vv = (float4)vp_dot4((a), (b)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x08u: vv = float4(1, (a).y * (b).y, (a).z, (b).w); break;\n"
+"            case 0x09u: vv = min((a), (b)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x0Au: vv = max((a), (b)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x0Bu: vv = (float4)((a) < (b)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x0Cu: vv = (float4)((a) >= (b)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x0Eu: vv = frac(a); break;\n"
+"            case 0x0Fu: vv = floor(a); break;\n"
+"            case 0x10u: vv = (float4)((a) == (b)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x11u: vv = (float4)0; break;\n"
+"            case 0x12u: vv = (float4)((a) > (b)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x13u: vv = (float4)((a) <= (b)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x14u: vv = (float4)((a) != (b)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x15u: vv = float4(1, 1, 1, 1); break;\n"
+"            case 0x16u: vv = sign(a); break;\n"
+"            case 0x19u: { const uint u = (d2 >> 8) & 3u; vv = ((vtex >> u) & 1u) ? vs_fetch(u, a) : float4(0, 0, 0, 0); break; }\n"
+"            case 0x0Du: {                                      // ARL: not under the condition test\n"
+"                const int4 ia = (int4)floor(a);\n"
+"                int4 t = addr_sel ? A1 : A0;\n"
+"                if (vm & 8u) t.x = ia.x; if (vm & 4u) t.y = ia.y; if (vm & 2u) t.z = ia.z; if (vm & 1u) t.w = ia.w;\n"
+"                if (addr_sel) A1 = t; else A0 = t;\n"
+"                handled = false; break; }\n"
+"            default: handled = false; break;\n"
+"            }\n"
+"            if (handled) {\n"
+"                if (sat) vv = saturate(vv);\n"
+"                if (vec_result && dst_out != 0x1Fu) { float4 d = O[dst_out & 15u]; VS_STORE(d, vm); O[dst_out & 15u] = d; }\n"
+"                if (dst_tmp != 0x3Fu) { float4 d = R[dst_tmp & 31u]; VS_STORE(d, vm); R[dst_tmp & 31u] = d; }\n"
+"                if (cc_update) {\n"
+"                    float4 d = CC[sel];\n"
+"                    if (!test) { if (vm & 8u) d.x = vv.x; if (vm & 4u) d.y = vv.y; if (vm & 2u) d.z = vv.z; if (vm & 1u) d.w = vv.w; }\n"
+"                    else if (cond != 0u) {                     // each component tests the register as written so far\n"
+"                        if ((vm & 8u) && vs_test(vs_c(d, cswz.x), cond)) d.x = vv.x;\n"
+"                        if ((vm & 4u) && vs_test(vs_c(d, cswz.y), cond)) d.y = vv.y;\n"
+"                        if ((vm & 2u) && vs_test(vs_c(d, cswz.z), cond)) d.z = vv.z;\n"
+"                        if ((vm & 1u) && vs_test(vs_c(d, cswz.w), cond)) d.w = vv.w;\n"
+"                    }\n"
+"                    CC[sel] = d;\n"
+"                }\n"
+"            }\n"
+"        }\n"
+"        // ---- scalar unit (reads its source after the vector unit's writes) ----\n"
+"        if (sm != 0u && sca_op != 0u) {\n"
+"            float4 c;\n"
+"            VS_SRC(c, src2, ((d0 >> 23) & 1u) != 0u);\n"
+"            float4 vv = (float4)0;\n"
+"            bool handled = true;\n"
+"            [forcecase] switch (sca_op) {\n"
+"            case 0x01u: vv = c; break;\n"
+"            case 0x02u: vv = (float4)(1.0 / (c).x); break;\n"
+"            case 0x03u: vv = (float4)clamp(1.0 / (c).x, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e19); break;\n"
+"            case 0x04u: vv = (float4)rsqrt(max(abs((c).x), 1e-10)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x05u: vv = (float4)exp2((c).x); break;\n"
+"            case 0x06u: vv = (float4)log2(max(abs((c).x), 1e-10)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x0Du: vv = (float4)log2(max(abs((c).x), 1e-10)); break;\n"
+"            case 0x0Eu: vv = (float4)exp2((c).x); break;\n"
+"            case 0x0Fu: vv = (float4)sin((c).x); break;\n"
+"            case 0x10u: vv = (float4)cos((c).x); break;\n"
+"            case 0x07u: vv = float4(1.0, max((c).x, 0.0), ((c).x > 0.0) ?\n"
+"                                    exp2(clamp((c).w, -127.996, 127.996) * log2(max((c).y, 1e-10))) : 0.0, 1.0); break;\n"
+"            default: handled = false; break;\n"
+"            }\n"
+"            if (handled) {\n"
+"                if (sat) vv = saturate(vv);\n"
+"                if (!vec_result && dst_out != 0x1Fu) { float4 d = O[dst_out & 15u]; VS_STORE(d, sm); O[dst_out & 15u] = d; }\n"
+"                if (sca_dst_tmp != 0x3Fu) { float4 d = R[sca_dst_tmp & 31u]; VS_STORE(d, sm); R[sca_dst_tmp & 31u] = d; }\n"
+"            }\n"
+"        }\n"
+"        // ---- flow (X.x: the target, already made relative; X.y: a BRB / CLB taken) ----\n"
+"        if (X.z != 0u) {\n"
+"            bool cnd = true;\n"
+"            if (cond == 0u) cnd = false;\n"
+"            else if (cond != 7u) cnd = vs_test(vs_c(CC[sel], cswz.x), cond);\n"
+"            const int tgt = (int)X.x;\n"
+"            if (sca_op == 0x09u || sca_op == 0x08u) pc = cnd ? tgt : next;\n"
+"            else if (sca_op == 0x0Au || sca_op == 0x0Bu) {\n"
+"                if (cnd) { CS[csp] = (uint)next; csp = min(csp + 1u, 7u); pc = tgt; } else pc = next;\n"
+"            } else if (sca_op == 0x0Cu) {\n"
+"                if (cnd) { if (csp > 0u) { csp--; pc = (int)CS[csp]; } else pc = -1; } else pc = next;\n"
+"            } else {\n"
+"                if (X.y == 0u) pc = next;\n"
+"                else if (sca_op == 0x11u) pc = tgt;\n"
+"                else { CS[csp] = (uint)next; csp = min(csp + 1u, 7u); pc = tgt; }\n"
+"            }\n"
+"        }\n"
+"    }\n"
+"    VSOutput Out;\n"
+"    float4 _p = O[0];\n"
+"    Out.pos = float4(_p.xyz * vp_posscale.xyz + _p.w * vp_posoffset.xyz, _p.w);\n"
+"#if SI_MV\n"
+"    Out.mvp = float4(dot(_p, vp_mv[0]), dot(_p, vp_mv[1]), dot(_p, vp_mv[2]), 0.0); Out.mvj = vp_mvjit;\n"
+"#endif\n"
+"    Out.col0 = O[1]; Out.col1 = O[2]; Out.fog = O[5].xxxx;\n"
+"    Out.t0 = O[7];  Out.t1 = O[8];  Out.t2 = O[9];  Out.t3 = O[10];\n"
+"    Out.t4 = O[11]; Out.t5 = O[12]; Out.t6 = O[13]; Out.t7 = O[14];\n"
+"    Out.t8 = O[15]; Out.t9 = O[6];\n"
+"    return Out;\n"
+"}\n"
+"\n"
+;

+/*
+ * [standin] See rsx_standin.h. The encoder walks a fragment program exactly as rsx_fp_decompile_internal does
+ * (the same constant-slot rule, the same block opening and closing), so the pixel shader in
+ * rsx_standin_fp.hlsl does per instruction what the translated text does, in the same order.
+ */
+#include <stdio.h>
+#include <stdlib.h>
+#include <string.h>
+#include "rsx_standin.h"
+#include "rsx_standin_fp_hlsl.h"
+#include "rsx_standin_vp_hlsl.h"
+#include "rsx_vp_decompiler.h"
+
+const char* rsx_si_reason_name(u32 reason)
+{
+    switch (reason) {
+    case RSX_SI_R_PROGRAM:    return "program not walkable";
+    case RSX_SI_R_FLOW:       return "flow control too deep";
+    case RSX_SI_R_TARGETS:    return "several targets or depth export";
+    case RSX_SI_R_SHADOW:     return "depth comparison layout";
+    case RSX_SI_R_RESOLVE:    return "one-tap resolve";
+    case RSX_SI_R_OPCODE:     return "fetch kind";
+    case RSX_SI_R_UNBUFFERED: return "constants in the text";
+    case RSX_SI_R_DERIV:      return "derivatives";
+    case RSX_SI_R_INPUTS:     return "inputs outside the vertex layout";
+    default:                  return "none";
+    }
+}
+
+static u32 si_word(const u8* p)
+{
+    const u32 be = ((u32)p[0] << 24) | ((u32)p[1] << 16) | ((u32)p[2] << 8) | (u32)p[3];
+    return (be << 16) | (be >> 16);
+}
+
+/* How many of the three sources the translation of an opcode reads (rsx_fp_decompile_internal's switch);
+ * 0 for what it leaves out (no destination written either). */
+static u32 si_sources(u32 op)
+{
+    switch (op) {
+    case 0x01: case 0x10: case 0x11: case 0x13: case 0x14: case 0x1A: case 0x1B: case 0x1C: case 0x1D:
+    case 0x22: case 0x23: case 0x24: case 0x25: case 0x27: case 0x28: case 0x29: case 0x2A: case 0x2C: case 0x2D:
+    case 0x39: case 0x3C: case 0x17: case 0x18:
+        return 1;
+    case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x05: case 0x06: case 0x08: case 0x09: case 0x0A: case 0x0B: case 0x0C: case 0x0D:
+    case 0x0E: case 0x0F: case 0x26: case 0x3A: case 0x3B: case 0x38: case 0x2F: case 0x31:
+        return 2;
+    case 0x04: case 0x1F:
+        return 3;
+    default:
+        return 0;
+    }
+}
+
+enum { SI_K_INSTR = 0, SI_K_IF = 1, SI_K_ELSE = 2, SI_K_ENDIF = 3, SI_K_LOOP = 4, SI_K_ENDLOOP = 5, SI_K_BRK = 6 };
+
+static rsx_si_op* si_emit(rsx_si_prog* p, u32 kind, const u32 w[4])
+{
+    if (p->n_ops >= RSX_SI_MAX_OPS) { p->refused = RSX_SI_R_PROGRAM; return NULL; }
+    rsx_si_op* o = &p->ops[p->n_ops++];
+    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
+    if (w) memcpy(o->w, w, sizeof o->w);
+    o->x[0] = kind;
+    return o;
+}
+
+int rsx_si_encode(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, rsx_si_prog* p)
+{
+    p->n_ops = p->n_slots = p->n_regs = p->uses_units = p->refused = 0;
+    if (!ucode) { p->refused = RSX_SI_R_PROGRAM; return -1; }
+    enum { MAXB = 32 };
+    u32 b_else[MAXB], b_end[MAXB], b_op[MAXB], b_else_op[MAXB];
+    int b_loop[MAXB];
+    int n_blk = 0, loops_open = 0, ended = 0;
+    u32 off = 0, slot = 0, max_reg = 0;
+    while (off + 16 <= max_bytes && !p->refused) {
+        /* Close blocks ending here, innermost first, then open an else (the decompiler's order). */
+        while (n_blk > 0 && b_end[n_blk - 1] == off) {
+            --n_blk;
+            rsx_si_op* e = si_emit(p, b_loop[n_blk] ? SI_K_ENDLOOP : SI_K_ENDIF, NULL);
+            if (!e) break;
+            const u32 at = p->n_ops;                       /* the op after the end */
+            if (b_loop[n_blk]) { e->x[1] = b_op[n_blk] + 1u; p->ops[b_op[n_blk]].x[1] = at; loops_open--; }
+            else {
+                if (b_else_op[n_blk] != ~0u) p->ops[b_else_op[n_blk]].x[1] = at;
+                else p->ops[b_op[n_blk]].x[1] = at;
+            }
+        }
+        if (p->refused) break;
+        if (n_blk > 0 && b_else[n_blk - 1] == off) {
+            rsx_si_op* e = si_emit(p, SI_K_ELSE, NULL);
+            if (!e) break;
+            b_else_op[n_blk - 1] = p->n_ops - 1u;
+            p->ops[b_op[n_blk - 1]].x[1] = p->n_ops;       /* false: into the else part */
+            b_else[n_blk - 1] = 0;
+        }
+        u32 w[4];
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; i++) w[i] = si_word(ucode + off + 4u * i);
+        off += 16;
+        const int has_k = (w[1] & 3u) == 2u || (w[2] & 3u) == 2u || (w[3] & 3u) == 2u;
+        if (has_k && off + 16 <= max_bytes) off += 16;
+        const u32 my_slot = slot;
+        if (has_k) slot++;
+        const u32 opcode = (w[0] >> 24) & 63u;
+        if (w[2] >> 31) {                                   /* flow control */
+            const u32 end_at = (w[3] & 0x7FFFFFFFu) << 2;
+            if (opcode == 0x02u || opcode == 0x03u || opcode == 0x04u) {
+                if (!(n_blk == MAXB || end_at <= off)) {
+                    rsx_si_op* o = si_emit(p, opcode == 0x02u ? SI_K_IF : SI_K_LOOP, w);
+                    if (!o) break;
+                    if (opcode == 0x02u) {
+                        const u32 else_at = (w[2] & 0x7FFFFFFFu) << 2;
+                        b_else[n_blk] = else_at != end_at ? else_at : 0;
+                        b_loop[n_blk] = 0;
+                    } else {
+                        const u32 end_n = (w[2] >> 2) & 0xFFu, init = (w[2] >> 10) & 0xFFu, inc = (w[2] >> 19) & 0xFFu;
+                        o->x[2] = init | (end_n << 8) | ((inc ? inc : 1u) << 16);
+                        b_else[n_blk] = 0;
+                        b_loop[n_blk] = 1;
+                        loops_open++;
+                        if (loops_open > 4) p->refused = RSX_SI_R_FLOW;
+                    }
+                    b_end[n_blk] = end_at;
+                    b_op[n_blk] = p->n_ops - 1u;
+                    b_else_op[n_blk] = ~0u;
+                    n_blk++;
+                }
+            } else if (opcode == 0x00u && loops_open) {
+                if (!si_emit(p, SI_K_BRK, w)) break;
+            }
+            if (w[0] & 1u) { ended = 1; break; }
+            continue;
+        }
+        if (opcode == 0x15u || opcode == 0x16u) p->refused = RSX_SI_R_DERIV;
+        rsx_si_op* o = si_emit(p, SI_K_INSTR, w);
+        if (!o) break;
+        o->x[1] = my_slot;
+        o->x[2] = si_sources(opcode);                     /* the sources the shader reads */
+        o->x[3] = has_k ? 1u : 0u;
+        /* registers the text names: the TEMP sources the opcode reads, and the destination when written */
+        { const u32 n_src = si_sources(opcode);
+          for (u32 s = 1; s <= n_src; s++)
+              if ((w[s] & 3u) == 0u) { const u32 r = (w[s] >> 2) & 63u; if (r > max_reg) max_reg = r; }
+          if (n_src && !(w[0] & (1u << 30))) { const u32 r = (w[0] >> 1) & 63u; if (r > max_reg) max_reg = r; } }
+        if (opcode == 0x17u || opcode == 0x18u || opcode == 0x2Fu || opcode == 0x31u || opcode == 0x19u ||
+            opcode == 0x33u || opcode == 0x34u)
+            p->uses_units |= 1u << ((w[0] >> 17) & 15u);
+        if (w[0] & 1u) { ended = 1; break; }
+    }
+    if (!p->refused && !ended) p->refused = RSX_SI_R_PROGRAM;   /* no END: the buffered translation fails too */
+    if (!p->refused && max_reg >= 48u) p->refused = RSX_SI_R_PROGRAM;
+    while (!p->refused && n_blk > 0) {                         /* a block that never saw its end closes at END */
+        --n_blk;
+        rsx_si_op* e = si_emit(p, b_loop[n_blk] ? SI_K_ENDLOOP : SI_K_ENDIF, NULL);
+        if (!e) break;
+        const u32 at = p->n_ops;
+        if (b_loop[n_blk]) { e->x[1] = b_op[n_blk] + 1u; p->ops[b_op[n_blk]].x[1] = at; }
+        else if (b_else_op[n_blk] != ~0u) p->ops[b_else_op[n_blk]].x[1] = at;
+        else p->ops[b_op[n_blk]].x[1] = at;
+    }
+    p->n_slots = slot;
+    p->n_regs = max_reg + 1u;
+    if (!p->refused && RSX_SI_HEAD_ROWS + p->n_slots + 2u * p->n_ops > RSX_SI_BLOCK_ROWS) p->refused = RSX_SI_R_PROGRAM;
+    return p->refused ? -1 : (int)p->n_ops;
+}
+
+/* A float as the translated text spells it ("%.9g" of the double) and fxc reads it back. */
+static u32 si_literal(double v)
+{
+    char t[48];
+    snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%.9g", v);
+    const float f = strtof(t, NULL);
+    u32 u; memcpy(&u, &f, 4);
+    return u;
+}
+
+u32 rsx_si_desc_check(const rsx_si_prog* p, const rsx_si_desc* d, rsx_si_state* s)
+{
+    memset(s, 0, sizeof *s);
+    if (p->refused) return p->refused;
+    if (d->fp_ctrl == RSX_FP_CTRL_AUTO || (d->fp_ctrl & 0xEu) || (d->rt_count & 0xFFu) > 1u) return RSX_SI_R_TARGETS;
+    if (d->upres) return RSX_SI_R_RESOLVE;
+    /* What the decompiler refuses outright (the real pipeline then fails too: nothing to stand in for). */
+    for (u32 u = 0; u < 16; u++) {
+        if (!(p->uses_units & (1u << u))) continue;
+        const rsx_fp_shadow_desc* sd = d->shadow ? &d->shadow[u] : NULL;
+        if (sd && sd->enabled &&
+            (sd->enabled != 1 || sd->func > 7 || sd->linear > 1 || sd->unnormalized > 1 || sd->soft > 1 ||
+             (sd->scale != 0 && sd->scale != 1 && sd->scale != 2 && sd->scale != 4) ||
+             ((d->cube_mask | d->vol_mask) & (1u << u))))
+            return RSX_SI_R_SHADOW;
+    }
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < p->n_ops; i++) {
+        const rsx_si_op* o = &p->ops[i];
+        if (o->x[0] != 0u) continue;
+        const u32 op = (o->w[0] >> 24) & 63u, unit = (o->w[0] >> 17) & 15u;
+        const int fetch_other = op == 0x19u || op == 0x33u || op == 0x34u;
+        if (d->shadow && d->shadow[unit].enabled && (op == 0x31u || op == 0x2Fu || fetch_other)) return RSX_SI_R_SHADOW;
+        if (d->gamma && d->gamma[unit] && !(o->w[0] & (1u << 21)) && fetch_other) return RSX_SI_R_OPCODE;
+    }
+    u32 f = 0;
+    if (!(d->fp_ctrl & 0x40u)) f |= 1u;
+    if (d->srgb_output) f |= 2u;
+    if (d->wpos_mode == 1u && (d->wpos_x > 1u || d->wpos_y > 1u)) f |= 4u;
+    else if (d->wpos_mode == 2u) f |= 8u;
+    if (d->alpha_test && d->alpha_func >= 0x200u && d->alpha_func <= 0x206u)
+        f |= 16u | ((d->alpha_func - 0x200u) << 5);
+    s->flags = f;
+    s->wpos[0] = d->wpos_x ? d->wpos_x : 1u;
+    s->wpos[1] = d->wpos_y ? d->wpos_y : 1u;
+    for (u32 u = 0; u < 16; u++) {
+        u32 x = 0;
+        const int cube = (d->cube_mask >> u) & 1u, vol = !cube && ((d->vol_mask >> u) & 1u);
+        if (d->gamma) x |= d->gamma[u] & 15u;
+        if (d->expand) x |= (u32)(d->expand[u] & 31u) << 4;
+        if (d->shadow && d->shadow[u].enabled && (p->uses_units & (1u << u))) {
+            const rsx_fp_shadow_desc* sd = &d->shadow[u];
+            x |= 1u << 9 | (u32)(sd->func & 7u) << 10 | (u32)(sd->linear & 1u) << 13 |
+                 (u32)(sd->unnormalized & 1u) << 14 | (u32)(sd->soft & 1u) << 15 | (u32)(sd->scale & 7u) << 16;
+        }
+        if (cube) x |= 1u << 20;
+        if (vol) x |= 1u << 21;
+        /* rsx_fp_apply_unnorm_scale: TEX / TXP of a texel-addressed 2D or 3D unit, not a comparison */
+        const u32 w = d->unnorm_dim[u][0], h = d->unnorm_dim[u][1], dd = d->unnorm_dim[u][2];
+        if (((d->unnorm_mask >> u) & 1u) && !cube && w && h && (!vol || dd) && !(x & (1u << 9))) {
+            x |= 1u << 19;
+            s->unit[u][1] = si_literal(1.0 / (double)w);
+            s->unit[u][2] = si_literal(1.0 / (double)h);
+            if (vol) s->unit[u][3] = si_literal(1.0 / (double)dd);
+        }
+        s->unit[u][0] = x;
+    }
+    return 0;
+}
+
+u32 rsx_si_block_rows(u32 n_slots, u32 n_ops)
+{
+    return RSX_SI_HEAD_ROWS + n_slots + 2u * n_ops;
+}
+
+void rsx_si_block_write(void* dst, u32 n_slots, u32 n_regs, u32 n_ops, const rsx_si_op* ops, const rsx_si_state* s,
+                        const u32 (*constants)[4], u32 n_constants, const float fp_alpha[4])
+{
+    u32 (*k)[4] = (u32 (*)[4])dst;
+    k[0][0] = n_slots; k[0][1] = s->flags; k[0][2] = n_ops; k[0][3] = 2u * n_regs;
+    memcpy(k[1], fp_alpha, 16);
+    k[2][0] = s->wpos[0]; k[2][1] = s->wpos[1]; k[2][2] = 0; k[2][3] = 0;
+    memcpy(k[3], s->unit, sizeof s->unit);
+    u32 (*kc)[4] = k + RSX_SI_HEAD_ROWS;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < n_slots; i++) {
+        if (constants && i < n_constants) memcpy(kc[i], constants[i], 16);
+        else memset(kc[i], 0, 16);
+    }
+    memcpy(kc + n_slots, ops, (size_t)n_ops * sizeof(rsx_si_op));
+}
+
+u64 rsx_si_variant_of(const rsx_si_desc* d)
+{
+    u64 v = 0;
+    for (u32 u = 0; u < 16; u++) {
+        if ((d->cube_mask >> u) & 1u) v |= 1ull << (2u * u);
+        else if ((d->vol_mask >> u) & 1u) v |= 2ull << (2u * u);
+    }
+    if (d->mv) v |= 1ull << 32;
+    if (d->shadow)   /* the depth comparison's code only in the variants that need it (it costs every pixel) */
+        for (u32 u = 0; u < 16; u++) if (d->shadow[u].enabled) { v |= 1ull << 33; break; }
+    return v;
+}
+
+u32 rsx_si_variant_source(u64 variant, char* out, u32 cap)
+{
+    u32 n = 0;
+    char line[64];
+    for (u32 u = 0; u < 16; u++) {
+        const u32 kind = (u32)(variant >> (2u * u)) & 3u;
+        if (!kind) continue;
+        const int m = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "#define SI_K%u %u\n", u, kind);
+        if (m < 0 || n + (u32)m + 1u > cap) return 0;
+        memcpy(out + n, line, (size_t)m); n += (u32)m;
+    }
+    if ((variant >> 33) & 1u) {
+        static const char sh[] = "#define SI_SHADOW 1\n";
+        if (n + sizeof sh > cap) return 0;
+        memcpy(out + n, sh, sizeof sh - 1); n += (u32)(sizeof sh - 1);
+    }
+    if ((variant >> 32) & 1u) {
+        static const char mv[] = "#define SI_MV 1\n";
+        if (n + sizeof mv > cap) return 0;
+        memcpy(out + n, mv, sizeof mv - 1); n += (u32)(sizeof mv - 1);
+    }
+    const u32 len = (u32)(sizeof k_rsx_si_fp_hlsl - 1);
+    if (n + len + 1u > cap) return 0;
+    memcpy(out + n, k_rsx_si_fp_hlsl, len);
+    n += len;
+    out[n] = '\0';
+    return n;
+}
+
+/* ---- [standin2] the vertex side ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
+static u32 si_le(const u8* p) { return (u32)p[0] | ((u32)p[1] << 8) | ((u32)p[2] << 16) | ((u32)p[3] << 24); }
+static int si_vp_flow(u32 sca_op)
+{
+    return sca_op == 0x08 || sca_op == 0x09 || sca_op == 0x0A || sca_op == 0x0B ||
+           sca_op == 0x0C || sca_op == 0x11 || sca_op == 0x12;
+}
+
+u32 rsx_si_vp_encode(const u8* words, u32 bytes, u32 vp_start, u32 branch_bits, u32 vtex_mask,
+                     int compact, u32 layout_mask, rsx_si_vprog* p)
+{
+    p->n_ops = 0; p->present = 0xFFFFu; p->vtex = vtex_mask & 15u; p->refused = 0;
+    if (!words) return p->refused = RSX_SI_R_PROGRAM;
+    /* the inputs exactly as rsx_vp_decompile_compact_ex chooses them */
+    if (compact) {
+        rsx_vp_input_analysis an;
+        if (rsx_vp_analyze_inputs(words, bytes, &an) < 0 || !an.exact || (an.input_mask & ~(layout_mask & 0xFFFFu)) != 0)
+            p->present = 0xFFFFu;
+        else
+            p->present = an.input_mask;
+        if (p->present & ~(layout_mask & 0xFFFFu)) return p->refused = RSX_SI_R_INPUTS;
+    }
+    for (u32 off = 0; off + 16 <= bytes && p->n_ops < RSX_SI_MAX_VP_OPS; off += 16) {
+        rsx_si_op* o = &p->ops[p->n_ops++];
+        memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; i++) o->w[i] = si_le(words + off + 4u * i);
+        const u32 d0 = o->w[0], d2 = o->w[2], d3 = o->w[3];
+        const u32 sca_op = (o->w[1] >> 27) & 0x1Fu;
+        if (si_vp_flow(sca_op)) {
+            /* the decompiler's vp_branch_target, made relative to the program's start slot */
+            const u32 t = (((d0 >> 23) & 1u) << 9) | ((d2 & 0x3Fu) << 3) | ((d3 >> 29) & 7u);
+            o->x[0] = t >= vp_start ? t - vp_start : t;
+            o->x[1] = ((branch_bits >> ((d3 >> 23) & 0x1Fu)) & 1u) == ((d3 >> 28) & 1u);   /* BRB / CLB taken */
+            o->x[2] = 1u;
+        }
+        if (d3 & 1u) break;
+    }
+    return 0;
+}
+
+u32 rsx_si_vp_block_rows(u32 n_ops) { return 1u + 2u * n_ops; }
+
+void rsx_si_vp_block_write(void* block, u32 at, u32 n_ops, u32 present, u32 vtex, const rsx_si_op* ops)
+{
+    u32 (*k)[4] = (u32 (*)[4])block;
+    k[2][2] = at;
+    k[at][0] = n_ops; k[at][1] = present; k[at][2] = vtex; k[at][3] = 0;
+    memcpy(k + at + 1, ops, (size_t)n_ops * sizeof(rsx_si_op));
+}
+
+u32 rsx_si_vp_source(int mv, char* out, u32 cap)
+{
+    static const char def[] = "#define SI_MV 1\n";
+    u32 n = 0;
+    if (mv) { if (sizeof def > cap) return 0; memcpy(out, def, sizeof def - 1); n = (u32)(sizeof def - 1); }
+    const u32 len = (u32)(sizeof k_rsx_si_vp_hlsl - 1);
+    if (n + len + 1u > cap) return 0;
+    memcpy(out + n, k_rsx_si_vp_hlsl, len);
+    n += len;
+    out[n] = '\0';
+    return n;
+}
+
+/* [standin4] The pixel shader variants of the stand-in met on this PC's recorded pipelines (14,994 records of
+ * menus, car select and races; 44 variants: texture unit kinds x motion vectors x depth comparison), commonest
+ * first (the first, all units 2D, is 63 % of them). gt5.exe --prepare-shaders compiles all of them (and both vertex
+ * variants) even on a PC with no records, and the game compiles any the cache lacks at start, in this order. */
+static const u64 k_si_builtin[] = {
+    0x0000000000ull, 0x0200000000ull, 0x0210400000ull, 0x0200400000ull, 0x0010400000ull, 0x0000400000ull,
+    0x0010000000ull, 0x0210000000ull, 0x0010000010ull, 0x0100000000ull, 0x0000000004ull, 0x0210000010ull,
+    0x0000000010ull, 0x0010000004ull, 0x0210000040ull, 0x0000000001ull, 0x0200400028ull, 0x00000008a2ull,
+    0x0200000040ull, 0x0210400028ull, 0x0000000040ull, 0x0300400000ull, 0x0300000000ull, 0x0200000010ull,
+    0x0000400028ull, 0x0210000028ull, 0x0310400000ull, 0x0000000050ull, 0x0200000100ull, 0x0210000004ull,
+    0x0100400000ull, 0x0010000001ull, 0x0210000100ull, 0x0200000004ull, 0x0200000028ull, 0x0210000001ull,
+    0x0110000000ull, 0x0110000004ull, 0x0110400000ull, 0x0000000100ull, 0x0210400004ull, 0x0100000050ull,
+    0x0300000010ull, 0x0010000040ull,
+};
+u32 rsx_si_builtin_variants(const u64** out)
+{
+    *out = k_si_builtin;
+    return (u32)(sizeof k_si_builtin / sizeof k_si_builtin[0]);
+}

+/*
+ * [standin] A stand-in for a draw whose own pipeline is still being made: the draw's own vertex shader with
+ * one general pixel shader that runs the RSX fragment program from its words (rsx_standin_fp.hlsl), as
+ * rsx_fp_decompiler.c translates it. Pure C, no graphics API: rsx_live_draw.c makes the pipelines.
+ *
+ *  - rsx_si_encode: the program as the decompiler walks it, turned into micro-ops (its instructions, and its
+ *    IFE / LOOP / REP / BRK blocks exactly where the decompiler opens and closes them).
+ *  - rsx_si_desc_check: everything else that shapes the translated text (units, gamma, sign expansion, depth
+ *    comparison, texel sizes, sRGB, alpha test, WPOS edits, motion vectors), honoured or refused with a reason.
+ *  - rsx_si_block_*: the per-draw block the pixel shader reads at b1 (header, fp_alpha, unit descriptors, the
+ *    inline constants, the micro-ops).
+ *  - rsx_si_variant_source: the shader text for a variant (the kind of each texture unit, motion vectors).
+ */
+#ifndef PS3RECOMP_RSX_STANDIN_H
+#define PS3RECOMP_RSX_STANDIN_H
+
+#include "ps3emu/ps3types.h"
+#include "rsx_fp_decompiler.h"
+
+#ifdef __cplusplus
+extern "C" {
+#endif
+
+#define RSX_SI_MAX_OPS     1536u     /* micro-ops a program may have: the block must fit b1's 4096 rows */
+#define RSX_SI_BLOCK_ROWS  4096u
+#define RSX_SI_HEAD_ROWS   19u       /* header, fp_alpha, WPOS divisor, 16 unit descriptors */
+
+/* Why a draw cannot be drawn by the stand-in (it is then left out or waited for, as without it). */
+enum {
+    RSX_SI_OK = 0,
+    RSX_SI_R_PROGRAM,        /* the program could not be walked (no end, too long, a register past 47) */
+    RSX_SI_R_FLOW,           /* flow control the interpreter does not nest (more than 4 open loops) */
+    RSX_SI_R_TARGETS,        /* several colour targets or a depth export */
+    RSX_SI_R_SHADOW,         /* a depth comparison the translation itself refuses */
+    RSX_SI_R_RESOLVE,        /* the upscaler's one-tap resolve edit */
+    RSX_SI_R_OPCODE,         /* a fetch the translation refuses (gamma on TXD / TEXBEM) */
+    RSX_SI_R_UNBUFFERED,     /* inline constants written into the text (LD constants not buffered) */
+    RSX_SI_R_DERIV,          /* DDX / DDY: the translation leaves them out, and divides by the zeros that leaves
+                              * where fxc folds the division and the GPU does not: no stand-in can match that */
+    RSX_SI_R_INPUTS,         /* [standin2] the vertex program reads inputs the vertex layout does not have */
+    RSX_SI_R_N
+};
+const char* rsx_si_reason_name(u32 reason);
+
+typedef struct { u32 w[4]; u32 x[4]; } rsx_si_op;   /* the instruction's words; kind, slot / jump, loop, flags */
+typedef struct {
+    u32 n_ops, n_slots, n_regs;      /* micro-ops; inline constant slots (the decompiler's count); registers */
+    u32 uses_units;                  /* units a TEX / TXP / TXB / TXL reads */
+    u32 refused;                     /* RSX_SI_R_*, 0 when it can run */
+    rsx_si_op ops[RSX_SI_MAX_OPS];
+} rsx_si_prog;
+int rsx_si_encode(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, rsx_si_prog* out);
+
+/* The rest of the translation's inputs, as get_pso has them. */
+typedef struct {
+    u32 fp_ctrl;
+    u32 cube_mask, vol_mask;
+    const rsx_fp_shadow_desc* shadow;    /* NULL: none */
+    const u8* gamma;                     /* 16, or NULL */
+    const u8* expand;                    /* 16, or NULL (the decompiler is given NULL with no expand unit) */
+    u32 unnorm_mask;
+    u32 unnorm_dim[16][3];
+    u32 srgb_output;
+    u32 alpha_test, alpha_func;
+    u32 wpos_mode, wpos_x, wpos_y;       /* 0 none, 1 the AA grid, 2 the render-scale line */
+    u32 mv, upres, rt_count;
+} rsx_si_desc;
+/* The descriptor rows (k[0].y flags and the 16 unit rows) for a program; 0 or a reason. */
+typedef struct { u32 flags; u32 wpos[2]; u32 unit[16][4]; } rsx_si_state;
+u32 rsx_si_desc_check(const rsx_si_prog* p, const rsx_si_desc* d, rsx_si_state* out);
+
+/* Rows of b1 the stand-in reads for a program of n_slots constant slots and n_ops micro-ops. */
+u32 rsx_si_block_rows(u32 n_slots, u32 n_ops);
+/* Writes them (16 bytes a row). constants: the draw's inline constants as the decompiler numbers them
+ * (missing rows are zero); fp_alpha: the draw's fp_alpha row. */
+void rsx_si_block_write(void* dst, u32 n_slots, u32 n_regs, u32 n_ops, const rsx_si_op* ops, const rsx_si_state* s,
+                        const u32 (*constants)[4], u32 n_constants, const float fp_alpha[4]);
+
+/* Variant = the kind of each texture unit (2 bits: 0 2D, 1 cube, 2 3D) | motion vectors << 32 | a depth
+ * comparison unit << 33. The shader
+ * text for it: the defines, then the shader. Returns its length, 0 when it does not fit. */
+u64 rsx_si_variant_of(const rsx_si_desc* d);
+u32 rsx_si_variant_source(u64 variant, char* out, u32 cap);
+
+/* ---- [standin2] the vertex side: a vertex program run from its words (rsx_standin_vp.hlsl), for a pipeline whose
+ * own vertex shader is not compiled: its stand-in then needs no compile at all, and one pipeline serves every
+ * new pipeline of the same render state and vertex layout. */
+#define RSX_SI_MAX_VP_OPS 544u
+typedef struct {
+    u32 n_ops;
+    u32 present;                     /* the inputs the translated shader reads (others are 0,0,0,1) */
+    u32 vtex;                        /* vertex texture units bound */
+    u32 refused;
+    rsx_si_op ops[RSX_SI_MAX_VP_OPS];
+} rsx_si_vprog;
+/* words: the transform program as the decompiler reads it; compact/layout_mask: as get_pso decompiles it
+ * (rsx_vp_decompile_compact_ex with the layout's mask, or rsx_vp_decompile_ex). 0 or a reason. */
+u32 rsx_si_vp_encode(const u8* words, u32 bytes, u32 vp_start, u32 branch_bits, u32 vtex_mask,
+                     int compact, u32 layout_mask, rsx_si_vprog* out);
+u32 rsx_si_vp_block_rows(u32 n_ops);
+/* Appends the vertex part at row `at` of a block rsx_si_block_write wrote (and points its header at it). */
+void rsx_si_vp_block_write(void* block, u32 at, u32 n_ops, u32 present, u32 vtex, const rsx_si_op* ops);
+/* The vertex shader text: mv = the motion-vector variant. Returns its length, 0 when it does not fit. */
+u32 rsx_si_vp_source(int mv, char* out, u32 cap);
+/* [standin4] The built-in list of pixel variants (commonest first): their count, *out the list. */
+u32 rsx_si_builtin_variants(const u64** out);
+
+#ifdef __cplusplus
+}
+#endif
+#endif

+/*
+ * [standin] DirectX 12 side of the stand-in (rsx_standin.c, rsx_standin_fp.hlsl, rsx_standin_vp.hlsl). #included by
+ * rsx_live_draw.c after the compile pool's code (.inc: every .c in libs/video is built on its own).
+ *
+ * With "Asynchronous shader loading" on, a draw whose pipeline is still being made was left out (or, for draws
+ * other draws read, waited for). Now such a draw is drawn by a stand-in: one general vertex shader that runs the
+ * RSX vertex program from its words and one general pixel shader that runs the fragment program from its words,
+ * both as rsx_vp/fp_decompiler.c translate them, with the draw's own render state and vertex layout.
+ * [standin2] Since both shaders are general, the stand-in pipeline depends only on the render state, the vertex
+ * layout and the shaders' variants (texture unit kinds, motion vectors, depth comparison), not on the programs: one
+ * pipeline serves every new pipeline of that state, made once (about 1 ms of the driver, on the pool's fast queue)
+ * and kept; a new pipeline needs NO compile at all to have its stand-in. Round 1 used the draw's own vertex shader,
+ * which needed the vertex shader compiled first and a pipeline of its own for every new pipeline (36 ms each in the
+ * driver with a vertex shader new to it, on the same pool threads as the real compiles: more left out, for longer).
+ * A depth-EQUAL pass keeps that per-pipeline form when its own vertex shader is compiled (positions then bit for bit
+ * the real ones; the general one matches them bit for bit in 92 % of the recorded programs and within one ulp in
+ * the rest, which is fine everywhere but against an equal-depth test), and is left out otherwise.
+ * The walker writes, for each draw, the programs and their translation inputs after the draw's own pixel constants
+ * (256-aligned, same ring allocation); the recording thread points b1 (visible to both stages) at that block for the
+ * one draw it draws with the stand-in. Draws that wait keep waiting (LD_STANDIN_PRODUCERS=1: the stand-in takes
+ * those too). What the stand-in cannot do exactly is refused, counted by reason, and left to the old rule.
+ * Switches: LD_STANDIN=0 off (as before); LD_STANDIN_ALL=1 every draw the stand-in accepts is drawn with it, ready
+ * or not (picture check); LD_STANDIN_PRODUCERS=1 also the draws that wait; LD_STANDIN_MAX_OPS=<n> no stand-in for
+ * fragment programs longer than n (its pixel cost: about 0.06 ms per instruction per 1080p screen it covers).
+ */
+#include "rsx_standin.h"
+
+enum { LD_CT_SI = 3, LD_CT_SIP = 4 };
+/* Pipeline-level refusals beyond rsx_standin.h's (RSX_SI_R_*), and the draw-level one. */
+enum { LD_SIR_VSNEW = RSX_SI_R_N, LD_SIR_VARIANT, LD_SIR_DEBUG, LD_SIR_MEMORY, LD_SIR_FAILED, LD_SIR_NOTREADY, LD_SIR_LONG,
+       LD_SIR_EQUAL, LD_SIR_NOATTR, LD_SIR_N };
+static const char* ld_si_reason(u32 r)
+{
+    switch (r) {
+    case LD_SIR_VSNEW:    return "vertex shader not compiled";
+    case LD_SIR_VARIANT:  return "its shader not ready yet";
+    case LD_SIR_DEBUG:    return "debug edits";
+    case LD_SIR_MEMORY:   return "out of memory";
+    case LD_SIR_FAILED:   return "pipeline failed";
+    case LD_SIR_NOTREADY: return "stand-in not ready yet";
+    case LD_SIR_LONG:     return "program longer than LD_STANDIN_MAX_OPS";
+    case LD_SIR_EQUAL:    return "depth-equal pass, vertex shader new";
+    case LD_SIR_NOATTR:   return "no vertex attributes";
+    default:              return rsx_si_reason_name(r);
+    }
+}
+
+/* [standin2] A general stand-in pipeline: both shaders general, one per (render state, layout, variants). */
+typedef struct ld_sip {
+    ld_ctask task;                      /* LD_CT_SIP on the pool's fast queue */
+    volatile LONG done;                 /* made (pso set) or failed (pso NULL) */
+    ID3D12PipelineState* pso;
+    struct ld_sip* next_bg;             /* [standin3] in the stand-in thread's list (s_sibg_lock's) */
+    int ahead;                          /* made ahead from the records only: when the game's pool is idle */
+    u64 key;
+    u32 ps_var, vs_var;                 /* slots in s_si_var */
+    render_state_t rs;
+    u32 masked, count, packed;
+    u8 attrs[RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR];
+} ld_sip;
+/* One new pipeline's stand-in: its programs as micro-ops, and which pipeline draws it. */
+typedef struct ld_si {
+    ld_ctask task;                      /* LD_CT_SI: only for the own-vertex-shader form (depth-EQUAL passes) */
+    volatile LONG done;
+    ID3D12PipelineState* pso;           /* the own-vertex-shader form's pipeline */
+    ID3DBlob* vs;                       /* its own copy of the vertex shader, released once built */
+    ld_sip* gen;                        /* the general form's shared pipeline, or NULL */
+    u32 var;                            /* the pixel variant's slot */
+    render_state_t rs;
+    u32 masked, count, packed;
+    u8 attrs[RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR];
+    rsx_si_state st;
+    u32 n_ops, n_slots, n_regs, rows;   /* rows: the whole block (pixel part, then the vertex part) */
+    u32 vn_ops, vpresent, vtex, vat;    /* the vertex part: micro-ops, inputs read, vertex textures, its first row */
+    rsx_si_op* vops;                    /* vn_ops, after ops[] */
+    rsx_si_op ops[];                    /* n_ops, then the vertex micro-ops */
+} ld_si;
+
+static struct {
+    int on, all, producers, said;
+    u32 max_ops;
+    int started;
+    LONGLONG t0;                        /* when the base variants were asked for */
+    int ready_said;
+} s_si = { -1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 };
+/* Shader variants (stage 'P': unit kinds, motion vectors, depth comparison; 'V': motion vectors): the walker's
+ * table. Each is an ordinary shader to the pool and the shader cache (0.7-2 s of fxc once a PC, then read; the
+ * prepare step makes the ones this PC's records need before the game starts). */
+#define LD_SI_MAX_VAR 128u                     /* [standin4] the built-in list (44) and what records or draws add */
+/* [standin3] state: 0 not in the cache and no draw needs it yet, 1 to compile (a draw needs it), 2 ready, 3 failed,
+ * 4 being compiled, 5 [standin4] to compile ahead (the built-in list, the cache lacks it; below-normal priority).
+ * The walker makes a slot (looked up in the cache's memory only once its loader is done, so the shaders a former
+ * session compiled are found: round 2 asked while the folder's own files were still being listed and compiled them
+ * again at every start); the stand-in thread compiles, one at a time, never on the game's compile pool. */
+static struct { u64 v; u32 stage; volatile LONG state; ID3DBlob* volatile blob; char* src; u32 len; u64 hash; } s_si_var[LD_SI_MAX_VAR];
+static volatile LONG s_si_nvar;
+static volatile LONG s_si_warm[LD_SI_MAX_VAR][LD_SI_MAX_VAR];   /* the driver has made a pipeline of this pair */
+static SRWLOCK s_sibg_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
+static ld_sip* s_sibg_head;                                       /* pipelines for the stand-in thread */
+static HANDLE s_sibg_wake;
+static volatile LONG64 s_si_var_read, s_si_var_compiled, s_si_var_qpc, s_si_bg_made, s_si_bg_qpc, s_si_wait_qpc;
+static volatile LONG64 s_si_wait_real, s_si_wait_kept;   /* [standin5] must-wait draws left to the real pipeline */
+/* General pipelines by key (the walker's table; the objects live as long as the process). */
+#define LD_SIP_SLOTS 4096u
+static ld_sip* s_sip[LD_SIP_SLOTS];
+static u32 s_sip_n;
+/* What get_pso hands to the next ld_async_build (the walker's alone). */
+static struct {
+    int valid;
+    const u8* fp; u32 fp_size;
+    rsx_si_desc d;
+    const u8* vp; u32 vp_bytes, vp_start, vp_bits, vtex, compact, layout_mask;
+} s_si_in;
+/* The draw being recorded: its stand-in and where its block went in the pixel constants (0: none). */
+static ld_si* s_si_draw;
+static u32 s_si_draw_off;
+/* Counters for the [stutter] line. */
+static volatile LONG64 s_si_drawn, s_si_drawn_wait, s_si_refused[LD_SIR_N], s_si_made, s_si_made_qpc, s_si_psos, s_si_got;
+static volatile LONG64 s_si_bytes;
+
+static int ld_si_on(void)
+{
+    if (s_si.on < 0) {
+        const char* e = getenv("LD_STANDIN");
+        s_si.on = !(e && atoi(e) == 0);
+        e = getenv("LD_STANDIN_ALL");
+        s_si.all = s_si.on && e && atoi(e) != 0;
+        e = getenv("LD_STANDIN_PRODUCERS");
+        s_si.producers = s_si.on && !(e && *e && atoi(e) == 0);   /* [standin5] on by default; 0 = as before */
+        /* The stand-in costs about 0.06 ms per instruction of the program per 1080p screen it covers (this PC's
+         * RTX 4070 Ti SUPER; 300-instruction car materials 18-43 ms a full screen): a limit for slow GPUs / 4K. */
+        e = getenv("LD_STANDIN_MAX_OPS");
+        s_si.max_ops = e && atoi(e) > 0 ? (u32)atoi(e) : 0u;
+    }
+    return s_si.on;
+}
+
+/* The walker: a variant's slot, or -1. need: a draw's stand-in uses it (compiled if the cache lacks it); 0: only
+ * looked up (the records' made-ahead pipelines use only what the cache has). */
+static int ld_si_var_slot(u32 stage, u64 v, int need)
+{
+    const u32 nv = (u32)s_si_nvar;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < nv; i++)
+        if (s_si_var[i].v == v && s_si_var[i].stage == stage) {
+            if (need && (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_si_var[i].state, 1, 0) == 0 ||
+                         InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_si_var[i].state, 1, 5) == 5) && s_sibg_wake)
+                SetEvent(s_sibg_wake);           /* needed now: ahead of the built-in list's */
+            return (int)i;
+        }
+    if (nv >= LD_SI_MAX_VAR) return -1;
+    static char src[96 * 1024];
+    const u32 n = stage == 'V' ? rsx_si_vp_source((int)(v & 1u), src, sizeof src) : rsx_si_variant_source(v, src, sizeof src);
+    if (!n) return -1;
+    const u64 h = fnv1a(src, n, 1469598103934665603ull);
+    s_si_var[nv].v = v; s_si_var[nv].stage = stage; s_si_var[nv].len = n; s_si_var[nv].hash = h;
+    ID3DBlob* blob = shader_disk_cache_load(stage, src, n, h);   /* memory only: the loader is done */
+    if (blob) {
+        s_si_var[nv].blob = blob;                 /* the walker's reference, kept for the run */
+        s_si_var[nv].state = 2;
+        InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_var_read);
+    } else {
+        s_si_var[nv].src = (char*)malloc(n + 1u);
+        if (!s_si_var[nv].src) return -1;
+        memcpy(s_si_var[nv].src, src, n + 1u);
+        s_si_var[nv].state = need ? 1 : 0;
+    }
+    InterlockedExchange(&s_si_nvar, (LONG)nv + 1);   /* published: the stand-in thread may look at it now */
+    if (s_si_var[nv].state == 1 && s_sibg_wake) SetEvent(s_sibg_wake);
+    return (int)nv;
+}
+/* Any thread: the variant's compiled shader, or NULL. */
+static ID3DBlob* ld_si_var_blob(u32 slot)
+{
+    if (slot >= LD_SI_MAX_VAR || InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_si_var[slot].state, 0, 0) != 2) return NULL;
+    return s_si_var[slot].blob;
+}
+static int ld_si_var_failed(u32 slot)
+{
+    return slot >= LD_SI_MAX_VAR || InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_si_var[slot].state, 0, 0) == 3;
+}
+
+static void ld_si_prebuild(void);              /* rsx_shader_prep.inc */
+static ld_sip* ld_sip_get(const render_state_t* rs, const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* masked_layout, int packed_offsets,
+                          u32 ps_var, u32 vs_var, int ahead);
+static void ld_si_build(struct ld_si* any);
+/* [standin3] The stand-in's threads: two, never the game's compile pool. In this order: a variant a draw's
+ * stand-in needs (normal priority: a screen's few variants are the cheapest way to have everything on it), a
+ * draw's pipeline whose variant pair the driver has not made yet (its first one costs the driver 0.2-0.45 s: not
+ * on the game's pool); then, at below-normal priority and only while the game's pool has nothing queued or
+ * running, the records' made-ahead pipelines. A stand-in whose pipeline is not made yet is simply not ready (its
+ * draws are left out as without it): nothing waits for one. */
+static int ld_si_pool_idle(void)
+{
+    return !s_cpool_head && !s_cpool_hi_head && InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_cp_running, 0, 0) == 0;
+}
+/* One variant from state `from` (1 needed, 5 ahead): claimed, compiled, stored in the cache, published. */
+static int ld_si_bg_compile(LONG from, int priority)
+{
+    const u32 nv = (u32)InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_si_nvar, 0, 0);
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < nv; i++) {
+        if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_si_var[i].state, 4, from) != from) continue;   /* claimed: 4 = compiling */
+        SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), priority);
+        LARGE_INTEGER c0, c1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&c0);
+        ID3DBlob* blob = NULL; ID3DBlob* err = NULL;
+        const HRESULT hr = D3DCompile(s_si_var[i].src, s_si_var[i].len, s_si_var[i].stage == 'V' ? "xvs" : "xps", NULL,
+                                      NULL, "main", s_si_var[i].stage == 'V' ? "vs_5_0" : "ps_5_0", 0, 0, &blob, &err);
+        if (err) err->lpVtbl->Release(err);
+        if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && blob) {
+            shader_disk_cache_store(s_si_var[i].stage, s_si_var[i].src, s_si_var[i].len, s_si_var[i].hash, blob);
+            s_si_var[i].blob = blob;              /* this thread's reference, kept for the run */
+            InterlockedExchange(&s_si_var[i].state, 2);
+            InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_var_compiled);
+        } else {
+            if (blob) blob->lpVtbl->Release(blob);
+            InterlockedExchange(&s_si_var[i].state, 3);
+        }
+        QueryPerformanceCounter(&c1);
+        InterlockedAdd64(&s_si_var_qpc, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart);
+        InterlockedAdd64(&s_si_bg_qpc, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart);
+        return 1;
+    }
+    return 0;
+}
+/* One pipeline of the list whose variants are there (or failed): ahead 0 = a draw's, 1 = made ahead. */
+static int ld_si_bg_pipeline(int ahead)
+{
+    ld_sip* take = NULL;
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_sibg_lock);
+    for (ld_sip** pp = &s_sibg_head; *pp; pp = &(*pp)->next_bg) {
+        ld_sip* q = *pp;
+        if ((q->ahead != 0) != (ahead != 0)) continue;
+        const int failed = ld_si_var_failed(q->ps_var) || ld_si_var_failed(q->vs_var);
+        if (!failed && !(ld_si_var_blob(q->ps_var) && ld_si_var_blob(q->vs_var))) continue;
+        *pp = q->next_bg; q->next_bg = NULL; take = q;
+        break;
+    }
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_sibg_lock);
+    if (!take) return 0;
+    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), ahead ? THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL : THREAD_PRIORITY_NORMAL);
+    LARGE_INTEGER c0, c1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&c0);
+    ld_si_build((struct ld_si*)take);            /* fails cleanly (NULL pipeline) when a variant failed */
+    QueryPerformanceCounter(&c1);
+    InterlockedAdd64(&s_si_bg_qpc, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart);
+    InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_bg_made);
+    return 1;
+}
+static DWORD WINAPI ld_si_bg_main(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    { HRESULT (WINAPI *sd)(HANDLE, PCWSTR) = (HRESULT (WINAPI*)(HANDLE, PCWSTR))
+          (void*)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("kernel32.dll"), "SetThreadDescription");
+      if (sd) sd(GetCurrentThread(), L"rsx stand-in"); }
+    for (;;) {
+        WaitForSingleObject(s_sibg_wake, 50);
+        /* One item at a time, each time the most urgent: a variant a draw needs, a draw's pipeline whose pair the
+         * driver has not made yet, [standin4] a variant of the built-in list the cache lacks (below normal), the
+         * made-ahead pipelines (below normal, only while the game's compile pool is idle). */
+        while (ld_si_bg_compile(1, THREAD_PRIORITY_NORMAL) || ld_si_bg_pipeline(0) ||
+               ld_si_bg_compile(5, THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL) || (ld_si_pool_idle() && ld_si_bg_pipeline(1))) {}
+    }
+}
+/* The walker, at every frame's end (ld_nw_frame). [standin2] The base variants are asked for only once pack.bin is
+ * in memory: asked for earlier (round 1: at the first frame) the cache answered "not cached" while its loader
+ * still read the pack, so they were compiled again at every start. */
+static void ld_si_frame(void)
+{
+    if (!ld_si_on() || s_cpool_state != 1) return;
+    if (!s_si.started) {
+        /* [standin3] only once the cache's loader is done (pack.bin and the folder's own files in memory): the
+         * shaders a former session compiled are loose files until then, and a lookup before it misses them */
+        if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_shader_mem_loading, 0, 0)) return;
+        if (!s_sibg_wake) {
+            s_sibg_wake = CreateEventA(NULL, FALSE, FALSE, NULL);
+            /* two threads: a screen's few new variants and pairs side by side (each a second or less, once a PC) */
+            int started = 0;
+            for (int k2 = 0; k2 < 2 && s_sibg_wake; k2++) {
+                HANDLE th = CreateThread(NULL, 1u << 20, ld_si_bg_main, NULL, 0, NULL);
+                if (th) { CloseHandle(th); started++; }
+            }
+            if (!started) { s_si.on = 0; return; }   /* no thread: no stand-in, as before */
+        }
+        s_si.started = 1;
+        LARGE_INTEGER t; QueryPerformanceCounter(&t); s_si.t0 = t.QuadPart;
+        const int p = ld_si_var_slot('P', 0, 1), v = ld_si_var_slot('V', 0, 1);
+        const int vm = ld_si_var_slot('V', 1, 0);  /* the motion-vector vertex variant */
+        /* [standin4] The built-in list (rsx_si_builtin_variants: every variant met on the records of the PC it was
+         * made on, commonest first): read from the cache (the prepare step makes them, also with no records), else
+         * compiled ahead by the stand-in's threads at below-normal priority, after anything a draw needs. And for
+         * each, one pipeline of a plain state, made ahead (below normal, while the game's pool is idle), so that the
+         * driver's one-time cost of the pair (0.2-0.45 s cold) is paid at start, not at the pair's first need. */
+        { const u64* bl; const u32 bn = rsx_si_builtin_variants(&bl);
+          if (vm >= 0) InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_si_var[vm].state, 5, 0);
+          for (u32 k2 = 0; k2 < bn; k2++) {
+              const int sl = ld_si_var_slot('P', bl[k2], 0);
+              if (sl < 0) continue;
+              InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_si_var[sl].state, 5, 0);
+              const int mvv = (bl[k2] >> 32) & 1u;
+              const int vsl = mvv ? vm : v;
+              if (vsl < 0) continue;
+              render_state_t rs0; memset(&rs0, 0, sizeof rs0);
+              rs0.color_mask = 0x01010101u;
+              if (mvv) { rs0.rt_count = LD_RT_MV; rs0.depth_write = 1u; }   /* the variant writes the vectors' target */
+              ld_sip_get(&rs0, NULL, 0, (u32)sl, (u32)vsl, 1);
+          }
+          SetEvent(s_sibg_wake); }
+        fprintf(stderr, "[shaders] stand-in for draws whose pipeline is being made: on (LD_STANDIN=0 off)%s%s; its shaders %s\n",
+                s_si.all ? ", every draw it can take (LD_STANDIN_ALL)" : "",
+                s_si.producers ? ", also draws that wait (LD_STANDIN_PRODUCERS)" : "",
+                p < 0 || v < 0 ? "could not be made" : s_si_var[p].blob && s_si_var[v].blob ? "read from the shader cache"
+                                                                                       : "being compiled");
+    }
+    ld_si_prebuild();                             /* once, when this PC's records are read (rsx_shader_prep.inc) */
+    if (!s_si.ready_said && s_si_nvar >= 2 && ld_si_var_blob(0) && ld_si_var_blob(1)) {
+        s_si.ready_said = 1;
+        LARGE_INTEGER t, f; QueryPerformanceCounter(&t); QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
+        fprintf(stderr, "[shaders] stand-in ready %.0f ms after it was asked for (frame %u)\n",
+                (double)(t.QuadPart - s_si.t0) * 1000.0 / (double)f.QuadPart, g_ld_frames);
+    }
+}
+
+/* get_pso, just before build_pso: both programs and every input of their translation. */
+static void ld_si_note(const u8* fp, u32 fp_size, u32 fp_ctrl, u32 cube_mask, u32 vol_mask, const rsx_fp_shadow_desc* shadow,
+                       const u8* gamma, const u8* expand, u32 unnorm_mask, const u32 dim[16][3], u32 srgb, u32 alpha_test,
+                       u32 alpha_func, int wpos_scaled, int wpos_rs, const u32 wpos_grid[2], int mv, u32 rt_count,
+                       const u8* vp, u32 vp_instrs, u32 vp_start, u32 vp_bits, u32 vtex_mask,
+                       const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* masked_layout)
+{
+    s_si_in.valid = 0;
+    if (!ld_si_on() || !s_nw.mode) return;
+    rsx_si_desc* d = &s_si_in.d;
+    memset(d, 0, sizeof *d);
+    s_si_in.fp = fp; s_si_in.fp_size = fp_size;
+    d->fp_ctrl = fp_ctrl; d->cube_mask = cube_mask; d->vol_mask = vol_mask;
+    d->shadow = shadow; d->gamma = gamma; d->expand = expand;
+    d->unnorm_mask = unnorm_mask;
+    memcpy(d->unnorm_dim, dim, sizeof d->unnorm_dim);
+    d->srgb_output = srgb; d->alpha_test = alpha_test; d->alpha_func = alpha_func;
+    d->wpos_mode = wpos_rs ? 2u : wpos_scaled ? 1u : 0u;
+    d->wpos_x = wpos_grid[0]; d->wpos_y = wpos_grid[1];
+    d->mv = mv != 0; d->upres = (rt_count & LD_RT_UPRES) != 0; d->rt_count = rt_count;
+    s_si_in.vp = vp; s_si_in.vp_bytes = vp_instrs * 16u; s_si_in.vp_start = vp_start; s_si_in.vp_bits = vp_bits;
+    s_si_in.vtex = vtex_mask;
+    s_si_in.compact = masked_layout != NULL;
+    s_si_in.layout_mask = masked_layout ? (u32)masked_layout->mask : 0xFFFFu;
+    s_si_in.valid = 1;
+}
+
+/* [standin2] The general pipeline for a (state, layout, variants), made on the fast queue the first time. */
+static ld_sip* ld_sip_get(const render_state_t* rs, const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* masked_layout, int packed_offsets,
+                          u32 ps_var, u32 vs_var, int ahead)
+{
+    struct { render_state_t rs; u32 masked, count, packed, ps_var, vs_var; u8 attrs[RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR]; } k;
+    memset(&k, 0, sizeof k);
+    k.rs = *rs;
+    k.rs.alpha_test_enable = k.rs.alpha_func = k.rs.alpha_ref_raw = k.rs.alpha_ref_format = 0;   /* in the block */
+    if (masked_layout) {
+        k.masked = 1u; k.count = masked_layout->count < RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR ? masked_layout->count : RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR;
+        k.packed = packed_offsets ? 1u : 0u;
+        memcpy(k.attrs, masked_layout->attrs, k.count);
+    }
+    k.ps_var = ps_var; k.vs_var = vs_var;
+    const u64 key = fnv1a(&k, sizeof k, 1469598103934665603ull) | 1u;
+    u32 h = (u32)(key ^ (key >> 32)) & (LD_SIP_SLOTS - 1u);
+    for (; s_sip[h]; h = (h + 1u) & (LD_SIP_SLOTS - 1u)) {
+        ld_sip* p = s_sip[h];
+        if (p->key == key && p->ps_var == ps_var && p->vs_var == vs_var && p->masked == k.masked && p->count == k.count &&
+            p->packed == k.packed && !memcmp(p->attrs, k.attrs, sizeof k.attrs) && ld_rs_desc_same(&p->rs, rs)) {
+            if (!ahead && p->ahead) {             /* a draw needs a made-ahead one now: ahead of the others */
+                AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_sibg_lock);
+                p->ahead = 0;
+                ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_sibg_lock);
+                SetEvent(s_sibg_wake);
+            }
+            return p;
+        }
+    }
+    if (s_sip_n * 4u >= LD_SIP_SLOTS * 3u) return NULL;
+    ld_sip* p = (ld_sip*)calloc(1, sizeof *p);
+    if (!p) return NULL;
+    p->task.kind = LD_CT_SIP;
+    p->key = key; p->ps_var = ps_var; p->vs_var = vs_var;
+    p->rs = *rs; p->masked = k.masked; p->count = k.count; p->packed = k.packed;
+    memcpy(p->attrs, k.attrs, sizeof p->attrs);
+    s_sip[h] = p; s_sip_n++;
+    p->ahead = ahead;
+    /* [standin3] On the game's fast queue only when it costs the driver about 1 ms: both variants there and a pipeline
+     * of the pair made before. Else (and every made-ahead one) the stand-in thread's. */
+    if (!ahead && ld_si_var_blob(ps_var) && ld_si_var_blob(vs_var) && InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_si_warm[ps_var][vs_var], 0, 0))
+        ld_cpool_push_hi(&p->task);
+    else {
+        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_sibg_lock);
+        p->next_bg = s_sibg_head; s_sibg_head = p;
+        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_sibg_lock);
+        SetEvent(s_sibg_wake);
+    }
+    return p;
+}
+
+/* ld_async_build, on the walker, for a pipeline handed to the pool: its stand-in, or NULL (refused, counted).
+ * vsb: the job's own copy of its vertex shader when that is compiled (the depth-EQUAL form uses it). */
+static ld_si* ld_si_attach(ID3DBlob* vsb, const render_state_t* rs, const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* masked_layout,
+                           int packed_offsets)
+{
+    if (!s_si_in.valid || !ld_si_on()) return NULL;
+    s_si_in.valid = 0;
+    InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_psos);
+    u32 why = 0;
+    static rsx_si_prog prog;                     /* the walker's alone */
+    static rsx_si_vprog vprog;
+    const int equal = rs->depth_test && rs->depth_func == 0x0202u;   /* an equal-depth pass: its own vertex shader */
+    if (!s_si.started) why = LD_SIR_VARIANT;      /* the cache is not read yet: nothing is asked for before that */
+    else if (ld_prep_debug_edits() || getenv("RSX_FP_DEBUG")) why = LD_SIR_DEBUG;
+    else if (!ld_fp_constants_buffered()) why = RSX_SI_R_UNBUFFERED;
+    else if (equal && !vsb) why = LD_SIR_EQUAL;
+    else if (!equal && masked_layout && masked_layout->count == 0) why = LD_SIR_NOATTR;
+    rsx_si_state st; memset(&st, 0, sizeof st);
+    if (!why && rsx_si_encode(s_si_in.fp, s_si_in.fp_size, &prog) < 0) why = prog.refused ? prog.refused : RSX_SI_R_PROGRAM;
+    if (!why) why = rsx_si_desc_check(&prog, &s_si_in.d, &st);
+    if (!why && s_si.max_ops && prog.n_ops > s_si.max_ops) why = LD_SIR_LONG;
+    if (!why && !equal)
+        why = rsx_si_vp_encode(s_si_in.vp, s_si_in.vp_bytes, s_si_in.vp_start, s_si_in.vp_bits, s_si_in.vtex,
+                               s_si_in.compact, s_si_in.layout_mask, &vprog);
+    const u32 vn = equal ? 0u : vprog.n_ops;
+    const u32 rows = rsx_si_block_rows(prog.n_slots, prog.n_ops) + (vn ? rsx_si_vp_block_rows(vn) : 0u);
+    if (!why && rows > RSX_SI_BLOCK_ROWS) why = RSX_SI_R_PROGRAM;
+    int slot = -1, vslot = -1;
+    if (!why && (slot = ld_si_var_slot('P', rsx_si_variant_of(&s_si_in.d), 1)) < 0) why = LD_SIR_MEMORY;
+    if (!why && ld_si_var_failed((u32)slot)) why = LD_SIR_VARIANT;   /* it could not be compiled */
+    if (!why && !equal && (vslot = ld_si_var_slot('V', s_si_in.d.mv ? 1u : 0u, 1)) < 0) why = LD_SIR_MEMORY;
+    ld_si* s = NULL;
+    if (!why) {
+        s = (ld_si*)calloc(1, sizeof *s + ((size_t)prog.n_ops + vn) * sizeof(rsx_si_op));
+        if (!s) why = LD_SIR_MEMORY;
+        else if (equal) {
+            const SIZE_T n = vsb->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(vsb);
+            if (FAILED(D3DCreateBlob(n, &s->vs)) || !s->vs) { free(s); s = NULL; why = LD_SIR_MEMORY; }
+            else memcpy(s->vs->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(s->vs), vsb->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(vsb), n);
+        } else if (!(s->gen = ld_sip_get(rs, masked_layout, packed_offsets, (u32)slot, (u32)vslot, 0))) {
+            free(s); s = NULL; why = LD_SIR_MEMORY;
+        }
+    }
+    if (why) {
+        InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_refused[why < LD_SIR_N ? why : 0]);
+        return NULL;
+    }
+    InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_got);
+    s->task.kind = LD_CT_SI;
+    s->var = (u32)slot;
+    s->rs = *rs;
+    if (masked_layout) {
+        s->masked = 1u; s->count = masked_layout->count; s->packed = packed_offsets ? 1u : 0u;
+        memcpy(s->attrs, masked_layout->attrs, sizeof s->attrs);
+    }
+    s->st = st;
+    s->n_ops = prog.n_ops; s->n_slots = prog.n_slots; s->n_regs = prog.n_regs;
+    memcpy(s->ops, prog.ops, (size_t)prog.n_ops * sizeof(rsx_si_op));
+    s->vops = s->ops + prog.n_ops;
+    if (vn) {
+        s->vn_ops = vn; s->vpresent = vprog.present; s->vtex = vprog.vtex;
+        s->vat = rsx_si_block_rows(prog.n_slots, prog.n_ops);
+        memcpy(s->vops, vprog.ops, (size_t)vn * sizeof(rsx_si_op));
+    }
+    s->rows = rows;
+    if (equal) {                                  /* the own-vertex-shader form: a pipeline of its own */
+        if (ld_si_var_blob((u32)slot)) ld_cpool_push_hi(&s->task);
+        else {                                    /* its variant is not compiled yet: none for this pipeline */
+            if (s->vs) { s->vs->lpVtbl->Release(s->vs); s->vs = NULL; }
+            InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_refused[LD_SIR_VARIANT]);
+            ld_cpool_finish(&s->done);
+        }
+    } else ld_cpool_finish(&s->done);             /* the general form: its pipeline is the shared one */
+    return s;
+}
+
+/* The general pipeline's input layout: all sixteen attributes, from where the draw's layout has them (an
+ * attribute it does not have reads the first element; the shader reads it only if the program does, as 0,0,0,1). */
+static void ld_sip_layout(const ld_sip* p, D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC il[16])
+{
+    for (u32 a = 0; a < 16u; a++) {
+        u32 offset = a * 16u;
+        if (p->masked) {
+            offset = 0;
+            for (u32 s = 0; s < p->count; s++)
+                if (p->attrs[s] == a) { offset = p->packed ? s * 16u : a * 16u; break; }
+        }
+        D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC e = { "ATTR", a, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, 0, offset,
+                                       D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0 };
+        il[a] = e;
+    }
+}
+/* A compile thread: a stand-in pipeline (general: kind LD_CT_SIP; own vertex shader: LD_CT_SI). Its shaders still
+ * compiling (the first session on a PC, before the prepare step ran): none, counted. */
+static void ld_si_build(struct ld_si* any)
+{
+    LARGE_INTEGER c0, c1;
+    ID3D12PipelineState* pso = NULL;
+    if (any->task.kind == LD_CT_SIP) {
+        ld_sip* p = (ld_sip*)any;
+        ID3DBlob* ps = ld_si_var_blob(p->ps_var);
+        ID3DBlob* vs = ld_si_var_blob(p->vs_var);
+        if (ps && vs) {
+            D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC il[16], gil[16];
+            D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pd;
+            ld_fill_pipeline_desc(&pd, il, vs, ps, &p->rs, (int)p->masked, p->count, p->attrs, (int)p->packed);
+            ld_sip_layout(p, gil);
+            pd.InputLayout.pInputElementDescs = gil; pd.InputLayout.NumElements = 16;
+            QueryPerformanceCounter(&c0);
+            if (FAILED(g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateGraphicsPipelineState(g.dev, &pd, &IID_ID3D12PipelineState, (void**)&pso)))
+                pso = NULL;
+            QueryPerformanceCounter(&c1);
+            InterlockedAdd64(&s_si_made_qpc, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart);
+            if (pso) InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_made);
+            else InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_refused[LD_SIR_FAILED]);
+        } else InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_refused[LD_SIR_VARIANT]);
+        if (pso) InterlockedExchange(&s_si_warm[p->ps_var][p->vs_var], 1);
+        p->pso = pso;
+        ld_cpool_finish(&p->done);
+        return;
+    }
+    ld_si* s = any;
+    ID3DBlob* ps = ld_si_var_blob(s->var);
+    if (ps && s->vs) {
+        D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC il[16];
+        D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pd;
+        ld_fill_pipeline_desc(&pd, il, s->vs, ps, &s->rs, (int)s->masked, s->count, s->attrs, (int)s->packed);
+        QueryPerformanceCounter(&c0);
+        if (FAILED(g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateGraphicsPipelineState(g.dev, &pd, &IID_ID3D12PipelineState, (void**)&pso)))
+            pso = NULL;
+        QueryPerformanceCounter(&c1);
+        InterlockedAdd64(&s_si_made_qpc, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart);
+        if (pso) InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_made);
+        else InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_refused[LD_SIR_FAILED]);
+    } else InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_refused[LD_SIR_VARIANT]);
+    if (s->vs) { s->vs->lpVtbl->Release(s->vs); s->vs = NULL; }   /* its own copy: no other thread has it */
+    s->pso = pso;
+    ld_cpool_finish(&s->done);
+}
+/* Its pipeline when it is made (any thread), NULL while it is being made or when it failed. */
+static ID3D12PipelineState* ld_si_pso(const ld_si* s)
+{
+    if (s->gen) return InterlockedCompareExchange(&s->gen->done, 0, 0) ? s->gen->pso : NULL;
+    return InterlockedCompareExchange(&((ld_si*)s)->done, 0, 0) ? s->pso : NULL;
+}
+static int ld_si_failed(const ld_si* s)
+{
+    if (s->gen) return InterlockedCompareExchange(&s->gen->done, 0, 0) && !s->gen->pso;
+    return InterlockedCompareExchange(&((ld_si*)s)->done, 0, 0) && !s->pso;
+}
+static volatile LONG* ld_si_done_flag(ld_si* s) { return s->gen ? &s->gen->done : &s->done; }
+
+/* The walker, after get_pso: the draw's stand-in when it may be drawn with it (its pipeline still being made, or
+ * LD_STANDIN_ALL), else NULL. ld_upload_pixel_constants then writes its block. */
+static void ld_si_for_draw(ID3D12PipelineState* pso)
+{
+    s_si_draw = NULL; s_si_draw_off = 0;
+    if (!s_nw.mode || !ld_pso_is_job(pso)) return;
+    ld_pso_job* const j = ld_pso_job_of(pso);
+    ld_si* const s = j->si;
+    if (!s) return;
+    if (ld_si_failed(s)) return;
+    if (!s_si.all && InterlockedCompareExchange(&j->done, 0, 0)) return;           /* the real one is ready */
+    s_si_draw = s;
+}
+/* ld_upload_pixel_constants: bytes the draw's allocation needs beyond its own constants (base = their size). */
+static u32 ld_si_extra_bytes(u32 base)
+{
+    if (!s_si_draw) return 0;
+    return ((base + 255u) & ~255u) - base + s_si_draw->rows * 16u;
+}
+/* ... and the block, written after them (dst = the allocation, base = their size, alpha = the fp_alpha row). */
+static void ld_si_write_block(u8* dst, u32 base, const u8* alpha)
+{
+    if (!s_si_draw) return;
+    const u32 off = (base + 255u) & ~255u;
+    float a[4]; memcpy(a, alpha, 16);
+    rsx_si_block_write(dst + off, s_si_draw->n_slots, s_si_draw->n_regs, s_si_draw->n_ops, s_si_draw->ops, &s_si_draw->st,
+                       (const u32 (*)[4])g.fp_constants.values, g.fp_constants.count, a);
+    if (s_si_draw->vn_ops)
+        rsx_si_vp_block_write(dst + off, s_si_draw->vat, s_si_draw->vn_ops, s_si_draw->vpresent, s_si_draw->vtex, s_si_draw->vops);
+    s_si_draw_off = off;
+    InterlockedAdd64(&s_si_bytes, (LONG64)s_si_draw->rows * 16);
+}
+
+/* ---- the recording thread ---- */
+/* s_rec_b1 (b1 as the walker last set it) and s_rec_cur_pso (the pipeline set for its calls): beside ro_draw */
+/* Set the stand-in for one draw: 1 when set (b1 pointed at its block; ld_si_rec_end puts things back). */
+static int ld_si_rec_set(ld_si* s, u32 off)
+{
+    ID3D12PipelineState* p = s && off ? ld_si_pso(s) : NULL;
+    if (!p) return 0;
+    s_rec_real->lpVtbl->SetPipelineState(s_rec_real, p);
+    s_rec_real->lpVtbl->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(s_rec_real, 4, s_rec_b1 + off);
+    return 1;
+}
+static void ld_si_rec_end(int restore_pso)
+{
+    s_rec_real->lpVtbl->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(s_rec_real, 4, s_rec_b1);
+    if (restore_pso && s_rec_cur_pso) s_rec_real->lpVtbl->SetPipelineState(s_rec_real, s_rec_cur_pso);
+}
+/* A draw that would be left out: the stand-in instead, if it is ready. [standin3] Never waited for (round 2 waited
+ * up to 2 ms a draw): a stand-in may not make a frame longer than without it. */
+static int ld_si_rec_leave(ld_si* s, u32 off)
+{
+    if (!s || !off) return 0;
+    if (ld_si_rec_set(s, off)) { InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_drawn); return 1; }
+    InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_refused[LD_SIR_NOTREADY]);
+    return 0;
+}
+/* A draw that would wait for its pipeline (LD_STANDIN_PRODUCERS, or LD_STANDIN_ALL): wait for the stand-in
+ * instead (about a millisecond, or nothing once its state's pipeline is made). */
+static int ld_si_rec_wait(ld_si* s, u32 off, u32 why)
+{
+    if (!s || !off || !(s_si.producers || s_si.all)) return 0;
+    volatile LONG* d = ld_si_done_flag(s);
+    if (s_si.all) {                               /* the picture test: the stand-in for every draw it takes */
+        if (!InterlockedCompareExchange(d, 0, 0)) {
+            LARGE_INTEGER a, b; QueryPerformanceCounter(&a);
+            ld_cpool_wait(d);
+            QueryPerformanceCounter(&b);
+            InterlockedAdd64(&g_st.rec_wait_qpc, b.QuadPart - a.QuadPart);
+            InterlockedAdd64(&s_si_wait_qpc, b.QuadPart - a.QuadPart);
+            InterlockedIncrement64(&g_st.rec_wait_n);
+        }
+        if (!ld_si_rec_set(s, off)) return 0;
+        InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_drawn_wait);
+        return 1;
+    }
+    /* [standin5] A draw that must wait (its picture is read by other draws): the stand-in only when it can be had
+     * now or within about a millisecond, and never into a target that may be drawn once and kept ("a target new
+     * this frame", "its target is read by later draws" = not redrawn every frame): a one-ulp difference there could
+     * stay for the session. Everything else waits for the real pipeline exactly as without the stand-in. */
+    if (why == NWR_NEWTARGET || why == NWR_PRODUCER) { InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_wait_kept); return 0; }
+    if (!InterlockedCompareExchange(d, 0, 0)) {
+        /* instantly there: its two shaders in memory and its pair's first (cold) pipeline made, so at most its
+         * state's ~1 ms pipeline is missing; that is waited for, 3 ms at most */
+        const ld_sip* p = s->gen;
+        const int instant = p && ld_si_var_blob(p->ps_var) && ld_si_var_blob(p->vs_var) &&
+                            InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_si_warm[p->ps_var][p->vs_var], 0, 0);
+        if (!instant) { InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_wait_real); return 0; }
+        LARGE_INTEGER a, b; QueryPerformanceCounter(&a);
+        ld_cpool_wait_ms(d, 3);
+        QueryPerformanceCounter(&b);
+        InterlockedAdd64(&g_st.rec_wait_qpc, b.QuadPart - a.QuadPart);
+        InterlockedAdd64(&s_si_wait_qpc, b.QuadPart - a.QuadPart);
+        if (!InterlockedCompareExchange(d, 0, 0)) { InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_wait_real); return 0; }
+    }
+    if (!ld_si_rec_set(s, off)) { InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_wait_real); return 0; }
+    InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_drawn_wait);
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* The [stutter] line's tail (appended when the mode is on or anything happened since the last line). */
+static void ld_si_stutter(char* out, size_t cap, double k)
+{
+    static LONG64 p_drawn, p_wait, p_made, p_made_qpc, p_psos, p_got, p_ref[LD_SIR_N], p_vr, p_vc, p_vq, p_bm, p_bq, p_wq, p_wr, p_wk;
+    const LONG64 wr = s_si_wait_real, wk = s_si_wait_kept;
+    const LONG64 vr = s_si_var_read, vc = s_si_var_compiled, vq = s_si_var_qpc, bm = s_si_bg_made, bq = s_si_bg_qpc, wq = s_si_wait_qpc;
+    const LONG64 dr = s_si_drawn, dw = s_si_drawn_wait, mk = s_si_made, mq = s_si_made_qpc, ps = s_si_psos, gt = s_si_got;
+    LONG64 ref[LD_SIR_N]; int any_ref = 0;
+    for (int r = 0; r < LD_SIR_N; r++) { ref[r] = s_si_refused[r]; any_ref |= ref[r] != p_ref[r]; }
+    if (ld_si_on() && (s_nw.mode || dr != p_drawn || any_ref)) {
+        size_t used = strlen(out);
+        snprintf(out + used, cap - used, " | stand-in: %lld draws drawn by it (%lld that would have waited; %lld that had to wait waited for"
+                 " their own pipeline as the stand-in was not instantly there, %lld into a target maybe kept), %lld of %lld new pipelines"
+                 " got one, %lld stand-in pipelines made (%.1f ms each in the driver), %u kept",
+                 (long long)(dr - p_drawn), (long long)(dw - p_wait), (long long)(wr - p_wr), (long long)(wk - p_wk),
+                 (long long)(gt - p_got), (long long)(ps - p_psos),
+                 (long long)(mk - p_made), mk != p_made ? (double)(mq - p_made_qpc) * k / (double)(mk - p_made) : 0.0, s_sip_n);
+        used = strlen(out);
+        snprintf(out + used, cap - used, "; its shaders: %lld read from the cache, %lld compiled (%.0f ms); its own thread made %lld"
+                 " pipelines, busy %.0f ms; the recording thread waited %.0f ms for it",
+                 (long long)(vr - p_vr), (long long)(vc - p_vc), (double)(vq - p_vq) * k, (long long)(bm - p_bm),
+                 (double)(bq - p_bq) * k, (double)(wq - p_wq) * k);
+        int first = 1;
+        for (int r = 1; r < LD_SIR_N; r++) {
+            if (ref[r] == p_ref[r]) continue;
+            used = strlen(out);
+            snprintf(out + used, cap - used, "%s%s %lld", first ? "; refused: " : ", ", ld_si_reason((u32)r),
+                     (long long)(ref[r] - p_ref[r]));
+            first = 0;
+        }
+    }
+    p_drawn = dr; p_wait = dw; p_made = mk; p_made_qpc = mq; p_psos = ps; p_got = gt;
+    p_vr = vr; p_vc = vc; p_vq = vq; p_bm = bm; p_bq = bq; p_wq = wq; p_wr = wr; p_wk = wk;
+    for (int r = 0; r < LD_SIR_N; r++) p_ref[r] = ref[r];
+}

+s32 cellKbGetData(u32 port_no, CellKbData* data)
+{
+    unsigned long long ea = (unsigned int)(uintptr_t)data;
+
+    if (!s_kb_initialized)
+        return CELL_KB_ERROR_UNINITIALIZED;
+
+    if (port_no >= s_kb_max_connect || !data)
+        return CELL_KB_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER;
+
+    KbPortState* kb = &s_kb_ports[port_no];
+
+    if (!kb->connected) {
+        vm_write32(ea + 0x00, 0);
+        vm_write32(ea + 0x04, 0);
+        vm_write32(ea + 0x08, 0);
+        return CELL_KB_ERROR_NO_DEVICE;
+    }
+
+    kb_fill_data(kb, ea);
+    return CELL_OK;
+}

+/* The firmware's port limit for the argument checks below. The library takes
+ * port numbers up to 127 and answers "no device" for one past the count the
+ * title asked cellKbInit for; only a number past 127 is a bad argument. */
+#define KB_FW_MAX_PORTS 127u
+
+/* cellKbRead (sys_io, NID 0xFF0A21B7): the firmware's read call; cellKbGetData
+ * above is this runtime's own older name and no title imports it. GT5's
+ * keyboard thread (func_00C0C030) calls it every poll for each keyboard
+ * cellKbGetInfo reports and walks data->len key codes; unregistered, the call
+ * answered 0 without writing, so the thread read whatever its stack held.
+ * A port with no keyboard reads as an empty packet and still succeeds. */
+s32 cellKbRead(u32 port_no, CellKbData* data)
+{
+    unsigned long long ea = (unsigned int)(uintptr_t)data;
+
+    if (!s_kb_initialized)
+        return CELL_KB_ERROR_UNINITIALIZED;
+
+    if (port_no >= KB_FW_MAX_PORTS || !data)
+        return CELL_KB_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER;
+
+    if (port_no >= s_kb_max_connect || port_no >= CELL_KB_MAX_KEYBOARDS)
+        return CELL_KB_ERROR_NO_DEVICE;
+
+    KbPortState* kb = &s_kb_ports[port_no];
+    if (!kb->connected) {
+        vm_write32(ea + 0x00, 0);
+        vm_write32(ea + 0x04, 0);
+        vm_write32(ea + 0x08, 0);
+        return CELL_OK;
+    }
+
+    kb_fill_data(kb, ea);
+    return CELL_OK;
+}

+/* cellKbGetConfiguration (sys_io, NID 0x1F71ECBE): layout, read mode and code
+ * type of one keyboard. GT5 maps `arrange` to its own layout table right after
+ * connecting a keyboard; unregistered, it read an unwritten stack word. The
+ * host's keyboard reaches the game as a pad, not as typed text, so the layout
+ * reported is the system default, US 101. */
+s32 cellKbGetConfiguration(u32 port_no, CellKbConfig* config)
+{
+    unsigned long long ea = (unsigned int)(uintptr_t)config;
+
+    if (!s_kb_initialized)
+        return CELL_KB_ERROR_UNINITIALIZED;
+
+    if (port_no >= KB_FW_MAX_PORTS || !config)
+        return CELL_KB_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER;
+
+    if (port_no >= s_kb_max_connect || port_no >= CELL_KB_MAX_KEYBOARDS ||
+        !s_kb_ports[port_no].connected)
+        return CELL_KB_ERROR_NO_DEVICE;
+
+    vm_write32(ea + 0x00, CELL_KB_MAPPING_101);
+    vm_write32(ea + 0x04, s_kb_ports[port_no].rmode);
+    vm_write32(ea + 0x08, s_kb_ports[port_no].codetype);
     return CELL_OK;
 }

+/* sceNpTrophySetSoundLevel (NID 0x27DEDA93): the volume, 20 to 100, of the

+ * code (func_00C2AC08) with level 20..100 and options 0, and treats any
