+/* The PRX modules this process has loaded, as sys_prx_get_module_list sees
+ * them. The answer has to agree with sys_prx_get_module_id_by_name above: no
+ * module is loaded by name here (the firmware libraries are this runtime's own
+ * code, not PRX objects), so the list is empty and every id is unknown.
+ *
+ * GT5 is the caller (func_00C0BCCC, keyboard set-up): it lists the modules and
+ * looks each one up by id for "cellGcmHud_Library", the development kit's GCM
+ * HUD, and leaves the keyboard to the HUD when it finds it. A retail console
+ * never has that module, which is the answer an empty list gives. Unregistered,
+ * the call answered 0 and the game read the count from its own zeroed struct,
+ * so nothing a player sees changes; the list is now an answer, not luck. */
+#define PRX_ERROR_UNKNOWN_MODULE 0x8001112Eu
+
+/* sys_prx_get_module_list (NID 0xA5D06BF0). Guest struct (big-endian):
+ * +0x00 size u64, +0x08 max u32, +0x0C count u32 (out), +0x10 idlist u32. */
+s32 sys_prx_get_module_list(u64 flags, void* info)
+{
+    (void)flags;
+    const u32 ea = (u32)(uintptr_t)info;
+    if (!ea || !vm_read32(ea + 0x10))
+        return (s32)CELL_EINVAL;
+    vm_write32(ea + 0x0C, 0);   /* count: no PRX module is loaded */
+    return CELL_OK;
+}
+
+/* sys_prx_get_module_info (NID 0x84BB6774). info: +0x00 size u64 (0x48). */
+s32 sys_prx_get_module_info(u32 id, u64 flags, void* info)
+{
+    (void)id; (void)flags;
+    const u32 ea = (u32)(uintptr_t)info;
+    if (!ea)
+        return (s32)CELL_EFAULT;
+    if (vm_read32(ea) != 0 || vm_read32(ea + 4) != 0x48)
+        return (s32)CELL_EINVAL;
+    return (s32)PRX_ERROR_UNKNOWN_MODULE;
+}

+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * sys_mempool: fixed-size blocks carved from a chunk the caller supplies.
+ *
+ * Gran Turismo 5's steering-wheel driver keeps its per-wheel state in two of
+ * these. Unregistered, create "succeeded" without writing the id and every
+ * allocation came back 0, so the driver refused each wheel at attach.
+ * Blocks sit at chunk + i * block_size, as in the firmware.
+ * -----------------------------------------------------------------------*/
+#define MEMPOOL_MAX 16
+typedef struct {
+    int  used;
+    u32  chunk;
+    u32  block_size;
+    u32  count;        /* blocks in the pool */
+    u32  nfree;
+    u32* free;         /* stack of free block addresses */
+} SysMempool;
+static SysMempool s_mempool[MEMPOOL_MAX];
+
+static SysMempool* mempool_get(u32 id)
+{
+    return (id >= 1 && id <= MEMPOOL_MAX && s_mempool[id - 1].used) ? &s_mempool[id - 1] : NULL;
+}
+
+s32 sys_mempool_create(u32 mempool_ea, u32 chunk, u64 chunk_size, u64 block_size, u64 ralignment)
+{
+    u64 align = (ralignment == 0 || ralignment == 2) ? 4 : ralignment;
+    if (!mempool_ea || !chunk || !block_size || block_size > chunk_size) return CELL_EINVAL;
+    if ((align & (align - 1)) != 0 || (chunk & 7) != 0) return CELL_EINVAL;
+    const u64 count = chunk_size / block_size;
+    u32* stack = (u32*)malloc((size_t)count * sizeof(u32));
+    if (!stack) return CELL_ENOMEM;
+    slot_lock();
+    int i = 0;
+    while (i < MEMPOOL_MAX && s_mempool[i].used) i++;
+    if (i == MEMPOOL_MAX) { slot_unlock(); free(stack); return CELL_EAGAIN; }
+    SysMempool* p = &s_mempool[i];
+    p->used = 1;
+    p->chunk = chunk;
+    p->block_size = (u32)block_size;
+    p->count = (u32)count;
+    p->free = stack;
+    /* Handed out from the start of the chunk upward. */
+    for (u32 b = 0; b < p->count; b++) p->free[b] = chunk + (p->count - 1 - b) * p->block_size;
+    p->nfree = p->count;
+    slot_unlock();
+    vm_write32(mempool_ea, (u32)(i + 1));
+    return CELL_OK;
+}
+
+s32 sys_mempool_destroy(u32 mempool)
+{
+    slot_lock();
+    SysMempool* p = mempool_get(mempool);
+    if (!p) { slot_unlock(); return CELL_ESRCH; }
+    free(p->free);
+    memset(p, 0, sizeof *p);
+    slot_unlock();
+    return CELL_OK;
+}
+
+u32 sys_mempool_try_allocate_block(u32 mempool)
+{
+    slot_lock();
+    SysMempool* p = mempool_get(mempool);
+    const u32 block = (p && p->nfree) ? p->free[--p->nfree] : 0;
+    slot_unlock();
+    return block;
+}
+
+u32 sys_mempool_allocate_block(u32 mempool)
+{
+    /* Waits for a block to be freed when the pool is empty. */
+    for (;;) {
+        if (!mempool_get(mempool)) return 0;
+        const u32 block = sys_mempool_try_allocate_block(mempool);
+        if (block) return block;
+#ifdef _WIN32
+        Sleep(1);
+#else
+        usleep(1000);
+#endif
+    }
+}
+
+s32 sys_mempool_free_block(u32 mempool, u32 block)
+{
+    slot_lock();
+    SysMempool* p = mempool_get(mempool);
+    s32 rc = CELL_OK;
+    if (!p) rc = CELL_ESRCH;
+    else if (block < p->chunk || block >= p->chunk + p->count * p->block_size ||
+             (block - p->chunk) % p->block_size != 0 || p->nfree >= p->count)
+        rc = CELL_EINVAL;
+    else p->free[p->nfree++] = block;
+    slot_unlock();
+    return rc;
+}
+
+u64 sys_mempool_get_count(u32 mempool)
+{
+    slot_lock();
+    SysMempool* p = mempool_get(mempool);
+    const u64 n = p ? (u64)(p->count - p->nfree) : 0;   /* blocks in use */
+    slot_unlock();
+    return n;
+}

+/*
+ * [prep] Shaders made before their first draw. #included by rsx_live_draw.c just before get_pso(), so it
+ * sees the renderer's own state. On a draw's path it only runs ld_prep_note (once per new pipeline) and
+ * ld_prep_lookup (a shader that is not in the pack); the rest is the walker's tick at present (cheap:
+ * hand-overs only), threads of its own, and gt5.exe --prepare-shaders.
+ *
+ * Why: the shader cache and the made-ahead list (pipelines_d3d12.lst) name shaders by the hash of OUR
+ * HLSL, so nothing in them outlives a change of the generator, and nothing on a PC can give GT5's own
+ * programs back: its data is one encrypted volume (GT.VOL), so they can't be read from the disc either.
+ * Here each new pipeline is noted by the two programs it came from (a hash of their own bytes) and every
+ * input of their translation (shader_keys.lst), and every program the game used is kept once
+ * (programs.bin: the player's own data, never shipped). Both live in scratch\shader_keys, which "Clear
+ * the shader cache" leaves alone. With them:
+ *  - gt5.exe --prepare-shaders (the install / update / launcher step) translates every noted pipeline
+ *    with today's generator, compiles what the cache lacks on all cores, writes the cache, makes each
+ *    pipeline once (the driver keeps it) and puts them in the made-ahead list under their new names.
+ *  - in the game the list waits: a listed pipeline whose programs are known (stored, found in memory as
+ *    the game loads them, or just used by a draw) is translated and compiled by threads of its own, only
+ *    while the game's own compile pool has nothing to do, and then as many as the CPU has free (at most
+ *    half of it) while the backlog is long; its first draw finds the shaders ready.
+ *  - a list that ships with the port (shaders\known_d3d12.lst: keys only, no program bytes) adds what
+ *    other players' games drew; its pipelines are made the moment their programs are seen here.
+ * Settings: a record says which of the settings-made parts its text depends on (Shadows; the render
+ * scale and upscaler, for programs reading WPOS or depth textures read by texel; motion vectors, for
+ * depth-writing single-target draws; the upscaler's one-tap resolve; and, for its pipeline only, the scale
+ * of a polygon-offset slope) and what those settings were (one byte a kind, from the setting values
+ * themselves, not from what a frame happened to have on). Its texts are used when their kinds' settings
+ * are today's, its pipeline when the pipeline's are too; a record with none is used with any settings.
+ * Exactness: a prepared shader is used only when a draw's own translation is its text exactly (same
+ * length and two independent 64-bit hashes; the pack compares the whole source), so a stale record can
+ * waste work but never draw a wrong shader.
+ * LD_PREP=0: none of it. LD_PREP_BUILD=0: notes and store only, nothing built in the game.
+ * LD_PREP_CHECK=1: every new pipeline's two texts are made again from its record and compared with the
+ * draw's (the first 16 of a session always are); [shader-prep] lines say how many matched.
+ * LD_PREP_SCAN=0: no memory scan (it runs while listed programs are not yet known). LD_PREP_THREADS=<n>:
+ * at most n threads for the game's own making ahead.
+ */
+
+#define LD_PREP_MAGIC    0x31504B53u   /* "SKP1": a pipeline's keys */
+#define LD_PREP_VERSION  2u            /* 1: 496 bytes, a per-frame settings word (read, converted) */
+#define LD_PREP_V1_SIZE  496u
+#define LD_PROG_MAGIC    0x31475250u   /* "PRG1": a program in the store */
+#define LD_PREP_DIR      "scratch\\shader_keys"
+#define LD_PREP_SHIPPED  "shaders\\known_d3d12.lst"
+#define LD_PREP_MAX_PROG (64u * 1024u)
+
+enum {
+    LD_PREP_F_MASKED = 1u, LD_PREP_F_PACKED = 2u, LD_PREP_F_MV = 4u, LD_PREP_F_UPRES = 8u,
+    LD_PREP_F_WPOS_GRID = 16u, LD_PREP_F_WPOS_RS = 32u, LD_PREP_F_BRANCH = 64u,
+    /* the settings kinds the record's text depends on; cfg holds a byte for each (0 = any) */
+    LD_PREP_D_SHADOW = 0x100u, LD_PREP_D_SCALE = 0x200u, LD_PREP_D_MV = 0x400u, LD_PREP_D_UPRES = 0x800u,
+    /* ... and its pipeline only (not its text): a polygon-offset slope, times the pass's scale */
+    LD_PREP_D_SCALE_PSO = 0x1000u
+};
+
+/* One pipeline, by its programs: everything get_pso's translation and the pipeline description took.
+ * Keys only: the programs themselves are in the player's own store. */
+typedef struct {
+    u32 magic, version, size, flags;
+    u64 vp_key, fp_key;                 /* ld_prep_vp_key / rsx_fp_structural_hash (inline constants left out) */
+    u32 vp_instrs, vp_start, fp_size, fp_ctrl;
+    u32 cube_mask, vol_mask, vtex_mask, shadow_mask;
+    u32 expand_units, srgb_output, branch_bits, unnorm_mask;
+    u32 wpos_x, wpos_y, n_consts;
+    u32 cfg;                            /* a byte a settings kind (shadow, scale, mv, upres), 0 = any */
+    u32 layout_mask, layout_count;
+    u32 fp_head, vp_head;               /* a 32-bit hash of each program's first 16 bytes as guest memory holds
+                                         * them, for finding a listed program in memory (the scan) */
+    u8  gamma[16], expand[16], attrs[16];
+    rsx_fp_shadow_desc shadow[16];
+    u16 unnorm_dim[16][3];
+    render_state_t rs;                  /* as built: motion-vector / one-tap-resolve bits included */
+    char title[12];                     /* the release it was drawn on: disc id ... */
+    u32 eboot_size;                     /* ... and the size of the game's EBOOT (one per version) */
+    u64 check;                          /* fnv1a of everything before it */
+} ld_prep_rec;
+typedef char ld_prep_rec_size_is_512[sizeof(ld_prep_rec) == 512u ? 1 : -1];
+
+typedef struct ld_prep_prog {
+    struct ld_prep_prog* next_file;     /* the writer's list */
+    struct ld_prep_prog* next_walk;     /* the walker's list */
+    u64 key;
+    u32 stage, size;                    /* 'V' (transform program words as the decompiler reads them) or 'P' (guest bytes) */
+    u32 origin;                         /* 0 met by a draw, 1 found in memory, 2 read from programs.bin */
+    u8 bytes[];
+} ld_prep_prog;
+
+static int ld_prep_on(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_PREP"); on = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
+    return on;
+}
+static int ld_prep_build_on(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_PREP_BUILD"); on = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
+    return on;
+}
+static u64 ld_prep_vp_key(const u8* vp, u32 bytes)
+{
+    static const u32 tag = 0x314B5056u;   /* "VPK1" */
+    return fnv1a(vp, bytes, fnv1a(&tag, sizeof tag, 1469598103934665603ull));
+}
+/* A program's first 16 bytes as guest memory holds them, hashed (part of the list format: keep it). The
+ * transform program is kept as the decompiler reads it, host-order words; memory has them big-endian. */
+static u32 ld_prep_head(const u8* p)
+{
+    u64 a, b;
+    memcpy(&a, p, 8); memcpy(&b, p + 8, 8);
+    u64 h = (a * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) ^ ((b + 0x632BE59BD9B4E019ull) * 0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4Full);
+    h ^= h >> 29;
+    return (u32)(h ^ (h >> 32));
+}
+static u32 ld_prep_vp_head(const u8* host_words)
+{
+    u8 b[16];
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
+        u32 w; memcpy(&w, host_words + 4u * k, 4);
+        w = _byteswap_ulong(w);
+        memcpy(b + 4u * k, &w, 4);
+    }
+    return ld_prep_head(b);
+}
+static u64 ld_prep_rec_id(const ld_prep_rec* r)
+{
+    const u64 h = fnv1a(r, (u32)offsetof(ld_prep_rec, check), 1469598103934665603ull);
+    return h ? h : 1u;
+}
+static void ld_prep_rec_seal(ld_prep_rec* r)
+{
+    r->check = fnv1a(r, (u32)offsetof(ld_prep_rec, check), 1469598103934665603ull);
+}
+static int ld_prep_rec_valid(const ld_prep_rec* r)
+{
+    return r->magic == LD_PREP_MAGIC && r->version == LD_PREP_VERSION && r->size == (u32)sizeof *r &&
+           r->check == fnv1a(r, (u32)offsetof(ld_prep_rec, check), 1469598103934665603ull) &&
+           r->vp_instrs && r->vp_instrs <= RSX_DSP_VP_INSTR && r->fp_size && r->fp_size <= LD_PREP_MAX_PROG &&
+           r->layout_count <= RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR;
+}
+/* A version-1 record (round 1's test lists): the same fields up to the render state; its settings word
+ * was what a frame had on, not settings, so it becomes "any settings", with no release. */
+static int ld_prep_rec_from_v1(ld_prep_rec* r, const u8* p)
+{
+    u32 m, v, size; u64 check;
+    memcpy(&m, p, 4); memcpy(&v, p + 4, 4); memcpy(&size, p + 8, 4); memcpy(&check, p + 488, 8);
+    if (m != LD_PREP_MAGIC || v != 1u || size != LD_PREP_V1_SIZE) return 0;
+    if (check != fnv1a(p, 488u, 1469598103934665603ull)) return 0;
+    memset(r, 0, sizeof *r);
+    memcpy(r, p, 488u);                   /* every field up to and with the render state */
+    r->version = LD_PREP_VERSION; r->size = (u32)sizeof *r;
+    r->flags &= 0xFFu; r->cfg = 0;
+    ld_prep_rec_seal(r);
+    return ld_prep_rec_valid(r);
+}
+
+/* ---- settings ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *
+ * One byte a kind, from the setting values (the registry in the game; in --prepare-shaders the values
+ * play.bat and settings.bat give, ld_prep_apply_bat). 1 + Shadows level; the others 1 + a hash of the
+ * values of the keys that decide that kind. The keys are the ones rsx_live_draw.c reads for the render
+ * scale (LD_RES_*, the upscaler's mode and scale, the TV mode, Shadows for the scaled shadow passes),
+ * motion vectors (LD_MV, the upscaler, frame generation) and the one-tap resolve (LD_UP_*, the upscaler). */
+static u8 ld_prep_cfg_hash(const char* const* keys, u32 extra)
+{
+    u64 h = fnv1a(&extra, sizeof extra, 1469598103934665603ull);
+    char v[96];
+    for (; *keys; keys++) {
+        gt5_setting_str(*keys, v, sizeof v);
+        h = fnv1a(*keys, (u32)strlen(*keys), h);
+        h = fnv1a("=", 1, h);
+        h = fnv1a(v, (u32)strlen(v), h);
+        h = fnv1a(";", 1, h);
+    }
+    return (u8)(1u + (u32)(h % 255u));
+}
+static u32 ld_prep_cfg_compute(void)
+{
+    static const char* const scale_keys[] = { "LD_RES_SCALE", "LD_RES_TARGET", "LD_RES_AA", "LD_RES_MIN", "LD_RES_ONLY",
+        "LD_RES_SKIP", "LD_RES_SCENE", "LD_RES_DEPTH_RULE", "LD_RES_OUT", "LD_AA", "LD_DLSS_SCALE", "PS3_VIDEO_MODE", NULL };
+    static const char* const mv_keys[] = { "LD_MV", "LD_AA", "LD_FRAMEGEN", "LD_FG_METHOD", NULL };
+    static const char* const up_keys[] = { "LD_AA", "LD_UP_RESOLVE", "LD_UP_OUT", "LD_DLSS_SCALE", "PS3_VIDEO_MODE", NULL };
+    const u32 level = (u32)ld_sm_level_read();
+    const u32 sh = 1u + level;
+    return sh | ((u32)ld_prep_cfg_hash(scale_keys, level) << 8) | ((u32)ld_prep_cfg_hash(mv_keys, 0) << 16) |
+           ((u32)ld_prep_cfg_hash(up_keys, 0) << 24);
+}
+/* The settings now, recomputed only when the registry changes (any thread). */
+static SRWLOCK s_cfg_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
+static u32 ld_prep_cfg_now(void)
+{
+    static u32 cfg; static unsigned gen = ~0u;
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_cfg_lock);
+    if (gen != gt5_settings_gen()) { gen = gt5_settings_gen(); cfg = ld_prep_cfg_compute(); }
+    const u32 c = cfg;
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_cfg_lock);
+    return c;
+}
+/* Its texts usable now: every kind they depend on was made under today's settings (or the record is
+ * from before kinds were kept). */
+static int ld_prep_usable(const ld_prep_rec* r, u32 cur)
+{
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
+        if (!(r->flags & ((u32)LD_PREP_D_SHADOW << k))) continue;
+        const u32 a = (r->cfg >> (8u * k)) & 0xFFu, b = (cur >> (8u * k)) & 0xFFu;
+        if (a && a != b) return 0;
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+/* ... and its pipeline too (the slope's scale is the render-scale kind's byte). */
+static int ld_prep_usable_pso(const ld_prep_rec* r, u32 cur)
+{
+    if (!ld_prep_usable(r, cur)) return 0;
+    if (!(r->flags & LD_PREP_D_SCALE_PSO)) return 1;
+    const u32 a = (r->cfg >> 8) & 0xFFu, b = (cur >> 8) & 0xFFu;
+    return !a || a == b;
+}
+/* Debug switches that edit get_pso's text after the translation: no notes and no checks with them. */
+static int ld_prep_debug_edits(void)
+{
+    static int d = -1;
+    if (d < 0) d = getenv("LD_SHADER_TINT") || getenv("LD_PS_STAGES") || getenv("LD_PS_ZERO") ||
+                   getenv("LD_FORCE_GREEN") || getenv("LD_FORCE_COL0") || getenv("RSX_FP_CTRL_AUTO");
+    return d;
+}
+
+/* get_pso's translation, from a record: the same calls with the same inputs, in the same order. Any
+ * thread: the vertex decompiler keeps its branch state and work buffers per thread (rsx_vp_decompiler.c),
+ * the fragment decompiler and the text edits keep none that shape the text. 1 when both made. */
+static int ld_prep_translate(const ld_prep_rec* r, const u8* vp, const u8* fp,
+                             char* vs, u32 vs_cap, char* ps, u32 ps_cap)
+{
+    rsx_vp_set_branch_base(r->vp_start);
+    rsx_vp_set_branch_bits((r->flags & LD_PREP_F_BRANCH) ? r->branch_bits : 0u);
+    const int vi = (r->flags & LD_PREP_F_MASKED)
+        ? rsx_vp_decompile_compact_ex(vp, r->vp_instrs * 16u, r->vtex_mask, r->layout_mask, vs, vs_cap)
+        : rsx_vp_decompile_ex(vp, r->vp_instrs * 16u, r->vtex_mask, vs, vs_cap);
+    if (vi <= 0) return 0;
+    u32 n_consts = 0;
+    int fi = rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_shadow_color_expand_vol_ex(
+        fp, r->fp_size, r->fp_ctrl, r->cube_mask, r->vol_mask,
+        r->shadow_mask ? r->shadow : NULL, r->gamma, r->expand_units ? r->expand : NULL,
+        ps, ps_cap, &n_consts);
+    if (fi > 0 && n_consts != r->n_consts) fi = -1;
+    if (fi > 0 && (r->flags & LD_PREP_F_WPOS_RS)) {
+        if (ld_rs_apply_wpos(ps, ps_cap, r->wpos_x, r->wpos_y) < 0) fi = -1;
+    } else if (fi > 0 && (r->flags & LD_PREP_F_WPOS_GRID) &&
+               rsx_fp_apply_wpos_grid(ps, ps_cap, r->wpos_x, r->wpos_y) < 0)
+        fi = -1;
+    if (fi > 0 && r->srgb_output && rsx_fp_apply_srgb_output(ps, ps_cap) < 0) fi = -1;
+    if (fi > 0 && r->rs.alpha_test_enable &&
+        rsx_fp_apply_alpha_test_buffered(ps, ps_cap, r->rs.alpha_func) < 0)
+        fi = -1;
+    if (fi > 0) {
+        u32 dim[16][3];
+        for (u32 u = 0; u < 16; u++)
+            for (u32 k = 0; k < 3; k++) dim[u][k] = r->unnorm_dim[u][k];
+        if (rsx_fp_apply_unnorm_scale(ps, ps_cap, r->unnorm_mask, (const u32 (*)[3])dim, r->cube_mask, r->vol_mask) < 0)
+            fi = -1;
+    }
+    if (fi <= 0) return 0;
+    if ((r->flags & LD_PREP_F_MV) && !ld_mv_apply_shaders(vs, vs_cap, ps, ps_cap)) return 0;
+    if ((r->flags & LD_PREP_F_UPRES) && !ld_up_apply_resolve(ps, ps_cap)) return 0;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* ---- the files ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
+static char s_prep_dir[MAX_PATH];
+static int ld_prep_dir(void)
+{
+    if (s_prep_dir[0]) return 1;
+    const char* o = getenv("LD_PREP_DIR");
+    if (o && o[0]) snprintf(s_prep_dir, sizeof s_prep_dir, "%s", o);
+    else { CreateDirectoryA("scratch", NULL); snprintf(s_prep_dir, sizeof s_prep_dir, "%s", LD_PREP_DIR); }
+    if (!CreateDirectoryA(s_prep_dir, NULL) && GetLastError() != ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) { s_prep_dir[0] = 0; return 0; }
+    return 1;
+}
+static u8* ld_prep_read_file(const char* path, size_t* n)
+{
+    *n = 0;
+    FILE* f = fopen(path, "rb");
+    if (!f) return NULL;
+    u8* d = NULL;
+    if (_fseeki64(f, 0, SEEK_END) == 0) {
+        const long long len = _ftelli64(f);
+        if (len > 0 && len < (1ll << 31) && _fseeki64(f, 0, SEEK_SET) == 0) {
+            d = (u8*)malloc((size_t)len);
+            if (d && fread(d, 1, (size_t)len, f) == (size_t)len) *n = (size_t)len;
+            else { free(d); d = NULL; }
+        }
+    }
+    fclose(f);
+    return d;
+}
+static u64 ld_prep_ft(const FILETIME* t) { return ((u64)t->dwHighDateTime << 32) | t->dwLowDateTime; }
+
+/* Programs: the table every part looks them up in (filled by whoever loads; after s_prep_ready only the
+ * walker writes it, and only a slot's program pointer, never a new slot), with each one's records. */
+typedef struct { u64 key; u32 stage; u32 head; ld_prep_prog* volatile prog; } ld_prep_pslot;
+typedef struct { u32 rec, next; } ld_prep_link;
+static ld_prep_pslot* s_pt;
+static u32 s_pt_mask;
+static ld_prep_link* s_links;
+static u32 s_links_n;
+static ld_prep_pslot* ld_prep_slot(u64 key, u32 stage, int add)
+{
+    if (!s_pt) return NULL;
+    const u64 k = key ^ ((u64)stage << 56);
+    u32 i = (u32)(k ^ (k >> 31)) & s_pt_mask;
+    for (u32 probes = 0; probes <= s_pt_mask; probes++, i = (i + 1u) & s_pt_mask) {
+        ld_prep_pslot* s = &s_pt[i];
+        if (s->stage == stage && s->key == key) return s;
+        if (!s->stage) {
+            if (!add) return NULL;
+            s->key = key; s->stage = stage; s->head = 0; s->prog = NULL;
+            return s;
+        }
+    }
+    return NULL;
+}
+static int ld_prog_ok(const u8* p, size_t avail, ld_prep_prog** out)
+{
+    *out = NULL;
+    if (avail < 24) return 0;
+    u32 m, stage, size, check; u64 key;
+    memcpy(&m, p, 4); memcpy(&stage, p + 4, 4); memcpy(&key, p + 8, 8); memcpy(&size, p + 16, 4); memcpy(&check, p + 20, 4);
+    if (m != LD_PROG_MAGIC || (stage != 'V' && stage != 'P') || !size || size > LD_PREP_MAX_PROG || (size_t)size + 24 > avail)
+        return 0;
+    if ((u32)fnv1a(p + 24, size, 1469598103934665603ull) != check) return -1;   /* damaged: skip it */
+    ld_prep_prog* g2 = (ld_prep_prog*)malloc(sizeof *g2 + size);
+    if (!g2) return -1;
+    memset(g2, 0, sizeof *g2);
+    g2->key = key; g2->stage = stage; g2->size = size; g2->origin = 2;
+    memcpy(g2->bytes, p + 24, size);
+    *out = g2;
+    return 1;
+}
+static void ld_prog_write(FILE* f, const ld_prep_prog* g2)
+{
+    const u32 m = LD_PROG_MAGIC, check = (u32)fnv1a(g2->bytes, g2->size, 1469598103934665603ull);
+    fwrite(&m, 4, 1, f); fwrite(&g2->stage, 4, 1, f); fwrite(&g2->key, 8, 1, f);
+    fwrite(&g2->size, 4, 1, f); fwrite(&check, 4, 1, f); fwrite(g2->bytes, 1, g2->size, f);
+}
+
+/* The records both parts read: the PC's own (newest first) and then the shipped list, without repeats.
+ * Version-1 records (496 bytes) are converted; a file is one or the other, told by its first record. */
+typedef struct { ld_prep_rec* r; u32 n, own, shipped, damaged, v1; } ld_prep_list;
+static void ld_prep_add_list(ld_prep_list* L, const u8* d, size_t n, u64* seen, u32 seen_mask, int newest_first, u32* added)
+{
+    *added = 0;
+    u32 v = 0, rs = 0;
+    if (n >= 12) { memcpy(&v, d + 4, 4); memcpy(&rs, d + 8, 4); }
+    const size_t rec_size = (v == 1u && rs == LD_PREP_V1_SIZE) ? LD_PREP_V1_SIZE : sizeof(ld_prep_rec);
+    const size_t cnt = n / rec_size;
+    for (size_t j = 0; j < cnt; j++) {
+        const size_t k = newest_first ? cnt - 1 - j : j;
+        ld_prep_rec r;
+        if (rec_size == LD_PREP_V1_SIZE) {
+            if (!ld_prep_rec_from_v1(&r, d + k * rec_size)) { L->damaged++; continue; }
+            L->v1++;
+        } else {
+            memcpy(&r, d + k * rec_size, sizeof r);
+            if (!ld_prep_rec_valid(&r)) { L->damaged++; continue; }
+        }
+        const u64 id = ld_prep_rec_id(&r);
+        u32 i = (u32)(id ^ (id >> 29)) & seen_mask;
+        int dup = 0;
+        while (seen[i]) { if (seen[i] == id) { dup = 1; break; } i = (i + 1u) & seen_mask; }
+        if (dup) continue;
+        seen[i] = id;
+        L->r[L->n++] = r;
+        (*added)++;
+    }
+}
+static int ld_prep_load_lists(ld_prep_list* L)
+{
+    memset(L, 0, sizeof *L);
+    char path[MAX_PATH];
+    size_t n_own = 0, n_ship = 0;
+    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\shader_keys.lst", s_prep_dir);
+    u8* own = ld_prep_read_file(path, &n_own);
+    const char* sp = getenv("LD_PREP_SHIPPED");
+    u8* ship = ld_prep_read_file(sp && sp[0] ? sp : LD_PREP_SHIPPED, &n_ship);
+    const size_t total = n_own / LD_PREP_V1_SIZE + n_ship / LD_PREP_V1_SIZE + 1u;
+    u32 mask = 1023u;
+    while (mask < 2u * total + 1024u) mask = mask * 2u + 1u;
+    u64* seen = (u64*)calloc((size_t)mask + 1u, sizeof *seen);
+    L->r = (ld_prep_rec*)malloc(total * sizeof *L->r);
+    if (!seen || !L->r) { free(seen); free(L->r); L->r = NULL; free(own); free(ship); return 0; }
+    if (own) ld_prep_add_list(L, own, n_own, seen, mask, 1, &L->own);
+    if (ship) ld_prep_add_list(L, ship, n_ship, seen, mask, 0, &L->shipped);
+    free(seen); free(own); free(ship);
+    return 1;
+}
+static int ld_prep_load_programs(u32* n_out)
+{
+    *n_out = 0;
+    char path[MAX_PATH];
+    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\programs.bin", s_prep_dir);
+    size_t n = 0;
+    u8* d = ld_prep_read_file(path, &n);
+    size_t off = 0;
+    while (d && off + 24 <= n) {
+        ld_prep_prog* g2 = NULL;
+        const int ok = ld_prog_ok(d + off, n - off, &g2);
+        if (ok == 0) break;                          /* a torn tail */
+        u32 size; memcpy(&size, d + off + 16, 4);
+        off += 24u + size;
+        if (!g2) continue;
+        ld_prep_pslot* s = ld_prep_slot(g2->key, g2->stage, 1);
+        if (s && !s->prog) { s->prog = g2; (*n_out)++; }
+        else free(g2);
+    }
+    free(d);
+    return 1;
+}
+/* How many programs the store may hold, from its size (a program is at least 24 + 16 bytes; most are
+ * 0.5-8 KB, so this errs high): the table is sized for them and the records' programs together. */
+static u32 ld_prep_prog_hint(void)
+{
+    char p[MAX_PATH];
+    WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA a;
+    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\programs.bin", s_prep_dir);
+    u32 hint = 8192u;
+    if (GetFileAttributesExA(p, GetFileExInfoStandard, &a) && !a.nFileSizeHigh && a.nFileSizeLow / 256u > hint)
+        hint = a.nFileSizeLow / 256u;
+    return hint < (1u << 22) ? hint : (1u << 22);
+}
+static int ld_prep_table_make(u32 n_recs, u32 n_prog_hint)
+{
+    u32 sz = 4096u;
+    while (sz < 2u * (2u * n_recs + n_prog_hint) + 4096u) sz <<= 1;
+    s_pt = (ld_prep_pslot*)calloc(sz, sizeof *s_pt);
+    s_links = (ld_prep_link*)malloc(((size_t)2u * n_recs + 1u) * sizeof *s_links);
+    if (!s_pt || !s_links) { free(s_pt); free(s_links); s_pt = NULL; s_links = NULL; return 0; }
+    s_pt_mask = sz - 1u;
+    s_links_n = 1;   /* 0 = end of a chain */
+    return 1;
+}
+static void ld_prep_link_rec(u32 rec, u64 key, u32 stage)
+{
+    ld_prep_pslot* s = ld_prep_slot(key, stage, 1);
+    if (!s) return;
+    s_links[s_links_n].rec = rec; s_links[s_links_n].next = s->head;
+    s->head = s_links_n++;
+}
+static int ld_prep_rec_ready(u32 i, const ld_prep_rec* recs, ld_prep_prog** vp, ld_prep_prog** fp)
+{
+    const ld_prep_rec* r = &recs[i];
+    const ld_prep_pslot* v = ld_prep_slot(r->vp_key, 'V', 0);
+    const ld_prep_pslot* f = ld_prep_slot(r->fp_key, 'P', 0);
+    ld_prep_prog* a = v ? v->prog : NULL;
+    ld_prep_prog* b = f ? f->prog : NULL;
+    if (!a || !b || a->size != r->vp_instrs * 16u || b->size != r->fp_size) return 0;
+    if (vp) *vp = a;
+    if (fp) *fp = b;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* The release this game is (records carry it; the tools sort lists by it; the game uses any release's). */
+extern const char* cellGame_get_title_id(void);
+extern uint8_t* vm_base;
+static void ld_prep_release(char title[12], u32* eboot_size)
+{
+    static char t[12]; static u32 sz; static int done;
+    if (!done) {
+        done = 1;
+        const char* id = cellGame_get_title_id();
+        snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%s", id ? id : "");
+        WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA a;
+        if (GetFileAttributesExA("input\\EBOOT.elf", GetFileExInfoStandard, &a)) sz = a.nFileSizeLow;
+    }
+    memcpy(title, t, 12);
+    *eboot_size = sz;
+}
+
+/* ---- in the game ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
+static volatile LONG s_prep_ready;
+static ld_prep_list s_pl;
+static u8* s_rec_state;              /* 0 waiting for a program, 1 queued, 2 done or skipped (walker) */
+static SRWLOCK s_prep_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
+static ld_prep_prog* s_new_file;     /* programs first used or found this session, for programs.bin */
+static ld_prep_prog* s_new_walk;     /* ... and for the walker's table */
+static ld_prep_rec* s_rec_pend; static u32 s_rec_pend_n, s_rec_pend_cap;
+static u64* s_noted; static u32 s_noted_n;               /* walker: record ids noted this session */
+static u64* s_seen_prog; static u32 s_seen_prog_n;       /* walker: program keys handled this session */
+#define LD_PREP_SEEN (1u << 18)   /* [found] was 65536: s_sent also holds the files' texts (tens of thousands) */
+static struct {
+    volatile LONG64 noted, programs, built, built_fail, used, translate_fail, other_settings, check_same, check_diff,
+                    known, full, work_qpc, translated;
+    u32 n_prog_file;
+} s_pst;
+
+static int ld_prep_set_add(u64** set, u32* n, u64 key)
+{
+    if (!*set) *set = (u64*)calloc(LD_PREP_SEEN, sizeof **set);
+    if (!*set || *n >= LD_PREP_SEEN / 2u) return 0;
+    if (!key) key = 1u;
+    u32 i = (u32)(key ^ (key >> 31)) & (LD_PREP_SEEN - 1u);
+    while ((*set)[i]) { if ((*set)[i] == key) return 0; i = (i + 1u) & (LD_PREP_SEEN - 1u); }
+    (*set)[i] = key; (*n)++;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* Shaders made ahead and not yet asked for (walker): by length and two hashes of the text. */
+typedef struct { u64 key, h2; u32 stage, len; u8* blob; u32 blob_len; u32 used; } ld_prep_built;
+#define LD_PREP_BUILT 16384u
+#define LD_PREP_BUILT_MAX 8192u              /* about 50 MB of compiled shaders at most */
+static ld_prep_built* s_built; static u32 s_built_n;
+
+static u64 ld_prep_h2(const char* src, u32 len) { return ld_fast_hash(src, len, 0x50524550ull); }
+static ld_prep_built* ld_prep_built_slot(u32 stage, u64 hash, u32 len, int add)
+{
+    if (!s_built) {
+        if (!add) return NULL;
+        s_built = (ld_prep_built*)calloc(LD_PREP_BUILT, sizeof *s_built);
+        if (!s_built) return NULL;
+    }
+    const u64 key = shader_mem_key(stage, hash, len);
+    u32 i = (u32)(key ^ (key >> 29)) & (LD_PREP_BUILT - 1u);
+    while (s_built[i].key) {
+        if (s_built[i].key == key && s_built[i].stage == stage && s_built[i].len == len) return &s_built[i];
+        i = (i + 1u) & (LD_PREP_BUILT - 1u);
+    }
+    if (!add || s_built_n >= LD_PREP_BUILT_MAX) return NULL;
+    s_built[i].key = key; s_built[i].stage = stage; s_built[i].len = len;
+    s_built_n++;
+    return &s_built[i];
+}
+
+/* shader_disk_cache_load_raw, for a shader not in the pack: one made ahead with exactly this text.
+ * The walker's alone (it is the only caller of the cache loads). A copy, as ld_blob_private does. */
+static ID3DBlob* ld_prep_lookup(u32 stage, const char* source, u32 length, u64 hash)
+{
+    if (!s_built_n) return NULL;
+    ld_prep_built* b = ld_prep_built_slot(stage, hash, length, 0);
+    if (!b || !b->blob || b->h2 != ld_prep_h2(source, length)) return NULL;
+    ID3DBlob* out = NULL;
+    if (FAILED(D3DCreateBlob(b->blob_len, &out)) || !out) return NULL;
+    memcpy(out->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(out), b->blob, b->blob_len);
+    if (!b->used) { b->used = 1; InterlockedIncrement64(&s_pst.used); }
+    return out;
+}
+
+/* [found] every program of the game's files, by their containers (no list) */
+#include "rsx_shader_found.inc"   /* .inc: see above */
+
+/* ---- the game's own making ahead: a queue of records and threads that translate and compile ---------- *
+ * A worker takes a record whose programs are known, translates it (any thread may: see ld_prep_translate),
+ * compiles the texts the pack doesn't hold and nobody else took, saves them as the game's compiles are
+ * saved, and leaves the bytes for the walker (ld_prep_tick), which hands them to the first draw that asks.
+ * "Needed now" always beats "maybe later":
+ *  - the gate (ld_prep_gate_main): while the game's compile pool has work queued or running, or the
+ *    made-ahead list's threads are still making pipelines, the gate is shut; workers finish the shader in
+ *    hand and take nothing new, the memory scan waits; the gate opens 100 ms after the pool went idle.
+ *    Polled every 5 ms from the pool's own state, not from priorities or frame times.
+ *  - no second copy where it is free: a text a worker is compiling is in the in-flight table; a pool thread
+ *    given the same text by a draw takes the worker's result only if it is out already, else compiles the text
+ *    itself ([stall], 19 Nov: no pool thread waits for a worker); a text a draw's pipeline has (noted in
+ *    ld_prep_note before its compile starts) is never taken by a worker.
+ *  - workers: none without a backlog, 1-2 with a short one, with a long one the processors the game leaves
+ *    free, never more than half the logical processors nor (logical - pool threads running - 2)
+ *    (ld_prep_control, every 250 ms). Below normal priority. */
+typedef struct { u32 rec; ld_prep_prog* vp; ld_prep_prog* fp; } ld_prep_item;
+typedef struct ld_prep_done { struct ld_prep_done* next; u32 stage, len; u64 hash, h2; u8* blob; u32 blob_len, found; } ld_prep_done;
+static ld_prep_item* s_qhi; static u32 s_qhi_r, s_qhi_w;   /* a program was just used or found: first */
+static ld_prep_item* s_qn;  static u32 s_qn_r, s_qn_w;     /* known at start, in list order */
+static volatile LONG* s_rec_taken;                         /* a worker took the record (a record may be queued twice) */
+static SRWLOCK s_q_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
+static CONDITION_VARIABLE s_q_wake = CONDITION_VARIABLE_INIT;
+static volatile LONG s_active, s_busy;
+static HANDLE s_wth[64]; static u32 s_wth_n;
+static ld_prep_done* s_done;                                /* under s_q_lock */
+static u64* s_sent; static u32 s_sent_n;                    /* texts a worker took or a draw has, under s_q_lock */
+static volatile LONG s_cfg_cur;                              /* the settings now, for the workers */
+/* [found] programs of the game's files (rsx_shader_found.inc), after every record: [0] each program's likeliest text,
+ * [1] the next ranks, in the order they come back; under s_q_lock */
+static ld_found_item* s_qf[2]; static u32 s_qf_r[2], s_qf_w[2], s_qf_cap[2];
+static void ld_prep_found_push(const ld_found* f, u32 rank)
+{
+    const int q = rank ? 1 : 0;
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    if (s_qf_r[q] && s_qf_r[q] == s_qf_w[q]) s_qf_r[q] = s_qf_w[q] = 0;
+    if (s_qf_w[q] == s_qf_cap[q]) {
+        const u32 nc = s_qf_cap[q] ? s_qf_cap[q] * 2u : 4096u;
+        ld_found_item* p = (ld_found_item*)realloc(s_qf[q], (size_t)nc * sizeof *p);
+        if (p) { s_qf[q] = p; s_qf_cap[q] = nc; }
+    }
+    int pushed = 0;
+    if (s_qf_w[q] < s_qf_cap[q]) { s_qf[q][s_qf_w[q]].f = f; s_qf[q][s_qf_w[q]].rank = rank; s_qf_w[q]++; pushed = 1; }
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    if (pushed) WakeAllConditionVariable(&s_q_wake);
+}
+
+/* The gate. */
+static volatile LONG s_gate_open = 1;
+static volatile LONG64 s_gate_closed_at, s_paused_qpc;      /* when it shut; time shut, summed */
+static volatile LONG64 s_adopted, s_adopt_wait_qpc;          /* pool compiles served by a worker's result */
+static int ld_prep_game_busy(void)
+{
+    if (s_cpool_head || s_cpool_hi_head) return 1;                 /* queued (a racy look is enough) */
+    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_cp_running, 0, 0) > 0) return 1;   /* running, or waiting for a shader */
+    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_ahead_ready, 0, 0) && InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_ahead_next, 0, 0) < (LONG)s_ahead_n)
+        return 1;                                                  /* the made-ahead list's pipelines */
+    return 0;
+}
+static DWORD WINAPI ld_prep_gate_main(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_ABOVE_NORMAL);   /* it must see the pool promptly */
+    LARGE_INTEGER fq; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&fq);
+    const LONGLONG idle_needed = fq.QuadPart / 10;                         /* 100 ms */
+    LONGLONG last_busy = 0;
+    for (;;) {
+        Sleep(5);
+        LARGE_INTEGER q; QueryPerformanceCounter(&q);
+        if (ld_prep_game_busy()) {
+            last_busy = q.QuadPart;
+            if (s_gate_open) {
+                s_gate_closed_at = q.QuadPart;
+                InterlockedExchange(&s_gate_open, 0);
+            }
+        } else if (!s_gate_open && q.QuadPart - last_busy >= idle_needed) {
+            InterlockedAdd64(&s_paused_qpc, q.QuadPart - s_gate_closed_at);
+            AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+            InterlockedExchange(&s_gate_open, 1);
+            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+            WakeAllConditionVariable(&s_q_wake);
+        }
+    }
+}
+/* Time the gate was shut, summed, the current stretch included (for the 5 s line). */
+static LONG64 ld_prep_paused_total(void)
+{
+    LONG64 t = s_paused_qpc;
+    if (!s_gate_open) { LARGE_INTEGER q; QueryPerformanceCounter(&q); t += q.QuadPart - s_gate_closed_at; }
+    return t;
+}
+
+/* The in-flight table: texts a worker is compiling right now, and their results for any pool thread
+ * waiting for them. Under s_q_lock; a slot is free again when its result is out and nobody waits. */
+typedef struct { u64 key, h2; u8* blob; u32 blob_len; LONG used, done, waiters; } ld_prep_fl;
+#define LD_PREP_FL 128
+static ld_prep_fl s_fl[LD_PREP_FL];
+static volatile LONG s_fl_used;
+static CONDITION_VARIABLE s_fl_cv = CONDITION_VARIABLE_INIT;
+static int ld_prep_fl_take(u64 key, u64 h2)               /* s_q_lock held; -1 = no room (compiled anyway) */
+{
+    for (int i = 0; i < (int)LD_PREP_FL; i++)
+        if (!s_fl[i].used) {
+            memset(&s_fl[i], 0, sizeof s_fl[i]);
+            s_fl[i].used = 1; s_fl[i].key = key; s_fl[i].h2 = h2;
+            InterlockedIncrement(&s_fl_used);
+            return i;
+        }
+    return -1;
+}
+static void ld_prep_fl_put(int i, const u8* blob, u32 blob_len)   /* s_q_lock held */
+{
+    if (i < 0) return;
+    ld_prep_fl* f = &s_fl[i];
+    f->done = 1;
+    if (f->waiters && blob && (f->blob = (u8*)malloc(blob_len)) != NULL) { memcpy(f->blob, blob, blob_len); f->blob_len = blob_len; }
+    if (!f->waiters) { f->used = 0; InterlockedDecrement(&s_fl_used); }
+}
+/* ld_cpool_compile, on a pool thread: a draw's shader a worker has compiled and not handed over yet: the result
+ * as a blob of this thread's own. 0: compile it as usual, also while the worker is still compiling it ([stall]:
+ * a pool thread never sleeps on a worker). */
+static int ld_prep_adopt(const ld_shader_job* j, ID3DBlob** out)
+{
+    *out = NULL;
+    if (!InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_fl_used, 0, 0) || !j->source) return 0;
+    const u64 key = shader_mem_key(j->stage, j->hash, j->length);
+    const u64 h2 = ld_prep_h2(j->source, j->length);
+    LARGE_INTEGER c0, c1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&c0);
+    u8* bytes = NULL; u32 n = 0;
+    int found = 0;
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    for (int i = 0; i < (int)LD_PREP_FL; i++) {
+        ld_prep_fl* f = &s_fl[i];
+        if (!f->used || f->key != key || f->h2 != h2) continue;
+        /* [stall] Never wait here for a worker: a pool thread compiles the text itself unless the worker's result is
+         * already out (a second compile of one shader costs less than any wait on a thread the gate can park). */
+        if (!f->done) break;
+        found = 1;
+        f->waiters++;
+        if (f->blob && (bytes = (u8*)malloc(f->blob_len)) != NULL) { memcpy(bytes, f->blob, f->blob_len); n = f->blob_len; }
+        if (--f->waiters == 0) { free(f->blob); f->blob = NULL; f->used = 0; InterlockedDecrement(&s_fl_used); }
+        break;
+    }
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    if (!found || !bytes) { free(bytes); return 0; }   /* not in flight, or the worker's compile failed */
+    ID3DBlob* b = NULL;
+    if (SUCCEEDED(D3DCreateBlob(n, &b)) && b) memcpy(b->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(b), bytes, n);
+    free(bytes);
+    if (!b) return 0;
+    QueryPerformanceCounter(&c1);
+    InterlockedIncrement64(&s_adopted);
+    InterlockedAdd64(&s_adopt_wait_qpc, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart);
+    *out = b;
+    return 1;
+}
+/* A text a draw's pipeline has: no worker takes it (ld_prep_note, before the draw's compile starts). */
+static void ld_prep_sent_mark(u32 stage, const char* src)
+{
+    const u32 len = (u32)strlen(src);
+    const u64 qk = shader_mem_key(stage, fnv1a(src, len, 1469598103934665603ull), len);
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    ld_prep_set_add(&s_sent, &s_sent_n, qk);
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+}
+
+static u32 ld_prep_backlog(void)
+{
+    return (s_qhi_w - s_qhi_r) + (s_qn_w - s_qn_r) + (s_qf_w[0] - s_qf_r[0]) + (s_qf_w[1] - s_qf_r[1]) + (u32)s_busy;
+}
+/* One text a worker made: compiled unless the pack has it, a draw has it or another worker took it; the result
+ * to the in-flight table (pool threads) and to the walker (ld_prep_tick), and saved as the game's compiles are.
+ * 0 in the pack, 1 compiled, 2 a draw or another worker has it, -1 failed. found: a text of the files' programs
+ * ([found]: the walker keeps a quarter of its table for the records'). */
+static int ld_prep_make_text(u32 stage, const char* src, u32 found)
+{
+    const u32 len = (u32)strlen(src);
+    const u64 h = fnv1a(src, len, 1469598103934665603ull);
+    const u64 qk = shader_mem_key(stage, h, len);
+    const u64 h2 = ld_prep_h2(src, len);
+    /* In the pack with this exact text: nothing to do (the table is read-only once ready). */
+    const shader_mem_entry* e = InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_shader_mem_ready, 0, 0) ? shader_mem_get(qk) : NULL;
+    if (e && e->size >= sizeof(shader_disk_cache_header) + len &&
+        memcmp(e->data + sizeof(shader_disk_cache_header), src, len) == 0) return 0;
+    /* The game's work first: wait for the gate between shaders too. Then take the text (unless a
+     * draw has it or another worker took it) into the in-flight table, and from here on wait for
+     * nothing until its result is out. */
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    while (!s_gate_open || ld_prep_game_busy())
+        SleepConditionVariableSRW(&s_q_wake, &s_q_lock, s_gate_open ? 10u : INFINITE, 0);
+    const int mine = ld_prep_set_add(&s_sent, &s_sent_n, qk);
+    const int fl = mine ? ld_prep_fl_take(qk, h2) : -1;
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    if (!mine) return 2;
+    ID3DBlob* blob = NULL; ID3DBlob* err = NULL;
+    const HRESULT hr = D3DCompile(src, len, stage == 'P' ? "xps" : "xvs", NULL, NULL, "main",
+                                  stage == 'P' ? "ps_5_0" : "vs_5_0", 0, 0, &blob, &err);
+    ld_prep_done* d = NULL;
+    if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && blob) {
+        const SIZE_T bl = blob->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(blob);
+        d = (ld_prep_done*)calloc(1, sizeof *d);
+        if (d && bl && (d->blob = (u8*)malloc(bl)) != NULL) {
+            memcpy(d->blob, blob->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(blob), bl);
+            d->blob_len = (u32)bl; d->stage = stage; d->len = len; d->hash = h; d->h2 = h2; d->found = found;
+        } else { free(d); d = NULL; }
+        shader_disk_cache_store(stage, src, len, h, blob);   /* as the game's own compiles */
+        blob->lpVtbl->Release(blob);
+    } else InterlockedIncrement64(&s_pst.built_fail);
+    if (err) err->lpVtbl->Release(err);
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    ld_prep_fl_put(fl, d ? d->blob : NULL, d ? d->blob_len : 0u);
+    if (d) { d->next = s_done; s_done = d; }
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    WakeAllConditionVariable(&s_fl_cv);
+    return d ? 1 : -1;
+}
+/* [found] a found item's text (ld_found_work's job): made, remembered as predicted, counted */
+static int ld_prep_found_text(void* ctx, u32 stage, const char* src)
+{
+    (void)ctx;
+    ld_found_text_made(stage, src);
+    InterlockedIncrement64(&s_fp_texts);
+    const int r = ld_prep_make_text(stage, src, 1u);
+    InterlockedIncrement64(r == 1 ? &s_fp_made : r == 0 ? &s_fp_cached : r == 2 ? &s_fp_other : &s_fp_failed);
+    return 0;
+}
+static DWORD WINAPI ld_prep_worker(LPVOID arg)
+{
+    const LONG me = (LONG)(intptr_t)arg;
+    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL);
+    { HRESULT (WINAPI *sd)(HANDLE, PCWSTR) = (HRESULT (WINAPI*)(HANDLE, PCWSTR))
+          (void*)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("kernel32.dll"), "SetThreadDescription");
+      if (sd) sd(GetCurrentThread(), L"rsx shader prepare"); }
+    char* vs = (char*)malloc(256u * 1024u);
+    char* ps = (char*)malloc(256u * 1024u);
+    char* fb = NULL; char* fo = NULL;   /* [found] made the first time a found item comes */
+    if (!vs || !ps) return 0;
+    for (;;) {
+        ld_prep_item it;
+        ld_found_item fi; int is_found = 0;
+        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+        for (;;) {
+            const int work = me < s_active && (s_qhi_r < s_qhi_w || s_qn_r < s_qn_w || s_qf_r[0] < s_qf_w[0] ||
+                                               s_qf_r[1] < s_qf_w[1]);
+            if (work && s_gate_open && !ld_prep_game_busy()) break;
+            /* Woken by a push, a change of s_active or the gate opening; only with work and the gate still open
+             * over a busy pool (the gate's 5 ms poll not round yet) is it looked at again in 10 ms. */
+            SleepConditionVariableSRW(&s_q_wake, &s_q_lock, work && s_gate_open ? 10u : INFINITE, 0);
+        }
+        if (s_qhi_r < s_qhi_w) it = s_qhi[s_qhi_r++];
+        else if (s_qn_r < s_qn_w) it = s_qn[s_qn_r++];
+        else { const int q = s_qf_r[0] < s_qf_w[0] ? 0 : 1; fi = s_qf[q][s_qf_r[q]++]; is_found = 1; }
+        InterlockedIncrement(&s_busy);
+        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+        LARGE_INTEGER c0, c1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&c0);
+        if (is_found) {   /* [found] a program of the game's files: its texts, made as a record's are */
+            if (!fb) fb = (char*)malloc(256u * 1024u);
+            if (!fo) fo = (char*)malloc(64u * 1024u);
+            if (fb && fo) ld_found_work(&fi, ld_prep_found_text, NULL, vs, fb, fo);
+            QueryPerformanceCounter(&c1);
+            InterlockedAdd64(&s_pst.work_qpc, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart);
+            InterlockedDecrement(&s_busy);
+            continue;
+        }
+        const ld_prep_rec* r = &s_pl.r[it.rec];
+        if (InterlockedExchange(&s_rec_taken[it.rec], 1)) { InterlockedDecrement(&s_busy); continue; }   /* queued twice */
+        if (!ld_prep_usable(r, (u32)s_cfg_cur)) InterlockedIncrement64(&s_pst.other_settings);
+        else if (!ld_prep_translate(r, it.vp->bytes, it.fp->bytes, vs, 256u * 1024u, ps, 256u * 1024u))
+            InterlockedIncrement64(&s_pst.translate_fail);
+        else {
+            InterlockedIncrement64(&s_pst.translated);
+            ld_prep_make_text('V', vs, 0u);   /* [found] the per-text work, shared with the found items */
+            ld_prep_make_text('P', ps, 0u);
+        }
+        QueryPerformanceCounter(&c1);
+        InterlockedAdd64(&s_pst.work_qpc, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart);
+        InterlockedDecrement(&s_busy);
+    }
+}
+static void ld_prep_set_active(LONG n)
+{
+    if (n > (LONG)s_wth_n) {   /* threads are made the first time they are wanted, and stay */
+        const u32 want = (u32)n < 64u ? (u32)n : 64u;
+        while (s_wth_n < want) {
+            HANDLE t = CreateThread(NULL, 1u << 20, ld_prep_worker, (LPVOID)(intptr_t)s_wth_n, 0, NULL);
+            if (!t) break;
+            s_wth[s_wth_n++] = t;
+        }
+        if (n > (LONG)s_wth_n) n = (LONG)s_wth_n;
+    }
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    s_active = n;
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    WakeAllConditionVariable(&s_q_wake);
+}
+static void ld_prep_push(const ld_prep_item* it, int hi)
+{
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    if (hi) s_qhi[s_qhi_w++] = *it; else s_qn[s_qn_w++] = *it;
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    WakeAllConditionVariable(&s_q_wake);
+}
+
+static void ld_prep_first_diff(const char* what, const char* a, const char* b)
+{
+    size_t i = 0;
+    while (a[i] && a[i] == b[i]) i++;
+    const size_t from = i > 40 ? i - 40 : 0;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] check: the %s differs at byte %zu: draw \"%.80s\" record \"%.80s\"\n",
+            what, i, a + from, b + from);
+}
+
+/* get_pso, a new pipeline with both texts made: note it (once a session) and its programs (once ever).
+ * vs/ps are the texts build_pso is about to get. */
+static void ld_prep_note(u32 vp_start, const u8* vp_uc, u32 vp_instrs, const u8* fp_uc, u32 fp_size, u32 fp_ctrl,
+    u32 cube_mask, u32 vol_mask, u32 vtex_mask, u32 shadow_mask, const rsx_fp_shadow_desc* shadow,
+    const u8* gamma, u32 expand_units, const u8* expand, u32 srgb_output, int wpos_scaled, int wpos_rs,
+    const u32 wpos_grid[2], int branch_used, u32 branch_bits, u32 unnorm_mask, const u32 unnorm_dim[][3],
+    u32 n_consts, int mv_built, const render_state_t* rs, const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* masked_layout,
+    int packed_payload, const char* vs, const char* ps)
+{
+    if (!ld_prep_on()) return;
+    /* This draw's texts are compiled by the game now (or found ready): no worker takes them later. */
+    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_prep_ready, 0, 0)) { ld_prep_sent_mark('V', vs); ld_prep_sent_mark('P', ps); }
+    if (ld_prep_debug_edits() || !ld_fp_constants_buffered()) return;
+    if (!vp_uc || !fp_uc || !vp_instrs || !fp_size || fp_size > LD_PREP_MAX_PROG || fp_size < 16u) return;
+    if (unnorm_mask)
+        for (u32 u = 0; u < 16; u++)
+            for (u32 k = 0; k < 3; k++) if (unnorm_dim[u][k] > 0xFFFFu) return;
+    const u64 vp_key = ld_prep_vp_key(vp_uc, vp_instrs * 16u);
+    const u64 fp_key = rsx_fp_structural_hash(fp_uc, fp_size, 1469598103934665603ull);
+    if (!fp_key) return;
+    ld_found_met(vp_key, fp_key, vs, ps);   /* [found] were its texts predicted from the files? */
+    ld_prep_rec r;
+    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
+    r.magic = LD_PREP_MAGIC; r.version = LD_PREP_VERSION; r.size = (u32)sizeof r;
+    r.vp_key = vp_key; r.fp_key = fp_key;
+    r.vp_instrs = vp_instrs; r.vp_start = vp_start; r.fp_size = fp_size; r.fp_ctrl = fp_ctrl;
+    r.cube_mask = cube_mask; r.vol_mask = vol_mask; r.vtex_mask = vtex_mask; r.shadow_mask = shadow_mask;
+    if (shadow_mask) memcpy(r.shadow, shadow, sizeof r.shadow);
+    memcpy(r.gamma, gamma, 16);
+    r.expand_units = expand_units;
+    if (expand_units) memcpy(r.expand, expand, 16);
+    r.srgb_output = srgb_output;
+    if (wpos_rs) { r.flags |= LD_PREP_F_WPOS_RS; r.wpos_x = wpos_grid[0]; r.wpos_y = wpos_grid[1]; }
+    else if (wpos_scaled) { r.flags |= LD_PREP_F_WPOS_GRID; r.wpos_x = wpos_grid[0]; r.wpos_y = wpos_grid[1]; }
+    if (branch_used) { r.flags |= LD_PREP_F_BRANCH; r.branch_bits = branch_bits; }
+    r.unnorm_mask = unnorm_mask;
+    if (unnorm_mask)
+        for (u32 u = 0; u < 16; u++)
+            for (u32 k = 0; k < 3; k++) r.unnorm_dim[u][k] = (u16)unnorm_dim[u][k];
+    r.n_consts = n_consts;
+    if (mv_built) r.flags |= LD_PREP_F_MV;
+    r.rs = *rs;
+    if (rs->rt_count & LD_RT_UPRES) r.flags |= LD_PREP_F_UPRES;
+    if (masked_layout) {
+        r.flags |= LD_PREP_F_MASKED;
+        if (packed_payload) r.flags |= LD_PREP_F_PACKED;
+        r.layout_mask = masked_layout->mask;
+        r.layout_count = masked_layout->count < RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR ? masked_layout->count : RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR;
+        memcpy(r.attrs, masked_layout->attrs, r.layout_count);
+    }
+    /* What of its text the settings make (see the top). */
+    const u32 targets = rs->rt_count & 0xFFu;
+    if (shadow_mask) r.flags |= LD_PREP_D_SHADOW;
+    if (strstr(ps, "_rsx_wpos(input.position)")) r.flags |= LD_PREP_D_SCALE;   /* grid line or scale line */
+    for (u32 u = 0; u < 16 && unnorm_mask; u++) {
+        /* a depth texture read by texel takes its zeta snapshot's host size (get_pso): scale-made */
+        if (!(unnorm_mask & (1u << u))) continue;
+        rsx_dsp_texture tx;
+        rsx_dsp_get_texture(&g.rsx, u, &tx);
+        const u32 f = tx.format & TEX_FMT_BASE_MASK & ~(u32)TEX_FMT_UNNORM;
+        if (f == TEX_FMT_DEPTH24_D8 || f == TEX_FMT_DEPTH16) { r.flags |= LD_PREP_D_SCALE; break; }
+    }
+    if (rs->slope_bias) r.flags |= LD_PREP_D_SCALE_PSO;
+    if (mv_built || (rs->depth_test && rs->depth_write && targets == 1u)) r.flags |= LD_PREP_D_MV;
+    if (rs->rt_count & LD_RT_UPRES) r.flags |= LD_PREP_D_UPRES;
+    else if (!rs->depth_test && !rs->blend_enable && targets == 1u) {
+        /* the scene's copy into the display buffer would get the one-tap edit with the upscaler on */
+        static char scratch[256 * 1024];
+        const size_t n = strlen(ps);
+        if (n + 64u < sizeof scratch) {
+            memcpy(scratch, ps, n + 1u);
+            if (ld_up_apply_resolve(scratch, sizeof scratch)) r.flags |= LD_PREP_D_UPRES;
+        }
+    }
+    r.cfg = ld_prep_cfg_now();
+    r.fp_head = ld_prep_head(fp_uc); r.vp_head = ld_prep_vp_head(vp_uc);
+    ld_prep_release(r.title, &r.eboot_size);
+    ld_prep_rec_seal(&r);
+    /* The check: the record must give back exactly the texts the draw made. */
+    static int check_all = -1;
+    if (check_all < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_PREP_CHECK"); check_all = e && atoi(e) != 0; }
+    if (check_all || s_pst.check_same + s_pst.check_diff < 16) {
+        static char cvs[256 * 1024], cps[256 * 1024];
+        const int ok = ld_prep_translate(&r, vp_uc, fp_uc, cvs, sizeof cvs, cps, sizeof cps);
+        const int same = ok && strcmp(cvs, vs) == 0 && strcmp(cps, ps) == 0;
+        if (same) s_pst.check_same++;
+        else {
+            s_pst.check_diff++;
+            if (s_pst.check_diff <= 4) {
+                if (!ok) fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] check: the record did not translate (flags 0x%X)\n", r.flags);
+                else if (strcmp(cvs, vs) != 0) ld_prep_first_diff("vertex shader", vs, cvs);
+                else ld_prep_first_diff("pixel shader", ps, cps);
+            }
+            return;   /* a record that doesn't give the draw's text back is not kept */
+        }
+    }
+    const u64 id = ld_prep_rec_id(&r);
+    if (ld_prep_set_add(&s_noted, &s_noted_n, id)) {
+        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_prep_lock);
+        if (s_rec_pend_n == s_rec_pend_cap) {
+            const u32 nc = s_rec_pend_cap ? s_rec_pend_cap * 2u : 256u;
+            ld_prep_rec* p = (ld_prep_rec*)realloc(s_rec_pend, (size_t)nc * sizeof *p);
+            if (p) { s_rec_pend = p; s_rec_pend_cap = nc; }
+        }
+        if (s_rec_pend_n < s_rec_pend_cap) s_rec_pend[s_rec_pend_n++] = r;
+        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_prep_lock);
+        InterlockedIncrement64(&s_pst.noted);
+    }
+    /* The programs, the first time this session: to the store, and to the walker's table, where they
+     * free the listed pipelines that waited for them. */
+    for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
+        const u32 stage = k ? 'P' : 'V';
+        const u64 key = k ? fp_key : vp_key;
+        if (!ld_prep_set_add(&s_seen_prog, &s_seen_prog_n, key ^ ((u64)stage << 56))) continue;
+        ld_found_drawn(key, stage);   /* [found] known from the game's files before this draw? */
+        { static u32 said;   /* the first ones, against the scan's lines: was it in memory before this draw? */
+          const ld_prep_pslot* s = InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_prep_ready, 0, 0) ? ld_prep_slot(key, stage, 0) : NULL;
+          if (k && said < 24 && vm_base && fp_uc >= vm_base && fp_uc < vm_base + 0x100000000ull) {
+              said++;
+              const char* fw = ld_found_where(key, stage);   /* [found] */
+              fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] t=%.1f s: first draw of fragment program %016llX, fetched at guest 0x%08X; %s\n",
+                      ld_uptime_s(), (unsigned long long)key, (unsigned)(fp_uc - vm_base),
+                      fw ? fw : !s ? "in no list" : s->prog ? (s->prog->origin == 1 ? "found in memory before" : "stored") :
+                      "listed, not found before");
+          } }
+        const u32 size = k ? fp_size : vp_instrs * 16u;
+        ld_prep_prog* g2 = (ld_prep_prog*)malloc(sizeof *g2 + size);
+        if (!g2) continue;
+        memset(g2, 0, sizeof *g2);
+        g2->key = key; g2->stage = stage; g2->size = size;
+        memcpy(g2->bytes, k ? fp_uc : vp_uc, size);
+        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_prep_lock);
+        g2->next_file = s_new_file; s_new_file = g2;
+        g2->next_walk = s_new_walk; s_new_walk = g2;
+        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_prep_lock);
+    }
+}
+
+/* The walker, at every present: the shaders the workers finished into the table draws look in, the
+ * programs met this session into the program table (their waiting records to the front of the queue),
+ * and the frame's time for ld_prep_control. No translation or compile here. */
+static volatile LONG64 s_tick_n, s_tick_gap_sum, s_tick_gap_max;
+static void ld_prep_tick(void)
+{
+    if (!ld_prep_on() || !InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_prep_ready, 0, 0)) return;
+    { static LONGLONG last;
+      LARGE_INTEGER q; QueryPerformanceCounter(&q);
+      if (last) {
+          const LONG64 gap = q.QuadPart - last;
+          InterlockedAdd64(&s_tick_gap_sum, gap);
+          if (gap > s_tick_gap_max) s_tick_gap_max = gap;
+          InterlockedIncrement64(&s_tick_n);
+      }
+      last = q.QuadPart; }
+    ld_prep_done* d;
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    d = s_done; s_done = NULL;
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_q_lock);
+    while (d) {
+        ld_prep_done* next = d->next;
+        /* [found] the files' texts leave a quarter of the table to the records' (they are saved in the cache anyway) */
+        ld_prep_built* b = d->found && s_built_n >= LD_PREP_BUILT_MAX / 4u * 3u ? NULL
+                           : ld_prep_built_slot(d->stage, d->hash, d->len, 1);
+        if (b && !b->blob) {
+            b->blob = d->blob; b->blob_len = d->blob_len; b->h2 = d->h2; d->blob = NULL;
+            InterlockedIncrement64(&s_pst.built);
+        } else if (!b) InterlockedIncrement64(&s_pst.full);
+        free(d->blob); free(d);
+        d = next;
+    }
+    ld_prep_prog* nw;
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_prep_lock);
+    nw = s_new_walk; s_new_walk = NULL;
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_prep_lock);
+    for (; nw; nw = nw->next_walk) {
+        ld_prep_pslot* s = ld_prep_slot(nw->key, nw->stage, 0);
+        if (!s) continue;                          /* in no list: nothing waits for it */
+        if (s->prog && nw->origin != 0) continue;  /* found in memory, already known */
+        if (!s->prog) s->prog = nw;
+        /* Its records to the front of the queue: those that waited for it, and, when a draw has just used
+         * it, those already queued behind others (each record goes to the front once; a worker takes a
+         * record once, s_rec_taken). States: 0 waiting, 1 queued, 3 queued at the front, 2 skipped. */
+        for (u32 l = s->head; l; l = s_links[l].next) {
+            const u32 i = s_links[l].rec;
+            ld_prep_item it;
+            if (s_rec_state[i] == 0) {
+                if (!ld_prep_rec_ready(i, s_pl.r, &it.vp, &it.fp)) continue;
+            } else if (s_rec_state[i] == 1 && nw->origin == 0 && !s_rec_taken[i]) {
+                if (!ld_prep_rec_ready(i, s_pl.r, &it.vp, &it.fp)) continue;
+            } else continue;
+            s_rec_state[i] = 3;
+            it.rec = i;
+            if (ld_prep_build_on()) ld_prep_push(&it, 1);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/* ---- the memory scan --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *
+ * While listed programs are not known yet (LD_PREP_SCAN=0: never): find them in guest memory as the game
+ * loads them (a track's or car's during its loading screen), not at their first draw. A pass hashes each
+ * 64 KB of committed guest memory, skips the pieces that are as they were, and at every 16 bytes of the
+ * rest compares a hash of the 16 bytes with the first-16-byte hashes of the listed programs not known yet
+ * (a bitmap first); a candidate is checked by the program's own key over its listed length. A pass runs
+ * when the game has read a lot from disc (4 MB since the last pass) and its reading paused for 0.5 s or
+ * 2 s went by, or once a minute after any reading; its cost is held to 1 s of one thread in any 5 s.
+ * A program found goes to the walker's table as one the game used (and to the store). One found that a
+ * draw had already met counts as "after its first draw". The thread ends once every listed program is
+ * known. "[shader-prep] scan" lines every 5 s with a pass. */
+typedef struct { u32 head, stage, size, pad; u64 key; } ld_scan_ent;
+static ld_scan_ent* s_se; static u32 s_se_n;
+static u8* s_bloom;                     /* 1 << 20 bits by head */
+static volatile LONG64 s_scan_found, s_scan_late, s_scan_bytes, s_scan_sweeps, s_scan_found_v;
+static HANDLE s_scan_th;
+static int ld_scan_cmp(const void* a, const void* b)
+{
+    const ld_scan_ent* x = (const ld_scan_ent*)a;
+    const ld_scan_ent* y = (const ld_scan_ent*)b;
+    if (x->head != y->head) return x->head < y->head ? -1 : 1;
+    if (x->stage != y->stage) return x->stage < y->stage ? -1 : 1;
+    if (x->key != y->key) return x->key < y->key ? -1 : 1;
+    return 0;
+}
+static int ld_prep_scan_on(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_PREP_SCAN"); on = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
+    return on;
+}
+/* The listed programs without bytes (the loader's, before ready). */
+static void ld_scan_index(void)
+{
+    s_se = (ld_scan_ent*)malloc(((size_t)2u * s_pl.n + 1u) * sizeof *s_se);
+    s_bloom = (u8*)calloc(1u << 17, 1);
+    if (!s_se || !s_bloom) { s_se_n = 0; return; }
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_pl.n; i++) {
+        const ld_prep_rec* r = &s_pl.r[i];
+        if (!r->fp_head && !r->vp_head) continue;
+        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
+            const u32 stage = k ? 'P' : 'V';
+            const ld_prep_pslot* s = ld_prep_slot(k ? r->fp_key : r->vp_key, stage, 0);
+            if (!s || s->prog) continue;   /* its bytes are known already */
+            ld_scan_ent* e = &s_se[s_se_n++];
+            e->head = k ? r->fp_head : r->vp_head; e->stage = stage; e->key = k ? r->fp_key : r->vp_key;
+            e->size = k ? r->fp_size : r->vp_instrs * 16u; e->pad = 0;
+            s_bloom[(e->head & 0xFFFFFu) >> 3] |= (u8)(1u << (e->head & 7u));
+        }
+    }
+    qsort(s_se, s_se_n, sizeof *s_se, ld_scan_cmp);
+    u32 w = 0;   /* one entry per program (records share them) */
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_se_n; i++)
+        if (!w || ld_scan_cmp(&s_se[w - 1u], &s_se[i]) != 0 || s_se[w - 1u].size != s_se[i].size) s_se[w++] = s_se[i];
+    s_se_n = w;
+}
+static void ld_scan_found(const ld_scan_ent* e, const u8* p)
+{
+    /* Already met by a draw (or stored): the scan came too late for it. */
+    const ld_prep_pslot* s = ld_prep_slot(e->key, e->stage, 0);
+    const int late = s && s->prog;
+    { static volatile LONG said;   /* where programs are found, the first ones ("loaded, or only drawn?") */
+      if (InterlockedIncrement(&said) <= 24)
+          fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] scan t=%.1f s: %s program %016llX (%u bytes) at guest 0x%08X%s\n", ld_uptime_s(),
+                  e->stage == 'V' ? "vertex" : "fragment", (unsigned long long)e->key, e->size, (unsigned)(p - vm_base),
+                  late ? ", after its first draw" : ""); }
+    if (late) { InterlockedIncrement64(&s_scan_late); return; }
+    ld_prep_prog* g2 = (ld_prep_prog*)malloc(sizeof *g2 + e->size);
+    if (!g2) return;
+    memset(g2, 0, sizeof *g2);
+    g2->key = e->key; g2->stage = e->stage; g2->size = e->size; g2->origin = 1;
+    if (e->stage == 'P') memcpy(g2->bytes, p, e->size);
+    else for (u32 k = 0; k + 4u <= e->size; k += 4u) {
+        u32 w; memcpy(&w, p + k, 4); w = _byteswap_ulong(w); memcpy(g2->bytes + k, &w, 4);
+    }
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_prep_lock);
+    g2->next_file = s_new_file; s_new_file = g2;
+    g2->next_walk = s_new_walk; s_new_walk = g2;
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_prep_lock);
+    InterlockedIncrement64(&s_scan_found);
+    if (e->stage == 'V') InterlockedIncrement64(&s_scan_found_v);
+}
+/* One piece of guest memory, [p, p + n), with `room` readable bytes from p. */
+static void ld_scan_piece(const u8* p, size_t n, size_t room, u64** got, u32* got_n)
+{
+    static u8 vbuf[RSX_DSP_VP_INSTR * 16];
+    for (size_t o = 0; o + 16u <= n; o += 16u) {
+        const u32 h = ld_prep_head(p + o);
+        if (!(s_bloom[(h & 0xFFFFFu) >> 3] & (1u << (h & 7u)))) continue;
+        size_t lo = 0, hi = s_se_n;
+        while (lo < hi) { const size_t mid = (lo + hi) / 2u; if (s_se[mid].head < h) lo = mid + 1u; else hi = mid; }
+        for (size_t k = lo; k < s_se_n && s_se[k].head == h; k++) {
+            const ld_scan_ent* e = &s_se[k];
+            if (e->size > room - o) continue;
+            u64 key;
+            if (e->stage == 'P') key = rsx_fp_structural_hash(p + o, e->size, 1469598103934665603ull);
+            else {
+                if (e->size > sizeof vbuf) continue;
+                for (u32 b = 0; b + 4u <= e->size; b += 4u) {
+                    u32 w; memcpy(&w, p + o + b, 4); w = _byteswap_ulong(w); memcpy(vbuf + b, &w, 4);
+                }
+                key = ld_prep_vp_key(vbuf, e->size);
+            }
+            if (key != e->key) continue;
+            if (!ld_prep_set_add(got, got_n, key ^ ((u64)e->stage << 56))) continue;
+            ld_scan_found(e, p + o);
+        }
+    }
+}
+/* A range of guest memory searched now, on the caller's thread: a file the game's own reader has just loaded
+ * (GT5\src\gt5_volprobe.cpp). The same test as the scan (bitmap of first-16-byte hashes, then the program's
+ * own key over its listed length); a program found goes to the store and the walker the same way. Counts:
+ * found = listed programs not known before (stored now), known = listed programs already known (stored,
+ * drawn or found earlier), vertex = how many of the found were vertex programs. Returns 0 (and nothing is
+ * searched) while the lists are not read, or when nothing is looked for. Also used once at start for the
+ * executable's own image (its built-in shader containers), see ld_prep_main. */
+static SRWLOCK s_scan_ext_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
+static u64* s_scan_ext_got; static u32 s_scan_ext_got_n;
+int rsx_shader_prep_scan_guest(uint32_t ea, uint32_t n, uint32_t* found, uint32_t* known, uint32_t* vertex)
+{
+    *found = *known = *vertex = 0;
+    if (!InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_prep_ready, 0, 0) || !s_se_n || !s_bloom || !vm_base || n < 16u) return 0;
+    if ((u64)ea + n > 0x100000000ull) n = (uint32_t)(0x100000000ull - ea);
+    u8* vbuf = (u8*)malloc(RSX_DSP_VP_INSTR * 16);
+    if (!vbuf) return 0;
+    const u8* p = vm_base + ea;
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_scan_ext_lock);
+    __try {
+        for (u32 o = 0; o + 16u <= n; o += 16u) {
+            const u32 h = ld_prep_head(p + o);
+            if (!(s_bloom[(h & 0xFFFFFu) >> 3] & (1u << (h & 7u)))) continue;
+            size_t lo = 0, hi = s_se_n;
+            while (lo < hi) { const size_t mid = (lo + hi) / 2u; if (s_se[mid].head < h) lo = mid + 1u; else hi = mid; }
+            for (size_t k = lo; k < s_se_n && s_se[k].head == h; k++) {
+                const ld_scan_ent* e = &s_se[k];
+                if (e->size > n - o) continue;
+                u64 key;
+                if (e->stage == 'P') key = rsx_fp_structural_hash(p + o, e->size, 1469598103934665603ull);
+                else {
+                    if (e->size > RSX_DSP_VP_INSTR * 16) continue;
+                    for (u32 b = 0; b + 4u <= e->size; b += 4u) {
+                        u32 w; memcpy(&w, p + o + b, 4); w = _byteswap_ulong(w); memcpy(vbuf + b, &w, 4);
+                    }
+                    key = ld_prep_vp_key(vbuf, e->size);
+                }
+                if (key != e->key) continue;
+                /* known: present here, but stored, drawn or found before (also by an earlier range) */
+                const int fresh = ld_prep_set_add(&s_scan_ext_got, &s_scan_ext_got_n, key ^ ((u64)e->stage << 56));
+                const ld_prep_pslot* s = ld_prep_slot(e->key, e->stage, 0);
+                if (!fresh || (s && s->prog)) { (*known)++; continue; }
+                ld_scan_found(e, p + o);
+                (*found)++;
+                if (e->stage == 'V') (*vertex)++;
+            }
+        }
+    } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] scan of guest 0x%08X (%u bytes) stopped: not readable\n", ea, n);
+    }
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_scan_ext_lock);
+    free(vbuf);
+    return 1;
+}
+/* How many listed programs the scan looks for (0 until the lists are read). */
+uint32_t rsx_shader_prep_scan_listed(void)
+{
+    return InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_prep_ready, 0, 0) ? s_se_n : 0u;
+}
+/* For the volume reader (GT5\src\gt5_volread.cpp): how many listed programs are not known yet (no bytes:
+ * not stored, drawn or found), a hash of the shipped list's program keys (*list_hash: the reader's done-list
+ * belongs to one shipped list; the PC's own records come first in s_pl and are left out, they grow as it
+ * plays), and the folder the lists live in (*dir, or NULL). 0 until the lists are read. */
+uint32_t rsx_shader_prep_scan_unknown(uint64_t* list_hash, const char** dir)
+{
+    if (list_hash) *list_hash = 0;
+    if (dir) *dir = NULL;
+    if (!InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_prep_ready, 0, 0) || !s_se_n) return 0;
+    u32 unknown = 0;
+    u64 h = 1469598103934665603ull;
+    for (u32 i = s_pl.own; i < s_pl.n; i++) h = (h ^ s_pl.r[i].vp_key ^ (s_pl.r[i].fp_key << 1)) * 1099511628211ull;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_se_n; i++) {
+        const ld_prep_pslot* s = ld_prep_slot(s_se[i].key, s_se[i].stage, 0);
+        if (!(s && s->prog)) unknown++;
+    }
+    if (list_hash) *list_hash = h;
+    if (dir && s_prep_dir[0]) *dir = s_prep_dir;
+    return unknown;
+}
+
+/* One pass; returns the bytes hashed and searched. */
+static void ld_scan_pass(u64* chunk_h, u64** got, u32* got_n, u64* read_out, u64* searched_out)
+{
+    u64 read = 0, scanned = 0;
+    for (u8* a = vm_base; a < vm_base + 0x100000000ull;) {
+        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
+        if (!VirtualQuery(a, &mi, sizeof mi)) break;
+        u8* end = (u8*)mi.BaseAddress + mi.RegionSize;
+        if (end > vm_base + 0x100000000ull) end = vm_base + 0x100000000ull;
+        const int readable = mi.State == MEM_COMMIT && !(mi.Protect & (PAGE_GUARD | PAGE_NOACCESS)) &&
+                             (mi.Protect & (PAGE_READONLY | PAGE_READWRITE | PAGE_WRITECOPY | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ |
+                                            PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE));
+        if (readable) {
+            for (u8* c = (u8*)((uintptr_t)a & ~(uintptr_t)0xFFFF); c < end; c += 0x10000) {
+                u8* lo = c < a ? a : c;
+                u8* hi = c + 0x10000 < end ? c + 0x10000 : end;
+                const u32 idx = (u32)((u64)(c - vm_base) >> 16);
+                while (!s_gate_open) Sleep(10);   /* the game's own compiles first */
+                __try {
+                    const u64 h = ld_fast_hash(lo, (u32)(hi - lo), 0x5343414Eull);
+                    read += (u64)(hi - lo);
+                    if (h != chunk_h[idx]) {
+                        chunk_h[idx] = h;
+                        ld_scan_piece(lo, (size_t)(hi - lo), (size_t)(end - lo), got, got_n);
+                        scanned += (u64)(hi - lo);
+                    }
+                } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
+                    chunk_h[idx] = 0;   /* gone under us: look again next time */
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        a = end;
+    }
+    *read_out = read; *searched_out = scanned;
+}
+static double ld_uptime_s(void);
+static DWORD WINAPI ld_prep_scan_main(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_IDLE);
+    u64* chunk_h = (u64*)calloc(1u << 16, sizeof *chunk_h);   /* per 64 KB of the 4 GB guest space */
+    u64* got = NULL; u32 got_n = 0;
+    if (!chunk_h || !s_se_n || !vm_base) return 0;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] scan: looking for %u listed programs in guest memory as the game loads\n", s_se_n);
+    LARGE_INTEGER fq; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&fq);
+    ULONGLONG io_last = 0, acc = 0, acc_since = 0, quiet_since = 0, last_pass = 0, win_start = GetTickCount64();
+    double win_cost = 0.0, win_hashed = 0.0, win_searched = 0.0;
+    u32 win_passes = 0; LONG64 win_found0 = 0, win_late0 = 0;
+    int first = 1;
+    for (;;) {
+        Sleep(250);
+        const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
+        IO_COUNTERS io;
+        if (GetProcessIoCounters(GetCurrentProcess(), &io)) {
+            const ULONGLONG rd = io.ReadTransferCount;
+            if (io_last && rd > io_last) {
+                if (!acc) acc_since = now;
+                acc += rd - io_last;
+                quiet_since = now;
+            }
+            io_last = rd;
+        }
+        const int loaded = acc >= (4u << 20) && (now - quiet_since >= 500u || now - acc_since >= 2000u);
+        const int stale = acc && now - last_pass >= 60000u;
+        if ((first || loaded || stale) && win_cost < 1.0 && s_gate_open) {
+            first = 0;
+            LARGE_INTEGER t0, t1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
+            u64 rb = 0, sb = 0;
+            ld_scan_pass(chunk_h, &got, &got_n, &rb, &sb);
+            QueryPerformanceCounter(&t1);
+            const double sec = (double)(t1.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart) / (double)fq.QuadPart;
+            win_cost += sec; win_hashed += (double)rb; win_searched += (double)sb; win_passes++;
+            s_scan_sweeps++; s_scan_bytes += (LONG64)sb;
+            acc = 0; last_pass = now;
+        }
+        if (now - win_start >= 5000u) {
+            if (win_passes) {
+                /* known now: listed programs found or met by a draw (a racy look at pointers that never go) */
+                u32 known = 0;
+                for (u32 i = 0; i < s_se_n; i++) {
+                    const ld_prep_pslot* s = ld_prep_slot(s_se[i].key, s_se[i].stage, 0);
+                    if (s && s->prog) known++;
+                }
+                fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] scan t=%.0f s: %u passes, %.0f MB hashed, %.0f MB searched, %.2f s; "
+                        "found %lld before their first draw (%lld so far, %lld of them vertex programs), %lld after; "
+                        "%u of %u listed programs known\n",
+                        ld_uptime_s(), win_passes, win_hashed / 1048576.0, win_searched / 1048576.0, win_cost,
+                        (long long)(s_scan_found - win_found0), (long long)s_scan_found, (long long)s_scan_found_v,
+                        (long long)(s_scan_late - win_late0), known, s_se_n);
+                if (known >= s_se_n) {
+                    fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] scan: every listed program is known; the scan stops\n");
+                    free(chunk_h);
+                    return 0;
+                }
+            }
+            win_start = now; win_cost = win_hashed = win_searched = 0.0; win_passes = 0;
+            win_found0 = s_scan_found; win_late0 = s_scan_late;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/* ---- the thread: loads, appends what the session noted, and sets how many workers may work ---------- */
+static void ld_prep_flush(void)
+{
+    ld_prep_rec* recs; u32 n; ld_prep_prog* progs;
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_prep_lock);
+    recs = s_rec_pend; n = s_rec_pend_n; s_rec_pend = NULL; s_rec_pend_n = s_rec_pend_cap = 0;
+    progs = s_new_file; s_new_file = NULL;
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_prep_lock);
+    char path[MAX_PATH];
+    if (n) {
+        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\shader_keys.lst", s_prep_dir);
+        FILE* f = fopen(path, "ab");
+        if (f) { fwrite(recs, sizeof *recs, n, f); fclose(f); }
+    }
+    free(recs);
+    if (progs) {
+        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\programs.bin", s_prep_dir);
+        FILE* f = fopen(path, "ab");
+        static u64* written; static u32 written_n;
+        for (ld_prep_prog* g2 = progs; g2; g2 = g2->next_file) {
+            /* Once in the file: not one it had at start (the table's copy came from it), not twice this
+             * session (a program found in memory and then met by a draw comes twice). */
+            const ld_prep_pslot* s = InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_prep_ready, 0, 0) ? ld_prep_slot(g2->key, g2->stage, 0) : NULL;
+            if (s && s->prog && s->prog->origin == 2) continue;
+            if (!ld_prep_set_add(&written, &written_n, g2->key ^ ((u64)g2->stage << 56)) && written_n < LD_PREP_SEEN / 2u) continue;
+            if (f) { ld_prog_write(f, g2); InterlockedIncrement64(&s_pst.programs); }
+        }
+        if (f) fclose(f);
+    }
+}
+/* A list of version-1 records (round 1's builds) is written again as version 2, oldest first, so the
+ * session's notes can be appended to it (the loader's thread, once, before anything is appended). */
+static void ld_prep_rewrite_v1(void)
+{
+    char path[MAX_PATH], tmp[MAX_PATH];
+    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\shader_keys.lst", s_prep_dir);
+    FILE* f = fopen(path, "rb");
+    u32 hd[3] = {0, 0, 0};
+    if (!f) return;
+    const size_t got = fread(hd, 4, 3, f);
+    fclose(f);
+    if (got != 3 || hd[1] != 1u || hd[2] != LD_PREP_V1_SIZE) return;
+    snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.tmp.%lu", path, (unsigned long)GetCurrentProcessId());
+    FILE* o = fopen(tmp, "wb");
+    int ok = o != NULL;
+    for (u32 k = s_pl.own; ok && k-- > 0;) ok = fwrite(&s_pl.r[k], sizeof s_pl.r[k], 1, o) == 1;
+    if (o) ok = (fclose(o) == 0) && ok;
+    if (ok) ok = MoveFileExA(tmp, path, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING) != 0;
+    if (!ok) {   /* set aside rather than appended to: one file, one record size */
+        char old[MAX_PATH];
+        DeleteFileA(tmp);
+        snprintf(old, sizeof old, "%s.v1", path);
+        MoveFileExA(path, old, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING);
+    }
+}
+/* At most half the logical processors (LD_PREP_THREADS lowers it), whatever the idle tests say. */
+static int ld_prep_threads_max(void)
+{
+    SYSTEM_INFO si; GetSystemInfo(&si);
+    int n = (int)si.dwNumberOfProcessors / 2;
+    { const char* e = getenv("LD_PREP_THREADS"); if (e && atoi(e) > 0 && atoi(e) < n) n = atoi(e); }
+    if (n < 1) n = 1;
+    if (n > 64) n = 64;
+    return n;
+}
+static u64 ld_prep_thread_cpu(HANDLE t)
+{
+    FILETIME c, x, k, u;
+    return t && GetThreadTimes(t, &c, &x, &k, &u) ? ld_prep_ft(&k) + ld_prep_ft(&u) : 0;
+}
+/* Every 250 ms: how many workers may work (see ld_prep_worker's block), and a line every 5 s. */
