+static void ld_prep_control(void)
+{
+    static u64 p_proc, p_prep; static ULONGLONG p_wall, line_t;
+    static double base_ms;
+    static LONG64 p_built, p_used, p_work, p_paused, p_adopted;
+    const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
+    s_cfg_cur = (LONG)ld_prep_cfg_now();   /* the settings the workers check records against */
+    FILETIME c, x, k, u;
+    const u64 proc = GetProcessTimes(GetCurrentProcess(), &c, &x, &k, &u) ? ld_prep_ft(&k) + ld_prep_ft(&u) : 0;
+    u64 prep = ld_prep_thread_cpu(s_scan_th);
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_wth_n; i++) prep += ld_prep_thread_cpu(s_wth[i]);
+    const double wall = p_wall ? (double)(now - p_wall) / 1000.0 : 0.0;
+    const double game = wall > 0.05 && proc >= p_proc && prep >= p_prep
+                      ? ((double)(proc - p_proc) - (double)(prep - p_prep)) / 1e7 / wall : 0.0;
+    p_proc = proc; p_prep = prep; p_wall = now;
+    const LONG64 ticks = InterlockedExchange64(&s_tick_n, 0);
+    const LONG64 gaps = InterlockedExchange64(&s_tick_gap_sum, 0);
+    InterlockedExchange64(&s_tick_gap_max, 0);
+    LARGE_INTEGER fq; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&fq);
+    const double frame_ms = ticks ? 1000.0 * (double)gaps / (double)ticks / (double)fq.QuadPart : 0.0;
+    SYSTEM_INFO si; GetSystemInfo(&si);
+    const int n_cpu = (int)si.dwNumberOfProcessors, tmax = ld_prep_threads_max();
+    const u32 backlog = ld_prep_backlog();
+    const LONG cur = s_active;
+    /* the usual frame time: measured while at most two workers run */
+    if (ticks >= 3 && cur <= 2) base_ms = base_ms > 0.0 ? 0.75 * base_ms + 0.25 * frame_ms : frame_ms;
+    const int suffering = ticks >= 3 && base_ms > 0.0 && frame_ms > 17.0 && frame_ms > 1.2 * base_ms;
+    LONG want;
+    if (!backlog || !ld_prep_build_on()) want = 0;
+    else if (backlog < 32u) want = backlog < 8u ? 1 : 2;
+    else {
+        int free_cpu = (int)((double)n_cpu - game - 1.0);
+        if (free_cpu < 2) free_cpu = 2;
+        want = free_cpu < tmax ? free_cpu : tmax;
+        if (suffering && cur > 2) want = cur / 2 > 2 ? cur / 2 : 2;
+        else if (want > cur) { const LONG step = cur < 2 ? 2 : cur; if (want > cur + step) want = cur + step; }
+    }
+    /* Room for the pool even when the gate is wrong: never more than logical - pool threads running - 2. */
+    { const LONG room = (LONG)n_cpu - InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_cp_running, 0, 0) - 2;
+      if (want > room) want = room > 0 ? room : 0; }
+    if (want != cur) ld_prep_set_active(want);
+    if (now - line_t >= 5000u) {
+        line_t = now;
+        const LONG64 built = s_pst.built, used = s_pst.used, work = s_pst.work_qpc;
+        const LONG64 paused = ld_prep_paused_total(), adopted = s_adopted;
+        if (backlog || built != p_built || used != p_used || adopted != p_adopted)
+            fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] t=%.0f s: backlog %u pipelines; workers %ld of %d (game %.1f of %d processors busy, "
+                    "frames %.1f ms, usual %.1f ms%s); paused %.0f ms for the game's own compiles; made %lld shaders (+%lld), "
+                    "%lld used by draws (+%lld); %lld of the game's compiles served by one in flight (+%lld); %.1f s of work\n",
+                    ld_uptime_s(), backlog, (long)s_active, tmax, game, n_cpu, frame_ms, base_ms,
+                    suffering ? ", slower" : "", 1000.0 * (double)(paused - p_paused) / (double)fq.QuadPart,
+                    (long long)built, (long long)(built - p_built), (long long)used, (long long)(used - p_used),
+                    (long long)adopted, (long long)(adopted - p_adopted), (double)(work - p_work) / (double)fq.QuadPart);
+        p_built = built; p_used = used; p_work = work; p_paused = paused; p_adopted = adopted;
+    }
+}
+static void ld_prep_stamp(char* out, size_t cap, u32 cfg);
+static void ld_prep_check_stamp(void)
+{
+    /* Prepared for another build, settings or driver than this run's: the next start prepares again. */
+    char path[MAX_PATH], line[1024] = "", now[1024];
+    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\prepared.txt", g_ld_shader_disk_dir);
+    FILE* f = fopen(path, "r");
+    if (!f) return;
+    if (!fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) line[0] = 0;
+    fclose(f);
+    ld_prep_stamp(now, sizeof now, ld_prep_cfg_now());
+    if (strcmp(line, now) != 0) {
+        DeleteFileA(path);
+        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] the shaders were prepared for another build, settings or graphics driver: "
+                "the next start from the launcher prepares them again\n");
+    }
+}
+static DWORD WINAPI ld_prep_main(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL);
+    InterlockedExchange(&s_found_play, 1);   /* [found] the game's session: found programs go to the workers */
+    ld_prep_check_stamp();                   /* [found] first: whether found programs are prepared depends on it */
+    LARGE_INTEGER fq, t0, t1;
+    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&fq); QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
+    u32 n_prog = 0;
+    if (ld_prep_load_lists(&s_pl) && ld_prep_table_make(s_pl.n, ld_prep_prog_hint())) {
+        ld_prep_load_programs(&n_prog);
+        s_rec_state = (u8*)calloc(s_pl.n ? s_pl.n : 1u, 1);
+        s_qn = (ld_prep_item*)malloc((s_pl.n ? s_pl.n : 1u) * sizeof *s_qn);
+        s_qhi = (ld_prep_item*)malloc((s_pl.n ? s_pl.n : 1u) * sizeof *s_qhi);
+        s_rec_taken = (volatile LONG*)calloc(s_pl.n ? s_pl.n : 1u, sizeof *s_rec_taken);
+        if (s_rec_state && s_qn && s_qhi && s_rec_taken) {
+            for (u32 i = 0; i < s_pl.n; i++) {
+                ld_prep_link_rec(i, s_pl.r[i].vp_key, 'V');
+                ld_prep_link_rec(i, s_pl.r[i].fp_key, 'P');
+            }
+            const u32 cfg = ld_prep_cfg_now();
+            u32 other = 0;
+            for (u32 i = 0; i < s_pl.n; i++) {
+                ld_prep_item it;
+                if (!ld_prep_usable(&s_pl.r[i], cfg)) { s_rec_state[i] = 2; other++; continue; }
+                if (!ld_prep_rec_ready(i, s_pl.r, &it.vp, &it.fp)) continue;
+                s_rec_state[i] = 1; it.rec = i;
+                if (ld_prep_build_on()) s_qn[s_qn_w++] = it;
+            }
+            s_pst.known = s_pl.n; s_pst.other_settings = other;
+            s_cfg_cur = (LONG)cfg;
+            if (s_pl.v1) ld_prep_rewrite_v1();
+            s_pst.n_prog_file = n_prog;
+            if (ld_prep_scan_on()) ld_scan_index();
+            QueryPerformanceCounter(&t1);
+            fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] lists: %u pipelines (%u noted on this PC, %u shipped, %u damaged, %u of an older "
+                    "version), %u programs stored; %u can be made now, %u made under other settings, %u wait for their "
+                    "programs (%.0f ms to read)\n",
+                    s_pl.n, s_pl.own, s_pl.shipped, s_pl.damaged, s_pl.v1, n_prog, s_qn_w, other,
+                    s_pl.n - s_qn_w - other, 1000.0 * (double)(t1.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart) / (double)fq.QuadPart);
+            InterlockedExchange(&s_prep_ready, 1);
+            /* The executable's own programs (GT5 keeps 8 shader containers in its data segment): searched now,
+             * as soon as the lists are read, so they go to build-ahead before the first menu; they need no file
+             * read. The memory scan's first pass would find them too, a few seconds later. */
+            if (ld_prep_scan_on() && s_se_n) {
+                LARGE_INTEGER e0, e1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&e0);
+                uint32_t f = 0, k = 0, v = 0;
+                /* the committed, readable stretches of the image's 32 MB (as the scan pass tells them) */
+                u8* run_lo = NULL;
+                for (u8* a = vm_base + 0x00010000u; a <= vm_base + 0x02000000u;) {
+                    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
+                    int ok = 0;
+                    u8* end = vm_base + 0x02000000u;
+                    if (a < vm_base + 0x02000000u && VirtualQuery(a, &mi, sizeof mi)) {
+                        end = (u8*)mi.BaseAddress + mi.RegionSize;
+                        if (end > vm_base + 0x02000000u) end = vm_base + 0x02000000u;
+                        ok = mi.State == MEM_COMMIT && !(mi.Protect & (PAGE_GUARD | PAGE_NOACCESS)) &&
+                             (mi.Protect & (PAGE_READONLY | PAGE_READWRITE | PAGE_WRITECOPY | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ |
+                                            PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE));
+                    }
+                    if (ok && !run_lo) run_lo = a;
+                    if (!ok && run_lo) {
+                        uint32_t f1 = 0, k1 = 0, v1 = 0;
+                        rsx_shader_prep_scan_guest((uint32_t)(run_lo - vm_base), (uint32_t)(a - run_lo), &f1, &k1, &v1);
+                        f += f1; k += k1; v += v1;
+                        run_lo = NULL;
+                    }
+                    if (a >= vm_base + 0x02000000u) break;
+                    a = end;
+                }
+                QueryPerformanceCounter(&e1);
+                fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] the executable's own programs: %u listed ones found (%u vertex), %u known "
+                        "already (%.0f ms)\n", f, v, k, 1000.0 * (double)(e1.QuadPart - e0.QuadPart) / (double)fq.QuadPart);
+            }
+            { HANDLE gt = CreateThread(NULL, 64u << 10, ld_prep_gate_main, NULL, 0, NULL);   /* the game first */
+              if (gt) CloseHandle(gt); }
+            if (ld_prep_scan_on() && s_se_n)
+                s_scan_th = CreateThread(NULL, 1u << 20, ld_prep_scan_main, NULL, 0, NULL);
+        }
+    }
+    if (!InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_prep_ready, 0, 0))
+        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] the lists could not be read: nothing is made ahead this session\n");
+    ld_found_load();   /* [found] found.bin and the executable's own containers */
+    LONG64 last_sum = -1; int ticks = 0, quiet = 0;
+    for (;;) {
+        Sleep(250);
+        if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_prep_ready, 0, 0)) ld_prep_control();
+        if (++ticks % 4) continue;
+        ld_prep_flush();
+        ld_found_flush();   /* [found] */
+        const LONG64 sum = s_pst.noted + s_pst.built + s_pst.used + s_pst.check_diff + s_pst.translate_fail + s_scan_found;
+        if (quiet < 30) quiet++;
+        if (sum != last_sum && quiet >= 30) {
+            quiet = 0; last_sum = sum;
+            fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] this session: %lld pipelines noted, %lld programs stored; made ahead %lld shaders "
+                    "(%lld used by draws so far, %lld failed, %lld records for other settings, %lld did not translate, %lld past the cap); "
+                    "programs found in memory %lld (and %lld after their first draw); text check %lld of %lld the same\n",
+                    (long long)s_pst.noted, (long long)s_pst.programs, (long long)s_pst.built, (long long)s_pst.used,
+                    (long long)s_pst.built_fail, (long long)s_pst.other_settings, (long long)s_pst.translate_fail,
+                    (long long)s_pst.full, (long long)s_scan_found, (long long)s_scan_late, (long long)s_pst.check_same,
+                    (long long)(s_pst.check_same + s_pst.check_diff));
+            ld_found_line();   /* [found] */
+        }
+    }
+}
+static void ld_prep_start(void)
+{
+    static int started;
+    if (started || !ld_prep_on() || !ld_prep_dir()) return;
+    started = 1;
+    HANDLE t = CreateThread(NULL, 1u << 20, ld_prep_main, NULL, 0, NULL);
+    if (t) CloseHandle(t);
+}
+
+/* ---- gt5.exe --prepare-shaders ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *
+ * Run by the installer, the update and the launcher, in the GT5 folder, before the game starts:
+ *  1. every listed pipeline whose programs this PC has, and whose settings kinds are the ones play.bat
+ *     and settings.bat give now, is translated with today's generator;
+ *  2. the shaders the cache lacks are compiled on every logical processor (below normal priority) and
+ *     written as the game writes them, then the pack is rewritten with them;
+ *  3. every one of those pipelines is made once on the GPU the game uses and let go, so the driver keeps
+ *     it in its own disk cache for gt5.exe: measured here (RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, GT5's own 8,523 pipelines,
+ *     tools\psobench), a pipeline the driver has never seen takes 21 ms to make, one it has 0.47 ms;
+ *  4. the pipelines go into the made-ahead list under their new names, so the game makes them at its start.
+ * Progress: "GT5_SHADERS done total" lines on stdout (shaders and pipelines together) and
+ * <cache>\prepare_progress.txt. Safe to stop at any point: each shader is its own file the moment it is
+ * compiled, and the next run (or the game) carries on. When nothing changed since the last full run (the
+ * same gt5.exe, settings, shipped list and graphics driver; the stamp <cache>\prepared.txt, which clearing
+ * the cache removes) it ends at once. The stamp's second line is what the launcher compares before it
+ * starts this at all (gt5.exe, settings.bat, the shipped list: sizes and times). --force: run anyway;
+ * --threads=N: N threads. */
+typedef struct { u32 stage, len; u64 hash; char* src; u8* blob; u32 blob_len; } ld_prep_job;
+static ld_prep_job* s_pj; static volatile LONG s_pj_next, s_pj_done, s_pj_fail; static LONG s_pj_n;
+static char s_pj_cache[MAX_PATH];
+
+/* What the cache holds, by shader_mem_key: a pack entry (header, text, blob), a job of this run, or a
+ * file beside the pack (read when a pipeline needs it). */
+typedef struct { u64 key, hash; u32 stage, len; const u8* entry; s32 job; u32 used; } ld_prep_have;
+#define LD_PREP_HAVE_SLOTS (1u << 20)
+static ld_prep_have* s_have; static u32 s_have_n;
+static ld_prep_have* ld_prep_have_slot(u32 stage, u64 hash, u32 len, int add)
+{
+    const u64 key = shader_mem_key(stage, hash, len);
+    u32 i = (u32)(key ^ (key >> 29)) & (LD_PREP_HAVE_SLOTS - 1u);
+    while (s_have[i].used) {
+        if (s_have[i].key == key && s_have[i].stage == stage && s_have[i].hash == hash && s_have[i].len == len) return &s_have[i];
+        i = (i + 1u) & (LD_PREP_HAVE_SLOTS - 1u);
+    }
+    if (!add || s_have_n >= LD_PREP_HAVE_SLOTS / 2u) return NULL;
+    s_have[i].used = 1; s_have[i].key = key; s_have[i].hash = hash; s_have[i].stage = stage; s_have[i].len = len;
+    s_have[i].entry = NULL; s_have[i].job = -1;
+    s_have_n++;
+    return &s_have[i];
+}
+/* A compiled shader as a blob of the calling thread's own (d3dcompiler's reference counts are not
+ * thread-safe), from wherever the cache has it. */
+static ID3DBlob* ld_prep_blob(u32 stage, u64 hash, u32 len)
+{
+    const ld_prep_have* h = ld_prep_have_slot(stage, hash, len, 0);
+    if (!h) return NULL;
+    const u8* bytes = NULL; u32 n = 0; u8* file = NULL;
+    if (h->job >= 0) { bytes = s_pj[h->job].blob; n = s_pj[h->job].blob_len; }
+    else {
+        const u8* e = h->entry;
+        size_t fn = 0;
+        if (!e) {
+            char path[MAX_PATH];
+            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\%c_%016llX_%08X.bin", s_pj_cache, (char)stage, (unsigned long long)hash, len);
+            e = file = ld_prep_read_file(path, &fn);
+        }
+        shader_disk_cache_header hd;
+        if (e) {
+            memcpy(&hd, e, sizeof hd);
+            if (hd.magic == SHADER_DISK_CACHE_MAGIC && hd.stage == stage && hd.source_length == len &&
+                hd.blob_length && hd.blob_length <= SHADER_DISK_CACHE_MAX_BLOB &&
+                (!file || (u64)sizeof hd + hd.source_length + hd.blob_length == fn)) {
+                bytes = e + sizeof hd + hd.source_length; n = hd.blob_length;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    ID3DBlob* b = NULL;
+    if (bytes && n && SUCCEEDED(D3DCreateBlob(n, &b)) && b) memcpy(b->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(b), bytes, n);
+    free(file);
+    return b;
+}
+
+static DWORD WINAPI ld_prep_compile_worker(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL);
+    for (;;) {
+        const LONG i = InterlockedIncrement(&s_pj_next) - 1;
+        if (i >= s_pj_n) return 0;
+        ld_prep_job* j = &s_pj[i];
+        ID3DBlob* blob = NULL; ID3DBlob* err = NULL;
+        /* exactly as ld_cpool_compile */
+        const HRESULT hr = D3DCompile(j->src, j->len, j->stage == 'V' ? "xvs" : "xps", NULL, NULL, "main",
+                                      j->stage == 'V' ? "vs_5_0" : "ps_5_0", 0, 0, &blob, &err);
+        int ok = 0;
+        if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && blob) {
+            const SIZE_T bl = blob->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(blob);
+            char path[MAX_PATH], tmp[MAX_PATH];
+            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\%c_%016llX_%08X.bin", s_pj_cache, (char)j->stage,
+                     (unsigned long long)j->hash, j->len);
+            snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.tmp.%lu", path, (unsigned long)GetCurrentThreadId());
+            shader_disk_cache_header h;
+            memset(&h, 0, sizeof h);
+            h.magic = SHADER_DISK_CACHE_MAGIC; h.version = SHADER_DISK_CACHE_VERSION; h.stage = j->stage;
+            h.source_length = j->len; h.blob_length = (u32)bl; h.source_hash = j->hash;
+            FILE* f = bl && bl <= SHADER_DISK_CACHE_MAX_BLOB ? fopen(tmp, "wb") : NULL;
+            if (f) {
+                ok = fwrite(&h, sizeof h, 1, f) == 1 && fwrite(j->src, 1, j->len, f) == j->len &&
+                     fwrite(blob->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(blob), 1, bl, f) == bl;
+                ok = (fclose(f) == 0) && ok;
+                if (ok) ok = MoveFileExA(tmp, path, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING) != 0;
+                if (!ok) DeleteFileA(tmp);
+            }
+            if (ok && (j->blob = (u8*)malloc(bl)) != NULL) {   /* for the pipelines below */
+                memcpy(j->blob, blob->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(blob), bl);
+                j->blob_len = (u32)bl;
+            }
+        }
+        if (!ok) InterlockedIncrement(&s_pj_fail);
+        if (blob) blob->lpVtbl->Release(blob);
+        if (err) err->lpVtbl->Release(err);
+        InterlockedIncrement(&s_pj_done);
+    }
+}
+
+/* The pipelines, made once each and let go (a made pipeline holds about 140 KB of the process's memory). */
+static ld_ahead_rec* s_pp; static LONG s_pp_n; static volatile LONG s_pp_next, s_pp_done, s_pp_fail;
+static volatile LONG64 s_pp_qpc;
+static DWORD WINAPI ld_prep_pso_worker(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL);
+    for (;;) {
+        const LONG i = InterlockedIncrement(&s_pp_next) - 1;
+        if (i >= s_pp_n) return 0;
+        const ld_ahead_rec* r = &s_pp[i];
+        ID3DBlob* vs = ld_prep_blob('V', r->vs_hash, r->vs_len);
+        ID3DBlob* ps = vs ? ld_prep_blob('P', r->ps_hash, r->ps_len) : NULL;
+        int ok = 0;
+        if (vs && ps) {
+            D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC il[16];
+            D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pd;
+            /* the game's own description of it (ld_fill_pipeline_desc, apply_render_state) */
+            ld_fill_pipeline_desc(&pd, il, vs, ps, &r->rs, (int)r->masked, r->count, r->attrs, (int)r->packed);
+            ID3D12PipelineState* pso = NULL;
+            LARGE_INTEGER c0, c1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&c0);
+            const HRESULT hr = g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateGraphicsPipelineState(g.dev, &pd, &IID_ID3D12PipelineState, (void**)&pso);
+            QueryPerformanceCounter(&c1);
+            InterlockedAdd64(&s_pp_qpc, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart);
+            if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && pso) { ok = 1; pso->lpVtbl->Release(pso); }
+        }
+        if (vs) vs->lpVtbl->Release(vs);
+        if (ps) ps->lpVtbl->Release(ps);
+        if (!ok) InterlockedIncrement(&s_pp_fail);
+        InterlockedIncrement(&s_pp_done);
+    }
+}
+/* The device the game would use (its own choice, ld_create_device), its root signature, and a depth
+ * buffer to stand for the game's (apply_render_state only asks whether there is one). */
+static int ld_create_device(IDXGIFactory4* factory);
+static int make_root_signature(void);
+static int ld_prep_device(void)
+{
+    IDXGIFactory4* f = NULL;
+    if (FAILED(CreateDXGIFactory1(&IID_IDXGIFactory4, (void**)&f)) || !f) return 0;
+    const int ok = ld_create_device(f) == 0 && g.dev;
+    f->lpVtbl->Release(f);
+    if (!ok || make_root_signature() != 0 || !g.rootsig_x) return 0;
+    D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp; memset(&hp, 0, sizeof hp); hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT;
+    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC rd; memset(&rd, 0, sizeof rd);
+    rd.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D; rd.Width = 1; rd.Height = 1; rd.DepthOrArraySize = 1;
+    rd.MipLevels = 1; rd.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT_S8X24_UINT; rd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
+    rd.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_DEPTH_STENCIL;
+    return SUCCEEDED(g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateCommittedResource(g.dev, &hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &rd,
+               D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_DEPTH_WRITE, NULL, &IID_ID3D12Resource, (void**)&g.depth)) && g.depth;
+}
+
+static void ld_prep_progress(const char* path, LONG done, LONG total, int force)
+{
+    static ULONGLONG last;
+    const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
+    if (!force && now - last < 250u) return;
+    last = now;
+    printf("GT5_SHADERS %ld %ld\n", (long)done, (long)total);
+    fflush(stdout);
+    FILE* f = fopen(path, "w");
+    if (f) { fprintf(f, "%ld %ld\n", (long)done, (long)total); fclose(f); }
+}
+/* The settings play.bat would start the game with: its own `set "NAME=value"` lines, then settings.bat's
+ * (the launcher's), into this process's environment, which ld_prep_cfg_now reads. Lines with a %...% in
+ * their value are left out (none of the keys the settings kinds use has one). */
+static void ld_prep_apply_bat(const char* path)
+{
+    FILE* f = fopen(path, "r");
+    if (!f) return;
+    char line[1024];
+    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
+        char* p = line;
+        while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
+        if (_strnicmp(p, "set \"", 5) != 0) continue;
+        p += 5;
+        char* eq = strchr(p, '=');
+        char* end = eq ? strchr(eq, '"') : NULL;
+        if (!eq || !end || eq == p) continue;
+        *eq = 0; *end = 0;
+        if (strchr(eq + 1, '%')) continue;
+        _putenv_s(p, eq + 1);
+    }
+    fclose(f);
+}
+/* What a full run was made for: gt5.exe, the shipped list, the settings kinds and the graphics drivers
+ * (a new driver starts its cache empty). */
+static void ld_prep_stamp(char* out, size_t cap, u32 cfg)
+{
+    char exe[MAX_PATH]; WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA a, s;
+    memset(&a, 0, sizeof a); memset(&s, 0, sizeof s);
+    if (GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, exe, sizeof exe)) GetFileAttributesExA(exe, GetFileExInfoStandard, &a);
+    const char* sp = getenv("LD_PREP_SHIPPED");
+    GetFileAttributesExA(sp && sp[0] ? sp : LD_PREP_SHIPPED, GetFileExInfoStandard, &s);
+    /* [found] what the game's files gave so far (the reader adds to it) and how many pixel sets a program */
+    WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA fd; memset(&fd, 0, sizeof fd);
+    if (ld_found_on() && ld_prep_dir()) {
+        char fp[MAX_PATH]; snprintf(fp, sizeof fp, "%s\\found.bin", s_prep_dir);
+        GetFileAttributesExA(fp, GetFileExInfoStandard, &fd);
+    }
+    int n = snprintf(out, cap, "exe %lu-%llu shipped %lu-%llu found %lu/%u settings %08X version %u gpu",
+                     (unsigned long)a.nFileSizeLow, (unsigned long long)ld_prep_ft(&a.ftLastWriteTime),
+                     (unsigned long)s.nFileSizeLow, (unsigned long long)ld_prep_ft(&s.ftLastWriteTime),
+                     (unsigned long)fd.nFileSizeLow, ld_found_on() ? ld_found_ps_count() : 0u, cfg, LD_PREP_VERSION);
+    IDXGIFactory1* f = NULL;
+    if (n > 0 && SUCCEEDED(CreateDXGIFactory1(&IID_IDXGIFactory1, (void**)&f)) && f) {
+        IDXGIAdapter1* ad = NULL;
+        for (UINT i = 0; f->lpVtbl->EnumAdapters1(f, i, &ad) != DXGI_ERROR_NOT_FOUND && n > 0 && (size_t)n < cap; i++) {
+            DXGI_ADAPTER_DESC1 d; LARGE_INTEGER umd; umd.QuadPart = 0;
+            if (SUCCEEDED(ad->lpVtbl->GetDesc1(ad, &d)) && !(d.Flags & DXGI_ADAPTER_FLAG_SOFTWARE)) {
+                ad->lpVtbl->CheckInterfaceSupport(ad, &IID_IDXGIDevice, &umd);
+                n += snprintf(out + n, cap - (size_t)n, " %04X:%04X:%llX", d.VendorId, d.DeviceId,
+                              (unsigned long long)umd.QuadPart);
+            }
+            ad->lpVtbl->Release(ad);
+        }
+        f->lpVtbl->Release(f);
+    }
+    if (n > 0 && (size_t)n + 2 < cap) { out[n] = '\n'; out[n + 1] = 0; }
+}
+/* The launcher's line: what it can look at without starting anything (GT5Launcher.cs, PrepareWanted). */
+static void ld_prep_launcher_line(char* out, size_t cap)
+{
+    char exe[MAX_PATH]; WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA a, b, s;
+    memset(&a, 0, sizeof a); memset(&b, 0, sizeof b); memset(&s, 0, sizeof s);
+    if (GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, exe, sizeof exe)) GetFileAttributesExA(exe, GetFileExInfoStandard, &a);
+    GetFileAttributesExA("settings.bat", GetFileExInfoStandard, &b);
+    GetFileAttributesExA(LD_PREP_SHIPPED, GetFileExInfoStandard, &s);
+    snprintf(out, cap, "launcher %lu %llu %llu %lu %llu\n",
+             (unsigned long)a.nFileSizeLow, (unsigned long long)ld_prep_ft(&a.ftLastWriteTime),
+             (unsigned long long)ld_prep_ft(&b.ftLastWriteTime), (unsigned long)s.nFileSizeLow,
+             (unsigned long long)ld_prep_ft(&s.ftLastWriteTime));
+}
+static void ld_prep_write_stamp(const char* path, const char* full, const char* launcher)
+{
+    FILE* f = fopen(path, "w");
+    if (f) { fputs(full, f); fputs(launcher, f); fclose(f); }
+}
+
+/* [standin2] The walker, at a frame's end once the stand-in's shaders are asked for (ld_si_frame): the general
+ * stand-in pipeline of every render state and vertex layout this PC's records name, made ahead by the stand-in's own
+ * [standin3] thread, at below-normal priority and only while the game's compile pool is idle (about 1 ms each once
+ * the driver knows the two shaders), so that a new pipeline of a known state finds its stand-in made before its
+ * first frame. Once, when the records are read; only with the variants the cache has. */
+static void ld_si_prebuild(void)
+{
+    static int done;
+    if (done || !InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_prep_ready, 0, 0)) return;
+    done = 1;
+    const u32 cfg = ld_prep_cfg_now();
+    const u32 before = s_sip_n;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_pl.n && s_sip_n * 2u < LD_SIP_SLOTS; i++) {
+        const ld_prep_rec* r = &s_pl.r[i];
+        if (!ld_prep_usable_pso(r, cfg)) continue;
+        if (r->rs.depth_test && r->rs.depth_func == 0x0202u) continue;   /* equal-depth passes use their own form */
+        if ((r->rs.rt_count & 0xFFu) > 1u || (r->rs.rt_count & LD_RT_UPRES)) continue;
+        const int masked = (r->flags & LD_PREP_F_MASKED) != 0;
+        if (masked && !r->layout_count) continue;
+        rsx_si_desc d; memset(&d, 0, sizeof d);
+        d.cube_mask = r->cube_mask; d.vol_mask = r->vol_mask; d.shadow = r->shadow_mask ? r->shadow : NULL;
+        d.mv = (r->flags & LD_PREP_F_MV) != 0;
+        /* [standin3] only with variants the cache has (none is compiled for the records alone) */
+        const int ps = ld_si_var_slot('P', rsx_si_variant_of(&d), 0), vs = ld_si_var_slot('V', d.mv ? 1u : 0u, 0);
+        if (ps < 0 || vs < 0 || !ld_si_var_blob((u32)ps) || !ld_si_var_blob((u32)vs)) continue;
+        rsx_vertex_layout_plan lp; memset(&lp, 0, sizeof lp);
+        if (masked) {
+            lp.mask = r->layout_mask; lp.count = (u8)(r->layout_count < 16u ? r->layout_count : 16u);
+            memcpy(lp.attrs, r->attrs, sizeof lp.attrs);
+        }
+        ld_sip_get(&r->rs, masked ? &lp : NULL, (r->flags & LD_PREP_F_PACKED) != 0, (u32)ps, (u32)vs, 1);
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "[shaders] stand-in pipelines made ahead: %u render states and layouts of this PC's records\n",
+            s_sip_n - before);
+}
+
+/* [found] One text for this run to compile unless the cache has it: 1 added, 0 cached (or a job already), -1 no
+ * room. (The step's own two loops do the same inline.) */
+typedef struct { u32* cap; u32 added; FILE* texts; } ld_found_jobs;
+static int ld_found_job_add(void* ctx, u32 stage, const char* src)
+{
+    ld_found_jobs* j = (ld_found_jobs*)ctx;
+    const u32 len = (u32)strlen(src);
+    const u64 h = fnv1a(src, len, 1469598103934665603ull);
+    if (j->texts) { const u32 t[2] = {stage, len}; fwrite(t, 4, 2, j->texts); fwrite(&h, 8, 1, j->texts); }   /* found_texts.bin */
+    if (ld_prep_have_slot(stage, h, len, 0)) return 0;
+    if ((u32)s_pj_n == *j->cap) {
+        ld_prep_job* p = (ld_prep_job*)realloc(s_pj, (size_t)*j->cap * 2u * sizeof *s_pj);
+        if (!p) return -1;
+        memset(p + *j->cap, 0, (size_t)*j->cap * sizeof *p);
+        s_pj = p; *j->cap *= 2u;
+    }
+    char* copy = (char*)malloc(len + 1u);
+    ld_prep_have* hs = copy ? ld_prep_have_slot(stage, h, len, 1) : NULL;
+    if (!hs) { free(copy); return -1; }
+    memcpy(copy, src, len + 1u);
+    hs->job = (s32)s_pj_n;
+    s_pj[s_pj_n].stage = stage; s_pj[s_pj_n].len = len; s_pj[s_pj_n].hash = h; s_pj[s_pj_n].src = copy;
+    s_pj_n++; j->added++;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+int rsx_live_draw_prepare_shaders(int argc, char** argv)
+{
+    int force = 0, nt = 0;
+    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
+        if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--force")) force = 1;
+        else if (!strncmp(argv[i], "--threads=", 10)) nt = atoi(argv[i] + 10);
+    }
+    LARGE_INTEGER fq, t0, t1, t2, t3;
+    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&fq); QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
+    /* The settings the next start will have (play.bat's defaults, then the launcher's settings.bat). */
+    ld_prep_apply_bat("play.bat");
+    ld_prep_apply_bat("settings.bat");
+    /* The cache folder, as shader_disk_cache_prepare names it (without starting the game's loaders). */
+    const char* od = getenv("RSX_SHADER_CACHE_DIR");
+    if (od && od[0]) snprintf(s_pj_cache, sizeof s_pj_cache, "%s", od);
+    else { CreateDirectoryA("scratch", NULL);
+           snprintf(s_pj_cache, sizeof s_pj_cache, "scratch\\rsx_shader_cache_v%u", SHADER_DISK_CACHE_VERSION); }
+    CreateDirectoryA(s_pj_cache, NULL);
+    char progress[MAX_PATH], stamp_path[MAX_PATH], stamp[1024], launcher[256], old[1024] = "";
+    snprintf(progress, sizeof progress, "%s\\prepare_progress.txt", s_pj_cache);
+    snprintf(stamp_path, sizeof stamp_path, "%s\\prepared.txt", s_pj_cache);
+    if (!ld_prep_on()) { ld_prep_progress(progress, 0, 0, 1); return 0; }
+    if (!ld_prep_dir()) { fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] no folder for the lists\n"); ld_prep_progress(progress, 0, 0, 1); return 1; }
+    const u32 cfg = ld_prep_cfg_compute();
+    ld_prep_stamp(stamp, sizeof stamp, cfg);
+    ld_prep_launcher_line(launcher, sizeof launcher);
+    { FILE* f = fopen(stamp_path, "r"); if (f) { if (!fgets(old, sizeof old, f)) old[0] = 0; fclose(f); } }
+    if (!force && !strcmp(old, stamp)) {
+        ld_prep_write_stamp(stamp_path, stamp, launcher);   /* the launcher's line may be newer (settings.bat saved) */
+        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] prepared already for this build, these settings and this driver\n");
+        ld_prep_progress(progress, 0, 0, 1);
+        return 0;
+    }
+    /* What the cache has: the pack's entries and the files beside it. */
+    s_have = (ld_prep_have*)calloc(LD_PREP_HAVE_SLOTS, sizeof *s_have);
+    if (!s_have) { fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] out of memory\n"); return 1; }
+    size_t pack_n = 0;
+    char pack_path[MAX_PATH];
+    snprintf(pack_path, sizeof pack_path, "%s\\pack.bin", s_pj_cache);
+    u8* pack = ld_prep_read_file(pack_path, &pack_n);
+    u32 pack_count = 0;
+    if (pack && pack_n >= 8) {
+        u32 m; memcpy(&m, pack, 4); memcpy(&pack_count, pack + 4, 4);
+        if (m != SHADER_PACK_MAGIC) pack_count = 0;
+    }
+    { size_t off = 8;
+      for (u32 i = 0; i < pack_count && off + 4 <= pack_n; i++) {
+          u32 size; memcpy(&size, pack + off, 4); off += 4;
+          if (size > pack_n - off) break;
+          u64 key; shader_disk_cache_header hd;
+          if (shader_mem_entry_key(pack + off, size, &key)) {
+              memcpy(&hd, pack + off, sizeof hd);
+              ld_prep_have* h = ld_prep_have_slot(hd.stage, hd.source_hash, hd.source_length, 1);
+              if (h && !h->entry) h->entry = pack + off;
+          }
+          off += size;
+      } }

+      snprintf(pat, sizeof pat, "%s\\*_*.bin", s_pj_cache);
+      HANDLE fh = FindFirstFileA(pat, &fd);
+      if (fh != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
+          do {
+              char st = 0; unsigned long long h = 0; unsigned len = 0;
+              if (sscanf(fd.cFileName, "%c_%16llX_%8X.bin", &st, &h, &len) == 3 && (st == 'V' || st == 'P'))
+                  ld_prep_have_slot((u32)(u8)st, (u64)h, len, 1);
+          } while (FindNextFileA(fh, &fd));
+          FindClose(fh);
+      } }
+    const u32 n_cached = s_have_n;
+    /* The lists and the programs. */
+    if (!ld_prep_load_lists(&s_pl) || !ld_prep_table_make(s_pl.n, ld_prep_prog_hint())) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] the lists could not be read\n");
+        ld_prep_progress(progress, 0, 0, 1);
+        return 1;
+    }
+    u32 n_prog = 0;
+    ld_prep_load_programs(&n_prog);
+    /* 1. Translate, collect the missing texts and the made-ahead records. */
+    static char vs[256 * 1024], ps[256 * 1024];
+    u32 cap_jobs = 4096u, n_ahead = 0, n_ready = 0, n_other = 0, n_fail = 0, n_wait = 0;
+    s_pj = (ld_prep_job*)calloc(cap_jobs, sizeof *s_pj);
+    s_pp = (ld_ahead_rec*)malloc(((size_t)s_pl.n + 1u) * sizeof *s_pp);
+    if (!s_pj || !s_pp) { fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] out of memory\n"); return 1; }
+    /* Oldest first, so the PC's newest pipelines end up last in the made-ahead list (the ones it keeps):
+     * the shipped records (s_pl.r[own..n), in file order), then the PC's own (s_pl.r[0..own) is newest
+     * first, so from own - 1 down to 0). */
+    for (u32 step = 0; step < s_pl.n; step++) {
+        const u32 i = step < s_pl.n - s_pl.own ? s_pl.own + step : s_pl.n - 1u - step;
+        const ld_prep_rec* r = &s_pl.r[i];
+        ld_prep_prog* vp = NULL; ld_prep_prog* fp = NULL;
+        if (!ld_prep_usable(r, cfg)) { n_other++; continue; }
+        if (!ld_prep_rec_ready(i, s_pl.r, &vp, &fp)) { n_wait++; continue; }
+        if (!ld_prep_translate(r, vp->bytes, fp->bytes, vs, sizeof vs, ps, sizeof ps)) { n_fail++; continue; }
+        n_ready++;
+        u64 hv = 0, hp = 0; u32 lv = 0, lp = 0;
+        int ok = 1;
+        for (int k = 0; k < 2 && ok; k++) {
+            const char* src = k ? ps : vs;
+            const u32 stage = k ? 'P' : 'V';
+            const u32 len = (u32)strlen(src);
+            const u64 h = fnv1a(src, len, 1469598103934665603ull);
+            if (k) { hp = h; lp = len; } else { hv = h; lv = len; }
+            if (ld_prep_have_slot(stage, h, len, 0)) continue;   /* cached (or already a job of this run) */
+            if ((u32)s_pj_n == cap_jobs) {
+                ld_prep_job* p = (ld_prep_job*)realloc(s_pj, (size_t)cap_jobs * 2u * sizeof *s_pj);
+                if (!p) { ok = 0; break; }
+                memset(p + cap_jobs, 0, (size_t)cap_jobs * sizeof *p);
+                s_pj = p; cap_jobs *= 2u;
+            }
+            char* copy = (char*)malloc(len + 1u);
+            ld_prep_have* hs = copy ? ld_prep_have_slot(stage, h, len, 1) : NULL;
+            if (!hs) { free(copy); ok = 0; break; }
+            memcpy(copy, src, len + 1u);
+            hs->job = (s32)s_pj_n;
+            s_pj[s_pj_n].stage = stage; s_pj[s_pj_n].len = len; s_pj[s_pj_n].hash = h; s_pj[s_pj_n].src = copy;
+            s_pj_n++;
+        }
+        if (ok && ld_prep_usable_pso(r, cfg))
+            ld_ahead_rec_fill(&s_pp[n_ahead++], hv, lv, hp, lp, &r->rs, (r->flags & LD_PREP_F_MASKED) ? 1u : 0u,
+                              r->layout_count, r->attrs, (r->flags & LD_PREP_F_PACKED) ? 1u : 0u);
+    }
+    /* [standin2] The stand-in's own shaders (rsx_standin_d3d12.inc): the built-in list of pixel variants, every other
+     * one these records need, and both vertex ones, so that the game reads them from the cache at its first frame
+     * instead of compiling them (counted in GT5_SHADERS done / total like every shader of this step). */
+    { u64 vars[160]; u32 nv = 0, added = 0;
+      { const u64* bl; const u32 bn = rsx_si_builtin_variants(&bl);   /* [standin4] the built-in list first: also */
+        for (u32 k = 0; k < bn && nv < 128u; k++) vars[nv++] = bl[k]; }   /* on a PC with no records */
+      for (u32 i = 0; i < s_pl.n && nv < 158u; i++) {
+          const ld_prep_rec* r = &s_pl.r[i];
+          if (!ld_prep_usable(r, cfg)) continue;
+          rsx_si_desc d; memset(&d, 0, sizeof d);
+          d.cube_mask = r->cube_mask; d.vol_mask = r->vol_mask; d.shadow = r->shadow_mask ? r->shadow : NULL;
+          d.mv = (r->flags & LD_PREP_F_MV) != 0;
+          const u64 v = rsx_si_variant_of(&d);
+          u32 k = 0; while (k < nv && vars[k] != v) k++;
+          if (k == nv) vars[nv++] = v;
+      }
+      static char sisrc[96 * 1024];
+      for (u32 k = 0; k < nv + 2u; k++) {
+          const u32 stage = k < nv ? 'P' : 'V';
+          const u32 len = k < nv ? rsx_si_variant_source(vars[k], sisrc, sizeof sisrc)
+                                 : rsx_si_vp_source((int)(k - nv), sisrc, sizeof sisrc);
+          if (!len) continue;
+          const u64 h = fnv1a(sisrc, len, 1469598103934665603ull);
+          if (ld_prep_have_slot(stage, h, len, 0)) continue;   /* cached already */
+          if ((u32)s_pj_n == cap_jobs) {
+              ld_prep_job* q = (ld_prep_job*)realloc(s_pj, (size_t)cap_jobs * 2u * sizeof *s_pj);
+              if (!q) break;
+              memset(q + cap_jobs, 0, (size_t)cap_jobs * sizeof *q);
+              s_pj = q; cap_jobs *= 2u;
+          }
+          char* copy = (char*)malloc(len + 1u);
+          ld_prep_have* hs = copy ? ld_prep_have_slot(stage, h, len, 1) : NULL;
+          if (!hs) { free(copy); break; }
+          memcpy(copy, sisrc, len + 1u);
+          hs->job = (s32)s_pj_n;
+          s_pj[s_pj_n].stage = stage; s_pj[s_pj_n].len = len; s_pj[s_pj_n].hash = h; s_pj[s_pj_n].src = copy;
+          s_pj_n++; added++;
+      }
+      fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] the stand-in's shaders: %u variants, %u to compile\n", nv + 2u, added); }
+    /* [found] every program of the game's files (rsx_shader_found.inc): vertex shaders exactly, pixel shaders for the
+     * likeliest texture bindings; after the records' and the stand-in's, so the surest come first. */
+    { ld_found_jobs jc; jc.cap = &cap_jobs; jc.added = 0;
+      u32 nvp = 0, nfp = 0, nsets = 0;
+      /* every text made from the files, by hash, for the game's count of how many its draws met were predicted */
+      char tp[MAX_PATH], tt[MAX_PATH];
+      snprintf(tp, sizeof tp, "%s\\found_texts.bin", s_prep_dir);
+      snprintf(tt, sizeof tt, "%s.tmp.%lu", tp, (unsigned long)GetCurrentProcessId());
+      jc.texts = ld_found_on() ? fopen(tt, "wb") : NULL;
+      LARGE_INTEGER f0, f1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&f0);
+      const u32 texts = ld_found_prepare(ld_found_job_add, &jc, &nvp, &nfp, &nsets);
+      QueryPerformanceCounter(&f1);
+      if (jc.texts) {
+          if (fclose(jc.texts) != 0 || !MoveFileExA(tt, tp, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING)) DeleteFileA(tt);
+      }
+      if (ld_found_on())
+          fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] the game's files: %u vertex and %u fragment programs known (%lld in the executable), "
+                  "%u likely texture bindings (up to %u a fragment program): %u texts, %u to compile (%.1f s)\n", nvp, nfp,
+                  (long long)s_found_exe, nsets, ld_found_ps_count(), texts, jc.added,
+                  (double)(f1.QuadPart - f0.QuadPart) / (double)fq.QuadPart); }
+    s_pp_n = (LONG)n_ahead;
+    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t1);
+    fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] %u pipelines listed (%u noted on this PC, %u shipped, %u of an older version), %u programs "
+            "stored: %u translated (%u did not), %u wait for programs, %u were made under other settings; %ld shaders to "
+            "compile (%u in the cache), %.1f s\n",
+            s_pl.n, s_pl.own, s_pl.shipped, s_pl.v1, n_prog, n_ready, n_fail, n_wait, n_other, (long)s_pj_n, n_cached,
+            (double)(t1.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart) / (double)fq.QuadPart);
+    /* 2. Compile on every logical processor (the PC stays usable: below normal priority). */
+    if (nt <= 0) { SYSTEM_INFO si; GetSystemInfo(&si); nt = (int)si.dwNumberOfProcessors; }
+    if (nt > 64) nt = 64;
+    if (nt < 1) nt = 1;
+    const LONG total = s_pj_n + s_pp_n;
+    ld_prep_progress(progress, 0, total, 1);
+    HANDLE th[64]; int started = 0;
+    for (int k = 0; k < nt && k < s_pj_n; k++) {
+        th[started] = CreateThread(NULL, 1u << 20, ld_prep_compile_worker, NULL, 0, NULL);
+        if (th[started]) started++;
+    }
+    if (!started && s_pj_n) ld_prep_compile_worker(NULL);
+    while (started && WaitForMultipleObjects((DWORD)started, th, TRUE, 250) == WAIT_TIMEOUT)
+        ld_prep_progress(progress, s_pj_done, total, 0);
+    for (int k = 0; k < started; k++) CloseHandle(th[k]);
+    const int compile_threads = started ? started : 1;
+    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t2);
+    /* The pack again: the old one's entries and this run's shaders (the next start reads it whole). */
+    int pack_ok = 1;
+    if (s_pj_n > s_pj_fail) {
+        char tmp[MAX_PATH];
+        snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.tmp.%lu", pack_path, (unsigned long)GetCurrentProcessId());
+        FILE* o = fopen(tmp, "wb");
+        pack_ok = o != NULL;
+        u32 count = 0;
+        if (o) {
+            const u32 m = SHADER_PACK_MAGIC;
+            pack_ok = fwrite(&m, 4, 1, o) == 1 && fwrite(&count, 4, 1, o) == 1;
+            size_t off = 8;
+            for (u32 i = 0; pack_ok && i < pack_count && off + 4 <= pack_n; i++) {
+                u32 size; memcpy(&size, pack + off, 4);
+                if (size > pack_n - off - 4) break;
+                pack_ok = fwrite(pack + off, 1, 4u + size, o) == 4u + size;
+                off += 4u + size; count++;
+            }
+            for (LONG i = 0; pack_ok && i < s_pj_n; i++) {
+                const ld_prep_job* j = &s_pj[i];
+                if (!j->blob) continue;
+                shader_disk_cache_header h;
+                memset(&h, 0, sizeof h);
+                h.magic = SHADER_DISK_CACHE_MAGIC; h.version = SHADER_DISK_CACHE_VERSION; h.stage = j->stage;
+                h.source_length = j->len; h.blob_length = j->blob_len; h.source_hash = j->hash;
+                const u32 size = (u32)sizeof h + j->len + j->blob_len;

+                count++;
+            }
+            if (pack_ok) pack_ok = _fseeki64(o, 4, SEEK_SET) == 0 && fwrite(&count, 4, 1, o) == 1;
+            pack_ok = (fclose(o) == 0) && pack_ok;
+            if (pack_ok) pack_ok = MoveFileExA(tmp, pack_path, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING) != 0;
+            if (!pack_ok) DeleteFileA(tmp);
+        }
+    }
+    /* 3. The pipelines, once each, on the GPU the game uses. */

+        for (int k = 0; k < nt && k < s_pp_n; k++) {
+            th[pso_threads] = CreateThread(NULL, 1u << 20, ld_prep_pso_worker, NULL, 0, NULL);
+            if (th[pso_threads]) pso_threads++;
+        }
+        if (!pso_threads) ld_prep_pso_worker(NULL);
+        while (pso_threads && WaitForMultipleObjects((DWORD)pso_threads, th, TRUE, 250) == WAIT_TIMEOUT)

+        for (int k = 0; k < pso_threads; k++) CloseHandle(th[k]);
+    } else if (s_pp_n) fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] no graphics device: the pipelines are left to the game\n");
+    ld_prep_progress(progress, total, total, 1);
+    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t3);
+    free(pack);   /* the pipelines read their shaders from it */
+    /* 4. The made-ahead list: its records, then these (the newest are the ones the game keeps and makes). */
+    { char lst[MAX_PATH], tmp[MAX_PATH]; size_t n = 0;
+      snprintf(lst, sizeof lst, "%s\\pipelines_d3d12.lst", s_pj_cache);
+      snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.tmp.%lu", lst, (unsigned long)GetCurrentProcessId());
+      u8* old_l = ld_prep_read_file(lst, &n);
+      FILE* o = n_ahead ? fopen(tmp, "wb") : NULL;
+      int ok = o != NULL;
+      if (o) {
+          const size_t whole = n - n % sizeof(ld_ahead_rec);
+          if (old_l && whole) ok = fwrite(old_l, 1, whole, o) == whole;
+          if (ok) ok = fwrite(s_pp, sizeof *s_pp, n_ahead, o) == n_ahead;
+          ok = (fclose(o) == 0) && ok;
+          if (ok) ok = MoveFileExA(tmp, lst, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING) != 0;
+          if (!ok) DeleteFileA(tmp);
+      }
+      free(old_l); }
+    const int complete = s_pj_fail == 0 && pack_ok;
+    if (complete) ld_prep_write_stamp(stamp_path, stamp, launcher);
+    fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] compiled %ld of %ld shaders on %d threads in %.1f s (%ld failed); "
+            "%ld of %ld pipelines made on %d threads in %.1f s (%.1f s in the driver, %ld failed)%s; "
+            "%u pipelines into the made-ahead list%s\n",
+            (long)s_pj_done - (long)s_pj_fail, (long)s_pj_n, compile_threads,
+            (double)(t2.QuadPart - t1.QuadPart) / (double)fq.QuadPart, (long)s_pj_fail,
+            (long)s_pp_done - (long)s_pp_fail, (long)s_pp_n, pso_threads ? pso_threads : (have_dev ? 1 : 0),
+            (double)(t3.QuadPart - t2.QuadPart) / (double)fq.QuadPart, (double)s_pp_qpc / (double)fq.QuadPart,
+            (long)s_pp_fail, have_dev ? "" : " (no device)", n_ahead,
+            complete ? "" : "; not all done: the next run carries on");
+    return complete ? 0 : 1;
+}

+/*
+ * ps3recomp - inet_pton for AF_INET, the way the PS3's libnet (a BSD network
+ * library) reads an address: exactly four dot-separated decimal parts, each
+ * 0..255, no leading zeros ("01" is refused, "0" is fine), nothing before,
+ * between or after them. Used by the offline network model in ppu_sysprx.cpp,
+ * which must answer without a host socket library.
+ *
+ * Reads the text one byte at a time and stops at the first byte that cannot
+ * continue an address, so it never looks further than about sixteen bytes.
+ * Returns 1 and fills out[0..3] (network order) on success; returns 0 and
+ * leaves out untouched otherwise.
+ */
+#ifndef PS3RECOMP_NET_INET_PTON4_H
+#define PS3RECOMP_NET_INET_PTON4_H
+
+#include <stdint.h>
+
+static inline int net_inet_pton4(const uint8_t* src, uint8_t out[4])
+{
+    uint8_t part[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
+    int parts = 0;          /* parts started so far */
+    int in_part = 0;        /* the current part has a digit */
+    unsigned value = 0;
+    for (;;) {
+        const uint8_t ch = *src++;
+        if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
+            if (in_part && value == 0) return 0;        /* leading zero */
+            value = value * 10u + (unsigned)(ch - '0');
+            if (value > 255u) return 0;
+            if (!in_part) {
+                if (++parts > 4) return 0;
+                in_part = 1;
+            }
+            part[parts - 1] = (uint8_t)value;
+        } else if (ch == '.' && in_part) {
+            if (parts == 4) return 0;
+            in_part = 0;
+            value = 0;
+        } else if (ch == 0) {
+            break;
+        } else {
+            return 0;
+        }
+    }
+    if (parts < 4 || !in_part) return 0;
+    out[0] = part[0]; out[1] = part[1]; out[2] = part[2]; out[3] = part[3];
+    return 1;
+}
+
+#endif /* PS3RECOMP_NET_INET_PTON4_H */

+        if (ctx->image_id >= 0 && ((stop_lsa && ctx->pc == stop_lsa) || (ctx->pc != seq_next && spu_lifted_lookup(ctx, ctx->pc)))) { g_spu_interp_steps = steps; g_spu_interp_last_pc = ctx->pc; return ctx->pc; }  /* rejoin fast path */
+        seq_next = (ctx->pc + 4) & 0x3FFFC;
         g_spu_interp_last_pc = ctx->pc;
         if (_g1>0) {
             int inr = (ctx->pc >= 0x26E80u && ctx->pc < 0x26F14u);

+/* spu_jcap.c -- job capture (see spu_jcap.h for the switches and the file layout).
+ *
+ * One recorder per captured job, owned by the host thread that runs it: a context is pinned to its thread
+ * for the length of a run, so nothing here is shared between threads except the per-image counters
+ * (atomics) and the output directory (written once at start). Two recorders can be open on a thread at
+ * once: a policy-module run (kind 3) of j75BFE68A and, inside it, one WWS job (kind 1); each operation goes
+ * to both. */
+#include "spu_context.h"
+#include "spu_jcap.h"
+#include "spu_workload.h"
+#include <stdio.h>
+#include <stdlib.h>
+#include <string.h>
+#include <time.h>
+#if defined(_WIN32)
+#include <direct.h>
+#include <immintrin.h>
+#define JCAP_MKDIR(p) _mkdir(p)
+#else
+#include <sys/stat.h>
+#include <immintrin.h>
+#define JCAP_MKDIR(p) mkdir(p, 0777)
+#endif
+
+int g_spu_jcap_on = -1;
+
+#define JCAP_MAX_IMAGES 128
+#define JCAP_WWS_RETURN 0x3280u
+typedef struct {
+    char name[16];
+    volatile long seen;       /* jobs of this image met so far */
+    volatile long started;    /* captures begun (at most s_n) */
+    volatile long written;
+} jcap_img;
+
+static char s_list[1024];     /* ",w018CAD00,j75BFE68A," */
+static int  s_all, s_all_w, s_all_j;
+static char s_dir[600];
+static long s_n = 8, s_skip = 0, s_every = 1;
+static long s_minjobs = 0;    /* SPU_JOB_CAPTURE_MINJOBS: a policy-module run (kind 3) is kept only with this many jobs in it */
+static uint64_t s_max_bytes = 64ull << 20;
+static jcap_img s_img[JCAP_MAX_IMAGES];
+static volatile long s_nimg;
+static volatile long s_img_lock;
+
+typedef struct jcap_recorder {
+    spu_context* ctx;
+    int kind;
+    uint32_t ret_pc, depth;
+    jcap_img* img;
+    spu_jcap_file_header hdr;
+    u128 gpr[128], irq_gpr[128];
+    uint8_t* ls;
+    uint8_t* buf;
+    size_t len, cap;
+    uint32_t nrec;
+    int truncated;
+    uint32_t restarts;        /* RESTART records written (a WWS job unwound by its computed return) */
+    uint32_t jobs;            /* kind 3: WWS jobs the run called */
+    /* lock-line command in progress */
+    uint32_t at_lsa;
+    uint8_t at_before[128];
+} jcap_recorder;
+
+#define JCAP_NEST 2
+static _Thread_local jcap_recorder* t_rec[JCAP_NEST];
+static _Thread_local int t_nrec;
+
+static uint64_t jcap_ns(void)
+{
+    struct timespec ts; timespec_get(&ts, TIME_UTC);
+    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec;
+}
+
+int spu_jcap_init(void)
+{
+    if (g_spu_jcap_on >= 0) return g_spu_jcap_on;
+    const char* e = getenv("SPU_JOB_CAPTURE");
+    if (!e || !*e) { __atomic_store_n(&g_spu_jcap_on, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); return 0; }
+    snprintf(s_list, sizeof s_list, ",%s,", e);
+    for (char* p = s_list; *p; p++) if (*p == ' ' || *p == ';') *p = ',';
+    s_all = strstr(s_list, ",*,") != NULL;
+    s_all_w = strstr(s_list, ",w*,") != NULL;
+    s_all_j = strstr(s_list, ",j*,") != NULL;
+    const char* d = getenv("SPU_JOB_CAPTURE_DIR");
+    if (d && *d) snprintf(s_dir, sizeof s_dir, "%s", d);
+    else {
+        const char* t = getenv("TEMP");
+        snprintf(s_dir, sizeof s_dir, "%s%sgt5_jcap", t ? t : ".", t ? "\\" : "/");
+    }
+    JCAP_MKDIR(s_dir);
+    const char* n = getenv("SPU_JOB_CAPTURE_N");
+    if (n && *n) s_n = atol(n);
+    if (s_n < 0) s_n = 0;
+    const char* k = getenv("SPU_JOB_CAPTURE_SKIP");
+    if (k && *k) s_skip = atol(k);
+    if (s_skip < 0) s_skip = 0;
+    const char* v = getenv("SPU_JOB_CAPTURE_EVERY");
+    if (v && *v) s_every = atol(v);
+    if (s_every < 1) s_every = 1;
+    const char* m = getenv("SPU_JOB_CAPTURE_MAX_MB");
+    if (m && *m && atol(m) > 0) s_max_bytes = (uint64_t)atol(m) << 20;
+    const char* mj = getenv("SPU_JOB_CAPTURE_MINJOBS");
+    if (mj && *mj && atol(mj) > 0) s_minjobs = atol(mj);
+    fprintf(stderr, "[jcap] job capture on: %s, %ld per image (skip %ld, every %ld), into %s\n",
+            e, s_n, s_skip, s_every, s_dir);
+    fflush(stderr);
+    __atomic_store_n(&g_spu_jcap_on, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
+    return 1;
+}
+
+static jcap_img* jcap_img_for(const char* name)
+{
+    const long n = __atomic_load_n(&s_nimg, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
+    for (long i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!strcmp(s_img[i].name, name)) return &s_img[i];
+    while (__atomic_exchange_n(&s_img_lock, 1, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) {}
+    jcap_img* r = NULL;
+    const long m = s_nimg;
+    for (long i = 0; i < m; i++) if (!strcmp(s_img[i].name, name)) r = &s_img[i];
+    if (!r && m < JCAP_MAX_IMAGES) {
+        r = &s_img[m];
+        snprintf(r->name, sizeof r->name, "%s", name);
+        __atomic_store_n(&s_nimg, m + 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
+    }
+    __atomic_store_n(&s_img_lock, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
+    return r;
+}
+
+static int jcap_wanted(const char* name)
+{
+    if (!name || !*name) return 0;
+    if (s_all || (s_all_w && name[0] == 'w') || (s_all_j && name[0] == 'j')) return 1;
+    char k[24];
+    snprintf(k, sizeof k, ",%s,", name);
+    return strstr(s_list, k) != NULL;
+}
+
+/* This job of `name`: capture it? Returns the image's counter block (job number in *job_no) or NULL. */
+static jcap_img* jcap_select(const char* name, uint32_t* job_no)
+{
+    if (!jcap_wanted(name)) return NULL;
+    jcap_img* im = jcap_img_for(name);
+    if (!im) return NULL;
+    const long seen = __atomic_add_fetch(&im->seen, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
+    if (seen <= s_skip || (seen - s_skip - 1) % s_every) return NULL;
+    if (__atomic_load_n(&im->started, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) >= s_n) return NULL;
+    if (__atomic_add_fetch(&im->started, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) > s_n) return NULL;
+    *job_no = (uint32_t)seen;
+    return im;
+}
+
+static void jcap_state(const spu_context* c, spu_jcap_state* s)
+{
+    memset(s, 0, sizeof *s);
+    s->pc = c->pc; s->status = c->status; s->stop_code = c->stop_code; s->int_enable = c->int_enable;
+    s->srr0 = c->srr0; s->event_status = c->event_status; s->event_mask = c->event_mask;
+    s->decrementer = c->decrementer;
+    s->mfc_lsa = c->mfc_lsa; s->mfc_eah = c->mfc_eah; s->mfc_eal = c->mfc_eal; s->mfc_size = c->mfc_size;
+    s->mfc_tag = c->mfc_tag; s->mfc_tag_mask = c->mfc_tag_mask; s->mfc_tag_status = c->mfc_tag_status;
+    s->atomic_stat = c->atomic_stat;
+    s->resv_ea = c->resv_ea; s->resv_valid = (uint32_t)c->resv_valid;
+    s->list_stall_mask = c->list_stall_mask; s->list_stall_stat = c->list_stall_stat;
+    s->irq_saved = (uint32_t)c->irq_saved; s->irq_resume_pc = c->irq_resume_pc;
+    s->irq_stall_seen = c->irq_stall_seen; s->host_depth = c->host_depth;
+    s->steps = c->steps; s->policy_mode = (uint32_t)c->policy_mode; s->drain_ret_pc = c->drain_ret_pc;
+    s->spu_id = c->spu_id;
+    s->out_mbox_count = c->ch_out_mbox.count; s->out_mbox_value = c->ch_out_mbox.value;
+    s->out_intr_mbox_count = c->ch_out_intr_mbox.count; s->out_intr_mbox_value = c->ch_out_intr_mbox.value;
+    s->in_mbox_count = c->ch_in_mbox.count; s->in_mbox_value = c->ch_in_mbox.value;
+    s->sig1_count = c->ch_sig_notify[0].count; s->sig1_value = c->ch_sig_notify[0].value;
+    s->sig2_count = c->ch_sig_notify[1].count; s->sig2_value = c->ch_sig_notify[1].value;
+    s->image_id = (uint32_t)c->image_id; s->resident_ovl = (uint32_t)c->resident_ovl;
+    s->resident_task = (uint32_t)c->resident_task; s->module_img_a00 = (uint32_t)c->module_img_a00;
+    s->park_on_empty_inmbox = (uint32_t)c->park_on_empty_inmbox; s->spu_group_id = c->spu_group_id;
+}
+
+static uint32_t jcap_be32(const uint8_t* p)
+{
+    return ((uint32_t)p[0] << 24) | ((uint32_t)p[1] << 16) | ((uint32_t)p[2] << 8) | p[3];
+}
+
+/* Name of a context image id: the SPURS-job registry's name, else "img<id>". */
+static void jcap_image_name(int id, char out[16])
+{
+    out[0] = 0;
+    if (!id) return;
+    const char* n = spu_workload_image_name(id);
+    if (n && *n) snprintf(out, 16, "%s", n);
+    else snprintf(out, 16, "img%d", id);
+}
+
+static void jcap_slot_name(const spu_context* c, unsigned s, char out[16])
+{
+    out[0] = 0;
+    if (!c->resident_code[s].image_id) return;
+    if (c->resident_code[s].source_ea) snprintf(out, 16, "w%08X", c->resident_code[s].source_ea);
+    else jcap_image_name(c->resident_code[s].image_id, out);
+}
+
+static void jcap_begin(spu_context* ctx, int kind, jcap_img* im, uint32_t job_no, const char* name)
+{
+    if (t_nrec >= JCAP_NEST) { __atomic_sub_fetch(&im->started, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); return; }
+    jcap_recorder* r = (jcap_recorder*)calloc(1, sizeof *r);
+    uint8_t* ls = r ? (uint8_t*)malloc(SPU_LS_SIZE) : NULL;
+    if (!r || !ls) { free(r); __atomic_sub_fetch(&im->started, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); return; }
+    r->ctx = ctx; r->kind = kind; r->img = im; r->ls = ls;
+    spu_jcap_file_header* h = &r->hdr;
+    memcpy(h->magic, SPU_JCAP_MAGIC, 8);
+    h->version = SPU_JCAP_VERSION;
+    h->header_size = (uint32_t)sizeof *h;
+    snprintf(h->image, sizeof h->image, "%s", name);
+    jcap_image_name(ctx->image_id, h->ctx_image);
+    jcap_image_name(ctx->resident_ovl, h->ovl_image);
+    h->kind = (uint32_t)kind;
+    h->job_no = job_no;
+    h->mxcsr = _mm_getcsr();
+    if (ctx->policy_mode) {
+        h->wid = jcap_be32(ctx->ls + 0x1DC);
+        h->spu_num = jcap_be32(ctx->ls + 0x1C8);
+    }
+    h->t_start_ns = jcap_ns();
+    for (unsigned s = 0; s < 4; s++) {
+        spu_jcap_slot* d = &h->slots[s];
+        d->lsa = ctx->resident_code[s].lsa; d->size = ctx->resident_code[s].size;
+        d->source_ea = ctx->resident_code[s].source_ea; d->image_id = (uint32_t)ctx->resident_code[s].image_id;
+        d->verify_state = ctx->resident_code[s].verify_state; d->source_index = ctx->resident_code[s].source_index;
+        jcap_slot_name(ctx, s, d->name);
+    }
+    jcap_state(ctx, &h->entry);
+    memcpy(r->gpr, ctx->gpr, sizeof r->gpr);
+    memcpy(r->irq_gpr, ctx->irq_gpr, sizeof r->irq_gpr);
+    memcpy(r->ls, ctx->ls, SPU_LS_SIZE);
+    t_rec[t_nrec++] = r;
+}
+
+/* ---- records ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
+static void jcap_put(jcap_recorder* r, uint16_t type, uint16_t flags, uint32_t a, uint32_t b,
+                     const void* p1, uint32_t n1, const void* p2, uint32_t n2)
+{
+    if (r->truncated) return;
+    const size_t need = sizeof(spu_jcap_rec) + n1 + n2;
+    if (r->len + need > s_max_bytes) { r->truncated = 1; return; }
+    if (r->len + need > r->cap) {
+        size_t c = r->cap ? r->cap : (size_t)1 << 20;
+        while (c < r->len + need) c *= 2;
+        uint8_t* nb = (uint8_t*)realloc(r->buf, c);
+        if (!nb) { r->truncated = 1; return; }
+        r->buf = nb; r->cap = c;
+    }
+    spu_jcap_rec h = { type, flags, n1 + n2, a, b };
+    memcpy(r->buf + r->len, &h, sizeof h); r->len += sizeof h;
+    if (n1) { memcpy(r->buf + r->len, p1, n1); r->len += n1; }
+    if (n2) { memcpy(r->buf + r->len, p2, n2); r->len += n2; }
+    r->nrec++;
+}
+
+#define JCAP_EACH(ctx, r) for (int _i = 0; _i < t_nrec; _i++) for (jcap_recorder* r = t_rec[_i]; r && r->ctx == (ctx); r = NULL)
+
+int spu_jcap_active(const spu_context* ctx)
+{
+    for (int i = 0; i < t_nrec; i++) if (t_rec[i]->ctx == ctx) return 1;
+    return 0;
+}
+
+static void jcap_opctx(const spu_context* c, spu_jcap_opctx* o)
+{
+    o->pc = c->pc; o->lr = c->gpr[0]._u32[0]; o->host_depth = c->host_depth; o->int_enable = c->int_enable;
+}
+
+static _Thread_local int t_in_op;
+int spu_jcap_in_op(void) { return t_in_op; }
+
+void spu_jcap_op_wrch(spu_context* ctx, uint32_t channel, const uint32_t value[4])
+{
+    t_in_op = 1;
+    spu_jcap_wrch w;
+    memset(&w, 0, sizeof w);
+    memcpy(w.value, value, 16);
+    w.mfc_lsa = ctx->mfc_lsa; w.mfc_eah = ctx->mfc_eah; w.mfc_eal = ctx->mfc_eal; w.mfc_size = ctx->mfc_size;
+    w.mfc_tag = ctx->mfc_tag; w.mfc_tag_mask = ctx->mfc_tag_mask;
+    jcap_opctx(ctx, &w.at);
+    JCAP_EACH(ctx, r) jcap_put(r, SPU_JCAP_R_WRCH, 0, channel, value[0], &w, sizeof w, NULL, 0);
+}
+
+void spu_jcap_op_rdch(spu_context* ctx, uint32_t channel, const uint32_t value[4])
+{
+    spu_jcap_rdch d;
+    memcpy(d.value, value, 16);
+    jcap_opctx(ctx, &d.at);
+    JCAP_EACH(ctx, r) jcap_put(r, SPU_JCAP_R_RDCH, 0, channel, value[0], &d, sizeof d, NULL, 0);
+}
+
+void spu_jcap_op_rchcnt(spu_context* ctx, uint32_t channel, uint32_t count)
+{
+    spu_jcap_opctx o;
+    jcap_opctx(ctx, &o);
+    JCAP_EACH(ctx, r) jcap_put(r, SPU_JCAP_R_RCHCNT, 0, channel, count, &o, sizeof o, NULL, 0);
+}
+
+static void jcap_post_of(const spu_context* c, spu_jcap_post* p)
+{
+    memset(p, 0, sizeof *p);
+    p->event_status = c->event_status; p->event_mask = c->event_mask;
+    p->mfc_tag_status = c->mfc_tag_status; p->mfc_tag_mask = c->mfc_tag_mask;
+    p->atomic_stat = c->atomic_stat; p->list_stall_mask = c->list_stall_mask;
+    p->list_stall_stat = c->list_stall_stat; p->srr0 = c->srr0;
+    p->int_enable = c->int_enable; p->decrementer = c->decrementer; p->status = c->status;
+    p->irq_stall_seen = c->irq_stall_seen; p->resv_valid = (uint32_t)c->resv_valid; p->resv_ea = c->resv_ea;
+    p->stop_code = c->stop_code;
+}
+
+void spu_jcap_op_post(spu_context* ctx)
+{
+    t_in_op = 0;
+    spu_jcap_post p;
+    jcap_post_of(ctx, &p);
+    JCAP_EACH(ctx, r) jcap_put(r, SPU_JCAP_R_POST, 0, 0, 0, &p, sizeof p, NULL, 0);
+}
+
+/* PUT: the bytes are taken before the transfer (local store is not changed by it); GET: after. */
+static _Thread_local uint8_t t_put_bytes[0x4000];
+static _Thread_local uint32_t t_put_n;
+void spu_jcap_xfer_pre(spu_context* ctx, uint32_t lsa, uint64_t ea, uint32_t size, uint32_t cmd)
+{
+    (void)ea;
+    t_put_n = 0;
+    const int is_get = (cmd & 0x40) != 0, is_put = (cmd & 0x20) && !is_get;
+    if (!is_put || !size || size > sizeof t_put_bytes) return;
+    lsa &= SPU_LS_MASK;
+    if ((uint64_t)lsa + size > SPU_LS_SIZE) return;
+    memcpy(t_put_bytes, ctx->ls + lsa, size);
+    t_put_n = size;
+}
+
+void spu_jcap_xfer_post(spu_context* ctx, uint32_t lsa, uint64_t ea, uint32_t size, uint32_t cmd, int result)
+{
+    spu_jcap_xfer x = { lsa, (uint32_t)(ea >> 32), (uint32_t)ea, result };
+    const int is_get = (cmd & 0x40) != 0, is_put = (cmd & 0x20) && !is_get;
+    const uint8_t* data = NULL;
+    uint32_t n = 0;
+    uint16_t fl = is_put ? SPU_JCAP_XF_PUT : 0;
+    const uint32_t l = lsa & SPU_LS_MASK;
+    if (is_get && size && size <= 0x4000 && (uint64_t)l + size <= SPU_LS_SIZE) { data = ctx->ls + l; n = size; }
+    else if (is_put && t_put_n == size && size) { data = t_put_bytes; n = size; }
+    if (n) fl |= SPU_JCAP_XF_DATA;
+    JCAP_EACH(ctx, r) jcap_put(r, SPU_JCAP_R_XFER, fl, cmd, size, &x, sizeof x, data, n);
+    t_put_n = 0;
+}
+
+static _Thread_local uint8_t t_at_before[128];
+static _Thread_local uint32_t t_at_lsa;
+void spu_jcap_atomic_pre(spu_context* ctx, uint32_t cmd)
+{
+    (void)cmd;
+    t_at_lsa = ctx->mfc_lsa & SPU_LS_MASK & ~127u;
+    memcpy(t_at_before, ctx->ls + t_at_lsa, 128);
+}
+
+void spu_jcap_atomic_post(spu_context* ctx, uint32_t cmd, int handled)
+{
+    if (!handled) return;       /* not a lock-line command: the DMA engine takes it, with its own records */
+    spu_jcap_atomic a;
+    a.lsa = t_at_lsa; a.atomic_stat = ctx->atomic_stat; a.handled = (uint32_t)handled; a.pad = 0;
+    memcpy(a.before, t_at_before, 128);
+    memcpy(a.after, ctx->ls + t_at_lsa, 128);
+    const uint32_t ea = ctx->mfc_eal;
+    JCAP_EACH(ctx, r) jcap_put(r, SPU_JCAP_R_ATOMIC, 0, cmd & 0xFFFFu, ea, &a, sizeof a, NULL, 0);
+}
+
+void spu_jcap_op_irq(spu_context* ctx, uint32_t target)
+{
+    spu_jcap_irq q = { ctx->event_status, ctx->event_mask, ctx->list_stall_stat, ctx->host_depth };
+    JCAP_EACH(ctx, r) jcap_put(r, SPU_JCAP_R_IRQ, 0, ctx->srr0, target, &q, sizeof q, NULL, 0);
+}
+
+/* ---- the end of a capture: the file ------------------------------------------------------------- */
+static void jcap_finish(jcap_recorder* r, uint32_t flags)
+{
+    spu_context* ctx = r->ctx;
+    if (r->kind == SPU_JCAP_KIND_POLICY_RUN && r->jobs < (uint32_t)s_minjobs) {
+        /* SPU_JOB_CAPTURE_MINJOBS: a run with too few jobs is dropped and does not count */
+        __atomic_sub_fetch(&r->img->started, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
+        free(r->buf); free(r->ls); free(r);
+        return;
+    }
+    jcap_put(r, SPU_JCAP_R_END, 0, r->nrec, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 0);
+    spu_jcap_file_header* h = &r->hdr;
+    h->flags = flags | (r->truncated ? SPU_JCAP_F_TRUNCATED : 0);
+    h->n_records = r->nrec;
+    h->records_bytes = r->len;
+    h->t_end_ns = jcap_ns();
+    const long seq = __atomic_fetch_add(&r->img->written, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
+    h->seq = (uint32_t)seq;
+    char path[700];
+    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s%c%s_k%u_%04ld.jcap", s_dir,
+#if defined(_WIN32)
+             '\\',
+#else
+             '/',
+#endif
+             h->image, h->kind, seq);
+    spu_jcap_state s;
+    const int complete = (flags & SPU_JCAP_F_COMPLETE) != 0;
+    if (complete) jcap_state(ctx, &s);
+    h->crc32 = 0;
+    uint32_t crc = spu_jcap_crc32(0, h, sizeof *h);
+    crc = spu_jcap_crc32(crc, r->gpr, sizeof r->gpr);
+    crc = spu_jcap_crc32(crc, r->irq_gpr, sizeof r->irq_gpr);
+    crc = spu_jcap_crc32(crc, r->ls, SPU_LS_SIZE);
+    if (r->len) crc = spu_jcap_crc32(crc, r->buf, r->len);
+    if (complete) {
+        crc = spu_jcap_crc32(crc, &s, sizeof s);
+        crc = spu_jcap_crc32(crc, ctx->gpr, sizeof ctx->gpr);
+        crc = spu_jcap_crc32(crc, ctx->ls, SPU_LS_SIZE);
+    }
+    h->crc32 = crc;
+    FILE* f = fopen(path, "wb");
+    int ok = 0;
+    if (f) {
+        ok = fwrite(h, sizeof *h, 1, f) == 1 && fwrite(r->gpr, sizeof r->gpr, 1, f) == 1 &&
+             fwrite(r->irq_gpr, sizeof r->irq_gpr, 1, f) == 1 && fwrite(r->ls, SPU_LS_SIZE, 1, f) == 1 &&
+             (r->len == 0 || fwrite(r->buf, r->len, 1, f) == 1);
+        if (ok && complete)
+            ok = fwrite(&s, sizeof s, 1, f) == 1 && fwrite(ctx->gpr, sizeof ctx->gpr, 1, f) == 1 &&
+                 fwrite(ctx->ls, SPU_LS_SIZE, 1, f) == 1;
+        ok = (fclose(f) == 0) && ok;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "[jcap] %s %s: %s job %u (kind %u), %u records, %llu bytes of records%s%s%s%s\n",
+            ok ? "wrote" : "FAILED to write", path, h->image, h->job_no, h->kind, h->n_records,
+            (unsigned long long)r->len, (h->flags & SPU_JCAP_F_UNWOUND) ? ", returned through a restart" : "",
+            (h->flags & SPU_JCAP_F_TRUNCATED) ? ", TRUNCATED" : "",
+            (h->flags & SPU_JCAP_F_ABORTED) ? ", the job did not return (not replayable to its end)" : "",
+            (seq + 1 == s_n) ? " -- the last one of this image" : "");
+    fflush(stderr);
+    free(r->buf); free(r->ls); free(r);
+}
+
+static void jcap_pop(jcap_recorder* r)
+{
+    for (int i = 0; i < t_nrec; i++)
+        if (t_rec[i] == r) {
+            for (int j = i; j + 1 < t_nrec; j++) t_rec[j] = t_rec[j + 1];
+            t_rec[--t_nrec] = NULL;
+            return;
+        }
+}
+
+/* ---- start and end points ----------------------------------------------------------------------- */
+/* Top of spu_ib_full: the WWS job manager calling a job (LS 0x327C `bisl $0,$5` of j75BFE68A, the "WWSJ"
+ * marker at 0x15E8): link 0x3280, target in a resident code slot. */
+void spu_jcap_dispatch(spu_context* ctx)
+{
+    if (!ctx->policy_mode) return;
+    const uint32_t pc = ctx->pc & SPU_LS_MASK;
+    if (pc == JCAP_WWS_RETURN) { spu_jcap_reached(ctx); return; }
+    if ((ctx->gpr[0]._u32[0] & SPU_LS_MASK) != JCAP_WWS_RETURN || pc < 0x4000u) return;
+    for (int i = 0; i < t_nrec; i++) if (t_rec[i]->ctx == ctx && t_rec[i]->kind == SPU_JCAP_KIND_WWS_JOB) return;
+    const uint8_t* l = ctx->ls;
+    if (!(l[0x15E8] == 'W' && l[0x15E9] == 'W' && l[0x15EA] == 'S' && l[0x15EB] == 'J' &&
+          jcap_be32(l + 0x327C) == 0x35240280u))
+        return;
+    for (int i = 0; i < t_nrec; i++)                  /* SPU_JOB_CAPTURE_MINJOBS: the runs' job count */
+        if (t_rec[i]->ctx == ctx && t_rec[i]->kind == SPU_JCAP_KIND_POLICY_RUN) t_rec[i]->jobs++;
+    char name[16] = "";
+    for (unsigned s = 0; s < 4; s++)
+        if (ctx->resident_code[s].image_id && pc - ctx->resident_code[s].lsa < ctx->resident_code[s].size) {
+            jcap_slot_name(ctx, s, name);
+            break;
+        }
+    uint32_t job_no = 0;
+    jcap_img* im = jcap_select(name, &job_no);
+    if (!im) return;
+    jcap_begin(ctx, SPU_JCAP_KIND_WWS_JOB, im, job_no, name);
+    if (t_nrec && t_rec[t_nrec - 1]->ctx == ctx && t_rec[t_nrec - 1]->kind == SPU_JCAP_KIND_WWS_JOB) {
+        jcap_recorder* r = t_rec[t_nrec - 1];
+        r->ret_pc = JCAP_WWS_RETURN;
+        r->depth = ctx->host_depth;
+        r->hdr.entry_pc = pc;
+        r->hdr.return_pc = JCAP_WWS_RETURN;
+    }
+}
+
+void spu_jcap_drain_leave(spu_context* ctx, uint32_t return_pc)
+{
+    for (int i = t_nrec - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
+        jcap_recorder* r = t_rec[i];
+        if (r->ctx != ctx || r->kind != SPU_JCAP_KIND_WWS_JOB) continue;
+        if ((return_pc & SPU_LS_MASK) != r->ret_pc || ctx->host_depth != r->depth) return;
+        if ((ctx->pc & SPU_LS_MASK) != r->ret_pc) return;
+        jcap_pop(r);
+        jcap_finish(r, SPU_JCAP_F_COMPLETE | (r->restarts ? SPU_JCAP_F_UNWOUND : 0));
+        return;
+    }
+}
+
+/* GT5's WWS jobs return through a computed link (the crt's `ila $0,0xDC; a $0,$0,$126` = LS 0x40DC) where
+ * nothing is lifted: the job's last host return reaches the manager's drain with pc 0x40DC, the drain finds
+ * no lifted code there and unwinds (spu_restart_dispatch), the run's driver re-dispatches 0x40DC at host
+ * depth 0, the micro-step / interpreter runs the crt's epilogue, and its `bi` reaches 0x3280 with no drain of
+ * the job's left to see it. The job's end is then the first time the pc reaches 0x3280: here, from the top
+ * of spu_ib_full (a dispatch to 0x3280) and from the interpreter (about to run 0x3280). Registers and local
+ * store are the job's exit state at that point, exactly as at a drain return. */
+void spu_jcap_reached(spu_context* ctx)
+{
+    if ((ctx->pc & SPU_LS_MASK) != JCAP_WWS_RETURN) return;
+    for (int i = t_nrec - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
+        jcap_recorder* r = t_rec[i];
+        if (r->ctx != ctx || r->kind != SPU_JCAP_KIND_WWS_JOB) continue;
+        jcap_pop(r);
+        jcap_finish(r, SPU_JCAP_F_COMPLETE | (r->restarts ? SPU_JCAP_F_UNWOUND : 0));
+        return;
+    }
+}
+
+void spu_jcap_restart(spu_context* ctx, int landing)
+{
+    spu_jcap_opctx o;
+    o.pc = ctx->pc; o.lr = ctx->drain_ret_pc; o.host_depth = ctx->host_depth; o.int_enable = ctx->int_enable;
+    JCAP_EACH(ctx, r) { r->restarts++; jcap_put(r, SPU_JCAP_R_RESTART, 0, (uint32_t)landing, ctx->pc & SPU_LS_MASK, &o, sizeof o, NULL, 0); }
+}
+
+void spu_jcap_run_begin(spu_context* ctx, int kind, uint32_t entry_fn_addr)
+{
+    if (g_spu_jcap_on < 0) spu_jcap_init();
+    if (g_spu_jcap_on <= 0) return;
+    char name[16];
+    jcap_image_name(ctx->image_id, name);
+    uint32_t job_no = 0;
+    jcap_img* im = jcap_select(name, &job_no);
+    if (!im) return;
+    jcap_begin(ctx, kind, im, job_no, name);
+    if (t_nrec && t_rec[t_nrec - 1]->ctx == ctx && t_rec[t_nrec - 1]->kind == kind)
+        t_rec[t_nrec - 1]->hdr.entry_fn_addr = entry_fn_addr;
+}
+
+void spu_jcap_run_end(spu_context* ctx, int halted)
+{
+    (void)halted;
+    for (int i = t_nrec - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
+        jcap_recorder* r = t_rec[i];
+        if (r->ctx != ctx) continue;
+        jcap_pop(r);
+        /* a WWS job still open here never came back to 0x3280 in its drain */
+        jcap_finish(r, r->kind == SPU_JCAP_KIND_WWS_JOB ? SPU_JCAP_F_ABORTED : SPU_JCAP_F_COMPLETE);
+    }
+}
