+          g_pso_n = g_pso_fpm = 0; }
+        { extern unsigned long long g_vp_memo_miss, g_fp_memo_miss[2];   /* LD_VP_MEMO, LD_FP_MEMO */
+          fprintf(stderr, "[pso-memo] per present: vertex programs worked out again %.1f; fragment program memo misses "
+                          "%.1f at a place it did not hold (new, or pushed out), %.1f whose words had changed there\n",
+                  (double)g_vp_memo_miss / (n ? n : 1), (double)g_fp_memo_miss[0] / (n ? n : 1),
+                  (double)g_fp_memo_miss[1] / (n ? n : 1));
+          g_vp_memo_miss = g_fp_memo_miss[0] = g_fp_memo_miss[1] = 0; }
+        { extern unsigned long long g_keycheck[3];
+          if (g_keycheck[0])
+              fprintf(stderr, "[pso-keycheck] %llu draws checked: %llu merged two chain keys (must be 0), %llu split one\n",
+                      g_keycheck[0], g_keycheck[1], g_keycheck[2]); }
+        { extern unsigned long long g_bt_tsc[3];
+          /* rdtsc ticks to milliseconds, from the TSC's rate against QPC since the first report. */
+          static unsigned long long tsc0; static LONGLONG qpc0;
+          const unsigned long long tsc_now = __rdtsc();
+          if (!tsc0) { tsc0 = tsc_now; qpc0 = t3; }
+          const double tick_ms = (t3 > qpc0 && tsc_now > tsc0)
+              ? (double)(t3 - qpc0) * 1000.0 / (double)f.QuadPart / (double)(tsc_now - tsc0) : 0.0;
+          const double per = tick_ms / (n ? n : 1);
+          const unsigned long long bt = g_bt_tsc[0] + g_bt_tsc[1] + g_bt_tsc[2];
+          { extern unsigned long long g_tex_neg[2];
+            if (bt && tick_ms > 0.0)
+              fprintf(stderr, "[bind-time] surfaces+textures per present: before the fragment textures %.2f ms, binding them %.2f ms, vertex textures and targets %.2f ms; "
+                              "plain textures known %.0f, learned %.0f\n",
+                      g_bt_tsc[0] * per, g_bt_tsc[1] * per, g_bt_tsc[2] * per,
+                      (double)g_tex_neg[0] / (n ? n : 1), (double)g_tex_neg[1] / (n ? n : 1));
+            g_tex_neg[0] = g_tex_neg[1] = 0; }
+          memset(g_bt_tsc, 0, sizeof g_bt_tsc); }
+        { extern unsigned long long g_cb_dedup[2];
+          if (g_cb_dedup[0] + g_cb_dedup[1])
+              fprintf(stderr, "[vconst] per present: %.0f constant blocks uploaded, %.0f draws reused the one before\n",
+                      (double)g_cb_dedup[1] / (n ? n : 1), (double)g_cb_dedup[0] / (n ? n : 1));
+          g_cb_dedup[0] = g_cb_dedup[1] = 0; }
+        { extern unsigned long long g_rec_ops, g_rec_sync_qpc;
+          extern int ld_rec_fast_now(void);
+          static int mode0 = -1;
+          const int mode1 = ld_rec_fast_now();
+          if (g_rec_ops)
+              fprintf(stderr, "[ld-rec] per present: %.0f calls recorded on the second thread, walker waited %.2f ms for it; queue mode %d->%d\n",
+                      (double)g_rec_ops / (n ? n : 1), (double)g_rec_sync_qpc * k, mode0, mode1);
+          mode0 = mode1;
+          g_rec_ops = g_rec_sync_qpc = 0; }
+        { /* [draw-calls] what LD_SMP_SAMPLED, LD_SRV_REUSE, LD_STATE_DEDUP, LD_CB_RANGE, LD_VC_HULL and
+           * LD_SRV_WRAP left out, per present, and the walker's waits for the GPU. "switches a->b": the six as
+           * bits (1 samplers, 2 tables, 4 calls, 8 constants, 16 write checks, 32 ring wraps) at the window's
+           * start and end; with PS3_AB_WHAT=drawcpu a window with a == b ran one way throughout (63 on, 0 off). */
+          static int dmode0 = -1;
+          const int dmode1 = ld_dc_mode();
+          const double per = 1.0 / (n ? n : 1);
+          fprintf(stderr, "[draw-calls] per present: samplers looked up %.0f, left default (unsampled) %.0f, "
+                          "new sampler tables %.1f, sampler cache full %.0f; texture tables made %.0f, reused %.0f; "
+                          "calls %.0f, not repeated %.0f (constant buffers %.0f, tables %.0f, stencil %.0f, blend %.0f, "
+                          "vertex buffer %.0f, index buffer %.0f); vertex constants %.0f blocks %.0f KB, %.0f reused by value; "
+                          "write checks %.0f (%.0f pages), %.0f saved; rings started over %.0f times in 5 s, retired freed early %.0f | "
+                          "GPU waits: descriptor rings %.1f flushes %.2f ms, presents %.2f ms, other %.1f flushes %.2f ms | switches %d->%d\n",
+#define DCP(x) ((double)(x) * per)
+                  DCP(g_dc[DC_SMP_LOOK]), DCP(g_dc[DC_SMP_SKIP]), DCP(g_dc[DC_SMP_TABLE]), DCP(g_dc[DC_SMP_FULL]),
+                  DCP(g_dc[DC_SRV_MADE]), DCP(g_dc[DC_SRV_REUSE]),
+                  DCP(g_dc[DC_SET] + g_dc[DC_SKIP]), DCP(g_dc[DC_SKIP]), DCP(g_dc[DC_SKIP_CBV]), DCP(g_dc[DC_SKIP_TAB]),
+                  DCP(g_dc[DC_SKIP_STENCIL]), DCP(g_dc[DC_SKIP_BLEND]), DCP(g_dc[DC_SKIP_VB]), DCP(g_dc[DC_SKIP_IB]),
+                  DCP(g_dc[DC_CB_UPLOADS]), DCP(g_dc[DC_CB_BYTES]) / 1024.0, DCP(g_dc[DC_CB_SAME]),
+                  DCP(g_dc[DC_WW_CALLS]), DCP(g_dc[DC_WW_PAGES]), DCP(g_dc[DC_WW_SAVED]),
+                  (double)g_dc[DC_SRV_WRAP], (double)g_dc[DC_RETIRED_FREED],
+                  DCP(g_dc_wait[1][0]), DCP(g_dc_wait[1][1]) / 1000.0, DCP(g_dc_wait[0][1]) / 1000.0,
+                  DCP(g_dc_wait[2][0]), DCP(g_dc_wait[2][1]) / 1000.0, dmode0, dmode1);
+#undef DCP
+          dmode0 = dmode1;
+          memset(g_dc, 0, DC_N * sizeof g_dc[0]);
+          memset(g_dc_wait, 0, sizeof g_dc_wait); }
+        pre = flush = swap = 0; n = 0; last = t3;
+    }
+}
+
+/* Readbacks into guest memory recorded in the open list (rsx_live_draw_read_rect). */
+#define LD_GUEST_READS 32
+#define LD_GUEST_READ_SMALL (64u * 1024u)
+typedef struct { ID3D12Resource* rb; u32 w, h, pitch, ea, dst_pitch; int pooled; u32 frame, src_off; int src;
+                 u32 flips;   /* [shadow] cellGcm_flip_serial() when it was recorded (LD_RB_LATE_LOG) */ } ld_guest_read;
+extern u32 cellGcm_flip_serial(void);
+static ld_guest_read s_guest_reads[LD_GUEST_READS];
+static u32 s_n_guest_reads;
+static ID3D12Resource* s_guest_read_pool[LD_GUEST_READS];
+static u32 s_guest_read_pool_n;
+extern void gcm_guest_row_write(u32 ea, const u8* s, u32 n);
+
+/* After the fence: the list that copied them has finished. Big-endian A8R8G8B8. */
+static SRWLOCK s_guest_read_pool_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
+static void ld_guest_read_apply_one(ld_guest_read* r);
+static void ld_guest_reads_apply(void)
+{
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_n_guest_reads; i++)
+        ld_guest_read_apply_one(&s_guest_reads[i]);
+    s_n_guest_reads = 0;
+}
+
+/* A present with readbacks pending used to wait for the whole frame on the GPU before the next
+ * one could start: in a GT5 race that was nearly every frame, 6-8 ms each. Now its readbacks go
+ * to this thread, which applies them as soon as the GPU is past them, and the present overlaps
+ * like any other. They still land in guest memory in order; a full wait drains this first.
+ * LD_ASYNC_READBACK=0 restores applying them only after a full wait. */
+#define LD_READ_BATCHES 8
+typedef struct { u64 fence; u32 n; ld_guest_read r[LD_GUEST_READS]; } ld_read_batch;
+static ld_read_batch s_rb_q[LD_READ_BATCHES];
+static volatile LONG s_rb_head, s_rb_tail;
+static HANDLE s_rb_wake, s_rb_fence_evt;
+static int ld_async_readback(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_ASYNC_READBACK"); on = !e || atoi(e) != 0; }
+    return on;
+}
+static DWORD WINAPI ld_read_worker(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    for (;;) {
+        WaitForSingleObject(s_rb_wake, INFINITE);
+        while (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_rb_head, 0, 0) != InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_rb_tail, 0, 0)) {
+            ld_read_batch* bt = &s_rb_q[(u32)s_rb_head % LD_READ_BATCHES];
+            if (g.fence->lpVtbl->GetCompletedValue(g.fence) < bt->fence &&
+                SUCCEEDED(g.fence->lpVtbl->SetEventOnCompletion(g.fence, bt->fence, s_rb_fence_evt)))
+                WaitForSingleObject(s_rb_fence_evt, INFINITE);
+            for (u32 i = 0; i < bt->n; i++) ld_guest_read_apply_one(&bt->r[i]);
+            InterlockedIncrement(&s_rb_head);
+        }
+    }
+}
+/* Room for one more batch, starting the thread the first time. */
+static int ld_read_batch_room(void)
+{
+    if (!ld_async_readback()) return 0;
+    if (!s_rb_wake) {
+        s_rb_wake = CreateEventA(NULL, FALSE, FALSE, NULL);
+        s_rb_fence_evt = CreateEventA(NULL, FALSE, FALSE, NULL);
+        HANDLE t = (s_rb_wake && s_rb_fence_evt) ? CreateThread(NULL, 0, ld_read_worker, NULL, 0, NULL) : NULL;
+        if (!t) return 0;
+        CloseHandle(t);
+    }
+    return (u32)(InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_rb_tail, 0, 0) - InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_rb_head, 0, 0)) < LD_READ_BATCHES;
+}
+static void ld_read_batch_push(u64 fence)
+{
+    ld_read_batch* bt = &s_rb_q[(u32)s_rb_tail % LD_READ_BATCHES];
+    bt->fence = fence;
+    bt->n = s_n_guest_reads;
+    memcpy(bt->r, s_guest_reads, sizeof(s_guest_reads[0]) * s_n_guest_reads);
+    s_n_guest_reads = 0;
+    InterlockedIncrement(&s_rb_tail);
+    SetEvent(s_rb_wake);
+}
+/* Before anything newer is applied here, everything queued has landed. */
+static void ld_read_batches_drain(void)
+{
+    if (!s_rb_wake) return;
+    while (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_rb_head, 0, 0) != InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_rb_tail, 0, 0)) {
+        SetEvent(s_rb_wake);
+        SwitchToThread();
+    }
+}
+
+static void ld_guest_read_apply_one(ld_guest_read* r)
+{
+    /* [shadow] LD_RB_LATE_LOG=1: how often a small readback (GT5's 16x8 auto-exposure sample) lands in guest
+     * memory two or more guest flips after the blit that asked for it. GT5 reads each slot of its ring of
+     * three two frames on; a slot read before its sample landed held whatever was there (with LD_RB_OWN=0
+     * the raw VRAM bytes cellGcmSys's own copy put there, else the sample of three frames before). One
+     * "[rb-late]" line every 600 small readbacks with the counts and the worst lateness. */
+    { static int on = -1; static volatile LONG n_all, n_late, worst;
+      if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_RB_LATE_LOG"); on = e && atoi(e) != 0; }
+      if (on && r->w * r->h <= 256u) {
+          const LONG late = (LONG)(cellGcm_flip_serial() - r->flips);
+          if (late >= 2) InterlockedIncrement(&n_late);
+          if (late > worst) InterlockedExchange(&worst, late);
+          if (InterlockedIncrement(&n_all) % 600 == 0)
+              fprintf(stderr, "[rb-late] small readbacks %ld, landed >= 2 flips late %ld, worst %ld flips (frame %u)\n",
+                      (long)n_all, (long)n_late, (long)worst, r->frame);
+      } }
+    {
+        const SIZE_T size = (SIZE_T)r->pitch * r->h;
+        u8* px = NULL; D3D12_RANGE rr = {0, size};
+        u8* row = (u8*)malloc((size_t)r->w * 4u);
+        if (row && SUCCEEDED(r->rb->lpVtbl->Map(r->rb, 0, &rr, (void**)&px))) {
+            /* LD_RB_LOG=<k>: every k-th small readback (GT5's 16x8 auto-exposure sample) logs its mean
+             * colour, the frame it was recorded in and the surface it came from. */
+            { static int every = -1; static u32 n, lines;
+              if (every < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_RB_LOG"); every = e ? (atoi(e) > 0 ? atoi(e) : 1) : 0; }
+              if (every && r->w * r->h <= 256u && (n++ % (u32)every) == 0 && lines < 40000u) {
+                  double m[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
+                  for (u32 y = 0; y < r->h; y++)
+                      for (u32 x = 0; x < r->w; x++)
+                          for (u32 c = 0; c < 4u; c++) m[c] += px[(SIZE_T)y * r->pitch + x * 4u + c];
+                  const double k = 1.0 / (double)(r->w * r->h);
+                  lines++;
+                  fprintf(stderr, "[rb-meter] f=%u src=%d 0x%X ea=0x%08X %ux%u mean %.1f %.1f %.1f a %.1f\n",
+                          r->frame, r->src, r->src_off, r->ea, r->w, r->h, m[0] * k, m[1] * k, m[2] * k, m[3] * k);
+              } }
+            for (u32 y = 0; y < r->h; y++) {
+                const u8* in = px + (SIZE_T)y * r->pitch;
+                for (u32 x = 0; x < r->w; x++) {
+                    row[x * 4u + 0u] = in[x * 4u + 3u];
+                    row[x * 4u + 1u] = in[x * 4u + 0u];
+                    row[x * 4u + 2u] = in[x * 4u + 1u];
+                    row[x * 4u + 3u] = in[x * 4u + 2u];
+                }
+                gcm_guest_row_write(r->ea + y * r->dst_pitch, row, r->w * 4u);
+            }
+            D3D12_RANGE wr = {0, 0};
+            r->rb->lpVtbl->Unmap(r->rb, 0, &wr);
+        }
+        free(row);
+        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_guest_read_pool_lock);
+        const int keep = r->pooled && s_guest_read_pool_n < LD_GUEST_READS;
+        if (keep) s_guest_read_pool[s_guest_read_pool_n++] = r->rb;
+        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_guest_read_pool_lock);
+        if (!keep) r->rb->lpVtbl->Release(r->rb);
+    }
+}
+
+/* Let a present overlap the next frame. Waiting for the GPU to finish at every present held the
+ * RSX thread 7-10 ms of a 35 ms race frame with the GPU 40% busy, and the title's frame waits on
+ * that thread. So a present submits, waits only for the frame before it, and the CPU records the
+ * next frame while the GPU draws this one. Everything a reset would overwrite stays in use until a
+ * full wait: the transient rings keep running forward, and a present that finds one past half
+ * full waits properly and starts them again, as does one with a readback pending. Every other
+ * flush still waits for everything. LD_PRESENT_OVERLAP=0 restores a full wait at every present. */
+static unsigned long long g_ld_full_waits, g_ld_fence_wait_us;
+static void ld_alloc_report(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1; static LONGLONG last;
+    if (on < 0) on = getenv("LD_ALLOC_TRACE") ? 1 : 0;
+    if (!on) return;
+    LARGE_INTEGER t, f; QueryPerformanceCounter(&t); QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
+    if (t.QuadPart - last < 5 * f.QuadPart) return;
+    last = t.QuadPart;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[alloc]");
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < LD_ALLOC_SITES; i++)
+        if (g_ld_alloc_at[i]) { fprintf(stderr, " L%u=%u", i, g_ld_alloc_at[i]); g_ld_alloc_at[i] = 0; }
+    fprintf(stderr, "\n");
+}
+
+unsigned g_ld_ovl_why_pub[8];
+#define g_ld_ovl_why g_ld_ovl_why_pub
+static int ld_present_overlap(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) {
+        const char* e = getenv("LD_PRESENT_OVERLAP");
+        on = (!e || atoi(e) != 0) && !getenv("LD_GPU_TIME") && g.alloc2;
+    }
+    if (!on) return 0;
+    /* Which ring kept a present from overlapping, counted for the [present-parts] line. */
+    /* [draw-calls] LD_SRV_WRAP: past half, a ring can start over under the submitted list's part instead
+     * (ld_rings_after_flush), when that leaves room: ld_ring_full is the old test without that case. */
+    const int why[9] = { s_n_guest_reads != 0 && !ld_read_batch_room(),
+        ld_ring_full(g.upload_used, UPLOAD_SIZE, s_up_hi, s_up_list_lo),
+        ld_ring_full(g.vb_used, VERT_BUFFER_SIZE, s_vb_hi, s_vb_list_lo),
+        ld_ring_full(g.ib_used, INDEX_BUFFER_SIZE, s_ib_hi, s_ib_list_lo),
+        ld_ring_full(g.cb_used, CB_RING_BYTES, s_cb_hi, s_cb_list_lo),
+        ld_ring_full(g.ps_cb_used, PS_CB_RING_BYTES, s_pcb_hi, s_pcb_list_lo),
+        ld_ring_full(g.srv_ring_used, SRV_RING_TABLES, s_srv_hi, s_srv_list_lo),
+        /* Sampler tables are written once and only ever reused by content, so a full ring just
+         * means the next new one flushes (sampler_table_needs_flush). They no longer reset at
+         * every present, and so never keep one from overlapping. */
+        0, 0 };
+    int any = 0;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (why[i]) { g_ld_ovl_why[i]++; any = 1; }
+    return !any;
+}
+
+/* [stutter] Every 5 s (LD_STUTTER_LOG=0 off): how many frames were late and what the renderer made
+ * for them, so a run says which phase stutters and whose time it is. t is seconds since the process
+ * started, the clock screendrive's .drive log keeps (scripts\stutterphases.py splits a run by it). */
+static double ld_uptime_s(void)
+{
+    static ULONGLONG created;
+    if (!created) {
+        FILETIME c, x, kt, ut;
+        if (GetProcessTimes(GetCurrentProcess(), &c, &x, &kt, &ut))
+            created = ((ULONGLONG)c.dwHighDateTime << 32) | c.dwLowDateTime;
+        if (!created) created = 1;
+    }
+    FILETIME n; GetSystemTimeAsFileTime(&n);
+    const ULONGLONG now = ((ULONGLONG)n.dwHighDateTime << 32) | n.dwLowDateTime;
+    return created > 1 && now > created ? (double)(now - created) / 1e7 : 0.0;
+}
+static void ld_stutter_note(double gap, double k, int picture)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_STUTTER_LOG"); on = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
+    if (!on) return;
+    static LONGLONG t0;
+    static unsigned n, n25, n50, n100, n250, all50, all100, npic;
+    static double worst;
+    /* What the last line had, to print the change. */
+    static unsigned p_walker, p_pool, p_cold, p_building, p_ready;
+    static LONG64 p_pool_qpc, p_rec_qpc;
+    static unsigned long long p_tex_n, p_swz, p_shaders, p_res_n;
+    static LONGLONG p_tex, p_dxt, p_res, p_create;
+    if (gap > 0.0 && picture) { n++; npic++; }
+    else if (gap > 0.0) {
+        n++;
+        if (gap >= 25.0) n25++;
+        if (gap >= 50.0) { n50++; all50++; }
+        if (gap >= 100.0) { n100++; all100++; }
+        if (gap >= 250.0) n250++;
+        if (gap > worst) worst = gap;
+    }
+    LARGE_INTEGER q; QueryPerformanceCounter(&q);
+    if (!t0) { t0 = q.QuadPart; return; }
+    if ((double)(q.QuadPart - t0) * k < 5000.0) return;
+    t0 = q.QuadPart;
+    const LONG64 pool_qpc = g_st.pool_build_qpc, rec_qpc = g_st.rec_wait_qpc;
+    /* [pool2] The compile pool's width and the walker's waits for the recording thread, since the last line. */
+    static LONG64 p_cp_busy, p_cp_comp, p_cp_comp_n, p_cp_parked;
+    static unsigned long long p_rsw_n[LD_RSW_N];
+    static LONGLONG p_rsw_qpc[LD_RSW_N];
+    const LONG64 cp_busy = s_cp_busy_qpc, cp_comp = s_cp_compile_qpc, cp_comp_n = s_cp_compile_n, cp_parked = s_cp_parked_qpc;
+    const LONG64 cp_max = InterlockedExchange64(&s_cp_compile_max, 0);
+    const LONG cp_peak = InterlockedExchange(&s_cp_peak, InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_cp_running, 0, 0));
+    char pool2[3072];
+    { const LONG64 nc = cp_comp_n - p_cp_comp_n;
+      snprintf(pool2, sizeof pool2,
+               " | compile threads %u: %.1f s in jobs, at most %ld at once, %lld compiles of %.0f ms (longest %.0f ms), %.0f ms waiting"
+               " inside a job | the walker waited for the recording thread: present %llu in %.0f ms, other flushes %llu in %.0f ms,"
+               " rewritten views %llu in %.0f ms, other %llu in %.0f ms",
+               s_cpool_threads, (double)(cp_busy - p_cp_busy) * k / 1000.0, (long)cp_peak, (long long)nc,
+               nc ? (double)(cp_comp - p_cp_comp) * k / (double)nc : 0.0, (double)cp_max * k, (double)(cp_parked - p_cp_parked) * k,
+               g_rsw_n[LD_RSW_PRESENT] - p_rsw_n[LD_RSW_PRESENT], (double)(g_rsw_qpc[LD_RSW_PRESENT] - p_rsw_qpc[LD_RSW_PRESENT]) * k,
+               g_rsw_n[LD_RSW_FLUSH] - p_rsw_n[LD_RSW_FLUSH], (double)(g_rsw_qpc[LD_RSW_FLUSH] - p_rsw_qpc[LD_RSW_FLUSH]) * k,
+               g_rsw_n[LD_RSW_VIEW] - p_rsw_n[LD_RSW_VIEW], (double)(g_rsw_qpc[LD_RSW_VIEW] - p_rsw_qpc[LD_RSW_VIEW]) * k,
+               g_rsw_n[LD_RSW_OTHER] - p_rsw_n[LD_RSW_OTHER], (double)(g_rsw_qpc[LD_RSW_OTHER] - p_rsw_qpc[LD_RSW_OTHER]) * k); }
+    /* [nowait] while new shaders are built in the background (or anything was left out since the last line) */
+    { static LONG64 p_draws, p_psos;
+      const LONG64 dr = s_nw_draws, ps = s_nw_psos;
+      const LONG64 mx = InterlockedExchange64(&s_nw_missing_max, 0);
+      if (s_nw.mode || dr != p_draws) {
+          const size_t used = strlen(pool2);
+          snprintf(pool2 + used, sizeof pool2 - used,
+                   " | new shaders in the background: %lld draws left out (%lld pipelines), longest missing %.0f ms",
+                   (long long)(dr - p_draws), (long long)(ps - p_psos), (double)mx * k);
+      }
+      p_draws = dr; p_psos = ps;
+      ld_si_stutter(pool2, sizeof pool2, k);   /* [standin] */
+      /* [nowait3] the draws that waited for their pipeline meanwhile, by why (only those that really waited) */
+      static LONG64 p_wn[NWR_N], p_wq[NWR_N];
+      int first = 1;
+      for (int r = 0; r < NWR_N; r++) {
+          const LONG64 wn = s_nw_wait_n[r], wq = s_nw_wait_qpc[r];
+          if (wn != p_wn[r]) {
+              const size_t used = strlen(pool2);
+              snprintf(pool2 + used, sizeof pool2 - used, "%s%s %lld in %.0f ms", first ? " | waited, by why: " : ", ",
+                       k_nwr_name[r], (long long)(wn - p_wn[r]), (double)(wq - p_wq[r]) * k);
+              first = 0;
+          }
+          p_wn[r] = wn; p_wq[r] = wq;
+      } }
+    p_cp_busy = cp_busy; p_cp_comp = cp_comp; p_cp_comp_n = cp_comp_n; p_cp_parked = cp_parked;
+    for (int r = 0; r < LD_RSW_N; r++) { p_rsw_n[r] = g_rsw_n[r]; p_rsw_qpc[r] = g_rsw_qpc[r]; }
+    fprintf(stderr, "[stutter] 5 s to t=%.0f s: %u frames, over 25 ms %u, over 50 ms %u, over 100 ms %u, over 250 ms %u, longest %.0f ms"
+            " (test pictures %u, not counted)"
+            " | new pipelines: %u made by the walker (%.0f ms in the driver), %u by the compile threads (%.0f ms of theirs),"
+            " %u from the made-ahead list (%u ready, %u being made, %u not started), recording thread waited %.0f ms for them"
+            " | shaders compiled %llu | textures decoded %llu in %.0f ms (DXT %.0f ms, %llu swizzled), new GPU resources %llu in %.0f ms"
+            " | made ahead so far %lld | since start: over 50 ms %u, over 100 ms %u%s\n",
+            ld_uptime_s(), n, n25, n50, n100, n250, worst, npic,
+            g_st.walker_pso_n - p_walker, (double)(g_st.create_qpc - p_create) * k,
+            g_st.pool_pso_n - p_pool, (double)(pool_qpc - p_pool_qpc) * k,
+            (g_st.ahead_cold - p_cold) + (g_st.ahead_building - p_building) + (g_st.ahead_ready - p_ready),
+            g_st.ahead_ready - p_ready, g_st.ahead_building - p_building, g_st.ahead_cold - p_cold,
+            (double)(rec_qpc - p_rec_qpc) * k,
+            g_st.shaders_n - p_shaders, g_st.tex_n - p_tex_n, (double)(g_st.tex_qpc - p_tex) * k,
+            (double)(g_st.tex_dxt_qpc - p_dxt) * k, g_st.tex_swz_n - p_swz,
+            g_st.res_n - p_res_n, (double)(g_st.res_qpc - p_res) * k,
+            (long long)g_st.ahead_made, all50, all100, pool2);
+    n = n25 = n50 = n100 = n250 = npic = 0; worst = 0.0;
+    p_walker = g_st.walker_pso_n; p_pool = g_st.pool_pso_n;
+    p_cold = g_st.ahead_cold; p_building = g_st.ahead_building; p_ready = g_st.ahead_ready;
+    p_pool_qpc = pool_qpc; p_rec_qpc = rec_qpc;
+    p_tex_n = g_st.tex_n; p_swz = g_st.tex_swz_n; p_shaders = g_st.shaders_n; p_res_n = g_st.res_n;
+    p_tex = g_st.tex_qpc; p_dxt = g_st.tex_dxt_qpc; p_res = g_st.res_qpc; p_create = g_st.create_qpc;
+}
+
+static void ld_hitch_note(LONGLONG now)
+{
+    static int ms = -1; static LONGLONG last; static unsigned long long fw0; static unsigned shown;
+    /* [stutter] What the last frame's line had, for the per-frame change. */
+    static unsigned f_walker, f_pool, f_ahead; static LONG64 f_rec;
+    static unsigned long long f_rsw_n; static LONGLONG f_rsw_qpc;   /* [pool2] */
+    if (ms < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_HITCH_MS"); ms = e ? atoi(e) : 250; }
+    LARGE_INTEGER f; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
+    const double k = 1000.0 / (double)f.QuadPart;
+    const double gap = last ? (double)(now - last) * k : 0.0;
+    const unsigned ahead_all = g_st.ahead_cold + g_st.ahead_building + g_st.ahead_ready;
+    const LONG64 rec_now = g_st.rec_wait_qpc;
+    unsigned long long rsw_n = 0; LONGLONG rsw_qpc = 0;
+    for (int r = 0; r < LD_RSW_N; r++) { rsw_n += g_rsw_n[r]; rsw_qpc += g_rsw_qpc[r]; }
+    if (ms > 0 && last && gap >= ms && shown < 400) {
+        shown++;
+        const double known = (g_hx_pso + g_hx_tex + g_hx_res) * k;
+        /* The texture decodes no longer include the new resources made for them (LD_CCR adds those to
+         * the new GPU resources): before, that time was counted twice and "rest" came out short. */
+        fprintf(stderr, "[slow-frame] %.0f ms at frame %u: new pipelines %u in %.0f ms (driver %.0f, shader cache reads %u in %.0f, %u shaders to the compile threads), "
+                "texture decodes %u in %.0f ms, texture hashing %.0f ms, new GPU resources %u in %.0f ms, GPU wait %.0f ms, rest %.0f ms"
+                "; pipelines made by the walker %u, by the compile threads %u, from the made-ahead list %u; recording thread waited %.0f ms for pipelines"
+                "; the walker waited for it %llu times, %.0f ms%s\n",
+                gap, g_ld_frames, g_hx_pso_n, g_hx_pso * k, g_hx_create * k, g_hx_cache_n, g_hx_cache * k, g_hx_async_n,
+                g_hx_tex_n, g_hx_tex * k, g_hx_hash * k, g_hx_res_n, g_hx_res * k,
+                (double)(g_ld_fence_wait_us - fw0) / 1000.0, gap - known - (double)(g_ld_fence_wait_us - fw0) / 1000.0,
+                g_st.walker_pso_n - f_walker, g_st.pool_pso_n - f_pool, ahead_all - f_ahead, (double)(rec_now - f_rec) * k,
+                rsw_n - f_rsw_n, (double)(rsw_qpc - f_rsw_qpc) * k,
+                s_st_picture ? "; this frame wrote a test picture (LD_FRAME_DUMP)" : "");
+    }
+    f_walker = g_st.walker_pso_n; f_pool = g_st.pool_pso_n; f_ahead = ahead_all; f_rec = rec_now;
+    f_rsw_n = rsw_n; f_rsw_qpc = rsw_qpc;
+    g_st.res_n += g_hx_res_n; g_st.res_qpc += g_hx_res; g_st.create_qpc += g_hx_create;
+    g_st.pso_qpc += g_hx_pso; g_st.shaders_n += g_hx_async_n;
+    g_st.tex_n += g_hx_tex_n; g_st.tex_qpc += g_hx_tex;
+    ld_stutter_note(gap, k, s_st_picture);
+    s_st_picture = 0;
+    g_hx_pso = g_hx_create = g_hx_tex = g_hx_hash = g_hx_res = g_hx_cache = 0;
+    g_hx_pso_n = g_hx_tex_n = g_hx_res_n = g_hx_cache_n = 0;
+    g_hx_async_n = 0;
+    fw0 = g_ld_fence_wait_us;
+    last = now;
+}
+
+/* ===========================================================================
+ * A second thread records the D3D12 command list (LD_RECORD_THREAD=0 turns it off).
+ *
+ * The FIFO walk is on GT5's critical path (each label it writes is something the
+ * game may be waiting for), and about a fifth of it was the D3D12 runtime and the
+ * driver recording calls: some 6000 a frame in a race. Here g.list is a stand-in
+ * whose methods copy their arguments into a ring, and this thread replays them
+ * onto the real list. Everything that reads guest memory, converts data, picks
+ * pipelines and writes labels stays on the walker; only the recording moves.
+ *
+ * Ordering: Close and Reset on the stand-in wait until the ring is empty, so
+ * submission, fences and the present are exactly as before. The one thing a
+ * recorded call reads at record time rather than on the GPU is a CPU descriptor
+ * (OMSetRenderTargets, the clears), so creating an RTV or DSV waits for the ring
+ * first (ld_rec_sync). Resource lifetimes need nothing new: anything a queued
+ * call names already has to live until the GPU has run it, which is later. */
+static ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* s_rec_real;
+static int s_rec_on;
+/* The last pipeline set was a stand-in whose shaders failed: its draws are dropped, as a draw
+ * with no pipeline always was. */
+static int s_rec_no_pso;
+/* [nowait] The last pipeline set was a stand-in still being made: it is set on the list at the first draw
+ * that uses it, waited for then unless that draw may be left out (the recording thread's alone; the walker
+ * clears it in pr_Reset, with the ring empty). */
+static struct ld_pso_job* s_rec_lazy;
+/* [nowait] Set by the walker around the one draw call of a scene draw that may be left out while its
+ * pipeline is made (ld_nw_draw_flags); pr_DrawInstanced / pr_DrawIndexedInstanced copy it into the call. */
+static u32 s_rec_draw_skip;
+/* [standin] ... and its stand-in with where its block is in the pixel constants (rsx_standin_d3d12.inc). */
+static void* s_rec_draw_si;
+static u32 s_rec_draw_si_off;
+#define LD_REC_RING (32u << 20)
+static u8* s_rec_ring;
+/* What the two threads share sits on cache lines of its own, away from the walker's private
+ * state: the walker queues about nine calls a draw (20k+ a frame on a full grid), and with the
+ * write and read positions, the walker's write position, the sleep flag and the list pointer the
+ * recording thread reads for every call all on one line -- plus a locked read of a position on
+ * every call and on every spin of the recording thread -- each call moved that line between the
+ * two cores two or three times. Now the walker reads the executed position only when its own copy
+ * says the ring is full, and the recording thread spins on a plain load, so neither thread takes
+ * the other's line for a look. Every call is still published as it is queued, and the recording
+ * thread picks it up at least as soon as before. LD_REC_FAST=0 goes back to the locked reads;
+ * PS3_AB_WHAT=recq alternates the two. */
+typedef struct { _Alignas(64) volatile LONG64 v; } ld_rec_line;
+static ld_rec_line s_rec_wr_l, s_rec_rd_l;    /* published write / executed positions */
+static struct { _Alignas(64) volatile LONG v; } s_rec_sleep_l, s_rec_fast_l = { 1 };
+#define s_rec_wr (s_rec_wr_l.v)
+#define s_rec_rd (s_rec_rd_l.v)
+#define s_rec_sleeping (s_rec_sleep_l.v)
+/* The walker's own: its write position and its last look at s_rec_rd (which only grows). */
+static struct { _Alignas(64) u64 wloc, rd_seen; } s_rec_w;
+#define s_rec_wloc (s_rec_w.wloc)
+static HANDLE s_rec_wake;
+unsigned long long g_rec_ops, g_rec_sync_qpc;
+typedef struct { u32 op, bytes; } ld_rec_hdr;
+enum { RO_WRAP = 1, RO_BARRIER, RO_COPYTEX, RO_GRT, RO_CRT, RO_CLRDSV, RO_DRAW, RO_CLRRTV, RO_GCBV,
+       RO_G32, RO_CRS, RO_DISPATCH, RO_COPYRES, RO_PSO, RO_GRS, RO_HEAPS, RO_VP, RO_SC, RO_STENCIL,
+       RO_RTS, RO_VB, RO_TOPO, RO_IB, RO_DRAWIDX, RO_ENDQ, RO_RESOLVEQ, RO_BLENDF };
+static ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* ld_list_real(void) { return s_rec_on ? s_rec_real : g.list; }
+
+static __forceinline u64 ld_rec_load(volatile LONG64* p) { return (u64)__atomic_load_n(p, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }
+/* LD_REC_FAST and PS3_AB_WHAT=recq; looked at in every ld_rec_sync (a few times a frame). Either
+ * way of working is correct at any moment. */
+static void ld_rec_mode(void)
+{
+    static int env = -2;
+    if (env == -2) {
+        const char* e = getenv("LD_REC_FAST");
+        env = e && *e ? (atoi(e) != 0) : -1;
+    }
+    extern int ps3_ab_on(const char* what);
+    const int ab = ps3_ab_on("recq");
+    s_rec_fast_l.v = ab >= 0 ? ab : env >= 0 ? env : 1;
+}
+int ld_rec_fast_now(void) { return (int)s_rec_fast_l.v; }
+static u8* ld_rec_begin(u32 op, size_t payload)
+{
+    const u32 bytes = (u32)((sizeof(ld_rec_hdr) + payload + 15u) & ~(size_t)15u);
+    u64 pos = s_rec_wloc % LD_REC_RING;
+    const u64 tail = LD_REC_RING - pos;
+    const u64 need = bytes + (tail < bytes ? tail : 0);
+    unsigned n = 0;
+    if (!s_rec_fast_l.v) s_rec_w.rd_seen = (u64)InterlockedCompareExchange64(&s_rec_rd, 0, 0);
+    if (s_rec_wloc + need - s_rec_w.rd_seen > LD_REC_RING) {
+        RSX_FG_WAIT(w);                          /* [fgv3] the ring is full: the recording thread is behind */
+        while (s_rec_wloc + need - s_rec_w.rd_seen > LD_REC_RING) {
+            s_rec_w.rd_seen = ld_rec_load(&s_rec_rd);
+            if (s_rec_wloc + need - s_rec_w.rd_seen <= LD_REC_RING) break;
+            if (s_rec_sleeping) SetEvent(s_rec_wake);
+            if (++n & 63) YieldProcessor(); else SwitchToThread();
+        }
+        rsx_fg_wait_end("renderer: recording ring full", &w);
+    }
+    if (tail < bytes) {
+        ld_rec_hdr* w = (ld_rec_hdr*)(s_rec_ring + pos);
+        w->op = RO_WRAP; w->bytes = (u32)tail;
+        s_rec_wloc += tail; pos = 0;
+    }
+    ld_rec_hdr* h = (ld_rec_hdr*)(s_rec_ring + pos);
+    h->op = op; h->bytes = bytes;
+    s_rec_wloc += bytes;
+    return (u8*)(h + 1);
+}
+static void ld_rec_end(void)
+{
+    InterlockedExchange64(&s_rec_wr, (LONG64)s_rec_wloc);   /* a full fence before the sleep check */
+    g_rec_ops++;
+    if (s_rec_sleeping) SetEvent(s_rec_wake);
+}
+/* Wait until the recording thread has replayed everything queued. */
+static void ld_rec_sync(void)
+{
+    if (!s_rec_on) return;
+    ld_rec_mode();
+    if (ld_rec_load(&s_rec_rd) == s_rec_wloc) return;
+    LARGE_INTEGER t0, t1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
+    RSX_FG_WAIT(w);                              /* [fgv3] */
+    unsigned n = 0;
+    while (ld_rec_load(&s_rec_rd) != s_rec_wloc) {
+        if (s_rec_sleeping) SetEvent(s_rec_wake);
+        if (++n & 63) YieldProcessor(); else SwitchToThread();
+    }
+    rsx_fg_wait_end("renderer: wait for the recording thread", &w);
+    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t1);
+    g_rec_sync_qpc += (unsigned long long)(t1.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart);
+    g_rsw_n[s_rsw_why]++; g_rsw_qpc[s_rsw_why] += t1.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart;   /* [pool2] */
+}
+
+typedef struct { UINT n, pad; D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER b[1]; } ro_barrier;
+typedef struct { D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION dst, src; UINT x, y, z, has_box; D3D12_BOX box; } ro_copytex;
+typedef struct { UINT idx, pad; D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE h; } ro_table;
+typedef struct { D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE h; D3D12_CLEAR_FLAGS f; FLOAT d; UINT stencil, n; D3D12_RECT r[1]; } ro_clrdsv;
+typedef struct { D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE h; FLOAT c[4]; UINT n, pad; D3D12_RECT r[1]; } ro_clrrtv;
+typedef struct { UINT a, b, c, d, skip, si_off; void* si; } ro_draw;          /* [nowait] skip: s_rec_draw_skip; [standin] */
+typedef struct { UINT a, b, c; INT d; UINT e, skip, si_off; void* si; } ro_drawidx;
+/* [standin] the recording thread's side (rsx_standin_d3d12.inc) */
+static D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS s_rec_b1;     /* b1 (the pixel constants) as the walker last set it */
+static ID3D12PipelineState* s_rec_cur_pso;     /* the pipeline last set on the list for the walker's calls */
+static int ld_rec_draw_prep(u32 skip, void* si, u32 si_off);
+static void ld_si_rec_end(int restore_pso);
+typedef struct { UINT idx, pad; D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS va; } ro_cbv;
+typedef struct { UINT idx, n, off, pad; UINT v[1]; } ro_32;
+typedef struct { void* p; } ro_ptr;
+typedef struct { UINT x, y, z; } ro_dispatch;
+typedef struct { ID3D12Resource* d; ID3D12Resource* s; } ro_copyres;
+typedef struct { UINT n, pad; ID3D12DescriptorHeap* h[2]; } ro_heaps;
+typedef struct { UINT n, pad; D3D12_VIEWPORT v[1]; } ro_vp;
+typedef struct { UINT n, pad; D3D12_RECT r[1]; } ro_sc;
+typedef struct { UINT n; BOOL single; UINT has_ds, m; D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE ds; D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rt[1]; } ro_rts;
+typedef struct { UINT start, n, has, pad; D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW v[1]; } ro_vb;
+typedef struct { UINT has, pad; D3D12_INDEX_BUFFER_VIEW v; } ro_ib;
+typedef struct { ID3D12QueryHeap* h; D3D12_QUERY_TYPE t; UINT i; } ro_endq;
+typedef struct { ID3D12QueryHeap* h; D3D12_QUERY_TYPE t; UINT start, n; ID3D12Resource* dst; UINT64 off; } ro_resolveq;
+#define RO_SIZE(T, arr, k) (offsetof(T, arr) + (size_t)(k) * sizeof(((T*)0)->arr[0]))
+
+#define LDL ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* t_
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_ResourceBarrier(LDL, UINT n, const D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER* b)
+{ (void)t_; ro_barrier* o = (ro_barrier*)ld_rec_begin(RO_BARRIER, RO_SIZE(ro_barrier, b, n)); o->n = n; memcpy(o->b, b, n * sizeof *b); ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_CopyTextureRegion(LDL, const D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION* d, UINT x, UINT y, UINT z,
+                                                   const D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION* s, const D3D12_BOX* box)
+{ (void)t_; ro_copytex* o = (ro_copytex*)ld_rec_begin(RO_COPYTEX, sizeof *o); o->dst = *d; o->src = *s; o->x = x; o->y = y; o->z = z;
+  o->has_box = box != NULL; if (box) o->box = *box; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(LDL, UINT i, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE h)
+{ (void)t_; ro_table* o = (ro_table*)ld_rec_begin(RO_GRT, sizeof *o); o->idx = i; o->h = h; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(LDL, UINT i, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE h)
+{ (void)t_; ro_table* o = (ro_table*)ld_rec_begin(RO_CRT, sizeof *o); o->idx = i; o->h = h; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_ClearDepthStencilView(LDL, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE h, D3D12_CLEAR_FLAGS f, FLOAT d, UINT8 s,
+                                                       UINT n, const D3D12_RECT* r)
+{ (void)t_; if (!r) n = 0; ro_clrdsv* o = (ro_clrdsv*)ld_rec_begin(RO_CLRDSV, RO_SIZE(ro_clrdsv, r, n)); o->h = h; o->f = f; o->d = d;
+  o->stencil = s; o->n = n; if (n) memcpy(o->r, r, n * sizeof *r); ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_ClearRenderTargetView(LDL, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE h, const FLOAT c[4], UINT n, const D3D12_RECT* r)
+{ (void)t_; if (!r) n = 0; ro_clrrtv* o = (ro_clrrtv*)ld_rec_begin(RO_CLRRTV, RO_SIZE(ro_clrrtv, r, n)); o->h = h;
+  memcpy(o->c, c, sizeof o->c); o->n = n; if (n) memcpy(o->r, r, n * sizeof *r); ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_DrawInstanced(LDL, UINT a, UINT b, UINT c, UINT d)
+{ (void)t_; ro_draw* o = (ro_draw*)ld_rec_begin(RO_DRAW, sizeof *o); o->a = a; o->b = b; o->c = c; o->d = d; o->skip = s_rec_draw_skip;
+  o->si = s_rec_draw_si; o->si_off = s_rec_draw_si_off; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_DrawIndexedInstanced(LDL, UINT a, UINT b, UINT c, INT d, UINT e)
+{ (void)t_; ro_drawidx* o = (ro_drawidx*)ld_rec_begin(RO_DRAWIDX, sizeof *o); o->a = a; o->b = b; o->c = c; o->d = d; o->e = e;
+  o->skip = s_rec_draw_skip; o->si = s_rec_draw_si; o->si_off = s_rec_draw_si_off; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(LDL, UINT i, D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS va)
+{ (void)t_; ro_cbv* o = (ro_cbv*)ld_rec_begin(RO_GCBV, sizeof *o); o->idx = i; o->va = va; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_SetGraphicsRoot32BitConstants(LDL, UINT i, UINT n, const void* v, UINT off)
+{ (void)t_; ro_32* o = (ro_32*)ld_rec_begin(RO_G32, RO_SIZE(ro_32, v, n)); o->idx = i; o->n = n; o->off = off; memcpy(o->v, v, n * 4u); ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_SetComputeRootSignature(LDL, ID3D12RootSignature* rs)
+{ (void)t_; ((ro_ptr*)ld_rec_begin(RO_CRS, sizeof(ro_ptr)))->p = rs; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_SetGraphicsRootSignature(LDL, ID3D12RootSignature* rs)
+{ (void)t_; ((ro_ptr*)ld_rec_begin(RO_GRS, sizeof(ro_ptr)))->p = rs; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_SetPipelineState(LDL, ID3D12PipelineState* p)
+{ (void)t_; ((ro_ptr*)ld_rec_begin(RO_PSO, sizeof(ro_ptr)))->p = p; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_Dispatch(LDL, UINT x, UINT y, UINT z)
+{ (void)t_; ro_dispatch* o = (ro_dispatch*)ld_rec_begin(RO_DISPATCH, sizeof *o); o->x = x; o->y = y; o->z = z; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_CopyResource(LDL, ID3D12Resource* d, ID3D12Resource* s)
+{ (void)t_; ro_copyres* o = (ro_copyres*)ld_rec_begin(RO_COPYRES, sizeof *o); o->d = d; o->s = s; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_SetDescriptorHeaps(LDL, UINT n, ID3D12DescriptorHeap* const* h)
+{ (void)t_; if (n > 2) n = 2; ro_heaps* o = (ro_heaps*)ld_rec_begin(RO_HEAPS, sizeof *o); o->n = n; memcpy(o->h, h, n * sizeof *h); ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_RSSetViewports(LDL, UINT n, const D3D12_VIEWPORT* v)
+{ (void)t_; ro_vp* o = (ro_vp*)ld_rec_begin(RO_VP, RO_SIZE(ro_vp, v, n)); o->n = n; memcpy(o->v, v, n * sizeof *v); ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_RSSetScissorRects(LDL, UINT n, const D3D12_RECT* r)
+{ (void)t_; ro_sc* o = (ro_sc*)ld_rec_begin(RO_SC, RO_SIZE(ro_sc, r, n)); o->n = n; memcpy(o->r, r, n * sizeof *r); ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_OMSetStencilRef(LDL, UINT ref)
+{ (void)t_; ((ro_32*)ld_rec_begin(RO_STENCIL, sizeof(ro_32)))->idx = ref; ld_rec_end(); }
+typedef struct { FLOAT f[4]; } ro_blendf;
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_OMSetBlendFactor(LDL, const FLOAT f[4])
+{ (void)t_; ro_blendf* o = (ro_blendf*)ld_rec_begin(RO_BLENDF, sizeof *o);
+  if (f) memcpy(o->f, f, sizeof o->f); else { o->f[0] = o->f[1] = o->f[2] = o->f[3] = 1.0f; } ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_OMSetRenderTargets(LDL, UINT n, const D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE* rt, BOOL single,
+                                                    const D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE* ds)
+{ (void)t_; const UINT m = rt ? (single ? (n ? 1u : 0u) : n) : 0u;
+  ro_rts* o = (ro_rts*)ld_rec_begin(RO_RTS, RO_SIZE(ro_rts, rt, m)); o->n = n; o->single = single; o->m = m;
+  o->has_ds = ds != NULL; if (ds) o->ds = *ds; if (m) memcpy(o->rt, rt, m * sizeof *rt); ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_IASetVertexBuffers(LDL, UINT start, UINT n, const D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW* v)
+{ (void)t_; const UINT m = v ? n : 0u; ro_vb* o = (ro_vb*)ld_rec_begin(RO_VB, RO_SIZE(ro_vb, v, m)); o->start = start; o->n = n;
+  o->has = v != NULL; if (m) memcpy(o->v, v, m * sizeof *v); ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_IASetPrimitiveTopology(LDL, D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY tp)
+{ (void)t_; ((ro_32*)ld_rec_begin(RO_TOPO, sizeof(ro_32)))->idx = (UINT)tp; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_IASetIndexBuffer(LDL, const D3D12_INDEX_BUFFER_VIEW* v)
+{ (void)t_; ro_ib* o = (ro_ib*)ld_rec_begin(RO_IB, sizeof *o); o->has = v != NULL; if (v) o->v = *v; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_EndQuery(LDL, ID3D12QueryHeap* h, D3D12_QUERY_TYPE tp, UINT i)
+{ (void)t_; ro_endq* o = (ro_endq*)ld_rec_begin(RO_ENDQ, sizeof *o); o->h = h; o->t = tp; o->i = i; ld_rec_end(); }
+static void STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_ResolveQueryData(LDL, ID3D12QueryHeap* h, D3D12_QUERY_TYPE tp, UINT s, UINT n,
+                                                  ID3D12Resource* d, UINT64 off)
+{ (void)t_; ro_resolveq* o = (ro_resolveq*)ld_rec_begin(RO_RESOLVEQ, sizeof *o); o->h = h; o->t = tp; o->start = s; o->n = n;
+  o->dst = d; o->off = off; ld_rec_end(); }
+/* These wait for the ring, then act on the real list. */
+static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_Close(LDL) { (void)t_; ld_rec_sync(); return s_rec_real->lpVtbl->Close(s_rec_real); }
+static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_Reset(LDL, ID3D12CommandAllocator* a, ID3D12PipelineState* p)
+{ (void)t_; ld_rec_sync(); s_rec_no_pso = 0; s_rec_lazy = NULL; return s_rec_real->lpVtbl->Reset(s_rec_real, a, p); }
+static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_QueryInterface(LDL, REFIID r, void** o) { (void)t_; return s_rec_real->lpVtbl->QueryInterface(s_rec_real, r, o); }
+static ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_AddRef(LDL) { (void)t_; return s_rec_real->lpVtbl->AddRef(s_rec_real); }
+static ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_Release(LDL) { (void)t_; ld_rec_sync(); return s_rec_real->lpVtbl->Release(s_rec_real); }
+static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_SetName(LDL, LPCWSTR n) { (void)t_; return s_rec_real->lpVtbl->SetName(s_rec_real, n); }
+static D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE STDMETHODCALLTYPE pr_GetType(LDL) { (void)t_; return s_rec_real->lpVtbl->GetType(s_rec_real); }
+#undef LDL
+static void pr_trap(void)
+{
+    fprintf(stderr, "[ld-rec] a command-list method the recording thread does not carry was called; "
+                    "run with LD_RECORD_THREAD=0\n");
+    fflush(stderr);
+    abort();
+}
+
+static void ld_rec_exec(const ld_rec_hdr* h)
+{
+    ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* L = s_rec_real;
+    const ID3D12GraphicsCommandListVtbl* V = L->lpVtbl;
+    const void* p = h + 1;
+    switch (h->op) {
+    case RO_BARRIER:  { const ro_barrier* o = p; V->ResourceBarrier(L, o->n, o->b); break; }
+    case RO_COPYTEX:  { const ro_copytex* o = p; V->CopyTextureRegion(L, &o->dst, o->x, o->y, o->z, &o->src, o->has_box ? &o->box : NULL); break; }
+    case RO_GRT:      { const ro_table* o = p; V->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(L, o->idx, o->h); break; }
+    case RO_CRT:      { const ro_table* o = p; V->SetComputeRootDescriptorTable(L, o->idx, o->h); break; }
+    case RO_CLRDSV:   { const ro_clrdsv* o = p; V->ClearDepthStencilView(L, o->h, o->f, o->d, (UINT8)o->stencil, o->n, o->n ? o->r : NULL); break; }
+    case RO_CLRRTV:   { const ro_clrrtv* o = p; V->ClearRenderTargetView(L, o->h, o->c, o->n, o->n ? o->r : NULL); break; }
+    case RO_DRAW:     { const ro_draw* o = p;
+                        const int k = ld_rec_draw_prep(o->skip, o->si, o->si_off);   /* [nowait] [standin] */
+                        if (!k) break;
+                        V->DrawInstanced(L, o->a, o->b, o->c, o->d);
+                        if (k == 2) ld_si_rec_end(!s_rec_lazy);
+                        break; }
+    case RO_DRAWIDX:  { const ro_drawidx* o = p;
+                        const int k = ld_rec_draw_prep(o->skip, o->si, o->si_off);
+                        if (!k) break;
+                        V->DrawIndexedInstanced(L, o->a, o->b, o->c, o->d, o->e);
+                        if (k == 2) ld_si_rec_end(!s_rec_lazy);
+                        break; }
+    case RO_GCBV:     { const ro_cbv* o = p; V->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(L, o->idx, o->va);
+                        if (o->idx == 4) s_rec_b1 = o->va;   /* [standin] */
+                        break; }
+    case RO_G32:      { const ro_32* o = p; V->SetGraphicsRoot32BitConstants(L, o->idx, o->n, o->v, o->off); break; }
+    case RO_CRS:      V->SetComputeRootSignature(L, (ID3D12RootSignature*)((const ro_ptr*)p)->p); break;
+    case RO_GRS:      V->SetGraphicsRootSignature(L, (ID3D12RootSignature*)((const ro_ptr*)p)->p); break;
+    case RO_PSO:      { ID3D12PipelineState* const sp = (ID3D12PipelineState*)((const ro_ptr*)p)->p;
+                        s_rec_lazy = NULL;
+                        if (ld_rec_pso_later(sp)) { s_rec_no_pso = 0; break; }   /* [nowait] set at its first draw */
+                        ID3D12PipelineState* q = ld_pso_resolve(sp);
+                        s_rec_no_pso = q == NULL; if (q) V->SetPipelineState(L, q);
+                        s_rec_cur_pso = q;   /* [standin] */
+                        break; }
+    case RO_DISPATCH: { const ro_dispatch* o = p; V->Dispatch(L, o->x, o->y, o->z); break; }
+    case RO_COPYRES:  { const ro_copyres* o = p; V->CopyResource(L, o->d, o->s); break; }
+    case RO_HEAPS:    { const ro_heaps* o = p; V->SetDescriptorHeaps(L, o->n, o->h); break; }
+    case RO_VP:       { const ro_vp* o = p; V->RSSetViewports(L, o->n, o->v); break; }
+    case RO_SC:       { const ro_sc* o = p; V->RSSetScissorRects(L, o->n, o->r); break; }
+    case RO_STENCIL:  V->OMSetStencilRef(L, ((const ro_32*)p)->idx); break;
+    case RO_BLENDF:   V->OMSetBlendFactor(L, ((const ro_blendf*)p)->f); break;
+    case RO_RTS:      { const ro_rts* o = p; V->OMSetRenderTargets(L, o->n, o->m ? o->rt : NULL, o->single, o->has_ds ? &o->ds : NULL); break; }
+    case RO_VB:       { const ro_vb* o = p; V->IASetVertexBuffers(L, o->start, o->n, o->has ? o->v : NULL); break; }
+    case RO_TOPO:     V->IASetPrimitiveTopology(L, (D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY)((const ro_32*)p)->idx); break;
+    case RO_IB:       { const ro_ib* o = p; V->IASetIndexBuffer(L, o->has ? &o->v : NULL); break; }
+    case RO_ENDQ:     { const ro_endq* o = p; V->EndQuery(L, o->h, o->t, o->i); break; }
+    case RO_RESOLVEQ: { const ro_resolveq* o = p; V->ResolveQueryData(L, o->h, o->t, o->start, o->n, o->dst, o->off); break; }
+    default: break;   /* RO_WRAP */
+    }
+}
+
+static DWORD WINAPI ld_rec_worker(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    { HRESULT (WINAPI *sd)(HANDLE, PCWSTR) = (HRESULT (WINAPI*)(HANDLE, PCWSTR))
+          (void*)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("kernel32.dll"), "SetThreadDescription");
+      if (sd) sd(GetCurrentThread(), L"rsx record"); }
+    u64 rd = 0;
+    /* Pauses before it sleeps: 4096 is ~0.2-0.6 ms of a core after every batch, at above-normal
+     * priority. On a small CPU (ps3_host_spin_sleep) that came out of the game threads' share, so
+     * there it spins 256. LD_REC_SPIN=<n> sets the count. */
+    extern int ps3_host_spin_sleep(void);
+    int spin_env = -1;
+    { const char* e = getenv("LD_REC_SPIN"); if (e && *e) spin_env = atoi(e); }
+    u8* const ring = s_rec_ring;   /* set before this thread starts; not read from its shared line per call */
+    for (;;) {
+        const unsigned spin_max = spin_env >= 0 ? (unsigned)spin_env : ps3_host_spin_sleep() ? 256u : 4096u;
+        const int fast = s_rec_fast_l.v;
+#define LD_REC_WR() (fast ? ld_rec_load(&s_rec_wr) : (u64)InterlockedCompareExchange64(&s_rec_wr, 0, 0))
+        u64 wr = LD_REC_WR();
+        for (unsigned spins = 0; wr == rd; wr = LD_REC_WR()) {
+            if (++spins < spin_max) { YieldProcessor(); continue; }
+            InterlockedExchange(&s_rec_sleeping, 1);
+            wr = (u64)InterlockedCompareExchange64(&s_rec_wr, 0, 0);
+            if (wr == rd) WaitForSingleObject(s_rec_wake, 2);
+            InterlockedExchange(&s_rec_sleeping, 0);
+            spins = 0;
+            if (wr != rd) break;
+        }
+#undef LD_REC_WR
+        while (rd != wr) {
+            const ld_rec_hdr* h = (const ld_rec_hdr*)(ring + rd % LD_REC_RING);
+            ld_rec_exec(h);
+            rd += h->bytes;
+            /* A locked exchange, not a plain store: the driver writes the command buffer with
+             * write-combining stores, which only a fence or locked instruction drains. With a
+             * plain store the walker could see the call done, close and submit the list while
+             * its last bytes sat in this core's buffers, and the GPU hung (DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_HUNG
+             * within a minute, 4 runs out of 4). */
+            InterlockedExchange64(&s_rec_rd, (LONG64)rd);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+static struct { const ID3D12GraphicsCommandListVtbl* lpVtbl; } s_rec_proxy;
+static ID3D12GraphicsCommandListVtbl s_rec_vtbl;
+/* Put the stand-in in front of g.list. On by default; LD_RECORD_THREAD=0 records on the walker
+ * as before. Measured in a GT5 race: the walk 6-9% shorter per draw, barriers and copies
+ * 2.0 -> 1.5 ms a frame, the walker waiting 0.04 ms a frame for this thread. */
+static void ld_rec_install(void)
+{
+    const char* e = getenv("LD_RECORD_THREAD");
+    if ((e && atoi(e) == 0) || !g.list || s_rec_on) return;
+    s_rec_ring = (u8*)VirtualAlloc(NULL, LD_REC_RING, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
+    s_rec_wake = CreateEventA(NULL, FALSE, FALSE, NULL);
+    if (!s_rec_ring || !s_rec_wake) return;
+    void** slots = (void**)&s_rec_vtbl;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof s_rec_vtbl / sizeof(void*); i++) slots[i] = (void*)pr_trap;
+    s_rec_vtbl.QueryInterface = pr_QueryInterface; s_rec_vtbl.AddRef = pr_AddRef; s_rec_vtbl.Release = pr_Release;
+    s_rec_vtbl.SetName = pr_SetName; s_rec_vtbl.GetType = pr_GetType;
+    s_rec_vtbl.Close = pr_Close; s_rec_vtbl.Reset = pr_Reset;
+    s_rec_vtbl.ResourceBarrier = pr_ResourceBarrier; s_rec_vtbl.CopyTextureRegion = pr_CopyTextureRegion;
+    s_rec_vtbl.SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable = pr_SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable;
+    s_rec_vtbl.SetComputeRootDescriptorTable = pr_SetComputeRootDescriptorTable;
+    s_rec_vtbl.ClearDepthStencilView = pr_ClearDepthStencilView; s_rec_vtbl.ClearRenderTargetView = pr_ClearRenderTargetView;
+    s_rec_vtbl.DrawInstanced = pr_DrawInstanced; s_rec_vtbl.DrawIndexedInstanced = pr_DrawIndexedInstanced;
+    s_rec_vtbl.SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView = pr_SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView;
+    s_rec_vtbl.SetGraphicsRoot32BitConstants = pr_SetGraphicsRoot32BitConstants;
+    s_rec_vtbl.SetComputeRootSignature = pr_SetComputeRootSignature; s_rec_vtbl.SetGraphicsRootSignature = pr_SetGraphicsRootSignature;
+    s_rec_vtbl.SetPipelineState = pr_SetPipelineState; s_rec_vtbl.Dispatch = pr_Dispatch; s_rec_vtbl.CopyResource = pr_CopyResource;
+    s_rec_vtbl.SetDescriptorHeaps = pr_SetDescriptorHeaps; s_rec_vtbl.RSSetViewports = pr_RSSetViewports;
+    s_rec_vtbl.RSSetScissorRects = pr_RSSetScissorRects; s_rec_vtbl.OMSetStencilRef = pr_OMSetStencilRef;
+    s_rec_vtbl.OMSetBlendFactor = pr_OMSetBlendFactor;
+    s_rec_vtbl.OMSetRenderTargets = pr_OMSetRenderTargets; s_rec_vtbl.IASetVertexBuffers = pr_IASetVertexBuffers;
+    s_rec_vtbl.IASetPrimitiveTopology = pr_IASetPrimitiveTopology; s_rec_vtbl.IASetIndexBuffer = pr_IASetIndexBuffer;
+    s_rec_vtbl.EndQuery = pr_EndQuery; s_rec_vtbl.ResolveQueryData = pr_ResolveQueryData;
+    s_rec_proxy.lpVtbl = &s_rec_vtbl;
+    HANDLE t = CreateThread(NULL, 1u << 20, ld_rec_worker, NULL, 0, NULL);
+    if (!t) return;
+    SetThreadPriority(t, THREAD_PRIORITY_ABOVE_NORMAL);
+    CloseHandle(t);
+    s_rec_real = g.list;
+    g.list = (ID3D12GraphicsCommandList*)&s_rec_proxy;
+    s_rec_on = 1;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[ld-rec] D3D12 commands are recorded on their own thread (LD_RECORD_THREAD)\n");
+}
+
+/* What the open command list was last given, so a draw that sets the same heaps, root signature,
+ * pipeline, topology, viewport or scissor as the one before skips the driver call. Every call of
+ * these kinds goes through here, and a list reset forgets it all. */
+static struct {
+    int heaps; ID3D12DescriptorHeap* h0; ID3D12DescriptorHeap* h1;
+    ID3D12RootSignature* rs; ID3D12PipelineState* pso;
+    int topo_ok; D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY topo;
+    int vp_ok; D3D12_VIEWPORT vp; int sc_ok; D3D12_RECT sc;
+    int rt_ok; UINT rt_n; D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rt[8]; int has_ds; D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE ds;
+    /* [draw-calls] LD_STATE_DEDUP: the draw path's root arguments and fixed-function state. Root arguments
+     * go stale when the root signature changes (and the tables when the heaps do); the rest lasts until
+     * the list is reset. Kept up to date whether the switch is on or not, so turning it on mid-race is safe. */
+    u8 cbv_ok[5], tab_ok[4]; D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS cbv[5]; UINT64 tab[4];
+    int stencil_ok; UINT stencil; int bf_ok; FLOAT bf[4];
+    int vb_ok; D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW vb; int ib_ok; D3D12_INDEX_BUFFER_VIEW ib;
+} s_lcs;
+static void ld_list_state_reset(void) { memset(&s_lcs, 0, sizeof s_lcs); }
+static void ld_set_heaps(ID3D12DescriptorHeap* const* h)
+{
+    if (s_lcs.heaps && s_lcs.h0 == h[0] && s_lcs.h1 == h[1]) return;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->SetDescriptorHeaps(g.list, 2, h);
+    s_lcs.heaps = 1; s_lcs.h0 = h[0]; s_lcs.h1 = h[1];
+    memset(s_lcs.tab_ok, 0, sizeof s_lcs.tab_ok);
+}
+static void ld_set_rootsig(ID3D12RootSignature* rs)
+{
+    if (rs && s_lcs.rs == rs) return;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->SetGraphicsRootSignature(g.list, rs);
+    s_lcs.rs = rs;
+    memset(s_lcs.cbv_ok, 0, sizeof s_lcs.cbv_ok);
+    memset(s_lcs.tab_ok, 0, sizeof s_lcs.tab_ok);
+}
+/* [draw-calls] The draw path's own calls, each skipped when the open list already has that value. Only
+ * sink_end_impl uses these, with g.rootsig_x set just before; every other path that sets root arguments
+ * first sets its own root signature, which makes these stale (above). */
+static int ld_dc_same(int known, int kind)
+{
+    if (known && s_dc.state) { g_dc[DC_SKIP]++; g_dc[kind]++; return 1; }
+    g_dc[DC_SET]++;
+    return 0;
+}
+static void ld_set_cbv(UINT i, D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS va)
+{
+    if (ld_dc_same(s_lcs.cbv_ok[i] && s_lcs.cbv[i] == va, DC_SKIP_CBV)) return;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView(g.list, i, va);
+    s_lcs.cbv_ok[i] = 1; s_lcs.cbv[i] = va;
+}
+static void ld_set_table(UINT i, D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE h)
+{
+    if (ld_dc_same(s_lcs.tab_ok[i] && s_lcs.tab[i] == h.ptr, DC_SKIP_TAB)) return;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(g.list, i, h);
+    s_lcs.tab_ok[i] = 1; s_lcs.tab[i] = h.ptr;
+}
+static void ld_set_stencil_ref(UINT ref)
+{
+    if (ld_dc_same(s_lcs.stencil_ok && s_lcs.stencil == ref, DC_SKIP_STENCIL)) return;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->OMSetStencilRef(g.list, ref);
+    s_lcs.stencil_ok = 1; s_lcs.stencil = ref;
+}
+static void ld_set_blend_factor(const FLOAT f[4])
+{
+    if (ld_dc_same(s_lcs.bf_ok && memcmp(s_lcs.bf, f, sizeof s_lcs.bf) == 0, DC_SKIP_BLEND)) return;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->OMSetBlendFactor(g.list, f);
+    s_lcs.bf_ok = 1; memcpy(s_lcs.bf, f, sizeof s_lcs.bf);
+}
+static void ld_set_vb(const D3D12_VERTEX_BUFFER_VIEW* v)
+{
+    if (ld_dc_same(s_lcs.vb_ok && memcmp(&s_lcs.vb, v, sizeof *v) == 0, DC_SKIP_VB)) return;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->IASetVertexBuffers(g.list, 0, 1, v);
+    s_lcs.vb_ok = 1; s_lcs.vb = *v;
+}
+static void ld_set_ib(const D3D12_INDEX_BUFFER_VIEW* v)
+{
+    if (ld_dc_same(s_lcs.ib_ok && memcmp(&s_lcs.ib, v, sizeof *v) == 0, DC_SKIP_IB)) return;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->IASetIndexBuffer(g.list, v);
+    s_lcs.ib_ok = 1; s_lcs.ib = *v;
+}
+static void ld_set_pso(ID3D12PipelineState* pso)
+{
+    if (pso && s_lcs.pso == pso) return;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->SetPipelineState(g.list, pso);
+    s_lcs.pso = pso;
+}
+static void ld_set_topo(D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY t)
+{
+    if (s_lcs.topo_ok && s_lcs.topo == t) return;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->IASetPrimitiveTopology(g.list, t);
+    s_lcs.topo_ok = 1; s_lcs.topo = t;
+}
+static void ld_set_viewports(UINT n, const D3D12_VIEWPORT* v)
+{
+    if (n == 1 && s_lcs.vp_ok && memcmp(&s_lcs.vp, v, sizeof *v) == 0) return;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->RSSetViewports(g.list, n, v);
+    s_lcs.vp_ok = n == 1;
+    if (n == 1) s_lcs.vp = *v;
+}
+static void ld_set_scissors(UINT n, const D3D12_RECT* r)
+{
+    if (n == 1 && s_lcs.sc_ok && memcmp(&s_lcs.sc, r, sizeof *r) == 0) return;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->RSSetScissorRects(g.list, n, r);
+    s_lcs.sc_ok = n == 1;
+    if (n == 1) s_lcs.sc = *r;
+}
+
+/* Render targets by handle. A view rewritten into the same slot (a surface recreated at a new size)
+ * keeps its handle, so every Create*View sets s_ld_rt_dirty and the next bind goes through. */
+static void ld_set_rts(UINT n, const D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE* rt, BOOL single, const D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE* ds)
+{
+    if (!s_ld_rt_dirty && !single && n <= 8 && s_lcs.rt_ok && s_lcs.rt_n == n &&
+        (ds ? (s_lcs.has_ds && s_lcs.ds.ptr == ds->ptr) : !s_lcs.has_ds) &&
+        (n == 0 || memcmp(s_lcs.rt, rt, n * sizeof *rt) == 0))
+        return;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->OMSetRenderTargets(g.list, n, rt, single, ds);
+    s_ld_rt_dirty = 0;
+    s_lcs.rt_ok = !single && n <= 8;
+    if (s_lcs.rt_ok) {
+        s_lcs.rt_n = n;
+        if (n) memcpy(s_lcs.rt, rt, n * sizeof *rt);
+        s_lcs.has_ds = ds != NULL;
+        if (ds) s_lcs.ds = *ds;
+    }
+}
+
 static void ld_flush(ld_flush_reason reason)

+/* [stutter] LD_TEX_FAST_SWIZZLE (on; =0 morton_index for every texel, as before). In morton_index each
+ * bit of x and of y lands at a place that depends only on the bit's number and lw/lh, never on the other
+ * coordinate's value, so morton_index(x, y) == morton_index(x, 0) | morton_index(0, y) exactly. Two
+ * tables per level (one entry per column, one per row) then give each texel's address with one OR
+ * instead of a loop of up to 24 steps. Walker only (texture decode runs there). */
+static int ld_tex_fast_swizzle(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_TEX_FAST_SWIZZLE"); on = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
+    return on;

+static u32 s_swz_x[4096], s_swz_y[4096];
+static void ld_swizzle_tables(u32 mw, u32 mh, u32 ox, u32 oy, u32 lw, u32 lh)
+{
+    for (u32 x = 0; x < mw && x < 4096u; x++) s_swz_x[x] = morton_index(x + ox, 0, lw, lh);
+    for (u32 y = 0; y < mh && y < 4096u; y++) s_swz_y[y] = morton_index(0, y + oy, lw, lh);

+/* Room for one upload: the ring when it fits, or a buffer of its own. A scene load
+ * decodes far more than the ring holds in a frame, and running out used to end the
+ * texture's upload there: the mips left over stayed black, so GT5's track went black
+ * with distance. ld_upload_done after the copy has been recorded. */
+static u8* ld_upload_space(u64 bytes, ID3D12Resource** buf, u32* offset)
+{
+    const u32 start = (g.upload_used + 511) & ~511u;
+    if ((u64)start + bytes <= s_up_cap) {   /* [draw-calls] the cap: LD_SRV_WRAP */
+        ld_ring_note(g.upload_used, s_up_hi, &s_up_list_lo);
+        *buf = g.upload;
+        *offset = start;
+        g.upload_used = start + (u32)bytes;
+        s_up_hi = g.upload_used;
+        return g.upload_mapped + start;
+    }
+    D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp = {0};
+    hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD;
+    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC rd = {0};
+    rd.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
+    rd.Width = bytes; rd.Height = 1; rd.DepthOrArraySize = 1; rd.MipLevels = 1;
+    rd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
+    rd.Layout = D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR;
+    ID3D12Resource* b = NULL;
+    if (FAILED(LD_CCR(g.dev, &hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &rd,
+            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, NULL, &IID_ID3D12Resource, (void**)&b)))
+        return NULL;
+    void* mapped = NULL;
+    if (FAILED(b->lpVtbl->Map(b, 0, NULL, &mapped))) {
+        b->lpVtbl->Release(b);
+        return NULL;
+    }
+    *buf = b;
+    *offset = 0;
+    return (u8*)mapped;
+}

+static void ld_upload_done(ID3D12Resource* buf)
+{

+/* Set around a refresh's decode: a create_texture call with the same description writes into
+ * this texture instead of allocating another. GT5 rewrites small lighting textures every
+ * frame, about 7 a flip, and a committed resource costs kernel time per allocation; that was
+ * most of the 14 ms a frame the refresh path took in a race. The queue keeps it in order: draws
+ * already recorded see the old contents, later ones the new. LD_TEX_REUSE=0 turns it off. */
+static ID3D12Resource* g_tex_reuse = NULL;
+static void tex_reuse_barrier(ID3D12Resource* t, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES from, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES to)
+{
+    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER b = {0};
+    b.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION; b.Transition.pResource = t;
+    b.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
+    b.Transition.StateBefore = from; b.Transition.StateAfter = to;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 1, &b);
+}
+static ID3D12Resource* tex_reuse_take(const D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC* rd)
+{
+    ID3D12Resource* t = g_tex_reuse;
+    if (!t) return NULL;
+    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC cur;
+    t->lpVtbl->GetDesc(t, &cur);
+    if (cur.Dimension != rd->Dimension || cur.Width != rd->Width || cur.Height != rd->Height ||
+        cur.DepthOrArraySize != rd->DepthOrArraySize || cur.MipLevels != rd->MipLevels ||
+        cur.Format != rd->Format)
+        return NULL;
+    tex_reuse_barrier(t, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST);
+    return t;
+}

+/* A volume's level: d slices of `rows` rows of row_bytes, one after another. */
+typedef struct { u32 w, h, d; const u8* data; u32 row_bytes, rows; } vol_level_t;

+static ID3D12Resource* create_texture_3d(DXGI_FORMAT fmt, const vol_level_t* lv, u32 n)
+{
+    if (n == 0) return NULL;
+    D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp = {0}; hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT;

+    ID3D12Resource* tex = NULL;

+            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, NULL,

+    for (u32 m = 0; m < n; m++) {
+        const u32 pitch = (lv[m].row_bytes + 255) & ~255u;
+        const u64 bytes = (u64)pitch * lv[m].rows * lv[m].d;
+        ID3D12Resource* up = NULL;
+        u32 start = 0;
+        u8* up_mem = ld_upload_space(bytes, &up, &start);
+        if (!up_mem) {

+            return NULL;
+        }

+                       lv[m].row_bytes);

+        src.pResource = up; src.Type = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT;

+        src.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.Format = fmt;
+        src.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.Width = lv[m].w;
+        src.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.Height = lv[m].h;
+        src.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.Depth = lv[m].d;
+        src.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.RowPitch = pitch;

+/* Slices of a 3D texture, 0 for anything sampled as 2D or cube. */
+static u32 texture_volume_depth(const rsx_dsp_texture* t)
+{
+    return (t->dimension == 3 && !t->cubemap && t->depth > 1) ? t->depth : 0;

+/* A swizzled texture with a border is stored at the next power of two above its size
+ * plus two, the image and its border centred in that: an 8x8 cube face takes 16x16 with
+ * the image at 4,4. GT5's car ambient cubes are these, 0x800 bytes a face, and read as
+ * plain 8x8 they landed mostly on unwritten memory: the paint's rainbow sheen. */
+static u32 border_padded(u32 v)
+{
+    u32 p = 1;
+    while (p < v + 2u) p <<= 1;
+    return p;
+}
+
+/* A half-float cube stays float: at 8 bits, dim ambient light rounds away to nothing. */
+static int texture_cube_is_hdr(u32 base_fmt, u32 remap)
+{
+    return base_fmt == RSX_TEX_FMT_W16Z16Y16X16_FLOAT && remap == 0xAAE4u;
+}
+
+/* Big-endian halves to host, R G B A. GT5 writes +inf alpha, which filtering would spread. */
+static void fp16_texel_to_host(const u8* p, u8* d)
+{
+    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
+        u16 h = (u16)((p[c * 2] << 8) | p[c * 2 + 1]);
+        if ((h & 0x7C00u) == 0x7C00u) h = c == 3 ? 0x3C00u : (u16)((h & 0x8000u) | 0x7BFFu);
+        d[c * 2] = (u8)h;
+        d[c * 2 + 1] = (u8)(h >> 8);
+    }
 }

+/* An all-zero mip level below a level with data has not been filled in. GT5's track
+ * textures declare chains whose lower levels stay zero in VRAM; sampling those read
+ * black, so the track went dark with distance. End the chain there: the sampler then
+ * clamps to the last real level. If the data arrives later the content hash notices
+ * and the texture is rebuilt with it. */
+static int mip_level_empty(const rsx_dsp_texture* t, const u8* level, u32 bytes, u32 m)
+{
+    if (!m || !bytes) return 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < bytes; i++)
+        if (level[i]) return 0;
+    static u32 said;
+    if (said++ < 32)
+        fprintf(stderr, "[mip-empty] 0x%08X fmt=0x%02X %ux%u declares %u mips, level %u is empty\n",
+                t->offset, t->format, t->width, t->height, t->mipmaps, m);
+    return 1;
+}

+/* Ending the chain at the first empty level was not enough. In this port only the top two or
+ * three levels of those track textures are ever written (why is still not known: no unhandled
+ * transfer is logged), and the rest of the span is zero only on a fresh boot. Once other scenes
+ * have used that memory it holds what they left there, often another texture's texels, and the
+ * road at Tsukuba showed it with distance as blocky black-and-white or grass-green noise.
+ *
+ * So a DXT level is also checked against the one above it: the mean colour of each 4x4 block of
+ * a real reduction is, give or take compression, the mean of the four blocks it was filtered
+ * from (median 1.4 of 255 apart on GT5's textures, 99% under 12; another texture's data is
+ * typically 15-80 apart). From the first level that is empty or does not follow, the rest of the
+ * chain is rebuilt from the last good level: decoded, box-filtered and re-encoded, so distant
+ * surfaces are filtered instead of shimmering on one sharp level. Should the real data arrive
+ * later, the content hash notices and the texture is decoded again with it.
+ *   LD_MIP_REBUILD=0     end the chain there instead (the sampler clamps to the last good level)
+ *   LD_MIP_FOLLOW_MAX=n  largest mean block difference still taken as a reduction (default 12) */
+static void dxt_block_mean(const u8* cb, int four, float out[3])
+{
+    const u32 c0 = (u32)cb[0] | ((u32)cb[1] << 8), c1 = (u32)cb[2] | ((u32)cb[3] << 8);
+    float p[4][3];
+    p[0][0] = (float)((c0 >> 11) & 31) * (255.0f / 31.0f);
+    p[0][1] = (float)((c0 >> 5) & 63) * (255.0f / 63.0f);
+    p[0][2] = (float)(c0 & 31) * (255.0f / 31.0f);
+    p[1][0] = (float)((c1 >> 11) & 31) * (255.0f / 31.0f);
+    p[1][1] = (float)((c1 >> 5) & 63) * (255.0f / 63.0f);
+    p[1][2] = (float)(c1 & 31) * (255.0f / 31.0f);
+    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
+        if (four || c0 > c1) {
+            p[2][c] = (2.0f * p[0][c] + p[1][c]) / 3.0f;
+            p[3][c] = (p[0][c] + 2.0f * p[1][c]) / 3.0f;
+        } else {
+            p[2][c] = (p[0][c] + p[1][c]) * 0.5f;
+            p[3][c] = 0.0f;
+        }
+    }
+    const u32 idx = (u32)cb[4] | ((u32)cb[5] << 8) | ((u32)cb[6] << 16) | ((u32)cb[7] << 24);
+    u32 cnt[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
+    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) cnt[(idx >> (2 * i)) & 3]++;
+    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++)
+        out[c] = ((float)cnt[0] * p[0][c] + (float)cnt[1] * p[1][c] +
+                  (float)cnt[2] * p[2][c] + (float)cnt[3] * p[3][c]) / 16.0f;
+}
+
+/* 1 when `cur` (bw x bh blocks) reads as a reduction of `prev` (pbw x pbh blocks), or when the two
+ * cannot be compared block for block (the small end of a chain). Up to 24 x 24 blocks are sampled. */
+static int dxt_level_follows(const u8* prev, u32 pbw, u32 pbh, const u8* cur, u32 bw, u32 bh, u32 block)
+{
+    if (!bw || !bh || pbw != 2 * bw || pbh != 2 * bh) return 1;
+    static float limit = -1.0f;
+    if (limit < 0.0f) { const char* e = getenv("LD_MIP_FOLLOW_MAX"); limit = e ? (float)atof(e) : 12.0f; }
+    const u32 sx = bw > 24 ? bw / 24 : 1, sy = bh > 24 ? bh / 24 : 1;
+    const int four = block == 16;
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    u32 n = 0;
+    for (u32 y = 0; y < bh; y += sy)
+        for (u32 x = 0; x < bw; x += sx) {
+            float a[3], q[3] = {0, 0, 0}, s[3];
+            dxt_block_mean(cur + ((size_t)y * bw + x) * block + (block - 8), four, a);
+            for (u32 dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++)
+                for (u32 dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
+                    dxt_block_mean(prev + ((size_t)(2 * y + dy) * pbw + 2 * x + dx) * block + (block - 8), four, s);
+                    q[0] += s[0]; q[1] += s[1]; q[2] += s[2];
+                }
+            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
+                const double d = (double)a[c] - (double)q[c] * 0.25;
+                sum += d < 0.0 ? -d : d;
+            }
+            n += 3;
+        }
+    return !n || sum / n <= limit;
+}

+/* The 16 texels of a DXT block as RGBA8: block 8 is DXT1, 16 is DXT3 (dxt3) or DXT5. */
+static void dxt_decode_block(const u8* b, u32 block, int dxt3, u8 out[16][4])
+{
+    const u8* cb = b + (block - 8);
+    const u32 c0 = (u32)cb[0] | ((u32)cb[1] << 8), c1 = (u32)cb[2] | ((u32)cb[3] << 8);
+    u8 p[4][4];
+    p[0][0] = (u8)(((c0 >> 11) & 31) * 255 / 31); p[0][1] = (u8)(((c0 >> 5) & 63) * 255 / 63);
+    p[0][2] = (u8)((c0 & 31) * 255 / 31);         p[0][3] = 255;
+    p[1][0] = (u8)(((c1 >> 11) & 31) * 255 / 31); p[1][1] = (u8)(((c1 >> 5) & 63) * 255 / 63);
+    p[1][2] = (u8)((c1 & 31) * 255 / 31);         p[1][3] = 255;
+    if (block == 16 || c0 > c1) {
+        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
+            p[2][c] = (u8)((2 * p[0][c] + p[1][c]) / 3);
+            p[3][c] = (u8)((p[0][c] + 2 * p[1][c]) / 3);
+        }
+        p[2][3] = p[3][3] = 255;
+    } else {
+        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) p[2][c] = (u8)((p[0][c] + p[1][c]) / 2);
+        p[2][3] = 255;
+        p[3][0] = p[3][1] = p[3][2] = p[3][3] = 0;
+    }
+    const u32 idx = (u32)cb[4] | ((u32)cb[5] << 8) | ((u32)cb[6] << 16) | ((u32)cb[7] << 24);
+    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) memcpy(out[i], p[(idx >> (2 * i)) & 3], 4);
+    if (block != 16) return;
+    if (dxt3) {
+        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) out[i][3] = (u8)(((b[i >> 1] >> ((i & 1) * 4)) & 15) * 17);
+        return;
+    }
+    u32 a[8];
+    a[0] = b[0]; a[1] = b[1];
+    if (a[0] > a[1]) for (u32 k = 1; k < 7; k++) a[k + 1] = ((7 - k) * a[0] + k * a[1]) / 7;
+    else { for (u32 k = 1; k < 5; k++) a[k + 1] = ((5 - k) * a[0] + k * a[1]) / 5; a[6] = 0; a[7] = 255; }
+    u64 bits = 0;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) bits |= (u64)b[2 + i] << (8 * i);
+    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) out[i][3] = (u8)a[(bits >> (3 * i)) & 7];
+}
+
+static u32 dxt_565(const int c[3])
+{
+    return (u32)(((c[0] * 31 + 127) / 255) << 11 | ((c[1] * 63 + 127) / 255) << 5 | ((c[2] * 31 + 127) / 255));
+}
+static void dxt_565_rgb(u32 v, int out[3])
+{
+    out[0] = (int)(((v >> 11) & 31) * 255 / 31); out[1] = (int)(((v >> 5) & 63) * 255 / 63); out[2] = (int)((v & 31) * 255 / 31);
+}
+
+/* A colour block (8 bytes) from 16 texels: the two ends of their bounding box, each texel the nearest of
+ * the four (three and transparent black for a DXT1 block with cut-out texels). */
+static void dxt_encode_colour(const u8 px[16][4], int punch, u8* out)
+{
+    int mn[3] = {255, 255, 255}, mx[3] = {0, 0, 0}, any = 0, holes = 0;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
+        if (punch && px[i][3] < 128) { holes = 1; continue; }
+        any = 1;
+        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
+            if (px[i][c] < mn[c]) mn[c] = px[i][c];
+            if (px[i][c] > mx[c]) mx[c] = px[i][c];
+        }
+    }
+    u32 e0 = any ? dxt_565(mx) : 0, e1 = any ? dxt_565(mn) : 0;
+    if (holes ? e0 > e1 : e0 < e1) { const u32 s = e0; e0 = e1; e1 = s; }
+    int p[4][3];
+    dxt_565_rgb(e0, p[0]); dxt_565_rgb(e1, p[1]);
+    const int three = holes || e0 == e1;   /* e0 <= e1 decodes as three colours */
+    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
+        if (three) { p[2][c] = (p[0][c] + p[1][c]) / 2; p[3][c] = 0; }
+        else { p[2][c] = (2 * p[0][c] + p[1][c]) / 3; p[3][c] = (p[0][c] + 2 * p[1][c]) / 3; }
+    }
+    u32 idx = 0;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
+        u32 best = 0;
+        if (holes && px[i][3] < 128) best = 3;
+        else {
+            int bd = 0x7FFFFFFF;
+            for (u32 k = 0; k < (three ? 3u : 4u); k++) {
+                const int dr = px[i][0] - p[k][0], dg = px[i][1] - p[k][1], db = px[i][2] - p[k][2];
+                const int d = dr * dr + dg * dg + db * db;
+                if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = k; }
+            }
+        }
+        idx |= best << (2 * i);
+    }
+    out[0] = (u8)e0; out[1] = (u8)(e0 >> 8); out[2] = (u8)e1; out[3] = (u8)(e1 >> 8);
+    out[4] = (u8)idx; out[5] = (u8)(idx >> 8); out[6] = (u8)(idx >> 16); out[7] = (u8)(idx >> 24);
+}
+
+static void dxt_encode_block(const u8 px[16][4], u32 block, int dxt3, u8* out)
+{
+    if (block == 8) { dxt_encode_colour(px, 1, out); return; }
+    memset(out, 0, 8);
+    if (dxt3) {
+        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) out[i >> 1] |= (u8)(((px[i][3] * 15 + 127) / 255) << ((i & 1) * 4));
+    } else {
+        u32 mn = 255, mx = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { if (px[i][3] < mn) mn = px[i][3]; if (px[i][3] > mx) mx = px[i][3]; }
+        out[0] = (u8)mx; out[1] = (u8)mn;
+        if (mx > mn) {
+            u32 a[8]; a[0] = mx; a[1] = mn;
+            for (u32 k = 1; k < 7; k++) a[k + 1] = ((7 - k) * mx + k * mn) / 7;
+            u64 bits = 0;
+            for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
+                u32 best = 0, bd = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
+                for (u32 k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
+                    const u32 d = px[i][3] > a[k] ? px[i][3] - a[k] : a[k] - px[i][3];
+                    if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = k; }
+                }
+                bits |= (u64)best << (3 * i);
+            }
+            for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) out[2 + i] = (u8)(bits >> (8 * i));
+        }
+    }
+    dxt_encode_colour(px, 0, out + 8);
+}
+
+/* Rebuilds levels from..n_total-1 of a DXT chain from level from-1, which lv already holds. The new
+ * levels live in *store (free it once the texture has been created). Returns the level count. */
+static u32 dxt_rebuild_mips(const rsx_dsp_texture* t, tex_level_t* lv, u32 from, u32 n_total,
+                            u32 block, int dxt3, int why, u8** store)
+{
+    *store = NULL;
+    const u32 src_lv = from - 1;
+    u32 tw = t->width >> src_lv, th = t->height >> src_lv;
+    if (!tw) tw = 1;
+    if (!th) th = 1;
+    const u32 sbw = lv[src_lv].row_bytes / block, sbh = lv[src_lv].rows;
+    u32 bytes = 0;
+    for (u32 m = from, w = tw, h = th; m < n_total; m++) {
+        w = w > 1 ? w >> 1 : 1; h = h > 1 ? h >> 1 : 1;
+        bytes += ((w + 3) / 4) * ((h + 3) / 4) * block;
+    }
+    u8* img = (u8*)malloc((size_t)tw * th * 4);
+    u8* nxt = (u8*)malloc((size_t)((tw + 1) / 2) * ((th + 1) / 2) * 4 + 4);
+    u8* out = (u8*)malloc(bytes ? bytes : 1);
+    if (!img || !nxt || !out) { free(img); free(nxt); free(out); return from; }
+    for (u32 by = 0; by < sbh; by++)
+        for (u32 bx = 0; bx < sbw; bx++) {
+            u8 px[16][4];
+            dxt_decode_block(lv[src_lv].data + ((size_t)by * sbw + bx) * block, block, dxt3, px);
+            for (u32 i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
+                const u32 x = bx * 4 + (i & 3), y = by * 4 + (i >> 2);
+                if (x < tw && y < th) memcpy(img + ((size_t)y * tw + x) * 4, px[i], 4);
+            }
+        }
+    u32 n = from, off = 0, w = tw, h = th;
+    for (u32 m = from; m < n_total; m++) {
+        const u32 nw = w > 1 ? w >> 1 : 1, nh = h > 1 ? h >> 1 : 1;
+        for (u32 y = 0; y < nh; y++)
+            for (u32 x = 0; x < nw; x++) {
+                const u32 x0 = 2 * x < w ? 2 * x : w - 1, x1 = 2 * x + 1 < w ? 2 * x + 1 : x0;
+                const u32 y0 = 2 * y < h ? 2 * y : h - 1, y1 = 2 * y + 1 < h ? 2 * y + 1 : y0;
+                for (u32 c = 0; c < 4; c++)
+                    nxt[((size_t)y * nw + x) * 4 + c] = (u8)((img[((size_t)y0 * w + x0) * 4 + c] + img[((size_t)y0 * w + x1) * 4 + c] +
+                                                              img[((size_t)y1 * w + x0) * 4 + c] + img[((size_t)y1 * w + x1) * 4 + c] + 2) / 4);
+            }
+        { u8* s = img; img = nxt; nxt = s; }
+        w = nw; h = nh;
+        const u32 bw = (w + 3) / 4, bh = (h + 3) / 4;
+        for (u32 by = 0; by < bh; by++)
+            for (u32 bx = 0; bx < bw; bx++) {
+                u8 px[16][4];
+                for (u32 i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
+                    u32 x = bx * 4 + (i & 3), y = by * 4 + (i >> 2);
+                    if (x >= w) x = w - 1;
+                    if (y >= h) y = h - 1;
+                    memcpy(px[i], img + ((size_t)y * w + x) * 4, 4);
+                }
+                dxt_encode_block((const u8(*)[4])px, block, dxt3, out + off + ((size_t)by * bw + bx) * block);
+            }
+        lv[n].w = (w + 3) & ~3u;
+        lv[n].h = (h + 3) & ~3u;
+        lv[n].data = out + off;
+        lv[n].row_bytes = bw * block;
+        lv[n].rows = bh;
+        off += bw * bh * block;
+        n++;
+    }
+    free(img); free(nxt);
+    *store = out;
+    static u32 said;
+    said++;
+    if (said <= 24 || (said & 255) == 0)
+        fprintf(stderr, "[mip-rebuild] #%u %u:0x%08X fmt=0x%02X %ux%u: levels %u-%u rebuilt from level %u (level %u %s)\n",
+                said, t->location, t->offset, t->format, t->width, t->height, from, n_total - 1, src_lv, from,
+                why == 1 ? "empty" : "not a reduction of the one above");
+    return n;
+}
