+/* A 3D texture. Colour formats are unpacked to RGBA8 like everything else here;
+ * DXT stays compressed, each slice its own run of blocks. */
+static ID3D12Resource* decode_guest_volume(const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u32 remap)
+{
+    const u32 base_fmt = t->format & TEX_FMT_BASE_MASK & ~(u32)TEX_FMT_UNNORM;
+    const int linear = (t->format & TEX_FMT_LINEAR) != 0;
+    u32 texel_size = 0, block = 0;
+    switch (base_fmt) {
+    case TEX_FMT_DXT1: block = 8; break;
+    case TEX_FMT_DXT23:
+    case TEX_FMT_DXT45: block = 16; break;
+    case TEX_FMT_B8: texel_size = 1; break;
+    case TEX_FMT_A4R4G4B4:
+    case TEX_FMT_A1R5G5B5:
+    case TEX_FMT_R5G6B5:
+    case TEX_FMT_G8B8: texel_size = 2; break;
+    case TEX_FMT_A8R8G8B8: texel_size = 4; break;
+    default: return NULL;
+    }
+    const u32 span = texture_source_span(t);
+    const u8* src = guest_ptr(t->location, t->offset, span);
+    if (!src) return NULL;
+    /* LD_VOL_DUMP=<dir>: each 3D texture's guest bytes, named by its address and shape. */
+    { static unsigned n = 0;
+      if (PS3_LOG_FIRST(n, 24))
+          fprintf(stderr, "[vol] %u:0x%08X fmt=0x%02X %ux%ux%u mips=%u pitch=%u remap=0x%X span=%u\n",
+                  t->location, t->offset, t->format, t->width, t->height, t->depth, t->mipmaps, t->pitch, remap, span);
+      const char* dir = getenv("LD_VOL_DUMP");
+      if (dir) {
+          char path[MAX_PATH];
+          snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s\\vol_%X_%08X_f%02X_%ux%ux%u_m%u.bin", dir, t->location, t->offset,
+                   t->format, t->width, t->height, t->depth, t->mipmaps);
+          FILE* f = fopen(path, "wb");
+          if (f) { fwrite(src, 1, span, f); fclose(f); }
+      } }
+    u32 n_mips = linear ? 1 : (t->mipmaps ? t->mipmaps : 1);
+    if (n_mips > 14) n_mips = 14;
+    vol_level_t lv[14];
+    u8* rgba[14] = {0};
+    u32 mw = t->width, mh = t->height, md = t->depth, off = 0, n = 0;
+    int oom = 0;
+    for (u32 m = 0; m < n_mips; m++) {
+        lv[n].d = md;
+        if (block) {
+            const u32 bw = (mw + 3) / 4, bh = (mh + 3) / 4;
+            lv[n].w = (mw + 3) & ~3u;
+            lv[n].h = (mh + 3) & ~3u;
+            /* The RSX stores a compressed volume as VTC (NV_texture_compression_vtc): slices
+             * in groups of four, each 4x4 cell of a group holding its blocks one per slice.
+             * D3D wants whole slices one after another. Read as slices, a lookup lands in the
+             * wrong slice: GT5's paint and rain tables are these, which is its rainbow paint. */
+            const size_t level_bytes = (size_t)bw * block * bh * md;
+            rgba[n] = (u8*)malloc(level_bytes);
+            if (!rgba[n]) { oom = 1; break; }
+            const u8* cell = src + off;
+            for (u32 group = 0; group < md; group += 4) {
+                const u32 in_group = md - group < 4 ? md - group : 4;
+                for (u32 by = 0; by < bh; by++)
+                    for (u32 bx = 0; bx < bw; bx++)
+                        for (u32 s = 0; s < in_group; s++, cell += block)
+                            memcpy(rgba[n] + (((size_t)(group + s) * bh + by) * bw + bx) * block, cell, block);
+            }
+            lv[n].data = rgba[n];
+            lv[n].row_bytes = bw * block;
+            lv[n].rows = bh;
+            off += bw * block * bh * md;
+        } else {
+            const u32 pitch = (m == 0 && linear && t->pitch) ? t->pitch : mw * texel_size;
+            rgba[n] = (u8*)malloc((size_t)mw * mh * md * 4);
+            if (!rgba[n]) { oom = 1; break; }
+            const u32 lw = log2_u32(mw), lh = log2_u32(mh), ld = log2_u32(md);
+            const u8* level_src = src + off;
+            for (u32 z = 0; z < md; z++)
+                for (u32 y = 0; y < mh; y++)
+                    for (u32 x = 0; x < mw; x++) {
+                        const u8* pixel = linear
+                            ? level_src + (size_t)z * pitch * mh + (size_t)y * pitch + (size_t)x * texel_size
+                            : level_src + (size_t)rsx_swizzle_offset_3d(x, y, z, lw, lh, ld) * texel_size;
+                        decode_texel(base_fmt, pixel, remap,
+                                     rgba[n] + (((size_t)z * mh + y) * mw + x) * 4);
+                    }
+            lv[n].w = mw; lv[n].h = mh;
+            lv[n].data = rgba[n];
+            lv[n].row_bytes = mw * 4;
+            lv[n].rows = mh;
+            off += pitch * mh * md;
+        }
+        n++;
+        if (mw == 1 && mh == 1 && md == 1) break;
+        mw = mw > 1 ? mw >> 1 : 1;
+        mh = mh > 1 ? mh >> 1 : 1;
+        md = md > 1 ? md >> 1 : 1;
+    }
+    /* BC blocks can't address below 4x4 cleanly in 3D; a chain that gets there stops early. */
+    if (block) {
+        u32 keep = 0;
+        while (keep < n && lv[keep].w >= 4 && lv[keep].h >= 4 &&
+               lv[keep].w == (keep ? lv[0].w >> keep : lv[0].w) &&
+               lv[keep].h == (keep ? lv[0].h >> keep : lv[0].h)) keep++;
+        n = keep ? keep : 1;
+    }
+    ID3D12Resource* result = NULL;
+    if (!oom) {
+        const DXGI_FORMAT dxgi = !block ? DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM
+                               : base_fmt == TEX_FMT_DXT1 ? DXGI_FORMAT_BC1_UNORM
+                               : base_fmt == TEX_FMT_DXT23 ? DXGI_FORMAT_BC2_UNORM
+                                                           : DXGI_FORMAT_BC3_UNORM;
+        result = create_texture_3d(dxgi, lv, n);
+    }
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < 14; i++) free(rgba[i]);
+    return result;
 }

+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * Texture packs (rsx_texpack.c). PS3_TEX_DUMP=1 writes each texture the game decodes to
+ * textures\dump, named by a hash of its top level; a file named by that hash in textures\replace is
+ * used instead, at any size. Textures are known by what they hold, never by where: GT5 moves them
+ * around VRAM (NV0039 copies) and reuses slots for others. Render targets never get here (binding
+ * takes those from the surfaces), and cube, 3D, bordered, float and depth textures are left alone.
+ * With neither on, the cache never calls any of this.
+ * -----------------------------------------------------------------------*/
+
+/* A texture-pack candidate's top level as stored: rows of row bytes, pitch apart. NULL otherwise. */
+static const u8* ld_tp_top(const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u32* row, u32* rows, u32* pitch, u32* block, u32* texel)
+{
+    if (t->cubemap || t->border || texture_volume_depth(t) || t->dimension < 1 || t->dimension > 2) return NULL;
+    const u32 w = t->width, h = t->height;
+    if (!w || !h || w > 4096 || h > 4096) return NULL;
+    *block = 0; *texel = 0;
+    switch (t->format & TEX_FMT_BASE_MASK) {
+    case TEX_FMT_DXT1: *block = 8; break;
+    case TEX_FMT_DXT23: case TEX_FMT_DXT45: *block = 16; break;
+    case TEX_FMT_B8: *texel = 1; break;
+    case TEX_FMT_A1R5G5B5: case TEX_FMT_A4R4G4B4: case TEX_FMT_R5G6B5: case TEX_FMT_G8B8: *texel = 2; break;
+    case TEX_FMT_A8R8G8B8: *texel = 4; break;
+    default: return NULL;
+    }
+    if (*block) {
+        *row = ((w + 3) / 4) * *block; *rows = (h + 3) / 4; *pitch = *row;
+    } else if (t->format & TEX_FMT_LINEAR) {
+        *row = w * *texel; *rows = h; *pitch = t->pitch ? t->pitch : *row;
+        if (*pitch < *row) return NULL;
+    } else {
+        if ((w & (w - 1)) || (h & (h - 1))) return NULL;
+        *row = w * h * *texel; *rows = 1; *pitch = *row;
+    }
+    return guest_ptr(t->location, t->offset, *pitch * (*rows - 1) + *row);
+}
+
+/* The texture-pack name of what the texture holds now, 0 if it can't have one. A DXT file keeps the
+ * game's channels as stored (the view applies the remap), any other is the picture after the remap,
+ * so the remap is part of those names. */
+static u64 ld_tp_ident(const rsx_dsp_texture* t)
+{
+    u32 row, rows, pitch, block, texel;
+    const LONGLONG q0 = hx_now();
+    const u8* src = ld_tp_top(t, &row, &rows, &pitch, &block, &texel);
+    const u64 id = src ? rsx_texpack_hash(src, row, rows, pitch, t->format & (TEX_FMT_BASE_MASK | TEX_FMT_LINEAR),
+                                          t->width, t->height, block ? 0u : (t->remap & 0xFFFFu)) : 0;
+    rsx_texpack_note_hash((u64)(hx_now() - q0));
+    return id;
+}
+
+static DXGI_FORMAT ld_tp_dxgi(u32 f)
+{
+    switch (f) {
+    case TP_FMT_RGBA8: return DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
+    case TP_FMT_BC1: return DXGI_FORMAT_BC1_UNORM;
+    case TP_FMT_BC2: return DXGI_FORMAT_BC2_UNORM;
+    case TP_FMT_BC3: return DXGI_FORMAT_BC3_UNORM;
+    case TP_FMT_BC7: return DXGI_FORMAT_BC7_UNORM;
+    default: return DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
+    }
+}

+/* Each file at each place it is used, once (a moved texture shows up at its new address), for the
+ * first 400 (PS3_TEX_LOG=<n> for more, 0 for none). */
+static void ld_tp_log_use(int k, const rsx_dsp_texture* t)
+{
+    static struct { int k; u32 loc, off; } *seen;
+    static u32 n, cap = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
+    if (cap == 0xFFFFFFFFu) {
+        const char* e = getenv("PS3_TEX_LOG");
+        cap = e && e[0] ? (u32)atoi(e) : 400u;
+        if (cap > 100000u) cap = 100000u;
+        seen = cap ? calloc(cap, sizeof *seen) : NULL;
+        if (!seen) cap = 0;
+    }
+    if (n >= cap) return;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < n; i++)
+        if (seen[i].k == k && seen[i].off == t->offset && seen[i].loc == t->location) return;
+    seen[n].k = k; seen[n].loc = t->location; seen[n].off = t->offset; n++;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[texpack] %s at %u:0x%08X (the game's %ux%u, format 0x%02X) frame %u\n",
+            rsx_texpack_name(k), t->location, t->offset, t->width, t->height, t->format, g_ld_frames);
+}
+
+/* The replacement file's texture with a reference for the caller, or NULL: still loading, failed,
+ * or a texel-addressed texture whose file is another size (its coordinates are in the game's texels). */
+static ID3D12Resource* ld_tp_take(int k, const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u32* fmt, u8* lod)
+{
+    if (rsx_texpack_poll(k) <= 0) return NULL;
+    const tp_image* im = rsx_texpack_image(k);
+    if ((t->format & TEX_FMT_UNNORM) && (im->w != t->width || im->h != t->height)) {
+        if (rsx_texpack_once(k, 0))
+            fprintf(stderr, "[texpack] %s is %ux%u, but the game reads that texture by texel at %ux%u: only a file of "
+                            "that size can replace it, so it stays the game's own\n",
+                    rsx_texpack_name(k), im->w, im->h, t->width, t->height);
+        return NULL;
+    }
+    ID3D12Resource* tex = (ID3D12Resource*)rsx_texpack_gpu(k);
+    int fresh = 0;
+    if (!tex) {
+        tex_level_t lv[TP_MAX_LEVELS];
+        for (u32 m = 0; m < im->n_levels; m++) {
+            lv[m].w = im->lv[m].w; lv[m].h = im->lv[m].h; lv[m].data = im->lv[m].data;
+            lv[m].row_bytes = im->lv[m].row_bytes; lv[m].rows = im->lv[m].rows;
+        }
+        ID3D12Resource* keep = g_tex_reuse;
+        g_tex_reuse = NULL;   /* a texture of its own, never written into a cache entry's */
+        tex = create_texture_mipped(ld_tp_dxgi(im->fmt), lv, im->n_levels);
+        g_tex_reuse = keep;
+        if (!tex) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "[texpack] %s: the graphics card would not take it (%ux%u)\n", rsx_texpack_name(k), im->w, im->h);
+            rsx_texpack_fail(k);
+            return NULL;
+        }
+        rsx_texpack_set_gpu(k, tex);
+        fresh = 1;
+    }
+    rsx_texpack_note_use(k, fresh);
+    tex->lpVtbl->AddRef(tex);
+    *fmt = (u32)ld_tp_dxgi(im->fmt);
+    u32 s = 0;
+    while (s < 8 && (im->w >> (s + 1)) >= t->width && (im->h >> (s + 1)) >= t->height) s++;
+    *lod = (u8)s;
+    return tex;
+}
+
+/* The texture cache's decode, or the texture pack's file for it. Sets e's texture-pack fields when
+ * it returns a texture (e may be the cache entry being refreshed: a returned texture that is e->tex
+ * already comes without an extra reference, like a decode written in place). */
+static ID3D12Resource* ld_tp_decode(texcache_t* e, const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u32 remap)
+{
+    if (!(g_texpack_dump | g_texpack_replace))
+        return decode_guest_texture_profiled(t, remap);
+    /* A texture rewritten frame after frame (movie planes, the menus' animated backgrounds, lighting
+     * the CPU makes) is neither dumped nor replaced, so it isn't hashed either: once it has come
+     * back within 8 frames twice in a row, it waits until it has settled (ld_tp_hit). */
+    e->tp_quick = (u8)((e->tp_frame && g_ld_frames - e->tp_frame < 8) ? (e->tp_quick < 255 ? e->tp_quick + 1 : 255) : 0);
+    if (e->tp_quick >= 2) {
+        ID3D12Resource* r = decode_guest_texture_profiled(t, remap);
+        if (r) {
+            e->tp_id = 0; e->tp_frame = g_ld_frames; e->tp_dump = 0; e->tp_late = 1;
+            e->repl_fmt = 0; e->repl_lod = 0; e->repl_wait = 0;
+        }
+        return r;
+    }
+    e->tp_late = 0;
+    const u64 id = ld_tp_ident(t);
+    u32 wait = 0;
+    if (id && g_texpack_replace) {
+        const int k = rsx_texpack_find(id);
+        if (k >= 0) {
+            u32 fmt = 0; u8 lod = 0;
+            ID3D12Resource* rep = ld_tp_take(k, t, &fmt, &lod);
+            if (rep) {
+                if (rep == e->tex) rep->lpVtbl->Release(rep);
+                e->tp_id = id; e->tp_frame = g_ld_frames; e->tp_dump = 0;
+                e->repl_fmt = fmt; e->repl_lod = lod; e->repl_wait = 0;
+                ld_tp_log_use(k, t);
+                return rep;
+            }
+            if (rsx_texpack_poll(k) == 0) wait = (u32)k + 1;   /* the game's own until the file is loaded */
+        }
+    }
+    ID3D12Resource* r = decode_guest_texture_profiled(t, remap);
+    if (r) {
+        e->tp_id = id; e->tp_frame = g_ld_frames;
+        e->tp_dump = (u8)(g_texpack_dump && id && !rsx_texpack_dumped(id));
+        e->repl_fmt = 0; e->repl_lod = 0; e->repl_wait = wait;
+    }
+    return r;
+}
+
+/* Hand the texture's top level to the dump: DXT blocks as they are, anything else as the RGBA the
+ * decode makes of it (after the remap). */
+static void ld_tp_dump(const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u64 id, u32 remap)
+{
+    u32 row, rows, pitch, block, texel;
+    const u8* src = ld_tp_top(t, &row, &rows, &pitch, &block, &texel);
+    if (!src || (t->width < 8 && t->height < 8)) return;   /* nothing to paint on a dot */
+    { /* nor on one that is all zeros: a slot not filled yet, whose name every empty slot of its size shares */
+      u32 y = 0, nz = 0;
+      for (; y < rows && !nz; y++)
+          for (u32 x = 0; x < row; x++) if (src[(size_t)y * pitch + x]) { nz = 1; break; }
+      if (!nz) return; }
+    const int rect = (t->format & TEX_FMT_UNNORM) != 0;
+    const u32 base = t->format & TEX_FMT_BASE_MASK;
+    if (block) {
+        rsx_texpack_dump(id, base == TEX_FMT_DXT1 ? TP_FMT_BC1 : base == TEX_FMT_DXT23 ? TP_FMT_BC2 : TP_FMT_BC3,
+                         t->format, rect, t->width, t->height, src, row * rows);
+        return;
+    }
+    const u32 w = t->width, h = t->height;
+    u8* rgba = (u8*)malloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
+    if (!rgba) return;
+    const int linear = (t->format & TEX_FMT_LINEAR) != 0;
+    const u32 lw = log2_u32(w), lh = log2_u32(h);
+    for (u32 y = 0; y < h; y++)
+        for (u32 x = 0; x < w; x++) {
+            const u8* p = linear ? src + (size_t)y * pitch + (size_t)x * texel
+                                 : src + (size_t)morton_index(x, y, lw, lh) * texel;
+            decode_texel(base, p, remap, rgba + ((size_t)y * w + x) * 4);
+        }
+    rsx_texpack_dump(id, TP_FMT_RGBA8, t->format, rect, w, h, rgba, w * h * 4);
+    free(rgba);
+}
+
+/* A cache hit while a replacement file loads or a dump waits. The dump waits until the texture has
+ * stayed the same for 20 frames, so what the game rewrites all the time (render-to-texture done by
+ * the CPU, movies) is never written. */
+static void ld_tp_hit(texcache_t* e, u32 index, const rsx_dsp_texture* t)
+{
+    if (e->tp_late) {
+        if (g_ld_frames - e->tp_frame < 20) return;
+        /* It kept changing, and has now held still for 20 frames: what it shows now gets its name. */
+        e->tp_late = 0; e->tp_quick = 0;
+        e->tp_id = ld_tp_ident(t);
+        if (!e->tp_id) return;
+        const int k = g_texpack_replace ? rsx_texpack_find(e->tp_id) : -1;
+        if (k >= 0) {
+            u32 fmt = 0; u8 lod = 0;
+            ID3D12Resource* rep = ld_tp_take(k, t, &fmt, &lod);
+            if (rep) {
+                ID3D12Resource* old = e->tex;
+                e->tex = rep; e->repl_fmt = fmt; e->repl_lod = lod;
+                write_texture_srv(index, e);
+                retire_texture(old);
+                ld_tp_log_use(k, t);
+            } else if (rsx_texpack_poll(k) == 0) {
+                e->repl_wait = (u32)k + 1;
+            }
+            return;
+        }
+        if (g_texpack_dump && !rsx_texpack_dumped(e->tp_id)) ld_tp_dump(t, e->tp_id, e->remap);
+        return;
+    }
+    if (e->repl_wait) {
+        const int k = (int)e->repl_wait - 1;
+        const int st = rsx_texpack_poll(k);
+        if (st < 0) e->repl_wait = 0;
+        else if (st > 0) {
+            e->repl_wait = 0;
+            u32 fmt = 0; u8 lod = 0;
+            /* Only while it still holds what was looked up; a change since gets decoded anew. */
+            ID3D12Resource* rep = ld_tp_ident(t) == e->tp_id ? ld_tp_take(k, t, &fmt, &lod) : NULL;
+            if (rep) {
+                ID3D12Resource* old = e->tex;
+                e->tex = rep; e->repl_fmt = fmt; e->repl_lod = lod; e->tp_dump = 0;
+                write_texture_srv(index, e);
+                retire_texture(old);
+                ld_tp_log_use(k, t);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    if (e->tp_dump && g_ld_frames - e->tp_frame >= 20) {
+        e->tp_dump = 0;
+        if (!rsx_texpack_dumped(e->tp_id) && ld_tp_ident(t) == e->tp_id) ld_tp_dump(t, e->tp_id, e->remap);
+    }
+}
+
+/* After a bind: a replacement with more levels than the game's texture needs a sampler whose level
+ * limits move down by as many (sampler_slot reads them from key bits 42-45). */
+static void ld_tp_sampler(u32 slot, const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u32* smp)
+{
+    if (slot < SRV_TEXTURE_BASE || slot >= SRV_TEXTURE_BASE + MAX_TEXTURES) return;
+    const texcache_t* e = &g.textures[slot - SRV_TEXTURE_BASE];
+    if (e->repl_lod) *smp = sampler_slot(t, sampler_key(t) | ((u64)e->repl_lod << 42));
+}
+
 /* Decode a guest texture descriptor into a cached SRV slot.  Unlike the old
  * descriptor-only cache, re-hash the source once per frame and refresh the
  * D3D resource when the game rewrites the same guest address. */
+/* Hashing every byte of every big texture each frame took time from the frame for textures that
+ * almost never change. A big one is sampled each frame (64 bytes every 4 KB), so a picture that
+ * changes everywhere, like a movie, is still caught at once; the full hash runs when the sample
+ * moves, and every 8th frame in case a small part changed. LD_TEX_PROBE=0 turns it off.
+ * "Every 8th frame" (tl5) is now 8 frames after its last full hash: it was the frames where
+ * (frame + cache index) % 8 == 0, so a texture bound only on frames that never matched (every other frame with
+ * the other parity, say) was never hashed in full, and a change between the probe's samples stayed unseen for
+ * good. Project Tourline 5 found such stale textures in a GT5 race (a car's damage map, small lighting cubes) and
+ * hashes held textures in full by age (texture-slots-stale.patch, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Ned Heller /
+ * sp00nznet). New entries start staggered as before, so the full hashes still spread over the frames.
+ * LD_TEX_PROBE_AGE=0: the old phase rule. */
+static int ld_tex_probe_age(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* v = getenv("LD_TEX_PROBE_AGE"); on = !(v && v[0] == '0'); }
+    return on;
+}
+static int texture_probe_skip(texcache_t* e, const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u32 index)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* v = getenv("LD_TEX_PROBE"); on = !v || atoi(v) != 0; }
+    if (!on) return 0;
+    const u32 span = texture_source_span(t);
+    if (span <= 64u * 1024u) return 0;
+    const u8* src = guest_ptr(t->location, t->offset, span);
+    if (!src) return 0;
+    u64 h = 1469598103934665603ull;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i + 64u <= span; i += 4096u)
+        for (u32 w = 0; w < 8u; w++) {
+            u64 word;
+            memcpy(&word, src + i + w * 8u, sizeof(word));
+            h ^= word;
+            h *= 1099511628211ull;
+        }
+    const int same = h == e->probe;
+    e->probe = h;
+    if (same && (ld_tex_probe_age() ? g_ld_frames - e->full_frame < 8u : ((g_ld_frames + index) & 7u) != 0u)) {
+        e->last_hash_frame = g_ld_frames;
+        return 1;
+    }
+    return 0;
+}
+
+static int ld_tex_pages_unwritten(texcache_t* entry, const rsx_dsp_texture* t);
+unsigned long long g_tex_page_skip_pub, g_tex_page_look_pub;
+#define g_tex_page_skip g_tex_page_skip_pub
+#define g_tex_page_look g_tex_page_look_pub
+/* LD_TEX_INDEX (on; 0 = the scan in texture_srv_slot alone, as before): the texture cache by its
+ * whole key. A bind whose texture was not where the hint pointed scanned the cache from there, up to
+ * all of its thousands of entries, and a new texture always scanned all of them. The entry the index
+ * gives is the one the scan finds: the cache never holds two entries with one key (an entry is only
+ * made after a miss), the index is told of every entry made or replaced (texture_srv_slot is the only
+ * place that writes a key), and a found entry is checked field by field. Which entry a full cache
+ * gives up is unchanged (the scan for the least recently used stays). Open addressing at a quarter
+ * full at most, with removal by shifting the run back. Walker thread only. */
+#define LD_TEX_IX_SLOTS (MAX_TEXTURES * 4u)   /* a power of two */
+static u32 s_tex_ix[LD_TEX_IX_SLOTS];          /* entry + 1, 0 = empty */
+static u32 s_tex_ix_h[MAX_TEXTURES];           /* each entry's key hash, for finding it to remove it */
+static int s_tex_ix_on = -1;
+static u32 ld_tex_ix_hash(const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u32 remap, u32 vd)
+{
+    u64 a = ((u64)t->offset << 32) ^ ((u64)t->location << 28) ^ ((u64)t->format << 16) ^ remap;
+    const u64 b = ((u64)t->width << 48) ^ ((u64)t->height << 32) ^ ((u64)t->pitch << 8) ^
+                  ((u64)t->cubemap << 7) ^ vd;
+    a = (a ^ (b * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull)) * 0xD6E8FEB86659FD93ull;
+    return (u32)(a ^ (a >> 32));
+}
+static int ld_tex_ix_find(const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u32 remap, u32 vd, u32 hk)
+{
+    for (u32 s = hk & (LD_TEX_IX_SLOTS - 1u);; s = (s + 1u) & (LD_TEX_IX_SLOTS - 1u)) {
+        const u32 v = s_tex_ix[s];
+        if (!v) return -1;
+        const texcache_t* e = &g.textures[v - 1u];
+        if (s_tex_ix_h[v - 1u] == hk && v - 1u < g.n_textures &&
+            e->location == t->location && e->offset == t->offset &&
+            e->format == t->format && e->width == t->width &&
+            e->height == t->height && e->pitch == t->pitch &&
+            e->remap == remap && e->cubemap == t->cubemap && e->volume_depth == vd)
+            return (int)(v - 1u);
+    }
+}
+static void ld_tex_ix_put(u32 i, u32 hk)
+{
+    s_tex_ix_h[i] = hk;
+    u32 s = hk & (LD_TEX_IX_SLOTS - 1u);
+    while (s_tex_ix[s]) s = (s + 1u) & (LD_TEX_IX_SLOTS - 1u);
+    s_tex_ix[s] = i + 1u;
+}
+static void ld_tex_ix_del(u32 i)
+{
+    u32 s = s_tex_ix_h[i] & (LD_TEX_IX_SLOTS - 1u);
+    while (s_tex_ix[s] != i + 1u) {
+        if (!s_tex_ix[s]) return;
+        s = (s + 1u) & (LD_TEX_IX_SLOTS - 1u);
+    }
+    /* Close the gap: a later entry of the run moves into it unless its home lies after the gap. */
+    for (u32 j = s;;) {
+        j = (j + 1u) & (LD_TEX_IX_SLOTS - 1u);
+        const u32 v = s_tex_ix[j];
+        if (!v) break;
+        const u32 home = s_tex_ix_h[v - 1u] & (LD_TEX_IX_SLOTS - 1u);
+        if (s <= j ? (home > s && home <= j) : (home > s || home <= j)) continue;
+        s_tex_ix[s] = v;
+        s = j;
+    }
+    s_tex_ix[s] = 0;
+}

+/* LD_SURF_MEMO (on; 0 = scan every time, as before): the answers of the search below, by request.
+ * The search reads only the surfaces' address, format and size and how many there are; the address
+ * and size change only where s_surf_struct_gen is bumped (surface_get_aa, a new surface or an old one
+ * hidden) and the format only with them, so an answer given at the same generation and the same count
+ * is the scan's answer. Several lookups a draw (the target, its other targets, the resolution scale)
+ * over up to 192 surfaces. Walker thread only. */
+#define LD_SURF_MEMO_SLOTS 256u
+static struct { u32 gen, n, loc, off, w, h, fmt, best; } s_surf_memo[LD_SURF_MEMO_SLOTS];
+static int s_surf_memo_on = -1;

+/* The surface a request of this address, size and format lands in, when it exists: surface_get's
+ * search, without creating anything. MAX_SURFACES when a new surface would be made. */
+static u32 surface_find(u32 location, u32 offset, u32 want_w, u32 want_h, DXGI_FORMAT want_fmt)
+{
+    if (s_surf_memo_on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_SURF_MEMO"); s_surf_memo_on = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
+    u32 ms = 0;
+    if (s_surf_memo_on) {
+        const u64 k = (((u64)offset << 32) ^ ((u64)location << 29) ^ ((u64)want_w << 14) ^ want_h ^
+                       ((u64)want_fmt << 40)) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
+        ms = (u32)(k >> 56) & (LD_SURF_MEMO_SLOTS - 1u);
+        const u32 n = g.n_surfaces;
+        if (s_surf_memo[ms].gen == s_surf_struct_gen && s_surf_memo[ms].n == n &&
+            s_surf_memo[ms].loc == location && s_surf_memo[ms].off == offset && s_surf_memo[ms].w == want_w &&
+            s_surf_memo[ms].h == want_h && s_surf_memo[ms].fmt == (u32)want_fmt)
+            return s_surf_memo[ms].best;
+    }
+    u32 best = MAX_SURFACES;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_surfaces; i++) {
+        const surface_t* c = &g.surfaces[i];
+        if (c->location == location && c->offset == offset && c->fmt == want_fmt &&
+            c->w >= want_w && c->h >= want_h &&
+            (best == MAX_SURFACES || (u64)c->w * c->h > (u64)g.surfaces[best].w * g.surfaces[best].h))
+            best = i;
+    }
+    if (s_surf_memo_on) {
+        s_surf_memo[ms].gen = s_surf_struct_gen; s_surf_memo[ms].n = g.n_surfaces;
+        s_surf_memo[ms].loc = location; s_surf_memo[ms].off = offset;
+        s_surf_memo[ms].w = want_w; s_surf_memo[ms].h = want_h; s_surf_memo[ms].fmt = (u32)want_fmt;
+        s_surf_memo[ms].best = best;
+    }
+    return best;
+}

+/* Can this surface hold what the texture reads? Two surfaces can share an address at different
+ * formats. GT5's reflection cube is 256x256 8-bit in some scenes and 128x128 half-float in others,
+ * at the same base, so the first face of the half-float cube has a frozen 8-bit neighbour. Its mip

+ * cars sampling those mips, far away or at their edges, came out with white rims. */
+static int surface_texel_matches(const surface_t* s, u32 tex_format)
+{

+    return tb == (s->fmt == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT ? 8u : 4u);

+/* A cube map whose faces are render targets: on the RSX that is six surfaces at
+ * consecutive offsets read as one texture, so GT5 renders its surroundings into
+ * them for the car paint to reflect. A host SRV can't do that, and binding the
+ * first face as 2D under a TextureCube declaration reads back black and garbage:
+ * the paint's black sides and rainbow sheen. Keep a real cube, recopying a face
+ * only after it has been drawn to. Returns its SRV slot, or -1. */
+typedef struct {
+    u32 location, offset, w, h;
+    ID3D12Resource* tex;
+    u32 mips;
+    u32 wgen[6];
+    int have[6];
+} cube_rt_t;
+static cube_rt_t g_cube_rt[MAX_CUBE_RT];
+
+static int surface_cube_srv(const rsx_dsp_texture* t)
+{
+    /* A pitch-linear face keeps its mip chain in the rows below it, at the same
+     * pitch: GT5 draws them there, 256x256 then 128x128 at row 256 and so on. */
+    u32 mips = 1, rows = t->height;
+    for (u32 mw = t->width, mh = t->height; mips < (t->mipmaps ? t->mipmaps : 1) && mips < 14 && (mw > 1 || mh > 1); mips++) {
+        mw = mw > 1 ? mw >> 1 : 1;
+        mh = mh > 1 ? mh >> 1 : 1;
+        rows += mh;
+    }
+    const u32 stride = ((t->format & TEX_FMT_LINEAR) && t->pitch)
+        ? rows * t->pitch
+        : rsx_texture_cube_face_stride(t->format, t->width, t->height, mips, t->pitch);
+    if (!stride) return -1;
+    surface_t* faces[6] = {0};
+    for (u32 f = 0; f < 6; f++)
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_surfaces; i++) {
+            surface_t* c = &g.surfaces[i];
+            /* Faces are copied texel for texel into the cube: only ones at guest size (ld_rs_pick never
+             * scales a power-of-two target, so that is every face unless LD_RES_MIN was set very low). */
+            if (c->tex && c->location == t->location && c->offset == t->offset + f * stride && c->rs == 1.0f &&
+                c->w >= t->width && c->h >= t->height && surface_texel_matches(c, t->format) &&
+                (!faces[f] || c->last_draw_generation > faces[f]->last_draw_generation))
+                faces[f] = c;
+        }
+    { static int ct = -1; static u32 cf = 0; static u32 cn = 0;
+      if (ct < 0) ct = getenv("LD_CUBE_TRACE") ? 1 : 0;
+      if (ct && t->offset == 0x4D40000u && (g_ld_frames % 150u) < 2u && cf != g_ld_frames && cn++ < 400) {
+          cf = g_ld_frames;
+          fprintf(stderr, "[cube-trace] f%u read %ux%u fmt=%02X mips=%u stride=%X:", g_ld_frames, t->width, t->height, t->format, t->mipmaps, stride);
+          for (u32 f = 0; f < 6; f++) { const surface_t* s = faces[f];
+              if (s) fprintf(stderr, " [%u %X %ux%u fmt=%d gen=%u wgen=%u]", f, s->offset, s->w, s->h, (int)s->fmt, s->last_draw_generation, s->swin_wgen);
+              else fprintf(stderr, " [%u none]", f); }
+          fprintf(stderr, "\n"); } }
+    if (!faces[0]) return -1;
+    cube_rt_t* cube = NULL;
+    u32 index = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < MAX_CUBE_RT; i++) {
+        cube_rt_t* c = &g_cube_rt[i];
+        if (c->tex && c->location == t->location && c->offset == t->offset &&
+            c->w == t->width && c->h == t->height) { cube = c; index = i; break; }
+        if (!c->tex && !cube) { cube = c; index = i; }
+    }
+    if (!cube) return -1;
+    if (!cube->tex) {
+        D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC rd;
+        faces[0]->tex->lpVtbl->GetDesc(faces[0]->tex, &rd);   /* the faces' format */
+        rd.Width = t->width; rd.Height = t->height; rd.Alignment = 0;
+        rd.DepthOrArraySize = 6; rd.MipLevels = (u16)mips;
+        rd.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE;
+        D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp = {0};
+        hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT;
+        if (FAILED(LD_CCR(g.dev, &hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &rd,
+                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, NULL, &IID_ID3D12Resource, (void**)&cube->tex))) {
+            cube->tex = NULL;
+            return -1;
+        }
+        D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC desc = {0};
+        desc.Format = rd.Format;
+        desc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURECUBE;
+        desc.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
+        desc.TextureCube.MipLevels = mips;
+        g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateShaderResourceView(g.dev, cube->tex, &desc, srv_cpu(SRV_CUBE_RT_BASE + index));
+        cube->mips = mips;
+        cube->location = t->location; cube->offset = t->offset;
+        cube->w = t->width; cube->h = t->height;
+        memset(cube->have, 0, sizeof(cube->have));
+        u32 found = 0;
+        for (u32 f = 0; f < 6; f++) found += faces[f] != NULL;
+        fprintf(stderr, "[cube-rt] %u:0x%X %ux%u stride=0x%X faces=%u mips=%u\n", t->location, t->offset,
+                t->width, t->height, stride, found, mips);
+    }
+    for (u32 f = 0; f < 6; f++) {
+        surface_t* face = faces[f];
+        if (!face || (cube->have[f] && cube->wgen[f] == face->swin_wgen)) continue;

+        src_b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE;
+        g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 1, &src_b);
+        u32 mw = t->width, mh = t->height, y = 0;
+        for (u32 m = 0; m < cube->mips; m++) {
+            if (y + mh > face->h) break;   /* this level hasn't been drawn yet */
+            D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER dst_b = {0};
+            dst_b.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
+            dst_b.Transition.pResource = cube->tex;
+            dst_b.Transition.Subresource = f * cube->mips + m;
+            dst_b.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
+            dst_b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST;
+            g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 1, &dst_b);
+            D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION dst = {0}, src = {0};

+            dst.SubresourceIndex = f * cube->mips + m;
+            src.pResource = face->tex;  src.Type = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX;
+            D3D12_BOX box = { 0, y, 0, mw, y + mh, 1 };
+            g.list->lpVtbl->CopyTextureRegion(g.list, &dst, 0, 0, 0, &src, &box);
+            dst_b.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST;
+            dst_b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
+            g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 1, &dst_b);
+            y += mh;
+            mw = mw > 1 ? mw >> 1 : 1;
+            mh = mh > 1 ? mh >> 1 : 1;
+        }
+        src_b.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE;
+        src_b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
+        g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 1, &src_b);
+        cube->have[f] = 1;
+        cube->wgen[f] = face->swin_wgen;
+    }
+    return (int)(SRV_CUBE_RT_BASE + index);

+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * Resolution scale: the filtering draw. Whenever texels have to move between two images that are
+ * not held at the same scale (a scaled surface into an unscaled one or back, a scaled surface into
+ * guest memory, the presented surface into the window), one triangle is drawn over the destination
+ * rect and every destination pixel averages n x n bilinear taps spread evenly over its footprint in
+ * the source. n is the source texels per destination pixel, rounded up (1 when not shrinking, at
+ * most 8): a whole-number reduction is then an exact box filter, 4x4 texels per pixel at 4x, where a
+ * single bilinear tap would read 2x2 of them and alias. One root signature, one pipeline per

+ * -----------------------------------------------------------------------*/

+static ID3D12PipelineState* ld_rs_blit_pso(DXGI_FORMAT fmt)
+{
+    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)

+    /* [fill] [aa3d] Three additions for the step into the window (ld_rs_draw's point = 2), cl a set of
+     * flags: 1 keeps every tap inside the source rect r (LD_FILL shows a part of the frame; outside it
+     * is GT5's black margin); 2 reduces with a tent over +-1 window pixel (2n x 2n bilinear taps,

+     * fold back at up to 0.67 of its amplitude (2x) against 0.29 (aa2\tools\filter_test*.py);

+    pd.pRootSignature = g_rs_blit_rs;
+    pd.VS.pShaderBytecode = vs->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(vs); pd.VS.BytecodeLength = vs->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(vs);
+    pd.PS.pShaderBytecode = ps->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(ps); pd.PS.BytecodeLength = ps->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(ps);
+    pd.BlendState.RenderTarget[0].RenderTargetWriteMask = D3D12_COLOR_WRITE_ENABLE_ALL;
+    pd.SampleMask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
+    pd.RasterizerState.FillMode = D3D12_FILL_MODE_SOLID;
+    pd.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE;
+    pd.RasterizerState.DepthClipEnable = TRUE;
+    pd.PrimitiveTopologyType = D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_TRIANGLE;
+    pd.NumRenderTargets = 1;
+    pd.RTVFormats[0] = fmt;
+    pd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
+    ID3D12PipelineState* pso = NULL;
+    HRESULT hr = g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateGraphicsPipelineState(g.dev, &pd, &IID_ID3D12PipelineState, (void**)&pso);
+    vs->lpVtbl->Release(vs); ps->lpVtbl->Release(ps);
+    if (FAILED(hr)) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[res-scale] filter pipeline for format %u failed hr=0x%08lX\n", (unsigned)fmt, (unsigned long)hr);
+        return NULL;
+    }
+    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
+        if (!g_rs_blit_pso[i].pso) { g_rs_blit_pso[i].fmt = fmt; g_rs_blit_pso[i].pso = pso; break; }
+    return pso;
+}

+/* Draw the part (u0,v0)-(u1,v1) of the texture in SRV slot srv_slot, src_tw x src_th of its texels,
+ * into the rect (dx,dy,dw,dh) of the render target rtv. src_rt: the source when it is a surface in
+ * the RENDER_TARGET state (it is made readable around the draw), else NULL. point: each destination
+ * pixel takes the one source texel under its centre, unfiltered (a readback: the texels may be
+ * packed depth bytes, which must not be averaged). Returns 1 when recorded. */
+static int ld_rs_draw(u32 srv_slot, ID3D12Resource* src_rt, float u0, float v0, float u1, float v1,
+                      float src_tw, float src_th, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtv, DXGI_FORMAT dst_fmt,
+                      float dx, float dy, float dw, float dh, int point)
+{
+    if (!(dw >= 1.0f) || !(dh >= 1.0f)) return 0;
+    ID3D12PipelineState* pso = ld_rs_blit_pso(dst_fmt);
+    if (!pso) return 0;
+    /* The descriptor ring can be exactly full here (a draw makes room before it takes a table; this
+     * is not a draw). Without a table the frame would be presented black, or a readback skipped: make
+     * room as the draw path does, by waiting for everything that reads the ring. */
+    if (g.srv_ring_used >= s_srv_cap) {   /* [draw-calls] the cap: LD_SRV_WRAP */
+        ld_flush(LD_FLUSH_DESCRIPTOR_RING);
+        if (!g.ready) return 0;
+        g.srv_ring_used = 0;
+    }
+    u32 slots[SRV_TABLE_SIZE];
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < SRV_TABLE_SIZE; i++) slots[i] = SRV_WHITE;
+    slots[0] = srv_slot;
+    const D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE table = srv_table(slots);
+    if (!table.ptr) return 0;
+
+    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER b = {0};
+    b.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
+    b.Transition.pResource = src_rt;
+    b.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
+    b.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
+    b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
+    if (src_rt) g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 1, &b);
+
+    ld_set_rts(1, &rtv, FALSE, NULL);
+    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = {g.srv_heap, g.smp_heap};
+    ld_set_heaps(heaps);
+    ld_set_pso(pso);
+    ld_set_rootsig(g_rs_blit_rs);
+    const float rx = fabsf(src_tw) / dw, ry = fabsf(src_th) / dh;
+    const float ratio = rx > ry ? rx : ry;
+    int n = ratio <= 1.001f ? 1 : (int)ceilf(ratio - 0.001f);
+    if (n > 8) n = 8;
+    if (point == 1) n = 0;
+    /* [fill] [aa3d] point = 2, the step into the window (ld_rs_present_draw): while LD_FILL shows a part
+     * of the frame, taps are kept inside it and a magnification takes the cubic filter; a reduction takes
+     * the tent unless LD_RES_DOWN=0 (the box as before). See the shader. */
+    float flags = 0.0f;
+    if (point == 2) {
+        static int down = -1;
+        if (down < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_RES_DOWN"); down = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
+        if (s_fill.on) { flags += 1.0f; if (ratio < 0.999f) n = -1; }
+        else if (ratio < 0.999f && ld_win_fit_on()) n = -1;   /* [win] the cubic for any magnification into the window */
+        if (down && n >= 2 && n <= 4) flags += 2.0f;     /* above 4x: the box (a tent would be 2n x 2n taps) */
+    }
+    const float c[8] = { u0, v0, u1, v1, (u1 - u0) / dw, (v1 - v0) / dh, (float)n, flags };
+    g.list->lpVtbl->SetGraphicsRoot32BitConstants(g.list, 0, 8, c, 0);
+    g.list->lpVtbl->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(g.list, 1, table);
+    const D3D12_VIEWPORT vp = { dx, dy, dw, dh, 0.0f, 1.0f };
+    const D3D12_RECT sc = { (LONG)dx, (LONG)dy, (LONG)(dx + dw), (LONG)(dy + dh) };
+    ld_set_viewports(1, &vp);
+    ld_set_scissors(1, &sc);
+    ld_set_topo(D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
+    g.list->lpVtbl->DrawInstanced(g.list, 3, 1, 0, 0);
+
+    b.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
+    b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
+    if (src_rt) g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 1, &b);
+    return 1;
+}

+/* Guest rect (sx,sy,sw,sh) of surface si into guest rect (dx,dy,dw,dh) of surface di, whatever scale
+ * each is held at. Returns 1 when recorded. */
+static int ld_rs_surface_blit_ex(u32 si, float sx, float sy, float sw, float sh,
+                                 u32 di, u32 dx, u32 dy, u32 dw, u32 dh, int point)
+{
+    surface_t* s = &g.surfaces[si];
+    surface_t* d = &g.surfaces[di];
+    if (si == di || !s->tex || !d->tex || !s->w || !s->h || !dw || !dh) return 0;
+    const LONG x0 = ld_he((LONG)dx, d->rs), y0 = ld_he((LONG)dy, d->rs);
+    const LONG x1 = ld_he((LONG)(dx + dw), d->rs), y1 = ld_he((LONG)(dy + dh), d->rs);
+    if (x1 <= x0 || y1 <= y0) return 0;
+    if (!ld_rs_draw(SRV_SURFACE_BASE + si, s->tex, sx / (float)s->w, sy / (float)s->h,
+                    (sx + sw) / (float)s->w, (sy + sh) / (float)s->h, sw * s->rs, sh * s->rs,
+                    rtv_handle(LD_SWAP_BUFFERS + di), d->fmt,
+                    (float)x0, (float)y0, (float)(x1 - x0), (float)(y1 - y0), point))
+        return 0;
+    ld_surface_note_write(di, LD_SURFACE_WRITE_COPY);
+    { static int n = 0; if (n++ < 8)
+        fprintf(stderr, "[res-scale] blit surf %u x%.3f (%.0f,%.0f %.0fx%.0f) -> surf %u x%.3f (%u,%u %ux%u)%s\n",
+                si, (double)s->rs, (double)sx, (double)sy, (double)sw, (double)sh, di, (double)d->rs, dx, dy, dw, dh,
+                point ? " point" : ""); }
+    return 1;
+}
+static int ld_rs_surface_blit(u32 si, float sx, float sy, float sw, float sh,
+                              u32 di, u32 dx, u32 dy, u32 dw, u32 dh)
+{
+    return ld_rs_surface_blit_ex(si, sx, sy, sw, sh, di, dx, dy, dw, dh, 0);
+}

+/* A 1:1 copy of the guest rect (sx,sy,w,h) of surface si to (dx,dy) of surface di when at least one
+ * of them is held at a resolution scale: a CopyTextureRegion of the scaled rect when both have the
+ * same scale and format, else the filtering draw. Returns 1 when recorded. */
+static int ld_rs_copy(u32 si, u32 sx, u32 sy, u32 di, u32 dx, u32 dy, u32 w, u32 h)
+{
+    surface_t* s = &g.surfaces[si];
+    surface_t* d = &g.surfaces[di];
+    if (si == di || !s->tex || !d->tex) return 0;
+    if (s->rs != d->rs || s->fmt != d->fmt)
+        return ld_rs_surface_blit(si, (float)sx, (float)sy, (float)w, (float)h, di, dx, dy, w, h);
+    const float rs = s->rs;
+    const u32 sfw = ld_hs(s->w, rs), sfh = ld_hs(s->h, rs), dfw = ld_hs(d->w, rs), dfh = ld_hs(d->h, rs);
+    const u32 l = (u32)ld_he((LONG)sx, rs), t = (u32)ld_he((LONG)sy, rs);
+    u32 r = (u32)ld_he((LONG)(sx + w), rs), bt = (u32)ld_he((LONG)(sy + h), rs);
+    const u32 hx = (u32)ld_he((LONG)dx, rs), hy = (u32)ld_he((LONG)dy, rs);
+    if (r > sfw) r = sfw;
+    if (bt > sfh) bt = sfh;
+    if (hx >= dfw || hy >= dfh || l >= r || t >= bt) return 0;
+    if (hx + (r - l) > dfw) r = l + (dfw - hx);
+    if (hy + (bt - t) > dfh) bt = t + (dfh - hy);
+    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER b[2] = {0};
+    for (int q = 0; q < 2; q++) {
+        b[q].Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
+        b[q].Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
+        b[q].Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
+    }
+    b[0].Transition.pResource = s->tex; b[0].Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE;
+    b[1].Transition.pResource = d->tex; b[1].Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 2, b);
+    D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION sl = {0}, dl = {0};
+    sl.pResource = s->tex; sl.Type = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX;
+    dl.pResource = d->tex; dl.Type = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX;
+    D3D12_BOX box = { l, t, 0, r, bt, 1 };
+    g.list->lpVtbl->CopyTextureRegion(g.list, &dl, hx, hy, 0, &sl, &box);
+    g_ldw[LDW_BLIT]++;
+    for (int q = 0; q < 2; q++) {
+        b[q].Transition.StateBefore = b[q].Transition.StateAfter;
+        b[q].Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
+    }
+    g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 2, b);
+    ld_surface_note_write(di, LD_SURFACE_WRITE_COPY);
+    return 1;
+}

-/* Returns DSV slot 1+i. Slot 0 is the legacy shared depth fallback. */
-static u32 zdepth_get(u32 location, u32 offset, u32 rt_w, u32 rt_h)
+/* What a texture over a zeta's memory reads of it. */
+#define LD_ZREAD_DEPTH   1u
+#define LD_ZREAD_STENCIL 2u
+/* A zeta read as a colour texture sees the packed D24S8 bytes: depth in A, R, G and stencil in B (see
+ * stencil_snapshot, whose view takes its channels from the same remap fields). Which of the two the
+ * texture's remap takes from memory: a channel whose op is ZERO or ONE reads nothing. Both when it
+ * cannot be told. */
+static u32 ld_zread_of_remap(u32 remap)
+{
+    u32 what = 0;
+    for (u32 comp = 0; comp < 4u; comp++) {
+        if (((remap >> (8u + comp * 2u)) & 3u) < 2u) continue;
+        what |= ((remap >> (comp * 2u)) & 3u) == 3u ? LD_ZREAD_STENCIL : LD_ZREAD_DEPTH;
+    }
+    return what ? what : (LD_ZREAD_DEPTH | LD_ZREAD_STENCIL);
+}
+/* How new the part of a zeta entry a read is after is. Depth: when the entry last got depth (a
+ * depth-writing pass, an import, a resolved snapshot), 0 when it holds none. Stencil: its last
+ * stencil-writing draw since a stencil clear (GT5's text: glyph polygons invert stencil bits and a
+ * later draw reads them back as colour; that draw can be under another target, at another scale,
+ * than the glyphs were, and with that same zeta bound, so "the entry bound now" is not the answer.
+ * That was the first rule here; the race's driver names, which GT5 composes off screen, came out
+ * empty at 2x, and this is the likeliest reason, not a proven one). */
+static u32 ld_zdepth_age(const zdepth_t* z, u32 what)
+{
+    const u32 depth = (what & LD_ZREAD_DEPTH) && (z->had_write || z->snapshot_valid) ? z->content_generation + 1u : 0u;
+    const u32 stencil = (what & LD_ZREAD_STENCIL) ? z->stencil_generation : 0u;
+    return stencil > depth ? stencil : depth;
+}
+/* Of the entries a zeta address has (one per resolution scale it is drawn at, so nearly always one),
+ * is entry i the one a texture bound to that address reads? The one with the newest of what the read
+ * is after (what: LD_ZREAD_*); between equals the entry bound as the zeta of the draw being set up
+ * (current_zslot), then the oldest entry. */
+static int ld_zdepth_reads(u32 i, u32 what, u32 current_zslot)
+{
+    const zdepth_t* z = &g.zdepths[i];
+    const u32 mine = ld_zdepth_age(z, what);
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < g.n_zdepths; k++) {
+        const zdepth_t* o = &g.zdepths[k];
+        if (k == i || o->location != z->location || o->offset != z->offset) continue;
+        const u32 theirs = ld_zdepth_age(o, what);
+        if (theirs > mine) return 0;
+        if (theirs == mine) {
+            if (current_zslot && current_zslot - 1u == k) return 0;
+            if (!(current_zslot && current_zslot - 1u == i) && k < i) return 0;
+        }
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* While a scale is in force: each distinct way a zeta is read as a colour texture (GT5's text, its
+ * depth readers), once, up to 32 lines. What the read is after, which entry it gets, and every entry
+ * of that address with its scale, guest size and the age of its depth and stencil: the line says at
+ * once when a read went to an entry that does not hold what it wants, or to one smaller than the
+ * texture (the read is then squeezed). */
+static void ld_rs_log_zeta_read(u32 i, const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u32 current_zslot)
+{
+    static struct { u32 i, tw, th, zw, zh, remap; float rs; } seen[32];
+    static u32 n;
+    const zdepth_t* z = &g.zdepths[i];
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < n; k++)
+        if (seen[k].i == i && seen[k].tw == t->width && seen[k].th == t->height && seen[k].zw == z->w &&
+            seen[k].zh == z->h && seen[k].remap == t->remap && seen[k].rs == z->rs) return;
+    if (n == 32u) return;
+    seen[n].i = i; seen[n].tw = t->width; seen[n].th = t->height; seen[n].zw = z->w; seen[n].zh = z->h;
+    seen[n].remap = t->remap; seen[n].rs = z->rs;
+    n++;
+    const u32 what = ld_zread_of_remap(t->remap);
+    fprintf(stderr, "[res-scale] zeta read as colour: texture %u:0x%X %ux%u remap=0x%X (%s) -> entry #%u%s; "
+                    "bound zeta #%d; frame %u; entries:",
+            t->location, t->offset, t->width, t->height, t->remap,
+            what == LD_ZREAD_STENCIL ? "stencil" : what == LD_ZREAD_DEPTH ? "depth" : "depth+stencil", i,
+            (t->width > z->w || t->height > z->h) ? " (SMALLER than the texture: squeezed)" : "",
+            (int)current_zslot - 1, g_ld_frames);
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < g.n_zdepths; k++) {
+        const zdepth_t* o = &g.zdepths[k];
+        if (!o->tex || o->location != z->location || o->offset != z->offset) continue;
+        fprintf(stderr, " [#%u x%.3f %ux%u depth@%u stencil@%u]", k, (double)o->rs, o->w, o->h,
+                ld_zdepth_age(o, LD_ZREAD_DEPTH), ld_zdepth_age(o, LD_ZREAD_STENCIL));
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "\n");
+}
+
+/* While a scale is in force: every distinct pass (colour target, clip, colour written or not, zeta
+ * entry, the scale it runs at), once, up to 96 lines, then nothing more is looked at. The list a
+ * report of a missing or misplaced element is read against: which passes run scaled, which at guest
+ * size, and which zeta entry each takes. LD_RES_PASSLOG=0: off. */
+static int g_rs_passlog = 1;
+static void ld_rs_log_pass(const rsx_dsp_surface* sf, u32 target, float trs, u32 zslot, int writes_colour)
+{
+    static struct { u32 target, cw, ch, zoff, zslot; float trs; int col; } seen[96];
+    static u32 n;
+    if (!g_rs_passlog || n == 96u) return;
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < n; k++)
+        if (seen[k].target == target && seen[k].cw == sf->clip_w && seen[k].ch == sf->clip_h &&
+            seen[k].zoff == sf->zeta_offset && seen[k].zslot == zslot && seen[k].trs == trs &&
+            seen[k].col == writes_colour) return;
+    seen[n].target = target; seen[n].cw = sf->clip_w; seen[n].ch = sf->clip_h; seen[n].zoff = sf->zeta_offset;
+    seen[n].zslot = zslot; seen[n].trs = trs; seen[n].col = writes_colour;
+    n++;
+    const surface_t* s = &g.surfaces[target];
+    fprintf(stderr, "[res-scale] pass: colour %u:0x%X -> surface %u (%ux%u x%.3f), clip %ux%u grid %ux%u, %s, "
+                    "runs at x%.3f; zeta %u:0x%X entry #%d",
+            sf->color_location[0], sf->color_offset[0], target, s->w, s->h, (double)s->rs, sf->clip_w, sf->clip_h,
+            sf->aa_sx, sf->aa_sy, writes_colour ? "colour written" : "no colour written", (double)trs,
+            sf->zeta_location, sf->zeta_offset, (int)zslot - 1);
+    if (zslot) fprintf(stderr, " x%.3f %ux%u", (double)g.zdepths[zslot - 1u].rs, g.zdepths[zslot - 1u].w,
+                       g.zdepths[zslot - 1u].h);
+    fprintf(stderr, "; frame %u%s\n", g_ld_frames, n == 96u ? " (last pass line)" : "");
+}
+
+/* ---- [shadow2] Shadow maps above the PS3's resolution (LD_SHADOWS) ------------------------------------
+ * The setting: "standard" = as the PS3 draws it, nothing here runs; "" (default) or "high" = 2x per axis
+ * with the soft filter; "ultra" = 4x per axis with the soft filter. Followed live, applied at a flip.
+ *
+ * Which zetas are shadow maps, by rule and not by address: a zeta a fragment program reads as a DEPTH16 or
+ * DEPTH24 texture with the depth compare on (rsx_fp_shadow_desc enabled == 1: 2D, one level, a compare
+ * function other than never / always), with normalized coordinates, through a texture exactly the size
+ * its passes drew (its snapshot extent), at least 64 x 64. Found during a frame, it is drawn at the scale
+ * from the next flip on (a frame's casters all at one scale). In GT5 that is the sun's 1024x2048 DEPTH16
+ * map at 0x5380000 (three cascades), and nothing else seen so far (LD_SHADOW_LOG runs: no other depth
+ * texture is read with a compare).
+ * Never scaled, and the reason printed once ("[shadow-scale] ... stays at guest size: ..."):
+ *   - a zeta a colour-writing draw depth- or stencil-tests against (a scene's depth: a title that PCFs
+ *     its own scene depth for soft particles or SSAO; those follow the render resolution instead);
+ *   - a compare read with texel (unnormalized) coordinates: the compare helper divides them by the bound
+ *     resource's size, which is the host size;
+ *   - a read through a texture of another size than the passes drew, or as colour (the D24S8 bytes);
+ *   - a pass into it with an antialiasing sample grid; a map whose larger entry cannot be made (memory).
+ * Raw depth reads (compare off) of a scaled map need nothing: normalized ones sample the larger snapshot
+ * in place, unnormalized ones divide by the guest size (get_pso's unnorm_dim).
+ * What changes for a scaled map's passes (ld_rs_pass gives them the map's scale): viewport, scissor and
+ * clear rectangles at that scale (as for a scaled colour target), WPOS divided back, polygon offset's
+ * slope part times the scale (its constant part is depth, unchanged), a zeta entry of its own as large as
+ * the passes' largest clip times the scale (not padded to the frame: 4 x 1920 is past the texture limit),
+ * and no colour target bound (null views: the guest's colour target, at guest size, would otherwise cut
+ * the larger pass down to its own size on hardware that renders the intersection of the attachments).
+ * Readers then take that entry (ld_zdepth_reads: the newest depth), its snapshot at the host size; the
+ * sampler (border colour, clamp) is the same in normalized coordinates. Depth is the host's D32F at any
+ * scale, as it always was here: a DEPTH16 map was never stored at 16 bits on the PC, so its compares were
+ * never less precise than the PS3's.
+ * Size: 2x = 2048x4096 (D32S8 64 MB + snapshot 32 MB), 4x = 4096x8192 (256 + 128 MB); a map that would be
+ * larger than LD_SM_MAX_TEXELS or 16384 on a side gets the largest scale that fits.
+ * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
+#define LD_SM_MAX_MAPS   8
+#define LD_SM_MAX_TEXELS (4096ull * 8192ull)
+enum { LD_SM_FREE = 0, LD_SM_FOUND, LD_SM_ACTIVE, LD_SM_VETO };
+typedef struct {
+    u32 loc, off;
+    u32 w, h;            /* guest extent its passes draw (= the texture's size) */
+    float scale;         /* what its passes run at while active */
+    u8 state, fmt, func, unit;
+    u32 frame;           /* found at */
+} ld_sm_map;
+static struct {
+    ld_sm_map map[LD_SM_MAX_MAPS];
+    u32 n;
+    int level;           /* 0 standard, 1 high, 2 ultra */
+    float want;          /* the scale the setting asks for: 1, 2, 4 */
+    int release;         /* entries at a scale no longer used may be left: look at the next flip */
+    u32 logs;
+    unsigned gen; int have_gen;   /* the settings generation last read */
+} s_sm = { .want = 1.0f };
+static ID3D12DescriptorHeap* s_sm_null_heap;
+static D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE s_sm_null_rtv[2];   /* R8G8B8A8_UNORM, R16G16B16A16_FLOAT */
+
+static ld_sm_map* ld_sm_find(u32 loc, u32 off)
+{
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_sm.n; i++)
+        if (s_sm.map[i].state != LD_SM_FREE && s_sm.map[i].loc == loc && s_sm.map[i].off == off) return &s_sm.map[i];
+    return NULL;
+}
+static float ld_sm_pass_scale(const rsx_dsp_surface* sf)
+{
+    if (!g_sm_on) return 0.0f;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_sm.n; i++) {
+        const ld_sm_map* m = &s_sm.map[i];
+        if (m->state == LD_SM_ACTIVE && m->loc == sf->zeta_location && m->off == sf->zeta_offset)
+            return m->scale > 1.0f ? m->scale : 0.0f;
+    }
+    return 0.0f;
+}
+/* A read of loc:off goes through the soft filter (get_pso). */
+static int ld_sm_soft_at(u32 loc, u32 off)
+{
+    if (!g_sm_on || !g_sm_soft) return 0;
+    const ld_sm_map* m = ld_sm_find(loc, off);
+    return m && m->state == LD_SM_ACTIVE && m->scale > 1.0f;
+}
+/* The scale a read of loc:off finds the map at (1 when it is not a scaled map). */
+static u32 ld_sm_scale_at(u32 loc, u32 off)
+{
+    if (!g_sm_on) return 1u;
+    const ld_sm_map* m = ld_sm_find(loc, off);
+    return m && m->state == LD_SM_ACTIVE && m->scale > 1.0f ? (u32)(m->scale + 0.5f) : 1u;
+}
+/* The largest of want, want/2, ... 1 a w x h map can be drawn at. */
+static float ld_sm_fit(u32 w, u32 h, float want)
+{
+    float s = want;
+    while (s > 1.0f) {
+        const double hw = (double)w * s, hh = (double)h * s;
+        if (hw <= (double)LD_RS_MAX_DIM && hh <= (double)LD_RS_MAX_DIM && hw * hh <= (double)LD_SM_MAX_TEXELS) break;
+        s *= 0.5f;
+    }
+    return s < 1.0f ? 1.0f : s;
+}
+/* At most 24 lines in a run; the format is a literal. */
+#define ld_sm_log(...) do { if (s_sm.logs < 24u) { s_sm.logs++; fprintf(stderr, "[shadow-scale] " __VA_ARGS__); } } while (0)
+static void ld_zeta_extent(const zdepth_t* z, u32* w, u32* h);
+/* loc:off is not a shadow map to scale (see the block above): from now on its passes run at guest size. */
+static void ld_sm_veto(u32 loc, u32 off, const char* why)
+{
+    ld_sm_map* m = ld_sm_find(loc, off);
+    if (m && m->state == LD_SM_VETO) return;
+    if (!m) {
+        if (s_sm.n == LD_SM_MAX_MAPS) return;
+        m = &s_sm.map[s_sm.n++];
+        memset(m, 0, sizeof *m);
+        m->loc = loc; m->off = off;
+    }
+    const int was_active = m->state == LD_SM_ACTIVE && m->scale > 1.0f;
+    m->state = LD_SM_VETO;
+    m->scale = 1.0f;
+    if (was_active) s_sm.release = 1;
+    ld_sm_log("frame %u: zeta %u:0x%X stays at guest size: %s\n", g_ld_frames, loc, off, why);
+}
+/* A draw that writes colour depth- or stencil-tests against zeta entry zi (sink_end_impl). */
+static void ld_sm_colour_pass(u32 zi)
+{
+    zdepth_t* z = &g.zdepths[zi];
+    if (z->sm_colour) return;
+    z->sm_colour = 1;
+    const ld_sm_map* m = ld_sm_find(z->location, z->offset);
+    if (m && m->state != LD_SM_VETO) ld_sm_veto(z->location, z->offset, "a draw that writes colour tests against it");
+}
+/* A texture unit u reads zeta entry zi through texture t (sink_end_impl's texture loop, depth formats;
+ * as_colour: through a colour format, the D24S8 bytes). Finds shadow maps and vetoes the reads the
+ * scale cannot serve. */
+static void ld_sm_note_read(const rsx_dsp_texture* t, u32 zi, u32 unit, int as_colour)
+{
+    if (as_colour) {
+        if (g.zdepths[zi].sm_colour) return;
+        g.zdepths[zi].sm_colour = 1;
+        const ld_sm_map* c = ld_sm_find(t->location, t->offset);
+        if (c && c->state != LD_SM_VETO) ld_sm_veto(t->location, t->offset, "read as a colour texture");
+        return;
+    }
+    if (s_sm.want == 1.0f) return;
+    ld_sm_map* m = ld_sm_find(t->location, t->offset);
+    if (m && m->state == LD_SM_VETO) return;
+    rsx_fp_shadow_desc d;
+    rsx_fp_shadow_desc_from_texture(&d, t->format, t->dimension, t->cubemap, t->mipmaps, t->filter, t->wrap, t->control0);
+    if (d.enabled != 1) return;                    /* not a compare: any scale serves it */
+    if (m && m->state == LD_SM_ACTIVE && t->width == m->w && t->height == m->h)
+        return;                                    /* the usual case, every frame */
+    const char* why = NULL;
+    u32 ew = 0, eh = 0;
+    int colour = 0;
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < g.n_zdepths; k++)
+        if (g.zdepths[k].location == t->location && g.zdepths[k].offset == t->offset && g.zdepths[k].sm_colour) colour = 1;
+    if (m) { ew = m->w; eh = m->h; }
+    else ld_zeta_extent(&g.zdepths[zi], &ew, &eh);
+    /* texel (unnormalized) coordinates are served: the compare helper is told the map's scale (get_pso) */
+    if (colour) why = "used with colour (a draw that writes colour tests against it, or a colour read)";
+    else if (t->width != ew || t->height != eh) why = "read through a texture of another size than drawn";
+    else if (ew < 64u || eh < 64u) why = "smaller than 64 x 64";
+    if (why) {
+        if (m) ld_sm_veto(t->location, t->offset, why);
+        else {
+            static u32 n_skip;   /* not a candidate yet: only said, a few times */
+            if (PS3_LOG_FIRST(n_skip, 8))
+                fprintf(stderr, "[shadow-scale] frame %u: depth compare on zeta %u:0x%X %ux%u (texture %ux%u, unit %u) not "
+                                "scaled: %s\n", g_ld_frames, t->location, t->offset, ew, eh, t->width, t->height, unit, why);
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+    if (m) return;                                 /* found this frame already */
+    if (s_sm.n == LD_SM_MAX_MAPS) return;
+    m = &s_sm.map[s_sm.n++];
+    memset(m, 0, sizeof *m);
+    m->loc = t->location; m->off = t->offset; m->w = ew; m->h = eh; m->scale = 1.0f;
+    m->state = LD_SM_FOUND; m->fmt = (u8)(t->format & TEX_FMT_BASE_MASK); m->func = d.func; m->unit = (u8)unit;
+    m->frame = g_ld_frames;
+    ld_sm_log("frame %u: shadow map found: zeta %u:0x%X %s %ux%u (unit %u, compare %u%s), drawn at x%.0f from the next frame\n",
+              g_ld_frames, m->loc, m->off, (m->fmt & 0x9Fu) == TEX_FMT_DEPTH16 ? "DEPTH16" : "DEPTH24", ew, eh, unit,
+              (unsigned)d.func, d.linear ? ", linear" : "", (double)ld_sm_fit(ew, eh, s_sm.want));
+}
+/* Is zeta entry z one an active map keeps (ld_rs_remake leaves it)? */
+static int ld_sm_keeps(const zdepth_t* z)
+{
+    if (!g_sm_on || z->rs == 1.0f) return 0;
+    const ld_sm_map* m = ld_sm_find(z->location, z->offset);
+    return m && m->state == LD_SM_ACTIVE && m->scale == z->rs;
+}
+/* Null render-target views for a scaled map's passes (no colour written): one per format a pipeline may
+ * name. 0 when they cannot be made (the pass then binds its colour target as before). */
+static int ld_sm_null_rtvs(void)
+{
+    if (s_sm_null_heap) return 1;
+    static int failed;
+    if (failed || !g.dev) return 0;
+    D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC hd = {0};
+    hd.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV;
+    hd.NumDescriptors = 2;
+    if (FAILED(g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateDescriptorHeap(g.dev, &hd, &IID_ID3D12DescriptorHeap, (void**)&s_sm_null_heap))) {
+        s_sm_null_heap = NULL;
+        failed = 1;
+        return 0;
+    }
+    D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE h;
+    s_sm_null_heap->lpVtbl->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(s_sm_null_heap, &h);
+    const UINT step = g.dev->lpVtbl->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(g.dev, D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV);
+    D3D12_RENDER_TARGET_VIEW_DESC rv = {0};
+    rv.ViewDimension = D3D12_RTV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
+    rv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
+    s_sm_null_rtv[0] = h;
+    g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateRenderTargetView(g.dev, NULL, &rv, h);
+    h.ptr += step;
+    rv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
+    s_sm_null_rtv[1] = h;
+    g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateRenderTargetView(g.dev, NULL, &rv, h);
+    return 1;
+}
+static void ld_rs_release_zeta(u32 i)
+{
+    zdepth_t* z = &g.zdepths[i];
+    retire_texture(z->tex);
+    if (z->snapshot) retire_texture(z->snapshot);
+    if (z->stencil_snap) retire_texture(z->stencil_snap);
+    z->tex = NULL; z->snapshot = NULL; z->stencil_snap = NULL;
+    z->location = LD_RS_LOC_DEAD;
+    z->had_write = 0; z->snapshot_valid = 0;
+    g_rs_dead_zetas++;
+}
+/* The setting's level: 0 standard, 1 high (also unset), 2 ultra. */
+static int ld_sm_level_read(void)
+{
+    char v[32];
+    gt5_setting_str("LD_SHADOWS", v, sizeof v);
+    if (!v[0] || !_stricmp(v, "high") || !strcmp(v, "2")) return 1;
+    if (!_stricmp(v, "ultra") || !strcmp(v, "4")) return 2;
+    if (!_stricmp(v, "standard") || !_stricmp(v, "ps3") || !_stricmp(v, "off") || !strcmp(v, "0") || !strcmp(v, "1"))
+        return 0;
+    return 1;
+}
+/* At every flip: the setting, maps found in the frame just ended become active, and the entries of
+ * scales no longer drawn at are released (between two frames, as ld_rs_apply does). */
+static void ld_sm_flip(void)
+{
+    if (!s_sm.have_gen || s_sm.gen != gt5_settings_gen()) {
+        s_sm.have_gen = 1;
+        s_sm.gen = gt5_settings_gen();
+        const int level = ld_sm_level_read();
+        const float want = level == 2 ? 4.0f : level == 1 ? 2.0f : 1.0f;
+        if (want != s_sm.want || level != s_sm.level) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "[shadow-scale] frame %u: Shadows %s (x%.0f%s)\n", g_ld_frames,
+                    level == 2 ? "Ultra" : level == 1 ? "High" : "Standard", (double)want, level ? ", soft" : "");
+            s_sm.level = level;
+            s_sm.want = want;
+        }
+    }
+    int any = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_sm.n; i++) {
+        ld_sm_map* m = &s_sm.map[i];
+        if (m->state == LD_SM_FOUND) m->state = LD_SM_ACTIVE;
+        if (m->state != LD_SM_ACTIVE) continue;
+        const float s = ld_sm_fit(m->w, m->h, s_sm.want);
+        if (s != m->scale) {
+            if (m->scale > 1.0f) s_sm.release = 1;
+            m->scale = s;
+            ld_sm_log("frame %u: zeta %u:0x%X %ux%u drawn at x%.0f = %ux%u\n", g_ld_frames, m->loc, m->off, m->w, m->h,
+                      (double)s, ld_hs(m->w, s), ld_hs(m->h, s));
+        }
+        if (m->scale > 1.0f) any = 1;
+    }
+    g_sm_on = any;
+    g_sm_soft = any && s_sm.level >= 1;
+    g_rs_on = LD_RS_ON_NOW();
+    if (!s_sm.release) return;
+    s_sm.release = 0;
+    /* The entries of scales a map's passes no longer run at. Not one some surface is held at (it may be
+     * a scaled target's: a vetoed map that a scaled pass uses). */
+    u32 n = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_zdepths; i++) {
+        const zdepth_t* z = &g.zdepths[i];
+        if (!z->tex || z->rs == 1.0f || z->location >= LD_RS_LOC_SCRATCH) continue;
+        const ld_sm_map* m = ld_sm_find(z->location, z->offset);
+        if (!m || (m->state == LD_SM_ACTIVE && m->scale == z->rs && g_sm_on)) continue;
+        int used = 0;
+        for (u32 k = 0; k < g.n_surfaces && !used; k++)
+            used = g.surfaces[k].tex && g.surfaces[k].location < LD_RS_LOC_SCRATCH && g.surfaces[k].rs == z->rs;
+        if (used) continue;
+        ld_rs_release_zeta(i);
+        n++;
+    }
+    if (n) fprintf(stderr, "[shadow-scale] frame %u: %u zeta entr%s of an earlier scale released\n", g_ld_frames, n,
+                   n == 1 ? "y" : "ies");
+}
+/* ---- [shadow2] end -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
+
+/* Returns DSV slot 1+i. Slot 0 is the legacy shared depth fallback.
+ * rs: the resolution scale of the colour target this zeta is bound with. The depth resource has to
+ * hold the same pixels as that target, so an address gets one entry per scale: 1.0f is the entry it
+ * always had, and a scaled target's draws and clears take (or make) the entry at their scale. */
+static u32 zdepth_get(u32 location, u32 offset, u32 rt_w, u32 rt_h, float rs)
 {
     if (!honor_zeta_track()) return 0;
     /* The DSV must cover the complete live framebuffer/viewport it is bound
@@ -3713,19 +8433,67 @@
      * backing remains a separate SRV concern. */
     u32 want_w = rt_w > g.width ? rt_w : g.width;
     u32 want_h = rt_h > g.height ? rt_h : g.height;
+    /* What the snapshot has to cover: this clip, as always. */

+/* A zeta whose memory was last written as colour. On RSX a zeta is only memory: GT5's dust, smoke and
+ * gravel pass draws a 256x144 copy of the scene depth as A8R8G8B8 into 0xEAC5000 (the D24S8 bytes:
+ * depth in A,R,G, stencil in B) and then depth-tests its particles against that memory as the zeta.
+ * Our zetas are separate D32S8 resources, so that depth never arrived: the zeta kept its clear (far),
+ * every particle passed, and in the cockpit view the dust of the cars ahead covered the dashboard.
+ * So before a depth-testing draw, a colour surface at the zeta's address and pitch that was drawn
+ * after the zeta last got depth (created, cleared, a depth write, an import) is converted into it.
+ * Depth only: the stencil is kept. LD_ZETA_IMPORT=0: off. */
+static ID3D12PipelineState* g_zimport_pso;
+
+static ID3D12PipelineState* ld_zeta_import_pso(void)
+{
+    static int failed;
+    if (g_zimport_pso || failed) return g_zimport_pso;
+    failed = 1;
+    if (!ld_scaled_blit_pso(DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM)) return NULL;   /* also makes g_sblit_rs */
+    static const char src[] =
+        "Texture2D t0 : register(t0);\n"
+        "float4 vs(uint id : SV_VertexID) : SV_Position {\n"
+        "    float2 q = float2((id << 1) & 2, id & 2);\n"
+        "    return float4(q * float2(2, -2) + float2(-1, 1), 0, 1); }\n"
+        "float ps(float4 p : SV_Position) : SV_Depth {\n"
+        "    uint3 b = (uint3)(t0.Load(int3(p.xy, 0)).arg * 255.0 + 0.5);\n"
+        "    return (float)((b.x << 16) | (b.y << 8) | b.z) / 16777215.0; }\n";
+    ID3DBlob* vs = NULL; ID3DBlob* ps = NULL; ID3DBlob* err = NULL;
+    if (FAILED(D3DCompile(src, sizeof(src) - 1u, "zeta_import", NULL, NULL, "vs", "vs_5_0", 0, 0, &vs, &err)) ||
+        FAILED(D3DCompile(src, sizeof(src) - 1u, "zeta_import", NULL, NULL, "ps", "ps_5_0", 0, 0, &ps, &err))) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[zeta-import] shader compile failed: %s\n",
+                err ? (const char*)err->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(err) : "?");
+        if (err) err->lpVtbl->Release(err);
+        if (vs) vs->lpVtbl->Release(vs);
+        return NULL;
+    }
+    if (err) err->lpVtbl->Release(err);
+    D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pd = {0};
+    pd.pRootSignature = g_sblit_rs;
+    pd.VS.pShaderBytecode = vs->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(vs); pd.VS.BytecodeLength = vs->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(vs);
+    pd.PS.pShaderBytecode = ps->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(ps); pd.PS.BytecodeLength = ps->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(ps);
+    pd.SampleMask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
+    pd.RasterizerState.FillMode = D3D12_FILL_MODE_SOLID;
+    pd.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE;
+    pd.RasterizerState.DepthClipEnable = TRUE;
+    pd.DepthStencilState.DepthEnable = TRUE;
+    pd.DepthStencilState.DepthWriteMask = D3D12_DEPTH_WRITE_MASK_ALL;
+    pd.DepthStencilState.DepthFunc = D3D12_COMPARISON_FUNC_ALWAYS;
+    pd.DSVFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT_S8X24_UINT;
+    pd.PrimitiveTopologyType = D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_TRIANGLE;
+    pd.NumRenderTargets = 0;
+    pd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
+    HRESULT hr = g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateGraphicsPipelineState(g.dev, &pd, &IID_ID3D12PipelineState,
+                                                            (void**)&g_zimport_pso);
+    vs->lpVtbl->Release(vs); ps->lpVtbl->Release(ps);
+    if (FAILED(hr)) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[zeta-import] PSO failed hr=0x%08lX\n", (unsigned long)hr);
+        g_zimport_pso = NULL;
+        return NULL;
+    }
+    failed = 0;
+    return g_zimport_pso;
+}

+static void ld_zeta_import(u32 zslot, u32 zeta_pitch, u32 target)
+{
+#if !defined(YZ_PERF_CLEAN)
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_ZETA_IMPORT"); on = !(e && e[0] == '0'); }
+    if (!on || !zslot || !zeta_pitch) return;
+    zdepth_t* z = &g.zdepths[zslot - 1];
+    if (!z->tex) return;
+    if (z->alias_gen != s_surf_struct_gen || z->alias_pitch != zeta_pitch) {
+        z->alias_gen = s_surf_struct_gen;
+        z->alias_pitch = zeta_pitch;
+        z->n_alias = 0;
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_surfaces && z->n_alias < 4u; i++) {
+            const surface_t* s = &g.surfaces[i];
+            if (s->tex && s->location == z->location && s->offset == z->offset &&
+                s->fmt == DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM && s->pitch == zeta_pitch)
+                z->alias[z->n_alias++] = i;
+        }
+    }
+    int si = -1;
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < z->n_alias; k++) {
+        const surface_t* s = &g.surfaces[z->alias[k]];
+        if (s->tex && s->last_draw_generation > z->content_generation &&
+            (si < 0 || s->last_draw_generation > g.surfaces[si].last_draw_generation))
+            si = (int)z->alias[k];
+    }
+    if (si < 0 || (u32)si == target) return;
+    surface_t* s = &g.surfaces[si];
+    /* The import reads the colour texel under each depth pixel: both at one resolution scale only
+     * (GT5's are particle buffers, never scaled; a mismatch keeps the zeta as it is). */
+    if (s->rs != z->rs) return;
+    ID3D12PipelineState* pso = ld_zeta_import_pso();
+    if (!pso) return;
+    u32 slots[SRV_TABLE_SIZE];
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < SRV_TABLE_SIZE; i++) slots[i] = SRV_WHITE;
+    slots[0] = SRV_SURFACE_BASE + (u32)si;
+    const D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE table = srv_table(slots);
+    if (!table.ptr) return;
+
+    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER b = {0};
+    b.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
+    b.Transition.pResource = s->tex;
+    b.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
+    b.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
+    b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 1, &b);
+
+    const D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE dsv = dsv_handle(zslot);
+    ld_set_rts(0, NULL, FALSE, &dsv);
+    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = {g.srv_heap, g.smp_heap};
+    ld_set_heaps(heaps);
+    ld_set_pso(pso);
+    ld_set_rootsig(g_sblit_rs);
+    g.list->lpVtbl->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(g.list, 1, table);
+    const u32 w = s->w < z->w ? s->w : z->w, h = s->h < z->h ? s->h : z->h;
+    D3D12_VIEWPORT vp = { 0.0f, 0.0f, (float)ld_hs(w, z->rs), (float)ld_hs(h, z->rs), 0.0f, 1.0f };
+    D3D12_RECT sc = { 0, 0, (LONG)ld_hs(w, z->rs), (LONG)ld_hs(h, z->rs) };
+    ld_set_viewports(1, &vp);
+    ld_set_scissors(1, &sc);
+    ld_set_topo(D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
+    g.list->lpVtbl->DrawInstanced(g.list, 3, 1, 0, 0);
+
+    b.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE;
+    b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 1, &b);
+    z->content_generation = ++g_ld_surface_generation;
+    z->had_write = 1;
+    z->snapshot_valid = 0;
+    /* The first import into each zeta (GT5 sizes its particle pass 640x360 down to 256x144 by load). */
+    { static u32 logged[(MAX_SURFACES + 31) / 32];
+      const u32 zi = zslot - 1;
+      if (!(logged[zi / 32] & (1u << (zi % 32)))) {
+          logged[zi / 32] |= 1u << (zi % 32);
+          fprintf(stderr, "[zeta-import] colour surface %d %u:0x%X %ux%u -> zeta #%u (pitch %u), first time\n",
+                  si, s->location, s->offset, w, h, zi, zeta_pitch);
+      } }
+#else
+    (void)zslot; (void)zeta_pitch; (void)target;
+#endif

+/* A title can read its zeta as an ordinary colour texture: on RSX the buffer is
+ * just memory, so A8R8G8B8 at that offset sees the D24S8 bytes with stencil in
+ * B. GT5 draws all its text that way, inverting a stencil bit for each glyph
+ * polygon and then sampling it for coverage. Our zeta is GPU-only and D32S8, so
+ * guest memory there reads as zero and the text comes out invisible. Rebuild the
+ * bytes for each bind, because the next glyph batch changes them. Returns the SRV
+ * slot, or 0 to fall back to guest memory. */
+static u32 stencil_snapshot(u32 i, const rsx_dsp_texture* t)
+{
+    zdepth_t* z = &g.zdepths[i];
+    if (!z->tex || !g.stencil_snapshot_pso || g.srv_ring_used >= s_srv_cap)   /* [draw-calls] LD_SRV_WRAP */
+        return 0;
+    const u32 w = t->width < z->w ? t->width : z->w;
+    const u32 h = t->height < z->h ? t->height : z->h;
+    if (!z->stencil_snap || z->stencil_w != w || z->stencil_h != h) {
+        D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp = {0};
+        hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT;
+        D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC rd = {0};
+        rd.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
+        rd.Width = ld_hs(w, z->rs);      /* the zeta's own texels, at its resolution scale */
+        rd.Height = ld_hs(h, z->rs);
+        rd.DepthOrArraySize = 1;
+        rd.MipLevels = 1;
+        rd.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
+        rd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
+        rd.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
+        ID3D12Resource* snap = NULL;
+        if (FAILED(LD_CCR(
+                g.dev, &hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &rd,
+                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS, NULL,
+                &IID_ID3D12Resource, (void**)&snap)))
+            return 0;
+        if (z->stencil_snap) retire_texture(z->stencil_snap);
+        z->stencil_snap = snap;
+        z->stencil_w = w;
+        z->stencil_h = h;
+        z->stencil_state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS;
+        z->stencil_remap = ~t->remap;   /* forces the SRV write below */
+        srv_write_depth_source(SRV_DEPTH_SOURCE_BASE + i, z->tex);
+        D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC ssd = {0};
+        ssd.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_X32_TYPELESS_G8X24_UINT;
+        ssd.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
+        ssd.Shader4ComponentMapping = D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING;
+        ssd.Texture2D.MipLevels = 1;
+        ssd.Texture2D.PlaneSlice = 1;
+        g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateShaderResourceView(
+            g.dev, z->tex, &ssd, srv_cpu(SRV_STENCIL_SOURCE_BASE + i));
+        D3D12_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC ud = {0};
+        ud.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
+        ud.ViewDimension = D3D12_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
