+/* The whole shader cache in memory, so a race never opens a file. One cached shader cost about 7 ms
+ * to open even on an SSD (10,000 small files; scanning on open, most likely), and a new track wants
+ * hundreds at once: 443 reads were 3.2 s of one 4.2 s frame. A thread reads pack.bin, every entry in
+ * one file, adds any .bin files the pack doesn't have yet (8 readers), and rewrites the pack when it
+ * found some. Until it is done, loads go to the files as before. RSX_SHADER_CACHE_PRELOAD=0 off.
+ * [stall] In two steps now, and no file is opened by a draw meanwhile. pack.bin alone is in use as soon as it
+ * is read (s_shader_mem_ready); the folder's own files (shaders compiled since the pack was last written) are
+ * listed, read and added as a second table afterwards (s_shader_mem2_ready). While the loader runs, a shader
+ * neither table has is compiled on the compile threads, never looked up file by file on the walker: on a slow
+ * or exFAT drive with 30,000+ files in the folder each such open took a large part of a second, the folder
+ * listing itself over a minute while shader-prep wrote its files there, and the walker opening one file per
+ * new shader stopped the game for 18 s at the top menu (D84, 19 Nov). */
+typedef struct { u64 key; const u8* data; u32 size; } shader_mem_entry;
+static shader_mem_entry* s_shader_mem;
+static u32 s_shader_mem_mask;
+static volatile LONG s_shader_mem_ready;
+static shader_mem_entry* s_shader_mem2;        /* [stall] the folder's files the pack lacks, once listed and read */
+static u32 s_shader_mem2_mask;
+static volatile LONG s_shader_mem2_ready;
+static volatile LONG s_shader_mem_loading;     /* [stall] the loader runs: no file lookups by draws */
+static unsigned long long g_ld_shader_disk_early;   /* [stall] lookups that went to the compile threads meanwhile */
+#define SHADER_PACK_MAGIC 0x50535A59u /* "YZSP" */
+
+static u64 shader_mem_key(u32 stage, u64 hash, u32 source_length)
+{
+    const u64 k = hash ^ ((u64)stage << 56) ^ ((u64)source_length * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull);
+    return k ? k : 1u;
+}
+static void shader_mem_put_in(shader_mem_entry* t, u32 mask, u64 key, const u8* data, u32 size)
+{
+    u32 i = (u32)(key ^ (key >> 29)) & mask;
+    while (t[i].key && t[i].key != key) i = (i + 1u) & mask;
+    t[i].key = key; t[i].data = data; t[i].size = size;
+}
+static const shader_mem_entry* shader_mem_get_in(const shader_mem_entry* t, u32 mask, u64 key)
+{
+    if (!t) return NULL;
+    u32 i = (u32)(key ^ (key >> 29)) & mask;
+    while (t[i].key) {
+        if (t[i].key == key) return &t[i];
+        i = (i + 1u) & mask;
+    }
+    return NULL;
+}
+/* Callers look only once s_shader_mem_ready is set; the second table counts once it is published. */
+static const shader_mem_entry* shader_mem_get(u64 key)
+{
+    const shader_mem_entry* e = shader_mem_get_in(s_shader_mem, s_shader_mem_mask, key);
+    if (!e && InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_shader_mem2_ready, 0, 0))
+        e = shader_mem_get_in(s_shader_mem2, s_shader_mem2_mask, key);
+    return e;
+}
+static int shader_mem_entry_key(const u8* d, u32 size, u64* key)
+{
+    shader_disk_cache_header h;
+    if (size < sizeof h) return 0;
+    memcpy(&h, d, sizeof h);
+    if (h.magic != SHADER_DISK_CACHE_MAGIC || h.version != SHADER_DISK_CACHE_VERSION) return 0;
+    if ((u64)sizeof h + h.source_length + h.blob_length != size) return 0;
+    if (!h.blob_length || h.blob_length > SHADER_DISK_CACHE_MAX_BLOB) return 0;
+    *key = shader_mem_key(h.stage, h.source_hash, h.source_length);
+    return 1;
+}
+typedef struct { char name[64]; u8* data; u32 size; } shader_mem_file;
+static shader_mem_file* s_smf;
+static volatile LONG s_smf_next;
+static LONG s_smf_n;
+static DWORD WINAPI shader_mem_reader(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    char path[MAX_PATH];
+    for (;;) {
+        const LONG i = InterlockedIncrement(&s_smf_next) - 1;
+        if (i >= s_smf_n) return 0;
+        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\%s", g_ld_shader_disk_dir, s_smf[i].name);
+        FILE* f = fopen(path, "rb");
+        if (!f) continue;
+        if (fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END) == 0) {
+            const long n = ftell(f);
+            if (n > 0 && n < 8L * 1024L * 1024L && fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET) == 0) {
+                u8* d = (u8*)malloc((size_t)n);
+                if (d && fread(d, 1, (size_t)n, f) == (size_t)n) { s_smf[i].data = d; s_smf[i].size = (u32)n; }
+                else free(d);
+            }
+        }
+        fclose(f);
+    }
+}
+static DWORD WINAPI shader_mem_loader(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    LARGE_INTEGER fq, t0, t1, tp;
+    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&fq); QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
+    char pack_path[MAX_PATH], path[MAX_PATH];
+    snprintf(pack_path, sizeof pack_path, "%s\\pack.bin", g_ld_shader_disk_dir);
+    u8* pack = NULL; size_t pack_n = 0;
+    FILE* f = fopen(pack_path, "rb");
+    if (f) {
+        if (_fseeki64(f, 0, SEEK_END) == 0) {
+            const long long n = _ftelli64(f);
+            if (n > 8 && n < (1ll << 31) && _fseeki64(f, 0, SEEK_SET) == 0) {
+                pack = (u8*)malloc((size_t)n);
+                if (pack && fread(pack, 1, (size_t)n, f) == (size_t)n) pack_n = (size_t)n;
+                else { free(pack); pack = NULL; }
+            }
+        }
+        fclose(f);
+    }
+    u32 pack_count = 0;
+    if (pack_n >= 8) {
+        u32 m; memcpy(&m, pack, 4); memcpy(&pack_count, pack + 4, 4);
+        if (m != SHADER_PACK_MAGIC) pack_count = 0;
+    }
+    /* [stall] Step 1: the pack alone, in use at once. */
+    u32 sz = 1024u;
+    while (sz < 2u * pack_count + 1024u) sz <<= 1;
+    shader_mem_entry* t1e = (shader_mem_entry*)calloc(sz, sizeof *t1e);
+    if (!t1e) { InterlockedExchange(&s_shader_mem_loading, 0); return 0; }
+    u32 in_pack = 0;
+    size_t off = 8;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < pack_count && off + 4 <= pack_n; i++) {
+        u32 size; memcpy(&size, pack + off, 4); off += 4;
+        if (size > pack_n - off) break;
+        u64 key;
+        if (shader_mem_entry_key(pack + off, size, &key)) { shader_mem_put_in(t1e, sz - 1u, key, pack + off, size); in_pack++; }
+        off += size;
+    }
+    s_shader_mem = t1e; s_shader_mem_mask = sz - 1u;
+    InterlockedExchange(&s_shader_mem_ready, 1);
+    QueryPerformanceCounter(&tp);
+    fprintf(stderr, "[shader-disk-cache] pack.bin in memory: %u shaders, %.1f s; the folder's own files follow\n",
+            in_pack, (double)(tp.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart) / (double)fq.QuadPart);
+    /* Step 2: names on disk, the files the pack lacks read by 8 readers, a table of their own. */
+    u32 cap = 0, n_names = 0;
+    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\*_*.bin", g_ld_shader_disk_dir);
+    WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
+    HANDLE fh = FindFirstFileA(path, &fd);
+    if (fh != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
+        do {
+            if (fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) continue;
+            const size_t len = strlen(fd.cFileName);
+            if (len >= 64 || len < 5 || strcmp(fd.cFileName + len - 4, ".bin") != 0) continue;
+            if (n_names == cap) {
+                const u32 nc = cap ? cap * 2u : 4096u;
+                shader_mem_file* g2 = (shader_mem_file*)realloc(s_smf, nc * sizeof *s_smf);
+                if (!g2) break;
+                s_smf = g2; cap = nc;
+            }
+            memset(&s_smf[n_names], 0, sizeof *s_smf);
+            memcpy(s_smf[n_names].name, fd.cFileName, len + 1);
+            n_names++;
+        } while (FindNextFileA(fh, &fd));
+        FindClose(fh);
+    }
+    LONG todo = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < n_names; i++) {
+        char st = 0; unsigned long long h = 0; unsigned len = 0;
+        if (sscanf(s_smf[i].name, "%c_%16llX_%8X.bin", &st, &h, &len) == 3 &&
+            shader_mem_get_in(t1e, sz - 1u, shader_mem_key((u32)(u8)st, (u64)h, len)))
+            continue;
+        s_smf[todo++] = s_smf[i];
+    }
+    s_smf_n = todo; s_smf_next = 0;
+    HANDLE th[8]; int nt = 0;
+    if (todo)
+        for (; nt < 8; nt++) {
+            th[nt] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, shader_mem_reader, NULL, 0, NULL);
+            if (!th[nt]) break;
+            SetThreadPriority(th[nt], THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL);
+        }
+    if (nt) WaitForMultipleObjects((DWORD)nt, th, TRUE, INFINITE);
+    for (int i = 0; i < nt; i++) CloseHandle(th[i]);
+    if (todo && !nt) shader_mem_reader(NULL);
+    u32 sz2 = 1024u;
+    while (sz2 < 2u * (u32)todo + 1024u) sz2 <<= 1;
+    shader_mem_entry* t2e = (shader_mem_entry*)calloc(sz2, sizeof *t2e);
+    u32 added = 0;
+    for (LONG i = 0; i < todo; i++) {
+        u64 key;
+        if (t2e && s_smf[i].data && shader_mem_entry_key(s_smf[i].data, s_smf[i].size, &key) &&
+            !shader_mem_get_in(t1e, sz - 1u, key) && !shader_mem_get_in(t2e, sz2 - 1u, key)) {
+            shader_mem_put_in(t2e, sz2 - 1u, key, s_smf[i].data, s_smf[i].size); added++;
+        } else free(s_smf[i].data);
+    }
+    free(s_smf); s_smf = NULL;
+    if (t2e) {
+        s_shader_mem2 = t2e; s_shader_mem2_mask = sz2 - 1u;
+        InterlockedExchange(&s_shader_mem2_ready, 1);
+    }
+    InterlockedExchange(&s_shader_mem_loading, 0);
+    const u32 total = in_pack + added;
+    int wrote = 0;
+    if (added) {

+        FILE* o = fopen(tmp, "wb");
+        int ok = o != NULL;
+        if (ok) {
+            const u32 m = SHADER_PACK_MAGIC;
+            ok = fwrite(&m, 4, 1, o) == 1 && fwrite(&total, 4, 1, o) == 1;
+            for (int tb = 0; tb < 2 && ok; tb++) {
+                const shader_mem_entry* t = tb ? t2e : t1e;

+                for (u32 i = 0; ok && t && i <= mask; i++)

+                        ok = fwrite(&t[i].size, 4, 1, o) == 1 && fwrite(t[i].data, 1, t[i].size, o) == t[i].size;
+            }
+            ok = (fclose(o) == 0) && ok;
+        }
+        if (ok) ok = MoveFileExA(tmp, pack_path, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING) != 0;
+        if (!ok) DeleteFileA(tmp);
+        wrote = ok;
+    }
+    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t1);
+    fprintf(stderr, "[shader-disk-cache] in memory: %u shaders, %u from pack.bin, %u files added%s, %.1f s "
+                    "(%llu shader lookups went to the compile threads meanwhile)\n",
+            total, in_pack, added, wrote ? ", pack rewritten" : "", (double)(t1.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart) / (double)fq.QuadPart,
+            g_ld_shader_disk_early);

+static ID3DBlob* shader_disk_cache_load_raw(

     u32 stage, const char* source, u32 source_length, u64 hash)
 {
+    const LONGLONG hx0 = hx_now();

+static ID3DBlob* shader_disk_cache_load_raw(
+    u32 stage, const char* source, u32 source_length, u64 hash)
+{
     char path[MAX_PATH];
     const u32 stage_index = shader_disk_cache_stage_index(stage);
+    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_shader_mem_ready, 0, 0)) {
+        const shader_mem_entry* e = shader_mem_get(shader_mem_key(stage, hash, source_length));
+        ID3DBlob* mblob = NULL;
+        if (e && source_length <= 256u * 1024u) {
+            shader_disk_cache_header mh;
+            memcpy(&mh, e->data, sizeof mh);
+            if (mh.stage == stage && mh.source_hash == hash && mh.source_length == source_length &&
+                memcmp(e->data + sizeof mh, source, source_length) == 0 &&
+                SUCCEEDED(D3DCreateBlob(mh.blob_length, &mblob)) && mblob) {
+                memcpy(mblob->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(mblob), e->data + sizeof mh + source_length, mh.blob_length);
+                shader_disk_cache_progress(++g_ld_shader_disk_hits[stage_index]);
+                return mblob;
+            }
+            if (mblob) mblob->lpVtbl->Release(mblob);
+        }
+        /* [prep] Made ahead this session (rsx_shader_prep.inc), with exactly this text. */
+        { ID3DBlob* pb = ld_prep_lookup(stage, source, source_length, hash);
+          if (pb) { shader_disk_cache_progress(++g_ld_shader_disk_hits[stage_index]); return pb; } }
+        /* Not cached: compile it. The files hold nothing the pack and folder scan didn't see. */
+        shader_disk_cache_progress(++g_ld_shader_disk_misses[stage_index]);
+        return NULL;
+    }
+    /* [stall] The loader is still reading the pack: compiled, not looked up file by file on the walker. */
+    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_shader_mem_loading, 0, 0)) {
+        g_ld_shader_disk_early++;
+        shader_disk_cache_progress(++g_ld_shader_disk_misses[stage_index]);
+        return NULL;
+    }
     if (!shader_disk_cache_path(path, stage, hash, source_length))
         return NULL;

+/* Saving a shader is a create, a write and a rename. On a hard disk that is tens of
+ * milliseconds, which the RSX thread would spend for every new shader while a scene
+ * loads, so a thread of its own does them. Anything still queued at exit compiles
+ * again next run. */

+    u32 stage;
+    shader_disk_cache_header header;
+    char path[MAX_PATH], temporary[MAX_PATH];
+    char data[];

+{

+            const u32 stage_index = shader_disk_cache_stage_index(job->stage);
+            const u64 value = ++g_ld_shader_disk_writes[stage_index];
+            shader_disk_cache_progress(value);
+        }
+        free(job);
+    }

+/* Shaders compiled on worker threads. A shader not in the cache takes 25-35 ms to compile, and a
+ * new car or track wants a hundred or more at once: one at a time on this thread, that was a
+ * freeze of seconds (6.6 s at one race start). Now a draw whose pipeline needs a new shader
+ * doesn't wait for it. The compile goes to a pool of threads, the draw names a stand-in for the
+ * pipeline, and the walk carries on to the next draws, whose new shaders compile alongside. The
+ * recording thread (ld_rec_exec) waits for a stand-in only when it reaches it, so the GPU gets
+ * the same commands in the same order as before; only the recording waits, not the walk. A
+ * pipeline whose shaders fail to compile records no draws, as a NULL pipeline always did.
+ * Pipelines whose shaders are all cached went on being built here, about half a millisecond each
+ * in the driver (0.76 ms on the owner's PC), one after the other: the frame a car or a track first
+ * shows built 100-400 of them, 300-370 ms of driver time on this thread alone (his 17 Nov logs:
+ * "new pipelines 402 in 319 ms (driver 309 ...)"). LD_PSO_POOL (on; =0 builds them here as
+ * before) sends those to the pool as well, so they are built side by side while the walk goes on;
+ * the recording thread still waits for each before the draws that use it, so nothing is drawn
+ * later or left out. LD_PSO_AHEAD (below) builds the ones this PC used before at start.
+ * Only with the recording thread (LD_RECORD_THREAD); LD_ASYNC_SHADERS=0 compiles here as before.
+ * [pool2] A pipeline job no longer waits on a pool thread for its shaders: it is queued only once both are
+ * compiled (the shader job that finishes last queues it), so every pool thread compiles or builds. Before,
+ * the job went into the queue behind its shaders and the thread that took it waited there; one vertex shader
+ * serves up to 28 pipelines of a new car or track, and in a replay of such a burst (300 pipelines, 323
+ * shaders, the game's own) up to 9 of the 14 threads sat waiting: 2.3 s, now 1.7 s on the same 14 threads
+ * and 1.3 s on 30 (an idle 32-thread PC; with other programs busy on it 5.0, 3.6 and 2.6 s). */
+typedef struct ld_ctask { struct ld_ctask* next; u32 kind; } ld_ctask;
+enum { LD_CT_SHADER = 1, LD_CT_PSO };
+struct ld_pso_job;
+typedef struct {
+    ld_ctask task;
+    u32 stage, length;
+    u64 hash;
+    char* source;                 /* freed by the walker once the shader is in its cache */
+    ID3DBlob* blob;               /* the compiled shader, kept for the life of the job */
+    volatile LONG done;
+    /* [pool2] pipelines waiting for this shader, in hand-out order (s_cpool_lock's) */
+    struct ld_pso_job* w_head; struct ld_pso_job* w_tail;
+    u8 started, urgent;           /* [nowait] a pool thread took it; moved to the queue's front (s_cpool_lock's) */
+} ld_shader_job;
+typedef struct ld_pso_job {
+    ld_ctask task;
+    ID3DBlob* vs_blob; ID3DBlob* ps_blob;   /* cached ones, or ... */
+    ld_shader_job* vs_job; ld_shader_job* ps_job;   /* ... ones still compiling */
+    struct ld_pso_job* w_next[2];           /* [pool2] next in the vertex [0] / pixel [1] shader's list */
+    u32 deps;                               /* [pool2] its shaders not compiled yet (s_cpool_lock's) */
+    render_state_t rs;
+    u32 masked, count, packed;
+    u8 attrs[RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR];
+    ID3D12PipelineState* pso;
+    volatile LONG done;
+    /* [ahead] What the made-ahead list records of it (vs_len 0: nothing), and for a pipeline made
+     * ahead: who has it (0 waiting, 1 a draw asked for it first, 2 a made-ahead thread took it),
+     * where its shaders are in the in-memory shader pack, and the device it is for. */
+    u64 vs_hash, ps_hash;
+    u32 vs_len, ps_len;
+    u32 note;                     /* 1: the pool notes it in the list once it is built */
+    u32 on_walker;                /* built by the walker itself (counted as the walker's) */
+    u32 taken;                    /* a made-ahead one a draw has used (the walker's alone) */
+    volatile LONG ahead_state;
+    const u8* vs_entry; const u8* ps_entry;
+    ID3D12Device* dev;
+    volatile LONG64 skip_t0;      /* [nowait] when the recording thread first left a draw of it out; -1 once built */
+    struct ld_si* si;             /* [standin] its stand-in (rsx_standin_d3d12.inc), or NULL */
+} ld_pso_job;
+static void ld_si_build(struct ld_si* s);   /* [standin] */

+static SRWLOCK s_cpool_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
+static CONDITION_VARIABLE s_cpool_work = CONDITION_VARIABLE_INIT, s_cpool_done = CONDITION_VARIABLE_INIT;
+static ld_ctask* s_cpool_head;
+static ld_ctask* s_cpool_tail;
+static ld_ctask* s_cpool_ur_last;   /* [nowait] the last of the shaders moved to the queue's front (ld_cpool_promote) */
+static int s_cpool_state = -1;   /* -1 not started, 0 off, 1 running (s_cpool_threads: with g_st) */
+static unsigned long long g_async_shaders, g_async_psos;

+static void ld_cpool_finish(volatile LONG* done)
+{
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+    InterlockedExchange(done, 1);
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+    WakeAllConditionVariable(&s_cpool_done);
+}
+static void ld_cpool_wait(volatile LONG* done)
+{
+    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(done, 0, 0)) return;
+    RSX_FG_WAIT(w);                              /* [fgv3] */
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+    while (!InterlockedCompareExchange(done, 0, 0))
+        SleepConditionVariableSRW(&s_cpool_done, &s_cpool_lock, INFINITE, 0);
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+    rsx_fg_wait_end("renderer: wait for a shader compile", &w);
+}
+static void ld_cpool_push(ld_ctask* t)
+{
+    t->next = NULL;
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+    if (s_cpool_tail) s_cpool_tail->next = t; else s_cpool_head = t;
+    s_cpool_tail = t;
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+    WakeConditionVariable(&s_cpool_work);
+}
+/* [stutter] A pipeline whose shaders are both ready (LD_PSO_POOL, or one taken from the made-ahead list
+ * before its turn): half a millisecond, waiting for nothing, so it goes ahead of the shader compiles
+ * (25-300 ms each) in a queue of its own; the workers take from it first. A job that waits for shaders
+ * stays in the main queue behind them, so a worker never waits for a compile no thread has. */
+static ld_ctask* s_cpool_hi_head;
+static ld_ctask* s_cpool_hi_tail;
+static void ld_cpool_push_hi_locked(ld_ctask* t)   /* s_cpool_lock held */
+{
+    t->next = NULL;
+    if (s_cpool_hi_tail) s_cpool_hi_tail->next = t; else s_cpool_hi_head = t;
+    s_cpool_hi_tail = t;
+}
+static void ld_cpool_push_hi(ld_ctask* t)
+{
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+    ld_cpool_push_hi_locked(t);
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+    WakeConditionVariable(&s_cpool_work);
+}
+/* [pool2] LD_CPOOL_DEPS (on; =0 the pipeline job goes into the queue behind its shaders and the thread that
+ * takes it waits for them, as before: for an A/B). */
+static int ld_cpool_deps_on(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_CPOOL_DEPS"); on = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
+    return on;
+}
+static void ld_cp_max64(volatile LONG64* m, LONG64 v)
+{
+    for (LONG64 p = *m; v > p; p = *m)
+        if (InterlockedCompareExchange64(m, v, p) == p) break;
+}
+
+/* The pipeline description build_pso() and the pool share, so the two can't differ. */
+static void ld_fill_pipeline_desc(D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC* pd, D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC il[16],
+    ID3DBlob* vs, ID3DBlob* ps, const render_state_t* rs,
+    int masked, u32 count, const u8* attrs, int packed_offsets)
+{
+    const u32 input_count = masked ? (count < 16u ? count : 16u) : RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR;
+    for (u32 slot = 0; slot < input_count; slot++) {
+        const u32 attr = masked ? attrs[slot] : slot;
+        D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC e = {
+            "ATTR", attr, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, 0,
+            masked && !packed_offsets ? attr * 16u : slot * 16u,
+            D3D12_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0
+        };
+        il[slot] = e;
+    }
+    memset(pd, 0, sizeof *pd);
+    pd->pRootSignature = g.rootsig_x;
+    pd->VS.pShaderBytecode = vs->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(vs);
+    pd->VS.BytecodeLength = vs->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(vs);
+    pd->PS.pShaderBytecode = ps->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(ps);
+    pd->PS.BytecodeLength = ps->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(ps);
+    pd->InputLayout.pInputElementDescs = input_count ? il : NULL;
+    pd->InputLayout.NumElements = input_count;
+    apply_render_state(pd, rs);
+    pd->SampleMask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
+    pd->PrimitiveTopologyType = D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_TRIANGLE;
+    pd->NumRenderTargets = (rs->rt_count & 0xFFu) ? (rs->rt_count & 0xFFu) : 1;
+    for (u32 r = 0; r < pd->NumRenderTargets; r++)
+        pd->RTVFormats[r] = rs->rt_fp16 ? DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT
+                                        : DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
+    if (rs->rt_count & LD_RT_MV) {
+        /* [mv] The motion-vector target after the colour target (only single-target draws get it):
+         * never blended, and written only by draws that write depth, so that a vector and the depth
+         * beside it are of the same surface. */
+        const u32 k = pd->NumRenderTargets++;
+        pd->RTVFormats[k] = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT;
+        pd->BlendState.IndependentBlendEnable = TRUE;
+        pd->BlendState.RenderTarget[k].BlendEnable = FALSE;
+        pd->BlendState.RenderTarget[k].RenderTargetWriteMask =
+            rs->depth_write ? (D3D12_COLOR_WRITE_ENABLE_RED | D3D12_COLOR_WRITE_ENABLE_GREEN) : 0;
+    }
+    pd->SampleDesc.Count = 1;
+}

+static int ld_prep_adopt(const ld_shader_job* j, ID3DBlob** out);   /* [prep] rsx_shader_prep.inc */
+static void ld_cpool_compile(ld_shader_job* j)
+{
+    static u32 fail_logs = 0;
+    ID3DBlob* blob = NULL;
+    ID3DBlob* err = NULL;
+    LARGE_INTEGER c0, c1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&c0);
+    /* [prep] The same text a made-ahead worker is compiling right now: its result, waited for here on the
+     * pool thread, instead of a second compile (ld_prep_adopt; 0 when there is none). */
+    const int adopted = ld_prep_adopt(j, &blob);
+    const HRESULT hr = adopted ? S_OK : D3DCompile(j->source, j->length, j->stage == 'V' ? "xvs" : "xps", NULL, NULL,
+                                  "main", j->stage == 'V' ? "vs_5_0" : "ps_5_0", 0, 0, &blob, &err);
+    QueryPerformanceCounter(&c1);
+    if (!adopted) {
+        InterlockedAdd64(&s_cp_compile_qpc, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart);
+        InterlockedIncrement64(&s_cp_compile_n);
+        ld_cp_max64(&s_cp_compile_max, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart);
+    }
+    if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && blob) {
+        if (!adopted) shader_disk_cache_store(j->stage, j->source, j->length, j->hash, blob);
+        j->blob = blob;
+    } else {
+        if (PS3_LOG_FIRST(fail_logs, 32))
+            fprintf(stderr, "[pso-fail] %s compile: %.768s\n", j->stage == 'V' ? "vertex" : "pixel",
+                    err ? (const char*)err->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(err) : "no compiler diagnostic");
+        if (blob) blob->lpVtbl->Release(blob);
+    }
+    if (err) err->lpVtbl->Release(err);
+    /* [pool2] Done: the pipelines that waited only for this shader go to the ready queue, in the order
+     * they were handed out. */
+    u32 released = 0;
+    const int k = j->stage == 'V' ? 0 : 1;
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+    InterlockedExchange(&j->done, 1);
+    for (ld_pso_job* p = j->w_head; p;) {
+        ld_pso_job* next = p->w_next[k];
+        p->w_next[k] = NULL;
+        if (p->deps && --p->deps == 0) { ld_cpool_push_hi_locked(&p->task); released++; }
+        p = next;
+    }
+    j->w_head = j->w_tail = NULL;
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+    WakeAllConditionVariable(&s_cpool_done);
+    if (released == 1) WakeConditionVariable(&s_cpool_work);
+    else if (released) WakeAllConditionVariable(&s_cpool_work);
+}
+
+static void ld_cpool_build(ld_pso_job* j)
+{
+    static u32 fail_logs = 0;
+    /* The shaders it waits for were queued before it, so a thread already has each. [pool2] With
+     * LD_CPOOL_DEPS (on) a pool thread only gets a job whose shaders are done; a wait here is counted. */
+    if ((j->vs_job && !InterlockedCompareExchange(&j->vs_job->done, 0, 0)) ||
+        (j->ps_job && !InterlockedCompareExchange(&j->ps_job->done, 0, 0))) {
+        LARGE_INTEGER w0, w1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&w0);
+        if (j->vs_job) ld_cpool_wait(&j->vs_job->done);
+        if (j->ps_job) ld_cpool_wait(&j->ps_job->done);
+        QueryPerformanceCounter(&w1);
+        if (s_cp_tls != TLS_OUT_OF_INDEXES && TlsGetValue(s_cp_tls)) {
+            InterlockedAdd64(&s_cp_parked_qpc, w1.QuadPart - w0.QuadPart);
+            InterlockedIncrement64(&s_cp_parked_n);
+        }
+    }
+    ID3DBlob* vs = j->vs_job ? j->vs_job->blob : j->vs_blob;
+    ID3DBlob* ps = j->ps_job ? j->ps_job->blob : j->ps_blob;
+    ID3D12PipelineState* pso = NULL;
+    if (vs && ps) {
+        D3D12_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC il[16];
+        D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pd;
+        ld_fill_pipeline_desc(&pd, il, vs, ps, &j->rs, (int)j->masked, j->count, j->attrs, (int)j->packed);
+        LARGE_INTEGER c0, c1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&c0);
+        const HRESULT hr = g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateGraphicsPipelineState(
+            g.dev, &pd, &IID_ID3D12PipelineState, (void**)&pso);
+        QueryPerformanceCounter(&c1);
+        if (j->on_walker) g_hx_create += c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart;
+        else if (j->ahead_state == 2) InterlockedAdd64(&g_st.ahead_qpc, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart);
+        else { InterlockedAdd64(&g_st.pool_build_qpc, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart); InterlockedIncrement64(&g_st.pool_build_n); }
+        if (FAILED(hr)) {
+            pso = NULL;
+            if (PS3_LOG_FIRST(fail_logs, 32))
+                fprintf(stderr, "[pso-fail] create hr=0x%08lX (built on a compile thread)\n", (unsigned long)hr);
+        }
+    }
+    if (pso && j->note) ld_ahead_note_job(j);
+    if (j->vs_blob) j->vs_blob->lpVtbl->Release(j->vs_blob);
+    if (j->ps_blob) j->ps_blob->lpVtbl->Release(j->ps_blob);
+    j->vs_blob = j->ps_blob = NULL;
+    j->pso = pso;
+    { const LONG64 t0 = InterlockedExchange64(&j->skip_t0, -1);   /* [nowait] how long its draws were missing */
+      if (t0 > 0) { LARGE_INTEGER t; QueryPerformanceCounter(&t); ld_cp_max64(&s_nw_missing_max, t.QuadPart - t0); } }
+    ld_cpool_finish(&j->done);
+}
+
+static DWORD WINAPI ld_cpool_worker(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    { HRESULT (WINAPI *sd)(HANDLE, PCWSTR) = (HRESULT (WINAPI*)(HANDLE, PCWSTR))
+          (void*)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("kernel32.dll"), "SetThreadDescription");
+      if (sd) sd(GetCurrentThread(), L"rsx shader compile"); }
+    if (s_cp_tls != TLS_OUT_OF_INDEXES) TlsSetValue(s_cp_tls, (LPVOID)1);
+    for (;;) {
+        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+        while (!s_cpool_head && !s_cpool_hi_head)
+            SleepConditionVariableSRW(&s_cpool_work, &s_cpool_lock, INFINITE, 0);
+        ld_ctask* t;
+        if (s_cpool_hi_head) {   /* [stutter] ready pipelines first */
+            t = s_cpool_hi_head;
+            s_cpool_hi_head = t->next;
+            if (!s_cpool_hi_head) s_cpool_hi_tail = NULL;
+        } else {
+            t = s_cpool_head;
+            s_cpool_head = t->next;
+            if (!s_cpool_head) s_cpool_tail = NULL;
+            if (t == s_cpool_ur_last) s_cpool_ur_last = NULL;   /* [nowait] the front run is taken */
+        }
+        if (t->kind == LD_CT_SHADER) ((ld_shader_job*)t)->started = 1;
+        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+        const LONG run = InterlockedIncrement(&s_cp_running);   /* [pool2] for the [stutter] line */
+        for (LONG p = s_cp_peak; run > p; p = s_cp_peak)
+            if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_cp_peak, run, p) == p) break;
+        LARGE_INTEGER b0, b1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&b0);
+        if (t->kind == LD_CT_SHADER) ld_cpool_compile((ld_shader_job*)t);
+        else if (t->kind == 3u || t->kind == 4u) ld_si_build((struct ld_si*)t);   /* [standin] LD_CT_SI / _SIP */
+        else ld_cpool_build((ld_pso_job*)t);
+        QueryPerformanceCounter(&b1);
+        InterlockedAdd64(&s_cp_busy_qpc, b1.QuadPart - b0.QuadPart);
+        InterlockedDecrement(&s_cp_running);
+    }
+}
+
+static int ld_async_shaders(void)
+{
+    if (s_cpool_state >= 0) return s_cpool_state;
+    s_cpool_state = 0;
+    const char* e = getenv("LD_ASYNC_SHADERS");
+    if ((e && atoi(e) == 0) || !s_rec_on) return 0;
+    SYSTEM_INFO si; GetSystemInfo(&si);
+    int n = (int)si.dwNumberOfProcessors - 4;
+    if (n > 8) n = 8;
+    if (n < 2) n = 2;
+    /* LD_CPOOL_WIDE (on; =0 the count above): on a big CPU, half its logical processors, up to 16.
+     * A new car or track hands 100-400 shaders or pipelines to the pool at once and the frame waits
+     * for all of them; 200 of GT5's shaders took 1.21 s on 8 threads and 0.94 s on 16 here
+     * (fxcbench, d3dcompiler_47). The same 8 as before up to 16 logical processors. */
+    /* [pool2] ... now every logical processor this process may use but two (the walker and the recording
+     * thread, which wait for the burst anyway), up to 32: the pool only has work while a frame waits for it,
+     * and then the game waits too. 300 pipelines + 323 new shaders of a new car or track (a replay with the
+     * game's own shaders, cold driver, idle PC): 1.7 s on 14 threads, 1.3 s on 30; on 8 logical processors
+     * the old 4 threads took 7.7 s for a race start's frames, 6 threads 4.7 s. On 4 logical processors 2
+     * threads as before, on 8 six (before four), on 28 twenty-six (before fourteen).
+     * LD_CPOOL_THREADS=<n> sets the count (tests). */
+    { const char* w = getenv("LD_CPOOL_WIDE");
+      if (!(w && atoi(w) == 0)) {
+          int lp = 0;
+          DWORD_PTR pm = 0, sm = 0;
+          if (GetProcessAffinityMask(GetCurrentProcess(), &pm, &sm))
+              for (; pm; pm &= pm - 1) lp++;
+          if (lp <= 0) lp = (int)si.dwNumberOfProcessors;
+          int wide = lp - 2;
+          if (wide > 32) wide = 32;
+          if (wide > n) n = wide;
+      } }
+    { const char* t = getenv("LD_CPOOL_THREADS");
+      if (t && atoi(t) > 0) n = atoi(t) > 64 ? 64 : atoi(t); }
+    if (s_cp_tls == TLS_OUT_OF_INDEXES) s_cp_tls = TlsAlloc();
+    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
+        HANDLE t = CreateThread(NULL, 1u << 20, ld_cpool_worker, NULL, 0, NULL);
+        if (!t) break;
+        CloseHandle(t);
+        s_cpool_threads++;
+    }
+    s_cpool_state = s_cpool_threads ? 1 : 0;
+    if (s_cpool_state)
+        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-async] new shaders compile on %u threads (LD_ASYNC_SHADERS)\n", s_cpool_threads);
+    return s_cpool_state;
+}
+
+/* One shader of a pipeline: 0 with *blob (a reference) when it is ready, 1 with *job while it
+ * compiles (started here if need be), -1 when it can't go to the pool. */
+static int ld_shader_need(u32 stage, shader_blob_cache_t* cache, const char* source, u32 length, u64 hash,
+                          ID3DBlob** blob, ld_shader_job** job)
+{
+    *blob = NULL; *job = NULL;
+    int boundary = 0, seen = 0;
+    if ((*blob = shader_blob_cache_find(cache, source, length, hash, &boundary, &seen)) != NULL) return 0;
+    const u64 key = shader_mem_key(stage, hash, length);
+    u32 i = (u32)(key ^ (key >> 31)) & (LD_PENDING_SLOTS - 1u);
+    for (; s_pending[i].key; i = (i + 1u) & (LD_PENDING_SLOTS - 1u)) {
+        ld_shader_job* j = s_pending[i].job;
+        if (s_pending[i].key != key || !j || j->length != length || memcmp(j->source, source, length) != 0)
+            continue;
+        if (!InterlockedCompareExchange(&j->done, 0, 0)) { *job = j; return 1; }
+        /* Done: into the walker's cache, where later draws find it. */
+        if (j->blob) {
+            shader_blob_cache_insert_accounted(cache, source, length, hash, j->blob, stage, seen);
+            j->blob->lpVtbl->AddRef(j->blob);
+            *blob = j->blob;
+        }
+        free(j->source); j->source = NULL;
+        s_pending[i].job = NULL;
+        if (!*blob) { *job = j; return 1; }   /* it failed: the pipeline fails with it */
+        return 0;
+    }
+    if ((*blob = shader_disk_cache_load(stage, source, length, hash)) != NULL) {
+        shader_blob_cache_insert_accounted(cache, source, length, hash, *blob, stage, seen);
+        return 0;
+    }
+    if (s_pending_n * 4u >= LD_PENDING_SLOTS * 3u) return -1;
+    ld_shader_job* j = (ld_shader_job*)calloc(1, sizeof *j);
+    char* copy = (char*)malloc(length ? length : 1u);
+    if (!j || !copy) { free(j); free(copy); return -1; }
+    memcpy(copy, source, length);
+    j->task.kind = LD_CT_SHADER;
+    j->stage = stage; j->length = length; j->hash = hash; j->source = copy;
+    s_pending[i].key = key; s_pending[i].job = j; s_pending_n++;
+    g_hx_async_n++; g_async_shaders++;
+    ld_cpool_push(&j->task);
+    *job = j;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* A blob's reference count is not safe across threads: d3dcompiler_47's AddRef and Release are a plain
+ * increment and decrement (measured 18 Nov: four threads doing balanced AddRef/Release pairs on one blob
+ * left its count at 4 instead of 2, and runs of the walker-and-pool pattern below ended in
+ * STATUS_HEAP_CORRUPTION, 6 of 6; with the copies, 0 of 46). The shader caches
+ * (g.vs_blobs, g.ps_blobs) hand out the one blob they keep for a shader, and the walker AddRefs and
+ * Releases those blobs for every pipeline it looks up. So a blob a pool job gets is a copy of its own,
+ * which the pool thread may let go; the walker's reference to the shared one is let go here, on the
+ * walker. Before, ld_cpool_build released the shared blob on a compile thread while the walker found the
+ * same shader for the next pipeline: a lost count freed a blob the cache still held, and the next lookup
+ * of that shader read freed memory (D50: shader_blob_cache_find, read of 0x1F at car select). With
+ * LD_PSO_POOL every new pipeline went that way; before it, only those with one shader cached and the
+ * other compiling. On failure (out of memory) *b is left as it was. */
+static int ld_blob_private(ID3DBlob** b)
+{
+    ID3DBlob* copy = NULL;
+    const SIZE_T n = (*b)->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(*b);
+    if (FAILED(D3DCreateBlob(n, &copy)) || !copy) return 0;
+    memcpy(copy->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(copy), (*b)->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(*b), n);
+    (*b)->lpVtbl->Release(*b);
+    *b = copy;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+static void ld_cpool_promote(ld_pso_job* j);
+static int ld_prep_debug_edits(void);
+static int ld_rs_desc_same(const render_state_t* a, const render_state_t* b);
+static int ld_cpool_wait_ms(volatile LONG* done, DWORD ms);
+#include "rsx_standin_d3d12.inc"   /* [standin] .inc, not .c: every .c file in libs/video is built on its own */
+
+/* build_pso(): a stand-in for a pipeline with a shader still to compile, or NULL to build it here. */
+static ID3D12PipelineState* ld_async_build(const char* vs_hlsl, u32 vs_length, u64 vs_hash,
+    const char* ps_hlsl, u32 ps_length, u64 ps_hash, const render_state_t* rs,
+    const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* masked_layout, int packed_offsets)
+{
+    if (!ld_async_shaders()) return NULL;
+    ID3DBlob *vsb = NULL, *psb = NULL;
+    ld_shader_job *vsj = NULL, *psj = NULL;
+    const int v = ld_shader_need('V', &g.vs_blobs, vs_hlsl, vs_length, vs_hash, &vsb, &vsj);
+    const int p = v < 0 ? -1 : ld_shader_need('P', &g.ps_blobs, ps_hlsl, ps_length, ps_hash, &psb, &psj);
+    ld_pso_job* j = NULL;
+    /* Both ready: built here as before, or with LD_PSO_POOL on the pool too. The pool full (or out
+     * of memory): compiled here too, once any shader already compiling for it is done. */
+    const int both_ready = v == 0 && p == 0;
+    if ((both_ready && !ld_pso_pool_on()) || v < 0 || p < 0 || !(j = (ld_pso_job*)calloc(1, sizeof *j))) {
+        if (vsj) ld_cpool_wait(&vsj->done);
+        if (psj) ld_cpool_wait(&psj->done);
+        if (vsb) vsb->lpVtbl->Release(vsb);
+        if (psb) psb->lpVtbl->Release(psb);
+        return NULL;
+    }
+    /* [fix1] The job's blobs are its own: the pool thread releases them (ld_blob_private). */
+    if ((vsb && !ld_blob_private(&vsb)) || (psb && !ld_blob_private(&psb))) {
+        free(j);
+        if (vsj) ld_cpool_wait(&vsj->done);
+        if (psj) ld_cpool_wait(&psj->done);
+        if (vsb) vsb->lpVtbl->Release(vsb);
+        if (psb) psb->lpVtbl->Release(psb);
+        return NULL;
+    }
+    j->task.kind = LD_CT_PSO;
+    j->vs_blob = vsb; j->ps_blob = psb; j->vs_job = vsj; j->ps_job = psj;
+    j->rs = *rs;
+    if (masked_layout) {
+        j->masked = 1u; j->count = masked_layout->count; j->packed = packed_offsets ? 1u : 0u;
+        memcpy(j->attrs, masked_layout->attrs, sizeof j->attrs);
+    }
+    j->vs_hash = vs_hash; j->vs_len = vs_length; j->ps_hash = ps_hash; j->ps_len = ps_length;
+    j->note = 1u;
+    j->si = ld_si_attach(vsb, rs, masked_layout, packed_offsets);   /* [standin] its stand-in: no compile needed */
+    g_async_psos++;
+    g_st.pool_pso_n++;
+    if (both_ready) ld_cpool_push_hi(&j->task);   /* [stutter] waits for nothing */
+    else if (!ld_cpool_deps_on()) ld_cpool_push(&j->task);
+    else {
+        /* [pool2] Queued by whichever of its shaders finishes last (ld_cpool_compile), or here if both
+         * finished since ld_shader_need looked. A failed shader is done too: the pipeline then fails. */
+        u32 deps = 0;
+        ld_shader_job* const sj[2] = { vsj, psj };
+        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
+            ld_shader_job* s = sj[k];
+            if (!s || InterlockedCompareExchange(&s->done, 0, 0)) continue;
+            j->w_next[k] = NULL;
+            if (s->w_tail) s->w_tail->w_next[k] = j; else s->w_head = j;
+            s->w_tail = j;
+            deps++;
+        }
+        j->deps = deps;
+        if (!deps) ld_cpool_push_hi_locked(&j->task);
+        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+        if (!deps) WakeConditionVariable(&s_cpool_work);
+    }
+    /* Jobs live as long as the process: the recording ring and the pipeline table may still name one. */
+    return (ID3D12PipelineState*)((uintptr_t)j | 1u);
+}
+
+/* The recording thread: the real pipeline behind a stand-in, waiting for it if need be. */
+static ID3D12PipelineState* ld_pso_resolve(ID3D12PipelineState* p)
+{
+    if (!ld_pso_is_job(p)) return p;
+    ld_pso_job* j = ld_pso_job_of(p);
+    if (!InterlockedCompareExchange(&j->done, 0, 0)) {
+        LARGE_INTEGER c0, c1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&c0);
+        ld_cpool_wait(&j->done);
+        QueryPerformanceCounter(&c1);
+        InterlockedAdd64(&g_st.rec_wait_qpc, c1.QuadPart - c0.QuadPart);
+        InterlockedIncrement64(&g_st.rec_wait_n);
+    }
+    return j->pso;
+}
+
+/* ---- [nowait] New shaders built in the background --------------------------------------------------------
+ * The setting (LD_SHADERS: "wait" / "bg"; "" = GT5_SHADERS_BG_DEFAULT, gt5_settings.h), LD_PSO_NOWAIT=1/0 the
+ * test switch over it. With it on, a draw whose pipeline is still being made is left out and the frame goes on;
+ * from the first frame its pipeline is ready the draw is there again. Nothing is drawn later or again.
+ * Which draws may be left out (ld_nw_draw_flags, on the walker, only for a stand-in not yet done; LD_SHADERS_RULE):
+ * rule 3 (default) leaves out every draw except those whose result other draws read (whole-screen passes and
+ * copies, shadow maps, surfaces other draws sample, fills and fades, stencil writes), and gives a draw into a
+ * surface not known yet, or into the 3D scene before the tracker has found it again (the first 3D frame after
+ * a loading screen), a wait of at most LD_SHADERS_FIRST_MS (100) a frame in all. Rule 2 (round 2) left out only
+ * 3D-scene geometry as the scene tracker knows it ([scene]: the colour target the frame's 3D picture is drawn
+ * into, its clip and zeta, depth test on, a perspective projection, one target, no stencil), never while the
+ * game shows no 3D scene nor in the first 3D frame after it (plus LD_SHADERS_SETTLE more, default 0).
+ * Only the draw call is left out: on the walker the draw is recorded completely (constants, textures, the zeta
+ * and surface trackers, motion-vector rows, made-ahead and shader-prep notes, the cull tags), so the frame's
+ * state is that of a draw that covered no pixel. A draw that must wait for a pipeline still queued moves its
+ * shaders to the front of the queue (ld_cpool_promote). How long a draw can be missing: until its pipeline is
+ * made, i.e. its shaders' compile (0.05-0.8 s each) after the ones queued before it, plus the driver's part
+ * (a race start's burst: about 1.3-2.6 s for the last of 300 on 26-30 threads); and never longer than
+ * LD_SHADERS_MAX_MS (1500; 0 = no limit) plus one compile: past that its draws wait (ld_nw_missing_too_long). */
+static void ld_cpool_promote(ld_pso_job* j)
+{
+    ld_shader_job* const sj[2] = { j->vs_job, j->ps_job };
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+    for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
+        ld_shader_job* s = sj[k];
+        if (!s || s->started || s->urgent || InterlockedCompareExchange(&s->done, 0, 0)) continue;
+        ld_ctask* prev = NULL;
+        ld_ctask* t = s_cpool_head;
+        while (t && t != &s->task) { prev = t; t = t->next; }
+        if (!t) continue;
+        if (prev) prev->next = t->next; else s_cpool_head = t->next;
+        if (s_cpool_tail == t) s_cpool_tail = prev;
+        if (s_cpool_ur_last) { t->next = s_cpool_ur_last->next; s_cpool_ur_last->next = t; }
+        else { t->next = s_cpool_head; s_cpool_head = t; }
+        if (!t->next) s_cpool_tail = t;
+        s_cpool_ur_last = t;
+        s->urgent = 1;
+    }
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+}
+/* The recording thread at a RO_PSO: 1 when it is a stand-in still being made and the mode is on, to be set on
+ * the list at its first draw (ld_rec_lazy_draw); 0 to resolve it now, as always. */
+static int ld_rec_pso_later(ID3D12PipelineState* p)
+{
+    if (!ld_pso_is_job(p) || !InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_nw_rec_on, 0, 0)) return 0;
+    ld_pso_job* j = ld_pso_job_of(p);
+    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&j->done, 0, 0)) return 0;
+    s_rec_lazy = j;
+    return 1;
+}
+/* [nowait3] ld_cpool_wait for at most ms milliseconds: 1 when done. */
+static int ld_cpool_wait_ms(volatile LONG* done, DWORD ms)
+{
+    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(done, 0, 0)) return 1;
+    LARGE_INTEGER f, t0, t; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f); QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
+    const LONGLONG end = t0.QuadPart + (LONGLONG)ms * f.QuadPart / 1000;
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+    while (!InterlockedCompareExchange(done, 0, 0)) {
+        QueryPerformanceCounter(&t);
+        if (t.QuadPart >= end) break;
+        const DWORD left = (DWORD)((end - t.QuadPart) * 1000 / f.QuadPart) + 1u;
+        SleepConditionVariableSRW(&s_cpool_done, &s_cpool_lock, left, 0);
+    }
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_cpool_lock);
+    return InterlockedCompareExchange(done, 0, 0) != 0;
+}
+static void ld_nw_count_wait(u32 why, LONGLONG ticks)
+{
+    if (why >= NWR_N) why = NWR_NONE;
+    InterlockedIncrement64(&s_nw_wait_n[why]);
+    InterlockedAdd64(&s_nw_wait_qpc[why], ticks);
+}
+/* The recording thread at a draw after such a stand-in, flags = the walker's verdict (reason << 8 | how):
+ * 0 = leave the draw out (it may be, and the pipeline is not ready), 1 = draw it (the pipeline is set on the
+ * list now, waited for if need be: how 0 until ready, how 2 while the frame's first-frame time lasts). */
+static int ld_rec_lazy_draw(u32 flags, struct ld_si* si, u32 si_off)
+{
+    ld_pso_job* j = s_rec_lazy;
+    const u32 how = flags & 0xFFu, why = (flags >> 8) & 0xFFu;
+    if (!InterlockedCompareExchange(&j->done, 0, 0)) {
+        int leave = how == 1u;
+        if (how == 2u) {   /* [nowait3] wait while this frame's first-frame time lasts, then leave it out */
+            if ((flags >> 16) != s_rec_first_frame) { s_rec_first_frame = flags >> 16; s_rec_first_used = 0; }
+            leave = 1;
+            const LONG64 left = s_nw.first_qpc - s_rec_first_used;
+            if (left > 0) {
+                LARGE_INTEGER f, a, b; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f); QueryPerformanceCounter(&a);
+                const int ready = ld_cpool_wait_ms(&j->done, (DWORD)(left * 1000 / f.QuadPart) + 1u);
+                QueryPerformanceCounter(&b);
+                s_rec_first_used += b.QuadPart - a.QuadPart;
+                InterlockedAdd64(&g_st.rec_wait_qpc, b.QuadPart - a.QuadPart);
+                InterlockedIncrement64(&g_st.rec_wait_n);
+                ld_nw_count_wait(why, b.QuadPart - a.QuadPart);
+                leave = !ready;
+            }
+        }
+        if (leave) {
+            if (ld_si_rec_leave(si, si_off)) return 2;   /* [standin] drawn with the stand-in instead */
+            if (!j->skip_t0) {   /* its first draw left out: the pool measures from here to ready (ld_cpool_build) */
+                LARGE_INTEGER t; QueryPerformanceCounter(&t);
+                if (InterlockedCompareExchange64(&j->skip_t0, t.QuadPart > 0 ? t.QuadPart : 1, 0) == 0)
+                    InterlockedIncrement64(&s_nw_psos);
+            }
+            InterlockedIncrement64(&s_nw_draws);
+            if (!InterlockedExchange(&s_nw_said, 1))
+                fprintf(stderr, "[shaders] frame %u: a draw was left out while its new pipeline was being made "
+                                "(new shaders built in the background); the [stutter] lines count them\n", g_ld_frames);
+            return 0;
+        }
+        if (how == 0u && !InterlockedCompareExchange(&j->done, 0, 0)) {   /* [nowait3] a draw that must wait: why */
+            if (ld_si_rec_wait(si, si_off, why)) return 2;   /* [standin] LD_STANDIN_PRODUCERS (on): an instant stand-in */
+            LARGE_INTEGER a, b; QueryPerformanceCounter(&a);
+            ld_cpool_wait(&j->done);
+            QueryPerformanceCounter(&b);
+            InterlockedAdd64(&g_st.rec_wait_qpc, b.QuadPart - a.QuadPart);
+            InterlockedIncrement64(&g_st.rec_wait_n);
+            ld_nw_count_wait(why, b.QuadPart - a.QuadPart);
+        }
+    }
+    s_rec_lazy = NULL;
+    ID3D12PipelineState* q = ld_pso_resolve((ID3D12PipelineState*)((uintptr_t)j | 1u));   /* ready by now */
+    s_rec_no_pso = q == NULL;
+    s_rec_cur_pso = q;   /* [standin] */
+    if (!q) return 0;
+    s_rec_real->lpVtbl->SetPipelineState(s_rec_real, q);
+    return 1;
+}
+/* [standin] The recording thread at a draw: 0 leave it out, 1 draw it with what is set, 2 draw it with the stand-in
+ * just set (ld_si_rec_end afterwards). */
+static int ld_rec_draw_prep(u32 skip, void* si, u32 si_off)
+{
+    if (s_rec_lazy) {
+        const int k = ld_rec_lazy_draw(skip, (ld_si*)si, si_off);
+        if (k != 1) return k;
+    }
+    if (s_rec_no_pso) return 0;
+    if (si && si_off && s_si.all) {   /* LD_STANDIN_ALL: the stand-in even with the real pipeline ready (waited for) */
+        ld_si* const s = (ld_si*)si;
+        volatile LONG* const d = ld_si_done_flag(s);   /* its own pipeline, or its state's shared one */
+        if (!InterlockedCompareExchange(d, 0, 0)) ld_cpool_wait(d);
+        if (ld_si_rec_set(s, si_off)) { InterlockedIncrement64(&s_si_drawn); return 2; }
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+/* The walker, at every frame's end (ld_scn_frame_end): the setting, followed live. */
+static void ld_nw_frame(void)
+{
+    if (s_nw.env == -2) {
+        const char* e = getenv("LD_PSO_NOWAIT");
+        s_nw.env = e && *e ? (atoi(e) != 0) : -1;
+        e = getenv("LD_SHADERS_SETTLE");
+        s_nw.settle = e && atoi(e) > 0 ? (u32)atoi(e) : 0u;
+        e = getenv("LD_SHADERS_RULE");                 /* [nowait3] */
+        s_nw.rule = e && atoi(e) == 2 ? 2 : 3;
+        e = getenv("LD_SHADERS_SHADOW_SKIP");
+        s_nw.shadow_skip = e && atoi(e) != 0;
+        e = getenv("LD_SHADERS_PRODUCER_SKIP");
+        s_nw.producer_skip = e && *e ? atoi(e) != 0 : LD_NW_PRODUCER_SKIP_DEFAULT;
+        e = getenv("LD_SHADERS_FIRST_MS");
+        const long fms = e && *e ? atol(e) : LD_NW_FIRST_MS_DEFAULT;
+        LARGE_INTEGER f; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
+        s_nw.first_qpc = fms > 0 ? (LONG64)fms * f.QuadPart / 1000 : 0;
+    }
+    if (!s_nw.have_gen || s_nw.gen != gt5_settings_gen()) {
+        s_nw.have_gen = 1;
+        s_nw.gen = gt5_settings_gen();
+        char v[16];
+        gt5_setting_str("LD_SHADERS", v, sizeof v);
+        int want = !_stricmp(v, "bg") ? 1 : !_stricmp(v, "wait") ? 0 : GT5_SHADERS_BG_DEFAULT;
+        if (s_nw.env >= 0) want = s_nw.env;
+        if (want != s_nw.want) {
+            s_nw.want = want;
+            fprintf(stderr, "[shaders] new shaders: %s (%s)\n",
+                    !want ? "waited for"
+                    : s_nw.rule == 2 ? "built in the background; a 3D-scene draw whose pipeline is not ready yet is left out "
+                                       "until it is (rule 2)"
+                    : "built in the background; a draw whose pipeline is not ready yet is left out until it is, unless "
+                      "it makes a picture other draws read (rule 3)",
+                    s_nw.env >= 0 ? "LD_PSO_NOWAIT" : v[0] ? "LD_SHADERS" : "the default");
+        }
+    }
+    /* Only where draws have stand-ins: the recording thread and the compile threads (once they started). */
+    s_nw.mode = s_nw.want && s_rec_on && s_cpool_state == 1;
+    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_nw_rec_on, 0, 0) != s_nw.mode) InterlockedExchange(&s_nw_rec_on, s_nw.mode);
+    if (s_nw.mode) ld_si_frame();   /* [standin] its shader asked for once, before the first 3D scene */
+}
+/* The walker: has this pipeline's draws been left out for LD_SHADERS_MAX_MS (1500) already? Then its draws wait
+ * like any other (and its shaders go to the front), so nothing stays missing longer than that and one compile,
+ * however few threads compile (2 on a 4-thread PC: a race start's few hundred shaders take many seconds there). */
+static int ld_nw_missing_too_long(ld_pso_job* j)
+{
+    static LONGLONG cap = -1;
+    if (cap < 0) {
+        const char* e = getenv("LD_SHADERS_MAX_MS");
+        const long ms = e && *e ? atol(e) : 1500;
+        LARGE_INTEGER f; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
+        cap = ms > 0 ? (LONGLONG)ms * f.QuadPart / 1000 : 0;
+    }
+    const LONG64 t0 = j->skip_t0;
+    if (t0 <= 0 || !cap) return 0;
+    LARGE_INTEGER t; QueryPerformanceCounter(&t);
+    return t.QuadPart - t0 > cap;
+}
+/* The walker, at a draw whose pipeline is a stand-in still being made (sink_end_impl): the draw call's flags,
+ * reason << 8 | how (how 0 = wait, 1 = may be left out, 2 = may be left out once this frame's first-frame time
+ * is spent). target, the draw's surface; sf, the surface registers; n_rt, its colour targets; writes_colour;
+ * rt, it samples a rendered surface or a zeta; tex, it samples any texture; n_vtx, its vertices.
+ *
+ * Rule 2 (LD_SHADERS_RULE=2, round 2): left out only when it is 3D-scene geometry as the scene tracker knows it
+ * (the block above); the reason it fails is the first test it fails.
+ * Rule 3 (default): wait only for a draw whose result other draws read; leave out every other draw, an object
+ * drawn into a picture that is drawn again next frame. In order:
+ *   several colour targets, a stencil write                                  -> wait (masks later passes read)
+ *   no colour written (depth only) into a zeta that is not the scene's        -> wait (a shadow map), unless
+ *                                                                               LD_SHADERS_SHADOW_SKIP=1
+ *   reads a rendered surface or zeta with the depth test off                  -> wait (resolves, copies, bloom,
+ *                                                                               exposure, tone map, composites,
+ *                                                                               the copy to the display buffer)
+ *   no texture, depth test off, at most 16 vertices                           -> wait (fills, fades, the border)
+ *   into a surface that is neither the 3D scene nor a display buffer:
+ *     a surface first drawn into in this frame                                -> wait ([nowait4]: it may be
+ *                                                                               drawn once and kept)
+ *     a surface other draws have sampled (reflection, mirror, instrument and  -> left out when the game redraws
+ *       particle buffers)                                                        it every frame (drawn in the
+ *                                                                               frame before too) and
+ *                                                                               LD_SHADERS_PRODUCER_SKIP is on
+ *                                                                               (default, [nowait4]); else wait
+ *   into the 3D scene before the tracker has found it this time (the first
+ *     3D frame after a loading screen or menu)                                -> time-limited wait
+ *   anything else (3D objects in the scene, 3D and 2D menu parts, the HUD)    -> may be left out
+ * "The 3D scene" is the surface the tracker found the 3D picture in (this time, or ever, or at the last scene's
+ * address); "a display buffer" one the game flips (ld_scn_is_display). Every frame's time-limited waits share
+ * LD_SHADERS_FIRST_MS (LD_NW_FIRST_MS_DEFAULT, 0 since [nowait4]); past it those draws are left out too. */
+static int ld_scn_is_display(const surface_t* s);
+#define NW_WAIT(r) ((u32)(r) << 8)
+#define NW_SKIP    1u
+#define NW_TIMED   (((u32)NWR_FIRST << 8) | 2u)
+static u32 ld_nw_draw_flags(u32 target, const rsx_dsp_surface* sf, u32 n_rt, int writes_colour, int rt, int tex, u32 n_vtx)
+{
+    if (!s_nw.mode) return 0;
+    const surface_t* ts = target < g.n_surfaces ? &g.surfaces[target] : NULL;
+    const int sig_scene = s_scn.on && s_scn.sig_valid && ts && ld_scn_sig_is(&s_scn.sig, ts);
+    render_state_t rs;
+    if (s_nw.rule == 2) {
+        if (!s_scn.on || !s_scn.sig_valid || s_scn.kind != LD_SCN_SCENE || s_nw.scene_frames <= s_nw.settle)
+            return NW_WAIT(NWR_NOSCENE);
+        if (n_rt != 1u) return NW_WAIT(NWR_MRT);
+        if (!sig_scene) return NW_WAIT(NWR_TARGET);
+        if (sf->clip_w != s_scn.sig.cw || sf->clip_h != s_scn.sig.ch) return NW_WAIT(NWR_CLIP);
+        if (sf->zeta_location != s_scn.sig.zloc || sf->zeta_offset != s_scn.sig.zoff) return NW_WAIT(NWR_ZETA);
+        decode_render_state(&rs);
+        if (!rs.depth_test) return NW_WAIT(NWR_DEPTHOFF);
+        if (rs.stencil_enable) return NW_WAIT(NWR_STENCIL);
+        const float* c3 = (const float*)g.rsx.constants[3];
+        if (!(c3[0] != 0.0f || c3[1] != 0.0f || c3[2] != 0.0f)) return NW_WAIT(NWR_FLAT);
+        return NW_SKIP;
+    }
+    if (n_rt > 1u) return NW_WAIT(NWR_MRT);
+    decode_render_state(&rs);
+    if (rs.stencil_enable && rs.s_write_mask) return NW_WAIT(NWR_STENCIL);
+    const int scene = sig_scene || (ts && (s_nw_was_scene[target] ||
+                      (s_nw_scene.valid && ts->location == s_nw_scene.loc && ts->offset == s_nw_scene.off)));
+    if (!writes_colour) {
+        const int scene_z = (s_scn.on && s_scn.sig_valid && sf->zeta_location == s_scn.sig.zloc && sf->zeta_offset == s_scn.sig.zoff) ||
+                            (s_nw_scene.valid && sf->zeta_location == s_nw_scene.zloc && sf->zeta_offset == s_nw_scene.zoff);
+        if (!scene_z && !s_nw.shadow_skip) return NW_WAIT(NWR_DEPTHONLY);
+        return scene_z && !(s_scn.on && s_scn.sig_valid) ? NW_TIMED : NW_SKIP;
+    }
+    if (rt && !rs.depth_test) return NW_WAIT(NWR_POST);
+    if (!tex && !rs.depth_test && n_vtx <= 16u) return NW_WAIT(NWR_FILL);
+    if (!ts) return NW_WAIT(NWR_TARGET);
+    if (!scene && !ld_scn_is_display(ts)) {
+        const u32 now = g_ld_frames + 1u;
+        /* [nowait4] a target new this frame waits: it may be one the game draws once and keeps */
+        if (!s_nw_first[target] || s_nw_first[target] == now) return NW_WAIT(NWR_NEWTARGET);
+        /* drawn in the frame before too (and, if drawn already in this one, in the one before that) */
+        const int redrawn = s_nw_last[target] + 1u == now || (s_nw_last[target] == now && s_nw_every[target]);
+        if (s_nw_samp[target] && !(s_nw.producer_skip && redrawn)) return NW_WAIT(NWR_PRODUCER);
+        return NW_SKIP;
+    }
+    if (scene && !sig_scene) return NW_TIMED;
+    return NW_SKIP;
+}
+
+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * [ahead] The made-ahead pipeline list (LD_PSO_AHEAD; =0 off, as before).
+ *
+ * Every pipeline a session uses is written once to pipelines_d3d12.lst beside the shader cache: its two
+ * shaders by hash and length, the render state the pipeline is made of and the vertex layout. At the
+ * next start a thread reads the list newest first (LD_PSO_AHEAD_MAX, 4096, kept; older and repeated
+ * records are dropped and the file rewritten), finds both shaders in the in-memory shader pack, and
+ * two to four threads at below-normal priority make the pipelines while the game boots. A draw that
+ * needs one of them takes it: ready, still being made (the recording thread waits for it as for any
+ * pool job), or not started yet (it is made at once, on the pool). It is used only when the draw's
+ * own translated shaders are byte for byte the ones in the pack and every field the pipeline is made
+ * of is the same, so it is exactly the pipeline the draw would have built.
+ * The owner's sessions on 17 Nov had 402, 183, 122 and 97 new pipelines in single frames, every one
+ * with its shaders cached ("0 shaders to the compile threads"): those are the ones this saves.
+ * Needs the shader pack in memory (RSX_SHADER_CACHE_PRELOAD on) and the shader cache folder. */
+#define LD_AHEAD_MAGIC   0x41505350u   /* "PSPA" */
+/* 2 [shreg]: the fragment decompiler's text changed for every program (register declaration); version 1
+ * records name pixel shaders no draw asks for any more, so they are dropped at the first start instead of
+ * being made (and kept) for nothing. */
+#define LD_AHEAD_VERSION 2u
+typedef struct {
+    u32 magic, version, rs_size, masked;
+    u64 vs_hash, ps_hash;
+    u32 vs_len, ps_len, count, packed;
+    u8 attrs[RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR];
+    render_state_t rs;
+    u64 check;
+} ld_ahead_rec;
+static int ld_pso_ahead_on(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) {
+        const char* e = getenv("LD_PSO_AHEAD");
+        const char* pl = getenv("RSX_SHADER_CACHE_PRELOAD");
+        on = !(e && atoi(e) == 0) && !(pl && atoi(pl) == 0) && !getenv("RSX_NO_SHADER_DISK_CACHE");
+    }
+    return on;
+}
+static u32 ld_ahead_cap(void)
+{
+    static u32 cap;
+    if (!cap) { const char* e = getenv("LD_PSO_AHEAD_MAX"); const long v = e ? atol(e) : 0;
+                cap = v >= 16 && v <= 16384 ? (u32)v : 4096u; }
+    return cap;
+}
+/* Every field ld_fill_pipeline_desc and apply_render_state read, and nothing else. */
+static int ld_rs_desc_same(const render_state_t* a, const render_state_t* b)
+{
+#define LD_RS_SAME(f) (a->f == b->f)
+    return LD_RS_SAME(blend_enable) && LD_RS_SAME(sf_rgb) && LD_RS_SAME(df_rgb) && LD_RS_SAME(sf_a) &&
+           LD_RS_SAME(df_a) && LD_RS_SAME(eq_rgb) && LD_RS_SAME(eq_a) && LD_RS_SAME(depth_test) &&
+           LD_RS_SAME(depth_write) && LD_RS_SAME(depth_func) && LD_RS_SAME(cull_enable) &&
+           LD_RS_SAME(cull_face) && LD_RS_SAME(front_face) && LD_RS_SAME(color_mask) && LD_RS_SAME(rt_fp16) &&
+           LD_RS_SAME(rt_count) && LD_RS_SAME(stencil_enable) && LD_RS_SAME(stencil_two_sided) &&
+           LD_RS_SAME(s_func) && LD_RS_SAME(s_func_mask) && LD_RS_SAME(s_write_mask) && LD_RS_SAME(s_fail) &&
+           LD_RS_SAME(s_zfail) && LD_RS_SAME(s_zpass) && LD_RS_SAME(bs_func) && LD_RS_SAME(bs_fail) &&
+           LD_RS_SAME(bs_zfail) && LD_RS_SAME(bs_zpass) && LD_RS_SAME(slope_bias) && LD_RS_SAME(depth_clip);
+#undef LD_RS_SAME
+}
+static void ld_ahead_rec_fill(ld_ahead_rec* r, u64 vs_hash, u32 vs_len, u64 ps_hash, u32 ps_len,
+                              const render_state_t* rs, u32 masked, u32 count, const u8* attrs, u32 packed)
+{
+    memset(r, 0, sizeof *r);
+    r->magic = LD_AHEAD_MAGIC; r->version = LD_AHEAD_VERSION; r->rs_size = (u32)sizeof(render_state_t);
+    r->vs_hash = vs_hash; r->vs_len = vs_len; r->ps_hash = ps_hash; r->ps_len = ps_len;
+    r->rs = *rs;
+    if (masked) {
+        r->masked = 1u; r->count = count < RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR ? count : RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR;
+        r->packed = packed ? 1u : 0u;
+        memcpy(r->attrs, attrs, r->count);
+    }
+    r->check = fnv1a(r, (u32)offsetof(ld_ahead_rec, check), 1469598103934665603ull);
+}
+static u64 ld_ahead_key(u64 vs_hash, u32 vs_len, u64 ps_hash, u32 ps_len, const render_state_t* rs,
+                        u32 masked, u32 count, const u8* attrs, u32 packed)
+{
+    u64 h = 1469598103934665603ull;
+    h = fnv1a(&vs_hash, sizeof vs_hash, h); h = fnv1a(&vs_len, sizeof vs_len, h);
+    h = fnv1a(&ps_hash, sizeof ps_hash, h); h = fnv1a(&ps_len, sizeof ps_len, h);
+    h = ld_hash_structural_render_state(rs, h);
+    h = fnv1a(&masked, sizeof masked, h);
+    if (masked) {
+        if (count > RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR) count = RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR;
+        h = fnv1a(&count, sizeof count, h); h = fnv1a(&packed, sizeof packed, h); h = fnv1a(attrs, count, h);
+    }
+    return h ? h : 1u;
+}
+static u64 ld_ahead_key_rec(const ld_ahead_rec* r)
+{
+    return ld_ahead_key(r->vs_hash, r->vs_len, r->ps_hash, r->ps_len, &r->rs, r->masked, r->count, r->attrs, r->packed);
+}
+
+/* Records to append: one per pipeline per session, noted by the walker or the pool; the made-ahead
+ * thread writes them once a second. */
+#define LD_AHEAD_SEEN 32768u
+static SRWLOCK s_ahead_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
+static u64* s_ahead_seen;
+static u32 s_ahead_seen_n;
+static ld_ahead_rec* s_ahead_pend;
+static u32 s_ahead_pend_n, s_ahead_pend_cap;
+static void ld_ahead_note_rec(const ld_ahead_rec* r)
+{
+    if (!ld_pso_ahead_on()) return;
+    const u64 key = ld_ahead_key_rec(r);
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_ahead_lock);
+    if (!s_ahead_seen) s_ahead_seen = (u64*)calloc(LD_AHEAD_SEEN, sizeof *s_ahead_seen);
+    if (s_ahead_seen && s_ahead_seen_n < LD_AHEAD_SEEN / 2u) {
+        u32 i = (u32)(key ^ (key >> 31)) & (LD_AHEAD_SEEN - 1u);
+        while (s_ahead_seen[i] && s_ahead_seen[i] != key) i = (i + 1u) & (LD_AHEAD_SEEN - 1u);
+        if (!s_ahead_seen[i]) {
+            if (s_ahead_pend_n == s_ahead_pend_cap) {
+                const u32 nc = s_ahead_pend_cap ? s_ahead_pend_cap * 2u : 256u;
+                ld_ahead_rec* p = (ld_ahead_rec*)realloc(s_ahead_pend, (size_t)nc * sizeof *p);
+                if (p) { s_ahead_pend = p; s_ahead_pend_cap = nc; }
+            }
+            if (s_ahead_pend_n < s_ahead_pend_cap) {
+                s_ahead_seen[i] = key; s_ahead_seen_n++;
+                s_ahead_pend[s_ahead_pend_n++] = *r;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_ahead_lock);
+}
+static void ld_ahead_note(u64 vs_hash, u32 vs_len, u64 ps_hash, u32 ps_len, const render_state_t* rs,
+                          u32 masked, u32 count, const u8* attrs, u32 packed)
+{
+    if (!ld_pso_ahead_on()) return;
+    ld_ahead_rec r;
+    ld_ahead_rec_fill(&r, vs_hash, vs_len, ps_hash, ps_len, rs, masked, count, attrs, packed);
+    ld_ahead_note_rec(&r);
+}
+static void ld_ahead_note_job(const ld_pso_job* j)
+{
+    if (j->vs_len && j->ps_len)
+        ld_ahead_note(j->vs_hash, j->vs_len, j->ps_hash, j->ps_len, &j->rs, j->masked, j->count, j->attrs, j->packed);
+}
+
+/* The list read at start: an index of made-ahead jobs by key, filled before s_ahead_ready and only read
+ * after it (by the walker; the made-ahead threads only touch a job's ahead_state, pso and done). */
+static volatile LONG s_ahead_ready;
+static struct ld_ahead_slot { u64 key; ld_pso_job* j; }* s_ahead_tab;
+static u32 s_ahead_mask;
+static ld_pso_job** s_ahead_jobs;
+static u32 s_ahead_n;
+static volatile LONG s_ahead_next;
+/* The made-ahead threads run below normal priority; once a draw waits for one of their pipelines the
+ * walker raises them to normal, so a busy CPU cannot hold that pipeline back (the handles stay open). */
+static HANDLE s_ahead_th[4];
+static volatile LONG s_ahead_th_n;
+static int s_ahead_boosted;
+static void ld_ahead_boost(void)
+{
+    if (s_ahead_boosted) return;
+    s_ahead_boosted = 1;
+    const LONG n = InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_ahead_th_n, 0, 0);
+    for (LONG i = 0; i < n; i++) SetThreadPriority(s_ahead_th[i], THREAD_PRIORITY_NORMAL);
+}
+
+/* The two shaders from the pack (header, source, bytecode), as blobs for ld_cpool_build to release. */
+static int ld_ahead_blobs(ld_pso_job* j)
+{
+    const u8* e[2] = { j->vs_entry, j->ps_entry };
+    ID3DBlob* b[2] = { NULL, NULL };
+    for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
+        shader_disk_cache_header h;
+        memcpy(&h, e[k], sizeof h);
+        if (FAILED(D3DCreateBlob(h.blob_length, &b[k])) || !b[k]) {
+            if (b[0]) b[0]->lpVtbl->Release(b[0]);
+            return 0;
+        }
+        memcpy(b[k]->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(b[k]), e[k] + sizeof h + h.source_length, h.blob_length);
+    }
+    j->vs_blob = b[0]; j->ps_blob = b[1];
+    return 1;
+}
+static const u8* ld_ahead_entry(u32 stage, u64 hash, u32 length)
+{
+    const shader_mem_entry* e = shader_mem_get(shader_mem_key(stage, hash, length));
+    if (!e) return NULL;
+    shader_disk_cache_header h;
+    memcpy(&h, e->data, sizeof h);
+    if (h.stage != stage || h.source_hash != hash || h.source_length != length) return NULL;
+    return e->data;
+}
+static DWORD WINAPI ld_ahead_builder(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    for (;;) {
+        const LONG i = InterlockedIncrement(&s_ahead_next) - 1;
+        if (i >= (LONG)s_ahead_n) return 0;
+        ld_pso_job* j = s_ahead_jobs[i];
+        if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&j->ahead_state, 2, 0) != 0) continue;   /* a draw took it first */
+        if (!ld_ahead_blobs(j)) {
+            j->pso = NULL;
+            ld_cpool_finish(&j->done);
+            InterlockedIncrement64(&g_st.ahead_failed);
+            continue;
+        }
+        ld_cpool_build(j);
+        if (j->pso) InterlockedIncrement64(&g_st.ahead_made); else InterlockedIncrement64(&g_st.ahead_failed);
+    }
+}
+static void ld_ahead_flush_pending(const char* path)
+{
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_ahead_lock);
+    ld_ahead_rec* p = s_ahead_pend;
+    const u32 n = s_ahead_pend_n;
+    s_ahead_pend = NULL; s_ahead_pend_n = s_ahead_pend_cap = 0;
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_ahead_lock);
+    if (n) {
+        FILE* f = fopen(path, "ab");
+        if (f) { fwrite(p, sizeof *p, n, f); fclose(f); }
+    }
+    free(p);
+}
+static DWORD WINAPI ld_ahead_main(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    char path[MAX_PATH];
+    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\pipelines_d3d12.lst", g_ld_shader_disk_dir);
+    /* The pack in memory, and the device state a pipeline is made against. */
+    int i;
+    for (i = 0; i < 9000; i++) {
+        if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_shader_mem_ready, 0, 0) && g.dev && g.rootsig_x && g.depth) break;
+        Sleep(20);
+    }
+    if (i == 9000) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[pso-ahead] the shader pack was not in memory after 3 minutes: no pipelines made ahead\n");
+        for (;;) { Sleep(1000); ld_ahead_flush_pending(path); }
+    }
+    LARGE_INTEGER fq, t0, t1, t2;
+    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&fq); QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
+    ld_ahead_rec* recs = NULL;
+    size_t n_recs = 0;
+    int torn = 0;   /* a record cut short (the game stopped mid-write): rewrite, or appends go astray */
+    { FILE* f = fopen(path, "rb");
+      if (f) {
+          if (_fseeki64(f, 0, SEEK_END) == 0) {
+              const long long n = _ftelli64(f);
+              if (n > 0 && n < (256ll << 20) && _fseeki64(f, 0, SEEK_SET) == 0) {
+                  n_recs = (size_t)n / sizeof *recs;
+                  torn = ((size_t)n % sizeof *recs) != 0;
+                  recs = (ld_ahead_rec*)malloc(n_recs ? n_recs * sizeof *recs : 1u);
+                  if (!recs || fread(recs, sizeof *recs, n_recs, f) != n_recs) { free(recs); recs = NULL; n_recs = 0; }
+              }
+          }
+          fclose(f);
+      } }
+    const u32 cap = ld_ahead_cap();
+    u32 sz = 1024u;
+    while (sz < 2u * cap) sz <<= 1;
+    s_ahead_tab = (struct ld_ahead_slot*)calloc(sz, sizeof *s_ahead_tab);
+    s_ahead_jobs = (ld_pso_job**)calloc(cap, sizeof *s_ahead_jobs);
+    u32* kept = (u32*)malloc((n_recs ? n_recs : 1u) * sizeof *kept);
+    u32 n_kept = 0, n_bad = 0, n_missing = 0;
+    if (!s_ahead_tab || !s_ahead_jobs || !kept) {
+        free(recs); free(kept);
+        fprintf(stderr, "[pso-ahead] out of memory: no pipelines made ahead\n");
+        for (;;) { Sleep(1000); ld_ahead_flush_pending(path); }
+    }
+    s_ahead_mask = sz - 1u;
+    /* Newest first: the file is appended to, so a pipeline used again sits nearer the end. */
+    for (size_t k = n_recs; k-- > 0 && n_kept < cap;) {
+        const ld_ahead_rec* r = &recs[k];
+        if (r->magic != LD_AHEAD_MAGIC || r->version != LD_AHEAD_VERSION || r->rs_size != (u32)sizeof(render_state_t) ||
+            r->check != fnv1a(r, (u32)offsetof(ld_ahead_rec, check), 1469598103934665603ull) ||
+            !r->vs_len || !r->ps_len) { n_bad++; continue; }
+        const u64 key = ld_ahead_key_rec(r);
+        u32 s = (u32)(key ^ (key >> 29)) & s_ahead_mask;
+        int dup = 0;
+        for (; s_ahead_tab[s].key; s = (s + 1u) & s_ahead_mask)
+            if (s_ahead_tab[s].key == key) { dup = 1; break; }
+        if (dup) continue;
+        s_ahead_tab[s].key = key;
+        kept[n_kept++] = (u32)k;
+        const u8* ve = ld_ahead_entry('V', r->vs_hash, r->vs_len);
+        const u8* pe = ld_ahead_entry('P', r->ps_hash, r->ps_len);
+        ld_pso_job* j = ve && pe ? (ld_pso_job*)calloc(1, sizeof *j) : NULL;
+        if (!j) { n_missing++; continue; }
+        j->task.kind = LD_CT_PSO;
+        j->rs = r->rs;
+        j->masked = r->masked; j->count = r->count; j->packed = r->packed;
+        memcpy(j->attrs, r->attrs, sizeof j->attrs);
+        j->vs_hash = r->vs_hash; j->vs_len = r->vs_len; j->ps_hash = r->ps_hash; j->ps_len = r->ps_len;
+        j->vs_entry = ve; j->ps_entry = pe;
+        j->dev = g.dev;
+        s_ahead_tab[s].j = j;
+        s_ahead_jobs[s_ahead_n++] = j;
+    }
+    /* Rewritten oldest first when it held repeats, old ones past the cap or damaged records. */

+        if (!th[started]) break;

+        s_ahead_th[nh++] = th[started];
+        started++;

+    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t2);

+            (long long)g_st.ahead_made, (double)(t2.QuadPart - t1.QuadPart) / (double)fq.QuadPart,
+            (double)g_st.ahead_qpc / (double)fq.QuadPart, (long long)g_st.ahead_failed, g_st.ahead_cold);
+    for (;;) { Sleep(1000); ld_ahead_flush_pending(path); }

+/* build_pso(): the made-ahead pipeline for exactly this draw, if there is one (*found then 1): the
+ * pipeline, or a stand-in while it is still being made. */
+static ID3D12PipelineState* ld_ahead_take(const char* vs_hlsl, u32 vs_length, u64 vs_hash,
+    const char* ps_hlsl, u32 ps_length, u64 ps_hash, const render_state_t* rs,
+    const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* masked_layout, int packed_offsets, int* found)
+{
+    *found = 0;
+    if (!InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_ahead_ready, 0, 0) || !s_ahead_n) return NULL;
+    const u32 masked = masked_layout ? 1u : 0u;
+    const u32 count = masked_layout ? masked_layout->count : 0u;
+    const u8* attrs = masked_layout ? masked_layout->attrs : NULL;
+    const u32 packed = masked_layout && packed_offsets ? 1u : 0u;
+    const u64 key = ld_ahead_key(vs_hash, vs_length, ps_hash, ps_length, rs, masked, count, attrs, packed);
+    ld_pso_job* j = NULL;
+    for (u32 s = (u32)(key ^ (key >> 29)) & s_ahead_mask; s_ahead_tab[s].key; s = (s + 1u) & s_ahead_mask) {
+        ld_pso_job* c = s_ahead_tab[s].j;
+        if (s_ahead_tab[s].key != key || !c || c->taken || c->dev != g.dev) continue;
+        if (c->vs_hash != vs_hash || c->vs_len != vs_length || c->ps_hash != ps_hash || c->ps_len != ps_length ||
+            c->masked != masked || !ld_rs_desc_same(&c->rs, rs)) continue;
+        if (masked && (c->count != (count < RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR ? count : RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR) ||
+                       c->packed != packed || memcmp(c->attrs, attrs, c->count) != 0)) continue;
+        /* The draw's own shaders, byte for byte the pack's. */
+        if (memcmp(c->vs_entry + sizeof(shader_disk_cache_header), vs_hlsl, vs_length) != 0 ||
+            memcmp(c->ps_entry + sizeof(shader_disk_cache_header), ps_hlsl, ps_length) != 0) continue;
+        j = c;
+        break;
+    }
+    if (!j) return NULL;
+    const LONG was = InterlockedCompareExchange(&j->ahead_state, 1, 0);
+    if (was == 0) {
+        /* Not started: made now, on the pool if it is running, else here. */
+        j->taken = 1u;
+        if (!ld_ahead_blobs(j)) { ld_cpool_finish(&j->done); return NULL; }   /* out of memory: built as usual */
+        *found = 1;
+        g_st.ahead_cold++;
+        ld_ahead_note(vs_hash, vs_length, ps_hash, ps_length, rs, masked, count, attrs, packed);
+        if (ld_pso_pool_on() && ld_async_shaders()) {
+            ld_cpool_push_hi(&j->task);
+            return (ID3D12PipelineState*)((uintptr_t)j | 1u);
+        }
+        j->on_walker = 1u;
+        g_st.walker_pso_n++;
+        ld_cpool_build(j);
+        *found = j->pso != NULL;
+        return j->pso;
+    }
+    /* A made-ahead thread has it. */
+    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&j->done, 0, 0)) {
+        if (!j->pso) { j->taken = 1u; return NULL; }   /* it failed there: built as usual */
+        j->taken = 1u;
+        *found = 1;
+        g_st.ahead_ready++;
+        ld_ahead_note(vs_hash, vs_length, ps_hash, ps_length, rs, masked, count, attrs, packed);
+        return j->pso;
+    }
+    j->taken = 1u;
+    *found = 1;
+    g_st.ahead_building++;
+    ld_ahead_note(vs_hash, vs_length, ps_hash, ps_length, rs, masked, count, attrs, packed);
+    ld_ahead_boost();
+    if (ld_async_shaders()) return (ID3D12PipelineState*)((uintptr_t)j | 1u);
+    ld_cpool_wait(&j->done);
+    *found = j->pso != NULL;
+    return j->pso;
+}

+/* The fragment program's structural hash, by its bytes. The same few programs come round draw after
+ * draw, and parsing one to skip its embedded constants cost more than comparing it with a copy. */
+#define LD_PSO_INDEX (MAX_PSOS * 2u)
+static u32 s_pso_index[LD_PSO_INDEX];   /* table index + 1, 0 = empty */
+static u32 ld_pso_slot(u64 key) { return (u32)((key ^ (key >> 29) ^ (key >> 47)) & (LD_PSO_INDEX - 1u)); }

+/* The table was append-only. A long session brings more than MAX_PSOS different pipelines (every car
+ * in a dealership has its own set), and once it was full get_pso() returned NULL for every new one:
+ * those draws were dropped until the game was restarted (a player's log: 8192 pipelines, 461,803 draw
+ * groups dropped, "shaders stopped compiling after visiting a few dealerships").
+ * When it fills, the pipelines no draw has asked for lately are released: the longest idle time that
+ * leaves a quarter of the table free, from 30 seconds down to two frames. A pipeline used in this
+ * frame or the one before always stays (lists recorded for them may not have been submitted yet), as
+ * does one still being built; the released ones wait for the next fence like retired textures. One
+ * that is needed again is built again, from the shader caches. LD_PSO_CAP=<n> makes the table smaller
+ * (tests). Returns how many were released. */
+static u32 ld_pso_cap(void)
+{
+    static u32 cap;
+    if (!cap) { const char* e = getenv("LD_PSO_CAP"); const long v = e ? atol(e) : 0;
+                cap = v >= 64 && v < MAX_PSOS ? (u32)v : MAX_PSOS; }
+    return cap;
+}
+static int ld_pso_entry_stays(const psocache_t* e, u32 window)
+{
+    if (ld_pso_is_job(e->pso) && !InterlockedCompareExchange(&ld_pso_job_of(e->pso)->done, 0, 0)) return 1;
+    return g_ld_frames - e->last_frame <= window;
+}
+static u32 ld_pso_evict(void)
+{
+    static const u32 windows[] = { 1800u, 600u, 120u, 16u, 2u };
+    const u32 cap = ld_pso_cap();
+    u32 window = 2u, keep = 0;
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < 5u; k++) {
+        window = windows[k]; keep = 0;
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_psos; i++) keep += (u32)ld_pso_entry_stays(&g.psos[i], window);
+        if (keep <= cap - cap / 4u) break;
+    }
+    if (keep >= g.n_psos) return 0;
+    u32 n = 0, released = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_psos; i++) {
+        const psocache_t e = g.psos[i];
+        if (ld_pso_entry_stays(&e, window)) { g.psos[n++] = e; continue; }
+        ID3D12PipelineState* p = ld_pso_is_job(e.pso) ? ld_pso_job_of(e.pso)->pso : e.pso;   /* a job here is done */
+        if (p) {
+            if (g.n_retired_psos >= MAX_PSOS) { g.psos[n++] = e; continue; }   /* cannot be: at most MAX_PSOS a fence */
+            g.retired_psos[g.n_retired_psos++] = p;
+        }
+        released++;
+    }
+    g.n_psos = n;
+    memset(s_pso_index, 0, sizeof s_pso_index);
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < g.n_psos; i++) {
+        u32 h = ld_pso_slot(g.psos[i].key);
+        while (s_pso_index[h]) h = (h + 1u) & (LD_PSO_INDEX - 1u);
+        s_pso_index[h] = i + 1u;
+    }
+    static u32 said;
+    if (said++ < 40u || (said & 63u) == 0u)
+        fprintf(stderr, "[pso-cache] table full (%u): released %u pipelines not asked for in the last %u frames, %u stay (time %u, frame %u)\n",
+                cap, released, window, g.n_psos, said, g_ld_frames);
+    return released;
