+/* What get_pso reads off the vertex program, by the program's bytes: its length, its TXL units, whether
+ * it uses branch bits, and its hash. A draw usually runs a program the one before it ran. */
+typedef struct { u32 start, instrs, txl, branch_used, ok; u64 hash; ld_vc_runs cr; u8 copy[RSX_DSP_VP_INSTR * 16]; } ld_vp_memo;
+static ld_vp_memo s_vp_memo[8];
+/* [pso-memo] lookups the program memos did not answer: vertex programs worked out again; fragment
+ * programs at a place no entry held (new, or pushed out) [0] and whose words had changed there [1]. */
+unsigned long long g_vp_memo_miss, g_fp_memo_miss[2];
+/* [draw-calls] LD_CB_RANGE: the transform constants a vertex program reads, as rsx_vp_decompiler.c's
+ * emit_src names them: a source of register type 3 reads vp_c[const_src & 511], or with D3.index_const
+ * vp_c[(const_src + a0/a1) & 511], i.e. any of them. The scan covers exactly the instructions the
+ * decompiler is given (vp_instrs from the start), and counts every source field of type 3 whether the
+ * opcode reads it or not, so it can only say more than the shader reads. The constants become runs:
+ * neighbours up to 4 apart join (a copy into write-combined memory wants whole lines), and while there
+ * are more than LD_VC_RUNS the two runs closest together join. n = 0: the program reads none. */
+static void ld_vp_const_runs(const u8* uc, u32 instrs, ld_vc_runs* r)
+{
+    u64 used[8] = {0};
+    int all = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < instrs && !all; i++) {
+        u32 d[4];
+        memcpy(d, uc + (size_t)i * 16u, 16);   /* the words as the decompiler reads them (little-endian host) */
+        const u32 src0 = ((d[2] >> 23) & 0x1FFu) | ((d[1] & 0xFFu) << 9);
+        const u32 src1 = (d[2] >> 6) & 0x1FFFFu;
+        const u32 src2 = ((d[3] >> 21) & 0x7FFu) | ((d[2] & 0x3Fu) << 11);
+        if ((src0 & 3u) != 3u && (src1 & 3u) != 3u && (src2 & 3u) != 3u) continue;
+        if ((d[3] >> 1) & 1u) { all = 1; break; }   /* indexed: any of the 512 */
+        const u32 c = (d[1] >> 12) & 511u;
+        used[c >> 6] |= 1ull << (c & 63u);
+    }
+    memset(r, 0, sizeof *r);
+    if (all) { r->n = 1; r->lo[0] = 0; r->cnt[0] = 512; memset(r->mask, 0xFF, sizeof r->mask); return; }
+    u32 lo[512], hi[512], n = 0;   /* runs, ends included */
+    for (u32 c = 0; c < 512; c++) {
+        if (!((used[c >> 6] >> (c & 63u)) & 1u)) continue;
+        if (n && c - hi[n - 1] <= 4u) hi[n - 1] = c;
+        else { lo[n] = c; hi[n] = c; n++; }
+    }
+    while (n > LD_VC_RUNS) {   /* join the pair with the smallest gap */
+        u32 best = 1;
+        for (u32 k = 2; k < n; k++) if (lo[k] - hi[k - 1] < lo[best] - hi[best - 1]) best = k;
+        hi[best - 1] = hi[best];
+        for (u32 k = best; k + 1 < n; k++) { lo[k] = lo[k + 1]; hi[k] = hi[k + 1]; }
+        n--;
+    }
+    r->n = n;
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < n; k++) {
+        r->lo[k] = (u16)lo[k]; r->cnt[k] = (u16)(hi[k] - lo[k] + 1u);
+        for (u32 c = lo[k]; c <= hi[k]; c++) r->mask[c >> 6] |= 1ull << (c & 63u);
+    }
+}

+/* Besides the hash and the sampled units, what get_pso derives from the program's bytes alone, kept
+ * with the copy (LD_PSO_MEMO=0 derives it every draw): the units the gamma and sign-expansion walks
+ * would accept with every mask set -- the per-draw masks only pick among them -- and the inline
+ * constants rsx_fp_collect_constants reads. */
+typedef struct { u32 loc, off, size; u8* copy; u64 h; u32 sampled, has_sampled;

+static ld_fp_memo s_fp_memo[128];
+/* LD_FP_MEMO (on; 0 = s_fp_memo above, one place per (location, offset) among 128, as before). A race
+ * frame runs more fragment programs than 128 places hold, and two programs whose places shared a slot
+ * pushed each other out on every switch (the memo answered only 57-80% of a race's lookups). Here 2048
+ * entries in sets of 4, the set from the whole (location, offset); a place has at most one entry (a
+ * program rewritten in place takes over its own entry, else an empty way, else the set's ways in turn).
+ * A hit is exactly the old hit: the entry for that place, holding the same bytes as guest memory now.
+ * [pso-memo] (GCM_DRAIN_STAT) says which kind the misses are. Walker thread only (get_pso). */
+#define LD_FPM_SET_BITS 9u
+#define LD_FPM_WAYS 4u
+static ld_fp_memo s_fpm[(1u << LD_FPM_SET_BITS) * LD_FPM_WAYS];
+static u8 s_fpm_next[1u << LD_FPM_SET_BITS];
+static int s_fpm_on = -1;
+static int ld_fpm_on(void)
+{
+    if (s_fpm_on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_FP_MEMO"); s_fpm_on = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
+    return s_fpm_on;

+static u32 ld_fpm_set(u32 loc, u32 off)
+{
+    return (u32)(((((u64)loc << 32) | off) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) >> (64u - LD_FPM_SET_BITS));
+}
+static u64 ld_fp_struct_hash_memo(u32 loc, u32 off, const u8* uc, u32 size)
+{
+    ld_fp_memo* m;
+    if (ld_fpm_on()) {
+        const u32 set = ld_fpm_set(loc, off);
+        ld_fp_memo* const s = &s_fpm[set * LD_FPM_WAYS];
+        m = NULL;
+        for (u32 w = 0; w < LD_FPM_WAYS && !m; w++)
+            if (s[w].copy && s[w].loc == loc && s[w].off == off) m = &s[w];   /* this place's entry */
+        if (m && m->size == size && memcmp(m->copy, uc, size) == 0)
+            return m->h;
+        for (u32 w = 0; w < LD_FPM_WAYS && !m; w++)
+            if (!s[w].copy) m = &s[w];
+        if (!m) m = &s[s_fpm_next[set]++ % LD_FPM_WAYS];
+    } else {
+        m = &s_fp_memo[((off >> 4) ^ (off >> 13) ^ (loc * 7u)) & 127u];
+        if (m->copy && m->loc == loc && m->off == off && m->size == size && memcmp(m->copy, uc, size) == 0)
+            return m->h;
+    }
+    const u64 h = rsx_fp_structural_hash(uc, size, 1469598103934665603ull);
+    if (size <= 16384u) {
+        u8* c = (u8*)realloc(m->copy, size ? size : 1u);
+        if (c) { memcpy(c, uc, size); m->copy = c; m->loc = loc; m->off = off; m->size = size; m->h = h;
+                 m->has_sampled = 0; m->has_cand = 0; m->has_consts = 0; }
+    }
+    return h;
+}
+/* rdtsc ticks in get_pso's parts, its lookups and how many found the fragment memo ([pso-time]). */
+unsigned long long g_pso_tsc[6], g_pso_n, g_pso_fpm;
+/* LD_PSO_KEYCHECK=1: both pipeline keys every draw. A fast key seen with two chain keys would merge
+ * pipelines the chain kept apart (a wrong pipeline drawn); a chain key seen with two fast keys only
+ * builds one more. [0] draws checked, [1] merges, [2] splits, cumulative. */
+unsigned long long g_keycheck[3];
+#define LD_KC_SLOTS (1u << 15)
+static u64 s_kc_fast[LD_KC_SLOTS], s_kc_fast_v[LD_KC_SLOTS], s_kc_chain[LD_KC_SLOTS], s_kc_chain_v[LD_KC_SLOTS];
+static void ld_kc_map(u64* keys, u64* vals, u64 k, u64 v, unsigned long long* conflict)
+{
+    if (!k) k = 1;
+    u32 h = (u32)(k ^ (k >> 32)) & (LD_KC_SLOTS - 1u);
+    for (u32 probe = 0; probe < 64; probe++, h = (h + 1u) & (LD_KC_SLOTS - 1u)) {
+        if (!keys[h]) { keys[h] = k; vals[h] = v; return; }
+        if (keys[h] == k) { if (vals[h] != v) (*conflict)++; return; }
+    }
+}
+static void ld_keycheck_note(u64 fast, u64 chain)
+{
+    g_keycheck[0]++;
+    ld_kc_map(s_kc_fast, s_kc_fast_v, fast, chain, &g_keycheck[1]);
+    ld_kc_map(s_kc_chain, s_kc_chain_v, chain, fast, &g_keycheck[2]);
+}
+static u32 ld_nonzero_units(const u8 masks[16])
+{
+    u32 u = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (masks[i]) u |= 1u << i;
+    return u;
+}
+/* The memo entry for (loc, off) if it holds exactly the bytes there now, else NULL. */
+static ld_fp_memo* ld_fp_memo_match(u32 loc, u32 off)
+{
+    ld_fp_memo* m = NULL;
+    if (ld_fpm_on()) {   /* LD_FP_MEMO */
+        ld_fp_memo* const s = &s_fpm[ld_fpm_set(loc, off) * LD_FPM_WAYS];
+        for (u32 w = 0; w < LD_FPM_WAYS && !m; w++)
+            if (s[w].copy && s[w].loc == loc && s[w].off == off && s[w].size) m = &s[w];
+    } else {
+        m = &s_fp_memo[((off >> 4) ^ (off >> 13) ^ (loc * 7u)) & 127u];
+        if (!m->copy || m->loc != loc || m->off != off || !m->size) m = NULL;
+    }
+    if (!m) { g_fp_memo_miss[0]++; return NULL; }
+    const u8* p = guest_ptr(loc, off, m->size);
+    if (p && memcmp(p, m->copy, m->size) == 0) return m;
+    g_fp_memo_miss[1]++;
+    return NULL;
+}
+
+/* [shreg] The fragment decompiler's register declaration (rsx_fp_decompiler.h, RSX_FP_OPT_REGISTER_VARS):
+ * only the registers a program names, as plain variables or (with flow control) as the arrays zeroed one
+ * register at a time, instead of two 48-register arrays zeroed in a loop. The same bytecode from
+ * D3DCompile for every one of the 34,338 shader texts it was checked on, in about 1.45x less compile time.
+ * LD_FP_REGS=array: the old text. LD_FP_REGS=allvars: plain variables in flow-control programs as well
+ * (those compile about 3x faster but to other code: an experiment). LD_FP_REGS=check: the new text, and
+ * each program is also translated the old way and both are compiled (twice the compile time, on the
+ * calling thread): when the bytecode differs the old text is used and [shader] lines say so, so another
+ * PC (other programs, another d3dcompiler_47.dll) can show it holds there too. Every translation in this
+ * file goes through it, the prepare step's (rsx_shader_prep.inc) as well: the name below is redirected. */
+static int s_fp_reg_mode = -1;   /* 0 arrays, 1 named only, 2 allvars, 3 check */
+static u32 ld_fp_reg_options(void)
+{
+    if (s_fp_reg_mode < 0) {
+        const char* e = getenv("LD_FP_REGS");
+        const int m = e && _stricmp(e, "array") == 0 ? 0 : e && _stricmp(e, "allvars") == 0 ? 2 :
+                      e && _stricmp(e, "check") == 0 ? 3 : 1;
+        fprintf(stderr, "[shader] fragment registers: %s\n", m == 0 ? "arrays (LD_FP_REGS=array)" :
+                m == 2 ? "plain variables everywhere (LD_FP_REGS=allvars)" :
+                m == 3 ? "only those named, each compiled both ways and compared (LD_FP_REGS=check)" :
+                "only those named");
+        s_fp_reg_mode = m;
+    }
+    return s_fp_reg_mode == 0 ? 0u : s_fp_reg_mode == 2 ? (RSX_FP_OPT_REGISTER_VARS | RSX_FP_OPT_VARS_IN_FLOW)
+                                                        : RSX_FP_OPT_REGISTER_VARS;
+}
+static volatile LONG s_fp_check_n, s_fp_check_diff;
+/* LD_FP_REGS=check: 1 when both texts compile to the same bytecode (or both fail). */
+static int ld_fp_same_bytecode(const char* a, const char* b)
+{
+    ID3DBlob* x = NULL; ID3DBlob* y = NULL;
+    const HRESULT hx = D3DCompile(a, strlen(a), "xps", NULL, NULL, "main", "ps_5_0", 0, 0, &x, NULL);
+    const HRESULT hy = D3DCompile(b, strlen(b), "xps", NULL, NULL, "main", "ps_5_0", 0, 0, &y, NULL);
+    int same = FAILED(hx) && FAILED(hy);
+    if (SUCCEEDED(hx) && SUCCEEDED(hy) && x && y) {
+        const SIZE_T n = x->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(x);
+        same = n == y->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(y) &&
+               memcmp(x->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(x), y->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(y), n) == 0;
+    }
+    if (x) x->lpVtbl->Release(x);
+    if (y) y->lpVtbl->Release(y);
+    return same;
+}
+static int ld_fp_decompile(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask, u32 tex_vol_mask,
+                           const rsx_fp_shadow_desc shadow[16], const u8 gamma_masks[16],
+                           const u8 expand_masks[16], char* out, u32 out_size, u32* out_constant_count)
+{
+    const int r = rsx_fp_decompile_opts_ex(ucode, max_bytes, ctrl, tex_cube_mask, tex_vol_mask, shadow,
+                                           gamma_masks, expand_masks, ld_fp_reg_options(), out, out_size,
+                                           out_constant_count);
+    if (s_fp_reg_mode != 3 || r <= 0) return r;
+    char* old = (char*)malloc(out_size);
+    u32 n_old = 0;
+    if (old && rsx_fp_decompile_opts_ex(ucode, max_bytes, ctrl, tex_cube_mask, tex_vol_mask, shadow, gamma_masks,
+                                        expand_masks, 0u, old, out_size, &n_old) > 0 && strcmp(old, out) != 0) {
+        const LONG n = InterlockedIncrement(&s_fp_check_n);
+        if (!ld_fp_same_bytecode(old, out)) {
+            const LONG d = InterlockedIncrement(&s_fp_check_diff);
+            if (d <= 16)
+                fprintf(stderr, "[shader] fragment registers: program %016llX compiles to other code in the new "
+                        "form; the old text is used (%ld of %ld so far)\n", (unsigned long long)
+                        rsx_fp_structural_hash(ucode, max_bytes, 1469598103934665603ull), (long)d, (long)n);
+            memcpy(out, old, strlen(old) + 1);
+        }
+        if ((n & (n - 1)) == 0 || (n & 1023) == 0)
+            fprintf(stderr, "[shader] fragment registers: %ld programs compiled both ways, %ld differ\n",
+                    (long)n, (long)InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_fp_check_diff, 0, 0));
+    }
+    free(old);
+    return r;
+}
+#define rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_shadow_color_expand_vol_ex ld_fp_decompile
+
+/* WPOS on a target held at a resolution scale (and perhaps at a sample grid of sx x sy as well):
+ * SV_POSITION counts host pixels, the program wants guest pixels. The line goes where
+ * rsx_fp_apply_wpos_grid puts its own, first in main, and for the same programs: only one that reads
+ * WPOS is touched, so any other stays byte-identical to its unscaled text. fp_alpha.w holds 1 / scale
+ * (ld_upload_pixel_constants). The position stays continuous: a program that turns it into a texture
+ * coordinate then gets a different one in every host pixel, which is the point of the scale; one that
+ * tests the pixel's parity (a dither) gets the guest's pattern, each cell scale x scale host pixels.
+ * Returns 1 when patched, 0 with nothing to do, -1 without mutation when the entry is not found. */
+static int ld_rs_apply_wpos(char* hlsl, u32 capacity, u32 sx, u32 sy)
+{
+    static const char wpos_read[] = "_rsx_wpos(input.position)";
+    static const char* const entries[] = { "main(PSInput input) : SV_TARGET {\n",
+                                           "main(PSInput input) {\n" };
+    if (!hlsl || !capacity || !sx || !sy) return -1;
+    size_t len = 0;
+    while (len < capacity && hlsl[len]) ++len;
+    if (len == capacity) return -1;
+    if (!strstr(hlsl, wpos_read)) return 0;
+    if (strstr(hlsl, "input.position.xy = ")) return -1;
+    char* body = NULL;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof entries / sizeof entries[0] && !body; ++i) {
+        char* at = strstr(hlsl, entries[i]);
+        if (at) body = at + strlen(entries[i]);
+    }
+    if (!body) return -1;
+    char line[128];
+    const int n = snprintf(line, sizeof line,
+        "    input.position.xy = input.position.xy * fp_alpha.w / float2(%u, %u);\n", sx, sy);
+    if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof line || len + (size_t)n + 1 > capacity) return -1;
+    memmove(body + n, body, len - (size_t)(body - hlsl) + 1);
+    memcpy(body, line, (size_t)n);
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* [mv] The motion-vector variant of a scene draw's two shaders, as edits of the text the decompilers
+ * made (which stay as they are).
+ * Vertex shader: three rows and the frame's jitter after the viewport transform in its constant
+ * block (the bytes of the 8 KB block that follow vp_posoffset), and two outputs right after FOG:
+ *   mvp = (rows . clip position): where this vertex was in the frame before, as host pixel * w and w.
+ *         One matrix does it for every program, whatever it computes its position from, because the
+ *         rows already hold "the previous c[0..3] times the inverse of this frame's";
+ *   mvj = (jitter x, jitter y, 1 when the rows are valid, 0), not interpolated.
+ * Fragment shader: the same two inputs at the same place; its main() becomes _mv_main() and a new
+ * main() returns its colour and, to a second target, previous pixel - this pixel, both without
+ * jitter (SV_Position is the jittered pixel, so the jitter comes off it); 30000 = "no vector" when
+ * the object has no previous transform or the vertex was behind the camera then.
+ * Returns 1 when both were changed; 0, with both untouched, when either is not of the expected
+ * shape (a program with several targets or a depth output keeps its ordinary pipeline). */
+static int ld_mv_text_insert(char* text, size_t cap, const char* after, const char* add)
+{
+    char* at = strstr(text, after);
+    if (!at) return 0;
+    at += strlen(after);
+    const size_t len = strlen(text), n = strlen(add);
+    if (len + n + 1 > cap) return 0;
+    memmove(at + n, at, len - (size_t)(at - text) + 1);
+    memcpy(at, add, n);
+    return 1;
+}
+static int ld_mv_apply_shaders(char* vs, size_t vs_cap, char* ps, size_t ps_cap)
+{
+    static const char vs_cb[]   = "    float4 vp_posoffset;\n";
+    static const char vs_fog[]  = "    float4 fog:FOG;\n";
+    static const char vs_pos[]  = "    Out.pos = float4(_p.xyz * vp_posscale.xyz + _p.w * vp_posoffset.xyz, _p.w);\n";
+    static const char ps_fog[]  = "    float4 fog : FOG;\n";
+    static const char ps_main[] = "float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_TARGET {\n";
+    static const char vs_cb_add[]  = "    float4 vp_mv[3];\n    float4 vp_mvjit;\n";
+    static const char io_add[]     = "    float4 mvp:MVPREV; nointerpolation float4 mvj:MVJIT;\n";
+    static const char vs_pos_add[] =
+        "    Out.mvp = float4(dot(_p, vp_mv[0]), dot(_p, vp_mv[1]), dot(_p, vp_mv[2]), 0.0); Out.mvj = vp_mvjit;\n";
+    static const char ps_main_new[] = "float4 _mv_main(PSInput input) {\n";
+    static const char ps_tail[] =
+        "struct MVOut { float4 c : SV_TARGET0; float4 mv : SV_TARGET1; };\n"
+        "MVOut main(PSInput input) {\n"
+        "    MVOut o;\n"
+        "    o.c = _mv_main(input);\n"
+        "    o.mv = float4(30000.0, 30000.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n"
+        "    if (input.mvj.z > 0.5 && input.mvp.z > 0.0)\n"
+        "        o.mv.xy = clamp(input.mvp.xy / input.mvp.z - (input.position.xy - input.mvj.xy), -4096.0, 4096.0);\n"
+        "    return o;\n"
+        "}\n";
+    /* Everything that can refuse is looked at before either text is touched. */
+    const char* a = strstr(vs, vs_cb);  const char* b = strstr(vs, vs_fog);  const char* c = strstr(vs, vs_pos);
+    const char* d = strstr(ps, ps_fog); char* e = strstr(ps, ps_main);
+    if (!a || !b || !c || !d || !e) return 0;
+    if (strstr(a + 1, vs_cb) || strstr(b + 1, vs_fog) || strstr(c + 1, vs_pos) || strstr(d + 1, ps_fog) || strstr(e + 1, ps_main))
+        return 0;
+    if (strstr(ps, "struct PSOutput") || strstr(ps, "_mv_main") || strstr(vs, "vp_mv")) return 0;
+    if (strlen(vs) + sizeof vs_cb_add + sizeof io_add + sizeof vs_pos_add + 1 > vs_cap) return 0;
+    if (strlen(ps) + sizeof io_add + sizeof ps_tail + 1 > ps_cap) return 0;
+    /* the fragment shader: the entry renamed (the new line is the shorter one), the inputs, the new main */
+    { const size_t old_n = sizeof ps_main - 1, new_n = sizeof ps_main_new - 1;
+      memcpy(e, ps_main_new, new_n);
+      memmove(e + new_n, e + old_n, strlen(e + old_n) + 1); }
+    if (!ld_mv_text_insert(ps, ps_cap, ps_fog, io_add)) return 0;
+    memcpy(ps + strlen(ps), ps_tail, sizeof ps_tail);
+    /* the vertex shader */
+    return ld_mv_text_insert(vs, vs_cap, vs_cb, vs_cb_add) &&
+           ld_mv_text_insert(vs, vs_cap, vs_fog, io_add) &&
+           ld_mv_text_insert(vs, vs_cap, vs_pos, vs_pos_add);
+}
+
+/* [up] The game's copy of the 3D scene into the display buffer, 1080p mode. The scene is 1152 guest
+ * pixels wide there (2304 samples) and the picture 1728: the fragment program takes floor() of the
+ * horizontal coordinate, samples at that guest pixel and at the next, and blends the two by the
+ * fraction. Whatever the texture holds, that is 1152 columns resampled. With the floor() left out the
+ * fraction is 0, the first tap's weight is 0 and the second tap is taken at the continuous coordinate
+ * with the whole weight: one bilinear tap per display pixel, at that pixel's centre. The edit: the one
+ * floor( of the program's own in main (not the one a WPOS snap puts there) becomes the identity.
+ * 1 when made; 0, and the text untouched, for a program without exactly one such floor(. */
+static int ld_up_apply_resolve(char* ps, size_t ps_cap)
+{
+    static const char anchor[] = "float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_TARGET";
+    static const char snap[] = "input.position.xy = ";
+    static const char add[] = "#define _upid(x) (x)\n";
+    char* m = strstr(ps, anchor);
+    if (!m || strstr(m + 1, anchor)) return 0;
+    char* hit = NULL;
+    for (char* f = strstr(m, "floor("); f; f = strstr(f + 1, "floor(")) {
+        if ((size_t)(f - ps) >= sizeof snap - 1u && memcmp(f - (sizeof snap - 1u), snap, sizeof snap - 1u) == 0) continue;
+        if (hit) return 0;
+        hit = f;
+    }
+    if (!hit) return 0;
+    const size_t len = strlen(ps), n = sizeof add - 1u;
+    if (len + n + 1u > ps_cap) return 0;
+    memcpy(hit, "_upid(", 6);                        /* the same length as "floor(" */
+    memmove(m + n, m, len - (size_t)(m - ps) + 1u);
+    memcpy(m, add, n);
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* [prep] Shaders made before their first draw: the lists by program, the store, --prepare-shaders. */
+#include "rsx_shader_prep.inc"   /* .inc, not .c: every .c file in libs/video is built on its own */
+
+/* LD_VP_MEMO (on; 0 = s_vp_memo, one place per `start & 7`, as before). Two programs loaded at the
+ * same start pushed each other out of those 8 places, and each such draw scanned, hashed and walked
+ * its program again. Here 1024 entries in sets of 4, the set picked from the start and up to 16 of the
+ * program's instructions, stopping at its END (the words after it are left over from other programs);
+ * in front, the entry the last draw used, which is what a draw usually runs. A hit is exactly the old
+ * hit: the same start and the same bytes over the whole program (compared in full every time), and
+ * what is kept is computed from the bytes by the same calls. A program with no END is not kept and
+ * comes back with ok = 0, as before. Walker thread only (get_pso). */
+#define LD_VPM_WAYS 4u
+#define LD_VPM_SETS 256u
+static ld_vp_memo s_vpm[LD_VPM_SETS * LD_VPM_WAYS];
+static struct { u64 head[2]; u32 start, instrs; } s_vpm_sig[LD_VPM_SETS * LD_VPM_WAYS];   /* what a search reads */
+static u8 s_vpm_next[LD_VPM_SETS];
+static ld_vp_memo* s_vpm_last;
+static ld_vp_memo s_vpm_none;
+static ld_vp_memo* ld_vp_memo_find(u32 start, const u8* vp_uc)
+{
+    ld_vp_memo* m = s_vpm_last;
+    if (m && m->start == start && memcmp(m->copy, vp_uc, (size_t)m->instrs * 16u) == 0) return m;
+    u64 head[2];
+    memcpy(head, vp_uc, 16);
+    u64 hh = (head[0] ^ (head[1] * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) ^ start) * 0xD6E8FEB86659FD93ull;
+    for (u32 k = 1; k < 16u && start + k < RSX_DSP_VP_INSTR && !(vp_uc[(k - 1u) * 16u + 12u] & 1u); k++) {
+        u64 w0, w1;
+        memcpy(&w0, vp_uc + k * 16u, 8); memcpy(&w1, vp_uc + k * 16u + 8u, 8);
+        hh = (hh ^ w0) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
+        hh = (hh ^ (hh >> 31) ^ w1) * 0xD6E8FEB86659FD93ull;
+    }
+    const u32 set = (u32)(hh >> 40) & (LD_VPM_SETS - 1u), base = set * LD_VPM_WAYS;
+    for (u32 w = 0; w < LD_VPM_WAYS; w++) {
+        const u32 i = base + w;
+        if (!s_vpm_sig[i].instrs || s_vpm_sig[i].start != start ||
+            s_vpm_sig[i].head[0] != head[0] || s_vpm_sig[i].head[1] != head[1]) continue;
+        if (memcmp(s_vpm[i].copy, vp_uc, (size_t)s_vpm[i].instrs * 16u) == 0) return s_vpm_last = &s_vpm[i];
+    }
+    g_vp_memo_miss++;
+    const u32 instrs = rsx_vp_program_size_instrs(vp_uc, (RSX_DSP_VP_INSTR - start) * 16);
+    if (!instrs || instrs > RSX_DSP_VP_INSTR - start) {
+        s_vpm_none.ok = 0; s_vpm_none.start = start; s_vpm_none.instrs = instrs;
+        return &s_vpm_none;
+    }
+    u32 w = 0;   /* an empty way, else the set's ways in turn */
+    while (w < LD_VPM_WAYS && s_vpm_sig[base + w].instrs) w++;
+    if (w == LD_VPM_WAYS) w = s_vpm_next[set]++ % LD_VPM_WAYS;
+    const u32 i = base + w;
+    m = &s_vpm[i];
+    m->start = start;
+    m->instrs = instrs;
+    memcpy(m->copy, vp_uc, (size_t)instrs * 16u);
+    m->txl = vp_txl_unit_mask(vp_uc, instrs);
+    m->branch_used = (u32)rsx_vp_uses_branch_bits(vp_uc, instrs * 16);
+    m->hash = ld_fast_hash(vp_uc, instrs * 16, 1469598103934665603ull);
+    ld_vp_const_runs(vp_uc, instrs, &m->cr);   /* [draw-calls] */
+    m->ok = 1;
+    memcpy(s_vpm_sig[i].head, head, sizeof head);
+    s_vpm_sig[i].start = start;
+    s_vpm_sig[i].instrs = instrs;
+    return s_vpm_last = m;
+}
+
 static ID3D12PipelineState* get_pso(
     const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* masked_layout, int packed_payload)
 {
     memset(&g_ld_current_pso, 0, sizeof(g_ld_current_pso));
+    const unsigned long long pt0 = __rdtsc();
+    static int memo_on = -1;
+    if (memo_on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_PSO_MEMO"); memo_on = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
     const u32 start = rsx_dsp_vp_start(&g.rsx);
     if (start >= RSX_DSP_VP_INSTR) { LD_PSO_BAIL("no vertex program uploaded (vp start out of range)"); return NULL; }
     const u8* vp_uc = (const u8*)(g.rsx.vp + start * 4);
-    const u32 vp_instrs = rsx_vp_program_size_instrs(vp_uc, (RSX_DSP_VP_INSTR - start) * 16);
-    if (!vp_instrs) { LD_PSO_BAIL("vertex program has zero instructions"); return NULL; }
+    static int vp_sets = -1;   /* LD_VP_MEMO: the memo in sets (ld_vp_memo_find); 0 = the 8 places below */
+    if (vp_sets < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_VP_MEMO"); vp_sets = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
+    ld_vp_memo* vpm = vp_sets ? ld_vp_memo_find(start, vp_uc) : &s_vp_memo[start & 7u];
+    if (!vp_sets && !(vpm->ok && vpm->start == start && memcmp(vpm->copy, vp_uc, (size_t)vpm->instrs * 16u) == 0)) {
+        g_vp_memo_miss++;
+        vpm->ok = 0;
+        vpm->start = start;
+        vpm->instrs = rsx_vp_program_size_instrs(vp_uc, (RSX_DSP_VP_INSTR - start) * 16);
+        if (vpm->instrs && vpm->instrs <= RSX_DSP_VP_INSTR - start) {
+            memcpy(vpm->copy, vp_uc, (size_t)vpm->instrs * 16u);
+            vpm->txl = vp_txl_unit_mask(vp_uc, vpm->instrs);
+            vpm->branch_used = (u32)rsx_vp_uses_branch_bits(vp_uc, vpm->instrs * 16);
+            vpm->hash = ld_fast_hash(vp_uc, vpm->instrs * 16, 1469598103934665603ull);
+            ld_vp_const_runs(vp_uc, vpm->instrs, &vpm->cr);   /* [draw-calls] */
+            vpm->ok = 1;
+        }
+    }
+    const u32 vp_instrs = vpm->instrs;
+    if (!vp_instrs || !vpm->ok) { LD_PSO_BAIL("vertex program has zero instructions"); return NULL; }
+    const unsigned long long pt1 = __rdtsc();
 
     u32 fp_loc = 0;
     const u32 fp_off = rsx_dsp_fragment_program(&g.rsx, &fp_loc);
     const u8* fp_uc = guest_ptr(fp_loc, fp_off, 16);
     if (!fp_uc) { LD_PSO_BAIL("fragment program address does not resolve to guest memory"); return NULL; }
-    const u32 fp_size = rsx_fp_program_size(fp_uc, 0x10000);
+    ld_fp_memo* const fpm = ld_fp_memo_match(fp_loc, fp_off);

+/* Vertex conversion on several cores. A race frame converts about a million vertices into
+ * float4 attributes on the RSX thread. rsx_vertex_fetch_many does it an attribute at a time
+ * (the same bytes as fetch_one per vertex: tests/test_vertex_fetch_plan.c) and only reads the
+ * plan and guest memory, so a big draw is cut into chunks that workers and this thread take in
+ * turn. The job is tagged with a generation so a worker that wakes late can never count a chunk
+ * twice. LD_VERTEX_THREADS=<n> workers (default 6, 0 = this thread only). */
+#define LD_VP_CHUNK 2048u
+#define LD_VP_MIN   4096u
+static struct { const rsx_vertex_fetch_plan* plan; const rsx_vertex_ref* refs; u8* out; u32 stride, count, nchunks; } s_vp;
+static volatile LONG64 s_vp_ctr;        /* generation << 32 | next chunk */
+static volatile LONG s_vp_done, s_vp_fail;
+static HANDLE s_vp_sem;
+static int s_vp_workers = -1;
+LONGLONG g_vx_pub[3];
+unsigned long long g_vx_pub_n[2];
+#define g_vx_gather g_vx_pub[0]
+#define g_vx_remap g_vx_pub[1]
+#define g_vx_fetch g_vx_pub[2]
+#define g_vx_verts g_vx_pub_n[0]
+#define g_vx_par_verts g_vx_pub_n[1]
+static void ld_vp_run(void)
+{
+    for (;;) {
+        const LONG64 v = InterlockedIncrement64(&s_vp_ctr) - 1;
+        const u32 c = (u32)(v & 0xFFFFFFFF);
+        if (c >= s_vp.nchunks) return;
+        const u32 i0 = c * LD_VP_CHUNK;
+        const u32 n = s_vp.count - i0 < LD_VP_CHUNK ? s_vp.count - i0 : LD_VP_CHUNK;
+        if (!rsx_vertex_fetch_many(s_vp.plan, s_vp.refs + i0, n, s_vp.out + (size_t)i0 * s_vp.stride))
+            InterlockedExchange(&s_vp_fail, 1);
+        InterlockedIncrement(&s_vp_done);
+    }
+}
+static DWORD WINAPI ld_vp_worker(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    for (;;) { WaitForSingleObject(s_vp_sem, INFINITE); ld_vp_run(); }
+}
+static int ld_fetch_vertices(const rsx_vertex_fetch_plan* plan, const rsx_vertex_ref* refs, u32 count, u8* out)
+{
+    if (s_vp_workers < 0) {
+        const char* e = getenv("LD_VERTEX_THREADS");
+        s_vp_workers = e ? atoi(e) : 6;
+        if (s_vp_workers > 16) s_vp_workers = 16;
+        if (s_vp_workers > 0) {
+            s_vp_sem = CreateSemaphoreA(NULL, 0, 1 << 20, NULL);
+            int started = 0;
+            for (int i = 0; s_vp_sem && i < s_vp_workers; i++) {
+                HANDLE t = CreateThread(NULL, 256 * 1024, ld_vp_worker, NULL, 0, NULL);
+                if (t) { CloseHandle(t); started++; }
+            }
+            s_vp_workers = started;
+        }
+        fprintf(stderr, "[vertex] conversion on %d worker thread(s) plus the RSX thread\n", s_vp_workers);
+    }
+    g_vx_verts += count;
+    if (count < LD_VP_MIN || s_vp_workers <= 0 || !plan->layout.stride)
+        return rsx_vertex_fetch_many(plan, refs, count, out);
+    g_vx_par_verts += count;
+    s_vp.plan = plan; s_vp.refs = refs; s_vp.out = out;
+    s_vp.stride = plan->layout.stride; s_vp.count = count;
+    s_vp.nchunks = (count + LD_VP_CHUNK - 1) / LD_VP_CHUNK;
+    s_vp_done = 0; s_vp_fail = 0;
+    const LONG64 gen = (s_vp_ctr >> 32) + 1;
+    InterlockedExchange64(&s_vp_ctr, gen << 32);
+    const LONG wake = (LONG)(s_vp.nchunks - 1 < (u32)s_vp_workers ? s_vp.nchunks - 1 : (u32)s_vp_workers);
+    if (wake > 0) ReleaseSemaphore(s_vp_sem, wake, NULL);
+    ld_vp_run();
+    while ((u32)InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_vp_done, 0, 0) < s_vp.nchunks) YieldProcessor();
+    /* Park the counter past the end, so a worker waking now finds nothing to take. */
+    InterlockedExchange64(&s_vp_ctr, (gen << 32) | 0x80000000);
+    return !s_vp_fail;
+}
+
+#if defined(__SSE4_1__)
+#include <smmintrin.h>
+/* Big-endian indices to vertex references, 8 (16-bit) or 4 (32-bit) at a time, until a block holds
+ * the restart value or fewer than a block remain. Returns how many were done; the caller does the
+ * rest one at a time, so a restart is always handled by the ordinary path. */
+static u32 ld_gather_fast(const u8* src, u32 count, int is_u32, int restart_enabled, u32 restart_value,
+                          u32 base_index, rsx_vertex_ref* out)
+{
+    u32 i = 0;
+    const __m128i base = _mm_set1_epi32((int)base_index);
+    if (!is_u32) {
+        const __m128i sw = _mm_setr_epi8(1, 0, 3, 2, 5, 4, 7, 6, 9, 8, 11, 10, 13, 12, 15, 14);
+        const int chk = restart_enabled && restart_value <= 0xFFFFu;
+        const __m128i rv = _mm_set1_epi16((short)(restart_value & 0xFFFFu));
+        for (; i + 8 <= count; i += 8) {
+            const __m128i x = _mm_shuffle_epi8(_mm_loadu_si128((const __m128i*)(src + (size_t)i * 2u)), sw);
+            if (chk && _mm_movemask_epi8(_mm_cmpeq_epi16(x, rv))) break;
+            const __m128i lo = _mm_cvtepu16_epi32(x);
+            const __m128i hi = _mm_cvtepu16_epi32(_mm_srli_si128(x, 8));
+            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)(out + i), _mm_unpacklo_epi32(lo, base));
+            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)(out + i + 2), _mm_unpackhi_epi32(lo, base));
+            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)(out + i + 4), _mm_unpacklo_epi32(hi, base));
+            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)(out + i + 6), _mm_unpackhi_epi32(hi, base));
+        }
+    } else {
+        const __m128i sw = _mm_setr_epi8(3, 2, 1, 0, 7, 6, 5, 4, 11, 10, 9, 8, 15, 14, 13, 12);
+        const __m128i rv = _mm_set1_epi32((int)restart_value);
+        for (; i + 4 <= count; i += 4) {
+            const __m128i x = _mm_shuffle_epi8(_mm_loadu_si128((const __m128i*)(src + (size_t)i * 4u)), sw);
+            if (restart_enabled && _mm_movemask_epi8(_mm_cmpeq_epi32(x, rv))) break;
+            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)(out + i), _mm_unpacklo_epi32(x, base));
+            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)(out + i + 2), _mm_unpackhi_epi32(x, base));
+        }
+    }
+    return i;
+}
+#endif
+
+/* ---- LD_VCACHE: converted draws kept across frames -------------------------------------------
+ * GT5 draws the same car and track meshes every frame from memory nothing rewrites, and each draw
+ * used to gather its indices, de-duplicate them and convert every vertex again (4.5 ms a frame,
+ * plus 0.9 ms copying into the ring). Here a draw's result -- its float vertices and its triangle
+ * list -- is kept in a GPU-visible arena, keyed by everything that decides it (the index and vertex
+ * array registers, the attributes the program reads, their defaults), and reused while the guest
+ * pages it was read from are unwritten. Windows write tracking (MEM_WRITE_WATCH on the guest
+ * reservation, vm.h) says whether they were: a query is about a microsecond, where converting a
+ * draw averaged five. This is the same idea as Xenia's and RPCS3's page watches, without faults.
+ *
+ * A key's pages are reset first and its data read afterwards, so a write can never slip between
+ * the read and the reset: a new key records its pages and resets them, the next sighting with
+ * those pages still clean converts and stores, and later ones draw from the store. A key whose
+ * pages keep being written (dynamic geometry) is left to the ordinary path after two strikes.
+ * LD_VCACHE=0 turns it off; LD_VCACHE_MB sizes the arena (default 384). */
+#define LD_VC_SLOTS 16384u
+#define LD_VC_SPANS 4u
+typedef struct {
+    u32 prim, mask, n_arr, n_idx, idx_loc, idx_off, idx_u32, restart, restart_value, base_index,
+        base_offset, divider;
+    batch_t first;     /* the first batch, the total count, and a hash of the whole batch list: */
+    u32 total;         /* NV4097 caps a batch at 256 indices, so a mesh is usually dozens of them */
+    u64 batches_hash;
+    struct { rsx_dsp_vertex_attr d; float def[4]; } a[16];
+} ld_vc_key;
+typedef struct {
+    u64 h;
+    ld_vc_key k;
+    u8 state;      /* 0 empty, 1 pages recorded, 2 stored, 3 left alone */
+    u8 strikes, indexed, n_spans;
+    u32 gen;       /* the write generation its pages were last known clean at */
+    u32 last_frame;   /* last frame it was looked up: the oldest one in a crowded run is replaced */
+    u32 vb_off, n_verts, ib_off, n_index;
+    const u8* lo[LD_VC_SPANS];
+    const u8* hi[LD_VC_SPANS];
+} ld_vc_entry;
+static ld_vc_entry* s_vc;
+static ID3D12Resource* s_vc_buf;
+static u8* s_vc_mapped;
+static u64 s_vc_size, s_vc_used;
+static int s_vc_on = -1;
+unsigned long long g_vc_stat[8];   /* hit, stored, recorded, dirty, left alone, unkeyable, wipes, failed */
+/* LD_VC_EVICT (on; 0 = the wipe as before): a full arena used to wait for the whole GPU and empty all
+ * 16,384 entries, and every draw was then converted again over the next frames (a hitch, then a burst).
+ * Now the arena is LD_VC_CHUNKS equal chunks, each filled from its start; when the one being filled is
+ * full, the next is one never used yet or else the one whose stored draws cost least to convert again
+ * (fewest vertices drawn from it in the last LD_VC_HOT frames, then the longest unused). Only that
+ * chunk's entries go, back to "pages recorded", so the next clean sighting stores them again. The GPU
+ * may still read the chunk: each chunk keeps the fence of the last command list that drew from it
+ * (ld_vc_note_draw), and the chunk is reused only once that fence has passed -- usually long since; if
+ * the open list itself draws from it, it is submitted and waited for, as the wipe did. Walker thread
+ * only, like everything else of the vertex cache. */
+#define LD_VC_CHUNKS 8u
+#define LD_VC_HOT 120u
+static int s_vc_evict = -1;
+static u64 s_vc_chunk_size;
+static struct { u64 used, fence; } s_vc_chunk[LD_VC_CHUNKS];
+static u32 s_vc_cur, s_vc_fresh = 1;   /* the chunk being filled; chunks from s_vc_fresh on were never used */
+static HANDLE s_vc_fence_evt;
+unsigned long long g_vc_evict[3];   /* chunks evicted, entries dropped, GPU waits for one (cumulative) */
+unsigned long long g_vc_why[6];    /* record failed: index ptr, attr not contiguous, no pages, too spread, reset failed, query failed */
+extern uint8_t* vm_base;
+static void ld_vc_fail(int why, const void* at)
+{
+    g_vc_why[why]++;
+    static int n;
+    if (n < 6) { n++; fprintf(stderr, "[vcache] cannot track a draw: reason %d at %p (guest base %p) err=%lu\n",
+                             why, at, (void*)vm_base, (unsigned long)GetLastError()); }
+}
+
+static int ld_vc_enabled(void)
+{
+    if (s_vc_on < 0) {
+        const char* e = getenv("LD_VCACHE");
+        s_vc_on = !(e && atoi(e) == 0);
+        if (s_vc_on) {
+            s_vc = (ld_vc_entry*)calloc(LD_VC_SLOTS, sizeof(ld_vc_entry));
+            const char* m = getenv("LD_VCACHE_MB");
+            s_vc_size = (u64)(m ? atoi(m) : 384) << 20;
+            if (!s_vc || s_vc_size < (16u << 20)) s_vc_on = 0;
+        }
+        { const char* v = getenv("LD_VC_EVICT"); s_vc_evict = !(v && atoi(v) == 0); }
+        s_vc_chunk_size = s_vc_size / LD_VC_CHUNKS;   /* a multiple of 128 KB: the arena is whole MB */
+        fprintf(stderr, "[vcache] %s%s\n", s_vc_on ? "on: converted draws are kept while their guest pages are unwritten" : "off",
+                s_vc_on ? (s_vc_evict ? "; a full arena gives up its coldest eighth (LD_VC_EVICT)" : "; a full arena is emptied (LD_VC_EVICT=0)") : "");
+    }
+    return s_vc_on;
+}
+
+static int ld_vc_key_build(ld_vc_key* k, u32 prim, const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* layout)
+{
+    if (dc.n_arr + dc.n_idx == 0 || (dc.n_arr && dc.n_idx) || dc.inl || dc.n_immediate) return 0;
+    memset(k, 0, sizeof *k);
+    k->prim = prim; k->mask = layout->mask; k->n_arr = dc.n_arr; k->n_idx = dc.n_idx;
+    const batch_t* bl = dc.n_idx ? dc.idx : dc.arr;
+    const u32 nb = dc.n_idx ? dc.n_idx : dc.n_arr;
+    k->first = bl[0];
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < nb; i++) k->total += bl[i].count;
+    k->batches_hash = ld_fast_hash(bl, nb * (u32)sizeof(batch_t), 0x9E3779B185EBCA87ull);
+    if (dc.n_idx) {
+        rsx_dsp_index_array ia; rsx_dsp_get_index_array(&g.rsx, &ia);
+        k->idx_loc = ia.location; k->idx_off = ia.offset; k->idx_u32 = ia.is_u32;
+        k->restart = (u32)rsx_dsp_restart_index_enabled(&g.rsx, ia.is_u32);
+        k->restart_value = rsx_dsp_restart_index(&g.rsx);
+        k->base_index = rsx_dsp_vertex_data_base_index(&g.rsx);
+    }
+    k->base_offset = rsx_dsp_vertex_data_base_offset(&g.rsx);
+    k->divider = rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, 0x1FC0);
+    for (u32 s = 0; s < layout->count; s++) {
+        const u32 a = layout->attrs[s];
+        rsx_dsp_get_vertex_attr(&g.rsx, a, &k->a[a].d);
+        rsx_dsp_vertex_default(&g.rsx, a, k->a[a].def);
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* Windows keeps one written-or-not bit per page, and many draws share a page (GT5's SPU jobs
+ * pack dozens of small vertex chunks into one): an entry that reset a page's bit hid the write
+ * that had changed its neighbour's data. So the bits are harvested into a generation per guest
+ * page instead -- each harvest takes the written pages and resets them, and stamps them with a
+ * new generation -- and an entry is clean while none of its pages is newer than its own. */
+#define LD_VC_SPAN_PAGES 2048u                 /* 8 MB: the largest span tracked */
+static u32* s_vc_page_gen;                     /* one per 4 KB of the 4 GB guest space */
+static u32 s_vc_gen = 1;
+static void* s_vc_addr[LD_VC_SPAN_PAGES];
+static int ld_vc_harvest(const u8* lo, const u8* hi)
+{
+    if (!s_vc_page_gen) {
+        s_vc_page_gen = (u32*)calloc(1u << 20, sizeof(u32));
+        if (!s_vc_page_gen) return 0;
+    }
+    if ((u64)(hi - lo) > (u64)LD_VC_SPAN_PAGES * 4096u || lo < vm_base || hi > vm_base + 0x100000000ull) return 0;
+    g_dc[DC_WW_CALLS]++; g_dc[DC_WW_PAGES] += (u64)(hi - lo) >> 12;   /* [draw-calls] */
+    ULONG_PTR n = LD_VC_SPAN_PAGES; ULONG gran = 0;
+    static int noreset = -1;   /* LD_VCACHE_NORESET=1: query without resetting (debug; nothing ever reads clean) */
+    if (noreset < 0) noreset = getenv("LD_VCACHE_NORESET") ? 1 : 0;
+    if (GetWriteWatch(noreset ? 0 : WRITE_WATCH_FLAG_RESET, (void*)lo, (SIZE_T)(hi - lo), s_vc_addr, &n, &gran) != 0) return 0;
+    if (n) {
+        const u32 gen = ++s_vc_gen;
+        for (ULONG_PTR i = 0; i < n; i++)
+            s_vc_page_gen[(u32)(((const u8*)s_vc_addr[i] - vm_base) >> 12)] = gen;
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* Textures: GT5 hashed every bound texture once a frame to see whether the guest had rewritten
+ * it. When none of its pages has been written since the last look, the content is the same and
+ * the hash is skipped; otherwise the pages are harvested before the hash reads them, so a write
+ * during or after the read shows next time. LD_TEX_PAGES=0 hashes as before. */
+static int ld_tex_pages_unwritten(texcache_t* entry, const rsx_dsp_texture* t)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* v = getenv("LD_TEX_PAGES"); on = !v || atoi(v) != 0; }
+    if (!on) return 0;
+    const u32 span = texture_source_span(t);
+    const u8* src = span ? guest_ptr(t->location, t->offset, span) : NULL;
+    if (!src) { entry->wgen = 0; return 0; }
+    const u8* lo = (const u8*)((uintptr_t)src & ~(uintptr_t)4095);
+    const u8* hi = (const u8*)(((uintptr_t)src + span + 4095) & ~(uintptr_t)4095);
+    g_tex_page_look++;
+    if (!ld_vc_harvest(lo, hi)) { entry->wgen = 0; return 0; }
+    const u32 since = entry->wgen;
+    entry->wgen = s_vc_gen;     /* what the hash about to run (if any) reads is at least this new */
+    if (!since) return 0;
+    for (const u8* pg = lo; pg < hi; pg += 4096)
+        if (s_vc_page_gen[(u32)((pg - vm_base) >> 12)] > since) return 0;
+    entry->last_hash_frame = g_ld_frames;
+    g_tex_page_skip++;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* 1: none of the entry's pages written since its generation; 0: written; -1: cannot tell.
+ * [draw-calls] LD_VC_HULL=<pages> (default 256, 0 = off): an entry's spans (sorted, apart) are harvested
+ * in one call over all of them when that adds no more than so many pages between them. A call costs
+ * ~2 us on a P-core and ~4 us on an E-core whatever its size, a page in it 2-6 ns more (scratchpad
+ * perf2\unit\gww_bench.c). Harvesting the pages between only stamps their own generations, as their
+ * own users' harvests would; which pages decide the entry is unchanged (the loop below). */
+static int ld_vc_clean(const ld_vc_entry* e)
+{
+    static int hull = -1;
+    if (hull < 0) { const char* v = getenv("LD_VC_HULL"); hull = v && *v ? atoi(v) : 256; if (hull < 0) hull = 0; }
+    int one = 0;
+    if (hull && s_dc.vc_hull && e->n_spans > 1) {
+        u64 inside = 0;
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < e->n_spans; i++) inside += (u64)(e->hi[i] - e->lo[i]);
+        const u64 whole = (u64)(e->hi[e->n_spans - 1] - e->lo[0]);
+        one = e->hi[e->n_spans - 1] > e->lo[0] && whole <= (u64)LD_VC_SPAN_PAGES * 4096u &&
+              whole - inside <= (u64)hull * 4096u;
+    }
+    if (one) {
+        if (!ld_vc_harvest(e->lo[0], e->hi[e->n_spans - 1])) { ld_vc_fail(5, e->lo[0]); return -1; }
+        g_dc[DC_WW_SAVED] += e->n_spans - 1u;
+    } else
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < e->n_spans; i++)
+        if (!ld_vc_harvest(e->lo[i], e->hi[i])) { ld_vc_fail(5, e->lo[i]); return -1; }
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < e->n_spans; i++)
+        for (const u8* pg = e->lo[i]; pg < e->hi[i]; pg += 4096)
+            if (s_vc_page_gen[(u32)((pg - vm_base) >> 12)] > e->gen) return 0;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* The guest pages this draw read: its index ranges and each fetched attribute's span, page-aligned,
+ * merged, at most LD_VC_SPANS of them, harvested. 0 when they cannot be named or tracked. */
+static int ld_vc_record(ld_vc_entry* e)
+{
+    /* One span for the index array (its batches, up to 256 of them, read one array) plus one per
+     * attribute: at most 17. */
+    const u8* lo[RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR + 1]; const u8* hi[RSX_DSP_NUM_VERTEX_ATTR + 1]; u32 n = 0;
+    if (dc.n_idx) {
+        rsx_dsp_index_array ia; rsx_dsp_get_index_array(&g.rsx, &ia);
+        const u32 es = ia.is_u32 ? 4u : 2u;
+        u64 first = ~0ull, end = 0;
+        for (u32 bi = 0; bi < dc.n_idx; bi++) {
+            const u64 start = (u64)ia.offset + (u64)dc.idx[bi].first * es, bytes = (u64)dc.idx[bi].count * es;
+            if (!bytes) continue;
+            if (start < first) first = start;
+            if (start + bytes > end) end = start + bytes;
+        }
+        if (end > first) {
+            if (end > 0x100000000ull || end - first > (16u << 20)) { ld_vc_fail(0, NULL); return 0; }
+            const u8* q = guest_ptr(ia.location, (u32)first, (u32)(end - first));
+            if (!q) { ld_vc_fail(0, NULL); return 0; }
+            lo[n] = q; hi[n] = q + (end - first); n++;
+        }
+    }
+    for (u32 s = 0; s < dc.layout.count; s++) {
+        const rsx_vertex_fetch_attr* f = &dc.fetch_plan.attr[dc.layout.attrs[s]];
+        if (!f->desc.type || !f->desc.size) continue;          /* its default is in the key */
+        if (!f->stable_base || f->stable_last < f->stable_first) { ld_vc_fail(1, f->stable_base); return 0; }
+        lo[n] = f->stable_base;
+        hi[n] = f->stable_base + (u64)(f->stable_last - f->stable_first) * f->stride + f->elem_size;
+        n++;
+    }
+    if (!n) { ld_vc_fail(2, NULL); return 0; }
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < n; i++) {
+        lo[i] = (const u8*)((uintptr_t)lo[i] & ~(uintptr_t)4095);
+        hi[i] = (const u8*)(((uintptr_t)hi[i] + 4095) & ~(uintptr_t)4095);
+    }
+    for (u32 i = 1; i < n; i++)                                 /* insertion sort by start */
+        for (u32 j = i; j > 0 && lo[j] < lo[j - 1]; j--) {
+            const u8* t = lo[j]; lo[j] = lo[j - 1]; lo[j - 1] = t;
+            t = hi[j]; hi[j] = hi[j - 1]; hi[j - 1] = t;
+        }
+    u32 m = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < n; i++) {
+        if (m && lo[i] <= hi[m - 1] + 16384) { if (hi[i] > hi[m - 1]) hi[m - 1] = hi[i]; continue; }
+        lo[m] = lo[i]; hi[m] = hi[i]; m++;
+    }
+    if (m > LD_VC_SPANS) {                                       /* one span over all of it, if small */
+        if (hi[m - 1] - lo[0] > (8u << 20)) { ld_vc_fail(3, lo[0]); return 0; }
+        hi[0] = hi[m - 1]; m = 1;
+    }
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < m; i++) {
+        if (!ld_vc_harvest(lo[i], hi[i])) { ld_vc_fail(4, lo[i]); return 0; }
+        e->lo[i] = lo[i]; e->hi[i] = hi[i];
+    }
+    e->n_spans = (u8)m;
+    e->gen = s_vc_gen;   /* writes from here on show as newer */
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* What to do with this draw: 0 the ordinary path, 1 ordinary path then record its pages,
+ * 2 ordinary conversion stored into the arena, 3 drawn from the arena. */
+static int ld_vc_find(u32 prim, const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* layout, ld_vc_entry** out)
+{
+    *out = NULL;
+    if (!ld_vc_enabled()) return 0;
+    ld_vc_key k;
+    if (!ld_vc_key_build(&k, prim, layout)) { g_vc_stat[5]++; return 0; }
+    const u64 h = ld_fast_hash(&k, (u32)sizeof k, 0x51ED270B27D4EB4Full) | 1u;
+    u32 i = (u32)(h >> 17) & (LD_VC_SLOTS - 1u);
+    ld_vc_entry* empty = NULL;
+    ld_vc_entry* oldest = NULL;
+    for (u32 probe = 0; probe < 32; probe++, i = (i + 1u) & (LD_VC_SLOTS - 1u)) {
+        ld_vc_entry* e = &s_vc[i];
+        if (!e->state) { if (!empty) empty = e; break; }
+        if (!oldest || e->last_frame < oldest->last_frame) oldest = e;
+        if (e->h != h || memcmp(&e->k, &k, sizeof k) != 0) continue;
+        e->last_frame = g_ld_frames;
+        if (e->state == 3) { g_vc_stat[4]++; return 0; }
+        *out = e;
+        if (!e->n_spans) return 1;
+        const int c = ld_vc_clean(e);
+        if (c < 0) { e->state = 3; g_vc_stat[7]++; return 0; }
+        if (c == 0) {
+            g_vc_stat[3]++;
+            if (++e->strikes >= 2) { e->state = 3; *out = NULL; return 0; }
+            e->state = 1; e->n_spans = 0;
+            return 1;
+        }
+        if (e->state == 2) {
+            static int nohit = -1;   /* LD_VCACHE_NOHIT=1: track and store, never draw from the arena (debug) */
+            if (nohit < 0) nohit = getenv("LD_VCACHE_NOHIT") ? 1 : 0;
+            if (nohit) return 0;
+            g_vc_stat[0]++; return 3;
+        }
+        return 2;
+    }
+    /* Not in the table. A draw from a ring buffer has a new address every frame and would fill
+     * the table with keys that never come back, so a key gets a slot only when it is seen a second
+     * time; until then one word per hash bucket remembers it. */
+    static u64 s_vc_seen[1u << 16];
+    u64* seen = &s_vc_seen[(u32)(h >> 7) & 0xFFFFu];
+    if (*seen != h) { *seen = h; g_vc_stat[5]++; return 0; }
+    ld_vc_entry* e = empty ? empty : oldest;   /* crowded: replace the one unused the longest */
+    if (!e) { g_vc_stat[5]++; return 0; }
+    memset(e, 0, sizeof *e);
+    e->h = h; e->k = k; e->state = 1; e->last_frame = g_ld_frames;
+    *out = e;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* LD_VC_EVICT: a draw from the arena was just recorded into the open list, which the next ld_flush
+ * submits with fence g.fence_value + 1; its chunk may not be reused before that fence has passed.
+ * Noted after the draw call, so a flush between the arena lookup and the call cannot leave the
+ * chunk's fence one list short. */
+static void ld_vc_note_draw(u32 vb_off)
+{
+    if (s_vc_evict > 0 && s_vc_chunk_size) {
+        const u32 c = (u32)(vb_off / s_vc_chunk_size);
+        if (c < LD_VC_CHUNKS) s_vc_chunk[c].fence = g.fence_value + 1u;
+    }
+}
+
+/* LD_VC_EVICT: an empty chunk for the next stores; LD_VC_CHUNKS when none can be had (the draw then
+ * takes the ring). A chunk never used is taken as it is; else the one whose stored draws were drawn
+ * least lately (their vertices over the last LD_VC_HOT frames; then the one unused the longest) is
+ * emptied: its entries go back to "pages recorded" (state 1 with their spans and generation, which a
+ * clean sighting turns into a fresh conversion and store), after the GPU has passed the last list that
+ * drew from it. Entries replaced or found dirty earlier left their bytes in the chunk; the chunk's
+ * fence covers those draws too. Rare: the scan is over the 16,384 entries, about a millisecond. */
+static u32 ld_vc_chunk_free(void)
+{
+    if (s_vc_fresh < LD_VC_CHUNKS) return s_vc_fresh++;
+    u64 hot[LD_VC_CHUNKS] = {0};
+    u32 age[LD_VC_CHUNKS];
+    for (u32 c = 0; c < LD_VC_CHUNKS; c++) age[c] = ~0u;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < LD_VC_SLOTS; i++) {
+        const ld_vc_entry* e = &s_vc[i];
+        if (e->state != 2) continue;
+        const u32 c = (u32)(e->vb_off / s_vc_chunk_size);
+        if (c >= LD_VC_CHUNKS) continue;
+        const u32 a = g_ld_frames - e->last_frame;
+        if (a <= LD_VC_HOT) hot[c] += e->n_verts;
+        if (a < age[c]) age[c] = a;
+    }
+    u32 v = 0;
+    for (u32 c = 1; c < LD_VC_CHUNKS; c++)
+        if (hot[c] < hot[v] || (hot[c] == hot[v] && age[c] > age[v])) v = c;
+    const u64 f = s_vc_chunk[v].fence;
+    if (f > g.fence_value) {
+        /* The open list draws from it: submit and wait, as the wipe did, and the rings start over. */
+        ld_flush(LD_FLUSH_VERTEX_RING);
+        g.vb_used = 0; g.ib_used = 0; g.cb_used = 0; g.ps_cb_used = 0;
+        g.srv_ring_used = 0; g.smp_ring_used = 0;
+        g_vc_evict[2]++;
+        if (!g.ready) return LD_VC_CHUNKS;
+    } else if (f && g.fence->lpVtbl->GetCompletedValue(g.fence) < f) {
+        /* Submitted but maybe not finished: wait for that list alone. */
+        if (!s_vc_fence_evt) s_vc_fence_evt = CreateEventA(NULL, FALSE, FALSE, NULL);
+        if (!s_vc_fence_evt || FAILED(g.fence->lpVtbl->SetEventOnCompletion(g.fence, f, s_vc_fence_evt)))
+            return LD_VC_CHUNKS;
+        WaitForSingleObject(s_vc_fence_evt, INFINITE);
+        g_vc_evict[2]++;
+    }
+    u32 dropped = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < LD_VC_SLOTS; i++) {
+        ld_vc_entry* e = &s_vc[i];
+        if (e->state == 2 && (u32)(e->vb_off / s_vc_chunk_size) == v) { e->state = 1; dropped++; }
+    }
+    s_vc_chunk[v].used = 0;
+    s_vc_chunk[v].fence = 0;
+    g_vc_evict[0]++;
+    g_vc_evict[1] += dropped;
+    return v;
+}

+/* Arena space for a store; a full arena is emptied, after the GPU has finished with it (with
+ * LD_VC_EVICT, one chunk of it: ld_vc_chunk_free). Returns 0 (and the draw takes the ring) when the
+ * arena was just emptied or cannot be made, or no chunk could be had. */
+static int ld_vc_alloc(u64 vb_bytes, u64 ib_bytes, u32* vb_off, u32* ib_off)
+{
+    if (!s_vc_buf) {
+        D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp = {0}; hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD;
+        D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC bd = {0};
+        bd.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER; bd.Width = s_vc_size;
+        bd.Height = 1; bd.DepthOrArraySize = 1; bd.MipLevels = 1;
+        bd.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN; bd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
+        bd.Layout = D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR;
+        if (FAILED(g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateCommittedResource(g.dev, &hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &bd,
+                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, NULL, &IID_ID3D12Resource, (void**)&s_vc_buf)) || !s_vc_buf) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "[vcache] cannot create the %llu MB arena; off\n", (unsigned long long)(s_vc_size >> 20));
+            s_vc_on = 0; s_vc_buf = NULL;
+            return 0;
+        }
+        D3D12_RANGE rr = {0, 0};
+        s_vc_buf->lpVtbl->Map(s_vc_buf, 0, &rr, (void**)&s_vc_mapped);
+    }
+    const u64 need = ((vb_bytes + 255u) & ~255ull) + ((ib_bytes + 255u) & ~255ull);
+    if (need > s_vc_size / 8) return 0;
+    if (s_vc_evict > 0 && s_vc_chunk_size) {   /* LD_VC_EVICT: a store never spans two chunks (need <= s_vc_size / 8 = a chunk) */
+        if (s_vc_chunk[s_vc_cur].used + need > s_vc_chunk_size) {
+            const u32 next = ld_vc_chunk_free();
+            if (next >= LD_VC_CHUNKS) return 0;
+            s_vc_cur = next;
+        }
+        const u64 at = (u64)s_vc_cur * s_vc_chunk_size + s_vc_chunk[s_vc_cur].used;
+        *vb_off = (u32)at;
+        *ib_off = (u32)(at + ((vb_bytes + 255u) & ~255ull));
+        s_vc_chunk[s_vc_cur].used += need;
+        return 1;
+    }
+    if (s_vc_used + need > s_vc_size) {
+        ld_flush(LD_FLUSH_VERTEX_RING);   /* waits: nothing in flight reads the arena after this */
+        g.vb_used = 0; g.ib_used = 0; g.cb_used = 0; g.ps_cb_used = 0;
+        g.srv_ring_used = 0; g.smp_ring_used = 0;
+        memset(s_vc, 0, (size_t)LD_VC_SLOTS * sizeof(ld_vc_entry));
+        s_vc_used = 0;
+        g_vc_stat[6]++;
+        return 0;
+    }
+    *vb_off = (u32)s_vc_used;
+    *ib_off = (u32)(s_vc_used + ((vb_bytes + 255u) & ~255ull));
+    s_vc_used += need;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* LD_VX_DIRECT (on; 0 = always de-duplicate, as before). A draw's references used to be de-duplicated
+ * (rsx_vertex_remap_build) and only the distinct vertices converted, in first-use order. When the
+ * vertices a draw names fill nearly all of their range, that work buys little: here the whole range
+ * [lowest, highest] is converted in vertex order and each index becomes its vertex less the lowest --
+ * the draw's own indices, rebased. Taken only when
+ *   - every reference has the same base index and highest + base index stays under the 20-bit wrap,
+ *     so the elements read are the vertices in order, no inline array or immediate vertices, and
+ *     every attribute the layout fetches is an ordinary per-vertex array (no frequency divider);
+ *   - the range is at most 1M vertices, at most a quarter (+16) more than the references, and at
+ *     most a quarter (+16) more than the distinct vertices named. (The GT6 port first asked only the
+ *     first of the two, and its race then converted 110-300,000 vertices a frame where the old way
+ *     converted 60-75,000.)
+ * Restart cuts are kept: they are positions in the reference list, which neither way changes. A draw
+ * whose references are already the range in order (an array draw, say) comes out exactly as the old
+ * way leaves it: the same references, not remapped. Else the occurrence map holds the rebased indices
+ * and the draw is indexed, as a de-duplicated one is; the vertex cache keys, records and stores it
+ * the same way. Walker thread only (the conversion workers only read the references made here). */
+#define LD_VXD_MAX_SPAN (1u << 20)
+static int s_vx_direct = -1;
+unsigned long long g_vx_direct[3];   /* [vertex-direct] draws, vertices converted this way, draws taken back */
+static u64* s_vxd_bits;
+static u32 s_vxd_words;
+static int ld_vx_direct(const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* layout)
+{
+    if (s_vx_direct < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_VX_DIRECT"); s_vx_direct = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
+    if (!s_vx_direct || dc.inl || dc.n_immediate || dc.n_refs < 2) return 0;
+    const u32 count = dc.n_refs, base = dc.refs[0].base_index;
+    u32 lo = dc.refs[0].vertex_id, hi = lo, same = 1u;
+    for (u32 i = 1; i < count; i++) {
+        const u32 v = dc.refs[i].vertex_id;
+        lo = v < lo ? v : lo;
+        hi = v > hi ? v : hi;
+        same &= (u32)(dc.refs[i].base_index == base);
+    }
+    const u64 span64 = (u64)hi - lo + 1u;
+    if (!same || span64 > LD_VXD_MAX_SPAN || span64 > (u64)count + count / 4u + 16u ||
+        (u64)hi + base > 0x000FFFFFull)
+        return 0;
+    const u32 divider = rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, 0x1FC0);
+    for (u32 s = 0; s < layout->count; s++) {
+        const u32 a = layout->attrs[s];
+        rsx_dsp_vertex_attr d;
+        rsx_dsp_get_vertex_attr(&g.rsx, a, &d);
+        if (d.type && d.size && !rsx_vertex_freq_plain(d.frequency, (divider >> a) & 1u)) return 0;
+    }
+    const u32 span = (u32)span64, words = (span + 63u) >> 6;
+    /* Room first, so that a failure leaves everything as it was for the old way. */
+    if (count > dc.ref_remap.occurrence_capacity) {
+        u32* occ = (u32*)realloc(dc.ref_remap.occurrence_to_unique, (size_t)count * sizeof(u32));
+        if (!occ) return 0;
+        dc.ref_remap.occurrence_to_unique = occ;
+        dc.ref_remap.occurrence_capacity = count;
+    }
+    if (span > dc.cap_refs) {
+        u32 nc = dc.cap_refs ? dc.cap_refs : 4096u;
+        while (nc < span) nc *= 2u;
+        rsx_vertex_ref* nr = (rsx_vertex_ref*)realloc(dc.refs, (size_t)nc * sizeof(*nr));
+        if (!nr) return 0;
+        dc.refs = nr;
+        dc.cap_refs = nc;
+    }
+    if (words > s_vxd_words) {
+        u64* b = (u64*)realloc(s_vxd_bits, (size_t)words * sizeof(u64));
+        if (!b) return 0;
+        s_vxd_bits = b;
+        s_vxd_words = words;
+    }
+    /* One pass: the rebased index of each reference, and which vertices are named. The occurrence
+     * map written here is only used if the direct way is taken; the old way rewrites it. */
+    memset(s_vxd_bits, 0, (size_t)words * sizeof(u64));
+    u32* const occ = dc.ref_remap.occurrence_to_unique;
+    u32 in_order = span == count;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < count; i++) {
+        const u32 k = dc.refs[i].vertex_id - lo;
+        occ[i] = k;
+        in_order &= (u32)(k == i);
+        s_vxd_bits[k >> 6] |= 1ull << (k & 63u);
+    }
+    u32 named = 0;
+    for (u32 w = 0; w < words; w++) named += (u32)__builtin_popcountll(s_vxd_bits[w]);
+    if (span > named + named / 4u + 16u) return 0;
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < span; k++) {
+        dc.refs[k].vertex_id = lo + k;
+        dc.refs[k].base_index = base;
+    }
+    dc.n_refs = span;
+    dc.refs_remapped = !in_order;
+    g_vx_direct[0]++;
+    g_vx_direct[1] += span;
+    return 1;
+}
+/* After rsx_vertex_fetch_plan_prepare on the direct way's range: 0 when a fetched attribute's range
+ * could not be had from guest memory in one piece. Its vertices are then fetched one by one, and one
+ * the draw does not name could lie where nothing is mapped -- for the position that fails the whole
+ * draw, which the old way (named vertices only) would have drawn. */
+static int ld_vx_direct_mapped(const rsx_vertex_layout_plan* layout)
+{
+    for (u32 s = 0; s < layout->count; s++) {
+        const rsx_vertex_fetch_attr* f = &dc.fetch_plan.attr[layout->attrs[s]];
+        if (f->desc.type && f->desc.size && !f->stable_base) return 0;
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+/* The references as gathered, from the rebased indices ld_vx_direct left in the occurrence map. */
+static void ld_vx_direct_undo(void)
+{
+    const u32 lo = dc.refs[0].vertex_id, base = dc.refs[0].base_index, count = dc.n_source_refs;
+    const u32* const occ = dc.ref_remap.occurrence_to_unique;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < count; i++) {
+        dc.refs[i].vertex_id = lo + occ[i];
+        dc.refs[i].base_index = base;
+    }
+    dc.n_refs = count;
+    dc.refs_remapped = 0;
+    g_vx_direct[2]++;
+}
