+/* LD_FRAME_SKIP=1: keep the game's clock at real time when the RSX thread can't keep 60 fps.
+ * GT5 advances its game time by one 60th of a second per frame it draws (a race clock read 14.65 s
+ * over 21 s of wall time at 41 fps), so slow frames are slow motion. Every command of a frame still
+ * runs, flips, labels, readbacks and all, but when the frames are running late the next frame's draws
+ * and clears are dropped. With nothing drawn it is not presented either, so the screen shows the
+ * frame before; at most every other frame is dropped. The lateness is a running total against
+ * 59.94 Hz, capped so a load or a stall is not made up afterwards.
+ * EXPERIMENTAL, off by default. Tested 2026-11-06 in a 12-car race: the scripted drive got lost,
+ * the scene ran at 20 game frames a second, vertex work per drawn frame doubled (12 ms, not 5) and
+ * the vertex ring overflowed: something a skipped frame leaves out is needed by later frames. */
+int g_ld_skip_frame;
+static unsigned long long g_ld_skip_n, g_ld_skip_frames;
+static HWND s_ld_hwnd;   /* the window the swap chain presents to (for IsIconic) */
+
+/* The refresh rate of the screen the window is on, looked up again every two seconds (the window can
+ * be moved to another screen). LD_DISPLAY_HZ=<n> says it instead (tests). 60 when it cannot be read. */
+static int ld_display_hz(void)
+{
+    static int hz = 60;
+    static ULONGLONG at;
+    const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
+    if (!at || now - at > 2000) {
+        int v = 0;
+        at = now;
+        HMONITOR m = s_ld_hwnd ? MonitorFromWindow(s_ld_hwnd, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST) : NULL;
+        MONITORINFOEXW mi;
+        memset(&mi, 0, sizeof mi);
+        mi.cbSize = sizeof mi;
+        if (m && GetMonitorInfoW(m, (MONITORINFO*)&mi)) {
+            DEVMODEW dm;
+            memset(&dm, 0, sizeof dm);
+            dm.dmSize = sizeof dm;
+            if (EnumDisplaySettingsW(mi.szDevice, ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS, &dm)) v = (int)dm.dmDisplayFrequency;
+        }
+        { const char* e = getenv("LD_DISPLAY_HZ"); if (e && atoi(e) > 0) v = atoi(e); }
+        hz = v >= 30 ? v : 60;
+    }
+    return hz;
+}
+int rsx_live_draw_get_display_hz(void) { return ld_display_hz(); }
+
+/* Which passes a left-out frame may leave out. A pass is a (colour target, zeta) pair from the
+ * register file. One the game draws every frame (the scene, its shadows, the bloom chain, the
+ * display buffer) is redrawn by the next drawn frame, so dropping it costs nothing. One it does not
+ * -- a race's name labels rendered into a texture when the order changes, a cube face redrawn in
+ * turn -- holds what later frames sample, and a dropped one stays missing: watch mode first showed
+ * every leaderboard name but one blank. Such a pass always runs. Tracked only while watch mode is
+ * on (s_ld_pass_track), so a pass is new, hence run, in the first frame after it starts. */
+static int s_ld_pass_track;
+static u32 s_ld_pass_frame = 1;
+#define LD_PASS_SLOTS 1024u
+static struct { u64 key; u32 frame, hot; } s_ld_pass[LD_PASS_SLOTS];
+static unsigned long long g_ld_pass_kept;   /* draws and clears run in left-out frames */
+/* 1 when the current draw or clear's pass was also drawn in the frame before this one. */
+static int ld_pass_hot(void)
+{
+    if (!s_ld_pass_track) return 1;   /* not tracking: every pass, as before */
+    rsx_dsp_surface sf;
+    rsx_dsp_get_surface(&g.rsx, &sf);
+    const u64 key = ((u64)((sf.color_location[0] << 31) | (sf.color_offset[0] & 0x7FFFFFFFu)) << 32) |
+                    (u64)((sf.zeta_location << 31) | (sf.zeta_offset & 0x7FFFFFFFu));
+    u32 h = (u32)((key * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) >> 54) & (LD_PASS_SLOTS - 1u);
+    int spare = -1;   /* an empty slot, or one not drawn since before the last frame */
+    for (u32 probe = 0; probe < 16; probe++, h = (h + 1u) & (LD_PASS_SLOTS - 1u)) {
+        if (s_ld_pass[h].frame && s_ld_pass[h].key == key) {
+            if (s_ld_pass[h].frame != s_ld_pass_frame) {   /* first time this frame */
+                s_ld_pass[h].hot = s_ld_pass[h].frame + 1u == s_ld_pass_frame;
+                s_ld_pass[h].frame = s_ld_pass_frame;
+            }
+            return (int)s_ld_pass[h].hot;
+        }
+        if (spare < 0 && (!s_ld_pass[h].frame || s_ld_pass[h].frame + 1u < s_ld_pass_frame)) spare = (int)h;
+    }
+    if (spare >= 0) {   /* a pass not seen last frame: new, so it runs */
+        s_ld_pass[spare].key = key;
+        s_ld_pass[spare].frame = s_ld_pass_frame;
+        s_ld_pass[spare].hot = 0;
+    }
+    return 0;
+}
+
+/* Watch mode: nobody is driving -- a B-Spec race, a replay, the attract demo, a menu left alone --
+ * so draw fewer frames. The game itself is untouched: every frame's commands still run, its flips,
+ * fences, labels and readbacks happen as before, and GT5's clock (one 60th of a second per game
+ * frame) keeps real time; only the drawing of some frames is left out, and a frame with nothing
+ * drawn is not presented, so the screen holds the last drawn one. Drawn frames are drawn exactly
+ * as before.
+ *   - minimized: nothing is drawn;
+ *   - watching: one game frame in LD_WATCH_DRAW (default 2, so 30 a second at 60) is drawn. The
+ *     drawn phase moves on by one every 64 frames, so passes the game spreads over alternate frames
+ *     (a reflection cube a face at a time) still all get drawn;
+ *   - OPTIONAL, off unless the user turns it on (their call: "make the b spec low resource thing
+ *     optional"). F9 in the game window switches it on and off by hand. LD_WATCH=1 (play.bat)
+ *     also lets it start by itself after LD_WATCH_IDLE_S (default 10) seconds with no button,
+ *     trigger or stick on any pad and none of the game keys, and any input then ends it at the
+ *     next frame; F9 on stays on until F9 again. While watching the process runs at below-normal
+ *     priority, so whatever else the user is doing comes first (LD_WATCH_PRIORITY=0 keeps it).
+ * LD_WATCH=0 off (default; F9 still works), 1 automatic, 2 always (tests). */
+static int ld_watch_skip(void)
+{
+    static int mode, draw_n = 2, prio = 1, lowered;
+    static unsigned long long idle_ms = 10000;
+    static unsigned set_gen;   /* the settings registry's change counter: the in-game menu changes these */
+    if (set_gen != gt5_settings_gen()) {
+        set_gen = gt5_settings_gen();
+        mode = gt5_setting_int("LD_WATCH", 0);
+        if (mode < 0) mode = 0;
+        { const int d = gt5_setting_int("LD_WATCH_DRAW", 2); draw_n = d >= 1 ? d : 2; }
+        { const int s = gt5_setting_int("LD_WATCH_IDLE_S", 10); idle_ms = (unsigned long long)(s >= 0 ? s : 10) * 1000ull; }
+        { const int p = gt5_setting_int("LD_WATCH_PRIORITY", 1) != 0;
+          if (!p && lowered) { SetPriorityClass(GetCurrentProcess(), NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS); lowered = 0; }
+          prio = p; }
+    }
+    extern unsigned long long cellPad_last_activity_ms(void);
+    extern unsigned long long cellPad_now_ms(void);
+    const unsigned long long now = cellPad_now_ms(), last = cellPad_last_activity_ms();
+    static unsigned long long start;
+    if (!start) start = now;
+    HWND fg = GetForegroundWindow();
+    DWORD fg_pid = 0;
+    if (fg) GetWindowThreadProcessId(fg, &fg_pid);
+    const int focused = fg_pid == GetCurrentProcessId();
+    /* F9: watch mode on, and off again. */
+    static int manual;
+    { static int f9_was;
+      const int f9 = focused && !gt5_menu_input_captured() && (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_F9) & 0x8000) != 0;
+      if (f9 && !f9_was) {
+          manual = !manual;
+          fprintf(stderr, "[watch] F9: watch mode %s\n", manual ? "switched on" : "switched off");
+      }
+      f9_was = f9; }
+    const unsigned long long quiet_since = last ? last : start;
+    /* LD_WATCH=3 (tests): on and off in turn every 10 s, so both are measured under the same load. */
+    const int watching = manual || mode == 2 || (mode == 1 && now - quiet_since >= idle_ms) ||
+                         (mode == 3 && ((now - start) / 10000ull) % 2ull == 1ull);
+    { static unsigned long long seg_t0, seg_frames; static int seg_state = -1;
+      if (mode == 3) {
+          if (seg_state != watching) {
+              if (seg_state >= 0 && now > seg_t0)
+                  fprintf(stderr, "[watch-ab] %s: %llu game frames in %.1f s, %.1f a second\n",
+                          seg_state ? "watching" : "normal", seg_frames, (now - seg_t0) / 1000.0,
+                          seg_frames * 1000.0 / (double)(now - seg_t0));
+              seg_state = watching; seg_t0 = now; seg_frames = 0;
+          }
+          seg_frames++;
+      } }
+    /* [win] LD_MIN_NODRAW (default 1; 0 = as before: only with watch mode on): a minimized window draws
+     * nothing, as in any PC game, while the game itself runs on. The priority is lowered only for watch
+     * mode, as before (a minimized game's sound must not crackle). */
+    static int min_any = -1;
+    if (min_any < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_MIN_NODRAW"); min_any = !(e && e[0] == '0'); }
+    const int minimized = (manual || mode || min_any) && s_ld_hwnd && IsIconic(s_ld_hwnd);
+    static int was = 0;
+    const int state = minimized ? 2 : watching;
+    s_ld_pass_track = state != 0;
+    if (state != was) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[watch] %s\n", state == 2 ? "window minimized: nothing drawn" :
+                state ? "on: drawing fewer frames" : "off: drawing every frame");
+        const int low = state == 1 || (state == 2 && (manual || mode));
+        if (prio) { SetPriorityClass(GetCurrentProcess(), low ? BELOW_NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS : NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS); lowered = low; }
+        was = state;
+    }
+    if (minimized) return 1;
+    if (!watching) return 0;
+    static unsigned long long k;
+    k++;
+    return ((k + k / 64u) % (unsigned long long)draw_n) != 0;
+}
+
+/* Game frames a second since the last call (the window title asks once a second). The same as the
+ * presented rate unless watch mode leaves frames undrawn; then it is the number that says how fast
+ * the game itself runs. */
+static volatile u64 g_ld_game_frames;
+double rsx_live_draw_get_game_fps(void)
+{
+    static u64 f0; static LONGLONG t0;
+    const u64 f = g_ld_game_frames; const LONGLONG t = hx_now();
+    double r = 0.0;
+    if (t0 && t > t0) {
+        LARGE_INTEGER q; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&q);
+        r = (double)(f - f0) * (double)q.QuadPart / (double)(t - t0);
+    }
+    f0 = f; t0 = t;
+    return r;
+}
+
+void rsx_live_draw_frame_boundary(void)
+{
+    ld_scn_frame_end();   /* [scene] judge the frame that just ended, set up the one that starts */
+    g_ld_game_frames++;
+    { extern void ps3_ab_frame(void); ps3_ab_frame(); }
+    static int on = -1; static LONGLONG last, rep_t; static double debt; static int skipped_last;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_FRAME_SKIP"); on = e && atoi(e) != 0;
+                  if (on) fprintf(stderr, "[frameskip] on: drop a frame's drawing when behind 60 fps\n"); }
+    if (!on) {
+        s_ld_pass_frame++;
+        g_ld_skip_frame = ld_watch_skip();
+        g_ld_skip_frames++;
+        if (g_ld_skip_frame) g_ld_skip_n++;
+        static LONGLONG wrep;
+        LARGE_INTEGER wf; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&wf);
+        const LONGLONG wt = hx_now();
+        if (!wrep) wrep = wt;
+        if (wt - wrep >= 5 * wf.QuadPart) {
+            if (g_ld_skip_n)
+                fprintf(stderr, "[watch] %llu of %llu game frames drawn; %llu draws and clears of passes "
+                                "the game does not redraw every frame run in the others\n",
+                        g_ld_skip_frames - g_ld_skip_n, g_ld_skip_frames, g_ld_pass_kept);
+            g_ld_skip_n = g_ld_skip_frames = g_ld_pass_kept = 0;
+            wrep = wt;
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+    /* A dropped frame still runs the passes the game doesn't redraw every frame (ld_pass_hot), as
+     * watch mode does. Without that, the first try (6 Nov) lost reflection faces and name labels and
+     * the vertex ring overflowed. */
+    s_ld_pass_frame++;
+    s_ld_pass_track = 1;
+    LARGE_INTEGER f; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
+    const LONGLONG now = hx_now();
+    if (last) {
+        const double ms = (double)(now - last) * 1000.0 / (double)f.QuadPart;
+        debt += ms - 16.683;
+        if (debt < 0) debt = 0;
+        if (debt > 100) debt = 100;
+    }
+    last = now;
+    /* Only when the RSX thread is what is late: its walk for the last drawn frame. Where the game itself
+     * sets the pace (menus, boot, a light scene), dropping frames only halves what is shown. */
+    extern void cellGcm_frame_counters(unsigned long long* walk_us, unsigned long long* wait_us);
+    static unsigned long long walk_prev; static double drawn_walk_ms;
+    { unsigned long long w, i; cellGcm_frame_counters(&w, &i);
+      if (walk_prev && !skipped_last) drawn_walk_ms = (double)(w - walk_prev) / 1000.0;
+      walk_prev = w; }
+    const int skip = !skipped_last && debt > 8.0 && drawn_walk_ms > 14.0;
+    g_ld_skip_frame = skip;
+    skipped_last = skip;
+    g_ld_skip_frames++;
+    if (skip) g_ld_skip_n++;
+    if (!rep_t) rep_t = now;
+    if (now - rep_t >= 5 * f.QuadPart) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[frameskip] %llu of %llu frames not drawn (%.0f%%), game frames %.1f/s\n",
+                g_ld_skip_n, g_ld_skip_frames, 100.0 * (double)g_ld_skip_n / (double)(g_ld_skip_frames ? g_ld_skip_frames : 1),
+                (double)g_ld_skip_frames * (double)f.QuadPart / (double)(now - rep_t));
+        g_ld_skip_n = g_ld_skip_frames = 0; rep_t = now;
+    }
+}
+
+LONGLONG g_dt_pub[6];
+unsigned long long g_dt_draws;
+/* Vertex constant blocks: [0] draws that bound the last upload again, [1] uploads. */
+unsigned long long g_cb_dedup[2];
+/* rdtsc ticks in the surfaces+textures phase: up to the fragment textures, binding them, the rest. */
+unsigned long long g_bt_tsc[3];
+#define LD_DT(k) do { const LONGLONG _n = hx_now(); g_dt_pub[k] += _n - dt_prev; dt_prev = _n; } while (0)
+
+/* ---- [shadow] LD_SHADOW_LOG=1 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * What the shadow passes and their readers look like here, for runs a report is checked against. Off: not
+ * one branch taken beyond the cached switch.
+ *   [shadow-pass] each distinct depth-writing pass (zeta, its format, clip, viewport, scissor, colour
+ *                 written or not, depth func, cull, polygon offset as the game set it and as applied,
+ *                 ZMIN_MAX_CONTROL, the depth clear value), up to 64 lines;
+ *   [shadow-tex]  each distinct read of a DEPTH24/DEPTH16 texture (address, size, filter, wrap, border
+ *                 colour, CONTROL0, the depth compare the fragment program gets, and what it was bound to:
+ *                 a zeta's snapshot with its sizes and scale, guest memory, white, a colour surface), up to
+ *                 64 lines;
+ *   [shadow-sum]  every 300 frames: depth-texture binds so far by what they were bound to.
+ * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
+static int ld_shadow_log_on(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_SHADOW_LOG"); on = e && atoi(e) != 0; }
+    return on;
+}
+static unsigned long long s_shlog_kind[5];   /* zeta snapshot, white, colour surface, other, (unused) */
+static void ld_shadow_log_pass(const rsx_dsp_surface* sf, const rsx_dsp_viewport* vp, u32 zslot, int writes_colour,
+                               float trs)
+{
+    if (!zslot || !(rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_DEPTH_TEST_ENABLE) & 1u) || !(rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_DEPTH_WRITE) & 1u))
+        return;
+    /* [shadow2] Two budgets of 64 lines, passes that write colour and passes that do not (shadow casters
+     * are the second), and the offset's numbers keyed only while one of its enables is on. Before, one
+     * budget keyed on the raw numbers, which GT5 rewrites every frame with every enable off (its pass into
+     * 0x2420000), was used up by frame 1501 of the first run: none of a race's cascade passes was printed. */
+    typedef struct { u32 zoff, clip, sch, scv, pen, pf, pu, zmm, dfunc, col, vpy; } ld_shlog_key;
+    static ld_shlog_key seen_all[2][64];
+    static u32 n_all[2];
+    const u32 b = writes_colour ? 0u : 1u;
+    u32* const np = &n_all[b];
+    if (*np == 64u) return;
+    const u32 prim = g.rsx.current_primitive;
+    const u32 pen = (rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, 0x0A60u) & 1u) | ((rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, 0x0A64u) & 1u) << 1) |
+                    ((rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, 0x0A68u) & 1u) << 2);
+    const u32 pf = rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, 0x0A78u), pu = rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, 0x0A7Cu);
+    const u32 pf_key = pen ? pf : 0u, pu_key = pen ? pu : 0u;
+    const u32 sch = rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_SCISSOR_HORIZONTAL), scv = rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_SCISSOR_VERTICAL);
+    const u32 zmm = rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, 0x1D78u), dfunc = rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_DEPTH_FUNC);
+    const u32 clip = (sf->clip_w << 16) | sf->clip_h, vpy = (u32)vp->y | ((u32)vp->h << 16);
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < *np; k++) {
+        const ld_shlog_key* s = &seen_all[b][k];
+        if (s->zoff == sf->zeta_offset && s->clip == clip && s->sch == sch && s->scv == scv &&
+            s->pen == pen && s->pf == pf_key && s->pu == pu_key && s->zmm == zmm &&
+            s->dfunc == dfunc && s->vpy == vpy) return;
+    }
+    {
+        ld_shlog_key* s = &seen_all[b][*np];
+        s->zoff = sf->zeta_offset; s->clip = clip; s->sch = sch; s->scv = scv; s->pen = pen;
+        s->pf = pf_key; s->pu = pu_key; s->zmm = zmm; s->dfunc = dfunc; s->col = (u32)writes_colour; s->vpy = vpy;
+        (*np)++;
+    }
+    float f, u, as, au;
+    memcpy(&f, &pf, sizeof f); memcpy(&u, &pu, sizeof u);
+    const int applied = ld_poly_offset(&as, &au);
+    const zdepth_t* z = &g.zdepths[zslot - 1];
+    fprintf(stderr, "[shadow-pass] frame %u zeta %u:0x%X %s (entry #%u %ux%u x%.3f) clip %ux%u vp %u,%u %ux%u scissor %u,%u %ux%u "
+                    "colour %s target %u:0x%X, dfunc 0x%X cull %u/0x%X prim %u, poly offset enables P%uL%uF%u factor %g units %g "
+                    "-> %s slope %g const %g, zminmax 0x%X, zclear 0x%08X, runs at x%.3f%s\n",
+            g_ld_frames, sf->zeta_location, sf->zeta_offset, sf->depth_format == 1u ? "Z16" : "Z24S8", zslot - 1u,
+            z->w, z->h, (double)z->rs, sf->clip_w, sf->clip_h, vp->x, vp->y, vp->w, vp->h,
+            sch & 0xFFFFu, scv & 0xFFFFu, sch >> 16, scv >> 16,
+            writes_colour ? "written" : "masked", sf->color_location[0], sf->color_offset[0], dfunc,
+            rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_CULL_FACE_ENABLE) & 1u, rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_CULL_FACE), prim,
+            pen & 1u, (pen >> 1) & 1u, (pen >> 2) & 1u, (double)f, (double)u,
+            applied ? "applied" : "none applied", (double)(as * trs),
+            (double)(au * (sf->depth_format == 1u ? 1.0f / 65536.0f : 1.0f / 16777216.0f)),
+            zmm, rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_ZSTENCIL_CLEAR), (double)trs,
+            !writes_colour && ld_sm_pass_scale(sf) > 0.0f ? " (a shadow map, scaled)" : "");
+}
+static void ld_shadow_log_binds(const u32 slots[SRV_TABLE_SIZE], u32 sampled, u32 current_zslot)
+{
+    static struct { u32 off, fmt, wh, filter, wrap, border, ctl, slot, snap; float rs; } seen[64];   /* [shadow2] rs */
+    static u32 n, last_sum;
+    for (u32 u = 0; u < RSX_DSP_NUM_TEXTURES && u < SRV_TABLE_SIZE; u++) {
+        if (!(sampled & (1u << u)) || !(rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, 0x1A00u + u * 0x20u + 0x0Cu) >> 31)) continue;
+        rsx_dsp_texture t;
+        rsx_dsp_get_texture(&g.rsx, u, &t);
+        const u32 base = t.format & 0x9Fu;
+        if (base < 0x90u || base > 0x93u) continue;
+        const u32 s = slots[u];
+        const int zi = s >= SRV_ZDEPTH_BASE && s < SRV_ZDEPTH_BASE + MAX_SURFACES ? (int)(s - SRV_ZDEPTH_BASE) : -1;
+        const u32 kind = zi >= 0 ? 0u : s == SRV_WHITE ? 1u : (s >= SRV_SURFACE_BASE && s < SRV_ZDEPTH_BASE) ? 2u : 3u;
+        s_shlog_kind[kind]++;
+        if (g_ld_frames != last_sum && (g_ld_frames % 300u) == 0) {
+            last_sum = g_ld_frames;
+            fprintf(stderr, "[shadow-sum] frame %u: depth-texture binds so far: zeta snapshot %llu, white %llu, colour surface %llu, "
+                            "other (guest memory decode, window) %llu\n", g_ld_frames,
+                    s_shlog_kind[0], s_shlog_kind[1], s_shlog_kind[2], s_shlog_kind[3]);
+        }
+        const u32 snap = zi >= 0 ? (g.zdepths[zi].snapshot_w << 16) | g.zdepths[zi].snapshot_h : 0u;
+        const float zrs = zi >= 0 ? g.zdepths[zi].rs : 0.0f;
+        const u32 wh = (t.width << 16) | t.height, ctl = t.control0 & 0x80000004u;
+        u32 k = 0;
+        for (; k < n; k++)
+            if (seen[k].off == t.offset && seen[k].fmt == t.format && seen[k].wh == wh && seen[k].filter == t.filter &&
+                seen[k].wrap == t.wrap && seen[k].border == t.border_color && seen[k].ctl == ctl &&
+                seen[k].slot == (zi >= 0 ? 1u : kind + 2u) && seen[k].snap == snap && seen[k].rs == zrs) break;
+        if (k < n || n == 64u) continue;
+        seen[n].off = t.offset; seen[n].fmt = t.format; seen[n].wh = wh; seen[n].filter = t.filter; seen[n].wrap = t.wrap;
+        seen[n].border = t.border_color; seen[n].ctl = ctl; seen[n].slot = zi >= 0 ? 1u : kind + 2u; seen[n].snap = snap;
+        seen[n].rs = zrs;
+        n++;
+        rsx_fp_shadow_desc d;
+        rsx_fp_shadow_desc_from_texture(&d, t.format, t.dimension, t.cubemap, t.mipmaps, t.filter, t.wrap, t.control0);
+        static const char* fn[8] = { "never", "less", "equal", "lequal", "greater", "notequal", "gequal", "always" };
+        char bound[160];
+        if (zi >= 0) {
+            const zdepth_t* z = &g.zdepths[zi];

+/* [shadow] What a CLEAR_SURFACE may write: the surface clip from the origin, then the scissor, as for a
+ * draw (and as the RSX, RPCS3 and the shared draw engine's eng_clear_rect do). The D3D12 path cleared the
+ * whole resource. GT5 draws the three cascades of its 1024x2048 DEPTH16 sun shadow map one under the other
+ * (rows 1365-2047, 682-1364, 0-681, in that order) and clears each just before drawing it, with the scissor
+ * on that cascade: cleared whole, the second clear wiped the first cascade and the third wiped both, so
+ * only the last cascade drawn held any shadow, and whatever the other two cover came out unshadowed. In a
+ * frame with the rear-view mirror (a 720p race capture) the third clear is followed by no draw at all, so
+ * the mirror and the scene draws before GT5's second, clear-less round of casters read an empty map.
+ *   colour: partial only when the scissor cuts into the clip (a clip smaller than the surface alone stays
+ *           a whole clear, as eng_clear_rect decides);
+ *   depth/stencil: partial when the rectangle leaves out any of what the zeta was ever bound with (its
+ *           snapshot's extent): a shadow map's cascades are smaller clips of one zeta.
+ * A written empty scissor clears nothing. LD_CLEAR_RECT=0: every clear whole, as before. */
+static int ld_clear_rect_on(void)
+{
+    static int on = -1;
+    if (on < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_CLEAR_RECT"); on = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
+    return on;
+}
+/* The guest rectangle a clear may write, in the surface's samples: [r0, r2) x [r1, r3). 0 = empty. */
+static int ld_clear_guest_rect(const rsx_dsp_surface* sf, u32 r[4])
+{
+    u32 x0 = 0, y0 = 0;
+    u32 x1 = sf->clip_w ? sf->clip_w : g.width, y1 = sf->clip_h ? sf->clip_h : g.height;
+    if (g.rsx.seen[M_SCISSOR_HORIZONTAL >> 2] || g.rsx.seen[M_SCISSOR_VERTICAL >> 2]) {
+        const u32 sh = rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_SCISSOR_HORIZONTAL), sv = rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_SCISSOR_VERTICAL);
+        const u32 ax = sf->aa_sx ? sf->aa_sx : 1u, ay = sf->aa_sy ? sf->aa_sy : 1u;   /* pixels -> samples */
+        const u32 sx = (sh & 0xFFFFu) * ax, sx1 = sx + (sh >> 16) * ax;
+        const u32 sy = (sv & 0xFFFFu) * ay, sy1 = sy + (sv >> 16) * ay;
+        if (sx > x0) x0 = sx;
+        if (sy > y0) y0 = sy;
+        if (sx1 < x1) x1 = sx1;
+        if (sy1 < y1) y1 = sy1;
+    }
+    if (x1 <= x0 || y1 <= y0) return 0;
+    r[0] = x0; r[1] = y0; r[2] = x1; r[3] = y1;
+    return 1;
+}
+/* That rectangle in host pixels of a resource held at scale rs, cut to its host size w x h. */
+static D3D12_RECT ld_clear_host_rect(const u32 r[4], float rs, u32 w, u32 h)

+/* See stencil_snapshot. */
+static int make_stencil_snapshot_pipeline(void)
+{
+    static const char source[] =
+        "Texture2D<float> depth_source : register(t0);\n"
+        "Texture2D<uint2> stencil_source : register(t1);\n"
+        "RWTexture2D<unorm float4> destination : register(u0);\n"
+        "[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]\n"
+        "void main(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {\n"
+        "    uint width, height;\n"
+        "    destination.GetDimensions(width, height);\n"
+        "    if (id.x < width && id.y < height) {\n"
+        "        uint d = (uint)(saturate(depth_source.Load(int3(id.xy, 0)))"
+        " * 16777215.0 + 0.5);\n"
+        "        uint s = stencil_source.Load(int3(id.xy, 0)).g;\n"
+        "        destination[id.xy] = float4(d >> 16, (d >> 8) & 255, d & 255, s)"
+        " / 255.0;\n"
+        "    }\n"
+        "}\n";
+    ID3DBlob* shader = NULL;
+    ID3DBlob* errors = NULL;
+    HRESULT hr = D3DCompile(
+        source, sizeof(source) - 1u, "stencil_snapshot_compute", NULL, NULL,
+        "main", "cs_5_0", D3DCOMPILE_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL3, 0, &shader, &errors);
+    if (FAILED(hr)) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[zetatrack] stencil snapshot shader compile failed "
+                "hr=0x%08lX: %s\n", (unsigned long)hr,
+                errors ? (const char*)errors->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(errors)
+                       : "<no diagnostics>");
+        if (errors) errors->lpVtbl->Release(errors);
+        return -1;
+    }
+    if (errors) errors->lpVtbl->Release(errors);
+
+    D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[2] = {0};
+    ranges[0].RangeType = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV;
+    ranges[0].NumDescriptors = 2;
+    ranges[1].RangeType = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_UAV;
+    ranges[1].NumDescriptors = 1;
+    D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER parameters[2] = {0};
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
+        parameters[i].ParameterType = D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_TABLE;
+        parameters[i].DescriptorTable.NumDescriptorRanges = 1;
+        parameters[i].DescriptorTable.pDescriptorRanges = &ranges[i];
+        parameters[i].ShaderVisibility = D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_ALL;
+    }
+    D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC description = {0};
+    description.NumParameters = 2;
+    description.pParameters = parameters;
+    ID3DBlob* serialized = NULL;
+    hr = D3D12SerializeRootSignature(
+        &description, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &serialized, NULL);
+    if (FAILED(hr)) {
+        shader->lpVtbl->Release(shader);
+        return -1;
+    }
+    hr = g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateRootSignature(
+        g.dev, 0, serialized->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(serialized),
+        serialized->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(serialized),
+        &IID_ID3D12RootSignature, (void**)&g.stencil_snapshot_rootsig);
+    serialized->lpVtbl->Release(serialized);
+    if (FAILED(hr)) {
+        shader->lpVtbl->Release(shader);
+        return -1;
+    }
+    D3D12_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pipeline = {0};
+    pipeline.pRootSignature = g.stencil_snapshot_rootsig;
+    pipeline.CS.pShaderBytecode = shader->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(shader);
+    pipeline.CS.BytecodeLength = shader->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(shader);
+    hr = g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateComputePipelineState(
+        g.dev, &pipeline, &IID_ID3D12PipelineState,
+        (void**)&g.stencil_snapshot_pso);
+    shader->lpVtbl->Release(shader);
+    return SUCCEEDED(hr) ? 0 : -1;

+/* Which GPU draws. A NULL adapter is whatever DXGI lists first: on a laptop with two GPUs that is
+ * usually the integrated one the screen is wired to, which made races crawl on gaming laptops. Ask for
+ * the high-performance GPU instead (IDXGIFactory6, Windows 10 1803 and newer). PS3_GPU=low picks the
+ * power-saving one, PS3_GPU=<n> the n-th adapter DXGI lists. The choice goes to play.err, and the
+ * exports below ask the NVIDIA and AMD drivers for the fast GPU as well. */
+__declspec(dllexport) unsigned long NvOptimusEnablement = 1;
+__declspec(dllexport) int AmdPowerXpressRequestHighPerformance = 1;
+char g_ld_gpu_name[128];
+
+static int ld_try_adapter(IDXGIAdapter1* ad)
+{
+    DXGI_ADAPTER_DESC1 d;
+    if (FAILED(ad->lpVtbl->GetDesc1(ad, &d)) || (d.Flags & DXGI_ADAPTER_FLAG_SOFTWARE)) return 0;
+    if (FAILED(D3D12CreateDevice((IUnknown*)ad, D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0, &IID_ID3D12Device, (void**)&g.dev))) return 0;
+    WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, d.Description, -1, g_ld_gpu_name, (int)sizeof(g_ld_gpu_name), NULL, NULL);
+    fprintf(stderr, "[gpu] %s, %llu MB of its own memory\n", g_ld_gpu_name,
+            (unsigned long long)(d.DedicatedVideoMemory >> 20));
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* [fg0] The swap chain allows tearing (made with DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_FLAG_ALLOW_TEARING): a Present with
+ * interval 0 then carries DXGI_PRESENT_ALLOW_TEARING, which is what "vertical sync off" means on a
+ * flip-model swap chain in a window, and what lets a variable-refresh screen show a frame when it is
+ * presented. Never with an interval above 0. LD_FG_PRESENT=0: as before, no flag anywhere. */
+static int g_ld_tearing;
+static UINT ld_present_flags(UINT interval)
+{
+    return interval == 0u && g_ld_tearing ? DXGI_PRESENT_ALLOW_TEARING : 0u;
+}
+
+static int ld_create_device(IDXGIFactory4* factory)
+{
+    const char* want = getenv("PS3_GPU");
+    IDXGIAdapter1* ad = NULL;
+    if (want && want[0] >= '0' && want[0] <= '9') {
+        if (SUCCEEDED(factory->lpVtbl->EnumAdapters1(factory, (UINT)atoi(want), &ad))) {
+            const int ok = ld_try_adapter(ad);
+            ad->lpVtbl->Release(ad);
+            if (ok) return 0;
+        }
+        fprintf(stderr, "[gpu] PS3_GPU=%s: no such adapter, picking one as usual\n", want);
+    }
+    IDXGIFactory6* f6 = NULL;
+    if (SUCCEEDED(factory->lpVtbl->QueryInterface(factory, &IID_IDXGIFactory6, (void**)&f6))) {
+        const DXGI_GPU_PREFERENCE pref = (want && (!_stricmp(want, "low") || !_stricmp(want, "integrated")))
+            ? DXGI_GPU_PREFERENCE_MINIMUM_POWER : DXGI_GPU_PREFERENCE_HIGH_PERFORMANCE;
+        for (UINT i = 0; !g.dev && f6->lpVtbl->EnumAdapterByGpuPreference(f6, i, pref, &IID_IDXGIAdapter1,
+                                                                          (void**)&ad) != DXGI_ERROR_NOT_FOUND; i++) {
+            ld_try_adapter(ad);
+            ad->lpVtbl->Release(ad);
+        }
+        f6->lpVtbl->Release(f6);
+    }
+    if (!g.dev) {
+        if (FAILED(D3D12CreateDevice(NULL, D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0, &IID_ID3D12Device, (void**)&g.dev))) return -1;
+        fprintf(stderr, "[gpu] the default adapter (Windows didn't say which is the fast one)\n");
+    }
+    return 0;
+}

+/* The in-game menu (F1; GT5\src\menu on Dear ImGui, or the runtime's empty stand-ins in a build without
+ * it): started once the back buffers exist, on the thread that owns the window. Its settings are the
+ * launcher's (settings.bat). Every setting the menu calls live has a reader that follows the registry
+ * (gt5_settings_gen); one that gets a row before its reader does must be marked here with
+ * gt5_setting_set_apply(key, GT5_APPLY_RESTART). The render resolution is switched through
+ * ld_set_res_target. */
+void ld_set_res_scale(float s);
+void ld_set_res_target(u32 lines);
+static void ld_menu_res_changed(const char* key, const char* old_value, const char* new_value, void* user)
+{
+    (void)key; (void)old_value; (void)user;
+    const int lines = new_value && *new_value ? atoi(new_value) : 0;
+    if (lines > 0) ld_set_res_target((u32)lines);
+    else ld_set_res_scale(1.0f);   /* "Same as the game draws" */
+}
+static void ld_menu_start(void* hwnd)
+{
+    gt5_menu_init_info mi;
+    memset(&mi, 0, sizeof mi);
+    mi.hwnd = (HWND)hwnd; mi.device = g.dev; mi.queue = g.queue;
+    mi.rtv_format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
+    mi.frame_w = g.out_w; mi.frame_h = g.out_h;   /* the back buffers' size, not the window's */
+    if (!gt5_menu_init(&mi)) return;
+    gt5_setting_enable("LD_RES_TARGET", 1);
+    gt5_setting_set_apply("LD_RES_TARGET", GT5_APPLY_LIVE);
+    gt5_settings_on_change("LD_RES_TARGET", ld_menu_res_changed, NULL);
+    gt5_setting_enable("LD_SHADOWS", 1);   /* [shadow2] read at every flip (ld_sm_flip) */
+    /* [nowait] New shaders (wait / build in the background): read at every frame's end (ld_nw_frame); it needs the
+     * recording thread and the compile threads, so it stays greyed with LD_RECORD_THREAD=0 or LD_ASYNC_SHADERS=0. */
+    { const char* e = getenv("LD_ASYNC_SHADERS");
+      if (s_rec_on && !(e && atoi(e) == 0)) gt5_setting_enable("LD_SHADERS", 1); }
+    /* Frame rate (60 / 30, rsx_frame_rate.c): 30 is the game's half-rate switch; no row without one. */
+    if (!rsx_frame_rate_has_switch()) gt5_setting_hide("GT5_SPEED", 1);
+    fprintf(stderr, "[menu] in-game menu ready: %ux%u\n", g.out_w, g.out_h);
+}

+/* A FIFO run of methods in one call (cellGcmSys's run fast path). The checks
+ * rsx_live_draw_method makes for every word are made once; any of them that
+ * is not the plain case -- the vertex-state trace, the serialized movie and
+ * debug-layer modes, movie playback -- sends the run through it word by word. */
+void rsx_live_draw_method_run(u32 method, const u8* be, u32 count, int incrementing)
+{
+    static int trace = -1;
+    if (trace < 0)
+        trace = getenv("RSX_VERTEX_STATE_TRACE") ? 1 : 0;
+    if (trace || g_ld_movie_mode || g_ld_debug_layer_enabled || ld_movie_composite_ui_enabled()) {
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < count; i++) {
+            const u8* p = be + 4u * i;
+            rsx_live_draw_method(incrementing ? method + 4u * i : method,
+                                 ((u32)p[0] << 24) | ((u32)p[1] << 16) | ((u32)p[2] << 8) | p[3]);
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+    if (!g.ready) return;
+    rsx_dispatch_method_run(&g.rsx, method, be, count, incrementing);
+}
+
+int rsx_live_draw_owns_rendering(void)
+{
+    return g.ready && g.enabled;
+}

+/* Is this small readback one the title has been repeating every frame? GT5's 16x8 auto-exposure
+ * sample is copied every frame into a ring of three, and the title reads each slot two frames
+ * later, so it may land late. Photo Mode's Auto Focus is not like that: for nine frames it copies
+ * a 16x16 patch of the scene's depth at the focus point and reads it straight back. Landing late,
+ * after the PPU had looked, the camera focused on whatever the ring held before (memory never
+ * written, or an older patch): every distance came out far out of focus and the viewfinder showed
+ * a fan of offset copies of the scene, the depth-of-field blur at its widest. It happened whenever
+ * the RSX thread fell behind: the viewfinder's first seconds (new shaders), a busy GPU. So a
+ * readback becomes asynchronous only once the same rect has been read in 12 frames in a row.
+ * LD_RB_SYNC=0: every small one asynchronous, as before; LD_RB_SYNC=2: all synchronous. */
+static int ld_readback_streaming(u32 loc, u32 abs, u32 w, u32 h)
+{
+    static int mode = -1;
+    if (mode < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_RB_SYNC"); mode = e ? atoi(e) : 1; }
+    if (mode == 0) return 1;
+    if (mode == 2) return 0;
+    static struct { u32 loc, abs, w, h, frame, run; } t[8];
+    static u32 next;
+    int k = -1;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
+        if (t[i].run && t[i].loc == loc && t[i].abs == abs && t[i].w == w && t[i].h == h) { k = i; break; }
+    if (k < 0) {
+        k = (int)(next++ & 7u);
+        t[k].loc = loc; t[k].abs = abs; t[k].w = w; t[k].h = h; t[k].frame = g_ld_frames; t[k].run = 1;
+    } else if (t[k].frame != g_ld_frames) {
+        t[k].run = t[k].frame + 1u == g_ld_frames ? t[k].run + 1u : 1u;
+        t[k].frame = g_ld_frames;
+    }
+    return t[k].run >= 12u;
+}
+
+/* A 1:1 blit from a live surface into main memory is how a title hands pixels to the
+ * CPU, and the guest-memory copy in cellGcmSys moves black. GT5 does it for three things:
+ * Photo Mode copies the finished shot out in two halves and encodes the JPEG from them,
+ * Auto Focus copies a 16x16 patch of depth, and every frame a 16x8 copy of the scene feeds
+ * auto-exposure from a ring of three, so it expects the answer late. A small rect the title
+ * repeats every frame therefore waits for the next flush (ld_readback_streaming); anything
+ * else flushes now, since the title may read it as soon as its label is released. */
+int rsx_live_draw_read_rect(u32 src_loc, u32 src_abs, u32 src_pitch, u32 w, u32 h,
+                            u32 dst_ea, u32 dst_pitch)
+{
+    if (!g.ready || !src_pitch || !w || !h) return 0;
+    u32 sx = 0, sy = 0;
+    const int si = surface_containing_ex(src_loc, src_abs, src_pitch, w, h, 1, &sx, &sy);
+    /* Which surface feeds a readback, each time that changes (auto-exposure's source shows in play.err). */
+    { static int last = -2; static unsigned n;
+      if (si != last && PS3_LOG_FIRST(n, 16)) {
+          if (si < 0) fprintf(stderr, "[blit-readback] no 8-bit surface holds %u:0x%X %ux%u\n", src_loc, src_abs, w, h);
+          else fprintf(stderr, "[blit-readback] source now surface %d %u:0x%X %ux%u, rect at %u,%u\n", si,
+                       g.surfaces[si].location, g.surfaces[si].offset, g.surfaces[si].w, g.surfaces[si].h, sx, sy);
+      }
+      last = si; }
+    if (si < 0) return 0;
+    const surface_t* s = &g.surfaces[si];
+    if (!s->last_write_generation || s->last_write_kind == LD_SURFACE_WRITE_CREATE) return 0;
+    if (s->fmt != DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM && s->fmt != DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM_SRGB) return 0;
+    /* A surface held at a resolution scale: the game must get guest-sized data, so the rect is
+     * first brought down (or up) to w x h in a scratch target at guest size and read from there.
+     * Small rects are the title's own measurements (GT5: 16x8 of the scene for auto-exposure, 16x16
+     * of packed depth for Auto Focus) and take one texel each, unfiltered; anything larger (a photo,
+     * a thumbnail) is filtered. */
+    ID3D12Resource* rd_tex = s->tex;
+    if (s->rs != 1.0f) {
+        u32 cw = 64u, ch = 64u;
+        while (cw < w) cw <<= 1;
+        while (ch < h) ch <<= 1;
+        const u32 scratch = surface_get(LD_RS_LOC_SCRATCH, 0u, cw, ch, s->fmt);
+        if (scratch == LD_INVALID_SURFACE || g.surfaces[scratch].w < w || g.surfaces[scratch].h < h ||
+            !ld_rs_surface_blit_ex((u32)si, (float)sx, (float)sy, (float)w, (float)h, scratch, 0, 0, w, h,
+                                   w * h <= 1024u))
+            return 0;
+        rd_tex = g.surfaces[scratch].tex;
+        sx = 0; sy = 0;
+    }
+    if (s_n_guest_reads == LD_GUEST_READS) ld_flush(LD_FLUSH_READBACK);
+    const u32 pitch = (w * 4u + 255u) & ~255u;
+    const UINT64 rb_size = (UINT64)pitch * h;
+    ID3D12Resource* rb = NULL;
+    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s_guest_read_pool_lock);
+    if (rb_size <= LD_GUEST_READ_SMALL && s_guest_read_pool_n)
+        rb = s_guest_read_pool[--s_guest_read_pool_n];
+    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s_guest_read_pool_lock);
+    if (!rb) {
+        D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp = {0}; hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK;
+        D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC bd = {0};
+        bd.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
+        bd.Width = rb_size <= LD_GUEST_READ_SMALL ? LD_GUEST_READ_SMALL : rb_size;
+        bd.Height = 1; bd.DepthOrArraySize = 1; bd.MipLevels = 1;

+    ld_guest_read* r = &s_guest_reads[s_n_guest_reads++];

+    r->pooled = rb_size <= LD_GUEST_READ_SMALL;

+    { static unsigned n = 0; if (PS3_LOG_FIRST(n, 8) || !(rb_size <= LD_GUEST_READ_SMALL))
+        fprintf(stderr, "[blit-readback] surface %d 0x%X %ux%u at %u,%u -> ea 0x%08X\n",
+                si, s->offset, w, h, sx, sy, dst_ea); }
+    return 1;
+}

+/* ---- [scene] begin (second block): see the first one, before LD_VERTEX_HOIST_FETCH ---------- */
+
+/* A surface at a display buffer's address that is at least as large as the video mode. GT5 also
+ * names those addresses for small off-screen passes (strips, depth-only passes): not the display. */
+static int ld_scn_is_display(const surface_t* s)
+{
+    if (s->w < g.width || s->h < g.height) return 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < 8; i++)
+        if (g.display_buffers[i].valid && g.display_buffers[i].location == s->location &&
+            g.display_buffers[i].offset == s->offset)
+            return 1;
+    return 0;
+}
+
+/* ---- [fill] (second block): see the first one, after the first [scene] block --------------- */
+
+/* Something was drawn into a display buffer at (x0,y0)-(x1,y1), guest pixels: it is part of the picture. */
+static void ld_fill_note(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1)
+{
+    const float W = (float)g.width, H = (float)g.height;
+    if (x0 < 0.0f) x0 = 0.0f;
+    if (y0 < 0.0f) y0 = 0.0f;
+    if (x1 > W) x1 = W;
+    if (y1 > H) y1 = H;
+    if (!(x1 > x0) || !(y1 > y0)) return;
+    if (!s_fill.have) {
+        s_fill.r[0] = x0; s_fill.r[1] = y0; s_fill.r[2] = x1; s_fill.r[3] = y1;
+        s_fill.have = 1;
+        return;
+    }
+    if (x0 < s_fill.r[0]) s_fill.r[0] = x0;
+    if (y0 < s_fill.r[1]) s_fill.r[1] = y0;
+    if (x1 > s_fill.r[2]) s_fill.r[2] = x1;
+    if (y1 > s_fill.r[3]) s_fill.r[3] = y1;
+}
+
+/* Every recorded draw (sink_end_impl): one that writes colour into a display buffer adds the rect it
+ * can touch, its viewport within its scissor, unless it covers the whole frame without reading a
+ * texture (GT5's border strip, a full-frame fill or fade: nothing there but a colour). */
+static void ld_fill_draw(u32 target, const rsx_dsp_viewport* vp, int writes_colour)
+{
+    if (s_fill.mode <= 0 || !writes_colour || target >= g.n_surfaces || !ld_scn_is_display(&g.surfaces[target])) return;
+    float x0 = (float)vp->x, y0 = (float)vp->y, x1 = (float)vp->x + (float)vp->w, y1 = (float)vp->y + (float)vp->h;
+    if (!vp->w || !vp->h) { x0 = 0.0f; y0 = 0.0f; x1 = (float)g.width; y1 = (float)g.height; }
+    if (g.rsx.seen[M_SCISSOR_HORIZONTAL >> 2] || g.rsx.seen[M_SCISSOR_VERTICAL >> 2]) {
+        const u32 sh = rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_SCISSOR_HORIZONTAL), sv = rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_SCISSOR_VERTICAL);
+        const float sx0 = (float)(sh & 0xFFFFu), sy0 = (float)(sv & 0xFFFFu);
+        const float sx1 = sx0 + (float)(sh >> 16), sy1 = sy0 + (float)(sv >> 16);
+        if (sx0 > x0) x0 = sx0;
+        if (sy0 > y0) y0 = sy0;
+        if (sx1 < x1) x1 = sx1;
+        if (sy1 < y1) y1 = sy1;
+    }
+    if (!(x1 > x0) || !(y1 > y0)) return;
+    if (x0 <= 0.5f && y0 <= 0.5f && x1 >= (float)g.width - 0.5f && y1 >= (float)g.height - 0.5f &&
+        g_ld_current_pso.valid && !g_ld_current_pso.sampled_units)
+        return;
+    ld_fill_note(x0, y0, x1, y1);
+}
+
+/* A copy or blit wrote (dx,dy) w x h guest pixels of surface di. */
+static void ld_fill_blit(u32 di, u32 dx, u32 dy, u32 w, u32 h)
+{
+    if (s_fill.mode <= 0 || di >= g.n_surfaces || !ld_scn_is_display(&g.surfaces[di])) return;
+    ld_fill_note((float)dx, (float)dy, (float)dx + (float)w, (float)dy + (float)h);
+}
+
+/* b (x0, y0, x1, y1) widened to the frame's shape about its centre and moved inside the frame. A box
+ * that fits the frame keeps fitting: widening one side to the frame's shape never exceeds the frame. */
+static void ld_fill_fit(float* b)
+{
+    const float W = (float)g.width, H = (float)g.height, a = W / H;
+    float w = b[2] - b[0], h = b[3] - b[1];
+    if (w < h * a) w = h * a; else h = w / a;
+    if (w > W) w = W;
+    if (h > H) h = H;
+    float x0 = (b[0] + b[2]) * 0.5f - w * 0.5f, y0 = (b[1] + b[3]) * 0.5f - h * 0.5f;
+    if (x0 < 0.0f) x0 = 0.0f;
+    if (y0 < 0.0f) y0 = 0.0f;
+    if (x0 + w > W) x0 = W - w;
+    if (y0 + h > H) y0 = H - h;
+    b[0] = x0; b[1] = y0; b[2] = x0 + w; b[3] = y0 + h;
+}
+
+/* At every present, before anything of it is recorded: the rect the window shows for this frame, from
+ * this frame's draws (s_fill.r) and the frames before. Sets s_fill.on and s_fill.cur. */
+static void ld_fill_present(void)
+{
+    if (s_fill.mode < 0) {
+        const char* e = getenv("LD_FILL");
+        s_fill.mode = !(e && atoi(e) == 0);
+        e = getenv("LD_FILL_FRAMES");
+        s_fill.frames = e && atoi(e) > 0 ? (u32)atoi(e) : 60u;
+        if (!s_fill.mode) fprintf(stderr, "[fill] off (LD_FILL=0): the frame is shown whole, border and all\n");
+    }
+    const int have = s_fill.have;
+    s_fill.have = 0;
+    if (s_fill.mode <= 0 || !g.width || !g.height) { s_fill.on = 0; return; }
+    const float W = (float)g.width, H = (float)g.height;
+    if (s_fill.fw != g.width || s_fill.fh != g.height) {
+        s_fill.fw = g.width; s_fill.fh = g.height;
+        s_fill.cur[0] = 0.0f; s_fill.cur[1] = 0.0f; s_fill.cur[2] = W; s_fill.cur[3] = H;
+        s_fill.win_have = 0; s_fill.win_n = 0; s_fill.on = 0;
+    }
+    if (!have) return;                                   /* nothing drawn: no say */
+    const float* r = s_fill.r;
+    float* c = s_fill.cur;
+    const char* why = NULL;
+    float b[4];
+    if (r[0] < c[0] - 0.5f || r[1] < c[1] - 0.5f || r[2] > c[2] + 0.5f || r[3] > c[3] + 0.5f) {
+        /* drawn outside: widen now, so nothing is cut off */
+        b[0] = r[0] < c[0] ? r[0] : c[0]; b[1] = r[1] < c[1] ? r[1] : c[1];
+        b[2] = r[2] > c[2] ? r[2] : c[2]; b[3] = r[3] > c[3] ? r[3] : c[3];
+        ld_fill_fit(b);
+        why = "widened";
+        s_fill.win_have = 0; s_fill.win_n = 0;
+    } else {
+        if (!s_fill.win_have) { memcpy(s_fill.win, r, sizeof s_fill.win); s_fill.win_have = 1; }
+        else {
+            if (r[0] < s_fill.win[0]) s_fill.win[0] = r[0];
+            if (r[1] < s_fill.win[1]) s_fill.win[1] = r[1];
+            if (r[2] > s_fill.win[2]) s_fill.win[2] = r[2];
+            if (r[3] > s_fill.win[3]) s_fill.win[3] = r[3];
+        }
+        if (++s_fill.win_n < s_fill.frames) return;
+        memcpy(b, s_fill.win, sizeof b);
+        ld_fill_fit(b);
+        s_fill.win_have = 0; s_fill.win_n = 0;
+        if (!((b[2] - b[0]) * (b[3] - b[1]) < (c[2] - c[0]) * (c[3] - c[1]) * 0.995f)) return;
+        why = "settled";
+    }
+    if ((b[2] - b[0]) * (b[3] - b[1]) >= W * H * 0.995f) { b[0] = 0.0f; b[1] = 0.0f; b[2] = W; b[3] = H; }
+    if (b[0] == c[0] && b[1] == c[1] && b[2] == c[2] && b[3] == c[3]) return;
+    memcpy(c, b, sizeof b);
+    s_fill.on = !(c[0] == 0.0f && c[1] == 0.0f && c[2] == W && c[3] == H);
+    s_fill.gen++;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[fill] frame %u: the game draws inside %.0f,%.0f %.0fx%.0f of %ux%u (%s): the window shows %s\n",
+            g_ld_frames, (double)r[0], (double)r[1], (double)(r[2] - r[0]), (double)(r[3] - r[1]), g.width, g.height, why,
+            s_fill.on ? "that part, filled" : "the whole frame");
+    if (s_fill.on)
+        fprintf(stderr, "[fill]   shown: %.1f,%.1f %.1fx%.1f, x%.3f\n", (double)c[0], (double)c[1], (double)(c[2] - c[0]),
+                (double)(c[3] - c[1]), (double)(W / (c[2] - c[0])));
+    fflush(stderr);
+}
+
+/* Every recorded draw, once its target and zeta are known. Returns 1 when this draw is the first
+ * colour draw of the frame into a display buffer and could be the copy of the scene: the texture
+ * units it samples then go to ld_scn_probe_sample and the verdict is ld_scn_probe_end's. */
+static int ld_scn_draw_begin(u32 target, const rsx_dsp_surface* sf, int writes_colour, u32 zslot)
+{
+    s_scn.draws++;
+    if (target >= MAX_SURFACES) return 0;
+    const surface_t* t = &g.surfaces[target];
+    const int dtest = (rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_DEPTH_TEST_ENABLE) & 1u) != 0;
+    if (s_scn.sig_valid && ld_scn_sig_is(&s_scn.sig, t)) s_scn.scene_draws++;
+    if (ld_scn_is_display(t)) {
+        if (g_scn_rule) {
+            /* [aa3d] rule 1: every colour draw into a display buffer is a candidate until the line is
+             * found (or a draw has read the remembered scene, not drawn again: a held frame). */
+            if (!writes_colour || s_scn.found || s_scn.held_seen) return 0;
+            s_scn.disp_seen = 1;
+            if (dtest) {
+                if (s_scn.reason == LD_SCN_R_NONE) s_scn.reason = LD_SCN_R_NOT_A_COPY;
+                return 0;
+            }
+            s_scn.b_draw = s_scn.draws - 1u;
+            s_scn.probe_best = -1;
+            s_scn.probe_stale = 0;
+            s_scn.b_display = target;
+            return 1;
+        }
+        if (!writes_colour || s_scn.disp_seen) return 0;
+        s_scn.disp_seen = 1;
+        s_scn.b_draw = s_scn.draws - 1u;
+        if (dtest || (rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_BLEND_ENABLE) & 1u)) {
+            s_scn.reason = LD_SCN_R_NOT_A_COPY;
+            return 0;
+        }
+        s_scn.probe_best = -1;
+        s_scn.probe_stale = 0;
+        s_scn.b_display = target;
+        return 1;
+    }
+    if (dtest && zslot) {
+        if (s_scn.depth_frame[target] != s_scn.frame + 1u) {
+            s_scn.depth_frame[target] = s_scn.frame + 1u;
+            s_scn.depth_draws[target] = 0;
+            s_scn.depth3d[target] = 0;
+        }
+        s_scn.depth_draws[target]++;
+        if (g_scn_rule && writes_colour && (rsx_dsp_reg(&g.rsx, M_DEPTH_WRITE) & 1u)) {   /* [aa3d] */
+            const float* c3 = (const float*)g.rsx.constants[3];
+            if (c3[0] != 0.0f || c3[1] != 0.0f || c3[2] != 0.0f) s_scn.depth3d[target]++;
+        }
+        s_scn.depth_zslot[target] = zslot;
+        s_scn.depth_zloc[target] = sf->zeta_location;
+        s_scn.depth_zoff[target] = sf->zeta_offset;
+        s_scn.depth_cw[target] = sf->clip_w;
+        s_scn.depth_ch[target] = sf->clip_h;
+    }
+    return 0;
+}
+
+/* The candidate's texture units have been looked at: is it the boundary? */
+static void ld_scn_probe_end(const rsx_dsp_surface* sf, const rsx_dsp_viewport* vp)
+{
+    if (s_scn.probe_best < 0) {
+        /* [aa3d] rule 1: a draw that reads nothing drawn in 3D this frame is 2D under or around the
+         * picture; the next display draw is looked at. One that reads the remembered scene ends it. */
+        if (g_scn_rule && !s_scn.probe_stale) {
+            if (s_scn.reason != LD_SCN_R_ZETA) s_scn.reason = LD_SCN_R_NO_SCENE;
+            return;
+        }
+        if (s_scn.probe_stale) s_scn.held_seen = 1;
+        s_scn.reason = s_scn.probe_stale ? LD_SCN_R_HELD : LD_SCN_R_NO_SCENE;
+        return;
+    }
+    const u32 si = (u32)s_scn.probe_best;
+    /* LD_SCENE_ZETA_RULE=0: do not ask for the scene's zeta to be the one still bound. */
+    static int zeta_rule = -1;
+    if (zeta_rule < 0) { const char* e = getenv("LD_SCENE_ZETA_RULE"); zeta_rule = !(e && atoi(e) == 0); }
+    if (zeta_rule && (s_scn.depth_zloc[si] != sf->zeta_location || s_scn.depth_zoff[si] != sf->zeta_offset)) {
+        s_scn.reason = LD_SCN_R_ZETA;
+        return;
+    }
+    const surface_t* s = &g.surfaces[si];
+    s_scn.found = 1;
+    s_scn.reason = LD_SCN_R_NONE;
+    s_scn.b_scene = si;
+    s_scn.b_zslot = s_scn.depth_zslot[si];
+    s_scn.b_depth_draws = s_scn.depth_draws[si];
+    s_scn.b_sig.loc = s->location; s_scn.b_sig.off = s->offset; s_scn.b_sig.w = s->w; s_scn.b_sig.h = s->h;
+    s_scn.b_sig.zloc = s_scn.depth_zloc[si]; s_scn.b_sig.zoff = s_scn.depth_zoff[si];
+    s_scn.b_sig.cw = s_scn.depth_cw[si]; s_scn.b_sig.ch = s_scn.depth_ch[si];
+    s_scn.b_sig.ax = s->aa_sx ? s->aa_sx : 1u; s_scn.b_sig.ay = s->aa_sy ? s->aa_sy : 1u;
+    s_scn.b_rs = s->rs;
+    s_scn.b_disp_rs = g.surfaces[s_scn.b_display].rs;
+    s_scn.b_disp_loc = g.surfaces[s_scn.b_display].location;
+    s_scn.b_disp_off = g.surfaces[s_scn.b_display].offset;
+    s_scn.b_vp[0] = vp->x; s_scn.b_vp[1] = vp->y; s_scn.b_vp[2] = vp->w; s_scn.b_vp[3] = vp->h;
+    if (s_cap.active) s_cap.pending |= 1;
+    if (s_mv.mode) s_cap.pending |= 2;       /* [mv] this frame's vectors are made at the same moment */
+}
+
+static const char* ld_scn_reason_text(int reason)
+{
+    switch (reason) {
+    case LD_SCN_R_NO_DISPLAY: return "no colour draw into a display buffer";
+    case LD_SCN_R_NOT_A_COPY: return "the display buffer's first colour draw is blended or depth-tested (2D, or HUD first)";
+    case LD_SCN_R_NO_SCENE:   return "the display buffer's first colour draw samples no surface drawn with depth this frame";
+    case LD_SCN_R_ZETA:       return "the display buffer's first colour draw samples a depth-drawn surface, but under another zeta";
+    case LD_SCN_R_HELD:       return "the scene was not drawn again";
+    default:                  return "?";
+    }
+}
+
+/* Halton sequence, base b, element i (1-based): 0 < value < 1. */
+static float ld_halton(u32 i, u32 b)
+{
+    float f = 1.0f, r = 0.0f;
+    while (i) { f /= (float)b; r += f * (float)(i % b); i /= b; }
+    return r;
+}
+
+/* The jitter of the frame being drawn: 1 and its offset in host pixels of the scene target (x to the
+ * right, y down; the picture is moved by that much) when the scene draws are being moved, else 0 and
+ * zeros. phase: the frame's place in the sequence. Valid from the frame's first draw until the next
+ * frame starts, so at the boundary it is the jitter the scene was drawn with. RSX thread. */
+int ld_jitter_current(float* x_px, float* y_px, unsigned* phase)
+{
+    if (x_px) *x_px = s_jit.on ? s_jit.x : 0.0f;
+    if (y_px) *y_px = s_jit.on ? s_jit.y : 0.0f;
+    if (phase) *phase = s_jit.on ? s_jit.phase : 0u;
+    return s_jit.on;
+}
+
+/* One CSV row per draw into the scene, for the frames of a capture (LD_SCENE_CONSTS). */
+static void ld_scn_consts_row(u32 target, const rsx_dsp_surface* sf, const rsx_dsp_viewport* vp,
+                              const float* xf, float trs, u32 prim, u32 n_tri, int moves, int moved)
+{
+    if (!s_cap.consts) {
+        static int failed;
+        if (failed) return;
+        s_cap.consts = fopen(s_cap.consts_path, "w");
+        if (!s_cap.consts) {
+            failed = 1;
+            fprintf(stderr, "[scene] cannot write LD_SCENE_CONSTS file %s\n", s_cap.consts_path);
+            return;
+        }
+        fprintf(s_cap.consts,
+                "frame,tag,draw,scene_draw,vp_hash,pso_key,prim,tri_verts,dtest,dwrite,dfunc,blend,cmask,"
+                "stencil,cull,frontface,zeta,rs,vpx,vpy,vpw,vph,vsx,vsy,vsz,vtx,vty,vtz,"
+                "psx,psy,psz,pox,poy,poz,persp_rule,jittered,jx,jy,attr0");
+        for (u32 c = 0; c < 8; c++)
+            fprintf(s_cap.consts, ",c%u.x,c%u.y,c%u.z,c%u.w", c, c, c, c);
+        fprintf(s_cap.consts, ",c467.x,c467.y,c467.z,c467.w\n");
+    }
+    FILE* f = s_cap.consts;
+    render_state_t rs;
+    decode_render_state(&rs);
+    rsx_dsp_vertex_attr a0;
+    rsx_dsp_get_vertex_attr(&g.rsx, 0, &a0);
+    const char* tag = s_cap.step < s_cap.n_steps ? s_cap.steps[s_cap.step].tag : "";
+    fprintf(f, "%u,%s,%u,%u,%016llX,%016llX,%u,%u,%u,%u,0x%X,%u,0x%08X,%u,%u,0x%X,%u:0x%X,%.4f,"
+               "%u,%u,%u,%u,%.9g,%.9g,%.9g,%.9g,%.9g,%.9g,"
+               "%.9g,%.9g,%.9g,%.9g,%.9g,%.9g,%d,%d,%.6f,%.6f,%u:0x%X",
+            s_scn.present_no, tag, s_scn.draws - 1u, s_scn.scene_draws - 1u,
+            (unsigned long long)g_ld_current_pso.vp_hash, (unsigned long long)g_ld_current_pso.key,
+            prim, n_tri, rs.depth_test, rs.depth_write, rs.depth_func, rs.blend_enable, rs.color_mask,
+            rs.stencil_enable, rs.cull_enable, rs.front_face, sf->zeta_location, sf->zeta_offset, (double)trs,
+            vp->x, vp->y, vp->w, vp->h,
+            (double)vp->scale[0], (double)vp->scale[1], (double)vp->scale[2],
+            (double)vp->translate[0], (double)vp->translate[1], (double)vp->translate[2],
+            (double)xf[0], (double)xf[1], (double)xf[2], (double)xf[4], (double)xf[5], (double)xf[6],
+            moves, moved, moved ? (double)s_jit.x : 0.0, moved ? (double)s_jit.y : 0.0,
+            a0.location, a0.offset);
+    const float* vc = (const float*)g.rsx.constants;
+    for (u32 c = 0; c < 8; c++)
+        fprintf(f, ",%.9g,%.9g,%.9g,%.9g", (double)vc[c * 4], (double)vc[c * 4 + 1], (double)vc[c * 4 + 2], (double)vc[c * 4 + 3]);
+    fprintf(f, ",%.9g,%.9g,%.9g,%.9g\n", (double)vc[467 * 4], (double)vc[467 * 4 + 1], (double)vc[467 * 4 + 2], (double)vc[467 * 4 + 3]);
+    (void)target;
+}
+
+/* The depth of zeta entry zslot as the renderer holds it (0 = near, 1 = far), its top-left
+ * want_w x want_h host texels: raw little-endian float32, row after row, into raw_path; and a small
+ * 8-bit PGM (every k-th texel, so that it is at most 640 wide; brightness = fourth root of 1 - depth,
+ * so near is bright and the far plane black). Returns 1 and the size written. */
+static int ld_scn_dump_depth(const char* raw_path, const char* pgm_path, u32 zslot, u32 want_w, u32 want_h,
+                             u32* out_w, u32* out_h, float* out_min, float* out_max, double* out_far_share)
+{
+    if (!zslot || zslot - 1u >= g.n_zdepths) return 0;
+    zdepth_t* z = &g.zdepths[zslot - 1u];
+    if (!z->tex || !z->snapshot) return 0;
+    if (!zdepth_snapshot(zslot) && !z->snapshot_valid) return 0;
+    const u32 sw = ld_hs(z->snapshot_w, z->rs), sh = ld_hs(z->snapshot_h, z->rs);
+    const u32 w = want_w && want_w < sw ? want_w : sw, h = want_h && want_h < sh ? want_h : sh;
+    if (!w || !h) return 0;
+    const u32 pitch = (w * 4u + 255u) & ~255u;
+    const UINT64 rb_size = (UINT64)pitch * h;
+    D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp = {0}; hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK;
+    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC bd = {0};
+    bd.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER; bd.Width = rb_size;
+    bd.Height = 1; bd.DepthOrArraySize = 1; bd.MipLevels = 1;
+    bd.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN; bd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
+    bd.Layout = D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR;
+    ID3D12Resource* rb = NULL;
+    if (FAILED(LD_CCR(g.dev, &hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &bd,
+            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, NULL, &IID_ID3D12Resource, (void**)&rb)))
+        return 0;
+    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER b = {0};
+    b.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
+    b.Transition.pResource = z->snapshot;
+    b.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
+    b.Transition.StateBefore = z->snapshot_state;
+    b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 1, &b);
+    D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION src = {0}, dst = {0};
+    src.pResource = z->snapshot; src.Type = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX; src.SubresourceIndex = 0;
+    dst.pResource = rb; dst.Type = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT;
+    dst.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
+    dst.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.Width = w;
+    dst.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.Height = h;
+    dst.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.Depth = 1;
+    dst.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.RowPitch = pitch;
+    const D3D12_BOX box = { 0, 0, 0, w, h, 1 };
+    g.list->lpVtbl->CopyTextureRegion(g.list, &dst, 0, 0, 0, &src, (w != sw || h != sh) ? &box : NULL);
+    b.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE;
+    b.Transition.StateAfter = z->snapshot_state;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 1, &b);
+    ld_flush(LD_FLUSH_READBACK);                   /* the copy completes on the GPU */
+
+    int ok = 0;
+    u8* px = NULL; D3D12_RANGE rr = {0, (SIZE_T)rb_size};
+    if (SUCCEEDED(rb->lpVtbl->Map(rb, 0, &rr, (void**)&px))) {
+        float lo = 1e30f, hi = -1e30f; u64 n_far = 0;
+        FILE* f = fopen(raw_path, "wb");
+        for (u32 y = 0; y < h; y++) {
+            const float* row = (const float*)(px + (SIZE_T)y * pitch);
+            if (f) fwrite(row, 4, w, f);
+            for (u32 x = 0; x < w; x++) {
+                const float d = row[x];
+                if (d < lo) lo = d;
+                if (d > hi) hi = d;
+                if (d >= 0.9999999f) n_far++;
+            }
+        }
+        if (f) { fclose(f); ok = 1; fprintf(stderr, "[live-draw] wrote %s\n", raw_path); }
+        const u32 k = (w + 639u) / 640u, pw = w / k, ph = h / k;
+        FILE* p = pw && ph ? fopen(pgm_path, "wb") : NULL;
+        if (p) {
+            fprintf(p, "P5\n%u %u\n255\n", pw, ph);
+            for (u32 y = 0; y < ph; y++) {
+                const float* row = (const float*)(px + (SIZE_T)(y * k) * pitch);
+                for (u32 x = 0; x < pw; x++) {
+                    float v = 1.0f - row[x * k];
+                    v = v < 0.0f ? 0.0f : v > 1.0f ? 1.0f : v;
+                    const u8 q = (u8)(sqrtf(sqrtf(v)) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
+                    fputc(q, p);
+                }
+            }
+            fclose(p);
+        }
+        D3D12_RANGE wr = {0, 0};
+        rb->lpVtbl->Unmap(rb, 0, &wr);
+        if (out_min) *out_min = lo;
+        if (out_max) *out_max = hi;
+        if (out_far_share) *out_far_share = (double)n_far / ((double)w * (double)h);
+    }
+    rb->lpVtbl->Release(rb);
+    if (out_w) *out_w = w;
+    if (out_h) *out_h = h;
+    return ok;
+}
+
+/* A capture frame's boundary was found: before the next draw or clear is recorded (so the display
+ * buffer holds the copied scene and nothing of the HUD), write the frame's files:
+ *   scene_<seq>_<tag>_f<present number>_color.ppm     the scene surface, its host texels
+ *   ..._depth.f32, ..._depth.pgm                      its depth, see ld_scn_dump_depth
+ *   ..._display.ppm                                   the display buffer, the part the window shows
+ *   ..._info.txt                                      sizes and what is known of the projection */
+static void ld_scn_pending_run(void)
+{
+    const int what = s_cap.pending;
+    s_cap.pending = 0;
+    if (what & 2) ld_mv_resolve(1);          /* [mv] */
+    if ((what & 2) && rsx_fg_version() == 2) ld_fg_scene_capture();   /* [fg1] the frame without HUD, its vectors and depth */
+    if (!(what & 1) || !s_cap.running || s_cap.step >= s_cap.n_steps) return;
+    const ld_cap_step* st = &s_cap.steps[s_cap.step];
+    const u32 seq = s_cap.seq++;
+    s_cap.step++;                  /* this frame is taken, whatever of it can be written */
+    s_cap.tries = 0;
+    if (s_cap.consts)              /* a line the tools read: this frame's rows are a whole scene */
+        fprintf(s_cap.consts, "#boundary,%u,%u,%s,%u\n", s_scn.present_no, seq, st->tag, s_scn.b_draw);
+    if (!s_cap.dir) return;        /* LD_SCENE_CONSTS alone: the rows are the capture */
+    if (s_scn.b_scene >= g.n_surfaces || s_scn.b_display >= g.n_surfaces ||
+        !ld_scn_sig_is(&s_scn.b_sig, &g.surfaces[s_scn.b_scene])) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[scene] dump %u skipped: the scene surface changed under it\n", seq);
+        return;
+    }
+    const surface_t* sc = &g.surfaces[s_scn.b_scene];
+    const surface_t* dp = &g.surfaces[s_scn.b_display];
+    char base[MAX_PATH * 2], path[MAX_PATH * 2 + 32], path2[MAX_PATH * 2 + 32];
+    snprintf(base, sizeof base, "%s\\scene_%03u_%s_f%06u", s_cap.dir, seq, st->tag, s_scn.present_no);
+    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s_color.ppm", base);
+    const u64 nb = ld_dump_surface_ppm(path, sc);
+    u32 dw = 0, dh = 0; float dmin = 0.0f, dmax = 0.0f; double dfar = 0.0;
+    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s_depth.f32", base);
+    snprintf(path2, sizeof path2, "%s_depth.pgm", base);
+    const int have_depth = ld_scn_dump_depth(path, path2, s_scn.b_zslot, ld_hs(sc->w, sc->rs), ld_hs(sc->h, sc->rs),
+                                             &dw, &dh, &dmin, &dmax, &dfar);
+    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s_display.ppm", base);
+    s_dump_clip_w = g.width; s_dump_clip_h = g.height;
+    ld_dump_surface_ppm(path, dp);
+    s_dump_clip_w = s_dump_clip_h = 0;
+
+    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s_info.txt", base);
+    FILE* f = fopen(path, "w");
+    if (f) {
+        const zdepth_t* z = s_scn.b_zslot && s_scn.b_zslot - 1u < g.n_zdepths ? &g.zdepths[s_scn.b_zslot - 1u] : NULL;
+        fprintf(f, "seq=%u\ntag=%s\npresent_frame=%u\ngame_frame=%u\n", seq, st->tag, s_scn.present_no, s_scn.frame);
+        fprintf(f, "video_mode=%ux%u\nres_scale=%.4f\n", g.width, g.height, (double)g_rs_user);
+        fprintf(f, "boundary_draw=%u\ndraws_before_dump=%u\nscene_depth_draws=%u\n", s_scn.b_draw, s_scn.draws, s_scn.b_depth_draws);
+        fprintf(f, "scene_surface=%u:0x%X\nscene_guest_size=%ux%u\nscene_grid=%ux%u\nscene_guest_pixels=%ux%u\n",
+                sc->location, sc->offset, sc->w, sc->h, s_scn.b_sig.ax, s_scn.b_sig.ay,
+                sc->w / s_scn.b_sig.ax, sc->h / s_scn.b_sig.ay);
+        fprintf(f, "scene_clip=%ux%u\nscene_clip_host_size=%ux%u\n", s_scn.b_sig.cw, s_scn.b_sig.ch,
+                ld_hs(s_scn.b_sig.cw, sc->rs), ld_hs(s_scn.b_sig.ch, sc->rs));
+        fprintf(f, "scene_rs=%.4f\nscene_host_size=%ux%u\nscene_format=%s\nscene_nonblack=%llu\n",
+                (double)sc->rs, ld_hs(sc->w, sc->rs), ld_hs(sc->h, sc->rs),
+                sc->fmt == DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT ? "R16G16B16A16_FLOAT (written as 8-bit)" : "R8G8B8A8_UNORM (sRGB-encoded by the game)",
+                (unsigned long long)(nb == UINT64_MAX ? 0 : nb));
+        fprintf(f, "zeta=%u:0x%X\n", s_scn.b_sig.zloc, s_scn.b_sig.zoff);
+        if (z)
+            fprintf(f, "zeta_entry=%u\nzeta_rs=%.4f\nzeta_guest_size=%ux%u\nzeta_snapshot_guest_size=%ux%u\n",
+                    s_scn.b_zslot - 1u, (double)z->rs, z->w, z->h, z->snapshot_w, z->snapshot_h);
+        fprintf(f, "zeta_host_format=D32_FLOAT_S8X24_UINT (R32G8X24_TYPELESS), cleared to 1.0\n");
+        fprintf(f, "depth_convention=0 near, 1 far (not reversed)\n");
+        if (have_depth)
+            fprintf(f, "depth_file_size=%ux%u\ndepth_file_format=float32 little-endian, row-major, no header\n"
+                       "depth_min=%.9g\ndepth_max=%.9g\ndepth_share_at_far=%.6f\n", dw, dh, (double)dmin, (double)dmax, dfar);
+        else
+            fprintf(f, "depth_file_size=none (no snapshot of this zeta could be made)\n");
+        fprintf(f, "display_surface=%u:0x%X\ndisplay_guest_size=%ux%u\ndisplay_rs=%.4f\n",
+                dp->location, dp->offset, dp->w, dp->h, (double)dp->rs);
+        fprintf(f, "display_dump_size=%ux%u\n",
+                ld_hs(dp->w > g.width ? g.width : dp->w, dp->rs), ld_hs(dp->h > g.height ? g.height : dp->h, dp->rs));
+        fprintf(f, "boundary_viewport=%u,%u %ux%u\n", s_scn.b_vp[0], s_scn.b_vp[1], s_scn.b_vp[2], s_scn.b_vp[3]);
+        fprintf(f, "jitter_on=%d\njitter_x=%.6f\njitter_y=%.6f\njitter_phase=%u\njitter_phases=%d\njitter_rule=%d\n",
+                s_jit.on, s_jit.on ? (double)s_jit.x : 0.0, s_jit.on ? (double)s_jit.y : 0.0, s_jit.phase, s_jit.phases, s_jit.rule);
+        /* What the first perspective scene draw at the full viewport says of the projection. With
+         * clip z = A * w + B (w = clip w) the stored depth is d = sz * (A + B / w) + tz. Estimates:
+         * they assume that draw's object-to-clip matrix has no scale in it. */
+        if (s_scn.proj_have) {
+            const float* c1 = s_scn.proj_c[0]; const float* c2 = s_scn.proj_c[1]; const float* c3 = s_scn.proj_c[2];
+            const double n1 = sqrt((double)c1[0] * c1[0] + (double)c1[1] * c1[1] + (double)c1[2] * c1[2]);
+            const double n3 = sqrt((double)c3[0] * c3[0] + (double)c3[1] * c3[1] + (double)c3[2] * c3[2]);
+            fprintf(f, "proj_c1=%.9g %.9g %.9g %.9g\nproj_c2=%.9g %.9g %.9g %.9g\nproj_c3=%.9g %.9g %.9g %.9g\n",
+                    (double)c1[0], (double)c1[1], (double)c1[2], (double)c1[3], (double)c2[0], (double)c2[1], (double)c2[2], (double)c2[3],
+                    (double)c3[0], (double)c3[1], (double)c3[2], (double)c3[3]);
+            fprintf(f, "viewport_scale_z=%.9g\nviewport_translate_z=%.9g\n", (double)s_scn.proj_sz, (double)s_scn.proj_tz);
+            if (n1 > 0.0 && n3 > 0.0) {
+                const double A = ((double)c2[0] * c3[0] + (double)c2[1] * c3[1] + (double)c2[2] * c3[2]) / (n3 * n3);
+                const double B = (double)c2[3] - A * (double)c3[3];
+                const double wn = -B / (1.0 + A), wf = B / (1.0 - A);
+                fprintf(f, "proj_A=%.9g\nproj_B=%.9g\n", A, B);
+                fprintf(f, "near_estimate=%.6g\nfar_estimate=%.6g\nfovy_estimate_degrees=%.4f\n",
+                        wn / n3, wf / n3, 2.0 * atan(n3 / n1) * 57.29577951308232);
+            }
+        } else {
+            fprintf(f, "near_estimate=unknown (no perspective scene draw at the full viewport was seen)\n");
+        }
+        if (s_mv.mode) ld_mv_dump(base, f);      /* [mv] the vectors' files and figures */
+        if (s_up.on) ld_up_dump(base, f);        /* [up] the upscaled picture */
+        fclose(f);
+    } else {
+        if (s_mv.mode) ld_mv_dump(base, NULL);
+        if (s_up.on) ld_up_dump(base, NULL);
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "[scene] dump %u (%s): frame %u, scene %u:0x%X %ux%u host, jitter %s %.3f,%.3f -> %s_*\n",
+            seq, st->tag, s_scn.present_no, sc->location, sc->offset, ld_hs(sc->w, sc->rs), ld_hs(sc->h, sc->rs),
+            s_jit.on ? "on" : "off", s_jit.on ? (double)s_jit.x : 0.0, s_jit.on ? (double)s_jit.y : 0.0, base);
+    fflush(stderr);
+}
+
+/* The steps of a capture, made when it is triggered. */
+static void ld_cap_add(u8 kind, int jit, const char* tag, float scale, u32 frames)
+{
+    if (s_cap.n_steps >= sizeof s_cap.steps / sizeof s_cap.steps[0]) return;
+    ld_cap_step* st = &s_cap.steps[s_cap.n_steps++];
+    memset(st, 0, sizeof *st);
+    st->kind = kind; st->jit = (signed char)jit; st->scale = scale; st->frames = frames;
+    if (tag) strncpy(st->tag, tag, sizeof st->tag - 1u);
+}
+static void ld_cap_start(void)
+{
+    s_cap.n_steps = 0; s_cap.step = 0; s_cap.tries = 0; s_cap.scale_changed = 0;
+    s_cap.user_scale = g_rs_user;
+    if (s_cap.test) {
+        /* jit: 0 = no offset, 1..4 = the four sample positions of a 2x2 grid (ld_scn_frame_end). */
+        static const char* const tags[6] = { "j0", "j1", "j2", "j3", "j4", "j5" };
+        static const signed char jit[6] = { 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 0 };
+        if (s_cap.test == 1) {
+            if (g_rs_user != 1.0f) { ld_cap_add(LD_CAP_SCALE, 0, "", 1.0f, 0); ld_cap_add(LD_CAP_SETTLE, 0, "", 0.0f, 12); }
+            ld_cap_add(LD_CAP_FRAME, 0, "ref", 0.0f, 0);
+            ld_cap_add(LD_CAP_SCALE, 0, "", 0.5f, 0);
+            ld_cap_add(LD_CAP_SETTLE, 0, "", 0.0f, 12);
+        }
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < 6; i++) ld_cap_add(LD_CAP_FRAME, jit[i], tags[i], 0.0f, 0);
+        if (s_cap.test == 1) ld_cap_add(LD_CAP_SCALE, 0, "", s_cap.user_scale, 0);
+    } else {
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < s_cap.frames && i < 24u; i++) ld_cap_add(LD_CAP_FRAME, -1, "n", 0.0f, 0);
+    }
+    s_cap.running = 1;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[scene] capture started at frame %u: %u steps%s\n", g_ld_frames, s_cap.n_steps,
+            s_cap.test == 1 ? " (jitter test, with its own resolution scales)" : s_cap.test ? " (jitter test)" : "");
+}
+
+/* A game frame has ended and the next begins (the first draw or clear after a flip). */
+static void ld_scn_frame_end(void)
+{
+    if (s_cap.pending) ld_scn_pending_run();     /* the boundary draw was the frame's last */
+
+    static int inited, log_on;
+    static int mv_user;                          /* [mv] LD_MV as set; the upscaler asks for 2 */
+    if (!inited) {
+        inited = 1;
+        const char* e;
+        log_on = (e = getenv("LD_SCENE_LOG")) != NULL && atoi(e) != 0;
+        s_cap.dir = (e = getenv("LD_SCENE_DUMP")) != NULL && e[0] ? e : NULL;
+        s_cap.consts_path = (e = getenv("LD_SCENE_CONSTS")) != NULL && e[0] ? e : NULL;
+        s_cap.trigger = (e = getenv("LD_SCENE_DUMP_FILE")) != NULL && e[0] ? e : NULL;
+        s_cap.at = (e = getenv("LD_SCENE_DUMP_AT")) != NULL && e[0] ? atol(e) : -1;
+        s_cap.frames = (e = getenv("LD_SCENE_DUMP_FRAMES")) != NULL && atoi(e) > 0 ? (u32)atoi(e) : 2u;
+        s_cap.test = (e = getenv("LD_JITTER_TEST")) != NULL ? atoi(e) : 0;
+        if (s_cap.test < 0 || s_cap.test > 2) s_cap.test = 0;
+        if (s_cap.test && !s_cap.dir) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "[scene] LD_JITTER_TEST needs LD_SCENE_DUMP=<dir>: ignored\n");
+            s_cap.test = 0;
+        }
+        s_jit.rule = (e = getenv("LD_JITTER_RULE")) != NULL ? atoi(e) : 0;
+        if (s_jit.rule < 0 || s_jit.rule > 2) s_jit.rule = 0;
+        s_mv.dump = (e = getenv("LD_MV_DUMP")) != NULL && atoi(e) != 0;     /* [mv] */
+        s_mv.log = (e = getenv("LD_MV_LOG")) != NULL && atoi(e) != 0;
+        s_up.log = (e = getenv("LD_UP_LOG")) != NULL && atoi(e) != 0;      /* [up] */
+        s_up.copy_in = (e = getenv("LD_UP_COPY")) != NULL && atoi(e) != 0;
+        s_up.resolve_fix = !((e = getenv("LD_UP_RESOLVE")) != NULL && atoi(e) == 0);
+        s_up.lod_bias = !((e = getenv("LD_UP_LOD")) != NULL && atoi(e) == 0);
+        g_scn_rule = !((e = getenv("LD_SCENE_RULE")) != NULL && atoi(e) == 0);              /* [aa3d] */
+        g_rs_scene_follow = !((e = getenv("LD_RES_SCENE")) != NULL && atoi(e) == 0);       /* [aa3d] */
+    }
+    { static unsigned gen = ~0u;
+      if (gen != gt5_settings_gen()) {
+          gen = gt5_settings_gen();
+          int n = gt5_setting_int("LD_JITTER", 0);
+          if (n < 0) n = 0;
+          if (n > 1024) n = 1024;
+          if (n != s_jit.phases) {
+              s_jit.phases = n;
+              if (n) fprintf(stderr, "[scene] camera jitter on: Halton(2,3), %d phases, rule %d (LD_JITTER)\n", n, s_jit.rule);
+              else   fprintf(stderr, "[scene] camera jitter off (LD_JITTER)\n");
+          }
+          /* [mv] */
+          mv_user = gt5_setting_int("LD_MV", 0);
+          if (mv_user < 0 || mv_user > 2) mv_user = 0;
+          const int v = gt5_setting_int("LD_MV_VIEW", 0);
+          s_mv.view = v > 0;
+          s_mv.view_px = v > 1 ? (float)v : 16.0f;
+          /* [up] */
+          char txt[32];
+          gt5_setting_str("LD_AA", txt, sizeof txt);
+          const int want = !_stricmp(txt, "dlaa") ? 1 : !_stricmp(txt, "dlss_q") ? 2 : !_stricmp(txt, "dlss_b") ? 3 :
+                           !_stricmp(txt, "dlss_p") ? 4 : !_stricmp(txt, "dlss_u") ? 5 : !_stricmp(txt, "dlss_c") ? 6 : 0;
+          float pct = (float)gt5_setting_float("LD_DLSS_SCALE", 100.0);
+          if (!(pct >= 33.0f)) pct = 33.0f;
+          if (pct > 100.0f) pct = 100.0f;
+          s_up.scale_pct = pct;
+          gt5_setting_str("LD_DLSS_PRESET", txt, sizeof txt);
+          const int preset = (txt[0] == 'J' || txt[0] == 'j') ? 10 : (txt[0] == 'K' || txt[0] == 'k') ? 11 :
+                             (txt[0] == 'L' || txt[0] == 'l') ? 12 : (txt[0] == 'M' || txt[0] == 'm') ? 13 : 0;
+          if (want != s_up.want || preset != s_up.preset) {
+              s_up.want = want; s_up.preset = preset;
+              s_up.gave_up = 0; s_up.fails = s_up.waits = 0; s_up.reason[0] = 0;   /* a change is a new try */
+              if (want && !s_up.avail)
+                  fprintf(stderr, "[upscale] LD_AA asks for DLSS, which cannot be used here: the setting is ignored\n");
+          }
+          float sx = 1.0f, sy = 1.0f;
+          gt5_setting_str("LD_UP_JITTER_SIGN", txt, sizeof txt);
+          if (txt[0]) { float a = 0.0f, b = 0.0f; if (sscanf(txt, "%f,%f", &a, &b) == 2) { sx = a < 0.0f ? -1.0f : 1.0f; sy = b < 0.0f ? -1.0f : 1.0f; } }
+          if (sx != s_up.sign_x || sy != s_up.sign_y) { s_up.sign_x = sx; s_up.sign_y = sy; s_up.reset_next = 1; }
+          s_up.view = gt5_setting_int("LD_UP_VIEW", 0);
+          gt5_setting_str("LD_UP_OUT", txt, sizeof txt);
+          s_up.out_scene = !_stricmp(txt, "scene");
+      } }
+    /* [up] The upscaler is on when wanted, usable and not given up; it then needs the vectors per object. */
+    { const int on = s_up.want && s_up.avail && !s_up.gave_up;
+      if (on != s_up.on) {
+          s_up.on = on;
+          if (on) fprintf(stderr, "[upscale] on: LD_AA mode %d, model %d (0 = the default)\n", s_up.want, s_up.preset);
+          else    fprintf(stderr, "[upscale] off%s%s\n", s_up.gave_up ? ": " : "", s_up.gave_up ? s_up.reason : "");
+      }
+      if (!s_up.want) InterlockedExchange(&s_up.state, s_up.avail || !s_up.loaded ? LD_UP_S_OFF : LD_UP_S_UNAVAILABLE);
+      else if (!s_up.avail) InterlockedExchange(&s_up.state, LD_UP_S_UNAVAILABLE);
+      else if (s_up.gave_up) InterlockedExchange(&s_up.state, LD_UP_S_GAVE_UP);
+      const int fg2 = rsx_fg_version() == 2;      /* [fg1] frame generation from the real vectors asks for them too */
+      const int m = on || fg2 ? 2 : mv_user;
+      if (m != s_mv.mode) {
+          s_mv.mode = m;
+          s_mv.prev_valid = 0;
+          fprintf(stderr, "[mv] motion vectors %s (%s)\n", m == 2 ? "per object" : m == 1 ? "from the camera only" : "off",
+                  on ? "for the upscaler" : fg2 ? "for frame generation" : m == 2 ? "LD_MV=2" : m == 1 ? "LD_MV=1" : "LD_MV=0");
+      } }
+
+    /* ---- the frame that ended ----
+     * Not a frame watch mode or the frame skip left out (g_ld_skip_frame still is that frame's here:
+     * only its every-other-frame passes ran), nor one with no draw at all: they say nothing. */
+    if (s_scn.on && s_scn.draws && !g_ld_skip_frame) {
+        int kind, reason = s_scn.reason;
+        if (s_scn.found) {
+            kind = LD_SCN_SCENE;
+        } else if (reason == LD_SCN_R_HELD) {
+            kind = LD_SCN_HELD;
+        } else {
+            kind = LD_SCN_BYPASS;
+            if (!s_scn.disp_seen) reason = LD_SCN_R_NO_DISPLAY;
+        }
+        /* One line when the judgement changes: the kind, the reason, the scene or where it goes. */
+        static int l_kind = -1, l_reason; static ld_scn_sig l_sig; static float l_rs; static u32 l_vp[4]; static u32 n_logs;
+        const int changed = kind != l_kind || (kind == LD_SCN_BYPASS && reason != l_reason) ||
+            (kind == LD_SCN_SCENE && (memcmp(&l_sig, &s_scn.b_sig, sizeof l_sig) != 0 || l_rs != s_scn.b_rs ||
+                                      memcmp(l_vp, s_scn.b_vp, sizeof l_vp) != 0));
+        if (changed) {
+            l_kind = kind; l_reason = reason;
+            if (kind == LD_SCN_SCENE) { l_sig = s_scn.b_sig; l_rs = s_scn.b_rs; memcpy(l_vp, s_scn.b_vp, sizeof l_vp); }
+            n_logs++;
+            if (n_logs <= 200u || (n_logs & (n_logs - 1u)) == 0) {
+                if (kind == LD_SCN_SCENE)
+                    fprintf(stderr, "[scene] frame %u: 3D scene %u:0x%X %ux%u (grid %ux%u, x%.3f = %ux%u; clip %ux%u), zeta %u:0x%X, "
+                                    "%u depth-tested draws; boundary = draw %u of %u, into display %u:0x%X (x%.3f) viewport %u,%u %ux%u\n",
+                            s_scn.present_no, s_scn.b_sig.loc, s_scn.b_sig.off, s_scn.b_sig.w, s_scn.b_sig.h, s_scn.b_sig.ax, s_scn.b_sig.ay,
+                            (double)s_scn.b_rs, ld_hs(s_scn.b_sig.w, s_scn.b_rs), ld_hs(s_scn.b_sig.h, s_scn.b_rs), s_scn.b_sig.cw, s_scn.b_sig.ch,
+                            s_scn.b_sig.zloc, s_scn.b_sig.zoff, s_scn.b_depth_draws, s_scn.b_draw, s_scn.draws,
+                            s_scn.b_disp_loc, s_scn.b_disp_off, (double)s_scn.b_disp_rs,
+                            s_scn.b_vp[0], s_scn.b_vp[1], s_scn.b_vp[2], s_scn.b_vp[3]);
+                else if (kind == LD_SCN_HELD)
+                    fprintf(stderr, "[scene] frame %u: scene held (%s; %u draws)\n", s_scn.present_no, ld_scn_reason_text(reason), s_scn.draws);
+                else
+                    fprintf(stderr, "[scene] frame %u: bypass (%s; %u draws)\n", s_scn.present_no, ld_scn_reason_text(reason), s_scn.draws);
+                fflush(stderr);
+            }
+        }
+        s_scn.kind = kind;
+        if (kind == LD_SCN_SCENE) { if (s_nw.scene_frames < 0xFFFFFFFFu) s_nw.scene_frames++; }   /* [nowait] */
