+        else if (kind == LD_SCN_BYPASS) s_nw.scene_frames = 0;
+        if (kind == LD_SCN_SCENE) {   /* [nowait3] the last scene found, kept through loading screens */
+            s_nw_scene.valid = 1;
+            s_nw_scene.loc = s_scn.b_sig.loc; s_nw_scene.off = s_scn.b_sig.off;
+            s_nw_scene.zloc = s_scn.b_sig.zloc; s_nw_scene.zoff = s_scn.b_sig.zoff;
+            if (s_scn.b_scene < MAX_SURFACES) s_nw_was_scene[s_scn.b_scene] = 1;
+        }
+        if (kind == LD_SCN_SCENE) { s_scn.sig = s_scn.b_sig; s_scn.sig_rs = s_scn.b_rs; s_scn.sig_valid = 1; }
+        if (kind == LD_SCN_SCENE) { s_up.vp_w = s_scn.b_vp[2]; s_up.vp_h = s_scn.b_vp[3]; s_up.disp_rs = s_scn.b_disp_rs; }   /* [up] */
+        else if (kind == LD_SCN_BYPASS) s_scn.sig_valid = 0;
+        if (s_jit.used) s_jit.index++;
+        if (s_mv.mode) ld_mv_frame_end(kind);    /* [mv] this frame's objects become the frame before's */
+        if (s_cap.active && !s_scn.found && s_cap.consts)     /* its rows are not a whole scene */
+            fprintf(s_cap.consts, "#no_boundary,%u\n", s_scn.present_no);
+        /* The capture: a settling step counts scene frames; a frame step that got no boundary waits. */
+        if (s_cap.running && s_cap.step < s_cap.n_steps) {
+            ld_cap_step* st = &s_cap.steps[s_cap.step];
+            if (st->kind == LD_CAP_SETTLE) {
+                if (kind == LD_SCN_SCENE && st->frames) st->frames--;
+                if (!st->frames) s_cap.step++;
+            }
+            if (++s_cap.tries > 900u) {
+                fprintf(stderr, "[scene] capture given up at step %u of %u: no 3D scene frame in 900 frames\n", s_cap.step, s_cap.n_steps);
+                if (s_cap.scale_changed) ld_set_res_scale(s_cap.user_scale);
+                s_cap.running = 0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    s_scn.frame++;
+    s_scn.present_no = g_ld_frames;
+    s_scn.draws = s_scn.scene_draws = 0;
+    s_scn.disp_seen = s_scn.found = 0;
+    s_scn.held_seen = 0;                         /* [aa3d] */
+    s_scn.reason = LD_SCN_R_NONE;
+    s_scn.proj_have = 0;
+    s_jit.used = 0;
+
+    /* ---- the frame that starts ---- */
+    ld_nw_frame();                               /* [nowait] the setting; it needs the scene known too */
+    s_scn.on = log_on || s_cap.dir || s_cap.consts_path || s_jit.phases > 0 || s_mv.mode > 0 || s_up.on ||
+               (g_rs_scene_follow && g_rs_user > 1.0f) ||   /* [aa3d] LD_RES_SCENE needs to know the 3D picture */
+               s_nw.want;
+    s_cap.active = 0;
+    /* [fgv] A vendor's frame generator the setting no longer asks for (another method, frame generation
+     * off, or it failed and version 2 took over): its context goes once every list that used it has run. */
+    if (rsx_fg_vendor_stale()) {
+        ld_flush(LD_FLUSH_RETIRE_QUEUE);
+        if (g.ready) { ld_rec_sync(); rsx_fg_vendor_drop(); }
+    }
+    if (s_up.on || s_up.made || s_up.out || (g_rs_scene_on && g_rs_scene_owner != 2)) ld_up_frame_begin();   /* [up] before the vectors: it may resize the scene */
+    if (!s_up.on) ld_rs_scene_follow_frame();    /* [aa3d] LD_RES_SCENE, while no upscaler sizes the scene */
+    ld_mv_frame_begin();                         /* [mv] after the frame's scene is known */
+    if (!s_scn.on) { s_jit.on = 0; return; }
+
+    /* The capture's trigger: a present number, a file, or (neither given) at once. */
+    if ((s_cap.dir || s_cap.consts_path) && !s_cap.running) {
+        int fire = 0;
+        if (s_cap.trigger) {
+            if ((s_scn.frame & 7u) == 0) {
+                const int there = GetFileAttributesA(s_cap.trigger) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES;
+                if (there && !s_cap.trigger_seen) fire = 1;
+                s_cap.trigger_seen = there;
+            }
+        } else if (!s_cap.at_done && (s_cap.at < 0 || (long)g_ld_frames >= s_cap.at)) {
+            fire = s_scn.kind == LD_SCN_SCENE;     /* waits for a 3D scene to be on screen */
+            if (fire) s_cap.at_done = 1;
+        }
+        if (fire) ld_cap_start();
+    }
+    signed char jit_step = -1;     /* -1: no capture frame, the setting decides; 0: none; 1..4: the test's offsets */
+    if (s_cap.running) {
+        while (s_cap.step < s_cap.n_steps && s_cap.steps[s_cap.step].kind == LD_CAP_SCALE) {
+            ld_set_res_scale(s_cap.steps[s_cap.step].scale);     /* counts from the next flip */
+            s_cap.scale_changed = s_cap.steps[s_cap.step].scale != s_cap.user_scale;
+            s_cap.step++;
+        }
+        if (s_cap.step >= s_cap.n_steps) {
+            s_cap.running = 0;
+            if (s_cap.consts) fflush(s_cap.consts);
+            fprintf(stderr, "[scene] capture finished at frame %u: %u frames written\n", g_ld_frames, s_cap.seq);
+            fflush(stderr);
+        } else if (s_cap.steps[s_cap.step].kind == LD_CAP_FRAME && s_scn.sig_valid) {
+            s_cap.active = 1;
+            jit_step = s_cap.steps[s_cap.step].jit;
+        } else if (s_cap.test) {
+            jit_step = 0;          /* between the test's frames: no jitter */
+        }
+    }
+
+    /* This frame's jitter. */
+    s_jit.on = 0; s_jit.x = s_jit.y = 0.0f; s_jit.phase = 0;
+    if (s_scn.sig_valid) {
+        if (jit_step >= 1) {
+            /* The four samples of a 2x2 grid over the pixel: the frame with offset (+1/4, +1/4) is the
+             * top-left sample of each pixel of a picture twice the size, (-1/4, +1/4) the top-right,
+             * (+1/4, -1/4) the bottom-left, (-1/4, -1/4) the bottom-right. */
+            static const float q[4][2] = { { 0.25f, 0.25f }, { -0.25f, 0.25f }, { 0.25f, -0.25f }, { -0.25f, -0.25f } };
+            s_jit.on = 1; s_jit.x = q[jit_step - 1][0]; s_jit.y = q[jit_step - 1][1]; s_jit.phase = (u32)jit_step;
+        } else if (jit_step < 0 && (s_jit.phases > 0 || (s_up.on && s_up.ready))) {
+            /* [up] the upscaler's own count when LD_JITTER does not say; a change of length starts it afresh */
+            const u32 phases = s_jit.phases > 0 ? (u32)s_jit.phases : s_up.jit_phases ? s_up.jit_phases : 8u;
+            { static u32 l_phases; if (phases != l_phases) { l_phases = phases; s_up.reset_next = 1; } }
+            s_up.phases_now = phases;
+            s_jit.phase = s_jit.index % phases;
+            s_jit.on = 1;
+            s_jit.x = ld_halton(s_jit.phase + 1u, 2u) - 0.5f;
+            s_jit.y = ld_halton(s_jit.phase + 1u, 3u) - 0.5f;
+        }
+    }
+}
+/* ---- [scene] end (second block) ------------------------------------------------------------ */
+
+/* ---- [mv] begin (second block): see the first one, after the first [scene] block ------------ */
+
+/* 4x4 matrices, row-major, for column vectors: out = a * b; inverse by cofactors (0 when singular). */
+static void ld_m4_mul(const double* a, const double* b, double* out)
+{
+    for (u32 r = 0; r < 4; r++)
+        for (u32 c = 0; c < 4; c++)
+            out[r * 4 + c] = a[r * 4] * b[c] + a[r * 4 + 1] * b[4 + c] + a[r * 4 + 2] * b[8 + c] + a[r * 4 + 3] * b[12 + c];
+}
+static int ld_m4_inv(const double* m, double* out)
+{
+    double v[16];
+    v[0]  =  m[5] * m[10] * m[15] - m[5] * m[11] * m[14] - m[9] * m[6] * m[15] + m[9] * m[7] * m[14] + m[13] * m[6] * m[11] - m[13] * m[7] * m[10];
+    v[4]  = -m[4] * m[10] * m[15] + m[4] * m[11] * m[14] + m[8] * m[6] * m[15] - m[8] * m[7] * m[14] - m[12] * m[6] * m[11] + m[12] * m[7] * m[10];
+    v[8]  =  m[4] * m[9] * m[15] - m[4] * m[11] * m[13] - m[8] * m[5] * m[15] + m[8] * m[7] * m[13] + m[12] * m[5] * m[11] - m[12] * m[7] * m[9];
+    v[12] = -m[4] * m[9] * m[14] + m[4] * m[10] * m[13] + m[8] * m[5] * m[14] - m[8] * m[6] * m[13] - m[12] * m[5] * m[10] + m[12] * m[6] * m[9];
+    v[1]  = -m[1] * m[10] * m[15] + m[1] * m[11] * m[14] + m[9] * m[2] * m[15] - m[9] * m[3] * m[14] - m[13] * m[2] * m[11] + m[13] * m[3] * m[10];
+    v[5]  =  m[0] * m[10] * m[15] - m[0] * m[11] * m[14] - m[8] * m[2] * m[15] + m[8] * m[3] * m[14] + m[12] * m[2] * m[11] - m[12] * m[3] * m[10];
+    v[9]  = -m[0] * m[9] * m[15] + m[0] * m[11] * m[13] + m[8] * m[1] * m[15] - m[8] * m[3] * m[13] - m[12] * m[1] * m[11] + m[12] * m[3] * m[9];
+    v[13] =  m[0] * m[9] * m[14] - m[0] * m[10] * m[13] - m[8] * m[1] * m[14] + m[8] * m[2] * m[13] + m[12] * m[1] * m[10] - m[12] * m[2] * m[9];
+    v[2]  =  m[1] * m[6] * m[15] - m[1] * m[7] * m[14] - m[5] * m[2] * m[15] + m[5] * m[3] * m[14] + m[13] * m[2] * m[7] - m[13] * m[3] * m[6];
+    v[6]  = -m[0] * m[6] * m[15] + m[0] * m[7] * m[14] + m[4] * m[2] * m[15] - m[4] * m[3] * m[14] - m[12] * m[2] * m[7] + m[12] * m[3] * m[6];
+    v[10] =  m[0] * m[5] * m[15] - m[0] * m[7] * m[13] - m[4] * m[1] * m[15] + m[4] * m[3] * m[13] + m[12] * m[1] * m[7] - m[12] * m[3] * m[5];
+    v[14] = -m[0] * m[5] * m[14] + m[0] * m[6] * m[13] + m[4] * m[1] * m[14] - m[4] * m[2] * m[13] - m[12] * m[1] * m[6] + m[12] * m[2] * m[5];
+    v[3]  = -m[1] * m[6] * m[11] + m[1] * m[7] * m[10] + m[5] * m[2] * m[11] - m[5] * m[3] * m[10] - m[9] * m[2] * m[7] + m[9] * m[3] * m[6];
+    v[7]  =  m[0] * m[6] * m[11] - m[0] * m[7] * m[10] - m[4] * m[2] * m[11] + m[4] * m[3] * m[10] + m[8] * m[2] * m[7] - m[8] * m[3] * m[6];
+    v[11] = -m[0] * m[5] * m[11] + m[0] * m[7] * m[9] + m[4] * m[1] * m[11] - m[4] * m[3] * m[9] - m[8] * m[1] * m[7] + m[8] * m[3] * m[5];
+    v[15] =  m[0] * m[5] * m[10] - m[0] * m[6] * m[9] - m[4] * m[1] * m[10] + m[4] * m[2] * m[9] + m[8] * m[1] * m[6] - m[8] * m[2] * m[5];
+    const double det = m[0] * v[0] + m[1] * v[4] + m[2] * v[8] + m[3] * v[12];
+    if (!(det > 1e-300 || det < -1e-300)) return 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < 16; i++) out[i] = v[i] / det;
+    return 1;
+}
+/* The viewport transform xf (what the vertex shader does to a clip position) as a matrix. */
+static void ld_mv_xf_matrix(const float* xf, double* x)
+{
+    memset(x, 0, 16 * sizeof(double));
+    x[0] = xf[0]; x[3] = xf[4];
+    x[5] = xf[1]; x[7] = xf[5];
+    x[10] = xf[2]; x[11] = xf[6];
+    x[15] = 1.0;
+}
+
+/* Should the draw being set up get the motion-vector pipeline? (get_pso: the answer is part of the
+ * pipeline's key through LD_RT_MV.) A perspective draw into the remembered scene that writes depth:
+ * the vector then belongs to the surface whose depth the scene's zeta holds. Blended draws without
+ * depth write (glass, smoke, the racing line) leave the vector of what is behind them. Not a draw
+ * with several guest colour targets, and not while the vector targets are of another size than the
+ * scene target (a resolution scale that changed this frame). */
+static int ld_mv_pipeline_wanted(const rsx_dsp_surface* sf, int depth_test, int depth_write, u32 rt_count)
+{
+    if (!s_mv.live || !s_mv.obj_tex || rt_count != 1u || !depth_test || !depth_write) return 0;
+    if (!s_scn.sig_valid || sf->clip_w != s_scn.sig.cw || sf->clip_h != s_scn.sig.ch) return 0;
+    /* The surface the draw will land in, as current_surface() will find it (nothing is created here). */
+    const u32 at = surface_find(sf->color_location[0], sf->color_offset[0], sf->clip_w, sf->clip_h,
+                                sf->color_format == RSX_SURFACE_FMT_F_W16Z16Y16X16
+                                    ? DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT : DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM);
+    if (at == MAX_SURFACES || !ld_scn_sig_is(&s_scn.sig, &g.surfaces[at])) return 0;
+    if (ld_hs(g.surfaces[at].w, g.surfaces[at].rs) != s_mv.w || ld_hs(g.surfaces[at].h, g.surfaces[at].rs) != s_mv.h) return 0;
+    const float* c3 = (const float*)g.rsx.constants[3];
+    return c3[0] != 0.0f || c3[1] != 0.0f || c3[2] != 0.0f;
+}
+
+/* The two vector textures at the scene target's host size, their views, and the SRV slots the
+ * full-screen passes read them through. 1 when they are there. */
+static int ld_mv_targets(u32 w, u32 h)
+{
+    if (s_mv.obj_tex && s_mv.out_tex && s_mv.w == w && s_mv.h == h) return 1;
+    if (!w || !h) return 0;
+    if (!s_mv.rtv_heap) {
+        D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC hd = {0};
+        hd.Type = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV;
+        hd.NumDescriptors = 2;
+        if (FAILED(g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateDescriptorHeap(g.dev, &hd, &IID_ID3D12DescriptorHeap, (void**)&s_mv.rtv_heap))) {
+            s_mv.rtv_heap = NULL;
+            return 0;
+        }
+        s_mv.rtv_heap->lpVtbl->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(s_mv.rtv_heap, &s_mv.obj_rtv);
+        s_mv.out_rtv = s_mv.obj_rtv;
+        s_mv.out_rtv.ptr += g.rtv_step;
+    }
+    if (s_mv.obj_tex) retire_texture(s_mv.obj_tex);      /* the open command list may still use them */
+    if (s_mv.out_tex) retire_texture(s_mv.out_tex);
+    s_mv.obj_tex = s_mv.out_tex = NULL;
+    s_mv.w = s_mv.h = 0;
+    D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp = {0}; hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT;
+    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC rd = {0};
+    rd.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
+    rd.Width = w; rd.Height = h; rd.DepthOrArraySize = 1;
+    rd.MipLevels = 1; rd.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT; rd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
+    rd.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_RENDER_TARGET;
+    D3D12_CLEAR_VALUE cv = {0};
+    cv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT;
+    cv.Color[0] = cv.Color[1] = LD_MV_SENTINEL;
+    ID3D12Resource* a = NULL; ID3D12Resource* b = NULL;
+    if (FAILED(LD_CCR(g.dev, &hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &rd, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, &cv,
+                      &IID_ID3D12Resource, (void**)&a)))
+        a = NULL;
+    cv.Color[0] = cv.Color[1] = 0.0f;
+    if (a && FAILED(LD_CCR(g.dev, &hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &rd, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, &cv,
+                           &IID_ID3D12Resource, (void**)&b)))
+        b = NULL;
+    if (!a || !b) {
+        if (a) a->lpVtbl->Release(a);
+        static u32 said;
+        if (said++ < 4u) fprintf(stderr, "[mv] the vector targets (%ux%u) could not be made: no motion vectors\n", w, h);
+        return 0;
+    }
+    /* The views sit in slots draws already recorded may name: wait for the recording thread, as every
+     * other rewritten view does. */
+    (s_ld_rt_dirty = 1), ld_rec_sync();
+    g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateRenderTargetView(g.dev, a, NULL, s_mv.obj_rtv);
+    g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateRenderTargetView(g.dev, b, NULL, s_mv.out_rtv);
+    srv_write(SRV_MV_BASE + 0, a);
+    srv_write(SRV_MV_BASE + 1, b);
+    s_mv.obj_tex = a; s_mv.out_tex = b;
+    s_mv.w = w; s_mv.h = h;
+    s_mv.obj_cleared = 0;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[mv] vector targets %ux%u (R16G16_FLOAT), mode %d\n", w, h, s_mv.mode);
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* The full-screen passes: one root signature (52 constants, a table of two textures), two pipelines.
+ *   fill: this frame's vectors. Where the object target holds one, that; elsewhere the pixel's depth
+ *         taken through the camera matrices of the viewport it lies in (rows a0, a1, a2 per region:
+ *         previous pixel x * w, y * w and w as a0.x * x + a0.y * y + a0.w - (1 - depth) * a0.z, the
+ *         form that keeps its precision next to the far plane).
+ *   view: the vectors as colours over a rect of the display buffer. */
+static int ld_mv_pipelines(void)
+{
+    static int failed;
+    if (s_mv.fill_pso && s_mv.view_pso) return 1;
+    if (failed) return 0;
+    failed = 1;
+    static const char src[] =
+        "cbuffer C : register(b0) { float4 r[12]; float4 misc; };\n"
+        "Texture2D t0 : register(t0);\n"
+        "Texture2D t1 : register(t1);\n"
+        "float4 vs(uint id : SV_VertexID) : SV_Position {\n"
+        "    float2 q = float2((id << 1) & 2, id & 2);\n"
+        "    return float4(q * float2(2, -2) + float2(-1, 1), 0, 1); }\n"
+        "float4 ps_fill(float4 p : SV_Position) : SV_Target {\n"
+        "    int3 ip = int3(p.xy, 0);\n"
+        "    if (misc.z > 0.5) { float2 o = t1.Load(ip).xy; if (o.x < 20000.0) return float4(o, 0, 0); }\n"
+        "    int k = 0;\n"
+        "    if (misc.w > 2.5 && p.x >= r[8].x && p.y >= r[8].y && p.x < r[8].z && p.y < r[8].w) k = 2;\n"
+        "    else if (misc.w > 1.5 && p.x >= r[4].x && p.y >= r[4].y && p.x < r[4].z && p.y < r[4].w) k = 1;\n"
+        "    float4 a0 = r[k * 4 + 1], a1 = r[k * 4 + 2], a2 = r[k * 4 + 3];\n"
+        "    float2 u = p.xy - misc.xy;\n"
+        "    float e = 1.0 - t0.Load(ip).x;\n"
+        "    float3 q = float3(a0.x * u.x + a0.y * u.y + a0.w - e * a0.z,\n"
+        "                      a1.x * u.x + a1.y * u.y + a1.w - e * a1.z,\n"
+        "                      a2.x * u.x + a2.y * u.y + a2.w - e * a2.z);\n"
+        "    if (!(q.z > 1e-6)) return float4(0, 0, 0, 0);\n"
+        "    return float4(clamp(q.xy / q.z - u, -4096.0, 4096.0), 0, 0);\n"
+        "}\n"
+        "float4 ps_view(float4 p : SV_Position) : SV_Target {\n"
+        "    float2 f = (p.xy - r[0].xy) / (r[0].zw - r[0].xy);\n"
+        "    float2 v = t0.Load(int3(r[1].xy + f * (r[1].zw - r[1].xy), 0)).xy;\n"
+        "    float m = saturate(length(v) / misc.x);\n"
+        "    float h = atan2(v.y, v.x) / 6.2831853 + 0.5;\n"
+        "    float3 c = saturate(abs(frac(h + float3(0.0, 2.0 / 3.0, 1.0 / 3.0)) * 6.0 - 3.0) - 1.0);\n"
+        "    return float4(c * m, 1);\n"
+        "}\n";
+    if (!s_mv.rootsig) {
+        D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE range = {0};
+        range.RangeType = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV;
+        range.NumDescriptors = 2;
+        D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER p[2] = {0};
+        p[0].ParameterType = D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER_TYPE_32BIT_CONSTANTS;
+        p[0].Constants.Num32BitValues = 52;
+        p[0].ShaderVisibility = D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL;
+        p[1].ParameterType = D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_TABLE;
+        p[1].DescriptorTable.NumDescriptorRanges = 1;
+        p[1].DescriptorTable.pDescriptorRanges = &range;
+        p[1].ShaderVisibility = D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL;
+        D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rsd = {0};
+        rsd.NumParameters = 2; rsd.pParameters = p;
+        ID3DBlob* sig = NULL; ID3DBlob* err = NULL;
+        if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rsd, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &sig, &err))) {
+            if (err) err->lpVtbl->Release(err);
+            return 0;
+        }
+        HRESULT hr = g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateRootSignature(g.dev, 0, sig->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(sig),
+                         sig->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(sig), &IID_ID3D12RootSignature, (void**)&s_mv.rootsig);
+        sig->lpVtbl->Release(sig);
+        if (FAILED(hr)) { s_mv.rootsig = NULL; return 0; }
+    }
+    ID3DBlob* vs = NULL; ID3DBlob* pf = NULL; ID3DBlob* pv = NULL; ID3DBlob* err = NULL;
+    if (FAILED(D3DCompile(src, sizeof(src) - 1u, "motion_vectors", NULL, NULL, "vs", "vs_5_0", 0, 0, &vs, &err)) ||
+        FAILED(D3DCompile(src, sizeof(src) - 1u, "motion_vectors", NULL, NULL, "ps_fill", "ps_5_0", 0, 0, &pf, &err)) ||
+        FAILED(D3DCompile(src, sizeof(src) - 1u, "motion_vectors", NULL, NULL, "ps_view", "ps_5_0", 0, 0, &pv, &err))) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[mv] shader compile failed: %s\n", err ? (const char*)err->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(err) : "?");
+        if (err) err->lpVtbl->Release(err);
+        if (vs) vs->lpVtbl->Release(vs);
+        if (pf) pf->lpVtbl->Release(pf);
+        return 0;
+    }
+    if (err) err->lpVtbl->Release(err);
+    HRESULT hr = S_OK;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < 2 && SUCCEEDED(hr); i++) {
+        ID3DBlob* ps = i ? pv : pf;
+        D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pd = {0};
+        pd.pRootSignature = s_mv.rootsig;
+        pd.VS.pShaderBytecode = vs->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(vs); pd.VS.BytecodeLength = vs->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(vs);
+        pd.PS.pShaderBytecode = ps->lpVtbl->GetBufferPointer(ps); pd.PS.BytecodeLength = ps->lpVtbl->GetBufferSize(ps);
+        pd.BlendState.RenderTarget[0].RenderTargetWriteMask = D3D12_COLOR_WRITE_ENABLE_ALL;
+        pd.SampleMask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
+        pd.RasterizerState.FillMode = D3D12_FILL_MODE_SOLID;
+        pd.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE;
+        pd.RasterizerState.DepthClipEnable = TRUE;
+        pd.PrimitiveTopologyType = D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_TRIANGLE;
+        pd.NumRenderTargets = 1;
+        pd.RTVFormats[0] = i ? DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM : DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT;
+        pd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
+        hr = g.dev->lpVtbl->CreateGraphicsPipelineState(g.dev, &pd, &IID_ID3D12PipelineState,
+                                                        (void**)(i ? &s_mv.view_pso : &s_mv.fill_pso));
+    }
+    vs->lpVtbl->Release(vs); pf->lpVtbl->Release(pf); pv->lpVtbl->Release(pv);
+    if (FAILED(hr) || !s_mv.fill_pso || !s_mv.view_pso) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[mv] pipeline failed hr=0x%08lX\n", (unsigned long)hr);
+        return 0;
+    }
+    failed = 0;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* An object's transform of the frame before, in that frame's table: the cheapest candidate, or -1.
+ *   candidates  in the same viewport, not yet taken by another object of this frame, and drawn in
+ *               that frame by the vertex program of this object's first draw (bit: its place among
+ *               the 256 program bits);
+ *   position    the smaller of two distances: between the clip-space origins (x, y, w), which is
+ *               small for what moves with the camera (the player's car and whatever races beside
+ *               it), and between the world positions (c[4..6]'s translation) with the candidate
+ *               moved on by its own last displacement, which is small for what stands still or
+ *               keeps its speed. Spinning wheels are told apart by this alone: all four share
+ *               programs and vertex counts, and their matrices change too much to compare;
+ *   cost        position + 0.5 when the first draws differ in program or vertex count
+ *               + the largest change of the normalised upper 3x3, at most 0.5.
+ * An identical matrix is taken at once (a camera and an object that both stand still). */
+static int ld_mv_match(const ld_mv_obj* o, u32 bit)
+{
+    const ld_mv_obj* t = s_mv.obj[s_mv.cur ^ 1u];
+    const float* oc = (const float*)o->c;
+    int best = -1;
+    double best_cost = 1e30;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_mv.n_obj[s_mv.cur ^ 1u]; i++) {
+        const ld_mv_obj* p = &t[i];
+        if (p->taken || p->vp[0] != o->vp[0] || p->vp[1] != o->vp[1] || p->vp[2] != o->vp[2] || p->vp[3] != o->vp[3])
+            continue;
+        if (memcmp(p->c, o->c, sizeof o->c) == 0) return (int)i;
+        if (!(p->progs[bit >> 6] & (1ull << (bit & 63u)))) continue;
+        const float* pc = (const float*)p->c;
+        const double cx = (double)oc[3] - pc[3], cy = (double)oc[7] - pc[7], cw = (double)oc[15] - pc[15];
+        const double wx = (double)o->m46[3] - ((double)p->m46[3] + p->vel[0]),
+                     wy = (double)o->m46[7] - ((double)p->m46[7] + p->vel[1]),
+                     wz = (double)o->m46[11] - ((double)p->m46[11] + p->vel[2]);
+        const double d_clip = sqrt(cx * cx + cy * cy + cw * cw), d_world = sqrt(wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz);
+        const double pos = d_clip < d_world ? d_clip : d_world;
+        if (!(pos < LD_MV_GATE)) continue;
+        double rot = 0.0;
+        for (u32 r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
+            const double na = sqrt((double)oc[r * 4] * oc[r * 4] + (double)oc[r * 4 + 1] * oc[r * 4 + 1] + (double)oc[r * 4 + 2] * oc[r * 4 + 2]);
+            const double nb = sqrt((double)pc[r * 4] * pc[r * 4] + (double)pc[r * 4 + 1] * pc[r * 4 + 1] + (double)pc[r * 4 + 2] * pc[r * 4 + 2]);
+            if (na == 0.0 || nb == 0.0) continue;
+            for (u32 k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
+                const double d = fabs(oc[r * 4 + k] / na - pc[r * 4 + k] / nb);
+                if (d > rot) rot = d;
+            }
+        }
+        const double cost = pos + (p->sig0 == o->sig0 ? 0.0 : 0.5) + (rot < 0.5 ? rot : 0.5);
+        if (cost < best_cost) { best_cost = cost; best = (int)i; }
+    }
+    return best;
+}
+
+/* The rows the vertex shader multiplies its clip position by to get where the vertex was in the frame
+ * before: (previous host pixel x) * w, (y) * w, w. With C the object's c[0..3] now, P those of the
+ * frame before and X the previous viewport transform: rows of Pix * X * P * inverse(C), Pix taking
+ * NDC to host pixels (x = (ndc.x + 1) * W / 2, y = (1 - ndc.y) * H / 2). */
+static void ld_mv_rows(ld_mv_obj* o, const ld_mv_obj* p, float host_w, float host_h)
+{
+    double c[16], ci[16], cp[16], t[16];
+    const float* oc = (const float*)o->c;
+    const float* pc = (const float*)p->c;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < 16; i++) { c[i] = oc[i]; cp[i] = pc[i]; }
+    o->rows_ok = 0;
+    if (!ld_m4_inv(c, ci)) return;
+    ld_m4_mul(cp, ci, t);
+    const double sx = p->xf[0], sy = p->xf[1], ox = p->xf[4], oy = p->xf[5];
+    for (u32 k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
+        const double rx = 0.5 * host_w * (sx * t[k] + (ox + 1.0) * t[12 + k]);
+        const double ry = 0.5 * host_h * ((1.0 - oy) * t[12 + k] - sy * t[4 + k]);
+        const double rw = t[12 + k];
+        if (!(rx == rx && ry == ry && rw == rw) || fabs(rx) > 1e30 || fabs(ry) > 1e30 || fabs(rw) > 1e30) return;
+        o->rows[k] = (float)rx; o->rows[4 + k] = (float)ry; o->rows[8 + k] = (float)rw;
+    }
+    o->rows_ok = 1;
+}
+
+/* A perspective draw into the scene: the object it belongs to (the draws with this c[0..3] in this
+ * viewport), entered in this frame's table when it is new. xf: the draw's viewport transform before
+ * any jitter. Returns its index, or -1 when the table is full. */
+static int ld_mv_object(const rsx_dsp_viewport* vp, const float* xf, float host_w, float host_h, u32 n_tri)
+{
+    ld_mv_obj* t = s_mv.obj[s_mv.cur];
+    const u32* c = g.rsx.constants[0];
+    const u32 bit = (u32)((g_ld_current_pso.vp_hash * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) >> 56);
+    int i = s_mv.last_obj;
+    if (i < 0 || memcmp(t[i].c, c, sizeof t[i].c) != 0 ||
+        t[i].vp[0] != vp->x || t[i].vp[1] != vp->y || t[i].vp[2] != vp->w || t[i].vp[3] != vp->h) {
+        for (i = (int)s_mv.n_obj[s_mv.cur] - 1; i >= 0; i--)
+            if (memcmp(t[i].c, c, sizeof t[i].c) == 0 &&
+                t[i].vp[0] == vp->x && t[i].vp[1] == vp->y && t[i].vp[2] == vp->w && t[i].vp[3] == vp->h)
+                break;
+        if (i < 0) {
+            if (s_mv.n_obj[s_mv.cur] >= LD_MV_MAX_OBJ) { s_mv.last_obj = -1; s_mv.st_full++; return -1; }
+            i = (int)s_mv.n_obj[s_mv.cur]++;
+            ld_mv_obj* o = &t[i];
+            memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
+            memcpy(o->c, c, sizeof o->c);
+            o->vp[0] = vp->x; o->vp[1] = vp->y; o->vp[2] = vp->w; o->vp[3] = vp->h;
+            memcpy(o->xf, xf, sizeof o->xf);
+            memcpy(o->m46, g.rsx.constants[4], sizeof o->m46);
+            o->ndc_w = host_w; o->ndc_h = host_h;
+            o->sig0 = g_ld_current_pso.vp_hash ^ ((u64)n_tri << 40);
+            o->prev = -1;
+            s_mv.st_obj++;
+            if (s_mv.mode == 2 && s_mv.prev_valid) {
+                const int j = ld_mv_match(o, bit);
+                if (j >= 0) {
+                    ld_mv_obj* p = &s_mv.obj[s_mv.cur ^ 1u][j];
+                    p->taken = 1;
+                    o->prev = j;
+                    o->vel[0] = o->m46[3] - p->m46[3]; o->vel[1] = o->m46[7] - p->m46[7]; o->vel[2] = o->m46[11] - p->m46[11];
+                    ld_mv_rows(o, p, host_w, host_h);
+                    s_mv.st_match++;
+                    if (memcmp(p->c, o->c, sizeof o->c) == 0) s_mv.st_exact++;
+                } else {
+                    s_mv.st_miss++;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    ld_mv_obj* o = &t[i];
+    o->draws++;
+    o->verts += n_tri;
+    o->progs[bit >> 6] |= 1ull << (bit & 63u);
+    s_mv.last_obj = i;
+    return i;
+}
+
+/* Before a draw with the motion-vector pipeline binds the object target: once a frame it is cleared
+ * to "no vector here". */
+static void ld_mv_draw_target(void)
+{
+    if (s_mv.obj_cleared == s_mv.frame + 1u) return;
+    s_mv.obj_cleared = s_mv.frame + 1u;
+    const float none[4] = { LD_MV_SENTINEL, LD_MV_SENTINEL, 0.0f, 0.0f };
+    g.list->lpVtbl->ClearRenderTargetView(g.list, s_mv.obj_rtv, none, 0, NULL);
+}
+
+/* The cameras of this frame: for each viewport scene objects were drawn through (the main one first,
+ * then the largest others), the view-projection c[0..3] * inverse(c[4..6]) of its largest object,
+ * checked against the next largest ones (an object whose program does not load c[4..6] gives another
+ * matrix: the first candidate a second one agrees with is taken). Then the 52 constants of the fill
+ * pass: per region its host rect and the three rows that take a pixel of this frame to the previous
+ * one through both cameras; a region with no camera of the frame before gets zero rows (no motion). */
+static void ld_mv_regions(u32 grid_x, u32 grid_y, float rs, float* k)
+{
+    ld_mv_obj* t = s_mv.obj[s_mv.cur];
+    const u32 n = s_mv.n_obj[s_mv.cur];
+    ld_mv_region* reg = s_mv.reg[s_mv.cur];
+    u32 n_reg = 0;
+    /* the viewports, by area */
+    for (u32 pass = 0; pass < LD_MV_REGIONS; pass++) {
+        int pick = -1;
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < n; i++) {
+            u32 q = 0;
+            while (q < n_reg && memcmp(reg[q].vp, t[i].vp, sizeof t[i].vp) != 0) q++;
+            if (q < n_reg) continue;
+            if (pick < 0 || (u64)t[i].vp[2] * t[i].vp[3] > (u64)t[pick].vp[2] * t[pick].vp[3]) pick = (int)i;
+        }
+        if (pick < 0) break;
+        memset(&reg[n_reg], 0, sizeof reg[n_reg]);
+        memcpy(reg[n_reg].vp, t[pick].vp, sizeof reg[n_reg].vp);
+        n_reg++;
+    }
+    s_mv.n_reg[s_mv.cur] = n_reg;
+    s_mv.cam_ok = 0; s_mv.cam_prev_ok = 0;        /* [fgv] */
+    memset(k, 0, 52 * sizeof(float));
+    for (u32 q = 0; q < n_reg; q++) {
+        /* its four largest objects */
+        int top[4] = { -1, -1, -1, -1 };
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < n; i++) {
+            if (memcmp(reg[q].vp, t[i].vp, sizeof t[i].vp) != 0) continue;
+            int at = (int)i;
+            for (u32 s = 0; s < 4; s++) {
+                if (top[s] < 0 || t[at].verts > t[top[s]].verts) { const int was = top[s]; top[s] = at; at = was; }
+                if (at < 0) break;
+            }
+        }
+        double cand[4][16];
+        int have[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
+        for (u32 s = 0; s < 4; s++) {
+            if (top[s] < 0) continue;
+            double c[16], m[16], mi[16];
+            const float* oc = (const float*)t[top[s]].c;
+            for (u32 i = 0; i < 16; i++) c[i] = oc[i];
+            for (u32 i = 0; i < 12; i++) m[i] = t[top[s]].m46[i];
+            m[12] = m[13] = m[14] = 0.0; m[15] = 1.0;
+            if (!ld_m4_inv(m, mi)) continue;
+            ld_m4_mul(c, mi, cand[s]);
+            have[s] = 1;
+        }
+        int use = -1;
+        for (u32 a = 0; a < 4 && use < 0; a++) {
+            if (!have[a]) continue;
+            for (u32 b = 0; b < 4 && use < 0; b++) {
+                if (b == a || !have[b]) continue;
+                double diff = 0.0, norm = 0.0;
+                for (u32 i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
+                    diff += (cand[a][i] - cand[b][i]) * (cand[a][i] - cand[b][i]);
+                    norm += cand[a][i] * cand[a][i];
+                }
+                if (diff <= 1e-6 * norm) use = (int)a;
+            }
+        }
+        if (use < 0) for (u32 a = 0; a < 4 && use < 0; a++) if (have[a]) use = (int)a;
+        if (use < 0) continue;
+        memcpy(reg[q].m, cand[use], sizeof reg[q].m);
+        memcpy(reg[q].xf, t[top[use]].xf, sizeof reg[q].xf);
+        reg[q].ndc_w = t[top[use]].ndc_w; reg[q].ndc_h = t[top[use]].ndc_h;
+        reg[q].ok = 1;
+        const double host_w = reg[q].ndc_w, host_h = reg[q].ndc_h;      /* what NDC spans, not the texture */
+        if (q == 0) {                              /* [fgv] the main viewport's camera, for a vendor's frame generator */
+            double xq[16];
+            ld_mv_xf_matrix(reg[q].xf, xq);
+            ld_m4_mul(xq, reg[q].m, s_mv.cam_f);
+            s_mv.cam_ndc_w = reg[q].ndc_w; s_mv.cam_ndc_h = reg[q].ndc_h;
+            s_mv.cam_ok = 1;
+        }
+        /* the rect, in host pixels of the scene target */
+        float* kr = k + q * 16u;
+        kr[0] = (float)(reg[q].vp[0] * grid_x) * rs;
+        kr[1] = (float)(reg[q].vp[1] * grid_y) * rs;
+        kr[2] = (float)((reg[q].vp[0] + reg[q].vp[2]) * grid_x) * rs;
+        kr[3] = (float)((reg[q].vp[1] + reg[q].vp[3]) * grid_y) * rs;
+        /* the same viewport's camera of the frame before */
+        const ld_mv_region* pr = NULL;
+        if (s_mv.prev_valid)
+            for (u32 i = 0; i < s_mv.n_reg[s_mv.cur ^ 1u]; i++)
+                if (s_mv.reg[s_mv.cur ^ 1u][i].ok && memcmp(s_mv.reg[s_mv.cur ^ 1u][i].vp, reg[q].vp, sizeof reg[q].vp) == 0)
+                    pr = &s_mv.reg[s_mv.cur ^ 1u][i];
+        if (pr && (pr->ndc_w != reg[q].ndc_w || pr->ndc_h != reg[q].ndc_h)) pr = NULL;   /* another layout: no history */
+        if (!pr) { if (q == 0) s_mv.reset = 1; continue; }
+        double xc[16], xp[16], fc[16], fp[16], fi[16], r[16];
+        ld_mv_xf_matrix(reg[q].xf, xc);
+        ld_mv_xf_matrix(pr->xf, xp);
+        ld_m4_mul(xc, reg[q].m, fc);
+        ld_m4_mul(xp, pr->m, fp);
+        if (!ld_m4_inv(fc, fi)) { if (q == 0) s_mv.reset = 1; continue; }
+        ld_m4_mul(fp, fi, r);                    /* this frame's NDC and depth -> the previous frame's, times w */
+        if (q == 0) { memcpy(s_mv.cam_r, r, sizeof s_mv.cam_r); s_mv.cam_prev_ok = 1; }   /* [fgv] */
+        double a[3][4];
+        for (u32 c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
+            a[0][c] = 0.5 * host_w * (r[c] + r[12 + c]);
+            a[1][c] = 0.5 * host_h * (r[12 + c] - r[4 + c]);
+            a[2][c] = r[12 + c];
+        }
+        double rows[3][4];
+        for (u32 j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
+            rows[j][0] = a[j][0] * 2.0 / host_w;                 /* per host pixel x */
+            rows[j][1] = -a[j][1] * 2.0 / host_h;                /* per host pixel y */
+            rows[j][2] = a[j][2];                                /* per unit of depth */
+            rows[j][3] = -a[j][0] + a[j][1] + a[j][2] + a[j][3]; /* at pixel (0, 0), depth 1 */
+        }
+        const double scale = rows[2][3];
+        if (!(scale > 1e-30 || scale < -1e-30) || scale != scale) { if (q == 0) s_mv.reset = 1; continue; }
+        for (u32 j = 0; j < 3; j++)
+            for (u32 c = 0; c < 4; c++)
+                kr[4 + j * 4 + c] = (float)(rows[j][c] / scale);
+        if (q == 0) {
+            /* A cut: the far point at the middle of the picture was more than a quarter of the width away. */
+            const double ux = 0.5 * host_w, uy = 0.5 * host_h;
+            const double qx = kr[4] * ux + kr[5] * uy + kr[7], qy = kr[8] * ux + kr[9] * uy + kr[11], qw = kr[12] * ux + kr[13] * uy + kr[15];
+            if (!(qw > 1e-6) || fabs(qx / qw - ux) > 0.25 * host_w || fabs(qy / qw - uy) > 0.25 * host_w) s_mv.reset = 1;
+        }
+    }
+    if (!n_reg) s_mv.reset = 1;
+    k[48] = s_jit.on ? s_jit.x : 0.0f;
+    k[49] = s_jit.on ? s_jit.y : 0.0f;
+    k[50] = (s_mv.mode == 2 && s_mv.obj_cleared == s_mv.frame + 1u) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
+    k[51] = (float)n_reg;
+}
+
+/* One of the two full-screen passes: pipeline, target, its viewport rect, the constants, two textures. */
+static int ld_mv_pass(ID3D12PipelineState* pso, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtv, float x, float y, float w, float h,
+                      const float* k, u32 srv0, u32 srv1)
+{
+    if (g.srv_ring_used >= s_srv_cap) {       /* as ld_rs_draw: make room by waiting for the readers */
+        ld_flush(LD_FLUSH_DESCRIPTOR_RING);
+        if (!g.ready) return 0;
+        g.srv_ring_used = 0;
+    }
+    u32 slots[SRV_TABLE_SIZE];
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < SRV_TABLE_SIZE; i++) slots[i] = SRV_WHITE;
+    slots[0] = srv0; slots[1] = srv1;
+    const D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE table = srv_table(slots);
+    if (!table.ptr) return 0;
+    ld_set_rts(1, &rtv, FALSE, NULL);
+    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = {g.srv_heap, g.smp_heap};
+    ld_set_heaps(heaps);
+    ld_set_pso(pso);
+    ld_set_rootsig(s_mv.rootsig);
+    g.list->lpVtbl->SetGraphicsRoot32BitConstants(g.list, 0, 52, k, 0);
+    g.list->lpVtbl->SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(g.list, 1, table);
+    const D3D12_VIEWPORT vp = { x, y, w, h, 0.0f, 1.0f };
+    const D3D12_RECT sc = { (LONG)x, (LONG)y, (LONG)(x + w), (LONG)(y + h) };
+    ld_set_viewports(1, &vp);
+    ld_set_scissors(1, &sc);
+    ld_set_topo(D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
+    g.list->lpVtbl->DrawInstanced(g.list, 3, 1, 0, 0);
+    return 1;
+}
+static void ld_mv_barrier(ID3D12Resource* tex, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES from, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES to)
+{
+    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER b = {0};
+    b.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
+    b.Transition.pResource = tex;
+    b.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
+    b.Transition.StateBefore = from;
+    b.Transition.StateAfter = to;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->ResourceBarrier(g.list, 1, &b);
+}
+
+/* The frame's vectors into s_mv.out_tex. Called once the boundary draw has been recorded, before the
+ * next draw or clear (with the scene dump): the scene and its depth are complete, the object target
+ * holds what this frame's scene draws wrote. Then, with LD_MV_VIEW, the vectors as colours over the
+ * rect of the display buffer the boundary draw put the 3D picture in (the HUD is drawn over it next).
+ * [up] The upscaler needs the vectors BEFORE the boundary draw is recorded (that draw samples its
+ * output): it calls this with after_boundary 0 while the boundary draw is being set up, which makes
+ * the vectors only; the call after the draw (after_boundary 1) then finds them made and adds the
+ * view. The vectors are made once a frame whichever call comes first. */
+static void ld_mv_resolve(int after_boundary)
+{
+    static float k[52];
+    static u32 w, h, done_frame;
+    if (!(s_mv.out_ok && done_frame == s_mv.frame + 1u)) {
+    s_mv.out_ok = 0;
+    if (!s_mv.tracking || !s_scn.found || s_scn.b_scene >= g.n_surfaces) return;
+    const surface_t* sc = &g.surfaces[s_scn.b_scene];
+    if (!ld_scn_sig_is(&s_scn.b_sig, sc)) return;
+    w = ld_hs(sc->w, sc->rs); h = ld_hs(sc->h, sc->rs);
+    if (!s_mv.obj_tex || !s_mv.out_tex || w != s_mv.w || h != s_mv.h) { s_mv.reset = 1; return; }
+    if (!s_scn.b_zslot || s_scn.b_zslot - 1u >= g.n_zdepths || !ld_mv_pipelines()) return;
+    zdepth_t* z = &g.zdepths[s_scn.b_zslot - 1u];
+    if (!z->tex || !z->snapshot) return;
+    if (!zdepth_snapshot(s_scn.b_zslot) && !z->snapshot_valid) return;
+    ld_mv_regions(s_scn.b_sig.ax, s_scn.b_sig.ay, sc->rs, k);
+    ld_mv_barrier(s_mv.obj_tex, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
+    const int drawn = ld_mv_pass(s_mv.fill_pso, s_mv.out_rtv, 0.0f, 0.0f, (float)w, (float)h, k,
+                                 SRV_ZDEPTH_BASE + (s_scn.b_zslot - 1u), SRV_MV_BASE + 0);
+    ld_mv_barrier(s_mv.obj_tex, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET);
+    if (!drawn) return;
+    s_mv.out_ok = 1;
+    done_frame = s_mv.frame + 1u;
+    s_mv.st_resolved++;
+    if (s_mv.log && (s_mv.st_resolved % 300u) == 1u) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[mv] frame %u: mode %d, %ux%u, %u objects this frame (%u viewports); since the last line: "
+                        "%u new objects, %u matched (%u with an unchanged matrix), %u without a previous transform, %u over the table; reset=%d\n",
+                s_scn.present_no, s_mv.mode, w, h, s_mv.n_obj[s_mv.cur], s_mv.n_reg[s_mv.cur],
+                s_mv.st_obj, s_mv.st_match, s_mv.st_exact, s_mv.st_miss, s_mv.st_full, s_mv.reset);
+        s_mv.st_obj = s_mv.st_match = s_mv.st_exact = s_mv.st_miss = s_mv.st_full = 0;
+    }
+    }   /* the vectors are made */
+    if (!after_boundary) return;
+    if (s_mv.view && s_scn.b_display < g.n_surfaces) {
+        const surface_t* dp = &g.surfaces[s_scn.b_display];
+        if (dp->tex && dp->fmt == DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) {
+            float v[52];
+            memset(v, 0, sizeof v);
+            v[0] = (float)ld_he((LONG)s_scn.b_vp[0], dp->rs); v[1] = (float)ld_he((LONG)s_scn.b_vp[1], dp->rs);
+            v[2] = (float)ld_he((LONG)(s_scn.b_vp[0] + s_scn.b_vp[2]), dp->rs);
+            v[3] = (float)ld_he((LONG)(s_scn.b_vp[1] + s_scn.b_vp[3]), dp->rs);
+            /* the scene's main viewport (region 0), or the whole target */
+            v[4] = k[0]; v[5] = k[1]; v[6] = k[2]; v[7] = k[3];
+            if (!(v[6] > v[4]) || !(v[7] > v[5])) { v[4] = v[5] = 0.0f; v[6] = (float)w; v[7] = (float)h; }
+            v[48] = s_mv.view_px;
+            if (v[2] > v[0] && v[3] > v[1]) {
+                ld_mv_barrier(s_mv.out_tex, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
+                if (ld_mv_pass(s_mv.view_pso, rtv_handle(LD_SWAP_BUFFERS + s_scn.b_display), v[0], v[1], v[2] - v[0], v[3] - v[1],
+                               v, SRV_MV_BASE + 1, SRV_WHITE))
+                    ld_surface_note_write(s_scn.b_display, LD_SURFACE_WRITE_COPY);
+                ld_mv_barrier(s_mv.out_tex, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+static float ld_half_to_float(u16 hv)
+{
+    const u32 s = (u32)(hv >> 15) << 31, e = (hv >> 10) & 0x1Fu, m = hv & 0x3FFu;
+    u32 bits;
+    if (e == 0) {
+        if (!m) bits = s;
+        else {
+            u32 mm = m, ee = 113u;                      /* subnormal: normalise */
+            while (!(mm & 0x400u)) { mm <<= 1; ee--; }
+            bits = s | (ee << 23) | ((mm & 0x3FFu) << 13);
+        }
+    } else if (e == 31u) bits = s | 0x7F800000u | (m << 13);
+    else bits = s | ((e + 112u) << 23) | (m << 13);
+    float f;
+    memcpy(&f, &bits, sizeof f);
+    return f;
+}
+/* One of the vector textures to a file: two float32 (x, y) per host pixel, row after row, no header;
+ * and, when ppm_path is given, the same as colours (hue = direction, full brightness at 16 pixels). */
+static int ld_mv_dump_tex(ID3D12Resource* tex, const char* raw_path, const char* ppm_path)
+{
+    const u32 w = s_mv.w, h = s_mv.h;
+    if (!tex || !w || !h) return 0;
+    const u32 pitch = (w * 4u + 255u) & ~255u;
+    const UINT64 rb_size = (UINT64)pitch * h;
+    D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp = {0}; hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK;
+    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC bd = {0};
+    bd.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER; bd.Width = rb_size;
+    bd.Height = 1; bd.DepthOrArraySize = 1; bd.MipLevels = 1;
+    bd.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN; bd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
+    bd.Layout = D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR;
+    ID3D12Resource* rb = NULL;
+    if (FAILED(LD_CCR(g.dev, &hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &bd,
+            D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, NULL, &IID_ID3D12Resource, (void**)&rb)))
+        return 0;
+    ld_mv_barrier(tex, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
+    D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION src = {0}, dst = {0};
+    src.pResource = tex; src.Type = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX; src.SubresourceIndex = 0;
+    dst.pResource = rb; dst.Type = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT;
+    dst.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT;
+    dst.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.Width = w;
+    dst.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.Height = h;
+    dst.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.Depth = 1;
+    dst.PlacedFootprint.Footprint.RowPitch = pitch;
+    g.list->lpVtbl->CopyTextureRegion(g.list, &dst, 0, 0, 0, &src, NULL);
+    ld_mv_barrier(tex, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET);
+    ld_flush(LD_FLUSH_READBACK);                   /* the copy completes on the GPU */
+    int ok = 0;
+    u8* px = NULL; D3D12_RANGE rr = {0, (SIZE_T)rb_size};
+    float* row_f = (float*)malloc((size_t)w * 2u * sizeof(float));
+    if (row_f && SUCCEEDED(rb->lpVtbl->Map(rb, 0, &rr, (void**)&px))) {
+        FILE* f = fopen(raw_path, "wb");
+        FILE* p = ppm_path ? fopen(ppm_path, "wb") : NULL;
+        if (p) fprintf(p, "P6\n%u %u\n255\n", w, h);
+        for (u32 y = 0; y < h; y++) {
+            const u16* row = (const u16*)(px + (SIZE_T)y * pitch);
+            for (u32 x = 0; x < w * 2u; x++) row_f[x] = ld_half_to_float(row[x]);
+            if (f) fwrite(row_f, sizeof(float), (size_t)w * 2u, f);
+            if (p) {
+                for (u32 x = 0; x < w; x++) {
+                    const float vx = row_f[x * 2u], vy = row_f[x * 2u + 1u];
+                    float m = sqrtf(vx * vx + vy * vy) / 16.0f;
+                    if (m > 1.0f) m = 1.0f;
+                    const float hue = atan2f(vy, vx) / 6.2831853f + 0.5f;
+                    u8 rgb[3];
+                    for (u32 c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
+                        float t = hue + (c == 0 ? 0.0f : c == 1 ? 2.0f / 3.0f : 1.0f / 3.0f);
+                        t -= floorf(t);
+                        float v = fabsf(t * 6.0f - 3.0f) - 1.0f;
+                        v = v < 0.0f ? 0.0f : v > 1.0f ? 1.0f : v;
+                        rgb[c] = (u8)(v * m * 255.0f + 0.5f);
+                    }
+                    fwrite(rgb, 1, 3, p);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        if (f) { fclose(f); ok = 1; fprintf(stderr, "[live-draw] wrote %s\n", raw_path); }
+        if (p) fclose(p);
+        D3D12_RANGE wr = {0, 0};
+        rb->lpVtbl->Unmap(rb, 0, &wr);
+    }
+    free(row_f);
+    rb->lpVtbl->Release(rb);
+    return ok;
+}
+/* The vectors of a dumped scene frame (LD_MV_DUMP), and what the info file says of them. */
+static void ld_mv_dump(const char* base, FILE* info)
+{
+    char path[MAX_PATH * 2 + 32], path2[MAX_PATH * 2 + 32];
+    int wrote = 0, wrote_obj = 0;
+    const int obj_used = s_mv.mode == 2 && s_mv.obj_cleared == s_mv.frame + 1u;
+    if (s_mv.dump && s_mv.out_ok) {
+        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s_mv.f32", base);
+        snprintf(path2, sizeof path2, "%s_mv.ppm", base);
+        wrote = ld_mv_dump_tex(s_mv.out_tex, path, path2);
+        if (obj_used) {
+            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s_mvobj.f32", base);
+            wrote_obj = ld_mv_dump_tex(s_mv.obj_tex, path, NULL);
+        }
+    }
+    if (!info) return;
+    u32 matched = 0;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < s_mv.n_obj[s_mv.cur]; i++) matched += s_mv.obj[s_mv.cur][i].prev >= 0;
+    fprintf(info, "mv_mode=%d\nmv_resolved=%d\nmv_reset=%d\nmv_size=%ux%u\n", s_mv.mode, s_mv.out_ok, s_mv.reset, s_mv.w, s_mv.h);
+    if (s_mv.n_reg[s_mv.cur])
+        fprintf(info, "mv_ndc_host_size=%.0fx%.0f\n", (double)s_mv.reg[s_mv.cur][0].ndc_w, (double)s_mv.reg[s_mv.cur][0].ndc_h);
+    fprintf(info, "mv_file=%s\nmv_object_file=%s\n",
+            wrote ? "float32 x, y per host pixel, row-major: this pixel + vector = its place in the frame before, jitter-free" : "none",
+            wrote_obj ? "the same layout; 30000 = no draw wrote a vector there" : "none");
+    fprintf(info, "mv_objects=%u\nmv_objects_matched=%u\nmv_viewports=%u\nmv_previous_frame_valid=%d\n",
+            s_mv.n_obj[s_mv.cur], matched, s_mv.n_reg[s_mv.cur], s_mv.prev_valid);
+    for (u32 q = 0; q < s_mv.n_reg[s_mv.cur]; q++) {
+        const ld_mv_region* r = &s_mv.reg[s_mv.cur][q];
+        fprintf(info, "mv_viewport%u=%u,%u %ux%u camera=%d\n", q, r->vp[0], r->vp[1], r->vp[2], r->vp[3], r->ok);
+        if (r->ok)
+            fprintf(info, "mv_view_projection%u=%.9g %.9g %.9g %.9g  %.9g %.9g %.9g %.9g  %.9g %.9g %.9g %.9g  %.9g %.9g %.9g %.9g\n", q,
+                    r->m[0], r->m[1], r->m[2], r->m[3], r->m[4], r->m[5], r->m[6], r->m[7],
+                    r->m[8], r->m[9], r->m[10], r->m[11], r->m[12], r->m[13], r->m[14], r->m[15]);
+    }
+}
+
+/* A frame that drew something has ended (ld_scn_frame_end): its table becomes "the frame before". */
+static void ld_mv_frame_end(int kind)
+{
+    if (kind == LD_SCN_SCENE && s_mv.n_obj[s_mv.cur]) {
+        s_mv.cur ^= 1u;
+        s_mv.prev_valid = 1;
+    } else if (kind != LD_SCN_HELD) {
+        s_mv.prev_valid = 0;         /* a bypass frame, or a first scene frame nothing was tracked in */
+    }
+    s_mv.n_obj[s_mv.cur] = 0;
+    s_mv.n_reg[s_mv.cur] = 0;
+    s_mv.last_obj = -1;
+}
+/* A frame starts: is it tracked, and with which targets? */
+static void ld_mv_frame_begin(void)
+{
+    s_mv.tracking = s_mv.live = 0;
+    s_mv.out_ok = 0;
+    s_mv.reset = !s_mv.prev_valid;
+    s_mv.last_obj = -1;
+    if (!s_mv.mode || !s_scn.sig_valid) return;
+    const u32 w = ld_hs(s_scn.sig.w, s_scn.sig_rs), h = ld_hs(s_scn.sig.h, s_scn.sig_rs);
+    if (w != s_mv.w || h != s_mv.h) s_mv.reset = 1;      /* the vectors of the frame before were of another size */
+    if (!ld_mv_targets(w, h)) return;
+    s_mv.frame++;
+    s_mv.tracking = 1;
+    s_mv.live = s_mv.mode == 2;
+}
+/* ---- [mv] end (second block) ----------------------------------------------------------------- */
+
+/* ---- [fg1] begin ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * Frame generation, version 2 (LD_FRAMEGEN=2, rsx_framegen.c): a 3D scene frame's picture without
+ * HUD, its vectors and its depth go to the generator right after the boundary draw was recorded
+ * (ld_scn_pending_run), before the game draws its HUD into the display buffer. The setting turns
+ * the scene detection and the per-object vectors on by itself (ld_scn_frame_end), with or without
+ * the upscaler.
+ *   - the picture: the display buffer's frame as the generator will get the finished one at the
+ *     present: its top-left video mode, or, with a resolution scale or a back buffer of another
+ *     size, the same filtering draw into a scratch target of the back buffer's size;
+ *   - the 3D picture's place in it: the boundary draw's viewport. Only when that viewport is the
+ *     whole centred picture (the race, replays): a state that copies the scene into another
+ *     rectangle (the start grid's intro) is left to be shown as drawn. [fga] With LD_FG_ALWAYS (the
+ *     default) wherever it is: that rectangle is the pre-race screen's and the results' box, and
+ *     leaving it out left those screens with no made frame at all;
+ *   - [fga] the game's picture in the frame (the frame less the window's bars), for a vendor's
+ *     generator, which is made for that part once instead of for each place of the 3D picture;
+ *   - the vectors (s_mv.out_tex) and the depth snapshot as they are: the generator brings them to
+ *     the frame's pixels itself, whatever the scene's own size is (supersampled, at an upscaler's
+ *     render size, the anamorphic 2x1 grid). */
+static int ld_rs_present_draw(u32 target, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtv);
+
+/* [fgv] For a vendor's frame generator (LD_FRAMEGEN=fsr / dlss), which records on the real list as the
+ * upscaler does: everything queued for the recording thread is replayed first. */
+static ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* ld_fg_real_list(void) { ld_rec_sync(); return ld_list_real(); }
+/* ... and before its context is made or released: everything recorded so far has run on the GPU. */
+static int ld_fg_finish(void) { ld_flush(LD_FLUSH_RETIRE_QUEUE); return g.ready != 0; }
+
+/* [fgv] The main viewport's camera of this frame as a vendor's frame generator wants it, from what
+ * ld_mv_regions kept (s_mv.cam_f, s_mv.cam_r): in the clip space of the 3D picture (the scene target's
+ * top-left scene_w x scene_h host pixels), matrices row-major for row vectors.
+ *   exact:    the step from this frame's clip space to the frame before's (the matrices the background's
+ *             vectors come from), and the view-projection as a whole;
+ *   derived:  near, far, the field of view, the axes and the position, by splitting that product into
+ *             a view and a projection: right for a camera that only turns and moves (no scale or shear
+ *             in the view) and a pinhole projection. Distances are in the game's world units.
+ * cam_ok stays 0 when no camera was found this frame or the split gives nonsense. */
+static void ld_fg_camera(rsx_fg_scene* fs)
+{
+    fs->cam_ok = 0; fs->cam_prev_ok = 0;
+    if (!s_mv.cam_ok || !(fs->scene_w >= 1.0f) || !(fs->scene_h >= 1.0f) || !(s_mv.cam_ndc_w >= 1.0f) || !(s_mv.cam_ndc_h >= 1.0f)) return;
+    /* host clip space -> the 3D picture's: pixel x = ndc_w / 2 * (X / W + 1) is to be scene_w / 2 * (X' / W + 1) */
+    const double sx = (double)s_mv.cam_ndc_w / (double)fs->scene_w, sy = (double)s_mv.cam_ndc_h / (double)fs->scene_h;
+    double S[16], Si[16], F[16];
+    memset(S, 0, sizeof S);
+    S[0] = sx; S[3] = sx - 1.0; S[5] = sy; S[7] = 1.0 - sy; S[10] = 1.0; S[15] = 1.0;
+    if (!ld_m4_inv(S, Si)) return;
+    ld_m4_mul(S, s_mv.cam_f, F);
+    const double* X = F; const double* Y = F + 4; const double* Z = F + 8; const double* W = F + 12;
+    const double n3 = sqrt(W[0] * W[0] + W[1] * W[1] + W[2] * W[2]);
+    if (!(n3 > 1e-12)) return;
+    const double fw[3] = { W[0] / n3, W[1] / n3, W[2] / n3 };
+    /* x and y rows without their share of the w row (an off-centre projection): right and up, scaled */
+    const double cx = (X[0] * fw[0] + X[1] * fw[1] + X[2] * fw[2]) / n3, cy = (Y[0] * fw[0] + Y[1] * fw[1] + Y[2] * fw[2]) / n3;
+    double xp[4], yp[4];
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; i++) { xp[i] = X[i] - cx * W[i]; yp[i] = Y[i] - cy * W[i]; }
+    const double nx = sqrt(xp[0] * xp[0] + xp[1] * xp[1] + xp[2] * xp[2]), ny = sqrt(yp[0] * yp[0] + yp[1] * yp[1] + yp[2] * yp[2]);
+    if (!(nx > 1e-12) || !(ny > 1e-12)) return;
+    const double xs = nx / n3, ys = ny / n3;
+    /* depth = Q + R / (view distance) */
+    const double Q = (Z[0] * fw[0] + Z[1] * fw[1] + Z[2] * fw[2]) / n3, R = (Z[3] - Q * W[3]) / n3;
+    const double zn = Q != 0.0 ? -R / Q : 0.0;
+    double zf = 1.0 - Q != 0.0 ? R / (1.0 - Q) : 0.0;
+    if (!(zn > 0.0) || zn != zn) return;
+    if (!(zf > zn) || zf != zf || zf > zn * 1e7) zf = zn * 1e7;        /* a far plane at infinity, or none to speak of */
+    /* the eye: where the x, y and w rows are all zero */
+    double A[16], Ai[16];
+    memset(A, 0, sizeof A);
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < 3; i++) { A[i] = xp[i]; A[4 + i] = yp[i]; A[8 + i] = W[i]; }
+    A[15] = 1.0;
+    if (!ld_m4_inv(A, Ai)) return;
+    const double bx = -xp[3], by = -yp[3], bw = -W[3];
+    const double eye[3] = { Ai[0] * bx + Ai[1] * by + Ai[2] * bw, Ai[4] * bx + Ai[5] * by + Ai[6] * bw, Ai[8] * bx + Ai[9] * by + Ai[10] * bw };
+    if (xs != xs || ys != ys || !(xs < 1e6) || !(ys < 1e6) || eye[0] != eye[0] || eye[1] != eye[1] || eye[2] != eye[2]) return;
+
+    /* [x, y, z, 1] * P = clip, for a view position in right / up / forward coordinates */
+    double P[16], Pi[16];
+    memset(P, 0, sizeof P);
+    P[0] = xs; P[5] = ys; P[8] = cx; P[9] = cy; P[10] = Q; P[11] = 1.0; P[14] = R;
+    if (!ld_m4_inv(P, Pi)) return;
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < 16; i++) { fs->view_to_clip[i] = (float)P[i]; fs->clip_to_view[i] = (float)Pi[i]; }
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
+        fs->cam_pos[i] = (float)eye[i];
+        fs->cam_right[i] = (float)(xp[i] / nx); fs->cam_up[i] = (float)(yp[i] / ny); fs->cam_fwd[i] = (float)fw[i];
+    }
+    fs->cam_near = (float)zn; fs->cam_far = (float)zf;
+    fs->cam_fov_y = (float)(2.0 * atan(1.0 / ys));
+    fs->cam_aspect = (float)(ys / xs);
+    fs->cam_ok = 1;
+    /* this frame's clip -> the frame before's, in the picture's clip space, turned for row vectors */
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < 16; i++) fs->clip_to_prev_clip[i] = fs->prev_clip_to_clip[i] = (i % 5u) == 0u ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
+    if (s_mv.cam_prev_ok && !s_mv.reset) {
+        double t[16], r[16], ri[16];
+        ld_m4_mul(S, s_mv.cam_r, t);
+        ld_m4_mul(t, Si, r);
+        if (ld_m4_inv(r, ri) && r[15] == r[15] && (r[15] > 1e-30 || r[15] < -1e-30)) {
+            for (u32 a = 0; a < 4; a++)
+                for (u32 b = 0; b < 4; b++) {
+                    fs->clip_to_prev_clip[a * 4 + b] = (float)(r[b * 4 + a] / r[15]);
+                    fs->prev_clip_to_clip[a * 4 + b] = (float)(ri[b * 4 + a] * r[15]);
+                }
+            fs->cam_prev_ok = 1;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+static void ld_fg_scene_capture(void)
+{
+    if (!s_scn.found || !s_mv.out_ok || !s_mv.out_tex || s_scn.b_display >= g.n_surfaces || s_scn.b_scene >= g.n_surfaces) return;
+    const surface_t* dp = &g.surfaces[s_scn.b_display];
+    const surface_t* sc = &g.surfaces[s_scn.b_scene];
+    zdepth_t* z = s_scn.b_zslot && s_scn.b_zslot - 1u < g.n_zdepths ? &g.zdepths[s_scn.b_zslot - 1u] : NULL;
+    if (!dp->tex || dp->fmt != DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM || !z || !z->snapshot || !z->snapshot_valid) return;
+    /* [fill] the frame the window gets is the part s_fill.cur of it while filling: the 3D rect has to be
+     * centred in that part, and is mapped through it. [fga] With LD_FG_ALWAYS (the default) it may be
+     * anywhere: the pre-race screen and the results copy the scene into a box (672,54 1152x972 of
+     * 1920x1080, drawn at 30), and that box was why no frame was made there. The mapping below holds for
+     * any rect; a box that moves or changes size is a cut to the generator (rsx_fg_scene_frame). */
+    const float fx0 = s_fill.on ? s_fill.cur[0] : 0.0f, fy0 = s_fill.on ? s_fill.cur[1] : 0.0f;
+    const float fw = s_fill.on ? s_fill.cur[2] - s_fill.cur[0] : (float)g.width, fh = s_fill.on ? s_fill.cur[3] - s_fill.cur[1] : (float)g.height;
+    if (!rsx_fg_always() &&
+        (fabsf(2.0f * ((float)s_scn.b_vp[0] - fx0) + (float)s_scn.b_vp[2] - fw) > 0.5f ||
+         fabsf(2.0f * ((float)s_scn.b_vp[1] - fy0) + (float)s_scn.b_vp[3] - fh) > 0.5f)) return;
+    rsx_fg_scene fs;
+    memset(&fs, 0, sizeof fs);
+    float kx = 1.0f, ky = 1.0f;          /* frame pixels per guest pixel of the display buffer */
+    float ox = 0.0f, oy = 0.0f;          /* [win] where the picture starts in the frame (black bars before it) */
+    if (g.out_w != g.width || g.out_h != g.height || dp->rs != 1.0f || s_fill.on) {
+        const u32 ps = surface_get(LD_RS_LOC_SCRATCH, 2u, g.out_w, g.out_h, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM);
+        if (ps == LD_INVALID_SURFACE || !ld_rs_present_draw(s_scn.b_display, rtv_handle(LD_SWAP_BUFFERS + ps))) return;
+        fs.hudless = g.surfaces[ps].tex; fs.w = g.out_w; fs.h = g.out_h;
+        float rw, rh;
+        ld_win_rect(&ox, &oy, &rw, &rh);
+        kx = rw / fw; ky = rh / fh;
+        fs.view[0] = ox; fs.view[1] = oy; fs.view[2] = ox + rw; fs.view[3] = oy + rh;   /* [fga] the game's picture */
+    } else {
+        if (dp->w < g.width || dp->h < g.height) return;
+        fs.hudless = dp->tex; fs.w = g.width; fs.h = g.height;
+        fs.view[2] = (float)g.width; fs.view[3] = (float)g.height;                      /* [fga] */
+    }
+    fs.motion = s_mv.out_tex;
+    fs.depth = z->snapshot;
+    fs.rect[0] = ox + ((float)s_scn.b_vp[0] - fx0) * kx; fs.rect[1] = oy + ((float)s_scn.b_vp[1] - fy0) * ky;
+    fs.rect[2] = ox + ((float)(s_scn.b_vp[0] + s_scn.b_vp[2]) - fx0) * kx; fs.rect[3] = oy + ((float)(s_scn.b_vp[1] + s_scn.b_vp[3]) - fy0) * ky;
+    fs.scene_w = (float)ld_hs(s_scn.b_sig.cw, sc->rs); fs.scene_h = (float)ld_hs(s_scn.b_sig.ch, sc->rs);
+    fs.reset = s_mv.reset;
+    { static u32 fill_gen;                /* [fill] the part shown changed: nothing before it matches */
+      if (fill_gen != s_fill.gen) { fill_gen = s_fill.gen; fs.reset = 1; } }
+    ld_fg_camera(&fs);                    /* [fgv] */
+    fs.real_list = ld_fg_real_list;
+    fs.finish = ld_fg_finish;
+    const D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES zs = z->snapshot_state;
+    ld_mv_barrier(s_mv.out_tex, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
+    if (zs != D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE) ld_mv_barrier(z->snapshot, zs, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
+    { RSX_FG_WAIT(cw);   /* [fgv3] the capture and, with a vendor's generator, its evaluate */
+      rsx_fg_scene_frame(g.dev, g.list, &fs);
+      rsx_fg_wait_end("frame generation: scene capture", &cw); }
+    ld_mv_barrier(s_mv.out_tex, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET);
+    if (zs != D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE) ld_mv_barrier(z->snapshot, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, zs);
+    ld_list_state_reset();       /* the generator set its own heap, root signature, pipeline and target */
+}
+/* ---- [fg1] end -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
+
+/* ---- [up] begin (second block): see the first one, after the first [mv] block ---------------- */
+
+static const char* ld_up_mode_name(int m)
+{
+    return m == 1 ? "DLAA" : m == 2 ? "DLSS Quality" : m == 3 ? "DLSS Balanced" : m == 4 ? "DLSS Performance" :
+           m == 5 ? "DLSS Ultra Performance" : m == 6 ? "DLSS custom" : "off";
+}
+static gt5_upscale_mode ld_up_mode_of(int m)
+{
+    return m == 2 ? GT5_UPSCALE_QUALITY : m == 3 ? GT5_UPSCALE_BALANCED : m == 4 ? GT5_UPSCALE_PERFORMANCE :
+           m == 5 ? GT5_UPSCALE_ULTRA_PERFORMANCE : GT5_UPSCALE_NATIVE;
+}
+
+/* Once, at start-up, on the renderer's thread: is there a back end (the DLSS plug-in next to the
+ * game, on a graphics card that can run it)? Then the menu's DLSS choices can be picked, and the
+ * setting counts at once. Nothing else happens until LD_AA asks for a mode. */
+static void ld_up_load(void)
+{
+    if (s_up.loaded) return;
+    s_up.loaded = 1;
+    s_up.sign_x = s_up.sign_y = 1.0f;
+    s_up.avail = rsx_upscale_load(g.dev) && rsx_upscale_api() != NULL;
+    /* [fgv] The vendors' frame generators: the menu's choices can be picked when their plug-in is there
+     * and can run on this card; when not, the choice stays greyed out with the reason. */
+    { static const char* const fgm[2] = { "fsr", "dlss" };
+      for (u32 i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
+          char why[200];
+          const int ok = rsx_fg_method_available(fgm[i], why, sizeof why);
+          gt5_setting_choice_enable("LD_FG_METHOD", fgm[i], ok);
+          gt5_setting_choice_note("LD_FG_METHOD", fgm[i], ok ? "" : why);
+      } }
+    if (!s_up.avail) { InterlockedExchange(&s_up.state, LD_UP_S_UNAVAILABLE); return; }
+    static const char* const modes[6] = { "dlaa", "dlss_q", "dlss_b", "dlss_p", "dlss_u", "dlss_c" };
+    gt5_setting_enable("LD_AA", 1);
+    gt5_setting_set_apply("LD_AA", GT5_APPLY_LIVE);
+    for (u32 i = 0; i < 6; i++) gt5_setting_choice_enable("LD_AA", modes[i], 1);
+    gt5_setting_enable("LD_DLSS_SCALE", 1);
+    gt5_setting_enable("LD_DLSS_PRESET", 1);
+}
+
+int ld_upscale_state(char* text, size_t cap)
+{
+    if (!text || !cap) return 0;
+    text[0] = 0;
+    const LONG st = s_up.state;
+    switch (st) {
+    case LD_UP_S_UNAVAILABLE: {
+        const gt5_upscale_caps* caps = rsx_upscale_caps();
+        snprintf(text, cap, "%s", caps && caps->message[0] ? caps->message : "the DLSS plug-in is not installed");
+        break; }
+    case LD_UP_S_RUNNING:
+    case LD_UP_S_HELD: {
+        char model[16] = "";
+        if (s_up.made_preset >= 10 && s_up.made_preset <= 13)
+            snprintf(model, sizeof model, ", model %c", "JKLM"[s_up.made_preset - 10]);
+        if (s_up.rw == s_up.ow && s_up.rh == s_up.oh)
+            snprintf(text, cap, "%s, %ux%u%s%s", ld_up_mode_name(s_up.made_mode), s_up.ow, s_up.oh, model,
+                     st == LD_UP_S_HELD ? " (picture held)" : "");
+        else
+            snprintf(text, cap, "%s, %ux%u to %ux%u%s%s", ld_up_mode_name(s_up.made_mode), s_up.rw, s_up.rh, s_up.ow,
+                     s_up.oh, model, st == LD_UP_S_HELD ? " (picture held)" : "");
+        if (s_up.gpu_ms > 0.0f) {
+            const size_t n = strlen(text);
+            if (n + 1u < cap) snprintf(text + n, cap - n, ", %.1f ms", (double)s_up.gpu_ms);
+        }
+        break; }
+    case LD_UP_S_NO_SCENE: break;   /* [aa3d] a screen without 3D: nothing to say (it acts on every 3D screen now) */
+    case LD_UP_S_WAITING:  break;   /* [aa3d] the few frames while it sets up for a new 3D screen: nothing to say */
+    case LD_UP_S_FAILED:   snprintf(text, cap, "not in this frame: %s", s_up.reason); break;
+    case LD_UP_S_GAVE_UP:  snprintf(text, cap, "switched off: %s", s_up.reason); break;
+    default: break;
+    }
+    return st == LD_UP_S_RUNNING || st == LD_UP_S_HELD;
+}
+
+/* The frame at hand is not upscaled: it is shown as the game drew it. hard: a failure, logged when
+ * its reason is new; LD_UP_MAX_FAILS of them in a row switch the upscaler off. Otherwise something
+ * it waits for (the first vectors, a size that changed); LD_UP_MAX_WAITS in a row do the same. */
+static void ld_up_miss(int hard, const char* why)
+{
+    const int fresh = strcmp(s_up.reason, why) != 0;
+    if (fresh) snprintf(s_up.reason, sizeof s_up.reason, "%s", why);
+    InterlockedExchange(&s_up.state, hard ? LD_UP_S_FAILED : LD_UP_S_WAITING);
+    if (hard) s_up.st_fail++;
+    const u32 n = hard ? ++s_up.fails : ++s_up.waits;
+    if (hard && fresh)
+        fprintf(stderr, "[upscale] frame %u is not upscaled: %s\n", s_scn.present_no, s_up.reason);
+    if (n >= (hard ? LD_UP_MAX_FAILS : LD_UP_MAX_WAITS) && !s_up.gave_up) {
+        s_up.gave_up = 1;      /* ld_scn_frame_end turns it off; changing the setting tries again */
+        fprintf(stderr, "[upscale] %u frames in a row without a result (%s): switched off until the setting is changed\n",
+                n, s_up.reason);
+    }
+}
+
+/* dlss_q/b/p: the 3D scene q gets a scale of its own (on), or its ordinary one back. Between two
+ * frames: the scene surface is remade (what it shows is drawn across), its zeta entry follows with
+ * the first draw. */
+static void ld_up_scene_scale(int on, float rs, const ld_scn_sig* q)
+{
+    if (on && q) {
+        g_rs_scene_loc = q->loc; g_rs_scene_off = q->off; g_rs_scene_w = q->w; g_rs_scene_h = q->h;
+        g_rs_scene_cw = q->cw; g_rs_scene_ch = q->ch; g_rs_scene_rs = rs;
+    }
+    g_rs_scene_on = on && q;
+    g_rs_scene_owner = g_rs_scene_on ? 1 : 0;    /* [aa3d] */
+    g_rs_on = LD_RS_ON_NOW();     /* [shadow2] scaled shadow maps keep it on too */
+    u32 n_surfaces = 0, n_zetas = 0;
+    ld_rs_remake(&n_surfaces, &n_zetas);
+    s_up.reset_next = 1;
+    if (!g_rs_scene_on) s_up.out_valid = 0;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[upscale] frame %u: the 3D scene %u:0x%X %ux%u is drawn at %s x%.4f: %u surfaces remade, %u zetas released\n",
+            g_ld_frames, g_rs_scene_loc, g_rs_scene_off, g_rs_scene_w, g_rs_scene_h,
+            g_rs_scene_on ? "the upscaler's render size," : "its own size again, not", (double)g_rs_scene_rs, n_surfaces, n_zetas);
+}
+
+/* [aa3d] LD_RES_SCENE (see g_rs_scene_owner): the scale of the 3D picture q when it follows the window
+ * it is shown in, or its ordinary one back (on = 0). Between two frames, as ld_up_scene_scale. */
+static void ld_rs_scene_follow_set(int on, float rs, const ld_scn_sig* q)
+{
+    if (on && q) {
+        g_rs_scene_loc = q->loc; g_rs_scene_off = q->off; g_rs_scene_w = q->w; g_rs_scene_h = q->h;
+        g_rs_scene_cw = q->cw; g_rs_scene_ch = q->ch; g_rs_scene_rs = rs;
+    }
+    g_rs_scene_on = on && q;
+    g_rs_scene_owner = g_rs_scene_on ? 2 : 0;
+    g_rs_on = LD_RS_ON_NOW();     /* [shadow2] scaled shadow maps keep it on too */
+    u32 n_surfaces = 0, n_zetas = 0;
+    ld_rs_remake(&n_surfaces, &n_zetas);
+    fprintf(stderr, "[res-scale] frame %u: the 3D picture %u:0x%X %ux%u (clip %ux%u) is drawn at %s x%.4f: %u surfaces remade, %u zetas released\n",
+            g_ld_frames, g_rs_scene_loc, g_rs_scene_off, g_rs_scene_w, g_rs_scene_h, g_rs_scene_cw, g_rs_scene_ch,
+            g_rs_scene_on ? "the size of the window it is shown in," : "its ordinary scale again, not", (double)g_rs_scene_rs,
+            n_surfaces, n_zetas);
+}
+
+/* [aa3d] Once per frame start while no upscaler runs: does the 3D picture of the last 3D frame need a
+ * scale of its own to be as sharp as the window it is copied into (LD_RES_SCENE)? That window is the
+ * copy's viewport at the display buffer's scale; the picture's scale is the larger of the two axes'
+ * ratios (a 2x1 sample grid keeps its shape), within the texture limits ld_rs_pick keeps, and it is
+ * only ever used when it is larger than what ld_rs_pick gives (that rule is never made blunter). */
+static void ld_rs_scene_follow_frame(void)
+{
+    static u32 no_scene;
+    const int mine = g_rs_scene_on && g_rs_scene_owner == 2;
+    if (!g_rs_scene_follow || !(g_rs_user > 1.0f)) {
+        if (mine) ld_rs_scene_follow_set(0, 1.0f, NULL);
+        return;
+    }
+    if (!s_scn.sig_valid || !s_up.vp_w || !s_up.vp_h || !s_scn.sig.cw || !s_scn.sig.ch) {
+        if (mine && ++no_scene >= 2u) ld_rs_scene_follow_set(0, 1.0f, NULL);
+        return;
+    }
+    no_scene = 0;
+    const ld_scn_sig* q = &s_scn.sig;
+    const int was = g_rs_scene_on;
+    g_rs_scene_on = 0;
+    const float pick = ld_rs_pick_at(q->loc, q->off, q->w, q->h, q->ax, q->ay);
+    g_rs_scene_on = was;
+    float drs = s_up.disp_rs > 0.0f ? s_up.disp_rs : 1.0f;
+    if (s_scn.b_display < g.n_surfaces && g.surfaces[s_scn.b_display].tex && ld_scn_is_display(&g.surfaces[s_scn.b_display]))
+        drs = g.surfaces[s_scn.b_display].rs;
+    const float sx = (float)s_up.vp_w * drs / (float)q->cw, sy = (float)s_up.vp_h * drs / (float)q->ch;
+    float rs = sx > sy ? sx : sy;
+    const float side = (float)LD_RS_MAX_DIM / (float)(q->w > q->h ? q->w : q->h);
+    if (rs > side) rs = side;
+    const float texels = (float)q->w * (float)q->h;
+    if (rs * rs * texels > (float)LD_RS_MAX_TEXELS) rs = sqrtf((float)LD_RS_MAX_TEXELS / texels);
+    rs = ld_rs_clamp(rs);
+    const int on = rs > pick * 1.001f;
+    const int same = mine && fabsf(g_rs_scene_rs - rs) <= 0.001f && g_rs_scene_loc == q->loc && g_rs_scene_off == q->off &&
+                     g_rs_scene_w == q->w && g_rs_scene_h == q->h && g_rs_scene_cw == q->cw && g_rs_scene_ch == q->ch;
+    if (on ? !same : mine) ld_rs_scene_follow_set(on, rs, q);
+}
+
+/* The back end's feature and the output texture for these sizes. Everything submitted is waited for
+ * first: the old feature and the old output may be named by lists that have not finished. 1 when
+ * made. */
+static int ld_up_make(u32 rw, u32 rh, u32 ow, u32 oh, gt5_upscale_mode quality)
+{
+    const gt5_upscale_api* api = rsx_upscale_api();
+    if (!api) return 0;
+    ld_flush(LD_FLUSH_RETIRE_QUEUE);
+    if (!g.ready) return 0;
+    s_up.made = 0;
+    s_up.out_valid = 0;
+    if (!s_up.out || s_up.ow != ow || s_up.oh != oh) {
+        if (s_up.out) { s_up.out->lpVtbl->Release(s_up.out); s_up.out = NULL; }   /* no list names it any more */
+        D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp = {0}; hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT;
+        D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC rd = {0};
+        rd.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
+        rd.Width = ow; rd.Height = oh; rd.DepthOrArraySize = 1;
+        rd.MipLevels = 1; rd.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM; rd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
+        /* written by the back end as an unordered-access target; a render target only for the dump's copy */
+        rd.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS | D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_RENDER_TARGET;
+        ID3D12Resource* t = NULL;
+        if (FAILED(LD_CCR(g.dev, &hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &rd, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, NULL,
+                          &IID_ID3D12Resource, (void**)&t)) || !t) {
+            ld_up_miss(1, "no texture for the upscaled picture could be made");
+            return 0;
+        }
+        s_up.out = t;
+        srv_write(SRV_UP_BASE, t);
+    }
+    if (s_up.copy_in && (!s_up.in_tex[0] || s_up.rw != rw || s_up.rh != rh)) {
+        static const DXGI_FORMAT fmt[3] = { DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT, DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT };
+        for (u32 i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
+            if (s_up.in_tex[i]) { s_up.in_tex[i]->lpVtbl->Release(s_up.in_tex[i]); s_up.in_tex[i] = NULL; }
+            D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp = {0}; hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT;
+            D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC rd = {0};
+            rd.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
+            rd.Width = rw; rd.Height = rh; rd.DepthOrArraySize = 1;
+            rd.MipLevels = 1; rd.Format = fmt[i]; rd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
+            if (FAILED(LD_CCR(g.dev, &hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &rd, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE, NULL,
+                              &IID_ID3D12Resource, (void**)&s_up.in_tex[i])))
+                s_up.in_tex[i] = NULL;
+        }
+        if (!s_up.in_tex[0] || !s_up.in_tex[1] || !s_up.in_tex[2]) {
+            ld_up_miss(1, "no textures for the upscaler's input copies could be made");
+            return 0;
+        }
+    }
+    /* The back end records its set-up into the real list; nothing else touches that list meanwhile,
+     * and it is executed before the first evaluation. */
+    ld_rec_sync();
+    RSX_FG_WAIT(cw);                             /* [fgv3] */
+    const int ok = api->create(ld_list_real(), rw, rh, ow, oh, quality, 0u, s_up.preset);
+    rsx_fg_wait_end("DLSS upscaler: create (NGX)", &cw);
+    ld_list_state_reset();
+    ld_flush(LD_FLUSH_RETIRE_QUEUE);
+    if (!g.ready) return 0;
+    if (!ok) {
+        char why[200];
+        snprintf(why, sizeof why, "%s %ux%u to %ux%u could not be made: %s", ld_up_mode_name(s_up.want), rw, rh, ow, oh,
+                 api->last_error());
+        ld_up_miss(1, why);
+        return 0;
+    }
+    s_up.made = 1; s_up.made_mode = s_up.want; s_up.made_preset = s_up.preset; s_up.made_quality = quality;
+    /* the scene's textures are picked for the render size: the bias takes them to the output's */
+    s_up.lod_code = 0;
+    if (s_up.lod_bias && rh < oh) {
+        const u32 c = (u32)(-log2f((float)rh / (float)oh) * 4.0f + 0.5f);
+        s_up.lod_code = c > 8u ? 8u : c;
+    }
+    s_up.gpu_ms = 0.0f;
+    s_up.rw = rw; s_up.rh = rh; s_up.ow = ow; s_up.oh = oh;
+    /* the jitter sequence: 8 phases times the area ratio, as the back end's guide asks */
+    { const float ratio = ((float)ow * (float)oh) / ((float)rw * (float)rh);
+      u32 n = (u32)ceilf(8.0f * ratio - 0.01f);
+      s_up.jit_phases = n < 8u ? 8u : n > 256u ? 256u : n; }
+    s_up.reset_next = 1;
+    s_up.last_qpc = 0;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[upscale] %s made: the scene %ux%u to %ux%u (%s; quality value %d), model %d (0 = the default), "
+                    "%u jitter phases, texture LOD bias %.2f\n",
+            ld_up_mode_name(s_up.want), rw, rh, ow, oh, s_up.out_scene ? "the scene's own size, LD_UP_OUT=scene" : "the display rectangle",
+            (int)quality, s_up.preset, s_up.jit_phases, -(double)s_up.lod_code * 0.25);
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* The upscaler goes: switched off while playing, given up, or the renderer shuts down. The feature
+ * is released only once the lists that used it have finished. */
+static void ld_up_release(int shutting_down)
+{
+    if (g_rs_scene_on && g_rs_scene_owner != 2 && !shutting_down) ld_up_scene_scale(0, 1.0f, NULL);   /* [aa3d] not LD_RES_SCENE's */
+    if (s_up.made || s_up.out) {
+        ld_flush(LD_FLUSH_RETIRE_QUEUE);
+        if (g.ready) {
+            const gt5_upscale_api* api = rsx_upscale_api();
+            if (api && s_up.made) { ld_rec_sync(); RSX_FG_WAIT(dw); api->destroy(); rsx_fg_wait_end("DLSS upscaler: destroy (NGX)", &dw); }
+            if (s_up.out) s_up.out->lpVtbl->Release(s_up.out);
+            for (u32 i = 0; i < 3; i++)
+                if (s_up.in_tex[i]) s_up.in_tex[i]->lpVtbl->Release(s_up.in_tex[i]);
+        }
+        s_up.out = NULL;
+        s_up.in_tex[0] = s_up.in_tex[1] = s_up.in_tex[2] = NULL;
+    }
+    s_up.lod_code = 0;
+    s_up.gpu_ms = 0.0f;
+    if (shutting_down && g.ready) {
+        if (s_up.q_heap) s_up.q_heap->lpVtbl->Release(s_up.q_heap);
+        if (s_up.q_rb) s_up.q_rb->lpVtbl->Release(s_up.q_rb);
+        s_up.q_heap = NULL; s_up.q_rb = NULL; s_up.q_state = 0; s_up.q_pending = 0;
+    }
+    s_up.made = 0; s_up.ready = 0; s_up.out_valid = 0; s_up.frame_ok = 0; s_up.evaluated = 0;
+    s_up.last_qpc = 0; s_up.reset_next = 1;
+    s_up.opt_ow = s_up.opt_oh = 0;
+}
+
+/* A frame starts (ld_scn_frame_end, before the motion vectors' own start): is the frame one the
+ * upscaler can work on, and is everything made for it? Sets s_up.ready; the jitter of the frame
+ * follows it. */
+static void ld_up_frame_begin(void)
+{
+    s_up.frame_ok = 0;
+    s_up.evaluated = 0;
+    s_up.ready = 0;
+    if (!s_up.on) { ld_up_release(0); return; }
+    const gt5_upscale_api* api = rsx_upscale_api();
+    if (!api) return;
+    if (!s_scn.sig_valid) {
+        /* No 3D scene is known: a menu, or the first frame of a scene (its boundary is not found yet). */
+        InterlockedExchange(&s_up.state, LD_UP_S_NO_SCENE);
+        if (g_rs_scene_on && ++s_up.no_scene >= 2u) ld_up_scene_scale(0, 1.0f, NULL);
+        return;
+    }
+    s_up.no_scene = 0;
+    const ld_scn_sig* q = &s_scn.sig;
+    /* base: the scale the scene has without the upscaler. s_out: the output as a scale of the scene's
+     * clip. LD_UP_OUT=scene: base, the game's supersampling stays. Otherwise the display rectangle
+     * the boundary draw filled in the last scene frame, at the display buffer's scale: the larger of
+     * the two axes' ratios, so neither axis is drawn with fewer pixels than the screen shows (720p
+     * mode: 1152x648 of a 2304x1296 clip, 0.5 times the display's scale; 1080p mode: 1728x972 of
+     * 2304x972, the display's scale, and the width stays 1.33 times the rectangle's). */
+    float base = 1.0f;
+    if (g_rs_user != 1.0f) {
+        const int was = g_rs_scene_on;
+        g_rs_scene_on = 0;
+        base = ld_rs_pick_at(q->loc, q->off, q->w, q->h, q->ax, q->ay);
+        g_rs_scene_on = was;
+    }
+    float s_out = base;
+    if (!s_up.out_scene && s_up.vp_w && s_up.vp_h && q->cw && q->ch) {
+        float drs = s_up.disp_rs > 0.0f ? s_up.disp_rs : 1.0f;
+        if (s_scn.b_display < g.n_surfaces && g.surfaces[s_scn.b_display].tex && ld_scn_is_display(&g.surfaces[s_scn.b_display]))
+            drs = g.surfaces[s_scn.b_display].rs;      /* as it is now: the resolution scale may have changed at the flip */
+        const float sx = (float)s_up.vp_w * drs / (float)q->cw, sy = (float)s_up.vp_h * drs / (float)q->ch;
+        s_out = sx > sy ? sx : sy;
+    }
+    const u32 ow = ld_hs(q->cw, s_out), oh = ld_hs(q->ch, s_out);
+    if (ow < 16u || oh < 16u) { ld_up_miss(1, "the 3D picture is too small"); return; }
+    float srs = s_out;
+    gt5_upscale_mode quality = GT5_UPSCALE_NATIVE;
+    if (s_up.want == 6) {
+        /* dlss_c: LD_DLSS_SCALE percent of the output, on even numbers; the back end's quality value
+         * by how much smaller that is. */
+        const u32 tw0 = 2u * (u32)((float)ow * s_up.scale_pct / 200.0f + 0.5f);
+        const u32 tw = tw0 < 2u ? 2u : tw0 > ow ? ow : tw0;
+        const float r = (float)tw / (float)ow;
+        if (tw != ow) srs = (float)tw / (float)q->cw;
+        quality = tw == ow ? GT5_UPSCALE_NATIVE : r >= 0.66f ? GT5_UPSCALE_QUALITY : r >= 0.58f ? GT5_UPSCALE_BALANCED :
+                  r >= 0.5f ? GT5_UPSCALE_PERFORMANCE : GT5_UPSCALE_ULTRA_PERFORMANCE;
+    } else if (s_up.want >= 2) {
+        quality = ld_up_mode_of(s_up.want);
+        /* The render size the back end wants for this output, as a scale of the scene. */
+        if (s_up.opt_ow != ow || s_up.opt_oh != oh || s_up.opt_mode != s_up.want) {
+            u32 tw = 0, th = 0;
+            ld_rec_sync();
+            RSX_FG_WAIT(ow_);                    /* [fgv3] */
+            if (!api->optimal(ow, oh, ld_up_mode_of(s_up.want), &tw, &th) || !tw || !th || tw > ow || th > oh) tw = th = 0;
+            rsx_fg_wait_end("DLSS upscaler: optimal settings (NGX)", &ow_);
+            s_up.opt_ow = ow; s_up.opt_oh = oh; s_up.opt_mode = s_up.want; s_up.opt_rw = tw; s_up.opt_rh = th;
+        }
+        if (!s_up.opt_rw) { ld_up_miss(1, "the back end gave no render size for this mode"); return; }
