+    IDirectInputDevice8_SetProperty(dev, DIPROP_RANGE, &r.diph);
+    dev_prop_dword(dev, DIPROP_DEADZONE, DIPH_DEVICE, 0, 0);
+    dev_prop_dword(dev, DIPROP_SATURATION, DIPH_DEVICE, 0, 10000);
+}
+
+static void dev_axes_present(LPDIRECTINPUTDEVICE8W dev, int* present)
+{
+    static const DWORD ofs[AX_COUNT] = {
+        DIJOFS_X, DIJOFS_Y, DIJOFS_Z, DIJOFS_RX, DIJOFS_RY, DIJOFS_RZ, DIJOFS_SLIDER(0), DIJOFS_SLIDER(1) };
+    for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT; a++) {
+        DIDEVICEOBJECTINSTANCEW oi; memset(&oi, 0, sizeof oi); oi.dwSize = sizeof oi;
+        present[a] = SUCCEEDED(IDirectInputDevice8_GetObjectInfo(dev, &oi, ofs[a], DIPH_BYOFFSET));
+    }
+}
+
+/* ---- the pedals' or the buttons' own device ---------------------------------------------------- */
+typedef struct { const char* match; GUID skip; int have_skip; Cand c; } XFind;
+static LONG axis_val(const DIJOYSTATE2* js, int a);
+
+static BOOL CALLBACK xfind_cb(LPCDIDEVICEINSTANCEW di, LPVOID ctx)
+{
+    XFind* f = (XFind*)ctx;
+    if (f->have_skip && !memcmp(&di->guidInstance, &f->skip, sizeof(GUID))) return DIENUM_CONTINUE;
+    Cand c; memset(&c, 0, sizeof c);
+    c.inst = di->guidInstance;
+    utf8(di->tszProductName, c.name, sizeof c.name);
+    c.vid = LOWORD(di->guidProduct.Data1);
+    c.pid = HIWORD(di->guidProduct.Data1);
+    devlist_add(c.name);
+    if (!f->c.score && dev_matches(c.name, c.vid, c.pid, f->match)) { f->c = c; f->c.score = 1; }
+    return DIENUM_CONTINUE;
+}
+
+static void pedals_decide(void);
+
+/* The pedals read from device x, once it is open. Unless PS3_WHEEL_PEDALS names their axes: on the pedals'
+ * device the axes it has, in order, are throttle, brake and clutch (of those read from it); on one pedal's
+ * own device, its first axis. */
+static void pedals_map_device(int x)
+{
+    const XDev* d = &s_xd[x];
+    int present[AX_COUNT], np = 0, rank = 0;
+    for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT; a++) if (d->axis_present[a]) present[np++] = a;
+    WheelMap tmp = s_map;
+    for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
+        if (pedal_src(p) != x) continue;
+        const int k = x == XD_PEDALS ? rank++ : 0;
+        tmp.pedal[p] = k < np ? present[k] : AX_NONE;
+        tmp.pedal_inv[p] = -1;
+    }
+    pedals_override(&tmp);
+    for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
+        if (pedal_src(p) != x) continue;
+        s_map.pedal[p] = tmp.pedal[p];
+        s_map.pedal_inv[p] = tmp.pedal_inv[p];
+        if (s_map.pedal[p] >= 0 && !d->axis_present[s_map.pedal[p]]) s_map.pedal[p] = AX_NONE;
+    }
+}
+
+static void xd_close(int x, const char* why)
+{
+    XDev* d = &s_xd[x];
+    if (!d->dev) return;
+    IDirectInputDevice8_Unacquire(d->dev);
+    IDirectInputDevice8_Release(d->dev);
+    d->dev = NULL;
+    d->ok = 0;
+    d->rest_known = 0;
+    d->fail_since = 0;
+    if (x == XD_BUTTONS) s_has_hat = s_base_has_hat;
+    for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) if (pedal_src(p) == x) s_map.pedal[p] = AX_NONE;   /* released until it's back */
+    fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] %s: the device for the %s (\"%s\") closed\n", why, d->what, d->name);
+}
+
+static int xd_open(int x)
+{
+    XDev* d = &s_xd[x];
+    XFind f; memset(&f, 0, sizeof f);
+    f.match = d->match; f.skip = s_inst; f.have_skip = s_dev != NULL;
+    if (FAILED(IDirectInput8_EnumDevices(s_di, DI8DEVCLASS_GAMECTRL, xfind_cb, &f, DIEDFL_ATTACHEDONLY)) || !f.c.score)
+        return 0;
+    if (FAILED(IDirectInput8_CreateDevice(s_di, &f.c.inst, &d->dev, NULL))) { d->dev = NULL; return 0; }
+    snprintf(d->name, sizeof d->name, "%s", f.c.name);
+    d->vid = f.c.vid; d->pid = f.c.pid;
+    IDirectInputDevice8_SetDataFormat(d->dev, &c_dfDIJoystick2);
+    IDirectInputDevice8_SetCooperativeLevel(d->dev, s_hwnd, DISCL_NONEXCLUSIVE | DISCL_BACKGROUND);
+    DIDEVCAPS caps; memset(&caps, 0, sizeof caps); caps.dwSize = sizeof caps;
+    IDirectInputDevice8_GetCapabilities(d->dev, &caps);
+    d->has_hat = caps.dwPOVs > 0;
+    d->buttons = (unsigned long)caps.dwButtons;
+    dev_full_range(d->dev);
+    dev_axes_present(d->dev, d->axis_present);
+    IDirectInputDevice8_Acquire(d->dev);
+    d->ok = 0; d->last_good = 0; d->fail_since = 0;
+    d->rest_known = 0;
+    d->said_missing = 0;
+    char axes[64] = ""; int n = 0;
+    for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT; a++)
+        if (d->axis_present[a] && n < (int)sizeof axes - 5) n += snprintf(axes + n, sizeof axes - (size_t)n, " %s", k_axis_name[a]);
+    if (xd_is_pedal(x)) {
+        pedals_map_device(x);
+        static const char* const pn[3] = { "throttle", "brake", "clutch" };
+        char which[96] = ""; int m = 0;
+        for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++)
+            if (pedal_src(p) == x && m < (int)sizeof which - 24)
+                m += snprintf(which + m, sizeof which - (size_t)m, "%s%s %s", m ? ", " : "", pn[p],
+                              s_map.pedal[p] >= 0 ? k_axis_name[s_map.pedal[p]] : "none");
+        fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] %s from \"%s\" (%04X:%04X), axes%s: %s "
+                        "(PS3_WHEEL_PEDALS=throttle=<axis>,... or the in-game menu's wheel page changes them)\n",
+                x == XD_PEDALS ? "pedals" : d->what, d->name, d->vid, d->pid, n ? axes : " none", m ? which : "no pedal");
+    } else {
+        if (d->has_hat) s_has_hat = 1;
+        fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] buttons from \"%s\" (%04X:%04X): %lu buttons, %s; PS3_WHEEL_BUTTONS numbers are its own\n",
+                d->name, d->vid, d->pid, d->buttons, d->has_hat ? "a d-pad" : "no d-pad (the wheel's, if it has one)");
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+
+/* Every read of the wheel: read the pedals' / buttons' device too. A reading stays usable for 50 ms
+ * (one that fails in between changes nothing); after that its pedals read released and its buttons
+ * up, and after a second without one it is closed and looked for again. */
+static void xd_poll(int x, ULONGLONG now)
+{
+    XDev* d = &s_xd[x];
+    if (!xd_separate(d)) return;
+    if (!d->dev) {
+        d->ok = 0;
+        if (now < d->next_look) return;
+        /* A look lists DirectInput's devices, which holds this thread for some milliseconds: every
+         * 2 s for the first half minute after the wheel was found, then every 10 s. */
+        d->next_look = now + (d->looks++ < 15 ? 2000 : 10000);
+        if (xd_open(x)) return;
+        if (!d->said_missing) {
+            d->said_missing = 1;
+            fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] the device for the %s (\"%s\") isn't connected: %s until it is (looked for every few seconds)\n",
+                    d->what, d->match, xd_is_pedal(x) ? "its pedals read released" : "no buttons");
+            gt5_menu_notice(GT5_NOTICE_WHEEL, xd_is_pedal(x) ? "Pedals not found" : "Wheel buttons not found",
+                            xd_is_pedal(x) ? "未找到踏板" : "未找到方向盘按钮", 8000);
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+    HRESULT hr = IDirectInputDevice8_Poll(d->dev);
+    if (FAILED(hr)) IDirectInputDevice8_Acquire(d->dev);
+    DIJOYSTATE2 js;
+    hr = IDirectInputDevice8_GetDeviceState(d->dev, sizeof js, &js);
+    if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) {
+        d->js = js;
+        d->last_good = now;
+        d->fail_since = 0;
+    } else {
+        if (!d->fail_since) d->fail_since = now;
+        if (now - d->fail_since >= 1000) {
+            xd_close(x, "lost");
+            d->next_look = now + 500;
+            d->looks = 0;
+            d->said_missing = 0;
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+    d->ok = d->last_good && now - d->last_good < 50;
+    if (!xd_is_pedal(x) || d->rest_known || !d->ok) return;
+    /* Rest points, as for the wheel: not from DirectInput's "middle of every axis" before the first
+     * report, and kept when the same pedals come back (a pedal held then would become "rest"). */
+    int fresh = 0;
+    for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT; a++) {
+        const LONG v = axis_val(&d->js, a);
+        if (d->axis_present[a] && v != 32767 && v != 32768) fresh = 1;
+    }
+    const int reuse = d->rest_have && d->rest_vid == d->vid && d->rest_pid == d->pid;
+    if (!fresh && !reuse) return;
+    char line[256]; int n = 0;
+    for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT; a++) {
+        if (!reuse) d->rest[a] = axis_val(&d->js, a);
+        if (d->axis_present[a] && n < (int)sizeof line - 24)
+            n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - (size_t)n, " %s=%ld", k_axis_name[a], d->rest[a]);
+    }
+    d->rest_known = 1;
+    d->rest_have = 1; d->rest_vid = d->vid; d->rest_pid = d->pid;
+    fprintf(stderr, reuse ? "[wheel] the device for the %s is back: keeping its rest points (0-65535):%s\n"
+                          : "[wheel] the device for the %s at rest (0-65535):%s\n", d->what, n ? line : " none");
+    pedals_decide();
+}
+
+static void fx_release_all(void);
+
+static void probe_close(void);
+
+static void dev_close(const char* why)
+{
+    probe_close();
+    for (int x = 0; x < XD_COUNT; x++) xd_close(x, why);
+    if (!s_dev) return;
+    fx_release_all();
+    if (s_has_ffb) IDirectInputDevice8_SendForceFeedbackCommand(s_dev, DISFFC_RESET);
+    IDirectInputDevice8_Unacquire(s_dev);
+    IDirectInputDevice8_Release(s_dev);
+    s_dev = NULL;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] %s: \"%s\" closed\n", why, s_name);
+    WheelInput none; memset(&none, 0, sizeof none); none.hat = -1;
+    publish(&none);
+}
+
+static int dev_open(void)
+{
+    Cand best; memset(&best, 0, sizeof best);
+    best.score = 0;
+    s_enum_count = 0;
+    s_devlist_n = 0;
+    if (FAILED(IDirectInput8_EnumDevices(s_di, DI8DEVCLASS_GAMECTRL, enum_cb, &best, DIEDFL_ATTACHEDONLY)))
+        return 0;
+    if (s_list && !s_enum_count) fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] DirectInput sees no game controllers\n");
+    s_list = 0;   /* list once */
+    if (!best.score) return 0;
+    if (FAILED(IDirectInput8_CreateDevice(s_di, &best.inst, &s_dev, NULL))) { s_dev = NULL; return 0; }
+    snprintf(s_name, sizeof s_name, "%s", best.name);
+    s_vid = best.vid; s_pid = best.pid;
+    s_inst = best.inst;
+    /* A pedals' or buttons' device that names this wheel: they're the wheel's own after all. */
+    for (int x = 0; x < XD_COUNT; x++) {
+        s_xd[x].on_wheel = dev_matches(s_name, s_vid, s_pid, s_xd[x].match);
+        s_xd[x].next_look = 0;
+        s_xd[x].looks = 0;
+        s_xd[x].said_missing = 0;
+    }
+    IDirectInputDevice8_SetDataFormat(s_dev, &c_dfDIJoystick2);
+
+    DIDEVCAPS caps; memset(&caps, 0, sizeof caps); caps.dwSize = sizeof caps;
+    IDirectInputDevice8_GetCapabilities(s_dev, &caps);
+    s_has_ffb = (caps.dwFlags & DIDC_FORCEFEEDBACK) && s_gain > 0;
+    s_has_hat = s_base_has_hat = caps.dwPOVs > 0;
+    /* Effects need exclusive access; a helper window that is never shown is
+     * enough with background access. */
+    if (FAILED(IDirectInputDevice8_SetCooperativeLevel(s_dev, s_hwnd,
+            (s_has_ffb ? DISCL_EXCLUSIVE : DISCL_NONEXCLUSIVE) | DISCL_BACKGROUND))) {
+        s_has_ffb = 0;
+        IDirectInputDevice8_SetCooperativeLevel(s_dev, s_hwnd, DISCL_NONEXCLUSIVE | DISCL_BACKGROUND);
+    }
+    DIPROPRANGE r;
+    r.diph.dwSize = sizeof(DIPROPRANGE);
+    r.diph.dwHeaderSize = sizeof(DIPROPHEADER);
+    r.diph.dwObj = 0;
+    r.diph.dwHow = DIPH_DEVICE;
+    r.lMin = 0; r.lMax = 65535;
+    IDirectInputDevice8_SetProperty(s_dev, DIPROP_RANGE, &r.diph);
+    set_prop_dword(DIPROP_DEADZONE, DIPH_DEVICE, 0, 0);
+    set_prop_dword(DIPROP_SATURATION, DIPH_DEVICE, 0, 10000);
+    if (s_has_ffb) {
+        /* The game centres the wheel itself (the G27's default spring). */
+        set_prop_dword(DIPROP_AUTOCENTER, DIPH_DEVICE, 0, DIPROPAUTOCENTER_OFF);
+        set_prop_dword(DIPROP_FFGAIN, DIPH_DEVICE, 0, (DWORD)s_gain * 100);
+    }
+    IDirectInputDevice8_Acquire(s_dev);
+    if (s_has_ffb) IDirectInputDevice8_SendForceFeedbackCommand(s_dev, DISFFC_RESET);
+
+    /* An axis the wheel doesn't have reads 0, which for a pedal that rests at
+     * the top would be "floored": a two-pedal wheel's missing clutch would hold
+     * the clutch down. Map only what is there. */
+    {
+        static const DWORD ofs[AX_COUNT] = {
+            DIJOFS_X, DIJOFS_Y, DIJOFS_Z, DIJOFS_RX, DIJOFS_RY, DIJOFS_RZ, DIJOFS_SLIDER(0), DIJOFS_SLIDER(1) };
+        for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT; a++) {
+            DIDEVICEOBJECTINSTANCEW oi; memset(&oi, 0, sizeof oi); oi.dwSize = sizeof oi;
+            s_axis_present[a] = SUCCEEDED(IDirectInputDevice8_GetObjectInfo(s_dev, &oi, ofs[a], DIPH_BYOFFSET));
+        }
+    }
+    build_map(&s_map, s_vid, s_pid);
+    for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++)
+        if (s_map.pedal[p] >= 0 && !s_axis_present[s_map.pedal[p]]) s_map.pedal[p] = AX_NONE;
+    /* A pedal on a device of its own: not from the wheel's axes; xd_open maps that device's. */
+    for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) if (pedal_src(p) >= 0) s_map.pedal[p] = AX_NONE;
+    s_rest_known = 0;
+    s_rest_wait = 0;
+    s_split = 0;
+    s_ffb_dirty = 1;
+    {
+        const char* e = getenv("PS3_WHEEL_RANGE");
+        fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] using \"%s\" (%04X:%04X), force feedback %s, range %s degrees; "
+                        "steer %s, throttle %s, brake %s, clutch %s; %lu buttons, %s\n",
+                s_name, s_vid, s_pid, s_has_ffb ? "on" : "off", (e && *e) ? e : "900",
+                k_axis_name[s_map.steer],
+                s_map.pedal[0] >= 0 ? k_axis_name[s_map.pedal[0]] : "none",
+                s_map.pedal[1] >= 0 ? k_axis_name[s_map.pedal[1]] : "none",
+                s_map.pedal[2] >= 0 ? k_axis_name[s_map.pedal[2]] : "none",
+                (unsigned long)caps.dwButtons, s_has_hat ? "a d-pad" : "no d-pad");
+        static const char* const xkey[XD_COUNT] = { "PS3_WHEEL_PEDAL_DEVICE", "PS3_WHEEL_BUTTON_DEVICE",
+            "PS3_WHEEL_THROTTLE_DEVICE", "PS3_WHEEL_BRAKE_DEVICE", "PS3_WHEEL_CLUTCH_DEVICE" };
+        for (int x = 0; x < XD_COUNT; x++) {
+            if (xd_separate(&s_xd[x]))
+                fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] the %s: read from the device \"%s\" (%s)\n", s_xd[x].what, s_xd[x].match, xkey[x]);
+            else if (s_xd[x].match[0] || s_xd[x].forced_wheel)
+                fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] the %s: the wheel's own (%s)\n", s_xd[x].what, xkey[x]);
+        }
+        static const char* const pn[3] = { "throttle", "brake", "clutch" };
+        for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++)
+            if (s_map.pbtn[p] >= 0)
+                fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] button %d floors the %s\n", s_map.pbtn[p] + 1, pn[p]);
+        int dpad_btns = 0;
+        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) dpad_btns += s_map.dpad[d] >= 0;
+        if (s_menu_cfg == 1 || (s_menu_cfg < 0 && !s_has_hat))
+            fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] no d-pad: at the game's menus, turn the rim for left / right and press "
+                            "the throttle / brake for down / up (PS3_WHEEL_MENU=off stops this)%s\n",
+                    dpad_btns ? "" : "; PS3_WHEEL_BUTTONS=up=7,down=8 puts the d-pad on buttons instead");
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+
+static LONG axis_val(const DIJOYSTATE2* js, int a)
+{
+    switch (a) {
+    case AX_X:  return js->lX;
+    case AX_Y:  return js->lY;
+    case AX_Z:  return js->lZ;
+    case AX_RX: return js->lRx;
+    case AX_RY: return js->lRy;
+    case AX_RZ: return js->lRz;
+    case AX_S0: return js->rglSlider[0];
+    case AX_S1: return js->rglSlider[1];
+    default:    return 0;
+    }
+}
+
+/* js and rest: the device the pedals are on (the wheel, or their own: PS3_WHEEL_PEDAL_DEVICE). */
+static float pedal(const DIJOYSTATE2* js, const LONG* rest, int rest_known, int p)
+{
+    const int a = s_map.pedal[p];
+    if (a < 0 || !rest_known || !js) return 0.f;   /* released until the device's first report */
+    const LONG v = axis_val(js, a);
+    if (s_split && p < 2) {
+        /* One axis, two pedals: each reads from the rest point to its own end,
+         * past a small dead zone, so an older wheel's jitter at rest is no pedal. */
+        const int below = (p == 0) != s_split_swap;
+        float f = below ? (float)(s_split_at - v) / (float)s_split_at
+                        : (float)(v - s_split_at) / (float)(65535 - s_split_at);
+        f = (f - 0.02f) / 0.98f;
+        return f < 0.f ? 0.f : (f > 1.f ? 1.f : f);
+    }
+    /* Which end is "released": where the pedal rested when the wheel was
+     * opened, if that was clearly one end; otherwise the model's default
+     * (the top, as on Logitech wheels). PS3_WHEEL_PEDALS ...inv flips it. */
+    int high = s_map.pedal_inv[p];
+    const int flip = high == 2;
+    if (high < 0 || flip) {
+        if (rest[a] > 58981)     high = 1;
+        else if (rest[a] < 6554) high = 0;
+        else                     high = 1;
+        if (flip) high = !high;
+    }
+    float f = high ? (65535.f - (float)v) / 65535.f : (float)v / 65535.f;
+    return f < 0.f ? 0.f : (f > 1.f ? 1.f : f);
+}
+
+/* The rest points of where pedal p is read from (the wheel, or a device of its own), NULL until known. */
+static const LONG* pedal_rest(int p)
+{
+    const int src = pedal_src(p);
+    if (src < 0) return s_rest_known ? s_rest : NULL;
+    return s_xd[src].rest_known ? s_xd[src].rest : NULL;
+}
+
+/* Each time the rest points of a device the pedals are read from become known. */
+static void pedals_decide(void)
+{
+    /* Older wheels (the Genius Speed Wheel 3, for one) put both pedals on one
+     * axis that rests in the middle, one pedal moving it down and the other up,
+     * with no brake axis. Read as one pedal, resting there would be half
+     * throttle: split it where it rests instead. Only throttle and brake on one device can share an axis. */
+#define REST_MID(r, a) ((r) && (a) >= 0 && (r)[a] >= 6554 && (r)[a] <= 58981)
+    const LONG* rt = pedal_rest(0);
+    const LONG* rc = pedal_rest(2);
+    const int same = pedal_src(0) == pedal_src(1);
+    const int ta = s_map.pedal[0], ba = s_map.pedal[1], ca = s_map.pedal[2];
+    int sa = AX_NONE;
+    const int was = s_split;
+    s_split = 0;
+    if (same && rt) {
+        if (ta >= 0 && (ba == ta || (ba == AX_NONE && REST_MID(rt, ta)))) sa = ta;
+        /* A pedal rests at one end of its axis, so a throttle axis and a brake axis that both
+         * rest in the middle aren't two pedals: Thrustmaster's "combined" mode puts both on Y
+         * (the other axis sits in the middle unused; read as a pedal it was a brake held half
+         * down, a player's T-GT, 15 Nov 2026). Split Y, as for the older wheels. */
+        else if (REST_MID(rt, ta) && REST_MID(rt, ba)) sa = (ta == AX_Y || ba == AX_Y) ? AX_Y : ta;
+    }
+    if (sa >= 0) {
+        s_split = 1;
+        /* Where it rests, unless that is far from the middle: the first reading can come
+         * with a pedal already moving. */
+        s_split_at = labs(rt[sa] - 32768) <= 6554 ? rt[sa] : 32768;
+        s_split_swap = (s_map.pedal_inv[0] == 2) != (s_map.pedal_inv[1] == 2);
+        s_map.pedal[0] = s_map.pedal[1] = sa;
+        if (!was)
+            fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] throttle and brake share the %s axis, split at %ld: throttle %s it, "
+                            "brake %s (PS3_WHEEL_PEDALS=throttle=%s%s,brake=%s swaps them)\n",
+                    k_axis_name[sa], s_split_at, s_split_swap ? "above" : "below",
+                    s_split_swap ? "below" : "above", k_axis_name[sa], s_split_swap ? "" : "inv",
+                    k_axis_name[sa]);
+    }
+    /* The same for the clutch: an axis resting in the middle is no clutch pedal (half down
+     * would slip it in a manual car). */
+    if (REST_MID(rc, ca) && !(ca == sa && pedal_src(2) == pedal_src(0))) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] %s rests in the middle, so it is no clutch pedal: no clutch "
+                        "(PS3_WHEEL_PEDALS=clutch=<axis> names the clutch's axis)\n", k_axis_name[ca]);
+        s_map.pedal[2] = AX_NONE;
+    }
+#undef REST_MID
+}
+
+/* Hat direction from -1/0/+1 steps (dy +1 = down), -1 = centred. */
+static int hat_from(int dx, int dy)
+{
+    static const int k[3][3] = { { 7, 0, 1 }, { 6, -1, 2 }, { 5, 4, 3 } };
+    return k[dy + 1][dx + 1];
+}
+
+/* GT5's menus move only with the d-pad (a G27 has one on its shifter). A wheel without one,
+ * as most cheap wheels are (a player's Genius Speed Wheel 3 has eight buttons and no d-pad),
+ * left the keyboard as the only way through them. At the menus (see wheel_g27_in_menus), the
+ * rim turned past a quarter of its travel holds d-pad left or right, and the throttle and the
+ * brake hold down and up; the game's own repeat scrolls while they're held. A d-pad or d-pad
+ * buttons pressed win. In a race nothing changes. */
+static void menu_dpad(WheelInput* in)
+{
+    static int dx, dy, was;   /* not at the menus until the game's driver says so */
+    static unsigned said;
+    if (!(s_menu_cfg == 1 || (s_menu_cfg < 0 && !s_has_hat))) return;
+    const int menus = wheel_g27_in_menus();
+    if (menus != was) {
+        if (said < 100) {
+            said++;
+            fprintf(stderr, menus ? "[wheel] the game is at its menus: the rim and pedals move through them\n"
+                                  : "[wheel] the game left its menus: the rim and pedals drive\n");
+        }
+        was = menus;
+        dx = dy = 0;
+    }
+    if (!menus) return;
+    /* Hysteresis, so a rim held near the threshold doesn't flicker. */
+    const float s = in->steer;
+    if ((dx > 0 && s < 0.15f) || (dx < 0 && s > -0.15f)) dx = 0;
+    if (!dx) dx = s > 0.25f ? 1 : s < -0.25f ? -1 : 0;
+    if ((dy > 0 && in->throttle < 0.3f) || (dy < 0 && in->brake < 0.3f)) dy = 0;
+    if (!dy) dy = in->throttle > 0.5f ? 1 : in->brake > 0.5f ? -1 : 0;
+    /* One direction at a time: a diagonal moves some menus nowhere. */
+    if (in->hat < 0 && (dx || dy)) in->hat = dy ? hat_from(0, dy) : hat_from(dx, 0);
+}
+
+/* ---- Every game controller, read while the in-game menu is open --------------------------------------
+ * The wheel page's "push the pedal down" takes the pedal from whichever device moved (a player's brake is
+ * one USB device, his throttle and clutch another, 24 Nov 2026): while the menu is open every game controller
+ * found is opened too (read only, never held) and its axes go to the menu with its name. Closed with the menu. */
+static LPDIRECTINPUTDEVICE8W s_probe[GT5_MENU_WHEEL_DEVICES];
+static char s_probe_name[GT5_MENU_WHEEL_DEVICES][64];
+static int  s_probe_n, s_probe_on, s_probe_base = -1;
+typedef struct { GUID g[GT5_MENU_WHEEL_DEVICES]; char n[GT5_MENU_WHEEL_DEVICES][64]; int count; } ProbeList;
+
+static BOOL CALLBACK probe_cb(LPCDIDEVICEINSTANCEW di, LPVOID ctx)
+{
+    ProbeList* l = (ProbeList*)ctx;
+    if (l->count >= GT5_MENU_WHEEL_DEVICES) return DIENUM_STOP;
+    l->g[l->count] = di->guidInstance;
+    utf8(di->tszProductName, l->n[l->count], sizeof l->n[0]);
+    l->count++;
+    return DIENUM_CONTINUE;
+}
+
+static void probe_close(void)
+{
+    for (int i = 0; i < s_probe_n; i++)
+        if (s_probe[i]) { IDirectInputDevice8_Unacquire(s_probe[i]); IDirectInputDevice8_Release(s_probe[i]); s_probe[i] = NULL; }
+    s_probe_n = 0; s_probe_on = 0; s_probe_base = -1;
+}
+
+static void probe_open(void)
+{
+    ProbeList l; memset(&l, 0, sizeof l);
+    s_probe_on = 1; s_probe_n = 0; s_probe_base = -1;
+    if (FAILED(IDirectInput8_EnumDevices(s_di, DI8DEVCLASS_GAMECTRL, probe_cb, &l, DIEDFL_ATTACHEDONLY))) return;
+    for (int i = 0; i < l.count; i++) {
+        snprintf(s_probe_name[i], sizeof s_probe_name[i], "%s", l.n[i]);
+        s_probe[i] = NULL;
+        if (s_dev && !memcmp(&l.g[i], &s_inst, sizeof(GUID))) { s_probe_base = i; continue; }   /* the wheel: its own reading */
+        LPDIRECTINPUTDEVICE8W d = NULL;
+        if (FAILED(IDirectInput8_CreateDevice(s_di, &l.g[i], &d, NULL)) || !d) continue;
+        IDirectInputDevice8_SetDataFormat(d, &c_dfDIJoystick2);
+        IDirectInputDevice8_SetCooperativeLevel(d, s_hwnd, DISCL_NONEXCLUSIVE | DISCL_BACKGROUND);
+        dev_full_range(d);
+        IDirectInputDevice8_Acquire(d);
+        s_probe[i] = d;
+    }
+    s_probe_n = l.count;
+}
+
+static void dev_poll(void)
+{
+    /* A wheel that stops answering (a USB hiccup, a loose cable) must not leave its last state
+     * with the game: that held the throttle and the steering where they were, with no control,
+     * for a second or more before the wheel was dropped (a player's Genius wheel, 14 Nov). After
+     * 50 ms without an answer the rim is centred and the pedals released, the wheel still
+     * attached; after a second it is closed and looked for again every half second. */
+    static ULONGLONG fail_since;
+    static int neutral, said;
+    DIJOYSTATE2 js;
+    HRESULT hr = IDirectInputDevice8_Poll(s_dev);
+    if (FAILED(hr)) {
+        hr = IDirectInputDevice8_Acquire(s_dev);
+        if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) s_ffb_dirty = 2;   /* effects were dropped with the device */
+    }
+    hr = IDirectInputDevice8_GetDeviceState(s_dev, sizeof js, &js);
+    if (FAILED(hr)) {
+        const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
+        if (!fail_since) fail_since = now;
+        if (!neutral && now - fail_since >= 50) {
+            WheelInput in; memset(&in, 0, sizeof in);
+            in.connected = 1; in.hat = -1;
+            in.shifter = s_shifter_cfg >= 0 ? s_shifter_cfg : s_shifter_seen;
+            publish(&in);
+            neutral = 1;
+            if (said < 20) { said++; fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] not answering (0x%08lX): rim centred, pedals released until it's back\n", (unsigned long)hr); }
+        }
+        if (now - fail_since >= 1000) {
+            fail_since = 0; neutral = 0;
+            s_lost_at = now;
+            dev_close("lost");
+            gt5_menu_notice(GT5_NOTICE_WHEEL, "Wheel not responding", "方向盘无响应", 8000);
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+    if (fail_since) {
+        if (neutral && said < 20) { said++; fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] answering again after %llu ms\n", (unsigned long long)(GetTickCount64() - fail_since)); }
+        fail_since = 0; neutral = 0;
+    }
+    int fresh = s_rest_have && s_rest_vid == s_vid && s_rest_pid == s_pid;
+    if (!s_rest_known && !fresh) {
+        /* Until the wheel's first report arrives, DirectInput hands back the middle of every
+         * axis: a Thrustmaster T-GT read 32768 on all eight, its released pedals too, so it looked
+         * like a wheel with every pedal half down. Rest points come from the first read that
+         * isn't that; the pedals read released until then. */
+        for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT; a++) {
+            const LONG v = axis_val(&js, a);
+            if (s_axis_present[a] && v != 32767 && v != 32768) fresh = 1;
+        }
+        const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
+        if (!s_rest_wait) s_rest_wait = now;
+        static unsigned said_wait;
+        if (!fresh && now - s_rest_wait >= 3000 && s_rest_wait != 1) {
+            s_rest_wait = 1;   /* said once per opening */
+            if (said_wait++ < 5)
+                fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] every axis still reads the middle: the pedals count as released "
+                                "until the wheel sends a reading (turn the rim a little)\n");
+            gt5_menu_notice(GT5_NOTICE_WHEEL, "Turn the wheel a little", "请稍微转动方向盘", 15000);
+        }
+    }
+    if (!s_rest_known && fresh) {
+        gt5_menu_notice(GT5_NOTICE_WHEEL, NULL, NULL, 0);   /* the wheel answers: nothing to say */
+        const int reuse = s_rest_have && s_rest_vid == s_vid && s_rest_pid == s_pid;
+        char line[256]; int n = 0;
+        for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT; a++) {
+            if (!reuse) s_rest[a] = axis_val(&js, a);
+            if (s_axis_present[a] && n < (int)sizeof line - 24)
+                n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - (size_t)n, " %s=%ld", k_axis_name[a], s_rest[a]);
+        }
+        s_rest_known = 1;
+        s_rest_have = 1; s_rest_vid = s_vid; s_rest_pid = s_pid;
+        fprintf(stderr, reuse ? "[wheel] back: keeping the rest points measured before (0-65535):%s\n"
+                              : "[wheel] axes at rest (0-65535):%s\n", n ? line : " none");
+        /* The pedals' own device measures its rest points itself (xd_poll). */
+        pedals_decide();
+        if (!wheel_trace_on())
+            fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] if a pedal or button is wrong, PS3_WHEEL_TRACE=1 logs them as they move\n");
+    }
+    WheelInput in; memset(&in, 0, sizeof in);
+    in.connected = 1;
+    /* The pedals' and the buttons' devices: the wheel's own reading, or their own device's (none while
+     * that device is missing or not answering: pedals released, buttons up). */
+    const ULONGLONG now_ms = GetTickCount64();
+    for (int x = 0; x < XD_COUNT; x++) xd_poll(x, now_ms);
+    const XDev* const pd = &s_xd[XD_PEDALS];
+    const XDev* const bd = &s_xd[XD_BUTTONS];
+    const DIJOYSTATE2* pjs = &js;
+    if (xd_separate(pd)) pjs = pd->ok ? &pd->js : NULL;
+    const DIJOYSTATE2* bjs = &js;
+    if (xd_separate(bd)) bjs = bd->ok ? &bd->js : NULL;
+    /* The in-game menu's wheel map ("press a button" / "push the pedal down"): the buttons and axes of
+     * the devices they're read from, and every game controller's axes with its name (a pedal is taken
+     * from whichever device moved), while the menu is open. */
+    if (gt5_menu_is_open()) {
+        gt5_menu_wheel mw;
+        memset(&mw, 0, sizeof mw);
+        mw.connected = 1;
+        snprintf(mw.name, sizeof mw.name, "%s", s_name);
+        if (bjs) for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) mw.button[i] = (unsigned char)(bjs->rgbButtons[i] >> 7);
+        if (pjs) for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT && a < 8; a++) mw.axis[a] = (float)axis_val(pjs, a) / 65535.f;
+        {   /* the pedals' devices: the pedals' one, then "brake: <name>" for a pedal on a device of its own */
+            int n = 0, all = 1;
+            for (int x = 0; x < XD_COUNT; x++) {
+                const XDev* d = &s_xd[x];
+                if (!xd_is_pedal(x) || !xd_separate(d) || n >= (int)sizeof mw.pedals - 8) continue;
+                n += snprintf(mw.pedals + n, sizeof mw.pedals - (size_t)n, "%s%s%s%s", n ? "; " : "",
+                              x == XD_PEDALS ? "" : d->what, x == XD_PEDALS ? "" : ": ", d->dev ? d->name : d->match);
+                if (!d->dev) all = 0;
+            }
+            mw.pedals_found = (unsigned char)all;
+        }
+        if (xd_separate(bd)) { snprintf(mw.buttons, sizeof mw.buttons, "%s", bd->dev ? bd->name : bd->match); mw.buttons_found = bd->dev != NULL; }
+        if (!s_probe_on) probe_open();
+        mw.devices = s_probe_n;
+        for (int i = 0; i < s_probe_n; i++) {
+            snprintf(mw.device[i], sizeof mw.device[i], "%s", s_probe_name[i]);
+            const DIJOYSTATE2* dj = NULL;
+            DIJOYSTATE2 pj;
+            if (i == s_probe_base) dj = &js;
+            else if (s_probe[i]) {
+                if (FAILED(IDirectInputDevice8_Poll(s_probe[i]))) IDirectInputDevice8_Acquire(s_probe[i]);
+                if (SUCCEEDED(IDirectInputDevice8_GetDeviceState(s_probe[i], sizeof pj, &pj))) dj = &pj;
+            }
+            if (dj) {
+                mw.device_read[i] = 1;
+                for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT && a < 8; a++) mw.device_axis[i][a] = (float)axis_val(dj, a) / 65535.f;
+            }
+        }
+        gt5_menu_feed_wheel(&mw);
+    } else if (s_probe_on) probe_close();
+    in.steer = ((float)axis_val(&js, s_map.steer) - 32767.5f) / 32767.5f;
+    {   /* each pedal from where it is read: the wheel, the pedals' device, or a device of its own */
+        float* const pedv[3] = { &in.throttle, &in.brake, &in.clutch };
+        for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
+            const int src = pedal_src(p);
+            if (src < 0) *pedv[p] = pedal(&js, s_rest, s_rest_known, p);
+            else { const XDev* d = &s_xd[src]; *pedv[p] = pedal(d->ok ? &d->js : NULL, d->rest, d->rest_known, p); }
+        }
+    }
+    /* The d-pad: the buttons' device's hat when it has one, else the wheel's. */
+    const DIJOYSTATE2* hjs = (xd_separate(bd) && bd->has_hat) ? bjs : &js;
+    const DWORD pov = hjs ? hjs->rgdwPOV[0] : 0xFFFFFFFFu;
+    in.hat = (LOWORD(pov) == 0xFFFF) ? -1 : (int)(((pov + 2250) / 4500) % 8);
+    if (bjs) {
+        for (int i = 0; i < WHEEL_BTN_COUNT; i++) {
+            const int h = s_map.btn[i];
+            if (h >= 0 && h < 128 && (bjs->rgbButtons[h] & 0x80)) in.buttons |= 1u << i;
+        }
+        if (in.hat < 0) {   /* the d-pad on buttons (PS3_WHEEL_BUTTONS=up=7,...) */
+            int on[4];
+            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
+                const int h = s_map.dpad[d];
+                on[d] = h >= 0 && h < 128 && (bjs->rgbButtons[h] & 0x80);
+            }
+            in.hat = hat_from(on[1] - on[3], on[2] - on[0]);
+        }
+        /* pedals on buttons (PS3_WHEEL_BUTTONS=brake=4) */
+        float* const pv[3] = { &in.throttle, &in.brake, &in.clutch };
+        for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
+            const int h = s_map.pbtn[p];
+            if (h >= 0 && h < 128 && (bjs->rgbButtons[h] & 0x80)) *pv[p] = 1.f;
+        }
+    }
+    menu_dpad(&in);
+    if (in.buttons & (0x7Fu << WHEEL_BTN_GEAR1)) s_shifter_seen = 1;
+    in.shifter = s_shifter_cfg >= 0 ? s_shifter_cfg : s_shifter_seen;
+    publish(&in);
+
+    if (wheel_trace_on()) {
+        static LONG last[AX_COUNT], plast[XD_COUNT][AX_COUNT]; static DWORD last_b; static unsigned lines;
+        int moved = 0;
+        for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT; a++) if (labs(axis_val(&js, a) - last[a]) > 2000) moved = 1;
+        /* the pedals' devices' axes, printed too */
+        for (int x = 0; x < XD_COUNT; x++)
+            if (xd_is_pedal(x) && xd_separate(&s_xd[x]) && s_xd[x].ok)
+                for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT; a++) if (labs(axis_val(&s_xd[x].js, a) - plast[x][a]) > 2000) moved = 1;
+        if ((moved || in.buttons != last_b) && lines < 3000) {
+            lines++;
+            for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT; a++) last[a] = axis_val(&js, a);
+            last_b = in.buttons;
+            char pax[480] = ""; int pn = 0;
+            for (int x = 0; x < XD_COUNT; x++) {
+                const XDev* d = &s_xd[x];
+                if (!xd_is_pedal(x) || !xd_separate(d) || !d->ok || pn >= (int)sizeof pax - 120) continue;
+                for (int a = 0; a < AX_COUNT; a++) plast[x][a] = axis_val(&d->js, a);
+                pn += snprintf(pax + pn, sizeof pax - (size_t)pn, " | %s' device X=%ld Y=%ld Z=%ld RX=%ld RY=%ld RZ=%ld S0=%ld S1=%ld",
+                               d->what, d->js.lX, d->js.lY, d->js.lZ, d->js.lRx, d->js.lRy, d->js.lRz, d->js.rglSlider[0], d->js.rglSlider[1]);
+            }
+            fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] axes X=%ld Y=%ld Z=%ld RX=%ld RY=%ld RZ=%ld S0=%ld S1=%ld%s"
+                            " -> steer %.2f thr %.2f brk %.2f clu %.2f btn %06X hat %d\n",
+                    js.lX, js.lY, js.lZ, js.lRx, js.lRy, js.lRz, js.rglSlider[0], js.rglSlider[1], pax,
+                    in.steer, in.throttle, in.brake, in.clutch, (unsigned)in.buttons, in.hat);
+        }
+        /* Every 10 s: what the PC wheel did, so a log shows whether it kept moving when the
+         * game's car didn't. */
+        static ULONGLONG from; static unsigned polls, stat_lines;
+        static float lo, hi, thr, brk;
+        const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
+        if (!from || !polls) { from = from ? from : now; lo = hi = in.steer; thr = brk = 0.f; }
+        polls++;
+        if (in.steer < lo) lo = in.steer;
+        if (in.steer > hi) hi = in.steer;
+        if (in.throttle > thr) thr = in.throttle;
+        if (in.brake > brk) brk = in.brake;
+        if (now - from >= 10000) {
+            if (stat_lines++ < 360)
+                fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] in %llu s: %u reads of the PC wheel, steer %.2f to %.2f, throttle up to %.2f, "
+                                "brake up to %.2f\n", (now - from) / 1000, polls, lo, hi, thr, brk);
+            from = now; polls = 0;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * Force feedback: one DirectInput effect per G27 slot, plus the default spring
+ * -------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
+typedef struct {
+    LPDIRECTINPUTEFFECT fx;
+    int         type;
+    int         running;
+    WheelEffect applied;
+} HostFx;
+
+static HostFx s_fx[WHEEL_FFB_SLOTS + 1];
+static int    s_fx_bad[16];   /* a type this wheel refused */
+
+static void fx_release_all(void)
+{
+    for (int i = 0; i <= WHEEL_FFB_SLOTS; i++) {
+        if (s_fx[i].fx) {
+            IDirectInputEffect_Stop(s_fx[i].fx);
+            IDirectInputEffect_Unload(s_fx[i].fx);
+            IDirectInputEffect_Release(s_fx[i].fx);
+        }
+        memset(&s_fx[i], 0, sizeof s_fx[i]);
+    }
+    memset(s_fx_bad, 0, sizeof s_fx_bad);
+}
+
+static const GUID* fx_guid(int type)
+{
+    switch (type) {
+    case WHEEL_FX_CONSTANT: return &GUID_ConstantForce;
+    case WHEEL_FX_SPRING:   return &GUID_Spring;
+    case WHEEL_FX_DAMPER:   return &GUID_Damper;
+    case WHEEL_FX_FRICTION: return &GUID_Friction;
+    case WHEEL_FX_SQUARE:   return &GUID_Square;
+    case WHEEL_FX_SAW_UP:   return &GUID_SawtoothUp;
+    case WHEEL_FX_SAW_DOWN: return &GUID_SawtoothDown;
+    case WHEEL_FX_TRIANGLE: return &GUID_Triangle;
+    default:                return NULL;
+    }
+}
+
+static LONG di_signed(float f) { if (f < -1.f) f = -1.f; if (f > 1.f) f = 1.f; return (LONG)(f * 10000.f); }
+static DWORD di_unsigned(float f) { if (f < 0.f) f = 0.f; if (f > 1.f) f = 1.f; return (DWORD)(f * 10000.f); }
+
+typedef union { DICONSTANTFORCE c; DICONDITION cond; DIPERIODIC p; } FxParams;
+
+static void fx_describe(const WheelEffect* w, DIEFFECT* eff, FxParams* prm, DWORD* axes, LONG* dir)
+{
+    memset(eff, 0, sizeof *eff);
+    memset(prm, 0, sizeof *prm);
+    axes[0] = DIJOFS_X;
+    dir[0] = 0;   /* one axis: the sign of the force is the direction */
+    eff->dwSize = sizeof(DIEFFECT);
+    eff->dwFlags = DIEFF_CARTESIAN | DIEFF_OBJECTOFFSETS;
+    eff->dwDuration = INFINITE;
+    eff->dwGain = DI_FFNOMINALMAX;
+    eff->dwTriggerButton = DIEB_NOTRIGGER;
+    eff->cAxes = 1;
+    eff->rgdwAxes = axes;
+    eff->rglDirection = dir;
+    switch (w->type) {
+    case WHEEL_FX_CONSTANT:
+        prm->c.lMagnitude = di_signed(w->level * s_ffb_sign);
+        eff->cbTypeSpecificParams = sizeof(DICONSTANTFORCE);
+        break;
+    case WHEEL_FX_SPRING:
+    case WHEEL_FX_DAMPER:
+    case WHEEL_FX_FRICTION:
+        prm->cond.lOffset = di_signed(w->center);
+        prm->cond.lPositiveCoefficient = di_signed(w->k_pos);
+        prm->cond.lNegativeCoefficient = di_signed(w->k_neg);
+        prm->cond.dwPositiveSaturation = di_unsigned(w->sat);
+        prm->cond.dwNegativeSaturation = di_unsigned(w->sat);
+        prm->cond.lDeadBand = (LONG)di_unsigned(w->deadband);
+        eff->cbTypeSpecificParams = sizeof(DICONDITION);
+        break;
+    default: {
+        u32 period = w->period_ms;
+        if (period < 4) period = 4;
+        if (period > 2000) period = 2000;
+        prm->p.dwMagnitude = di_unsigned(w->magnitude);
+        prm->p.lOffset = di_signed(w->offset * s_ffb_sign);
+        prm->p.dwPeriod = period * 1000;
+        eff->cbTypeSpecificParams = sizeof(DIPERIODIC);
+        break; }
+    }
+    eff->lpvTypeSpecificParams = prm;
+}
+
+static void fx_sync_one(HostFx* h, const WheelEffect* w, int force)
+{
+    const int on = w->playing && w->type != WHEEL_FX_NONE && !s_fx_bad[w->type & 15];
+    if (!on) {
+        if (h->fx && h->running) { IDirectInputEffect_Stop(h->fx); h->running = 0; }
+        return;
+    }
+    if (h->fx && h->type != w->type) {
+        IDirectInputEffect_Stop(h->fx);
+        IDirectInputEffect_Unload(h->fx);
+        IDirectInputEffect_Release(h->fx);
+        memset(h, 0, sizeof *h);
+    }
+    DIEFFECT eff; FxParams prm; DWORD axes[1]; LONG dir[1];
+    fx_describe(w, &eff, &prm, axes, dir);
+    if (!h->fx) {
+        HRESULT hr = IDirectInputDevice8_CreateEffect(s_dev, fx_guid(w->type), &eff, &h->fx, NULL);
+        if (FAILED(hr) || !h->fx) {
+            h->fx = NULL;
+            if (hr == DIERR_NOTEXCLUSIVEACQUIRED || hr == DIERR_NOTACQUIRED || hr == DIERR_INPUTLOST) {
+                s_ffb_dirty = 2;                     /* not ours right now: try again shortly */
+                s_ffb_retry_at = GetTickCount64() + 100;
+                return;
+            }
+            fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] this wheel refused effect type %d (0x%08lX); skipping it\n",
+                    w->type, (unsigned long)hr);
+            s_fx_bad[w->type & 15] = 1;
+            return;
+        }
+        h->type = w->type;
+        IDirectInputEffect_Start(h->fx, 1, 0);
+        h->running = 1;
+        h->applied = *w;
+        return;
+    }
+    if (force || !h->running || memcmp(&h->applied, w, sizeof *w) != 0) {
+        DWORD flags = DIEP_TYPESPECIFICPARAMS | (h->running && !force ? 0 : DIEP_START);
+        HRESULT hr = IDirectInputEffect_SetParameters(h->fx, &eff, flags);
+        if (FAILED(hr)) {   /* not acquired (another program has the wheel?): try again shortly */
+            s_ffb_dirty = 2;
+            s_ffb_retry_at = GetTickCount64() + 100;
+            return;
+        }
+        h->running = 1;
+        h->applied = *w;
+    }
+}
+
+static void ffb_sync(void)
+{
+    if (s_ffb_retry_at && GetTickCount64() < s_ffb_retry_at) return;
+    s_ffb_retry_at = 0;
+    const LONG d = InterlockedExchange(&s_ffb_dirty, 0);
+    if (!d || !s_has_ffb) return;
+    WheelFfb f;
+    wheel_g27_ffb_snapshot(&f);
+    for (int i = 0; i < WHEEL_FFB_SLOTS; i++) fx_sync_one(&s_fx[i], &f.slot[i], d == 2);
+    WheelEffect ds = f.def_spring;
+    ds.playing = f.def_spring_on;
+    if (!ds.type) ds.type = WHEEL_FX_SPRING;
+    fx_sync_one(&s_fx[WHEEL_FFB_SLOTS], &ds, d == 2);
+}
+
+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * Mouse steering (PS3_MOUSE_STEER=1), GitHub #37
+ *
+ * The G27 steered with the mouse, as in PC racing games. In a race, moving the mouse sideways
+ * turns the rim: raw mouse counts (so Windows' pointer speed and acceleration don't change it)
+ * into the G27's 14-bit rim position, so even a small movement steers. The left button is the
+ * throttle, the right one the brake, the middle one puts the rim straight; the keyboard and a
+ * pad keep working alongside (Cross still accelerates). While it steers, the cursor is hidden
+ * and kept inside the window, so a click can't land on another program.
+ * At the game's menus and while it's paused (GT5 plays its menu centring spring then, see
+ * wheel_g27_in_menus) the mouse steers nothing and the cursor is free: the menus work as
+ * before, with the keyboard or a pad, and the left button presses Cross, the right Circle and the
+ * wheel the d-pad's up/down (PS3_MOUSE_MENU=0: not; asked for by Arpadiam). The same, without the
+ * buttons, while another window (or the game's Quit box) is in front, so Alt+Tab lets go of the
+ * mouse at any time.
+ * The pad's left stick was tried as well (16 Nov 2026), and the same steering in a race reached
+ * the car both ways, but the stick has 256 steps to the G27's 16,384, no way to tell a race from
+ * the menus (where a deflected stick moves GT5's menu cursor) and no pedals for the buttons.
+ *
+ *   PS3_MOUSE_STEER         1 = on (off by default).
+ *   PS3_MOUSE_STEER_SENS    percent, 100: full lock (the G27's 450 degrees) is 2000 mouse counts
+ *                           from the centre, about the width of a 1920-pixel screen at Windows'
+ *                           default pointer speed. 200 = twice as quick, 2.5 = forty times slower
+ *                           (1 to 1000, decimals allowed; asked for by Arpadiam). GT5 turns hard on little
+ *                           rim (a tenth of lock swung a Fiat 500 across a lane at 45 mph), so
+ *                           1000 counts, tried first, made a few millimetres of mouse a big turn.
+ *   PS3_MOUSE_STEER_CENTER  0 (default): the rim stays where the mouse left it. N: once the mouse
+ *                           stops (150 ms), the rim goes back to the centre at N% of full lock a second.
+ *   PS3_MOUSE_STEER_TEST_FILE (tests): a virtual mouse instead of the real one, which is left alone,
+ *                           cursor included, and the window needn't be in front. A test writes
+ *                           "<what> <ms>" there, as for PS3_WHEEL_VIRTUAL_FILE: "move=300 500" moves
+ *                           the mouse 300 counts right over 500 ms, "left 2000" holds a button
+ *                           (left, right, middle), "wheel=-2" turns the wheel two notches
+ *                           towards you, '+' joins them: "move=-200+left 1000".
+ * -------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
+static float s_ms_counts = 2000.f;  /* mouse counts from the centre to full lock */
+static float s_ms_center;           /* back to the centre, in full locks a second (0 = never) */
+static LONG  s_ms_dx;               /* raw counts not taken yet (the mouse thread only) */
+static LONG  s_ms_abs_x;            /* a mouse that reports positions (a tablet, a remote desktop) */
+static int   s_ms_abs_have;
+static LONG  s_ms_wheel;            /* wheel turned, not taken yet (WHEEL_DELTA a notch, + = away) */
+void cellPad_set_mouse_buttons(unsigned btns);   /* cellPad.c: pad buttons the mouse presses at the menus */
+
+static LRESULT CALLBACK mouse_raw_proc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l)
+{
+    if (m == WM_INPUT) {
+        RAWINPUT ri;
+        UINT sz = sizeof ri;
+        if (GetRawInputData((HRAWINPUT)l, RID_INPUT, &ri, &sz, sizeof(RAWINPUTHEADER)) != (UINT)-1 &&
+            ri.header.dwType == RIM_TYPEMOUSE) {
+            const RAWMOUSE* r = &ri.data.mouse;
+            if (r->usFlags & MOUSE_MOVE_ABSOLUTE) {
+                /* Positions over the screen, 0-65535: the step is the change, in pixels. */
+                const int cx = GetSystemMetrics((r->usFlags & MOUSE_VIRTUAL_DESKTOP) ? SM_CXVIRTUALSCREEN : SM_CXSCREEN);
+                if (s_ms_abs_have) s_ms_dx += (LONG)((double)(r->lLastX - s_ms_abs_x) * (double)cx / 65535.0);
+                s_ms_abs_x = r->lLastX;
+                s_ms_abs_have = 1;
+            } else {
+                s_ms_dx += r->lLastX;
+            }
+            if (r->usButtonFlags & RI_MOUSE_WHEEL) s_ms_wheel += (SHORT)r->usButtonData;
+        }
+    }
+    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
+}
+
+/* The game's own window in front: not its Quit or text-entry box, nor another program. */
+static HWND game_window_in_front(void)
+{
+    if (gt5_menu_input_captured()) return NULL;   /* the in-game menu has the mouse: nothing steers, the cursor is free */
+    HWND fg = GetForegroundWindow();
+    DWORD pid = 0;
+    char cls[64] = "";
+    if (!fg) return NULL;
+    GetWindowThreadProcessId(fg, &pid);
+    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId()) return NULL;
+    GetClassNameA(fg, cls, sizeof cls);
+    return (!strcmp(cls, "ps3recomp_null") || !strcmp(cls, "ps3recomp_d3d12") || !strcmp(cls, "SDL_app")) ? fg : NULL;
+}
+
+/* Only the game window's own thread can take the cursor away (on WM_SETCURSOR), so that window
+ * gets a window procedure in front of its own that sets no cursor while the mouse steers. */
+static HWND          s_cur_hwnd;
+static WNDPROC       s_cur_next;
+static int           s_cur_wide;
+static volatile LONG s_cur_hide;
+
+static LRESULT CALLBACK cursor_proc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l)
+{
+    if (m == WM_SETCURSOR && LOWORD(l) == HTCLIENT && s_cur_hide) { SetCursor(NULL); return TRUE; }
+    return s_cur_wide ? CallWindowProcW(s_cur_next, h, m, w, l) : CallWindowProcA(s_cur_next, h, m, w, l);
+}
+
+/* While the mouse steers: the cursor hidden over the game window and kept inside it (a click
+ * outside would hand the mouse to another program mid-corner). Otherwise it's left alone. */
+static void cursor_hold(HWND gw, int on)
+{
+    static int clipped;
+    static ULONGLONG clip_at;
+    const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
+    if (s_cur_hwnd && !IsWindow(s_cur_hwnd)) s_cur_hwnd = NULL;   /* gone, and our procedure with it */
+    if (on && gw && !s_cur_hwnd) {
+        s_cur_wide = IsWindowUnicode(gw) ? 1 : 0;
+        s_cur_next = (WNDPROC)(s_cur_wide ? GetWindowLongPtrW(gw, GWLP_WNDPROC) : GetWindowLongPtrA(gw, GWLP_WNDPROC));
+        if (s_cur_next) {
+            if (s_cur_wide) SetWindowLongPtrW(gw, GWLP_WNDPROC, (LONG_PTR)cursor_proc);
+            else            SetWindowLongPtrA(gw, GWLP_WNDPROC, (LONG_PTR)cursor_proc);
+            s_cur_hwnd = gw;
+        }
+    }
+    const LONG hide = on && gw && gw == s_cur_hwnd;
+    if (InterlockedExchange(&s_cur_hide, hide) != hide && s_cur_hwnd) {
+        /* Now rather than at the next mouse movement, if the cursor is over the window. */
+        POINT pt;
+        if (GetCursorPos(&pt) && WindowFromPoint(pt) == s_cur_hwnd)
+            PostMessageW(s_cur_hwnd, WM_SETCURSOR, (WPARAM)s_cur_hwnd, MAKELPARAM(HTCLIENT, WM_MOUSEMOVE));
+    }
+    if (on && gw) {
+        if (!clipped || now - clip_at >= 250) {   /* Windows drops a clip now and then: renew it */
+            RECT r;
+            POINT o = { 0, 0 };
+            if (GetClientRect(gw, &r) && ClientToScreen(gw, &o) && r.right > 0 && r.bottom > 0) {
+                OffsetRect(&r, o.x, o.y);
+                ClipCursor(&r);
+                clipped = 1;
+                clip_at = now;
+            }
+        }
+    } else if (clipped) {
+        ClipCursor(NULL);
+        clipped = 0;
+    }
+}
+
+/* PS3_MOUSE_STEER_TEST_FILE: the virtual mouse's current command. */
+typedef struct {
+    LONG      move, given;   /* counts to move in all, and moved so far */
+    ULONGLONG from, until;
+    int       buttons;       /* 1 left, 2 right, 4 middle, held until `until` */
+} MsVirtual;
+
+static void ms_virtual_poll(const char* vf, MsVirtual* v, ULONGLONG now)
+{
+    if (now >= v->until) {
+        if (v->given != v->move) { s_ms_dx += v->move - v->given; v->given = v->move; }
+        v->buttons = 0;
+        FILE* f = fopen(vf, "rb");
+        if (f) {
+            char line[96] = "", what[64] = "";
+            int ms = 150;
+            const int got = fgets(line, sizeof line, f) != NULL;
+            fclose(f);
+            if (got && sscanf(line, "%63s %d", what, &ms) >= 1 && *what) {
+                f = fopen(vf, "wb");
+                if (f) fclose(f);
+                lower(what);
+                memset(v, 0, sizeof *v);
+                int known = 0;
+                for (char* w = what; w && *w; ) {
+                    char* plus = strchr(w, '+');
+                    if (plus) *plus = 0;
+                    if (!strncmp(w, "move=", 5))   { v->move = atol(w + 5); known = 1; }
+                    else if (!strcmp(w, "left"))   { v->buttons |= 1; known = 1; }
+                    else if (!strcmp(w, "right"))  { v->buttons |= 2; known = 1; }
+                    else if (!strcmp(w, "middle")) { v->buttons |= 4; known = 1; }
+                    else if (!strncmp(w, "wheel=", 6)) { s_ms_wheel += atol(w + 6) * WHEEL_DELTA; known = 1; }
+                    else if (!strcmp(w, "none"))   known = 1;
+                    if (plus) *plus = '+';
+                    w = plus ? plus + 1 : NULL;
+                }
+                if (ms < 1) ms = 1;
+                if (!known) { v->move = 0; v->buttons = 0; }
+                v->from = now;
+                v->until = known ? now + (ULONGLONG)ms : now;
+                fprintf(stderr, "[mouse] virtual: %s for %d ms%s\n", what, ms, known ? "" : " (unknown, ignored)");
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    if (now < v->until && v->move) {   /* spread over the time, as a hand moves a mouse */
+        const LONG target = (LONG)((double)v->move * (double)(now - v->from) / (double)(v->until - v->from));
+        s_ms_dx += target - v->given;
+        v->given = target;
+    }
+}
+
+/* PS3_MOUSE_STEER_SENS and PS3_MOUSE_STEER_CENTER, from the settings registry: at the start and again
+ * whenever the in-game menu changed them. Decimals too ("2.5", or "2,5": the registry reads numbers
+ * by hand, so the locale's decimal mark doesn't matter). */
+static void ms_read_settings(float* sens_out, int* ctr_out)
+{
+    float sens = (float)gt5_setting_float("PS3_MOUSE_STEER_SENS", 100.0);
+    if (!(sens == sens)) sens = 100.f;
+    if (sens < 1.f) sens = 1.f;
+    if (sens > 1000.f) sens = 1000.f;
+    s_ms_counts = 2000.f * 100.f / sens;
+    int ctr = gt5_setting_int("PS3_MOUSE_STEER_CENTER", 0);
+    if (ctr < 0) ctr = 0;
+    if (ctr > 1000) ctr = 1000;
+    s_ms_center = (float)ctr / 100.f;
+    if (sens_out) *sens_out = sens;
+    if (ctr_out) *ctr_out = ctr;
+}
+
+static DWORD mouse_thread(void)
+{
+    const char* e;
+    float sens;
+    int ctr;
+    ms_read_settings(&sens, &ctr);
+    const char* vf = getenv("PS3_MOUSE_STEER_TEST_FILE");
+    const int test = vf && *vf;
+    e = getenv("PS3_MOUSE_MENU");
+    const int menu_mouse = !(e && *e == '0');
+
+    WNDCLASSEXW wc;
+    memset(&wc, 0, sizeof wc);
+    wc.cbSize = sizeof wc;
+    wc.lpfnWndProc = mouse_raw_proc;
+    wc.hInstance = GetModuleHandleW(NULL);
+    wc.lpszClassName = L"ps3recomp_mouse";
+    RegisterClassExW(&wc);
+    HWND mw = CreateWindowExW(0, wc.lpszClassName, L"", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, HWND_MESSAGE, NULL, wc.hInstance, NULL);
+    if (!test) {
+        /* Raw input, delivered even while another window is in front (INPUTSINK); it's only used
+         * while the game is. */
+        RAWINPUTDEVICE rid;
+        rid.usUsagePage = 0x01;   /* generic desktop: mouse */
+        rid.usUsage = 0x02;
+        rid.dwFlags = RIDEV_INPUTSINK;
+        rid.hwndTarget = mw;
+        if (!mw || !RegisterRawInputDevices(&rid, 1, sizeof rid))
+            fprintf(stderr, "[mouse] can't read the mouse (raw input, error %lu): it won't steer\n", GetLastError());
+    }
+    char ctr_txt[48] = "off";
+    if (ctr) snprintf(ctr_txt, sizeof ctr_txt, "%d%% of full lock a second", ctr);
+    fprintf(stderr, "[mouse] mouse steering on: in races the mouse steers the emulated G27, full lock %.0f counts "
+                    "from the centre (PS3_MOUSE_STEER_SENS=%g), self-centring %s; left button throttle, right brake, "
+                    "middle straightens the wheel. Not at the game's menus%s\n",
+            s_ms_counts, sens, ctr_txt, test ? "; a test's virtual mouse (PS3_MOUSE_STEER_TEST_FILE)" : "");
+
+    WheelInput in;
+    memset(&in, 0, sizeof in);
+    in.connected = 1;
+    in.hat = -1;
+    in.steer_g27 = 1;
+    publish(&in);
+    MsVirtual v;
+    memset(&v, 0, sizeof v);
+    float steer = 0.f, logged = 0.f;
+    int seen_menus = 0, was = -1, logged_btn = 0;
+    unsigned said = 0, lines = 0, stat_lines = 0;
+    ULONGLONG prev = GetTickCount64(), moved_at = 0, stat_from = 0;
+    LONG stat_counts = 0;
+    float stat_lo = 0.f, stat_hi = 0.f;
+    unsigned stat_n = 0, stat_thr = 0, stat_brk = 0;
+    int mm_at = 0, mm_held = 0, mm_tap = 0;           /* the mouse at the menus, see below */
+    unsigned mm_pad = 0;
+    LONG mm_wheel = 0;
+    ULONGLONG mm_since = 0, mm_tap_end = 0, mm_next = 0;
+    while (!s_stop) {
+        MSG msg;
+        while (PeekMessageW(&msg, NULL, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) DispatchMessageW(&msg);
+        const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
+        { static unsigned set_gen;
+          if (set_gen != gt5_settings_gen()) { set_gen = gt5_settings_gen(); ms_read_settings(NULL, NULL); } }
+        if (test) ms_virtual_poll(vf, &v, now);
+        const LONG dx = s_ms_dx;
+        s_ms_dx = 0;
+        HWND gw = test ? NULL : game_window_in_front();
+        const int menus = wheel_g27_in_menus();
+        if (menus) seen_menus = 1;
+        const int front = test || gw != NULL;
+        /* Before the game's driver has taken the G27 it plays no spring yet: that isn't a race. */
+        const int steering = front && !menus && seen_menus;
+        if (steering != was) {
+            if (said < 200) {
+                said++;
+                if (steering)
+                    fprintf(stderr, "[mouse] in a race with the game in front: the mouse steers%s\n",
+                            test ? "" : " (cursor hidden and kept in the window)");
+                else
+                    fprintf(stderr, "[mouse] not steering: %s\n",
+                            !front ? "another window is in front" : menus ? "at the game's menus or paused"
+                                                                          : "the game hasn't taken the wheel yet");
+            }
+            was = steering;
+            steer = 0.f;   /* each race, and each return from the menus or another window, starts straight */
+        }
+        const float dt = (float)(now - prev) / 1000.f;
+        prev = now;
+        int buttons = 0;
+        if (steering) {
+            if (dx) { steer += (float)dx / s_ms_counts; moved_at = now; }
+            if (steer > 1.f) steer = 1.f;
+            if (steer < -1.f) steer = -1.f;
+            buttons = test ? v.buttons
+                           : ((GetAsyncKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) & 0x8000) ? 1 : 0) |
+                             ((GetAsyncKeyState(VK_RBUTTON) & 0x8000) ? 2 : 0) |
+                             ((GetAsyncKeyState(VK_MBUTTON) & 0x8000) ? 4 : 0);
+            if (buttons & 4) steer = 0.f;
+            if (s_ms_center > 0.f && !dx && now - moved_at >= 150) {
+                const float step = s_ms_center * dt;
+                steer = steer > step ? steer - step : steer < -step ? steer + step : 0.f;
+            }
+        } else {
+            steer = 0.f;
+        }
+        in.steer = steer;
+        in.throttle = (buttons & 1) ? 1.f : 0.f;
+        in.brake = (buttons & 2) ? 1.f : 0.f;
+        publish(&in);
+        if (!test) cursor_hold(gw, steering);
+
+        /* The mouse at the menus and the pause screen (PS3_MOUSE_MENU=0: not): the left button
+         * presses Cross, the right Circle, and each notch of the wheel taps the d-pad up or down.
+         * A button already held when the menus come up or the window comes to the front (the click
+         * that brought it there, the throttle at a race's end) counts only once it's let go. */
+        if (menu_mouse) {
+            const int at = front && menus;
+            const int b = !front ? 0 : test ? (v.buttons & 3)
+                        : ((GetAsyncKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) & 0x8000) ? 1 : 0) | ((GetAsyncKeyState(VK_RBUTTON) & 0x8000) ? 2 : 0);
+            if (at && (!mm_at || now - mm_since < 300)) mm_held |= b;   /* also a click just after the switch */
+            if (at && !mm_at) mm_since = now;
+            mm_held &= b;
+            mm_at = at;
+            mm_wheel += s_ms_wheel;
+            s_ms_wheel = 0;
+            unsigned pad = 0;
+            if (at) {
+                if ((b & 1) && !(mm_held & 1)) pad |= 1u << 14;   /* CELL_PAD_CTRL_CROSS */
+                if ((b & 2) && !(mm_held & 2)) pad |= 1u << 13;   /* CELL_PAD_CTRL_CIRCLE */
+                if (!mm_tap && now >= mm_next && (mm_wheel >= WHEEL_DELTA || mm_wheel <= -WHEEL_DELTA)) {
+                    mm_tap = mm_wheel > 0 ? 1 : -1;               /* away from you = up */
+                    mm_wheel -= mm_tap * WHEEL_DELTA;
+                    mm_tap_end = now + 80;
+                }
+                if (mm_tap) {
+                    pad |= mm_tap > 0 ? 1u << 4 : 1u << 6;        /* CELL_PAD_CTRL_UP / DOWN */
+                    if (now >= mm_tap_end) { mm_tap = 0; mm_next = now + 70; }
+                }
+            } else {
+                mm_wheel = 0;
+                mm_tap = 0;
+            }
+            if (pad != mm_pad && (wheel_trace_on() || test) && lines < 5000) {
+                lines++;
+                fprintf(stderr, "[mouse] t=%llu at the menus: pad%s%s%s%s\n", now, pad ? "" : " nothing",
+                        (pad & (1u << 14)) ? " cross" : "", (pad & (1u << 13)) ? " circle" : "",
+                        (pad & (1u << 4)) ? " up" : (pad & (1u << 6)) ? " down" : "");
+            }
+            mm_pad = pad;
+            cellPad_set_mouse_buttons(pad);
+        }
+
+        /* PS3_WHEEL_TRACE (and tests): each change, and every 10 s what the mouse did. */
+        if ((wheel_trace_on() || test) && steering) {
+            if ((fabsf(steer - logged) >= 0.01f || (buttons & 3) != logged_btn) && lines < 5000) {
+                lines++;
+                logged = steer;
+                logged_btn = buttons & 3;
+                fprintf(stderr, "[mouse] t=%llu steer %+.3f (G27 %d)%s%s\n", now, steer,
+                        0x2000 + (int)(steer * 8192.f), (buttons & 1) ? " throttle" : "", (buttons & 2) ? " brake" : "");
+            }
+            if (!stat_from) { stat_from = now; stat_lo = stat_hi = steer; }
+            stat_counts += dx < 0 ? -dx : dx;
+            stat_n++;
+            stat_thr += buttons & 1;
+            stat_brk += (buttons >> 1) & 1;
+            if (steer < stat_lo) stat_lo = steer;
+            if (steer > stat_hi) stat_hi = steer;
+            if (now - stat_from >= 10000) {
+                if (stat_lines++ < 360)
+                    fprintf(stderr, "[mouse] in %llu s: %ld counts of movement, steer %+.2f to %+.2f, throttle held %u%%, "
+                                    "brake %u%%\n", (now - stat_from) / 1000, (long)stat_counts, stat_lo, stat_hi,
+                            stat_n ? stat_thr * 100 / stat_n : 0, stat_n ? stat_brk * 100 / stat_n : 0);
+                stat_from = 0; stat_counts = 0; stat_n = stat_thr = stat_brk = 0;
+            }
+        }
+        MsgWaitForMultipleObjects(0, NULL, FALSE, 2, QS_ALLINPUT);
+    }
+    if (!test) cursor_hold(NULL, 0);
+    if (mw) DestroyWindow(mw);
+    return 0;
+}
+
+/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ * Thread
+ * -------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
+static LRESULT CALLBACK helper_proc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) { return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l); }
+
+/* Force feedback strength and direction, from the settings registry: on the wheel's thread, whenever
+ * the in-game menu changed them. A wheel that was opened without effects (strength 0) is opened again
+ * with them when the strength comes up. */
+static void ffb_settings_follow(void)
+{
+    int gain = gt5_setting_int("PS3_WHEEL_FFB", 100);
+    if (gain < 0) gain = 0;
+    if (gain > 100) gain = 100;
+    const float sign = gt5_setting_int("PS3_WHEEL_FFB_INVERT", 0) == 1 ? -1.f : 1.f;
+    if (gain != s_gain) {
+        const int was = s_gain;
+        s_gain = gain;
+        fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] force feedback strength %d%%\n", s_gain);
+        if (s_dev) {
+            if (s_has_ffb) set_prop_dword(DIPROP_FFGAIN, DIPH_DEVICE, 0, (DWORD)s_gain * 100);
+            else if (!was && gain) dev_close("force feedback switched on");
+        }
+    }
+    if (sign != s_ffb_sign) {
+        s_ffb_sign = sign;
+        fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] force feedback direction %s\n", sign < 0.f ? "inverted" : "normal");
+        wheel_host_ffb_changed();   /* the effects are sent again */
+    }
+}
+
+static DWORD WINAPI wheel_thread(LPVOID unused)
+{
+    (void)unused;
+    /* The game's threads keep every core busy on a small PC, some of them above normal
+     * priority; this one must still read the wheel every millisecond or two. Its work per
+     * read is a few microseconds, then it sleeps. */
+    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_HIGHEST);
+    if (s_mode == MODE_MOUSE) return mouse_thread();
+    if (s_mode == MODE_VIRTUAL) {
+        /* For testing the game side: PS3_WHEEL_VIRTUAL=steer=0.5,throttle=1
+         * holds the rim and pedals where it says, from DELAY seconds on.
+         * PS3_WHEEL_VIRTUAL_FILE=<path>: a test writes "<what> <ms>" there, e.g.
+         * "cross 200", "up 150" (the d-pad: up/down/left/right), "steer=-0.8 600",
+         * "throttle=1 300", and the wheel does that for that long; the file is
+         * emptied when it is taken. nohat=1 in PS3_WHEEL_VIRTUAL plays a wheel
+         * with no d-pad (as most cheap wheels are), jitter=1 a rim that never
+         * rests (see below). */
+        WheelInput in; memset(&in, 0, sizeof in);
+        in.connected = 1; in.hat = -1; in.shifter = s_shifter_cfg > 0;
+        publish(&in);
+        const char* v = getenv("PS3_WHEEL_VIRTUAL");
+        const char* vf = getenv("PS3_WHEEL_VIRTUAL_FILE");
+        const char* at;
+        float steer = 0.f, thr = 0.f, brk = 0.f;
+        double delay = 0.;
+        if (v && (at = strstr(v, "steer="))) steer = (float)atof(at + 6);
+        if (v && (at = strstr(v, "throttle="))) thr = (float)atof(at + 9);
+        if (v && (at = strstr(v, "brake="))) brk = (float)atof(at + 6);
+        if (v && (at = strstr(v, "delay="))) delay = atof(at + 6);
+        s_has_hat = !(v && strstr(v, "nohat=1"));
+        const int jitter = v && strstr(v, "jitter=1");
+        build_map(&s_map, 0, 0);
+        fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] PS3_WHEEL=virtual: a G27 with no PC wheel behind it (steer %.2f, throttle %.2f, brake %.2f after %.0f s%s)\n",
+                steer, thr, brk, delay, s_has_hat ? "" : ", no d-pad");
+        const ULONGLONG t0 = GetTickCount64();
+        ULONGLONG press_until = 0;
+        WheelInput press; memset(&press, 0, sizeof press);
+        int press_steer = 0, press_thr = 0, press_brk = 0;
+        while (!s_stop) {
+            const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
+            if (vf && *vf && now >= press_until) {
+                FILE* f = fopen(vf, "rb");
+                if (f) {
+                    char line[96] = "";
+                    const int got = fgets(line, sizeof line, f) != NULL;
+                    fclose(f);
+                    char what[48] = ""; int ms = 150;
+                    if (got && sscanf(line, "%47s %d", what, &ms) >= 1 && *what) {
+                        f = fopen(vf, "wb"); if (f) fclose(f);
+                        memset(&press, 0, sizeof press); press.hat = -1;
+                        press_steer = press_thr = press_brk = 0;
+                        s_vbtn = 0;
+                        lower(what);
+                        static const char* const dn[4] = { "up", "right", "down", "left" };
+                        int known = 0;
+                        /* Several at once with '+': "btn6+throttle=0.5 8000". */
+                        for (char* w = what; w && *w; ) {
+                            char* plus = strchr(w, '+');
+                            if (plus) *plus = 0;
+                            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) if (!strcmp(w, dn[d])) { press.hat = d * 2; known = 1; }
+                            for (int i = 0; i < WHEEL_BTN_COUNT; i++)
+                                if (!strcmp(w, k_btn_name[i])) { press.buttons |= 1u << i; known = 1; }
+                            if (!strncmp(w, "steer=", 6))    { press.steer = (float)atof(w + 6); press_steer = known = 1; }
+                            if (!strncmp(w, "throttle=", 9)) { press.throttle = (float)atof(w + 9); press_thr = known = 1; }
+                            if (!strncmp(w, "brake=", 6))    { press.brake = (float)atof(w + 6); press_brk = known = 1; }
+                            if (!strncmp(w, "btn", 3))       { known = 1; s_vbtn = atoi(w + 3); }   /* "btn7": host button 7 */
+                            if (plus) *plus = '+';
+                            w = plus ? plus + 1 : NULL;
+                        }
+                        press_until = known ? now + (ULONGLONG)(ms > 0 ? ms : 150) : 0;
+                        fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] virtual: %s for %d ms%s\n", what, ms, known ? "" : " (unknown, ignored)");
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+            const int pressing = now < press_until;
+            if (!pressing) s_vbtn = 0;
+            const int held = (double)(now - t0) / 1000.0 >= delay;
+            in.steer = pressing && press_steer ? press.steer : held ? steer : 0.f;
+            in.throttle = pressing && press_thr ? press.throttle : held ? thr : 0.f;
+            in.brake = pressing && press_brk ? press.brake : held ? brk : 0.f;
+            in.buttons = pressing ? press.buttons : 0;
+            in.hat = pressing && s_has_hat ? press.hat : -1;
+            if (s_vbtn) {   /* a host button by number, through the button map */
+                for (int i = 0; i < WHEEL_BTN_COUNT; i++) if (s_map.btn[i] == s_vbtn - 1) in.buttons |= 1u << i;
+                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) if (s_map.dpad[d] == s_vbtn - 1) in.hat = d * 2;
+                if (s_map.pbtn[0] == s_vbtn - 1) in.throttle = 1.f;
+                if (s_map.pbtn[1] == s_vbtn - 1) in.brake = 1.f;
+                if (s_map.pbtn[2] == s_vbtn - 1) in.clutch = 1.f;
+            }
+            /* jitter=1: a real rim never rests on one value, so nearly every report it
+             * sends is new; this wobbles the steering a little every 2 ms to match. */
+            if (jitter) { static int flip; flip ^= 1; in.steer += flip ? 0.004f : -0.004f; }
+            if (in.buttons & (0x7Fu << WHEEL_BTN_GEAR1)) s_shifter_seen = 1;   /* as a real wheel does */
+            in.shifter = s_shifter_cfg >= 0 ? s_shifter_cfg : s_shifter_seen;
+            menu_dpad(&in);
+            publish(&in);
+            Sleep(jitter ? 2 : 10);
+        }
+        return 0;
+    }
+    WNDCLASSEXW wc; memset(&wc, 0, sizeof wc);
+    wc.cbSize = sizeof wc;
+    wc.lpfnWndProc = helper_proc;
+    wc.hInstance = GetModuleHandleW(NULL);
+    wc.lpszClassName = L"ps3recomp_wheel";
+    RegisterClassExW(&wc);
+    s_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, wc.lpszClassName, L"", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, HWND_MESSAGE, NULL, wc.hInstance, NULL);
+    if (FAILED(DirectInput8Create(GetModuleHandleW(NULL), DIRECTINPUT_VERSION, &IID_IDirectInput8W,
+                                  (void**)&s_di, NULL))) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] DirectInput is not available; no wheel\n");
+        return 0;
+    }
+    ULONGLONG next_scan = 0;
+    const ULONGLONG t_start = GetTickCount64();
+    int said_none = 0;
+    while (!s_stop) {
+        const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
+        { static unsigned set_gen;
+          if (set_gen != gt5_settings_gen()) { set_gen = gt5_settings_gen(); ffb_settings_follow(); } }
+        if (!s_dev && now >= next_scan) {
+            /* A wheel plugged in later is found within a few seconds early on,
+             * within ten later; looking costs a little, on this thread only. */
+            next_scan = now + (s_lost_at && now - s_lost_at < 30000 ? 500
+                               : now - t_start < 30000 ? 3000 : 10000);
+            if (dev_open()) said_none = 1;
+            else if (!said_none) {
+                said_none = 1;
+                fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] no steering wheel found; still looking every few seconds\n");
+                /* On the screen only for a player who set a wheel up (named one, or mapped its buttons or
+                 * pedals): with a controller there is nothing to say. */
+                const char* b = getenv("PS3_WHEEL_BUTTONS");
+                const char* p = getenv("PS3_WHEEL_PEDALS");
+                if (s_mode == MODE_MATCH || (b && *b) || (p && *p))
+                    gt5_menu_notice(GT5_NOTICE_WHEEL, "Wheel not found", "未找到方向盘", 8000);
+            }
+        }
+        /* Read every millisecond or so. A long gap between reads: the PC was too busy to run
+         * this thread, or a call into the wheel's driver took that long. */
+        static ULONGLONG prev; static unsigned held_said;
+        if (s_dev) {
+            if (prev && now - prev >= 250 && held_said < 20) {
+                held_said++;
+                fprintf(stderr, "[wheel] %llu ms between two reads of the PC wheel\n", now - prev);
+            }
+            prev = now;
+            dev_poll();
+            if (s_dev) ffb_sync();
+            if (!s_dev) prev = 0;
+        } else prev = 0;
+        MSG msg;
+        while (PeekMessageW(&msg, NULL, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) DispatchMessageW(&msg);
+        Sleep(s_dev ? 1 : 20);
+    }
+    dev_close("shutdown");
+    IDirectInput8_Release(s_di);
+    s_di = NULL;
+    if (s_hwnd) DestroyWindow(s_hwnd);
+    return 0;
+}
+
+int wheel_host_start(void)
+{
+    read_settings();
+    if (s_mode == MODE_OFF) return 0;
+    if (s_started) return 1;
+    s_stop = 0;
+    s_pub.hat = -1;
+    wheel_g27_reset();
+    s_thread = CreateThread(NULL, 256 * 1024, wheel_thread, NULL, 0, NULL);
+    if (!s_thread) return 0;
+    s_started = 1;
+    return 1;
+}
+
+void wheel_host_stop(void)
+{
+    if (!s_started) return;
+    InterlockedExchange(&s_stop, 1);
+    WaitForSingleObject(s_thread, 3000);
+    CloseHandle(s_thread);
+    s_thread = NULL;
+    s_started = 0;
+}
+
+#else  /* !_WIN32: no host wheel yet */
+
+int  wheel_host_start(void) { return 0; }
+void wheel_host_stop(void) {}
+int  wheel_host_read(WheelInput* out) { memset(out, 0, sizeof *out); out->hat = -1; return 0; }
+void wheel_host_ffb_changed(void) {}
+unsigned wheel_host_pad_buttons(void) { return 0; }
+
+#endif
