```ps1
$tmp = Join-Path $gt5 'deps\fsr_build'
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $tmp | Out-Null
Push-Location $tmp
# Nothing of AMD's is linked: the plug-in loads AMD's loader DLL by name when the game starts.
# With the Vulkan headers add_vulkan.ps1 leaves (setup and update run it before this), the plug-in also gets
# its Vulkan part (gt5_upscale_vk.h); nothing of Vulkan is linked either, the game hands its device over.
$vk = @()
$vkInc = Join-Path $gt5 'deps\vulkan\prefix\include'
if ((Test-Path (Join-Path $vkInc 'vulkan\vulkan.h')) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $iface 'gt5_upscale_vk.h'))) {
    $vk = @('/DGT5_UPSCALE_WITH_VK', "/I$vkInc")
    Write-Host '   (with its Vulkan part)'
}
& $cc /nologo /O2 /MD /EHsc /W3 /LD -fuse-ld=lld -Wno-unknown-pragmas -Wno-deprecated-declarations -Wno-missing-braces "/I$incApi" "/I$incFg" "/I$iface" @vk $src "/Fe:$(Join-Path $tmp 'gt5_upscale_fsr.dll')" `
    /link wintrust.lib crypt32.lib advapi32.lib user32.lib
$rc = $LASTEXITCODE
Pop-Location
if ($rc -or -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $tmp 'gt5_upscale_fsr.dll'))) {
    Stop-AddOn 1 'Building the plug-in failed (see above). Nothing else was changed. Please report it with this text.' 'Build failed'
}
# AMD's files first and the plug-in last: the plug-in being there is what says FSR is in.
Send-Add 'build' 92 'Building'
try {
    foreach ($d in $Dlls) { Copy-Item -Force (Join-Path $bin $d.Name) (Join-Path $build $d.Name) -ErrorAction Stop }
    Copy-Item -Force $lic $licOut -ErrorAction Stop
    Copy-Item -Force (Join-Path $tmp 'gt5_upscale_fsr.dll') $plug -ErrorAction Stop
} catch { Stop-AddOn 1 "Copying the files next to the game failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" 'Copy failed' }
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Stop-AddOn 0 'AMD FSR 3 is in. In the game press F1: Display > "Frame generation: how" now offers AMD FSR 3.' 'AMD FSR 3 ready'

```

`GT5/scripts/add_vulkan.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
add_vulkan.ps1: the Vulkan renderer in this PC's gt5.exe. setup.ps1 (so the installer) and update.ps1 run it
with -Prepare before they build the game, so the game is built with both renderers from the start and the
launcher only switches between them. DirectX 12 stays the default and keeps working whatever happens here:
when this can't be done, the game is built with DirectX 12 alone and the launcher doesn't list Vulkan.

Vulkan needs two libraries the game leaves out otherwise: SDL2 (its window) and glslang (turns the game's
shaders into Vulkan's SPIR-V). This fetches their source code at a fixed release with git (about 60 MB),
checks each is exactly that release, builds them into GT5\deps\vulkan with the compiler the game is built
with (a few minutes), and turns Vulkan on in the game's build folder. GT5\CMakeLists.txt also turns it on by
itself in a new build folder when it finds them. build\SDL2.dll next to gt5.exe then says the exe has Vulkan.

  powershell -File GT5\scripts\add_vulkan.ps1 -Prepare           # the libraries, and Vulkan on for the next build
  powershell -File GT5\scripts\add_vulkan.ps1                    # the same, then gt5.exe rebuilt (only the runtime:
                                                                 #   about 10 to 20 minutes)
  powershell -File GT5\scripts\add_vulkan.ps1 -Remove            # gt5.exe rebuilt without it; setup and updates
                                                                 #   leave it out from then on (add it again to undo)
  powershell -File GT5\scripts\add_vulkan.ps1 -Remove -Prepare   # off for the next build only (setup's fallback
                                                                 #   when a build with Vulkan fails)
  -Sdl2Src / -GlslangSrc <folder>: use source code already on this PC (the same releases) instead of git.
  -NoPause: ask nothing, wait for nothing (for programs). Progress: GT5_ADD lines, see addon_common.ps1.
Exit code: 0 done, 1 failed (Vulkan is then off in the build folder, so the game still builds), 2 skipped.
#>
param(
    [switch]$Remove,
    [switch]$Prepare,
    [string]$Sdl2Src = '',
    [string]$GlslangSrc = '',
    [switch]$NoPause
)
# Continue: git and cmake write progress to stderr; each step's exit code says whether it worked.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'addon_common.ps1')
$gt5 = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
Initialize-AddOn $gt5 ([bool]$NoPause)
$build = Join-Path $gt5 'build'
$cache = Join-Path $build 'CMakeCache.txt'
$deps = Join-Path $gt5 'deps\vulkan'
$prefix = Join-Path $deps 'prefix'
# -Remove (without -Prepare) records that this install shouldn't have Vulkan; -Prepare then leaves it out.
$offMark = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $gt5) '.gt5\vulkan-off.txt'

# The releases, by the commit git checks them against, and about how much each clone fills on disk. Skip: a
# folder of the release that isn't fetched (glslang's Test: 2,900 of its 3,100 files, used only by its own
# tests, which are off here; on a slow drive they took longer than all the rest).
$Pins = @(
    @{ Name = 'SDL2 2.32.10'; Dir = 'SDL2-2.32.10'; Url = 'https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL.git'; Tag = 'release-2.32.10'
       Commit = '5d249570393f7a37e037abf22cd6012a4cc56a71'; MB = 85; Skip = '' },
    @{ Name = 'glslang 15.4.0'; Dir = 'glslang-15.4.0'; Url = 'https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang.git'; Tag = '15.4.0'
       Commit = '8a85691a0740d390761a1008b4696f57facd02c4'; MB = 9; Skip = '/Test/' }
)

# Vulkan on or off in the build folder's cache, for its next configure. The cache is edited and build.ninja
# deleted, so build.cmd configures again (keeping everything already compiled that doesn't change). No cache
# yet: nothing to do (a new build folder finds deps\vulkan by itself, see GT5\CMakeLists.txt).
function Get-CacheVulkan {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cache)) { return $null }
    $m = Select-String -LiteralPath $cache -Pattern '^PS3RECOMP_RSX_VULKAN:BOOL=(\w+)' | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $m) { return $null }
    return ($m.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value -match '^(ON|1|TRUE|YES)$')
}
function Set-CacheVulkan([bool]$on) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cache)) { return }
    if ((Get-CacheVulkan) -eq $on) { return }
    $v = if ($on) { 'ON' } else { 'OFF' }
    $text = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($cache)
    if ($text -match '(?m)^PS3RECOMP_RSX_VULKAN:BOOL=') { $text = $text -replace '(?m)^PS3RECOMP_RSX_VULKAN:BOOL=\w+', "PS3RECOMP_RSX_VULKAN:BOOL=$v" }
    else { $text = $text.TrimEnd() + "`r`nPS3RECOMP_RSX_VULKAN:BOOL=$v`r`n" }
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($cache, $text)
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $build 'build.ninja') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Write-Host "Vulkan is $v in the build folder: the next build configures again and builds the runtime with$(if (-not $on) { 'out' }) it."
}
# The libraries are all in deps\vulkan\prefix (the headers are copied last, so their being there means the
# rest is too; the other files are checked as well).
function Test-PrefixDone {
    return (Test-Path (Join-Path $prefix 'bin\SDL2.dll')) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $prefix 'cmake\SDL2Config.cmake')) -and
           (Test-Path (Join-Path $prefix 'lib\cmake\glslang\glslang-config.cmake')) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $prefix 'include\vulkan\vulkan.h'))
}
# A failure: Vulkan off for the next build, so the game still builds with DirectX 12.
function Fail([string]$msg, [string]$words) {
    Set-CacheVulkan $false
    Stop-AddOn 1 "$msg DirectX 12 still works." $words
}

Send-Add 'start' 0 'Vulkan'
if (Test-GameRunning $build) { Stop-AddOn 1 'The game is running: close it first, then run this again.' 'Game running' }

# ---- Off ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Remove) {
    Set-CacheVulkan $false
    if ($Prepare) { Stop-AddOn 0 'Vulkan is off for the next build.' 'Vulkan off' }
    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $build 'build.ninja')) -and -not (Test-Path $cache)) {
        Stop-AddOn 1 "There's no game build in $build yet. Run setup first (setup.bat in the install folder)." 'No game build'
    }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $offMark) | Out-Null
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $offMark -Value "Vulkan taken out with add_vulkan.ps1 -Remove, $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'). Run add_vulkan.ps1 to add it again." -Encoding ascii
    Write-Host '== Building gt5.exe without Vulkan'
    $rc = Invoke-Counted { cmd /c "`"$PSScriptRoot\build.cmd`" gt5" } 'game' 5 99 'Building the game'
    if ($rc) { Stop-AddOn 1 'Building gt5.exe failed (see above).' 'Build failed' }
    Stop-AddOn 0 'gt5.exe is built without Vulkan again (DirectX 12 only). GT5\deps\vulkan can be deleted.' 'Vulkan removed'
}
if ($Prepare -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $offMark)) {
    Set-CacheVulkan $false
    Stop-AddOn 2 "Vulkan was taken out of this install ($offMark): left out. Run add_vulkan.ps1 to add it again." 'Not wanted'
}
if (-not $Prepare -and -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $build 'build.ninja')) -and -not (Test-Path $cache)) {
    Stop-AddOn 1 "There's no game build in $build yet. Run setup first (setup.bat in the install folder)." 'No game build'
}
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $offMark -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# Where each part of the run goes on the bar: -Prepare is the libraries alone; a whole add is mostly the game.
$Bar = if ($Prepare) { @{ F1 = 15; F2 = 30; S = 45; G = 95 } } else { @{ F1 = 8; F2 = 15; S = 25; G = 45 } }

# ---- The libraries, when they aren't all there ----------------------------------------------------------
if (-not (Test-PrefixDone)) {
    $needSdl = -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $prefix 'bin\SDL2.dll')) -or -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $prefix 'cmake\SDL2Config.cmake'))
    $needHeaders = -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $prefix 'include\vulkan\vulkan.h'))
    $needGls = -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $prefix 'lib\cmake\glslang\glslang-config.cmake'))
    if (-not (Import-CompilerEnv $PSScriptRoot)) { Fail "Couldn't set up the compiler (build.cmd's reason is above)." 'No compiler' }
    $cc = $env:CLANGCL
    $toolArgs = @([regex]::Matches([string]$env:TOOLARGS, '"([^"]*)"') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value })
    $jobs = $env:GT5_JOBS
    if (-not $jobs) {
        $ram = [int][math]::Floor((Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem).TotalPhysicalMemory / 2GB)
        $jobs = [math]::Max(1, [math]::Min([int]$env:NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS, $ram))
    }
    $cm = { param($p) $p -replace '\\', '/' }   # CMake wants forward slashes
    $common = @('-G', 'Ninja', '-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release', "-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=$cc", "-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=$cc",
                "-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$(& $cm $prefix)", "-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=$(& $cm $prefix)") + $toolArgs

    # The source code, for what isn't built yet.
    $src = @{}
    $i = 0
    foreach ($p in $Pins) {
        $i++
        $f0 = if ($i -eq 1) { 0 } else { $Bar.F1 }; $f1 = if ($i -eq 1) { $Bar.F1 } else { $Bar.F2 }
        if ($p.Dir -like 'SDL2*') { if (-not ($needSdl -or $needHeaders)) { continue } } elseif (-not $needGls) { continue }
        $given = if ($p.Dir -like 'SDL2*') { $Sdl2Src } else { $GlslangSrc }
        if ($given) {
            if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $given 'CMakeLists.txt'))) { Fail "$given has no CMakeLists.txt: not the $($p.Name) source code." 'Wrong source' }
            $src[$p.Dir] = $given; continue
        }
        $d = Join-Path $deps "src\$($p.Dir)"
        $have = if (Test-Path (Join-Path $d '.git')) { git -C $d rev-parse HEAD 2>$null } else { '' }
        # A checkout cut short (a stop, a full disk) has that commit but not all its files: fetched again.
        if ($have -eq $p.Commit -and ((Test-Path (Join-Path $d '.git\index.lock')) -or (git -C $d status --porcelain --untracked-files=no 2>$null))) { $have = '' }
        if ($have -ne $p.Commit) {
            Remove-Tree $d
            if (Test-Path $d) { Fail "$d couldn't be emptied for a new download (is a file in it open?)." 'Folder in use' }
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $d) | Out-Null
            Write-Host "== Fetching $($p.Name) ($($p.Url))"
            if ($p.Skip) {
                # Nothing checked out until the paths are set; the skipped folder's files are never downloaded.
                $fm = $f0 + ($f1 - $f0) * 0.2
                $rc = Invoke-Fetch @('-c', 'advice.detachedHead=false', 'clone', '--quiet', '--depth', '1', '--branch', $p.Tag, '--filter=blob:none', '--no-checkout', $p.Url, "`"$d`"") $d 2 $f0 $fm 'Downloading'
                if (-not $rc) { Invoke-GitQuiet -C $d sparse-checkout set --no-cone '/*' "!$($p.Skip)"; $rc = $LASTEXITCODE }
                if (-not $rc) { $rc = Invoke-Fetch @('-C', "`"$d`"", '-c', 'advice.detachedHead=false', 'checkout', '--quiet', $p.Tag) $d $p.MB $fm $f1 'Downloading' }
            } else {
                $rc = Invoke-Fetch @('-c', 'advice.detachedHead=false', 'clone', '--quiet', '--depth', '1', '--branch', $p.Tag, $p.Url, "`"$d`"") $d $p.MB $f0 $f1 'Downloading'
            }
            if ($rc) {
                Remove-Tree $d
                Fail "Fetching $($p.Name) failed: check the internet connection and run this again." 'No internet'
            }
            Send-Add 'check' $f1 'Checking'
            $have = git -C $d rev-parse HEAD 2>$null
            if ($have -ne $p.Commit) {
                Remove-Tree $d
                Fail "$($p.Name) isn't the expected release (commit $have, expected $($p.Commit)), so it was deleted. Please report this." 'Unexpected download'
            }
        }
        $src[$p.Dir] = $d
    }
    $sdl = $src['SDL2-2.32.10']; $gls = $src['glslang-15.4.0']

    # SDL2 and glslang, into GT5\deps\vulkan\prefix.
    if ($needSdl) {
        $b = Join-Path $deps 'build\sdl2'
        # SDL_LIBC=ON: with the C runtime. Without it SDL2 builds against no C library at all, and newer
        # clang (Visual Studio 18's clang 22) turns its own string loops into strlen / wcslen calls that
        # then don't link. gt5.exe uses the same C runtime DLLs, so this adds nothing to install.
        Write-Host '== SDL2: configure'
        Send-Add 'build' $Bar.F2 'Building'
        $rc = Invoke-Counted { cmake -S $sdl -B $b @common -DSDL_SHARED=ON -DSDL_STATIC=OFF -DSDL_TEST=OFF -DSDL_LIBC=ON } 'build' $Bar.F2 $Bar.F2 'Building'
        if (-not $rc) { Write-Host "== SDL2: build ($jobs jobs)"; $rc = Invoke-Counted { cmake --build $b --target install -j $jobs } 'build' $Bar.F2 $Bar.S 'Building' }
        if ($rc) { Fail 'Building SDL2 failed (see above).' 'Build failed' }
    }
    if ($needGls) {
        $b = Join-Path $deps 'build\glslang'
        Write-Host '== glslang: configure'
        Send-Add 'build' $Bar.S 'Building'
        $rc = Invoke-Counted { cmake -S $gls -B $b @common -DENABLE_OPT=OFF -DGLSLANG_TESTS=OFF `
            -DENABLE_GLSLANG_BINARIES=OFF -DGLSLANG_ENABLE_INSTALL=ON -DENABLE_HLSL=ON -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF `
            -DBUILD_EXTERNAL=OFF -DENABLE_SPVREMAPPER=OFF } 'build' $Bar.S $Bar.S 'Building'
        if (-not $rc) { Write-Host "== glslang: build ($jobs jobs)"; $rc = Invoke-Counted { cmake --build $b --target install -j $jobs } 'build' $Bar.S $Bar.G 'Building' }
        if ($rc) { Fail 'Building glslang failed (see above).' 'Build failed' }
    }
    # The Vulkan headers: SDL2 carries the Khronos ones. Copied last: GT5's CMakeLists turns Vulkan on for a
    # new build folder when it finds them, and this script takes them as the sign that the rest is there.
    if ($needHeaders) {
        try { Copy-Item -Recurse -Force (Join-Path $sdl 'src\video\khronos\*') (Join-Path $prefix 'include') -ErrorAction Stop }
        catch { Fail "Copying the Vulkan headers failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" 'Build failed' }
    }
    if (-not (Test-PrefixDone)) { Fail "The libraries were built but $prefix is missing some of them. Please report this." 'Build failed' }
    # The source code and the libraries' build folders aren't needed any more.
    if (-not $Sdl2Src -and -not $GlslangSrc) { Remove-Tree (Join-Path $deps 'src') }
    Remove-Tree (Join-Path $deps 'build')
}

# ---- Vulkan on in the build folder; without -Prepare, gt5.exe rebuilt ---------------------------------
Set-CacheVulkan $true
if ($Prepare) { Stop-AddOn 0 'Vulkan is ready: the next build of the game has it.' 'Vulkan ready' }
Write-Host '== Building gt5.exe (the runtime only, a few minutes)'
Send-Add 'game' $Bar.G 'Building the game'
$rc = Invoke-Counted { cmd /c "`"$PSScriptRoot\build.cmd`" gt5" } 'game' $Bar.G 99 'Building the game'
if ($rc) { Fail 'Building gt5.exe with Vulkan failed (see above).' 'Build failed' }
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $build 'SDL2.dll'))) { Fail 'The build finished but build\SDL2.dll is missing. Please report this.' 'Build failed' }
# The DLSS and FSR 3 plug-ins, when they are in, were built before the Vulkan headers were here, so without
# their Vulkan part: each is built again now (its add script, its full text in GT5\logs\add_*.log; its
# progress lines are not passed on, this run's progress is Vulkan's). DLSS's plug-in being there means its
# licence was accepted when it was added (update.ps1 goes by the same rule). A failure leaves that plug-in as
# it was (Direct3D 12 only) and Vulkan in; the next update builds it again.
function Invoke-PlugInAgain([string]$Script, [string[]]$ArgList, [string]$Log) {
    $logs = Join-Path $gt5 'logs'
    $w = $null
    try {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $logs | Out-Null
        $w = New-Object IO.StreamWriter((Join-Path $logs "$Log.log"), $false, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
        $w.AutoFlush = $true
        $w.WriteLine("$Script $($ArgList -join ' ') (from add_vulkan.ps1), $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')")
    } catch { $w = $null }
    & powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Script) @ArgList -NoPause 2>&1 | ForEach-Object {
        if ($w) { try { $w.WriteLine("$_") } catch {} }
    }
    $code = [int]$LASTEXITCODE
    if ($w) { try { $w.Close() } catch {} }
    return $code
}
foreach ($p in @(@{ Dll = 'gt5_upscale_dlss.dll'; Script = 'add_dlss.ps1'; Args = @('-Accept'); Log = 'add_dlss'; Name = 'NVIDIA DLSS' },
                 @{ Dll = 'gt5_upscale_fsr.dll';  Script = 'add_fsr.ps1';  Args = @();          Log = 'add_fsr';  Name = 'AMD FSR 3' })) {
    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $build $p.Dll))) { continue }
    Write-Host "== $($p.Name): its plug-in built again with its Vulkan part"
    Send-Add 'game' 99 'Finishing up'
    $r = Invoke-PlugInAgain $p.Script $p.Args $p.Log
    if ($r -eq 1) { Write-Host "   $($p.Name): not built again this time (GT5\logs\$($p.Log).log says why); it works with Direct3D 12 as before." }
}
Stop-AddOn 0 'Vulkan is in. Pick Display > Renderer: Vulkan in the launcher (or set "GT5_RENDERER=vulkan" in settings.bat).' 'Vulkan ready'

```

`GT5/scripts/addon_common.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
addon_common.ps1: what the add scripts (add_vulkan.ps1, add_fsr.ps1, add_dlss.ps1) share, and the one
progress format they all print. They dot-source it; setup.ps1 and update.ps1 dot-source it for
Invoke-AddOn, which runs an add script with its full text going to GT5\logs and only the progress lines
passed on.

Progress. Besides their full text (for the log), the add scripts print lines of this one form on standard
output, and nothing else that starts with GT5_ADD:

    GT5_ADD <phase> <percent> <words>

  phase    start   the script began; words: the part's name ("Vulkan", "AMD FSR 3", "NVIDIA DLSS")
           fetch   downloading
           check   checking what was downloaded
           build   building the part
           game    building the game with it (add_vulkan.ps1 without -Prepare)
           remove  taking it out
           done    finished: the part is in (after -Remove: out). Percent 100.
           skip    nothing was done and nothing is wrong: not for this PC (no NVIDIA card, say) or not wanted
           fail    stopped; words say why. Nothing half-built is left looking finished.
  percent  0 to 100 for the whole run, or - when not known
  words    a few plain English words a person can read (the rest of the line)

Exit code: 0 done, 1 fail, 2 skip. With -NoPause a script asks nothing and waits for nothing: it can be
started by a program (the launcher, setup, update, the game) with no window and no input.
#>

# ---- For the add scripts ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# One progress line (see above). $pct: a number 0-100, or -1 / $null for "not known".
function Send-Add([string]$phase, $pct, [string]$words) {
    $p = '-'
    if ($null -ne $pct -and "$pct" -ne '' -and [double]$pct -ge 0) { $p = [string][int][math]::Min(100, [math]::Floor([double]$pct)) }
    Write-Host "GT5_ADD $phase $p $words"
}

# The end of an add script: the last words for the log, the last progress line, the exit code. Without
# -NoPause (someone ran it by hand in a console) it waits for Enter so the window can be read.
function Stop-AddOn([int]$code, [string]$msg, [string]$words = '') {
    Write-Host ''
    if ($code -eq 1) { Write-Host $msg -ForegroundColor Red } elseif ($code -eq 2) { Write-Host $msg -ForegroundColor Yellow } else { Write-Host $msg -ForegroundColor Green }
    if ($code -eq 0) { Send-Add 'done' 100 $(if ($words) { $words } else { 'Done' }) }
    elseif ($code -eq 2) { Send-Add 'skip' -1 $(if ($words) { $words } else { 'Not needed here' }) }
    else { Send-Add 'fail' -1 $(if ($words) { $words } else { 'Stopped' }) }
    if (-not $script:AddNoPause) { Write-Host ''; Read-Host 'Press Enter to close' | Out-Null }
    exit $code
}

# Git for this script: trusted on drives that don't record file owners (exFAT, FAT32: "dubious ownership",
# #41) through git's environment config, never asks for a password or opens a sign-in window, and is the
# PC's own or else the port's portable copy in tools\git (get-git.ps1; nothing installed in Windows).
function Initialize-AddOn([string]$gt5, [bool]$noPause) {
    $script:AddNoPause = $noPause
    if ($env:GT5_GIT_SAFE -ne '1') {
        $gn = 0; if ("$env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT" -match '^\d+$') { $gn = [int]$env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT }
        Set-Item "env:GIT_CONFIG_KEY_$gn" 'safe.directory'; Set-Item "env:GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_$gn" '*'
        $env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT = "$($gn + 1)"; $env:GT5_GIT_SAFE = '1'
    }
    $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT = '0'; $env:GCM_INTERACTIVE = 'never'
    $ownGit = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $gt5) 'tools\git\cmd'
    if (-not (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ownGit 'git.exe'))) { $env:Path = "$ownGit;$env:Path" }
}

# A folder and everything in it, git's read-only files too. cmd's rmdir: Remove-Item took minutes for the
# thousands of small files of a source checkout on a slow drive.
function Remove-Tree([string]$path) {
    if (-not $path -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path)) { return }
    cmd /c "rmdir /s /q `"$path`"" 2>$null
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $path -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
}

# This install's game is running (its exe is in GT5\build).
function Test-GameRunning([string]$build) {
    return [bool](Get-Process gt5 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -and $_.Path -like "$build\*" })
}

# The compiler and tools build.cmd uses (Visual Studio's, or get-toolchain.ps1's portable ones), into this
# process's environment. False when build.cmd can't set them up; its own reason is then in the output.
function Import-CompilerEnv([string]$scripts) {
    $lines = cmd /c "set GT5_ENV_ONLY=1&& call `"$scripts\build.cmd`" >nul 2>nul && set"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE) {
        # Again with build.cmd's own words shown (which compiler it looked for, and where), for the log.
        cmd /c "set GT5_ENV_ONLY=1&& call `"$scripts\build.cmd`"" 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }
        return $false
    }
    foreach ($l in $lines) { if ($l -match '^([^=]+)=(.*)$' -and $Matches[1] -ne 'GT5_ENV_ONLY') { Set-Item "env:$($Matches[1])" $Matches[2] } }
    return [bool]$env:CLANGCL
}

# git with what it says shown, except "warning: refs/tags/... is not a commit!" (said each time a release tag
# that is a tag object is named: it means nothing here).
function Invoke-GitQuiet {
    $out = & git @args 2>&1
    $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    foreach ($l in $out) { $t = "$l"; if ($t -and $t -notmatch 'is not a commit') { Write-Host $t } }
    $global:LASTEXITCODE = $code
}

# A git download, with progress from the size of the folder it fills ($expectMB: about how big it ends up)
# mapped onto $pct0..$pct1 of the whole run. git's own text goes to the log afterwards. Returns git's exit code.
function Invoke-Fetch([string[]]$gitArgs, [string]$dir, [double]$expectMB, [double]$pct0, [double]$pct1, [string]$words) {
    $tmp = [IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath git -ArgumentList $gitArgs -NoNewWindow -PassThru -RedirectStandardError $tmp -RedirectStandardOutput "$tmp.out"
    $null = $p.Handle   # so ExitCode is kept after the exit (Windows PowerShell 5.1)
    $last = -1
    while (-not $p.WaitForExit(1000)) {
        $mb = 0.0
        try { $mb = ((Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Recurse -Force -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum) / 1MB } catch {}
        $pct = $pct0 + ($pct1 - $pct0) * [math]::Min(0.95, $mb / [math]::Max(1, $expectMB))
        if ([int]$pct -ne $last) { $last = [int]$pct; Send-Add 'fetch' $pct $words }
    }
    $p.WaitForExit()
    $code = $p.ExitCode
    foreach ($f in "$tmp.out", $tmp) {
        foreach ($l in @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { if ($l -and $l -notmatch 'is not a commit') { Write-Host $l } }
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
    Send-Add 'fetch' $pct1 $words
    return [int]$code
}

# A build whose output counts its steps ("[12/240] ..." from ninja): every line shown, the count mapped onto
# $pct0..$pct1 of the whole run as $phase progress lines. Returns the exit code.
function Invoke-Counted([scriptblock]$run, [string]$phase, [double]$pct0, [double]$pct1, [string]$words) {
    $st = @{ Last = -1 }
    & $run 2>&1 | ForEach-Object {
        $l = "$_"
        Write-Host $l
        if ($l -match '^\[(\d+)/(\d+)\]' -and [int]$Matches[2] -gt 0) {
            $pct = $pct0 + ($pct1 - $pct0) * [int]$Matches[1] / [int]$Matches[2]
            if ([int]$pct -ne $st.Last) { $st.Last = [int]$pct; Send-Add $phase $pct $words }
        }
    }
    return [int]$LASTEXITCODE
}

# An NVIDIA RTX graphics card (DLSS needs one; GTX cards can't run it). The same test as the launcher's and the
# installer's. GT5_INSTALL_NORTX=1 (testing, as in GT5-Installer.bat): as if there were none.
function Test-RtxCard {
    if ($env:GT5_INSTALL_NORTX) { return $false }
    return [bool](@(Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) | Where-Object { "$($_.Name)" -match 'NVIDIA' -and "$($_.Name)" -match '\bRTX\b' })
}

# ---- For setup.ps1 and update.ps1 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Runs an add script with no window and nothing to answer. Its whole text goes to GT5\logs\<Log>.log; only
# its GT5_ADD progress lines are passed on (the installer's and the update window's progress). Returns the
# script's exit code (0 done, 1 failed, 2 skipped); it never stops the caller.
function Invoke-AddOn([string]$Script, [string[]]$ArgList = @(), [string]$Log, [string]$Logs) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Script)) { return 1 }
    $w = $null
    try {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Logs | Out-Null
        $w = New-Object IO.StreamWriter((Join-Path $Logs "$Log.log"), $false, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
        $w.AutoFlush = $true
        $w.WriteLine("$(Split-Path -Leaf $Script) $($ArgList -join ' '), $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')")
    } catch { $w = $null }
    & powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $Script @ArgList -NoPause 2>&1 | ForEach-Object {
        $l = "$_"
        if ($w) { try { $w.WriteLine($l) } catch {} }
        if ($l.StartsWith('GT5_ADD ')) { Write-Host $l }
    }
    $code = [int]$LASTEXITCODE
    if ($w) { try { $w.WriteLine("(exit code $code)"); $w.Dispose() } catch {} }
    return $code
}
```

`GT5/scripts/audiocheck.py`:

```py
"""Look for clicks and clipping in a captured run: audiocheck.py <f32> <from sec> <to sec> [--out spectrogram.png]

Prints, per second, how often samples sit at full scale and how often the signal jumps
further between two samples than sound normally can. Assumes interleaved float at 48 kHz.
"""
import os
import sys

import numpy as np

path, a, b = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3])
size = os.path.getsize(path)
ch = 2
for c in (2, 6, 8):
    # audiolevel.py's seconds tell which channel count fits; fall back to stereo.
    pass
ch = int(os.environ.get("AUDIO_CH", "2"))
sr = 48000
d = np.fromfile(path, dtype="<f4", offset=int(a * sr) * ch * 4, count=int((b - a) * sr) * ch)
print("file seconds at %d ch: %.1f" % (ch, size / 4 / ch / sr), "read", d.size)
for c in range(ch):
    x = d[c::ch]
    print("ch%d rms %.4f peak %.3f" % (c, np.sqrt((x * x).mean()), np.abs(x).max()))
x = d[0::ch]
n = sr
for i in range(0, min(len(x), n * 8), n):
    s = x[i:i + n]
    if not len(s):
        break
    j = np.abs(np.diff(s))
    print("%3d rms %.3f fullscale %6d jump>.3 %5d jump>.8 %5d zero-run-max %d" % (
        i // n, np.sqrt((s * s).mean()), (np.abs(s) >= 0.999).sum(), (j > 0.3).sum(), (j > 0.8).sum(),
        np.max(np.diff(np.flatnonzero(np.r_[True, s != 0, True]))) - 1))
if "--out" in sys.argv:
    from PIL import Image
    w = 1024
    hop = 512
    frames = (len(x) - w) // hop
    win = np.hanning(w)
    S = np.stack([np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x[k * hop:k * hop + w] * win)) for k in range(frames)], axis=1)
    S = 20 * np.log10(S + 1e-6)
    S = np.clip((S + 80) / 100, 0, 1)
    Image.fromarray((S[::-1] * 255).astype(np.uint8)).resize((1000, 400)).save(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--out") + 1])

```

`GT5/scripts/audiolevel.py`:

```py
"""Levels of an AUDIO_WAV capture: audiolevel.py <file.f32> [--wav out.wav] [--rate 48000]

Prints RMS and peak per 5 seconds, so a muted run can still show whether the game made
sound, and optionally writes a 16-bit WAV to listen to later.
"""
import array
import math
import sys
import wave

path = sys.argv[1]
rate = int(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--rate") + 1]) if "--rate" in sys.argv else 48000
out = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--wav") + 1] if "--wav" in sys.argv else None
wav = None
if out:
    wav = wave.open(out, "wb")
    wav.setnchannels(2)
    wav.setsampwidth(2)
    wav.setframerate(rate)
block = rate * 2 * 5
t = 0
with open(path, "rb") as f:
    while True:
        data = f.read(block * 4)
        if len(data) < 8:
            break
        s = array.array("f")
        s.frombytes(data[: len(data) // 4 * 4])
        total = 0.0
        peak = 0.0
        for v in s:
            total += v * v
            if abs(v) > peak:
                peak = abs(v)
        rms = math.sqrt(total / len(s))
        print(f"{t:5d}s  rms {rms:7.4f}  peak {peak:7.4f}")
        if wav:
            pcm = array.array("h", (max(-32768, min(32767, int(v * 32767))) for v in s))
            wav.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
        t += 5
if wav:
    wav.close()
print("seconds captured:", t)

```

`GT5/scripts/audiopeak.ps1`:

```ps1
# The Windows peak meter for gt5.exe's own audio session: audiopeak.ps1 -At 60 -Seconds 15
# Reads what actually reaches the output device from this process, ignoring other apps.
param([int]$At = 60, [int]$Seconds = 15)
Add-Type -TypeDefinition @"
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
[ComImport, Guid("BCDE0395-E52F-467C-8E3D-C4579291692E")] class MMDeviceEnumeratorCom {}
[ComImport, Guid("A95664D2-9614-4F35-A746-DE8DB63617E6"), InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
interface IMMDeviceEnumerator {
    int EnumAudioEndpoints(int dataFlow, int mask, out IntPtr devices);
    int GetDefaultAudioEndpoint(int dataFlow, int role, out IMMDevice device);
}
[ComImport, Guid("D666063F-1587-4E43-81F1-B948E807363F"), InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
interface IMMDevice {
    int Activate(ref Guid iid, int ctx, IntPtr p, [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.IUnknown)] out object o);
}
[ComImport, Guid("77AA99A0-1BD6-484F-8BC7-2C654C9A9B6F"), InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
interface IAudioSessionManager2 {
    int GetAudioSessionControl(IntPtr a, int b, out IntPtr c);
    int GetSimpleAudioVolume(IntPtr a, int b, out IntPtr c);
    int GetSessionEnumerator(out IAudioSessionEnumerator e);
}
[ComImport, Guid("E2F5BB11-0570-40CA-ACDD-3AA01277DEE8"), InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
interface IAudioSessionEnumerator {
    int GetCount(out int n);
    int GetSession(int i, [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.IUnknown)] out object s);
}
[ComImport, Guid("BFB7FF88-7239-4FC9-8FA2-07C950BE9C6D"), InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
interface IAudioSessionControl2 {
    int a0(); int a1(); int a2(); int a3(); int a4(); int a5(); int a6(); int a7(); int a8();
    int GetSessionIdentifier(out IntPtr s);
    int GetSessionInstanceIdentifier(out IntPtr s);
    int GetProcessId(out uint pid);
}
[ComImport, Guid("C02216F6-8C67-4B5B-9D00-D008E73E0064"), InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
interface IAudioMeterInformation { int GetPeakValue(out float peak); }
public static class Gt5Meter {
    static IAudioMeterInformation meter;
    public static bool Find(uint pid) {
        var en = (IMMDeviceEnumerator)new MMDeviceEnumeratorCom();
        IMMDevice dev; en.GetDefaultAudioEndpoint(0, 1, out dev);
        var iid = new Guid("77AA99A0-1BD6-484F-8BC7-2C654C9A9B6F");
        object o; dev.Activate(ref iid, 23, IntPtr.Zero, out o);
        IAudioSessionEnumerator se; ((IAudioSessionManager2)o).GetSessionEnumerator(out se);
        int n; se.GetCount(out n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            object s; se.GetSession(i, out s);
            uint p; ((IAudioSessionControl2)s).GetProcessId(out p);
            if (p == pid) { meter = (IAudioMeterInformation)s; return true; }
        }
        return false;
    }
    public static float Peak() { float v; meter.GetPeakValue(out v); return v; }
}
"@
$gt = $null
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60 -and -not $gt; $i++) { $gt = Get-Process gt5 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $gt) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 } }
if (-not $gt) { "gt5 not running"; exit }
while (((Get-Date) - $gt.StartTime).TotalSeconds -lt $At) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }
if (-not [Gt5Meter]::Find([uint32]$gt.Id)) { "no audio session found for gt5 pid $($gt.Id)"; exit }
$max = 0.0; $end = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($Seconds); $n = 0
while ((Get-Date) -lt $end) { $v = [Gt5Meter]::Peak(); if ($v -gt $max) { $max = $v }; $n++; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50 }
"device peak for gt5.exe over $Seconds s: $max ($n samples)"
```

`GT5/scripts/audioprobe.py`:

```py
import os as _gt5_os  # this clone's folders, wherever it was cloned to
GT5_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
BASE_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(GT5_DIR)
"""Per-second activity of the sound buffers in a running gt5.exe: audioprobe.py --sec 20 [--wait 12] --out f

Polls from outside: any voice-level meter above zero, nonzero samples in the mix buffers, and in the port ring.
"""
import ctypes
import ctypes.wintypes as w
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import time

import numpy as np

k = ctypes.windll.kernel32
k.OpenProcess.restype = w.HANDLE
k.VirtualQueryEx.argtypes = [w.HANDLE, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
k.VirtualQueryEx.restype = ctypes.c_size_t
k.ReadProcessMemory.argtypes = [w.HANDLE, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t)]
ELF = (GT5_DIR + r"\input\EBOOT.elf")


def arg(n, d=None):
    return sys.argv[sys.argv.index(n) + 1] if n in sys.argv else d


time.sleep(float(arg("--wait", 0)))
pid = int(subprocess.run(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command", "(Get-Process gt5).Id"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()[0])
h = k.OpenProcess(0x0410, False, pid)
buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(1 << 20)


def read(addr, n):
    got = ctypes.c_size_t(0)
    b = buf if n <= len(buf) else ctypes.create_string_buffer(n)
    if not k.ReadProcessMemory(h, ctypes.c_void_p(addr), b, n, ctypes.byref(got)) or got.value != n:
        return None
    return b.raw[:n]


class MBI(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("Base", ctypes.c_uint64), ("Alloc", ctypes.c_uint64), ("AllocProt", w.DWORD), ("pad0", w.DWORD),
                ("Size", ctypes.c_uint64), ("State", w.DWORD), ("Protect", w.DWORD), ("Type", w.DWORD), ("pad1", w.DWORD)]


sig = open(ELF, "rb").read()[0x177F200 - 0x10000:0x177F200 - 0x10000 + 32]
base = None
a = 0x10000
m = MBI()
while a < 0x7FFFFFFFFFFF and base is None:
    if not k.VirtualQueryEx(h, ctypes.c_void_p(a), ctypes.byref(m), ctypes.sizeof(m)):
        break
    b0, size = m.Base, m.Size
    a = b0 + size
    if m.State != 0x1000 or not (m.Protect & 0x66) or size >= 0x20000000 or size < 0x10000:
        continue
    d = read(b0, size)
    if not d:
        continue
    o = d.find(sig)
    while o >= 0:
        if ((b0 + o - 0x177F200) & 0xFFFF) == 0:
            base = b0 + o - 0x177F200
            break
        o = d.find(sig, o + 16)
regions = {"mixA": (0x6FFA0000, 0x2000), "mixB": (0x6FF9E000, 0x2000), "ring": (0x58000000, 0x20000)}
out = open(arg("--out"), "w")
t0 = time.perf_counter()
sec = float(arg("--sec", 20))
polls = 0
hits = {n: 0 for n in regions}
peak = {n: 0.0 for n in regions}
meter = 0
last = t0
dumped = set()
while True:
    now = time.perf_counter()
    if now - t0 > sec:
        break
    polls += 1
    for n, (ea, ln) in regions.items():
        d = read(base + ea, ln)
        if d is None:
            continue
        v = np.frombuffer(d, dtype=">f4")
        p = float(np.abs(v).max())
        if p > 1e-6:
            hits[n] += 1
        peak[n] = max(peak[n], p)
    d = read(base + 0x6FFB0000, 0x1B00)
    if d:
        ms = [struct.unpack(">f", d[i * 0x48 + 0x3C:i * 0x48 + 0x40])[0] for i in range(96)]
        if max(ms) > 1e-3:
            meter += 1
    if now - last >= 1.0:
        state = "bad" if meter > polls / 2 and hits["ring"] == 0 else ("good" if meter > polls / 2 else "")
        if state and state not in dumped:
            dumped.add(state)
            with open(arg("--out") + "." + state, "w") as f:
                for ea, ln in ((0x60044B00, 0x600), (0x1933410, 0x300), (0x19332A8, 0x100), (0x60040000, 0x400), (0x60044280, 0x80)):
                    d = read(base + ea, ln)
                    for i in range(0, ln, 32):
                        f.write("%08X: %s\n" % (ea + i, " ".join(d[i + j:i + j + 4].hex() for j in range(0, 32, 4))))
        out.write("%5.1f polls=%d voices=%d %s\n" % (now - t0, polls, meter, " ".join("%s=%d/%.3f" % (n, hits[n], peak[n]) for n in regions)))
        out.flush()
        polls = 0
        meter = 0
        hits = {n: 0 for n in regions}
        peak = {n: 0.0 for n in regions}
        last = now
out.close()
```

`GT5/scripts/audiorms.py`:

```py
"""RMS and peak of a captured mix per N seconds: audiorms.py <f32> [--step 5]"""
import os
import sys
import numpy as np

step = float(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--step") + 1]) if "--step" in sys.argv else 5.0
d = np.memmap(sys.argv[1], dtype="<f4", mode="r")
n = int(48000 * 2 * step)
out = []
for i in range(0, len(d) - n, n):
    c = np.asarray(d[i:i + n])
    out.append("%d:%.3f/%.2f" % (i // 96000, float(np.sqrt(np.mean(c * c))), float(np.abs(c).max())))
print(" ".join(out))
```

`GT5/scripts/autodrive.ps1`:

```ps1
# Drive a fresh gt5.exe through PAD_FILE, with generous waits, to Arcade's pre-race screen
# and, with -Race, on into the race with the accelerator held:
#   autodrive.ps1 [-Scale 1.0] [-Race]   Start run.ps1 with PAD_FILE=logs\pad.txt first.
param([double]$Scale = 1.0, [switch]$Race)
$root = "$(Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)"
$steps = @(
    @(28, "0x4000", 6),   # first dialog: OK
    @(18, "0x0020", 3),   # top menu: Right to Arcade
    @(6,  "0x4000", 4),   # Arcade
    @(20, "0x4000", 4),   # Single Race
    @(8,  "0x4000", 4),   # difficulty
    @(15, "0x4000", 4),   # track
    @(35, "0x4000", 4),   # car
    @(50, "0x4000", 4),   # car again, the showroom ignores the first while it loads
    @(55, "0x4000", 3)
)
if ($Race) {
    $steps += ,@(135, "0x4000", 6)   # pre-race: start flag
    $steps += ,@(30, "0x4000", 6)    # in case the first came early
    $steps += ,@(60, "0x4000", 4000) # accelerator
}
foreach ($s in $steps) {
    Start-Sleep -Seconds ([int]($s[0] * $Scale))
    Set-Content -Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Temp\gt5_pad.txt" -Value "$($s[1]) $($s[2])" -Encoding ascii -NoNewline
    "$(Get-Date -Format HH:mm:ss) pressed $($s[1])"
}
```

`GT5/scripts/build.cmd`:

```cmd
@echo off
REM Configure + build with clang-cl + Ninja: Visual Studio's, inside its x64 environment, or without Visual
REM Studio the portable tools from get-toolchain.ps1 (in the gt5-recomp folder).
REM Usage: scripts\build.cmd [target ...]   (GT5_JOBS sets the parallel jobs; GT5_TOOLCHAIN=<folder> uses
REM get-toolchain.ps1's tools in that folder even when Visual Studio is there)
REM Not %CL%: both cl and clang-cl read that variable as extra command-line options.
set "VSWHERE=%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe"
set "PATH=%PATH%;%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer"
set "TOOLARGS="
set "TC=%GT5_TOOLCHAIN%"
if defined GT5_TOOLCHAIN goto portable
REM Visual Studio: 2022 Community where it usually is, else the newest edition vswhere finds that has the
REM Clang tools (Professional, Enterprise, Build Tools, newer versions). Each must have both clang-cl and
REM vcvars64.bat: a folder left behind by an uninstall (or a half-finished install) can keep clang-cl
REM without vcvars64.bat, and calling that stopped the build with "The system cannot find the path
REM specified" (#35).
set "VS=%ProgramFiles%\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community"
if exist "%VS%\VC\Tools\Llvm\x64\bin\clang-cl.exe" if exist "%VS%\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" goto have_vs
set "VS="
if exist "%VSWHERE%" for /f "usebackq delims=" %%i in (`"%VSWHERE%" -sort -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Llvm.Clang -property installationPath`) do if not defined VS if exist "%%i\VC\Tools\Llvm\x64\bin\clang-cl.exe" if exist "%%i\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" set "VS=%%i"
if not defined VS goto no_vs
:have_vs
echo Building with the Visual Studio in "%VS%"
call "%VS%\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
REM The Windows SDK (kernel32.lib and the other Windows libraries): vcvars64.bat puts its folder in LIB
REM when it is installed. A Visual Studio without it stopped at CMake's first test with "could not open
REM 'kernel32.lib'" (#35).
for %%L in (kernel32.lib) do if "%%~$LIB:L"=="" goto no_sdk
set "CLANGCL=%VS:\=/%/VC/Tools/Llvm/x64/bin/clang-cl.exe"
:configure
REM add_vulkan.ps1 builds SDL2 and glslang with this same compiler: it asks for the environment alone.
if defined GT5_ENV_ONLY exit /b 0
REM A build folder set up with a compiler that's gone (Visual Studio uninstalled for the portable tools,
REM say) is set up again from scratch.
set "OLDCC="
if exist "%~dp0..\build\CMakeCache.txt" for /f "tokens=1,* delims==" %%a in ('findstr /b /c:"CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER:" "%~dp0..\build\CMakeCache.txt"') do set "OLDCC=%%b"
set "FRESH="
if defined OLDCC if not exist "%OLDCC%" set "FRESH=--fresh"
if defined FRESH del "%~dp0..\build\build.ninja" 2>nul
if not exist "%~dp0..\build\build.ninja" (
  cmake %FRESH% -S "%~dp0.." -B "%~dp0..\build" -G Ninja ^
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ^
    "-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=%CLANGCL%" ^
    "-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=%CLANGCL%" %TOOLARGS% || exit /b 1
)
REM Parallel jobs: one per thread, but at most one per 2 GB of RAM (the largest generated files need
REM about 1 GB each to compile, and running out of memory fails the build).
if not "%GT5_JOBS%"=="" goto have_jobs
set GT5_JOBS=%NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS%
for /f %%m in ('powershell -NoProfile -Command "[math]::Max(1, [int][math]::Floor((Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem).TotalPhysicalMemory / 2GB))"') do set RAMJOBS=%%m
if defined RAMJOBS if %RAMJOBS% LSS %GT5_JOBS% set GT5_JOBS=%RAMJOBS%
:have_jobs
REM The build itself, with recovery from a crashed or damaged compile: scripts\build_run.ps1.
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%~dp0build_run.ps1" -Jobs %GT5_JOBS% %*
exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%

:no_vs
REM No Visual Studio: get-toolchain.ps1's tools, in the folder it recorded, else "toolchain" next to the
REM gt5-recomp folder.
set "TC="
if exist "%~dp0..\..\.gt5\toolchain-path.txt" set /p TC=<"%~dp0..\..\.gt5\toolchain-path.txt"
if defined TC if exist "%TC%\gt5-toolchain.txt" goto portable
set "TC=%~dp0..\..\..\toolchain"
if exist "%TC%\gt5-toolchain.txt" goto portable
echo Visual Studio with "Desktop development with C++" and "C++ Clang tools for Windows" was not found,
echo and neither were the portable tools from get-toolchain.ps1. (A Visual Studio folder with clang-cl.exe
echo but no VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat is incomplete: repair it in the Visual Studio Installer.)
echo Install them with the Visual Studio Installer (see Requirements in README.md), or, to keep C: free,
echo run get-toolchain.ps1 in the gt5-recomp folder. Then run this again.
exit /b 1

:no_sdk
REM get-toolchain.ps1's tools bring their own Windows SDK: use them when they're there.
set "TC="
if exist "%~dp0..\..\.gt5\toolchain-path.txt" set /p TC=<"%~dp0..\..\.gt5\toolchain-path.txt"
if defined TC if exist "%TC%\gt5-toolchain.txt" goto portable
set "TC=%~dp0..\..\..\toolchain"
if exist "%TC%\gt5-toolchain.txt" goto portable
echo The Visual Studio in "%VS%" has no Windows SDK: kernel32.lib and the other Windows libraries
echo the build links with. Add it in the Visual Studio Installer: Modify, Individual components, tick
echo "Windows 11 SDK" (any version), then run this again. GT5-Installer.bat adds it by itself.
exit /b 1

:portable
REM get-toolchain.ps1's folder: LLVM, CMake and Ninja, and portable-msvc.py's MSVC libraries and Windows SDK.
REM This sets up by hand what vcvars64.bat would: INCLUDE, LIB and PATH (and VCToolsInstallDir, from which
REM clang-cl takes the MSVC version it presents as).
for %%i in ("%TC%") do set "TC=%%~fi"
if not exist "%TC%\gt5-toolchain.txt" goto bad_toolchain
set "MSVC="
for /d %%d in ("%TC%\msvc\VC\Tools\MSVC\*") do set "MSVC=%%~fd"
set "SDKVER="
for /d %%d in ("%TC%\msvc\Windows Kits\10\Lib\*") do set "SDKVER=%%~nxd"
set "SDK=%TC%\msvc\Windows Kits\10"
if not defined MSVC goto bad_toolchain
if not defined SDKVER goto bad_toolchain
if not exist "%TC%\llvm\bin\clang-cl.exe" goto bad_toolchain
set "VCToolsInstallDir=%MSVC%\"
set "INCLUDE=%MSVC%\include;%SDK%\Include\%SDKVER%\ucrt;%SDK%\Include\%SDKVER%\shared;%SDK%\Include\%SDKVER%\um;%SDK%\Include\%SDKVER%\winrt;%SDK%\Include\%SDKVER%\cppwinrt"
set "LIB=%MSVC%\lib\x64;%SDK%\Lib\%SDKVER%\ucrt\x64;%SDK%\Lib\%SDKVER%\um\x64"
set "PATH=%TC%\llvm\bin;%TC%\cmake\bin;%TC%\ninja;%SDK%\bin\%SDKVER%\x64;%PATH%"
set "CLANGCL=%TC:\=/%/llvm/bin/clang-cl.exe"
set TOOLARGS="-DCMAKE_LINKER=%TC:\=/%/llvm/bin/lld-link.exe" "-DCMAKE_RC_COMPILER=%SDK:\=/%/bin/%SDKVER%/x64/rc.exe" "-DCMAKE_MT=%SDK:\=/%/bin/%SDKVER%/x64/mt.exe"
echo Building with the portable tools in "%TC%"...
goto configure
:bad_toolchain
echo The portable tools in "%TC%" are missing or unfinished. Run get-toolchain.ps1 in the gt5-recomp folder again.
exit /b 1
```

`GT5/scripts/build_run.ps1`:

```ps1
# Runs the build for build.cmd (inside its Visual Studio environment) and recovers from a crashed or
# damaged compile, which heavy parallel builds do now and then, especially on some 13th/14th-gen Intel
# CPUs: a compiler crash leaves no object and is simply redone; a damaged object (the link then fails
# with undefined "llvm." symbols) is deleted so it gets compiled again. Each retry halves the jobs.
#   build_run.ps1 -Jobs <n> [targets...]      (the whole output also goes to build\last_build.log)
param([int]$Jobs = 8, [Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments = $true)][string[]]$Targets)
$build = Join-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) "build"
$log = Join-Path $build "last_build.log"

function Invoke-Build([int]$j) {
    $t = if ($Targets) { " --target " + ($Targets -join " ") } else { "" }
    cmd /c "cmake --build `"$build`" -j $j$t 2>&1" | Tee-Object -FilePath $log | Out-Host
    return $LASTEXITCODE
}

# Objects the linker found calling "llvm.*" (compiler-internal names): written damaged, so delete them.
function Remove-DamagedObjects {
    $bad = @{}; $inLlvm = $false
    foreach ($l in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        if ($l -match 'error: undefined symbol: (\S+)') { $inLlvm = $Matches[1].StartsWith("llvm.") }
        elseif ($inLlvm -and $l -match '>>>\s+(\S+\.obj):') { $bad[$Matches[1]] = $true }
    }
    foreach ($o in $bad.Keys) {
        $p = Join-Path $build $o
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p -Force; Write-Host "  removed damaged $o (it will be compiled again)" }
    }
}

# A GT5\spu from an older version may have a closed permission list ("Access is denied" from ninja).
& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "fix_spu_access.ps1")
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }
# The game's data: joins a GT.VOL split by a FAT32 dump, and says when it's missing (the build itself
# doesn't need it, so this never stops the build).
& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "fix_game_files.ps1")
$global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
# After a good build: the launcher (GT5Launcher.exe in the install folder), rebuilt with every update.
function Exit-Built {
    $lb = Join-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent) "launcher\build-launcher.ps1"
    if ((-not $Targets -or $Targets -contains "gt5") -and (Test-Path $lb)) { & $lb }
    exit 0
}
Write-Host "Building with $Jobs parallel jobs (set GT5_JOBS to change)."
if ((Invoke-Build $Jobs) -eq 0) { Exit-Built }
# Up to four retries: the linker names only a few files per error, so damaged objects surface one at a time.
foreach ($try in 1..4) {
    $Jobs = [math]::Max(1, [int][math]::Floor($Jobs / 2))
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "The build stopped. Trying again with $Jobs parallel jobs; it carries on where it stopped..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Remove-DamagedObjects
    if ((Invoke-Build $Jobs) -eq 0) { Exit-Built }
}
exit 1

```

`GT5/scripts/carfps.py`:

```py
import os as _gt5_os  # this clone's folders, wherever it was cloned to
GT5_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
BASE_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(GT5_DIR)
"""Frame rate on the car screen under one setting, by fixed timings rather than by reading the screen:
carfps.py <tag> [NAME=VALUE ...]

Starts the game muted and behind other windows, presses through to car select, waits, prints the
[fps] and [drain] lines from there and saves a picture, then stops the game.
"""
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

ROOT = GT5_DIR
tag = sys.argv[1]
envs = dict(a.split("=", 1) for a in sys.argv[2:])
envs.setdefault("LD_FRAME_DUMP_MS", "2500")
hash_env = "@{ " + "; ".join('%s = "%s"' % kv for kv in envs.items()) + " }"
game = subprocess.Popen(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command",
                         "& '%s\\scripts\\liveplay.ps1' -Tag %s -Seconds 400 -Env %s" % (ROOT, tag, hash_env)],
                        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)


def orange(pic, box):
    a = np.asarray(pic.crop(box), dtype=np.int16)
    return float(((a[..., 0] > 170) & (a[..., 1] > 80) & (a[..., 1] < 190) & (a[..., 2] < 90)).mean())


def gp(*args):
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "gp.py"), "--tag", tag] + list(args), stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)


err = os.path.join(ROOT, "logs", tag + ".err")
t0 = time.time()
# The dialog: wait for the first frames, then a settled screen.
while not os.path.exists(err) or os.path.getsize(err) < 20000:
    time.sleep(1)
    if time.time() - t0 > 120:
        break
gp("--wait", "22", "--snap", "s0")
gp("cross", "--wait", "36", "--snap", "s1")  # into the movie
gp("cross", "--wait", "34", "--snap", "s2")  # skipped; top menu
# The menu ignores input during its opening animation, so press until the second icon is selected.
for attempt in range(12):
    gp("right", "--wait", "4", "--full", "--snap", "s3")
    pic = Image.open(os.path.join(ROOT, "analysis", "frames_" + tag, "s3.png")).convert("RGB")
    if orange(pic, (434, 622, 490, 660)) > 0.07 and orange(pic, (320, 622, 376, 660)) < 0.02:
        break
    gp("--wait", "5")
gp("cross", "--wait", "16", "--snap", "s4")  # Arcade
gp("cross", "--wait", "5")                   # Single Race
gp("cross", "--wait", "12", "--snap", "s5")  # difficulty; track select
gp("cross", "--wait", "16", "--snap", "s6")  # the track
gp("--wait", "30", "--snap", "s7")           # let car select settle
txt = open(err, errors="replace").read()
print(tag, envs)
print("\n".join(re.findall(r"\[fps\][^\n]*", txt)[-4:]))
print("\n".join(x[:110] for x in re.findall(r"\[drain\][^\n]*", txt)[-3:]))
print("\n".join(x[:100] for x in re.findall(r"\[gpu-work\] per flip[^\n]*", txt)[-1:]))
subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/F", "/IM", "gt5.exe"], capture_output=True)
game.wait(timeout=30)
```

`GT5/scripts/cpusample.ps1`:

```ps1
# Per-thread CPU over a window of a running gt5.exe: cpusample.ps1 -At 50 -Window 5 -Log <run .err file>
# Prints each busy host thread's share of one core, with its guest thread id where the log names it.
param([int]$At = 50, [int]$Window = 5, [string]$Log = "")
$gt = $null
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 40 -and -not $gt; $i++) { $gt = Get-Process gt5 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $gt) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 } }
if (-not $gt) { "gt5 not running"; exit }
while (((Get-Date) - $gt.StartTime).TotalSeconds -lt $At) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }
$gt.Refresh()
$a = @{}; foreach ($t in $gt.Threads) { try { $a[$t.Id] = $t.TotalProcessorTime.TotalSeconds } catch {} }
Start-Sleep -Seconds $Window
$gt.Refresh()
$map = @{}
if ($Log -and (Test-Path $Log)) {
    Select-String -Path $Log -Pattern "\[THREAD (\d+)\] host thread started.*hosttid=(\d+)" | ForEach-Object { $map[[int]$_.Matches[0].Groups[2].Value] = $_.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value }
}
$rows = foreach ($t in $gt.Threads) {
    try { $d = $t.TotalProcessorTime.TotalSeconds - [double]$a[$t.Id] } catch { continue }
    if ($d -gt 0.05) { [pscustomobject]@{ Host = $t.Id; Guest = $map[$t.Id]; Pct = [math]::Round(100 * $d / $Window) } }
}
$total = ($rows | Measure-Object Pct -Sum).Sum
"total $total% of one core across $(($rows | Measure-Object).Count) busy threads"
$rows | Sort-Object Pct -Descending | Select-Object -First 16 | ForEach-Object { "{0,4}%  host {1,6}  guest {2}" -f $_.Pct, $_.Host, $_.Guest }

```

`GT5/scripts/cubemips.py`:

```py
"""Do the reflection cube's mip rows change? cubemips.py <surface dump dir>

Reads the half-float 128x255 cube faces from each LD_SURF_DUMP frame and prints, for each face, the brightness of the
main image and of its mip rows, and whether they changed since the frame before. A row that never changes while the
main image does is a stale mip chain.
"""
import glob
import os
import re
import sys

import numpy as np

D = sys.argv[1]
FACES = ["04D40000", "04D7FC00", "04DBF800", "04DFF400", "04E3F000", "04E7EC00"]
ROWS = [(0, 128), (128, 192), (192, 224), (224, 240), (240, 248), (248, 255)]


def read(f):
    d = open(f, "rb").read()
    p = d.split(maxsplit=4)
    w, h = int(p[1]), int(p[2])
    return np.frombuffer(d[len(d) - w * h * 3:], dtype=np.uint8).reshape(h, w, 3).astype(int)


frames = sorted(set(re.match(r"(f\d+)_", os.path.basename(f)).group(1) for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(D, "f*_128x255.ppm"))))
print(len(frames), "frames")
for face in FACES:
    prev = None
    print("face", face)
    for fr in frames:
        fs = glob.glob(os.path.join(D, fr + "_*_" + face + "_128x255.ppm"))
        if not fs:
            continue
        a = read(fs[0])
        cells = " ".join("%3d" % a[y0:y1].max() for y0, y1 in ROWS)
        ch = "" if prev is None else " changed:" + "".join("Y" if (a[y0:y1] != prev[y0:y1]).any() else "." for y0, y1 in ROWS)
        print("  ", fr, cells, ch)
        prev = a

```

`GT5/scripts/dbg_adc.py`:

```py
import os as _gt5_os  # this clone's folders, wherever it was cloned to
GT5_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
BASE_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(GT5_DIR)
"""Temporary: dump each Adhoc script to analysis/adc/ as func_00B866DC loads it.

func_00B26FA8 is the stream read (r4 = buffer, returns the count). Undo with
dbg_trace.py --clean.
"""
import os
import re
import shutil

GEN = (GT5_DIR + r"\generated")
ORIG = (GT5_DIR + r"\analysis\dbg_orig")
DECL = b'#include <stdint.h>\nextern "C" void gt5_adc_path(uint64_t); extern "C" void gt5_dump_adc(uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t);\n'
os.makedirs(ORIG, exist_ok=True)


def patch(chunk, edit):
    path = os.path.join(GEN, f"ppu_recomp_{chunk}.cpp")
    dst = os.path.join(ORIG, os.path.basename(path))
    if not os.path.exists(dst):
        shutil.copy2(path, dst)
    raw = edit(open(path, "rb").read())
    open(path, "wb").write(DECL + raw)


def path_probe(raw):
    head = b"void func_00B866DC(ppu_context* ctx) {"
    assert raw.count(head) == 1
    return raw.replace(head, head + b"\n    gt5_adc_path(ctx->gpr[5]);")


def read_probe(raw):
    head = b"void func_00B26FA8(ppu_context* ctx) {"
    assert raw.count(head) == 1
    raw = raw.replace(head, head + b"\n    const uint64_t _adc_buf = ctx->gpr[4];")
    tail = rb"\{ g_trampoline_fn = \(void\(\*\)\(void\*\)\)func_00D39D9C; return; \}(\s*\}\s*void func_00B270AC)"
    raw, n = re.subn(tail, lambda m: b"gt5_dump_adc(_adc_buf, ctx->gpr[3], ctx->thread_id); { g_trampoline_fn = (void(*)(void*))func_00D39D9C; return; }" + m.group(1), raw)
    assert n == 1
    return raw


patch("030", path_probe)
patch("029", read_probe)
print("patched")

```

```py
path = (GT5_DIR + r"\generated\ppu_recomp_030.cpp")

PROBE = (b'        fprintf(stderr, "[modlist %s] rec=%08X name=%08X a=%08X b=%08X c=%08X next=%08X nm=%.30s\\n", "%s", '
         b'(unsigned)ctx->gpr[31], vm_read32(ctx->gpr[31]), vm_read32(ctx->gpr[31]+4), vm_read32(ctx->gpr[31]+8), '
         b'vm_read32(ctx->gpr[31]+12), vm_read32(ctx->gpr[31]+16), '
```

`GT5/scripts/dbg_native.py`:

```py
import os as _gt5_os  # this clone's folders, wherever it was cloned to
GT5_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
BASE_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(GT5_DIR)
"""Temporary: log script function and native calls by name. Undo with dbg_trace.py --clean.

func_00B7B954 is the native dispatcher (r3 = the callable), func_00B15B70 calls a script
function (r4 = the callable). A callable's name is the std::string at *(obj+0xC)+4, the
same read func_00B01DF4 does.
"""
import os
import shutil

GEN = (GT5_DIR + r"\generated")
ORIG = (GT5_DIR + r"\analysis\dbg_orig")
os.makedirs(ORIG, exist_ok=True)
DECL = b'#include <stdint.h>\nextern "C" void gt5_log_call(const char*, uint64_t, uint64_t);\n'
for chunk, fn, reg in (("030", "00B7B954", 3), ("029", "00B15B70", 4)):
    path = os.path.join(GEN, f"ppu_recomp_{chunk}.cpp")
    dst = os.path.join(ORIG, os.path.basename(path))
    if not os.path.exists(dst):
        shutil.copy2(path, dst)
    raw = open(path, "rb").read()
    head = f"void func_{fn}(ppu_context* ctx) {{".encode()
    assert raw.count(head) == 1
    raw = raw.replace(head, head + f'\n    gt5_log_call("{"nat" if reg == 3 else "fn"}", ctx->gpr[{reg}], ctx->thread_id);'.encode())
    open(path, "wb").write(DECL + raw)
print("patched")
```

`GT5/scripts/dbg_trace.py`:

```py
import os as _gt5_os  # this clone's folders, wherever it was cloned to
GT5_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
BASE_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(GT5_DIR)
"""Temporary call trace of lifted functions: prints r3/r4 after every call inside them.

  dbg_trace.py 0001285C 00D397F8 ...   insert the probes (entry also shows strings and
                                       the first words of the r3 object)
  dbg_trace.py --clean                 put the patched chunks back

Originals go in analysis/dbg_orig/ so --clean needs no re-lift.
"""
import glob
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys

GEN = (GT5_DIR + r"\generated")
ORIG = (GT5_DIR + r"\analysis\dbg_orig")
CALL = re.compile(rb"^(\s*)ctx->lr = (0x[0-9A-F]+); (func_[0-9A-F]+|ps3_indirect_call)\(ctx\); DRAIN_TRAMPOLINE\(ctx\);(\s*)$")
DECL = b'#include <stdint.h>\nextern "C" const char* gt5_dbgstr(uint64_t); extern "C" void gt5_dbgobj(const char*, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t);'

if sys.argv[1:] == ["--clean"]:
    for p in glob.glob(ORIG + r"\*.cpp"):
        shutil.copy(p, os.path.join(GEN, os.path.basename(p)))  # fresh mtime, so ninja rebuilds it
        os.remove(p)
    print("restored")
    sys.exit()

want = {a.upper().rjust(8, "0") for a in sys.argv[1:]}
os.makedirs(ORIG, exist_ok=True)
head = re.compile(rb"^void (?:gt5_orig_)?func_([0-9A-F]{8})\(ppu_context\* ctx\) \{")
for path in sorted(glob.glob(GEN + r"\ppu_recomp_0*.cpp")):
    lines = open(path, "rb").read().split(b"\n")
    out, cur, hits = [], None, 0
    for l in lines:
        m = head.match(l)
        if m:
            cur = m.group(1).decode() if m.group(1).decode() in want else None
            out.append(l)
            if cur:
                out.append(b'    gt5_dbgobj("%s", ctx->gpr[3], ctx->gpr[4], ctx->gpr[5], ctx->lr, ctx->thread_id);' % cur.encode())
                out.append(b'    fprintf(stderr, "    s6=[%%s] s7=[%%s] s8=[%%s]\\n", gt5_dbgstr(ctx->gpr[6]), gt5_dbgstr(ctx->gpr[7]), gt5_dbgstr(ctx->gpr[8]));')
                hits += 1
            continue
        if cur and l.startswith(b"}"):
            cur = None
        out.append(l)
        if cur:
            c = CALL.match(l)
            if c:
                out.append(b'    fprintf(stderr, "[tr %s] %s %s -> r3=%%llX r4=%%llX\\n", (unsigned long long)ctx->gpr[3], (unsigned long long)ctx->gpr[4]);'
                           % (cur.encode(), c.group(2), c.group(3)))
    if hits:
        out.insert(0, DECL)
        dst = os.path.join(ORIG, os.path.basename(path))
        if not os.path.exists(dst):
            shutil.copy2(path, dst)
        open(path, "wb").write(b"\n".join(out))
        print("patched", os.path.basename(path), hits)

```

`GT5/scripts/demosheet.py`:

```py
import os as _gt5_os  # this clone's folders, wherever it was cloned to
GT5_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
BASE_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(GT5_DIR)
"""Skip to the attract demo and keep small pictures of it: demosheet.py <name> [count] [gap s] [start s]

Presses through the dialog and movie, waits for the demo, then saves <count> half-size frames from the
running game and a contact sheet at analysis\frames_lq\<name>_sheet.png.
"""
import glob
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from PIL import Image

ROOT = GT5_DIR
GP = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "gp.py")
name = sys.argv[1]
count = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 18
gap = float(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 9
start = float(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 150
snaps = os.path.join(ROOT, "analysis", "frames_lq")


def gp(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["python", GP, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)


time.sleep(30)
time.sleep(10)
gp("cross", "--wait", "20")
gp("cross", "--wait", "2")   # skips the movie to the title screen; a third press would enter My Home, which has no demo
time.sleep(start)
pics = []

    n = "%s_%02d" % (name, i)
    gp("--snap", n, "--wait", "0")
    p = os.path.join(snaps, n + ".png")
    if os.path.exists(p):

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (cols * w, rows * h))
    for i, p in enumerate(pics):

    sheet.save(os.path.join(snaps, name + "_sheet.png"))
    print("sheet done", flush=True)
```

```py
import csv
import sys

colour = collections.Counter()
for r in csv.DictReader(open(sys.argv[1])):
    f = int(r["frame"])
    n[f] += 1
    if r["cmask"] != "0x00000000":

last = None

        if last is not None:

        start, last = f, key
```

```ps1
# Drive a running gt5.exe by hand: send a press through PAD_FILE, wait, show the newest frame.
#   drive.ps1 -Press 0x4000 [-Polls 5] [-Wait 6] [-Dir analysis\frames_live]
# Masks: Cross 0x4000, Circle 0x2000, Square 0x8000, Triangle 0x1000, Start 0x0008,
#        Up 0x0010, Right 0x0020, Down 0x0040, Left 0x0080.
param([string]$Press = "", [int]$Polls = 5, [int]$Wait = 6, [string]$Dir = "analysis\frames_live")

$py = "$(Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent)\venv\Scripts\python.exe"
if ($Press) { Set-Content -Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Temp\gt5_pad.txt" -Value "$Press $Polls" -Encoding ascii -NoNewline }

& $py -I "$root\scripts\ppm2png.py" "$root\$Dir" 2>&1 | Out-Null

Select-String -Path "$root\logs\live.err" -Pattern "^\[throw\]|^\[exit-chain\] code|identical transfers|device removed" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(110, $_.Line.Length)) }
```

```py
"""Show a raw DXT1 level as an image, from each block's first colour: dxt1view.py <raw> <w> <h> <out.png> [--be]"""
import sys

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

d = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
w, h = int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3])
bw, bh = (w + 3) // 4, (h + 3) // 4
a = np.frombuffer(d[: bw * bh * 8], dtype="<u8" if "--be" not in sys.argv else ">u8").reshape(bh, bw)
c = (a & 0xFFFF).astype(np.uint32)
rgb = np.stack([((c >> 11) & 31) * 255 // 31, ((c >> 5) & 63) * 255 // 63, (c & 31) * 255 // 31], axis=-1).astype(np.uint8)
print("mean rgb", rgb.reshape(-1, 3).mean(axis=0), "zero blocks %.1f%%" % (100.0 * (a == 0).mean()))
Image.fromarray(rgb).save(sys.argv[4])
```
