`GT5/scripts/padsim.py`:

```py
import os as _gt5_os  # this clone's folders, wherever it was cloned to
GT5_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
BASE_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(GT5_DIR)
"""Feed made-up DualSense reports through the real parser and check what the game receives.

Starts a muted test run behind other windows on test_save, with PAD_NO_DUALSENSE so the real pad
stays out of it, and holds each report for a while. PAD_TRACE lines in logs/padsim.err show the
payload cellPadGetData handed the game. Nothing is sent to a controller.
"""
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

ROOT = GT5_DIR
ERR = os.path.join(ROOT, "logs", "padsim.err")
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "logs", "padsim.out")
REP = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "gt5_padsim_report.hex")


def report(kind, lx=128, ly=128, rx=128, ry=128, l2=0, r2=0, b0=8, b1=0):
    if kind == "usb":
        r = bytearray(64)
        r[0:9] = bytes([0x01, lx, ly, rx, ry, l2, r2, 1, b0])
        r[9] = b1
    elif kind == "bt_simple":      # what Windows returns: the 10-byte report padded to 78
        r = bytearray(78)
        r[0:10] = bytes([0x01, lx, ly, rx, ry, b0, b1, 0, l2, r2])
    elif kind == "bt_full":
        r = bytearray(78)
        r[0:11] = bytes([0x31, 0x41, lx, ly, rx, ry, l2, r2, 1, b0, b1])
    return bytes(r)


# name, report, what the game should get
CASES = [
    ("usb: Cross, part R2, stick left", report("usb", lx=0x40, l2=32, r2=144, b0=0x28, b1=0x08),
     dict(d1=0x00, d2=0x42, L=(0x40, 128), l2=32, r2=144, cross=255)),
    ("usb: nothing", report("usb"), dict(d1=0, d2=0, l2=0, r2=0)),
    ("bluetooth simple: Square, part L2, stick up", report("bt_simple", ly=0x10, l2=85, b0=0x18, b1=0x04),
     dict(d1=0x00, d2=0x81, L=(128, 0x10), l2=85, r2=0, square=255)),
    ("bluetooth simple: nothing", report("bt_simple"), dict(d1=0, d2=0, l2=0, r2=0)),
    ("bluetooth full: D-pad right, part R2", report("bt_full", r2=96, b0=0x02, b1=0x08),
     dict(d1=0x20, d2=0x02, l2=0, r2=96)),
    ("bluetooth full: Cross, Options", report("bt_full", b0=0x28, b1=0x20),
     dict(d1=0x08, d2=0x40, l2=0, r2=0, cross=255)),
    ("bluetooth full: light R2 touch", report("bt_full", r2=20, b1=0x08),
     dict(d1=0, d2=0x02, l2=0, r2=20)),
    ("bluetooth full: nothing", report("bt_full"), dict(d1=0, d2=0, l2=0, r2=0)),
]

LINE = re.compile(r"\[pad\] t=(\d+) tid=(\d+) d1=(\w+) d2=(\w+) L=(\d+),(\d+) R=(\d+),(\d+) l2=(\d+) r2=(\d+) cross=(\d+) square=(\d+)")


def put(rep):
    tmp = REP + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "w") as f:
        f.write(rep.hex(" "))
    os.replace(tmp, REP)


def lines():
    try:
        with open(ERR, errors="replace") as f:
            s = f.read()
    except OSError:
        return []
    out = []
    for m in LINE.finditer(s):
        g = m.groups()
        out.append(dict(t=int(g[0]), tid=g[1], d1=int(g[2], 16), d2=int(g[3], 16), L=(int(g[4]), int(g[5])),
                        R=(int(g[6]), int(g[7])), l2=int(g[8]), r2=int(g[9]), cross=int(g[10]), square=int(g[11])))
    return out


def main():
    hold = float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 2.0
    put(report("bt_full"))
    env = '@{PAD_TRACE="1";PAD_NO_DUALSENSE="1";PAD_DS_REPORT_FILE="%s"}' % REP
    secs = int(90 + hold * len(CASES) + 30)
    p = subprocess.Popen(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command",
                          "& '%s\\scripts\\run.ps1' -Seconds %d -Tag padsim -Env %s" % (ROOT, secs, env)],
                         stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, cwd=ROOT)
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < 90:
        time.sleep(1)
        try:
            if "GetData polling begins" in open(OUT, errors="replace").read():
                break
        except OSError:
            pass
    else:
        print("the game never polled the pad")
    print(f"polling after {time.time() - t0:.0f} s")
    time.sleep(3)
    bad = 0
    for name, rep, want in CASES:
        before = len(lines())
        put(rep)
        time.sleep(hold)
        new = lines()[before:]
        last = new[-1] if new else None
        ok = bool(last) and all(last[k] == v for k, v in want.items())
        # A held report must stay put: more than the change itself means it flickered.
        steady = len(new) <= 2
        bad += (not ok) + (not steady)
        shown = {k: last[k] for k in ("d1", "d2", "L", "l2", "r2", "cross", "square")} if last else None
        print(("ok  " if ok else "FAIL"), name, "| lines", len(new), "" if steady else "FLICKER", "|", shown)
    subprocess.run(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command",
                    "Get-Process gt5 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -Confirm:$false"])
    p.wait()
    all_lines = lines()
    print("trace lines", len(all_lines), "reader threads", sorted({x["tid"] for x in all_lines}))
    print("failures", bad)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`GT5/scripts/pamfscan.py`:

```py
"""Walk a dumped PAMF section stream (DMUX_DUMP): pamfscan.py <file> [--every n]

Per n MB: video and audio PES bytes so far, the last PTS of each, and how far video leads audio.
"""
import sys

path = sys.argv[1]
every = int(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--every") + 1]) if "--every" in sys.argv else 1
d = open(path, "rb").read()
print("size %.1f MB, first bytes %s" % (len(d) / 1e6, d[:16].hex()))
PACK = 2048
kinds = {}
vb = ab = 0
vpts = apts = None
apts0 = vpts0 = None
next_print = 0
for o in range(0, len(d) - PACK + 1, PACK):
    p = d[o:o + PACK]
    if p[:4] != b"\0\0\1\xba":
        kinds["notpack"] = kinds.get("notpack", 0) + 1
        continue
    q = 14 + (p[13] & 7)
    if p[q:q + 4] == b"\0\0\1\xbb":
        q += 6 + (p[q + 4] << 8 | p[q + 5])
        if p[q:q + 4] == b"\0\0\1\xbf":
            q += 6 + (p[q + 4] << 8 | p[q + 5])
    if p[q:q + 3] != b"\0\0\1":
        kinds["noPES"] = kinds.get("noPES", 0) + 1
        continue
    sid = p[q + 3]
    plen = (p[q + 4] << 8 | p[q + 5]) + 6
    k = "%02X" % sid
    if sid == 0xBD:
        k += "/%02X" % p[q + 9 + p[q + 8]]
    kinds[k] = kinds.get(k, 0) + 1
    flags = p[q + 7]
    pts = None
    if flags & 0x80:
        t = p[q + 9:q + 14]
        pts = ((t[0] & 0x0E) << 29) | (t[1] << 22) | ((t[2] & 0xFE) << 14) | (t[3] << 7) | (t[4] >> 1)
    size = plen - 9 - p[q + 8]
    if (sid & 0xF0) == 0xE0:
        vb += size
        if pts is not None:
            vpts = pts
            vpts0 = vpts0 if vpts0 is not None else pts
    elif sid == 0xBD and p[q + 9 + p[q + 8]] == 0:
        ab += size
        if pts is not None:
            apts = pts
            apts0 = apts0 if apts0 is not None else pts
    if o >= next_print and vpts is not None and apts is not None:
        print("%6.1f MB  video %7.2f MB pts %8.3f s  audio %6.2f MB pts %8.3f s  lead %6.3f s" % (
            o / 1e6, vb / 1e6, vpts / 90000, ab / 1e6, apts / 90000, (vpts - apts) / 90000))
        next_print += every * 1000000
print(sorted(kinds.items()))
print("audio frames so far about %d (2744 bytes each)" % (ab / 2744))

```

`GT5/scripts/pc_check.py`:

```py
"""Does every processor of this PC give the same answer?

The port is built on the player's PC: Python tools turn the game's code into C++, then a compiler turns
that into gt5.exe. Both are long calculations, and both assume the processor calculates correctly. Some
do not: a processor (or one of its cores) that has become unstable gives a wrong answer now and then,
which shows up as a tool stopping with an error that makes no sense, a compiler crash, or a game that
misbehaves. Seen on Intel's 13th and 14th generation desktop processors in particular.

This check runs one of the lift's own jobs (a deterministic program: same input, same output, always)
many times, each run pinned to one logical processor, a few processors at a time (the pattern in which
the faults were seen: runs alone passed, eight side by side failed). A run that stops with an error or
writes a different result is a wrong calculation, and the report says which processors gave them.

    python pc_check.py [--rounds 6] [--together 8] [--cpus 0,1,2] [--json FILE]

Exit code 0: every run agreed. 1: some did not (the table says where). 2: the check could not run.
Standard library only; Windows and Linux. Nothing outside the temporary folder is written.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

# The child: pin itself to one logical processor, then run the job in this same interpreter.
CHILD = r"""
import os, sys, runpy
cpu = int(sys.argv[1])
if os.name == "nt":
    import ctypes
    k = ctypes.windll.kernel32
    k.GetCurrentProcess.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    k.SetProcessAffinityMask.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
    if not k.SetProcessAffinityMask(k.GetCurrentProcess(), 1 << cpu):
        sys.exit(97)
else:
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, {cpu})
sys.argv = sys.argv[2:]
runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0], run_name="__main__")
"""

# With no lift job on disk yet (a fresh install), a stand-in of the same kind of work: a pure-Python
# loop over objects with attribute reads, comparisons, list building and hashing.
SYNTHETIC = r"""
import hashlib, sys
class Ins:
    def __init__(self, addr, op, a, b):
        self.addr = addr; self.op = op; self.a = a; self.b = b
x = 0x2545F491
ins = []
for i in range(60000):
    x = (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    ins.append(Ins(i * 4, x >> 26, (x >> 13) & 127, x & 127))
h = hashlib.sha256()
bounds = [(s, s + 2400) for s in range(0, 240000, 2000)]
for rnd in range(20):
    for (s, e) in bounds:
        fn = [i for i in ins if s <= i.addr < e]
        acc = 0
        for idx, i in enumerate(fn):
            if i.op & 1:
                acc = (acc * 31 + i.a * i.b + idx) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF
            elif i.a < i.b:
                acc ^= i.addr << (i.op & 7)
        h.update(acc.to_bytes(8, "little"))
open(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--output") + 1] + "/out.txt", "w").write(h.hexdigest())
"""


def find_job():
    """One of the lift's SPU jobs with the function list the lift made for it, or None."""
    # next to this script (GT5\scripts), or, for a copy of the script run from elsewhere, the GT5 folder
    # it was started in
    gt5 = next((g for g in (HERE.parent, Path.cwd())
                if (g.parent / "ps3recomp" / "tools" / "spu_lifter.py").is_file()), None)
    if gt5 is None:
        return None
    lifter = gt5.parent / "ps3recomp" / "tools" / "spu_lifter.py"
    best = None
    for dump in sorted((gt5 / "analysis" / "spu_miss").glob("spujob_*.bin")):
        fp = dump.name.split("_")[1][:8].upper()
        funcs = gt5 / "spu" / "jobs" / f"j{fp}_funcs.json"
        if funcs.is_file() and (best is None or dump.stat().st_size > best[0].stat().st_size):
            best = (dump, funcs, fp)
    if not best:
        return None
    dump, funcs, fp = best
    return [str(lifter), str(dump), "--base", "0x0", "--functions", str(funcs),
            "--symbol-prefix", f"gt5_j{fp}", "--source-name", "spu_recomp.c"], dump.name


def digest(folder):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    for p in sorted(Path(folder).rglob("*")):
        if p.is_file():
            h.update(p.name.encode()); h.update(p.read_bytes())
    return h.hexdigest()


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("--rounds", type=int, default=6, help="runs on each processor (default 6)")
    ap.add_argument("--together", type=int, default=8, help="processors busy at the same time (default 8)")
    ap.add_argument("--cpus", default="", help="only these logical processors, e.g. 0,1,2")
    ap.add_argument("--json", default="", help="also write the result here")
    ap.add_argument("--synthetic", action="store_true", help="use the stand-in job even when a lift job is there")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    n = os.cpu_count() or 1
    if n > 64 and os.name == "nt":
        n = 64          # one processor group; enough to say whether this PC calculates correctly
    cpus = [int(c) for c in a.cpus.split(",") if c.strip()] if a.cpus else list(range(n))
    job = None if a.synthetic else find_job()
    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="gt5_pc_check_"))
    child = tmp / "child.py"; child.write_text(CHILD)
    if job:
        argv, what = job
    else:
        syn = tmp / "job.py"; syn.write_text(SYNTHETIC)
        argv, what = [str(syn)], "a stand-in job (no lift job on disk yet)"
    name = ""
    try:
        if os.name == "nt":
            name = subprocess.run(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command", "(Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor).Name"],
                                  capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30).stdout.strip()
        else:
            name = next((l.split(":", 1)[1].strip() for l in open("/proc/cpuinfo") if l.startswith("model name")), "")
    except Exception:
        pass
    print(f"Processor: {name or 'unknown'}, {n} logical processors; Python {sys.version.split()[0]}")
    print(f"Job: {what}; {a.rounds} runs on each of {len(cpus)} processors, {a.together} at a time")

    runs = {c: [] for c in cpus}        # cpu -> list of (exit code, digest or "", last error line)
    t0 = time.time()
    seq = 0
    for rnd in range(a.rounds):
        # a different neighbourhood each round, so a processor is tried next to different others
        order = cpus[rnd % len(cpus):] + cpus[:rnd % len(cpus)]
        for g in range(0, len(order), a.together):
            group = order[g:g + a.together]
            procs = []
            for c in group:
                seq += 1
                out = tmp / f"o{seq}"; out.mkdir()
                p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-I", str(child), str(c), *argv, "--output", str(out)],
                                     stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
                procs.append((c, p, out))
            for c, p, out in procs:
                try:
                    _, err = p.communicate(timeout=600)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    p.kill(); _, err = p.communicate()
                last = next((l for l in reversed((err or "").splitlines()) if l.strip()), "")
                runs[c].append((p.returncode, digest(out) if p.returncode == 0 else "", last.strip()[:160]))
                shutil.rmtree(out, ignore_errors=True)
        print(f"  round {rnd + 1} of {a.rounds} done ({time.time() - t0:.0f} s)", flush=True)
    shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)

    if all(code == 97 for r in runs.values() for code, _, _ in r):
        print("The check could not pin its runs to processors on this system.")
        return 2
    counts = {}
    for r in runs.values():
        for code, d, _ in r:
            if code == 0:
                counts[d] = counts.get(d, 0) + 1
    if not counts:
        print("No run finished. First error: " + next((e for r in runs.values() for _, _, e in r if e), "(none)"))
        return 1
    good = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    bad = {}
    for c, r in runs.items():
        errs = [e or f"exit code {code}" for code, d, e in r if code != 0]
        diff = sum(1 for code, d, _ in r if code == 0 and d != good)
        if errs or diff:
            bad[c] = (len(errs), diff, errs[0] if errs else "a different result, with no error")
    total = sum(len(r) for r in runs.values())
    print()
    if not bad:
        print(f"RESULT: all {total} runs gave the same answer. No wrong calculation was seen.")
    else:
        wrong = sum(e + d for e, d, _ in bad.values())
        print(f"RESULT: {wrong} of {total} runs went wrong, on {len(bad)} of {len(cpus)} logical processors:")
        for c in sorted(bad):
            e, d, first = bad[c]
            print(f"  processor {c:2d}: {e} stopped with an error, {d} wrote a different result   e.g. {first}")
        print("The same program with the same input must always give the same answer, so this is the")
        print("processor (or memory) calculating wrongly, not the game's tools.")
    if a.json:
        json.dump({"processor": name, "logical": n, "job": what, "rounds": a.rounds, "together": a.together,
                   "total": total, "bad": {str(c): list(v) for c, v in bad.items()}}, open(a.json, "w"), indent=1)
    return 1 if bad else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`GT5/scripts/peek.ps1`:

```ps1
# Read a running gt5.exe from outside: the guest registers of a spinning host thread, and guest memory.
#   peek.ps1 -Thread 38916 -Ea 0x60000000,64   (Thread: host thread id, from profsym.py; Ea: address,bytes pairs)
# Finds the ppu_context by looking for the guest TOC in the memory a host register points at.
param([int]$Thread = 0, [string[]]$Ea = @(), [switch]$Scan, [string]$Dump = "")
Add-Type -TypeDefinition @"
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
public static class Gt5Peek {
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern IntPtr OpenProcess(int a, bool i, int id);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern IntPtr OpenThread(int a, bool i, int id);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern uint SuspendThread(IntPtr h);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern uint ResumeThread(IntPtr h);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern bool GetThreadContext(IntPtr h, IntPtr c);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern bool ReadProcessMemory(IntPtr p, IntPtr a, byte[] b, IntPtr n, out IntPtr r);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern IntPtr VirtualQueryEx(IntPtr p, IntPtr a, byte[] b, IntPtr n);
    public static IntPtr P;
    public static byte[] Read(long a, int n) {
        var b = new byte[n]; IntPtr r;
        if (!ReadProcessMemory(P, new IntPtr(a), b, new IntPtr(n), out r) || r.ToInt64() != n) return null;
        return b;
    }
    public static long Base() {
        // The guest address space: the largest single reservation in the process.
        long a = 0, best = 0, bestSize = 0, curBase = 0, curSize = 0;
        var m = new byte[48];
        while (a < 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFL) {
            if (VirtualQueryEx(P, new IntPtr(a), m, new IntPtr(48)) == IntPtr.Zero) break;
            long alloc = BitConverter.ToInt64(m, 8), size = BitConverter.ToInt64(m, 24); int state = BitConverter.ToInt32(m, 32);
            if (state != 0x10000) {
                if (alloc == curBase) curSize += size; else { curBase = alloc; curSize = size; }
                if (curSize > bestSize) { bestSize = curSize; best = curBase; }
            }
            a = BitConverter.ToInt64(m, 0) + size;
        }
        Console.WriteLine("largest allocation 0x" + best.ToString("X") + " size 0x" + bestSize.ToString("X"));
        return best;
    }
    public static long[] Regs(int tid) {
        IntPtr h = OpenThread(0x0002 | 0x0008 | 0x0040, false, tid);
        IntPtr raw = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(4096);
        IntPtr ctx = new IntPtr((raw.ToInt64() + 15) & ~15L);
        SuspendThread(h);
        Marshal.WriteInt32(ctx, 0x30, 0x00100003);
        GetThreadContext(h, ctx);
        ResumeThread(h);
        var v = new long[16];
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) v[i] = Marshal.ReadInt64(ctx, 0x78 + i * 8);
        return v;
    }
    // Every ppu_context in the process: gpr[1] a guest stack, gpr[2] one of the TOCs.
    public static void Scan(long[] toc) {
        long a = 0x10000;
        var m = new byte[48];
        while (a < 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFL) {
            if (VirtualQueryEx(P, new IntPtr(a), m, new IntPtr(48)) == IntPtr.Zero) break;
            long bas = BitConverter.ToInt64(m, 0), size = BitConverter.ToInt64(m, 24);
            int state = BitConverter.ToInt32(m, 32), type = BitConverter.ToInt32(m, 40), prot = BitConverter.ToInt32(m, 36);
            if (state == 0x1000 && (prot & 0x04) != 0 && size < 0x10000000) {
                var b = Read(bas, (int)size);
                if (b != null) for (int o = 8; o + 248 <= b.Length; o += 8) {
                    long g2 = BitConverter.ToInt64(b, o + 8);
                    if (Array.IndexOf(toc, g2) < 0) continue;
                    long g1 = BitConverter.ToInt64(b, o);
                    if (g1 < 0xC0000000L || g1 > 0xF0000000L) continue;
                    var t = new System.Text.StringBuilder("ctx 0x" + (bas + o - 8).ToString("X"));
                    for (int r = 0; r < 32; r++) t.Append(" r" + r + "=" + BitConverter.ToInt64(b, o - 8 + r * 8).ToString("X"));
                    System.IO.File.AppendAllText(@"$(Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)\logs\peek.txt", t.ToString() + System.Environment.NewLine);
                }
            }
            a = bas + size;
        }
    }
    public static long Find(byte[] sig) {
        long a = 0x10000;
        var m = new byte[48];
        while (a < 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFL) {
            if (VirtualQueryEx(P, new IntPtr(a), m, new IntPtr(48)) == IntPtr.Zero) break;
            long bas = BitConverter.ToInt64(m, 0), size = BitConverter.ToInt64(m, 24);
            int state = BitConverter.ToInt32(m, 32), prot = BitConverter.ToInt32(m, 36);
            if (state == 0x1000 && (prot & 0x66) != 0 && size >= 0x10000 && size < 0x20000000) {
                var b = Read(bas, (int)size);
                if (b != null) for (int o = 0; o + 32 <= b.Length; o += 16) {
                    if (b[o] != sig[0] || b[o + 1] != sig[1] || b[o + 2] != sig[2]) continue;
                    int k = 3; while (k < 32 && b[o + k] == sig[k]) k++;
                    if (k == 32 && ((bas + o - 0x177F200) & 0xFFFF) == 0) return bas + o;
                }
            }
            a = bas + size;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    public static void Open(int pid) { P = OpenProcess(0x0410, false, pid); }
}
"@
$gt = Get-Process gt5 | Select-Object -First 1
[Gt5Peek]::Open($gt.Id)
$base = [Gt5Peek]::Base()
# Guest address 0: where the Wws_Job module's signature sits, 0x177F200 into the guest image.
$elf = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes("$(Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)\input\EBOOT.elf")
$sig = New-Object byte[] 32
[Array]::Copy($elf, 0x177F200 - 0x10000, $sig, 0, 32)
$hit = [Gt5Peek]::Find($sig)
if ($hit) { $base = $hit - 0x177F200; "guest address 0 is host 0x{0:X}" -f $base } else { "signature not found" }
function BE32($b, $o) { return ([uint32]$b[$o] -shl 24) -bor ([uint32]$b[$o+1] -shl 16) -bor ([uint32]$b[$o+2] -shl 8) -bor [uint32]$b[$o+3] }
if ($Thread) {
    $toc = 0x1846AF0, 0x1866624, 0x18765B0, 0x185682C
    $found = $false
    foreach ($r in [Gt5Peek]::Regs($Thread)) {
        if ($r -lt 0x10000) { continue }
        for ($back = 0; $back -le 0x800 -and -not $found; $back += 8) {
            $b = [Gt5Peek]::Read($r - $back, 0x100)
            if (-not $b) { break }
            $g2 = [BitConverter]::ToInt64($b, 16)
            $g1 = [BitConverter]::ToInt64($b, 8)
            if (($toc -contains $g2) -and $g1 -gt 0x10000000 -and $g1 -lt 0xF0000000 -and ($g1 % 16) -eq 0) {
                $found = $true
                "ppu_context at 0x{0:X}" -f ($r - $back)
                for ($i = 0; $i -lt 32; $i++) { "r{0} = 0x{1:X}" -f $i, [BitConverter]::ToInt64($b, $i * 8) }
            }
        }
        if ($found) { break }
    }
    if (-not $found) { "no ppu_context found" }
}
if ($Scan) { [Gt5Peek]::Scan([long[]](0x1846AF0, 0x1866624, 0x18765B0, 0x185682C)) }
foreach ($pair in $Ea) {
    $p = $pair -split ","
    $addr = [Convert]::ToInt64($p[0], 16)
    $len = [int]$p[1]
    $b = [Gt5Peek]::Read($base + $addr, $len)
    if (-not $b) { "0x{0:X}: unreadable" -f $addr; continue }
    if ($Dump) { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($Dump, $b); "wrote $Dump"; continue }
    for ($o = 0; $o -lt $len; $o += 16) {
        $n = [Math]::Min(16, $len - $o)
        "{0:X8}: {1}" -f ($addr + $o), (($b[$o..($o + $n - 1)] | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString("X2") }) -join "")
    }
}
```

`GT5/scripts/ppm2png.py`:

```py
"""Convert frame dumps to PNG and report how much of each is non-black: ppm2png.py <dir>"""
import glob
import os
import struct
import sys
import zlib


def read_ppm(path):
    d = open(path, "rb").read()
    fields, pos = [], 0
    while len(fields) < 4:
        while d[pos] in b" \t\r\n":
            pos += 1
        end = pos
        while d[end] not in b" \t\r\n":
            end += 1
        fields.append(d[pos:end])
        pos = end
    return int(fields[1]), int(fields[2]), d[pos + 1:]


def write_png(path, w, h, rgb):
    def chunk(tag, data):
        return struct.pack(">I", len(data)) + tag + data + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data))
    raw = b"".join(b"\0" + rgb[y * w * 3:(y + 1) * w * 3] for y in range(h))
    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
                + chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 6)) + chunk(b"IEND", b""))


for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(sys.argv[1], "*.ppm"))):
    w, h, rgb = read_ppm(p)
    nb = sum(1 for i in range(0, len(rgb), 3 * 97) if rgb[i] or rgb[i + 1] or rgb[i + 2]) * 97
    png = p[:-4] + ".png"
    write_png(png, w, h, rgb)
    os.remove(p)
    print(f"{os.path.basename(png)} {w}x{h} nonblack~{nb * 100 // (w * h)}%")

```

`GT5/scripts/ppu_native_patch.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Switch native functions in for lifted PPU functions at build time (no re-lift).

    ppu_native_patch.py <lifted ppu_recomp_NNN.cpp> <patched copy> <ppu_natives.txt>
    ppu_native_patch.py --where <ppu_natives.txt> <generated folder>     (CMake: the files that get a copy)
    ppu_native_patch.py --pin <generated folder> <ADDR8>...               (list lines for these functions)

GT5/src/native/ppu_natives.txt lists the functions, one a line:

    <ADDR8> leaf <sha1>

`leaf`: the native form is made from this lift's own text of the function by src/native/gen_ppu_leaf.py
(its registers held in C locals; see there). <sha1> is the SHA-1 of the lifted function's text (its
`void func_<ADDR8>(ppu_context* ctx) {` line to its closing brace, LF line ends) the native was proven
on: a function whose text is another (another release or update, another lifter) stays lifted, and so
does one the generator turns away; the build says which and why.

In the copy, the lifted definition is renamed `func_<ADDR8>_lifted` and a function with the old name is
added that picks one at run time (GT5_PPU_NATIVE: 1 = native, the default; 0 = lifted; 2 = compare: the
native's compare form on a copy of the registers with its stores held back, then the lifted function for
real, registers and stored bytes compared, the first differences logged). Every caller, the function
table and the trampolines keep the old name, so nothing else changes. src/native/ppu_native.cpp has the
switch, the counters (the "[ppu-native]" log line) and the compare.
"""
import importlib.util
import os
import re
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))


def load_gen(listing):
    path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(listing)), "gen_ppu_leaf.py")
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        path = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "src", "native", "gen_ppu_leaf.py")
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("gen_ppu_leaf", path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


def read_list(listing):
    out = []
    for n, line in enumerate(open(listing, encoding="utf-8"), 1):
        f = line.split("#", 1)[0].split()
        if not f:
            continue
        if len(f) != 3 or f[1] != "leaf" or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,8}", f[0]) \
                or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", f[2]):
            sys.exit(f"[ppu-native] {listing}:{n}: not `<ADDR8> leaf <sha1>`: {line.strip()}")
        out.append((f[0].upper().rjust(8, "0"), f[1], f[2]))
    return out


def patch(src, dst, listing):
    gen = load_gen(listing)
    text = open(src, encoding="latin-1", newline="").read()
    nl = "\r\n" if "\r\n" in text else "\n"
    tail, done, kept = [], [], []
    for addr, kind, sha in read_list(listing):
        name = f"func_{addr}"
        span = gen.find_function(text, name)
        if not span:
            continue                                   # in another file of this lift
        ftext = text[span[0]:span[1]]
        if gen.fn_sha1(ftext) != sha:
            kept.append(f"{addr} (its lifted text is not the one the native was proven on)")
            continue
        nat, why = gen.generate(ftext.replace("\r\n", "\n"), name, f"gt5_ppu_native_{addr}", f"gt5_ppu_shadow_{addr}")
        if nat is None:
            kept.append(f"{addr} ({why})")
            continue
        text = text[:span[0]] + ftext.replace(f"void {name}(ppu_context* ctx) {{", f"void {name}_lifted(ppu_context* ctx) {{", 1) \
            + text[span[1]:]
        k = f"gt5_ppu_nat_k_{addr}"
        shadow = f"gt5_ppu_shadow_{addr}" if why is None else "nullptr"
        tail += [nat,
                 f"static const int {k} = gt5_ppu_native_register(\"{addr}\", {0 if why is None else 1});",
                 f"void {name}(ppu_context* ctx) {{",
                 "    const int m = g_gt5_ppu_native;",
                 f"    if (__builtin_expect(m == 1, 1)) {{ gt5_ppu_nat_count({k}); gt5_ppu_native_{addr}(ctx); return; }}",
                 f"    if (m == 2) {{ gt5_ppu_native_compare(ctx, {shadow}, {name}_lifted, {k}); return; }}",
                 f"    gt5_ppu_nat_lifted({k});",
                 f"    {name}_lifted(ctx);",
                 "}", ""]
        done.append(addr)
    if tail:
        body = "\n".join(["", "/* ppu_native_patch.py: native forms of the functions GT5/src/native/ppu_natives.txt lists */",
                          '#include "ppu_native.h"', ""] + tail)
        text += body.replace("\n", nl)
    open(dst, "w", encoding="latin-1", newline="").write(text)
    msg = f"[ppu-native] {os.path.basename(src)}: {len(done)} function(s) native"
    if kept:
        msg += "; stay lifted: " + ", ".join(kept)
    print(msg)


def where(listing, gdir):
    gen = load_gen(listing)
    want = {f"func_{a}": s for a, k, s in read_list(listing)}
    heads = re.compile(r"^void (func_[0-9A-F]{8})\(ppu_context\* ctx\) \{", re.M)
    files = []
    for fn in sorted(os.listdir(gdir)):
        if not re.fullmatch(r"ppu_recomp_\d+\.cpp", fn):
            continue
        text = open(os.path.join(gdir, fn), encoding="latin-1", newline="").read()
        hit = False
        for m in heads.finditer(text):
            if m.group(1) in want:
                span = gen.find_function(text, m.group(1))
                if span and gen.fn_sha1(text[span[0]:span[1]]) == want[m.group(1)]:
                    hit = True
        if hit:
            files.append(fn)
    sys.stdout.write(";".join(files))


def pin(gdir, addrs):
    gen = load_gen(os.path.join(HERE, "..", "src", "native", "ppu_natives.txt"))
    want = {"func_" + a.upper().rjust(8, "0") for a in addrs}
    for fn in sorted(os.listdir(gdir)):
        if not re.fullmatch(r"ppu_recomp_\d+\.cpp", fn):
            continue
        text = open(os.path.join(gdir, fn), encoding="latin-1", newline="").read()
        for name in sorted(want):
            span = gen.find_function(text, name)
            if span:
                ftext = text[span[0]:span[1]]
                nat, why = gen.generate(ftext.replace("\r\n", "\n"), name, "n", "s")
                if nat is None:
                    print(f"# {name[5:]} refused: {why}")
                else:
                    print(f"{name[5:]} leaf {gen.fn_sha1(ftext)}" + (f"   # {why}" if why else ""))


def main():
    a = sys.argv[1:]
    if a and a[0] == "--where":
        where(a[1], a[2])
    elif a and a[0] == "--pin":
        pin(a[1], a[2:])
    elif len(a) == 3:
        patch(*a)
    else:
        sys.exit(__doc__)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`GT5/scripts/prof.ps1`:

```ps1
# Sampling profiler for a running gt5.exe: prof.ps1 -At 130 -Seconds 10 -Out logs\prof_a.txt
# Suspends each thread briefly, records where it is, and writes "tid module rva count" lines
# for profsym.py to name. -At is seconds since the process started.
param([int]$At = 0, [int]$Seconds = 10, [string]$Out = "$(Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)\logs\prof.txt", [int]$Hz = 40)
Add-Type -TypeDefinition @"
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
public static class Gt5Prof {
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern IntPtr OpenThread(int access, bool inherit, int id);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern uint SuspendThread(IntPtr h);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern uint ResumeThread(IntPtr h);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern bool GetThreadContext(IntPtr h, IntPtr ctx);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern bool CloseHandle(IntPtr h);
    public static void Run(int pid, int seconds, int hz, string path) {
        var p = Process.GetProcessById(pid);
        var mods = new List<ProcessModule>();
        foreach (ProcessModule m in p.Modules) mods.Add(m);
        IntPtr raw = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(4096);
        IntPtr ctx = new IntPtr((raw.ToInt64() + 15) & ~15L);
        var hist = new Dictionary<string, int>();
        var cpu0 = new Dictionary<int, double>();
        p.Refresh();
        foreach (ProcessThread t in p.Threads) { try { cpu0[t.Id] = t.TotalProcessorTime.TotalSeconds; } catch {} }
        var end = DateTime.Now.AddSeconds(seconds);
        var handles = new Dictionary<int, IntPtr>();
        while (DateTime.Now < end) {
            p.Refresh();
            foreach (ProcessThread t in p.Threads) {
                IntPtr h;
                if (!handles.TryGetValue(t.Id, out h)) {
                    // SUSPEND_RESUME | GET_CONTEXT | QUERY_INFORMATION
                    h = OpenThread(0x0002 | 0x0008 | 0x0040, false, t.Id);
                    handles[t.Id] = h;
                }
                if (h == IntPtr.Zero) continue;
                if (SuspendThread(h) == 0xFFFFFFFF) continue;
                Marshal.WriteInt32(ctx, 0x30, 0x00100001); // CONTEXT_CONTROL for AMD64
                long rip = 0;
                if (GetThreadContext(h, ctx)) rip = Marshal.ReadInt64(ctx, 0xF8);
                ResumeThread(h);
                if (rip == 0) continue;
                string name = "?"; long rva = rip;
                foreach (var m in mods) {
                    long b = m.BaseAddress.ToInt64();
                    if (rip >= b && rip < b + m.ModuleMemorySize) { name = m.ModuleName; rva = rip - b; break; }
                }
                string k = t.Id + " " + name + " " + rva.ToString("X");
                int n; hist.TryGetValue(k, out n); hist[k] = n + 1;
            }
            System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(1000 / hz);
        }
        p.Refresh();
        using (var w = new StreamWriter(path)) {
            foreach (ProcessThread t in p.Threads) {
                try {
                    double a; cpu0.TryGetValue(t.Id, out a);
                    w.WriteLine("#cpu " + t.Id + " " + ((t.TotalProcessorTime.TotalSeconds - a) / seconds * 100).ToString("F0"));
                } catch {}
            }
            foreach (var kv in hist) w.WriteLine(kv.Key + " " + kv.Value);
        }
        foreach (var h in handles.Values) if (h != IntPtr.Zero) CloseHandle(h);
    }
}
"@
$gt = $null
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 120 -and -not $gt; $i++) { $gt = Get-Process gt5 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $gt) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 } }
if (-not $gt) { "gt5 not running"; exit }
while (((Get-Date) - $gt.StartTime).TotalSeconds -lt $At) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }
[Gt5Prof]::Run($gt.Id, $Seconds, $Hz, $Out)
"wrote $Out"
```

`GT5/scripts/proflines.py`:

```py
import os as _gt5_os  # this clone's folders, wherever it was cloned to
GT5_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.dirname(_gt5_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
BASE_DIR = _gt5_os.path.dirname(GT5_DIR)
"""Hot source lines of one thread in a prof.ps1 capture: proflines.py <prof.txt> <host tid> [--top N] [--context K]"""
import collections
import re
import subprocess
import sys

SYM = r"C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\VC\Tools\Llvm\x64\bin\llvm-symbolizer.exe"
EXE = (GT5_DIR + r"\build\gt5.exe")
BASE = 0x140000000


def arg(n, d):
    return int(sys.argv[sys.argv.index(n) + 1]) if n in sys.argv else d


tid = int(sys.argv[2])
rows = []
for line in open(sys.argv[1], errors="replace"):
    p = line.split()
    if len(p) >= 4 and not line.startswith("#") and int(p[0]) == tid and " ".join(p[1:-2]).lower() == "gt5.exe":
        rows.append((int(p[-2], 16), int(p[-1])))
text = "\n".join(hex(BASE + a) for a, _ in rows) + "\n"
out = subprocess.run([SYM, "--obj=" + EXE, "--no-inlines", "--output-style=GNU"], input=text, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split("\n")
c = collections.Counter()
for i, (a, n) in enumerate(rows):
    c[(out[i * 2].strip(), out[i * 2 + 1].strip())] += n
tot = sum(c.values()) or 1
files = {}
for (fn, loc), n in c.most_common(arg("--top", 14)):
    print("%5.1f%% %s %s" % (100.0 * n / tot, fn[:30], loc[-36:]))
    m = re.match(r"(.*):(\d+)", loc)
    k = arg("--context", 0)
    if m and k and "generated" in m[1]:
        ls = files.setdefault(m[1], open(m[1], errors="replace").readlines())
        ln = int(m[2])
        for l in ls[max(0, ln - 1 - k):ln + k]:
            print("        " + l.strip()[:100])
```
