```cpp
// ---- finding the game's functions --------------------------------------------------------------------------
const uint32_t kImageLo = 0x00010000, kImageHi = 0x02000000;   // every GT5 release's executable fits

uint32_t mask(uint32_t w)
{
    const uint32_t op = w >> 26, ra = (w >> 16) & 31;
    if (op == 18) return w & 0xFC000003u;   // b / bl: the target
    if (op == 16) return w & 0xFFFF0003u;   // bc: the target
    if (ra == 2 && (op == 14 || op == 32 || op == 34 || op == 36 || op == 38 || op == 40 || op == 44 || op == 48 ||
                    op == 50 || op == 52 || op == 54 || op == 58 || op == 62))
        return w & 0xFFFF0000u;              // TOC-relative: the offset
    if (op == 15) return w & 0xFFFF0000u;   // lis / addis: an address half
    return w;
}

// The one place the masked pattern matches; 0 if none or more than one (*n = matches).
uint32_t find_pattern(const uint32_t* pat, uint32_t words, int* n)
{
    uint32_t at = 0;
    *n = 0;
    for (uint32_t ea = kImageLo; ea + 4 * words <= kImageHi; ea += 4) {
        if (mask(rd32(ea)) != pat[0]) continue;
        uint32_t i = 1;
        while (i < words && mask(rd32(ea + 4 * i)) == pat[i]) i++;
        if (i == words) { (*n)++; at = ea; }
    }
    return *n == 1 ? at : 0;
}

// The function a bl at ea calls, through a cross-TOC stub (std r2,40(r1); addis; addi; b) if it is one.
uint32_t bl_target(uint32_t ea)
{
    const uint32_t w = rd32(ea);
    if ((w >> 26) != 18 || (w & 3) != 1) return 0;
    int32_t off = (int32_t)(w & 0x03FFFFFCu);
    if (off & 0x02000000) off -= 0x04000000;
    uint32_t t = ea + (uint32_t)off;
    if (t >= kImageLo && t < kImageHi - 16 && rd32(t) == 0xF8410028u && (rd32(t + 12) >> 26) == 18) {
        int32_t o2 = (int32_t)(rd32(t + 12) & 0x03FFFFFCu);
        if (o2 & 0x02000000) o2 -= 0x04000000;
        t = t + 12 + (uint32_t)o2;
    }
    return t >= kImageLo && t < kImageHi ? t : 0;
}

// A function's TOC: that of the function descriptor {code, toc} with the highest code at or below it (the
// executable's descriptors; a toc counts when hundreds of descriptors share it).
uint32_t toc_of(uint32_t fn)
{
    // Every descriptor-shaped pair once: {code 4-aligned in the image, toc 8-aligned in its upper half}; the
    // tocs hundreds of pairs share are real (Europe 1.00: four, 3,800 to 8,500 functions each).
    static std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> s_opd;   // code, toc; sorted by code
    if (s_opd.empty()) {
        std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> all;
        std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> uses;
        for (uint32_t ea = kImageLo; ea + 8 <= kImageHi; ea += 8) {
            const uint32_t code = rd32(ea), toc = rd32(ea + 4);
            if ((code & 3) || (toc & 7) || code < kImageLo || code >= toc || toc < 0x01000000 || toc >= kImageHi)
                continue;
            all.push_back({code, toc});
            uses[toc]++;
        }
        for (const auto& p : all)
            if (uses[p.second] >= 200) s_opd.push_back(p);
        std::sort(s_opd.begin(), s_opd.end());
    }
    auto it = std::upper_bound(s_opd.begin(), s_opd.end(), std::make_pair(fn, 0xFFFFFFFFu));
    if (it == s_opd.begin()) return 0;
    --it;
    return fn - it->first < 0x40000 ? it->second : 0;
}

// The game's request entry (FileObject's third virtual function, "submit") is wrapped so the reader knows
// when the game itself uses its file layer: found by the class's type name, its vtable's first function
// checked against the FileObject dtor found above. The descriptor's own address stands in for the function
// (as GT5\src\gt5_cockpit.cpp does).
void (*s_submit)(ppu_context*);
uint32_t s_submit_opd;
volatile LONG s_inflight;              // the reader has a request of its own running
volatile ULONGLONG s_game_submit_ms;   // GetTickCount64 of the game's last request
uint64_t s_reader_tid = ~0ull;

void submit_wrap(ppu_context* ctx)
{
    if (ctx->thread_id != s_reader_tid && !InterlockedCompareExchange(&s_inflight, 0, 0))
        s_game_submit_ms = GetTickCount64();
    s_submit(ctx);
    while (g_trampoline_fn) {
        void (*tf)(void*) = g_trampoline_fn;
        g_trampoline_fn = nullptr;
        tf(ctx);
    }
}

uint32_t find_word(uint32_t value, uint32_t from)
{
    for (uint32_t ea = (from + 3) & ~3u; ea + 4 <= kImageHi; ea += 4)
        if (rd32(ea) == value) return ea;
    return 0;
}

uint32_t find_submit_opd(uint32_t dtor)
{
    static const char kName[] = "N6PDISTD10FileObjectE";   // with its terminating zero
    const unsigned char* lo = vm_base + kImageLo;
    const unsigned char* hi = vm_base + kImageHi;
    for (const unsigned char* p = lo; p + sizeof kName <= hi; p++) {
        p = (const unsigned char*)memchr(p, 'N', (size_t)(hi - p));
        if (!p || p + sizeof kName > hi) break;
        if (memcmp(p, kName, sizeof kName) != 0 || p[-1] != 0) continue;
        const uint32_t name_ea = (uint32_t)(p - vm_base);
        for (uint32_t h = find_word(name_ea, kImageLo); h; h = find_word(name_ea, h + 4)) {
            const uint32_t ti = h - 4;   // type information: {its own vtable, name, ...}
            for (uint32_t v = find_word(ti, kImageLo); v; v = find_word(ti, v + 4)) {
                // the class's vtable: {0, type information, functions...}; slot 0 = the dtor
                if (rd32(v - 4) != 0) continue;
                const uint32_t opd0 = rd32(v + 4), opd2 = rd32(v + 12);
                if (opd0 < kImageLo || opd0 >= kImageHi || rd32(opd0) != dtor) continue;
                if (opd2 >= kImageLo && opd2 < kImageHi && !(opd2 & 3)) return opd2;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

bool find_functions()
{
    int n1, n2, n3;
    const uint32_t load = find_pattern(kPatLoad, sizeof kPatLoad / 4, &n1);
    const uint32_t stat = find_pattern(kPatStat, sizeof kPatStat / 4, &n2);
    const uint32_t upk = find_pattern(kPatUnpackCaller, sizeof kPatUnpackCaller / 4, &n3);
    if (!load || !stat || !upk) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume: the game's file code was not found in this executable (load %d, stat %d, "
                        "unpack %d matches; Europe / Asia 1.00 code expected): the volume is not read\n", n1, n2, n3);
        return false;
    }
    kLoad = load;
    kFoOpen = bl_target(load + 0x70); kFoRun = bl_target(load + 0xF0); kFoClose = bl_target(load + 0x140);
    kFoCtor = bl_target(stat + 0x3C); kFoDtor = bl_target(stat + 0xE4);
    kUnpack = bl_target(upk + 0x9C); kUnpackEnd = bl_target(upk + 0xA8);
    const bool same = bl_target(stat + 0x4C) == kFoOpen && bl_target(stat + 0x6C) == kFoRun &&
                      bl_target(stat + 0xBC) == kFoClose;
    kToc = toc_of(load);
    const uint32_t want[8] = {kFoCtor, kFoDtor, kFoOpen, kFoRun, kFoClose, kLoad, kUnpack, kUnpackEnd};
    static const char* const names[8] = {"FileObject ctor", "FileObject dtor", "open", "run", "close", "load",
                                         "unpack", "unpack end"};
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        s_fn[i].code = want[i];
        s_fn[i].fn = want[i] ? lifted(want[i]) : nullptr;
        if (!s_fn[i].fn || !same || !kToc || toc_of(want[i]) != kToc) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume: the game's %s was not found (0x%08X%s%s): the volume is not read\n",
                    names[i], want[i], same ? "" : ", load and stat call different functions",
                    kToc ? "" : ", no TOC");
            return false;
        }
    }
    s_submit_opd = find_submit_opd(kFoDtor);
    if (s_submit_opd) {
        s_submit = lifted(rd32(s_submit_opd));
        if (s_submit) {
            ppu_register_function(s_submit_opd, submit_wrap);
            wr32(s_submit_opd, s_submit_opd);   // the descriptor now leads to submit_wrap
        }
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume: the game's file code: load 0x%08X, stat 0x%08X, open 0x%08X, run 0x%08X, "
                    "close 0x%08X, FileObject 0x%08X / 0x%08X, unpack 0x%08X / 0x%08X (from 0x%08X), TOC 0x%08X; "
                    "its requests seen at 0x%08X%s\n", kLoad, stat, kFoOpen, kFoRun, kFoClose, kFoCtor, kFoDtor,
            kUnpack, kUnpackEnd, upk, kToc, s_submit_opd, s_submit ? "" : " (not wrapped: waits by disc reads)");
    return true;
}

uint64_t call(uint32_t code, uint64_t a0 = 0, uint64_t a1 = 0, uint64_t a2 = 0, uint64_t a3 = 0,
              uint64_t a4 = 0, uint64_t a5 = 0)
{
    void (*fn)(ppu_context*) = nullptr;
    for (const Fn& f : s_fn)
        if (f.code == code) fn = f.fn;
    if (!fn) return 0;
    InterlockedExchange(&s_inflight, 1);
    ppu_context c = *s_self;
    c.gpr[1] = (s_self->gpr[1] - 0x2000) & ~0xFull;   // below the thread's own frame
    c.gpr[2] = kToc;
    c.gpr[3] = a0; c.gpr[4] = a1; c.gpr[5] = a2; c.gpr[6] = a3; c.gpr[7] = a4; c.gpr[8] = a5;
    c.lr = 0;
    c.cia = code;
    ppu_context* saved = g_active_ctx;
    g_active_ctx = &c;
    fn(&c);
    while (g_trampoline_fn) {
        void (*tf)(void*) = g_trampoline_fn;
        g_trampoline_fn = nullptr;
        tf(&c);
    }
    g_active_ctx = saved;
    InterlockedExchange(&s_inflight, 0);
    return c.gpr[3];
}

uint32_t s_path, s_obj, s_result, s_bufdesc, s_range, s_state, s_ent, s_ent_cap, s_buf, s_ubuf;

// ---- reads that do not install ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GT5 copies a volume file to the hard disk the first time it opens it for reading ("Installing..." at the bottom
// right; the PDIPFS folder of its game data): its volume device (FileDevicePFSGameData) opens a handle in slot 34
// (Europe 1.00 0x00BC0918), which looks the file up and calls slot 46 (0x00BBC54C); slot 46 asks slot 60
// (0x00BBC3DC: not under one of the device's excluded folders, not above its size limit, room left on the disk)
// and on yes copies the whole file, counted in the "installing" count the indicator shows (0x00BB59F4), and
// opens the copy; on no it reads the file from the volume, as it does for any file it does not install. Slot 34
// is the only caller of slot 46, and slot 46 the only one that installs. So the reader's opens get "no": slot
// 34's wrapper marks this thread while it serves one of the reader's own FileObjects (its stack: load's, or
// s_obj), slot 60's wrapper answers "no" while marked and hands every other question to the game's own code.
// The device's vtable is found by its type name, its slots checked by the calls between them (34 calls slot 46,
// 46 calls slot 60); anything else: nothing is wrapped and the volume is not read.
void (*s_open_fn)(ppu_context*);
void (*s_install_fn)(ppu_context*);
uint32_t s_open_opd, s_install_opd;
uint32_t s_stack_lo, s_stack_hi;           // the reader's call stack (call()'s frames)
volatile LONG s_reader_opens, s_installs_declined;
thread_local int t_reader_open;

bool reader_object(uint32_t obj)
{
    return obj && (obj == s_obj || (obj >= s_stack_lo && obj < s_stack_hi));
}
void open_wrap(ppu_context* ctx)
{
    const int before = t_reader_open;
    const uint32_t h = (uint32_t)ctx->gpr[4];
    t_reader_open = h >= 0x10000u && reader_object(rd32(h + 8));   // the handle's FileObject
    if (t_reader_open) InterlockedIncrement(&s_reader_opens);
    s_open_fn(ctx);
    while (g_trampoline_fn) {
        void (*tf)(void*) = g_trampoline_fn;
        g_trampoline_fn = nullptr;
        tf(ctx);
    }
    t_reader_open = before;
}
void install_wrap(ppu_context* ctx)
{
    if (t_reader_open) {   // one of the reader's files: read from the volume, not installed
        InterlockedIncrement(&s_installs_declined);
        ctx->gpr[3] = 0;
        return;
    }
    s_install_fn(ctx);
    while (g_trampoline_fn) {
        void (*tf)(void*) = g_trampoline_fn;
        g_trampoline_fn = nullptr;
        tf(ctx);
    }
}
// A virtual call through vtable offset off (lwz rX, off(rY); ... bctrl) in the first 2 KB of code.
bool has_vcall(uint32_t code, uint32_t off)
{
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 0x200; i++) {
        const uint32_t w = rd32(code + 4 * i), ra = (w >> 16) & 31;
        if ((w >> 26) != 32 || (w & 0xFFFFu) != off || ra == 1 || ra == 2) continue;
        for (uint32_t j = 1; j <= 8; j++)
            if (rd32(code + 4 * (i + j)) == 0x4E800421u) return true;
    }
    return false;
}
bool find_install_hooks()
{
    static const char kName[] = "N6PDIPS321FileDevicePFSGameDataE";
    const unsigned char* lo = vm_base + kImageLo;
    const unsigned char* hi = vm_base + kImageHi;
    auto slot = [](uint32_t v, uint32_t k) { return rd32(v + 4 + 4 * k); };
    auto in_image = [](uint32_t a) { return a >= kImageLo && a < kImageHi && !(a & 3); };
    for (const unsigned char* p = lo; p + sizeof kName <= hi; p++) {
        p = (const unsigned char*)memchr(p, 'N', (size_t)(hi - p));
        if (!p || p + sizeof kName > hi) break;
        if (memcmp(p, kName, sizeof kName) != 0 || p[-1] != 0) continue;
        const uint32_t name_ea = (uint32_t)(p - vm_base);
        for (uint32_t h = find_word(name_ea, kImageLo); h; h = find_word(name_ea, h + 4)) {
            const uint32_t ti = h - 4;
            for (uint32_t v = find_word(ti, kImageLo); v; v = find_word(ti, v + 4)) {
                if (rd32(v - 4) != 0) continue;   // the primary vtable: {0, type information, slots...}
                const uint32_t o34 = slot(v, 34), o46 = slot(v, 46), o60 = slot(v, 60);
                if (!in_image(o34) || !in_image(o46) || !in_image(o60)) continue;
                const uint32_t c34 = rd32(o34), c46 = rd32(o46), c60 = rd32(o60);
                if (!in_image(c34) || !in_image(c46) || !in_image(c60)) continue;
                if (!has_vcall(c34, 46 * 4) || !has_vcall(c46, 60 * 4)) continue;
                void (*f34)(ppu_context*) = lifted(c34);
                void (*f60)(ppu_context*) = lifted(c60);
                if (!f34 || !f60) continue;
                s_open_opd = o34; s_open_fn = f34;
                s_install_opd = o60; s_install_fn = f60;
                fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume: reads without install: the volume device's open 0x%08X and install "
                                "check 0x%08X (its slots 34 / 60, vtable 0x%08X) wrapped for the reader's own files\n",
                        c34, c60, v + 4);
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}
void wrap_install_hooks()
{
    ppu_register_function(s_open_opd, open_wrap);
    ppu_register_function(s_install_opd, install_wrap);
    wr32(s_open_opd, s_open_opd);         // the descriptors now lead to the wrappers
    wr32(s_install_opd, s_install_opd);
}

void put_path(const std::string& p)
{
    const size_t n = p.size() < 1000 ? p.size() : 1000;
    memcpy(vm_base + s_path, p.data(), n);
    vm_base[s_path + n] = 0;
}

struct Ent { std::string name; uint32_t type, stored, unpacked; };

// One directory as the game lists it: 0 = listed, else the request's status (4: the volume's index is not
// read yet), -1 = not opened.
int list_dir(const std::string& dir, std::vector<Ent>& out)
{
    out.clear();
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
        put_path(dir);
        memset(vm_base + s_obj, 0, 0x200);
        call(kFoCtor, s_obj);
        const uint32_t o = (uint32_t)call(kFoOpen, s_obj, s_path);
        int status = -1;
        uint64_t count = 0;
        if (o) {
            wr32(o + 0x84, 3);
            wr32(o + 0xA0, pass ? s_ent : 0);
            wr32(o + 0xA4, pass ? s_ent_cap : 0);
            call(kFoRun, o);
            status = (int)rd32(o + 0xB0);
            count = rd64(o + 0xC0);
            call(kFoClose, o);
        }
        call(kFoDtor, s_obj);
        if (status != 0) return status;
        if (pass == 0) {
            if (count > s_ent_cap) {
                const uint32_t want = (uint32_t)(count + 64);
                const uint32_t e = galloc(want * 0x40);
                if (!e) return -2;
                gfree(s_ent);
                s_ent = e; s_ent_cap = want;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (count > s_ent_cap) count = s_ent_cap;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            const uint32_t e = s_ent + i * 0x40;
            char name[64];
            memcpy(name, vm_base + e + 0xC, 52);
            name[52] = 0;
            out.push_back({name, rd32(e), rd32(e + 4), rd32(e + 8)});
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

bool ends_with(const std::string& s, const char* e)
{
    const size_t n = strlen(e);
    return s.size() >= n && s.compare(s.size() - n, n, e) == 0;
}

// The game using its file layer right now (its own loads go first). With the request wrapper: a request of
// the game's (not the reader's, not made while the reader's own request runs: the device's work for it) in
// the last 500 ms. Without it (the wrapper not found): process reads over 100 ms while this thread reads
// nothing, 1 MB in 100 ms = 10 MB/s. Round 4 showed that test never firing: a 100 ms sample once a second
// rarely meets the game's short, mostly small loads (the demo's files are tens of KB).
bool game_reading()
{
    if (s_submit) {
        if (GetTickCount64() - s_game_submit_ms >= 500) return false;
        Sleep(100);
        return true;
    }
    IO_COUNTERS a, b;
    if (!GetProcessIoCounters(GetCurrentProcess(), &a)) return false;
    Sleep(100);
    if (!GetProcessIoCounters(GetCurrentProcess(), &b)) return false;
    return b.ReadTransferCount - a.ReadTransferCount >= (1u << 20);
}

struct Stats {
    uint64_t files = 0, stored = 0, unpacked = 0, found = 0, found_v = 0, too_big = 0, failed = 0;
    uint64_t containers = 0, added = 0, added_v = 0;   // [found] shader containers met, programs new to the store
    uint64_t skipped = 0, files_skipped = 0;           // [found] containers not read, files with one
    double wait_load = 0, wait_drive = 0;
} s_st;
uint32_t s_gfound[sizeof kGroups / sizeof kGroups[0]];          // programs found per group
std::string s_glast[sizeof kGroups / sizeof kGroups[0]];        // the group's file of its last find

// One file: load as stored, unpack if packed, search. false: not read (too big / failed). s_last_skipped: shader
// containers in it this build could not read (then it is not written to the done-list: a later build reads it).
uint32_t s_last_skipped;
bool read_file(const std::string& path, const Ent& e)
{
    s_last_skipped = 0;
    if (e.stored > kBufCap || e.unpacked > kUbufCap) { s_st.too_big++; return true; }   // never fits: done
    put_path(path);
    memset(vm_base + s_result, 0, 0x80);
    wr32(s_bufdesc, s_buf);
    wr32(s_bufdesc + 4, kBufCap);
    memset(vm_base + s_range, 0, 16);
    wr32(s_buf, 0);
    call(kLoad, s_result, s_path, 0, s_bufdesc, s_range, 0);
    if (rd32(s_result) != 0) { s_st.failed++; return false; }
    uint32_t data = s_buf, size = e.stored;
    if (rd32(s_buf) == 0xC5EEF7FFu) {   // packed: C5 EE F7 FF, then minus the unpacked size (little-endian)
        const uint32_t usize = 0u - __builtin_bswap32(rd32(s_buf + 4));
        if (usize == 0 || usize > kUbufCap) { s_st.too_big++; return true; }
        memset(vm_base + s_state, 0, 0x2000);
        call(kUnpack, s_state, s_ubuf, s_buf, 1);
        call(kUnpackEnd, s_state);
        data = s_ubuf;
        size = usize;
    }
    uint32_t found = 0, known = 0, vert = 0;
    if (s_list_mode) rsx_shader_prep_scan_guest(data, size, &found, &known, &vert);
    s_st.files++; s_st.stored += e.stored; s_st.unpacked += size; s_st.found += found; s_st.found_v += vert;
    if (s_found_mode) {   // [found] every container in it, every program of them
        uint32_t c = 0, a = 0, v = 0, sk = 0;
        rsx_shader_prep_take_shds(data, size, &c, &a, &v, &sk);
        s_last_skipped = sk;
        s_st.containers += c; s_st.added += a; s_st.added_v += v; s_st.skipped += sk;
        if (sk) s_st.files_skipped++;
        // LD_FOUND_DUMP=<folder>: the first 6 files with a container not read, whole, unpacked (to work out why;
        // the game's data: for this PC only)
        static int dumped;
        const char* dd = getenv("LD_FOUND_DUMP");
        if (sk && dd && dd[0] && dumped < 6) {
            std::string fn = std::string(dd) + "\\";
            for (char ch : path) fn += (ch == '/' || ch == '\\' || ch == ':') ? '_' : ch;
            fn += ".bin";
            CreateDirectoryA(dd, nullptr);
            if (FILE* f = fopen(fn.c_str(), "wb")) {
                fwrite(vm_base + data, 1, size, f);
                fclose(f);
                dumped++;
                fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume: dumped %s (%u bytes, %u containers not read) to %s\n", path.c_str(),
                        size, sk, fn.c_str());
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// A player driving: a race engine drives a car and is not paused (cellPad_race_pause_state() == 0) AND the
// controller or the keys were used within the last 3 s. The race engine alone is not enough: the title
// screen and the top menu run a demo race behind the menus, and car select and the pre-race screen keep a
// live one (19 Nov, D87: the reader slept through 78 s of menus). In a race the throttle is held; at the
// menus, the demo, replays, the pre-race and loading screens nobody holds anything for long, so the reader
// runs there (menu presses hold it back for 3 s each). A paused race (1) is not driving.
bool player_driving()
{
    if (cellPad_race_pause_state() != 0) return false;
    const unsigned long long now = cellPad_now_ms(), act = cellPad_last_activity_ms();
    return act && now >= act && now - act < 3000;
}

void reader_thread(ppu_context* ctx)
{
    s_self = ctx;
    s_reader_tid = ctx->thread_id;
    const double t0 = now_s();
    // The lists first (shader-prep reads them a few seconds in, also when there are none); then what to read
    // for: every container (the found store), the listed programs not known yet, or nothing.
    uint64_t hash = 0;
    const char* dir = nullptr;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2400 && !rsx_shader_prep_lists_ready(); i++) Sleep(250);
    const uint32_t unknown0 = rsx_shader_prep_scan_unknown(&hash, &dir);
    uint32_t known0 = 0, rules = 0;
    const char* fdir = rsx_shader_prep_found_dir(&known0, &rules);
    s_found_mode = fdir != nullptr;
    s_list_mode = unknown0 && dir;
    if (!s_found_mode && !s_list_mode) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume: %s: nothing to read\n",
                rsx_shader_prep_lists_ready() ? "every listed program is known" : "no shader list");
        return;
    }
    if (!dir) dir = fdir;
    // Reads that do not install (see above), or no reading at all.
    if (!find_install_hooks()) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume: the game's install check was not found in this executable: the volume is "
                        "not read (each file read would be copied to the hard disk)\n");
        return;
    }
    s_stack_hi = (uint32_t)((s_self->gpr[1] - 0x2000) & ~0xFull);   // call()'s frames are below this
    s_stack_lo = s_stack_hi - 0x40000u;
    s_path = galloc(1024); s_obj = galloc(0x200); s_result = galloc(0x80); s_bufdesc = galloc(16);
    s_range = galloc(16); s_state = galloc(0x2000); s_ent_cap = 4096; s_ent = galloc(s_ent_cap * 0x40);
    s_buf = galloc(kBufCap); s_ubuf = galloc(kUbufCap);
    if (!s_path || !s_obj || !s_result || !s_bufdesc || !s_range || !s_state || !s_ent || !s_buf || !s_ubuf) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume: no guest memory for the reader: not read this session\n");
        return;
    }
    // The done-list: its head, then one path a line; another head starts it over. The found store's: "found
    // <rules> load <addr> toc <addr>" (this release, these reading rules); the listed search's: "list <hash>"
    // (another shipped list).
    const std::string done_path = std::string(dir) + (s_found_mode ? "\\volume_found.txt" : "\\volume_read.txt");
    std::unordered_set<std::string> done;
    char head[96];
    if (s_found_mode) snprintf(head, sizeof head, "found %u load %08X toc %08X", rules, kLoad, kToc);
    else snprintf(head, sizeof head, "list %016llX", (unsigned long long)hash);
    if (FILE* f = fopen(done_path.c_str(), "r")) {
        char line[1100];
        bool same = fgets(line, sizeof line, f) && strncmp(line, head, strlen(head)) == 0;
        while (same && fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
            line[strcspn(line, "\r\n")] = 0;
            if (line[0]) done.insert(line);
        }
        fclose(f);
        if (!same) done.clear();
    }
    FILE* dl = fopen(done_path.c_str(), done.empty() ? "w" : "a");
    if (dl && done.empty()) fprintf(dl, "%s\n", head);
    // The volume's index: listing answers 4 until the game has read it.
    std::vector<std::vector<std::pair<std::string, Ent>>> todo(sizeof kGroups / sizeof kGroups[0]);
    std::vector<Ent> ents;
    int st = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 1200; i++) {
        st = list_dir(kGroups[0].dir, ents);
        if (st != 4 && st != -1) break;
        Sleep(250);
    }
    if (st != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume: the game's volume did not answer (status %d): not read this session\n", st);
        if (dl) fclose(dl);
        return;
    }
    size_t n_files = 0, n_before = 0;
    uint64_t n_bytes = 0;
    for (size_t g = 0; g < todo.size(); g++) {
        if (list_dir(kGroups[g].dir, ents) != 0) continue;
        for (const Ent& e : ents) {
            if (e.type != 1 || (kGroups[g].ending[0] && !ends_with(e.name, kGroups[g].ending))) continue;
            std::string p = std::string(kGroups[g].dir) + "/" + e.name;
            if (done.count(p)) { n_before++; continue; }
            n_files++; n_bytes += e.stored;
            todo[g].push_back({p, e});
        }
    }
    if (s_found_mode)
        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume: reading the game's model files for every shader program (%u known so "
                        "far)%s: %zu files (%.0f MB) in %zu groups, %zu read in earlier sessions\n", known0,
                s_list_mode ? " and the listed ones not seen yet" : "", n_files, n_bytes / 1048576.0, todo.size(),
                n_before);
    else
        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume: reading the game's model files for %u listed programs not seen yet: %zu "
                        "files (%.0f MB) in %zu groups, %zu read in earlier sessions\n",
                unknown0, n_files, n_bytes / 1048576.0, todo.size(), n_before);
    if (!n_files) {
        if (dl) fclose(dl);
        gfree(s_buf); gfree(s_ubuf); gfree(s_ent); gfree(s_state);
        return;
    }
    wrap_install_hooks();   // from here the reader's own opens do not install
    // In turns, one file of each group; the found store reads every one, the listed search alone stops when
    // nothing listed is unknown any more.
    size_t left = n_files, idx = 0;
    double last_line = 0, last_check = 0;
    bool said20 = false;
    std::vector<size_t> pos(todo.size(), 0);
    const char* why = "every file read";
    // The progress line: 20 s after the start, then once a minute, and at the end.
    auto progress = [&](uint32_t unknown, bool force) {
        const double t = now_s();
        if (!force && !(!said20 && t - t0 >= 20.0) && !(last_line && t - last_line >= 60.0)) return;
        said20 = true;
        last_line = t;
        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume t=%.0f s: %llu files read (%.0f MB, %.0f MB unpacked), %llu shader "
                        "containers, %llu programs new to the store (%llu vertex), %llu listed programs found (%llu "
                        "vertex), %u listed still unknown, %zu files left; waited %.0f s for the game's loads, %.0f s "
                        "while a player drove; %llu containers not read (in %llu files); reads without install: %ld "
                        "opens of the reader's, %ld installs declined\n",
                t - t0, (unsigned long long)s_st.files, s_st.stored / 1048576.0, s_st.unpacked / 1048576.0,
                (unsigned long long)s_st.containers, (unsigned long long)s_st.added, (unsigned long long)s_st.added_v,
                (unsigned long long)s_st.found, (unsigned long long)s_st.found_v, unknown, left, s_st.wait_load,
                s_st.wait_drive, (unsigned long long)s_st.skipped, (unsigned long long)s_st.files_skipped,
                (long)s_reader_opens, (long)s_installs_declined);
        // Per group: files read / programs found, and the file of the last find (which groups the last
        // programs come from, to order the groups better).
        std::string g;
        char one[160];
        for (size_t i = 0; i < todo.size(); i++) {
            snprintf(one, sizeof one, "%s%s%s %zu/%u%s%s", i ? ", " : "", kGroups[i].dir,
                     kGroups[i].ending[0] ? kGroups[i].ending : "", pos[i], s_gfound[i],
                     s_glast[i].empty() ? "" : " last ", s_glast[i].c_str());
            g += one;
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume groups (files read / programs found): %s\n", g.c_str());
    };
    uint32_t unknown = unknown0;
    while (left) {
        const size_t g = idx++ % todo.size();
        if (pos[g] >= todo[g].size()) continue;
        // The game first: no turn while it reads or while a player drives.
        if (now_s() - last_check >= 1.0) {
            for (;;) {
                progress(unknown, false);
                if (player_driving()) { Sleep(250); s_st.wait_drive += 0.25; continue; }
                const double w0 = now_s();
                if (game_reading()) { s_st.wait_load += now_s() - w0; continue; }
                break;
            }
            last_check = now_s();
        }
        const auto& item = todo[g][pos[g]++];
        left--;
        const uint64_t found_before = s_st.found + s_st.added;
        if (read_file(item.first, item.second) && dl && !s_last_skipped) {
            fprintf(dl, "%s\n", item.first.c_str());
            fflush(dl);
        }
        if (s_st.found + s_st.added > found_before) {
            s_gfound[g] += (uint32_t)(s_st.found + s_st.added - found_before);
            s_glast[g] = item.first.substr(item.first.rfind('/') + 1);
        }
        if (s_list_mode) unknown = rsx_shader_prep_scan_unknown(nullptr, nullptr);
        progress(unknown, !left || (s_list_mode && !unknown && !s_found_mode));
        if (s_list_mode && !unknown && !s_found_mode) { why = "every listed program is known"; break; }
        // Containers met and none of them readable by this build: stop (a later build reads these files again).
        if (s_found_mode && !s_st.containers && s_st.files_skipped >= 40) {
            why = "the shader containers in these files are not in a form this build reads";
            progress(unknown, true);
            break;
        }
    }
    if (dl) fclose(dl);
    gfree(s_buf); gfree(s_ubuf); gfree(s_ent); gfree(s_state);
    fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume: done (%s) after %.0f s: %llu files, %.0f MB read, %llu shader containers, "
                    "%llu programs new to the store (%llu vertex), %llu listed programs found, %llu too big, %llu not "
                    "read, %llu containers not read; reads without install: %ld opens of the reader's, %ld installs "
                    "declined\n", why, now_s() - t0, (unsigned long long)s_st.files, s_st.stored / 1048576.0,
            (unsigned long long)s_st.containers, (unsigned long long)s_st.added, (unsigned long long)s_st.added_v,
            (unsigned long long)s_st.found, (unsigned long long)s_st.too_big, (unsigned long long)s_st.failed,
            (unsigned long long)s_st.skipped, (long)s_reader_opens, (long)s_installs_declined);
    if (s_found_mode) {   // [found] everything to found.bin now, and what the files gave against what this PC drew
        rsx_shader_prep_found_flush();
        rsx_shader_prep_found_coverage();
    }
}

DWORD WINAPI starter(LPVOID)
{
    // Off the game's start: the search reads the 32 MB image a few times (well under a second).
    if (!find_functions()) return 0;
    // Started once the shader lists are read (the runtime and the game are up by then); the reader itself
    // waits for the volume (its listing answers once the game has mounted it and read its index).
    for (int i = 0; i < 2400 && !rsx_shader_prep_lists_ready(); i++) Sleep(250);
    if (!rsx_shader_prep_lists_ready()) return 0;
    const uint32_t opd = galloc(16), name = galloc(16), tid = galloc(8);
    if (!opd || !name || !tid) return 0;
    wr32(opd, opd);   // the descriptor's own address stands in for the function (registered below)
    wr32(opd + 4, kToc);
    wr32(opd + 8, 0);
    memcpy(vm_base + name, "volread", 8);
    ppu_register_function(opd, reader_thread);
    ppu_context c;
    memset(&c, 0, sizeof c);
    c.gpr[2] = kToc;
    c.gpr[3] = tid; c.gpr[4] = opd; c.gpr[5] = 0; c.gpr[6] = 3071; c.gpr[7] = 0x100000; c.gpr[8] = 0;
    c.gpr[9] = name;
    if (sys_ppu_thread_create(&c) != 0) fprintf(stderr, "[shader-prep] volume: the reader thread was not created\n");
    return 0;
}

void volread_loaded()
{
    const char* e = getenv("GT5_VOLREAD");
    if (e && atoi(e) == 0) return;
    HANDLE h = CreateThread(nullptr, 64u << 10, starter, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    if (h) CloseHandle(h);
}

const int s_registered = (ps3_on_loaded(volread_loaded), 0);

}  // namespace

#endif  // _WIN32

```

`GT5/src/gt5_widescreen.cpp`:

```cpp
// Ultrawide (wider than 16:9): GT5's own view setup, given the wider shape.
//
// GT5 draws for the shape of the TV. At start-up it reads the PS3's TV setting and hands its view
// setup a shape constant (16:9, or 4:3 for an old TV). The 3D cameras widen their view to that
// shape, keeping the height (Hor+), and the 2D layer (HUD, menus) keeps its 16:9 layout centred
// in it. The picture stays 1280x720, squeezed sideways, ready to be stretched by the TV. So a wider
// screen needs only those constants changed; the renderer then shows the picture across the wider
// window (display_aspect.c, rsx_live_draw.c).
//
// PS3_ASPECT or PS3_WINDOW_SIZE (play.bat) choose the shape. At 16:9, the default, nothing here
// touches the game.
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

extern "C" unsigned char* vm_base;
extern "C" float ps3_display_aspect(void);
extern "C" int ps3_display_wide(void);
extern "C" void ps3_display_title_widens(void);
extern "C" void ps3_on_loaded(void (*fn)(void));

namespace {

const uint32_t kShape16x9 = 0x3FE38E39;  // 16/9 as a big-endian float

struct ShapeConstant {
    uint32_t ea;
    const char* use;
};

// Europe BCES00569, disc executable 01.00. Each holds 16/9; the code reading it is noted.
const ShapeConstant kEurope0100[] = {
    {0x0186E2CC, "screen setup, picked when the TV setting is 16:9 (0x008CE594)"},
    {0x0186F910, "view setup for 3D scenes (0x0092D358, 0x0092D3BC, 0x0092E388)"},
};

uint32_t rd32(uint32_t ea)
{
    uint32_t v;
    memcpy(&v, vm_base + ea, 4);
    return __builtin_bswap32(v);
}

void wr32(uint32_t ea, uint32_t v)
{
    v = __builtin_bswap32(v);
    memcpy(vm_base + ea, &v, 4);
}

void gt5_widescreen_apply()
{
    for (const ShapeConstant& c : kEurope0100) {
        if (rd32(c.ea) != kShape16x9) {
            // Another release (or a changed executable): its constants live elsewhere, so the
            // runtime keeps the picture 16:9 rather than show a stretched one.
            fprintf(stderr, "[widescreen] no shape constants known for this executable (0x%08X holds 0x%08X):"
                            " 16:9 only\n", c.ea, rd32(c.ea));
            return;
        }
    }
    ps3_display_title_widens();
    if (!ps3_display_wide()) return;   // 16:9 asked (the default): the game is left as it is
    const float aspect = ps3_display_aspect();
    uint32_t bits;
    memcpy(&bits, &aspect, 4);
    for (const ShapeConstant& c : kEurope0100) wr32(c.ea, bits);
    fprintf(stderr, "[widescreen] game shape %.4f (16:9 is 1.7778): %u constants set\n", aspect,
            (unsigned)(sizeof kEurope0100 / sizeof kEurope0100[0]));
}

const int s_registered = (ps3_on_loaded(gt5_widescreen_apply), 0);

}  // namespace

```

```c
/*
 * gt5_binds.c - PS3_KEYS, PS3_WHEEL_BUTTONS and PS3_WHEEL_PEDALS as text (see gt5_binds.h).
 *
 * The keyboard half follows the launcher's KeyBinds class (GT5Launcher.cs) and the names
 * cellPad.c's kb_vk takes; the wheel half follows wheel_host_win.c's build_map. UTF-8.
 */
#include <ctype.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gt5_binds.h"

static int ieq(const char* a, const char* b)
{
    for (; *a && *b; a++, b++)
        if (tolower((unsigned char)*a) != tolower((unsigned char)*b)) return 0;
    return *a == *b;
}

/* ---- keyboard ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Windows virtual-key code -> the name the game takes. Letters, digits, F-keys and Num0-9 are made. */
static const struct { int vk; const char* name; } k_vk[] = {
    { 0x20, "Space" }, { 0x0D, "Enter" }, { 0x09, "Tab" }, { 0x08, "Backspace" }, { 0x26, "Up" }, { 0x28, "Down" },

#define N_VK ((int)(sizeof k_vk / sizeof k_vk[0]))

const char* gt5_kb_button(int b) { return b >= 0 && b < GT5_KB_BUTTONS ? k_kb[b].name : ""; }
const char* gt5_kb_action_label(int b, int zh)
{
    if (b < 0 || b >= GT5_KB_BUTTONS) return "";
    return zh ? k_kb[b].action_zh : k_kb[b].action_en;
}
const char* gt5_kb_button_label(int b, int zh)
{
    if (b < 0 || b >= GT5_KB_BUTTONS) return "";
    return zh ? k_kb[b].button_zh : k_kb[b].button_en;
}

/* Made names live here so a returned pointer stays good. */
static const char* made_name(int kind, int n)
{
    static char letters[26][2], digits[10][2], nums[10][5], fkeys[24][4];
    static int ready;
    if (!ready) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) { letters[i][0] = (char)('A' + i); letters[i][1] = 0; }
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) { digits[i][0] = (char)('0' + i); digits[i][1] = 0; snprintf(nums[i], sizeof nums[i], "Num%d", i); }
        for (int i = 0; i < 24; i++) snprintf(fkeys[i], sizeof fkeys[i], "F%d", i + 1);
        ready = 1;
    }
    switch (kind) {
    case 0: return letters[n];
    case 1: return digits[n];
    case 2: return nums[n];
    default: return fkeys[n];
    }
}

const char* gt5_kb_canon(const char* name)
{
    if (!name || !*name) return NULL;
    if (!name[1]) {
        const int c = toupper((unsigned char)name[0]);
        if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') return made_name(0, c - 'A');
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return made_name(1, c - '0');
    }
    if ((name[0] == 'N' || name[0] == 'n') && (name[1] == 'U' || name[1] == 'u') && (name[2] == 'M' || name[2] == 'm') &&
        name[3] >= '0' && name[3] <= '9' && !name[4])
        return made_name(2, name[3] - '0');
    if ((name[0] == 'F' || name[0] == 'f') && isdigit((unsigned char)name[1])) {
        char* end;
        const long n = strtol(name + 1, &end, 10);
        if (!*end && n >= 1 && n <= 24) return made_name(3, (int)n - 1);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < N_VK; i++) if (ieq(k_vk[i].name, name)) return k_vk[i].name;
    return NULL;
}

int gt5_kb_vk(const char* name)
{
    const char* c = gt5_kb_canon(name);
    if (!c) return 0;
    if (!c[1]) return c[0];                                        /* A-Z, 0-9 are their own codes */
    if (c[0] == 'N' && c[1] == 'u' && c[2] == 'm' && isdigit((unsigned char)c[3]) && !c[4]) return 0x60 + (c[3] - '0');
    if (c[0] == 'F' && isdigit((unsigned char)c[1])) return 0x70 + atoi(c + 1) - 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < N_VK; i++) if (k_vk[i].name == c) return k_vk[i].vk;
    return 0;
}

const char* gt5_kb_key_from_vk(int vk, long long lparam)
{
    const int ext = (lparam & 0x01000000) != 0;
    const int scan = (int)((lparam >> 16) & 0xFF);
    if (vk == 0x10) vk = scan == 0x36 ? 0xA1 : 0xA0;   /* Shift: the right one has its own scan code */
    if (vk == 0x11) vk = ext ? 0xA3 : 0xA2;
    if (vk == 0x12) vk = ext ? 0xA5 : 0xA4;
    if (vk >= 'A' && vk <= 'Z') return made_name(0, vk - 'A');
    if (vk >= '0' && vk <= '9') return made_name(1, vk - '0');
    if (vk >= 0x70 && vk <= 0x87) return made_name(3, vk - 0x70);
    if (vk >= 0x60 && vk <= 0x69) return made_name(2, vk - 0x60);
    for (int i = 0; i < N_VK; i++) if (k_vk[i].vk == vk) return k_vk[i].name;
    return NULL;
}

const char* gt5_kb_pretty(const char* k)
{
    if (!k) return "";
    if (!strcmp(k, "LAlt")) return "Left Alt";
    if (!strcmp(k, "RAlt")) return "Right Alt";
    if (!strcmp(k, "LCtrl")) return "Left Ctrl";
    if (!strcmp(k, "RCtrl")) return "Right Ctrl";
    if (!strcmp(k, "LShift")) return "Left Shift";
    if (!strcmp(k, "RShift")) return "Right Shift";
    return k;
}

int gt5_kb_count(const gt5_keymap* m, int b)
{
    int n = 0;
    while (n < GT5_KB_KEYS && m->key[b][n][0]) n++;
    return n;
}
static int kb_has(const gt5_keymap* m, int b, const char* key)
{
    for (int k = 0; k < GT5_KB_KEYS; k++) if (m->key[b][k][0] && !strcmp(m->key[b][k], key)) return 1;
    return 0;
}
static void kb_remove(gt5_keymap* m, int b, const char* key)
{
    for (int k = 0; k < GT5_KB_KEYS; k++) {
        if (!m->key[b][k][0] || strcmp(m->key[b][k], key)) continue;
        for (int j = k; j < GT5_KB_KEYS - 1; j++) memcpy(m->key[b][j], m->key[b][j + 1], sizeof m->key[b][j]);
        m->key[b][GT5_KB_KEYS - 1][0] = 0;
        k--;
    }
}
static void kb_add(gt5_keymap* m, int b, const char* key)
{
    const int n = gt5_kb_count(m, b);
    if (n < GT5_KB_KEYS && !kb_has(m, b, key)) snprintf(m->key[b][n], sizeof m->key[b][n], "%s", key);
}

void gt5_kb_clear(gt5_keymap* m, int b) { if (b >= 0 && b < GT5_KB_BUTTONS) memset(m->key[b], 0, sizeof m->key[b]); }

void gt5_kb_defaults(gt5_keymap* m)
{
    memset(m, 0, sizeof *m);
    for (int b = 0; b < GT5_KB_BUTTONS; b++) if (k_kb[b].def[0]) kb_add(m, b, k_kb[b].def);
}

void gt5_kb_parse(const char* s, gt5_keymap* m)
{
    gt5_keymap bound;
    int is_bound[GT5_KB_BUTTONS];
    memset(&bound, 0, sizeof bound);
    memset(is_bound, 0, sizeof is_bound);
    gt5_kb_defaults(m);
    char buf[2048];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s", s ? s : "");
    for (char* item = buf; item && *item; ) {
        char* next = strchr(item, ',');
        if (next) *next++ = 0;
        char* colon = strchr(item, ':');
        if (colon) {
            *colon = 0;
            char* bn = item;
            while (*bn == ' ' || *bn == '\t') bn++;
            { char* e = bn + strlen(bn); while (e > bn && (e[-1] == ' ' || e[-1] == '\t')) *--e = 0; }
            int b = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < GT5_KB_BUTTONS; i++) if (ieq(bn, k_kb[i].name)) b = i;
            if (b >= 0) {
                is_bound[b] = 1;
                for (char* k = colon + 1; k; ) {
                    char* slash = strchr(k, '/');
                    if (slash) *slash++ = 0;
                    while (*k == ' ' || *k == '\t') k++;
                    { char* e = k + strlen(k); while (e > k && (e[-1] == ' ' || e[-1] == '\t' || e[-1] == '\r' || e[-1] == '\n')) *--e = 0; }
                    const char* c = gt5_kb_canon(k);
                    if (c) kb_add(&bound, b, c);
                    k = slash;
                }
            }
        }
        item = next;
    }
    for (int b = 0; b < GT5_KB_BUTTONS; b++) if (is_bound[b]) memcpy(m->key[b], bound.key[b], sizeof m->key[b]);
    /* A default key that a binding took leaves its old button. */
    for (int b = 0; b < GT5_KB_BUTTONS; b++) {
        if (is_bound[b]) continue;
        for (int o = 0; o < GT5_KB_BUTTONS; o++) {
            if (!is_bound[o]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < GT5_KB_KEYS; k++) if (bound.key[o][k][0]) kb_remove(m, b, bound.key[o][k]);
        }
    }
}

size_t gt5_kb_format(const gt5_keymap* m, char* buf, size_t cap)
{
    size_t n = 0;
    if (cap) buf[0] = 0;
    for (int b = 0; b < GT5_KB_BUTTONS; b++) {
        const int cur = gt5_kb_count(m, b);
        const int def = k_kb[b].def[0] ? 1 : 0;
        const int same = cur == def && (!def || !strcmp(m->key[b][0], k_kb[b].def));
        if (same) continue;
        char part[128];
        size_t pn = (size_t)snprintf(part, sizeof part, "%s%s:", n ? "," : "", k_kb[b].name);
        if (!cur) pn += (size_t)snprintf(part + pn, sizeof part - pn, "none");
        for (int k = 0; k < cur; k++) pn += (size_t)snprintf(part + pn, sizeof part - pn, "%s%s", k ? "/" : "", m->key[b][k]);
        if (n + pn + 1 > cap) break;
        memcpy(buf + n, part, pn + 1);
        n += pn;
    }
    return n;
}

void gt5_kb_bind(gt5_keymap* m, int b, const char* key, int add)
{
    const char* c = gt5_kb_canon(key);
    if (!c || b < 0 || b >= GT5_KB_BUTTONS) return;
    for (int o = 0; o < GT5_KB_BUTTONS; o++) if (o != b) kb_remove(m, o, c);   /* a key used elsewhere moves here */
    if (!add) gt5_kb_clear(m, b);
    kb_add(m, b, c);
}

/* ---- wheel ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

static const struct { const char* name; const char* en; const char* zh; } k_wheel[GT5_WHEEL_BUTTONS] = {
    { "cross", "Cross", "✕" }, { "square", "Square", "□" }, { "circle", "Circle", "○" }, { "triangle", "Triangle", "△" },
    { "r1", "R1 (right paddle: shift up)", "R1（右拨片：升挡）" }, { "l1", "L1 (left paddle: shift down)", "L1（左拨片：降挡）" },
    { "r2", "R2", "R2" }, { "l2", "L2", "L2" },
    { "select", "Select", "Select" }, { "start", "Start", "Start" }, { "r3", "R3", "R3" }, { "l3", "L3", "L3" },
    { "gear1", "Shifter: 1st gear", "排挡杆：1 挡" }, { "gear2", "Shifter: 2nd gear", "排挡杆：2 挡" },
    { "gear3", "Shifter: 3rd gear", "排挡杆：3 挡" }, { "gear4", "Shifter: 4th gear", "排挡杆：4 挡" },
    { "gear5", "Shifter: 5th gear", "排挡杆：5 挡" }, { "gear6", "Shifter: 6th gear", "排挡杆：6 挡" },
    { "gearr", "Shifter: reverse", "排挡杆：倒挡" },
    { "plus", "+ button", "+ 按钮" }, { "minus", "- button", "- 按钮" },
    { "dialcw", "Dial, clockwise", "旋钮顺时针" }, { "dialccw", "Dial, anticlockwise", "旋钮逆时针" },
    { "up", "D-pad up", "十字键上" }, { "right", "D-pad right", "十字键右" },
    { "down", "D-pad down", "十字键下" }, { "left", "D-pad left", "十字键左" },
    { "throttle", "Throttle on a button", "用按钮代替油门" }, { "brake", "Brake on a button", "用按钮代替刹车" },
    { "clutch", "Clutch on a button", "用按钮代替离合" },
};
static const char* const k_axis[GT5_WHEEL_AXES] = { "X", "Y", "Z", "RX", "RY", "RZ", "S0", "S1" };
static const struct { const char* name; const char* en; const char* zh; } k_pedal[3] = {
    { "throttle", "Throttle", "油门" }, { "brake", "Brake", "刹车" }, { "clutch", "Clutch", "离合" },
};

const char* gt5_wheel_button(int i) { return i >= 0 && i < GT5_WHEEL_BUTTONS ? k_wheel[i].name : ""; }
const char* gt5_wheel_button_label(int i, int zh)
{
    if (i < 0 || i >= GT5_WHEEL_BUTTONS) return "";
    return zh ? k_wheel[i].zh : k_wheel[i].en;
}
const char* gt5_wheel_axis(int a) { return a >= 0 && a < GT5_WHEEL_AXES ? k_axis[a] : "none"; }
const char* gt5_wheel_pedal_label(int p, int zh)
{
    if (p < 0 || p >= 3) return "";
    return zh ? k_pedal[p].zh : k_pedal[p].en;
}

void gt5_wheel_parse(const char* buttons, const char* pedals, gt5_wheelmap* m)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < GT5_WHEEL_BUTTONS; i++) m->btn[i] = -1;
    for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) { m->pedal_axis[p] = -2; m->pedal_inv[p] = 0; }
    char buf[1024];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s", buttons ? buttons : "");
    for (char* c = buf; *c; c++) *c = (char)tolower((unsigned char)*c);
    for (char* tok = strtok(buf, ",; "); tok; tok = strtok(NULL, ",; ")) {
        char* eq = strchr(tok, '=');
        if (!eq) continue;
        *eq = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < GT5_WHEEL_BUTTONS; i++)
            if (!strcmp(tok, k_wheel[i].name)) { const int n = atoi(eq + 1); m->btn[i] = n > 0 ? n : 0; }
    }
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s", pedals ? pedals : "");
    for (char* c = buf; *c; c++) *c = (char)tolower((unsigned char)*c);
    for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
        const char* at = strstr(buf, k_pedal[p].name);
        const size_t len = strlen(k_pedal[p].name);
        if (!at || at[len] != '=') continue;
        char n[16];
        int i = 0;
        for (const char* s = at + len + 1; s[i] && s[i] != ',' && i < 15; i++) n[i] = (char)toupper((unsigned char)s[i]);
        n[i] = 0;
        int inv = 0;
        char* q = strstr(n, "INV");
        if (q) { *q = 0; inv = 1; }
        int a = -2;
        for (int x = 0; x < GT5_WHEEL_AXES; x++) if (!strcmp(n, k_axis[x])) a = x;
        if (!strcmp(n, "SLIDER") || !strcmp(n, "SLIDER0")) a = 6;
        if (!strcmp(n, "NONE")) a = -1;
        if (a == -2) continue;
        m->pedal_axis[p] = a;
        m->pedal_inv[p] = inv;
    }
}

size_t gt5_wheel_format_buttons(const gt5_wheelmap* m, char* buf, size_t cap)
{
    size_t n = 0;
    if (cap) buf[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < GT5_WHEEL_BUTTONS; i++) {
        if (m->btn[i] < 0) continue;
        char part[48];
        const size_t pn = (size_t)snprintf(part, sizeof part, "%s%s=%d", n ? "," : "", k_wheel[i].name, m->btn[i]);
        if (n + pn + 1 > cap) break;
        memcpy(buf + n, part, pn + 1);
        n += pn;
    }
    return n;
}

size_t gt5_wheel_format_pedals(const gt5_wheelmap* m, char* buf, size_t cap)
{
    size_t n = 0;
    if (cap) buf[0] = 0;
    for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
        if (m->pedal_axis[p] == -2) continue;
        char part[48];
        const size_t pn = (size_t)snprintf(part, sizeof part, "%s%s=%s%s", n ? "," : "", k_pedal[p].name,
                                           gt5_wheel_axis(m->pedal_axis[p]),
                                           m->pedal_axis[p] >= 0 && m->pedal_inv[p] ? "inv" : "");
        if (n + pn + 1 > cap) break;
        memcpy(buf + n, part, pn + 1);
        n += pn;
    }
    return n;
}
```
