```cpp
void ui_opened()
{
    ui.sub = SUB_NONE;
    ui.bind = BIND_NONE;
    ui.in_content = false;
    ui.focus_nav = true;
    ui.focus_content = false;
    ui.focus_key[0] = 0;
    ui.focus_row = -1;
    ui.popup_was_open = false;
    ui.help_key[0] = 0;
    ui.help_text[0] = 0;
    ui.scrolled_to[0] = 0;
    ui.shown_page = -1;
    // Vulkan can only be picked once the launcher has built it into gt5.exe (then SDL2.dll sits next to it).
    wchar_t exe[MAX_PATH];
    const DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, exe, MAX_PATH);
    if (n && n < MAX_PATH - 12) {
        wchar_t* cut = wcsrchr(exe, L'\\');
        if (cut) { wcscpy_s(cut + 1, (size_t)(MAX_PATH - (cut + 1 - exe)), L"SDL2.dll");
                   gt5_setting_choice_enable("GT5_RENDERER", "vulkan", GetFileAttributesW(exe) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES); }
    }
}

void ui_key_taken(const char* name)
{
    if (ui.bind == BIND_KEY_ROW) {
        ui.focus_row = ui.bind_row;
        if (name) { gt5_kb_bind(&ui.keys, ui.bind_row, name, ui.bind_add); save_keys(); }
    } else if (ui.bind == BIND_MENU_KEY) {
        if (name && strncmp(name, "Mouse", 5)) { gt5_setting_set("GT5_MENU_KEY", !strcmp(name, "F1") ? "" : name); note_changed(); }
        snprintf(ui.focus_key, sizeof ui.focus_key, "GT5_MENU_KEY");
    }
    ui.bind = BIND_NONE;
}

// ---- the corner readout ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

void ui_build_osd()
{
    sample_fps();
    gt5_menu_stats st;
    if (!stats_get(&st)) return;
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(S(16), S(16)));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowBgAlpha(0.55f);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(S(12), S(8)));
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowBorderSize, 0.0f);
    ImGui::Begin("##osd", nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
                                   ImGuiWindowFlags_NoInputs | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoFocusOnAppearing | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNav | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove);
    ImGui::PushFont(nullptr, small_px());
    stats_lines(st, true);
    ImGui::PopFont();
    ImGui::End();
    ImGui::PopStyleVar(2);
}

// ---- [win] "Quit the game?" ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Asked over the game (Esc, the window's X, Alt+F4) or over the menu (its About page). Two buttons, No
// with the focus; Enter or Cross takes the one with the focus, Esc or Circle is No, the mouse clicks.
void ui_build_quit()
{
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    const float W = io.DisplaySize.x, H = io.DisplaySize.y;
    ImGui::SetNavCursorVisible(ui.keyboard_last);
    ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList()->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(0, 0), ImVec2(W, H), IM_COL32(4, 6, 10, 150));
    const float b = base_px();
    const char* yes = T("Yes", "是");
    const char* no = T("No", "否");
    const char* q = T("Quit the game?", "退出游戏？");
    float bw = ImGui::CalcTextSize(yes).x > ImGui::CalcTextSize(no).x ? ImGui::CalcTextSize(yes).x : ImGui::CalcTextSize(no).x;
    bw = floorf(bw + S(72));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(floorf(W * 0.5f), floorf(H * 0.5f)), ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(0.5f, 0.5f));
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(S(36), S(28)));
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered, kNavHot);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonActive, kBlue);       // not the red: nothing is wrong
    ImGui::Begin("##quit", nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
                                    ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar);
    ImGui::PushFont(nullptr, b * 1.3f);
    const float qw = ImGui::CalcTextSize(q).x;
    const float row = bw * 2.0f + S(16);
    if (row > qw) ImGui::SetCursorPosX(ImGui::GetCursorPosX() + floorf((row - qw) * 0.5f));
    ImGui::TextUnformatted(q);
    ImGui::PopFont();
    ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0, S(14)));
    if (qw > row) ImGui::SetCursorPosX(ImGui::GetCursorPosX() + floorf((qw - row) * 0.5f));
    bool said_yes = ImGui::Button(yes, ImVec2(bw, b * 2.0f));
    ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, S(16));
    if (ui.quit_focus) { ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere(); ui.quit_focus = false; }
    bool said_no = ImGui::Button(no, ImVec2(bw, b * 2.0f));
    ImGui::End();
    ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, false)) said_no = true;
    if (said_yes) quit_answer(true);
    else if (said_no) quit_answer(false);
}

// ---- [win] the first-start hint ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

void ui_build_hint(float alpha)
{
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    char key[32], name[48], text[160];
    gt5_setting_stored("GT5_MENU_KEY", key, sizeof key);
    key_names(key, name, sizeof name);
    char pad_mode[16];
    gt5_setting_stored("GT5_MENU_PAD", pad_mode, sizeof pad_mode);
    const char* chord = !_stricmp(pad_mode, "off") ? nullptr : !_stricmp(pad_mode, "l3r3") ? "L3+R3" : "Select+Start";
    if (chord && pad_connected()) snprintf(text, sizeof text, T("%s / %s: settings", "%s / %s：设置"), name, chord);
    else snprintf(text, sizeof text, T("%s: settings", "%s：设置"), name);
    ImGui::PushFont(nullptr, base_px());
    const ImVec2 ts = ImGui::CalcTextSize(text);
    ImGui::PopFont();
    const ImVec2 pad(S(16), S(10));
    const float m = S(24);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(floorf(io.DisplaySize.x - m - ts.x - pad.x * 2.0f), floorf(io.DisplaySize.y - m - ts.y - pad.y * 2.0f)));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowBgAlpha(0.72f * alpha);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, pad);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowBorderSize, 0.0f);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_Alpha, alpha);
    ImGui::Begin("##hint", nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
                                    ImGuiWindowFlags_NoInputs | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoFocusOnAppearing | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNav | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove);
    ImGui::PushFont(nullptr, base_px());
    ImGui::TextUnformatted(text);
    ImGui::PopFont();
    ImGui::End();
    ImGui::PopStyleVar(3);
}

// ---- notices: a few plain words, top right, while the menu is closed ----------------------------------

void ui_build_notices()
{
    char lines[GT5_NOTICE_COUNT][192];
    const int n = notices_get(lines, GT5_NOTICE_COUNT);
    if (!n) return;
    const ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(io.DisplaySize.x - S(16), S(16)), ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(1.0f, 0.0f));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowBgAlpha(0.7f);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(S(14), S(10)));
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowBorderSize, 0.0f);
    ImGui::Begin("##notices", nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
                                       ImGuiWindowFlags_NoInputs | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoFocusOnAppearing | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNav | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ImGui::TextUnformatted(lines[i]);
    ImGui::End();
    ImGui::PopStyleVar(2);
}

// ---- the menu -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

void ui_build(const PadEdges& pad)
{
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    const float W = io.DisplaySize.x, H = io.DisplaySize.y;
    sample_fps();
    ImGui::SetNavCursorVisible(ui.keyboard_last);
    memset(&ui.tv, 0, sizeof ui.tv);
    ui.tv.small_px = small_px();

    // Back: out of a wait, out of a map, out of a page, out of the menu. Not when the press closed a
    // list or let go of a slider (Dear ImGui has dealt with it then).
    const bool waiting = ui.bind != BIND_NONE;
    bool back = !ui.popup_was_open && (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, false));
    if (waiting) {
        if (back) { if (ui.sub != SUB_NONE) ui.focus_row = ui.bind == BIND_WHEEL_PEDAL ? GT5_WHEEL_BUTTONS + ui.bind_row : ui.bind_row; bind_cancel(); }
        back = false;
    }
    if (back) {
        if (ui.sub != SUB_NONE) {
            snprintf(ui.focus_key, sizeof ui.focus_key, "%s", ui.sub == SUB_KEYS ? "PS3_KEYS" : "PS3_WHEEL_BUTTONS");
            ui.sub = SUB_NONE;
        } else if (ui.in_content) {
            ui.in_content = false; ui.focus_nav = true;
            ui.focus_content = false; ui.focus_key[0] = 0;   // a focus still on its way into the page is called off
        } else {
            request_close();
        }
    }
    if (!waiting && !ui.popup_was_open && ui.sub == SUB_NONE) {
        int turn = 0;
        if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadL1, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_PageUp, false)) turn = -1;
        if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadR1, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_PageDown, false)) turn = 1;
        if (turn) {
            ui.page = (ui.page + turn + GT5_PAGE_COUNT) % GT5_PAGE_COUNT;
            if (ui.in_content) ui.focus_content = true; else ui.focus_nav = true;
        }
    }

    // the game behind, dimmed
    ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList()->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(0, 0), ImVec2(W, H), IM_COL32(4, 6, 10, 150));

    // The panel: the window less a margin, at most about 1500 x 1010 at 100 % (68 x 46 lines of text),
    // in the middle.
    const float b = base_px();
    float pw = W - 2.0f * clampf(W * 0.03f, S(8), S(48)), ph = H - 2.0f * clampf(H * 0.04f, S(8), S(56));
    if (pw > b * 68.0f) pw = b * 68.0f;
    if (ph > b * 46.0f) ph = b * 46.0f;
    pw = floorf(pw); ph = floorf(ph);
    const bool tight = pw < b * 40.0f;           // a narrow window: less padding, a narrower page list
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(floorf(W * 0.5f), floorf(H * 0.5f)), ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(0.5f, 0.5f));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(pw, ph));
    if (tight) ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(S(14), S(14)));
    ImGui::Begin("##gt5menu", nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
                                       ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollWithMouse | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBringToFrontOnFocus);
    if (tight) ImGui::PopStyleVar();
    rect_out(ui.tv.panel, ImGui::GetWindowPos(), ImVec2(ImGui::GetWindowPos().x + pw, ImGui::GetWindowPos().y + ph));
    {
        ImFontBaked* baked = ImGui::GetFontBaked();
        const ImFontGlyph* g = baked->FindGlyph((ImWchar)'H');
        ui.tv.cap_px = g ? g->Y1 - g->Y0 : 0.0f;
        ui.tv.density = baked->RasterizerDensity;
    }
    const float inner_w = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;

    // the top line: "Settings", the game's name when there is room, "Saved" on the right
    {
        const double t = now_s();
        const char* note = ui.save_failed ? T("Settings couldn't be saved", "无法保存设置")
                         : (ui.saved_at != 0 && t - ui.saved_at < 2.5) ? T("Saved", "已保存") : nullptr;
        ImGui::PushFont(nullptr, b * 1.3f);
        const float title_w = ImGui::CalcTextSize(T("Settings", "设置")).x;
        ImGui::TextUnformatted(T("Settings", "设置"));
        ImGui::PopFont();
        const float note_w = note ? ImGui::CalcTextSize(note).x : 0.0f;
        const float name_w = ImGui::CalcTextSize(title_text()).x + S(20);
        if (title_w + name_w + note_w + S(40) < inner_w) {
            ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, S(20));
            ImGui::SetCursorPosY(ImGui::GetCursorPosY() + b * 0.36f);
            ImGui::TextColored(kDim, "%s", title_text());
        }
        if (note) {
            ImGui::SameLine(ImGui::GetWindowWidth() - note_w - ImGui::GetStyle().WindowPadding.x);
            ImGui::TextColored(ui.save_failed ? kAccentHot : kLive, "%s", note);
        }
    }
    ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0, S(2)));

    // sizes: page list | page, the help under them, the keys at the bottom (one line, or two in a
    // narrow window that has the height)
    const bool low = H < b * 30.0f;
    char close[64];
    Hints hints = hints_now(close, sizeof close);
    ImGui::PushFont(nullptr, small_px());
    if (low) hints_one_line(&hints, inner_w);
    const float hint_h = (float)hint_lines(hints, inner_w) * ImGui::GetTextLineHeightWithSpacing();
    ImGui::PopFont();
    const float avail_h = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().y - hint_h - ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.y * 2.0f;
    // The help box: as tall as the longest help needs at this width (one size while the focus moves),
    // never under three lines and never more than two fifths of the room. When that would leave the
    // page less than about four rows, there is no box: the focused row shows its help itself.
    float help_h = help_box_need(inner_w - S(18) * 2.0f, S(12));
    if (help_h < b * 3.4f) help_h = b * 3.4f;
    if (help_h > avail_h * 0.42f) help_h = avail_h * 0.42f;
    help_h = floorf(help_h);
    (void)help_h;
    g_inline_help = true;                       // no box under the page: a row's few words show under it when it has the focus
    g_show_heading = avail_h >= b * 14.0f;
    ui.tv.help_inline = g_inline_help;
    const float body_h = floorf(g_inline_help ? avail_h + ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.y : avail_h - help_h);
    float nav_w = 0.0f;
    for (int p = 0; p < GT5_PAGE_COUNT; p++) { const float w = ImGui::CalcTextSize(page_name(p)).x; if (w > nav_w) nav_w = w; }
    nav_w = floorf(nav_w + S(tight ? 20 : 28) * 2.0f + S(8) * 2.0f);
    if (nav_w < S(110)) nav_w = S(110);
    // the page list's entries share its height, two lines of text each at most (1.4 at least: in a
    // very low window the list scrolls, with the wheel or as the focus moves)
    const float entry_h = floorf(clampf((body_h - S(8) * 2.0f) / (float)GT5_PAGE_COUNT - ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.y, b * 1.4f, b * 2.0f));

    // the page list
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ChildBg, kNav);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(S(8), S(8)));
    ImGui::BeginChild("##nav", ImVec2(nav_w, body_h), ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar);
    bool nav_focused = false;
    for (int p = 0; p < GT5_PAGE_COUNT; p++) {
        if (ui.focus_nav && p == ui.page) { ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere(); ui.focus_nav = false; }
        const bool sel = p == ui.page;
        if (sel) ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Header, kAccent);
        ImGui::PushID(p);
        const bool pressed = ImGui::Selectable("##page", sel, 0, ImVec2(0, entry_h));
        ImGui::PopID();
        if (sel) ImGui::PopStyleColor();
        const ImVec2 a = ImGui::GetItemRectMin(), z = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
        rect_out(ui.tv.nav[p], a, z);
        ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddText(ImVec2(a.x + S(tight ? 12 : 18), floorf((a.y + z.y - ImGui::GetTextLineHeight()) * 0.5f)),
                                            ImGui::GetColorU32(sel ? kText : kDim), page_name(p));
        const bool foc = ImGui::IsItemFocused();
        if (foc) nav_focused = true;
        // The page follows the focus while it moves in the page list (not when the focus only passes
        // through on its way into a page).
        if (foc && !sel && ui.keyboard_last && !ui.focus_nav && !ui.in_content) { ui.page = p; ui.sub = SUB_NONE; bind_cancel(); }
        if (pressed) { ui.page = p; ui.sub = SUB_NONE; bind_cancel(); ui.in_content = true; ui.focus_content = true; }
    }
    if (nav_focused) {
        ui.in_content = false;
        if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_RightArrow, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadRight, false)) {
            ImGui::NavMoveRequestCancel();
            ui.in_content = true; ui.focus_content = true;
        } else if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_LeftArrow, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadLeft, false)) {
            ImGui::NavMoveRequestCancel();
        }
        if (!g_inline_help) set_help_text(help_nav());
    }
    ImGui::NavMoveRequestTryWrapping(ImGui::GetCurrentWindow(), ImGuiNavMoveFlags_LoopY);
    ImGui::EndChild();
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();

    // the page
    ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, S(tight ? 8 : 12));
    if (ui.page != ui.shown_page || ui.sub != ui.shown_sub) {      // another page or map: from its top
        ImGui::SetNextWindowScroll(ImVec2(0.0f, 0.0f));
        ui.shown_page = ui.page; ui.shown_sub = ui.sub;
        ui.scrolled_to[0] = 0;
    }
    if (tight) ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(S(14), S(12)));
    ImGui::BeginChild("##page", ImVec2(0, body_h), ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding, 0);
    if (tight) ImGui::PopStyleVar();
    {
        const ImRect& r = ImGui::GetCurrentWindow()->InnerRect;
        rect_out(ui.tv.page, r.Min, r.Max);
    }
    g_rows = RowState();
    if (ui.sub == SUB_KEYS) keys_screen(pad);
    else if (ui.sub == SUB_WHEEL) wheel_screen(pad);
    else if (ui.page == GT5_PAGE_ABOUT) about_page();
    else settings_page(ui.page, pad);
    if (g_rows.any_focus) ui.in_content = true;
    else ui.scrolled_to[0] = 0;
    ui.focus_content = false;          // asked for and nothing took it (an empty page): don't carry it over
    ui.focus_row = -1;
    if (pad.ry != 0.0f) ImGui::SetScrollY(ImGui::GetScrollY() + pad.ry * S(1100) * io.DeltaTime);
    ImGui::NavMoveRequestTryWrapping(ImGui::GetCurrentWindow(), ImGuiNavMoveFlags_LoopY);
    ImGui::EndChild();

    if (!g_inline_help) {
        footer(help_h);
        ui.tv.help_cut = g_help_needs > help_h + 1.0f;
    }

    // the keys
    ImGui::PushFont(nullptr, small_px());
    ImGui::SetCursorPosY(ImGui::GetCursorPosY() + S(2));
    hint_draw(hints, inner_w);
    ImGui::PopFont();
    ImGui::End();

    ui.popup_was_open = ImGui::IsPopupOpen("", ImGuiPopupFlags_AnyPopup) || ImGui::IsAnyItemActive();
}

}  // namespace gt5m

```

`GT5/src/menu/gt5_menu_vk.cpp`:

```cpp
// gt5_menu_vk.cpp - the in-game settings menu drawn with Vulkan (the API in gt5_menu_vk.h). The window,
// the input, the sizes and what is drawn are shared with the Direct3D 12 renderer (gt5_menu.cpp,
// gt5_menu_ui.cpp); this file has only the drawing. Dear ImGui's Vulkan renderer backend
// (imgui_impl_vulkan, with VK_NO_PROTOTYPES: every function from the renderer's loader) is used as it is.
//
// The renderer (rsx_vulkan_backend.c) copies each frame into a swap chain image that is the window's size
// and presents it from two threads: the one that draws (the window's) and, with frame generation, a
// presenter of its own. So the menu is drawn on the window's thread into an overlay image of the swap
// chain's size (transparent where there is no menu: premultiplied alpha, as Dear ImGui's blending leaves
// it), and whoever presents puts the overlay over the image after its copy, with one small render pass
// (gt5_menu_vk_composite). The overlay is laid out in the window's pixels like the D3D12 one; here the
// swap chain already has the window's size, so it is drawn one to one. UTF-8.
#ifndef VK_NO_PROTOTYPES
#define VK_NO_PROTOTYPES
#endif
#include "gt5_menu_internal.h"

#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gt5_menu_vk.h"
#include "imgui_impl_vulkan.h"

namespace gt5m {
namespace {

enum { RING = 4, MAX_IMAGES = 8 };

//   vertex:    void main() { vec2 p = vec2((gl_VertexIndex << 1) & 2, gl_VertexIndex & 2);
//                            gl_Position = vec4(p * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
//   fragment:  layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D overlay; layout(location = 0) out vec4 color;
//              void main() { color = texelFetch(overlay, ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy), 0); }

// The Vulkan functions this file calls, from the renderer's loader (the runtime loads vulkan-1.dll at
// run time; nothing here links to it).
#define GT5M_VK_FNS(X) \
    X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties) X(vkCreateImage) X(vkDestroyImage) X(vkGetImageMemoryRequirements) \
    X(vkAllocateMemory) X(vkFreeMemory) X(vkBindImageMemory) X(vkCreateImageView) X(vkDestroyImageView) \
    X(vkCreateRenderPass) X(vkDestroyRenderPass) X(vkCreateFramebuffer) X(vkDestroyFramebuffer) \
    X(vkCreateCommandPool) X(vkDestroyCommandPool) X(vkAllocateCommandBuffers) X(vkResetCommandBuffer) \
    X(vkBeginCommandBuffer) X(vkEndCommandBuffer) X(vkCmdBeginRenderPass) X(vkCmdEndRenderPass) \
    X(vkCmdBindPipeline) X(vkCmdBindDescriptorSets) X(vkCmdSetViewport) X(vkCmdSetScissor) X(vkCmdDraw) \
    X(vkCreateFence) X(vkDestroyFence) X(vkWaitForFences) X(vkResetFences) X(vkQueueSubmit) \
    X(vkCreateShaderModule) X(vkDestroyShaderModule) X(vkCreatePipelineLayout) X(vkDestroyPipelineLayout) \
    X(vkCreateGraphicsPipelines) X(vkDestroyPipeline) X(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout) X(vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout) \
    X(vkCreateDescriptorPool) X(vkDestroyDescriptorPool) X(vkAllocateDescriptorSets) X(vkUpdateDescriptorSets) \
    X(vkCreateSampler) X(vkDestroySampler)
#define GT5M_VK_DECL(name) PFN_##name name = nullptr;

struct Vk {
    bool inited = false;
    VkInstance inst = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkPhysicalDevice phys = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkDevice dev = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkQueue queue = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    uint32_t family = 0;
    PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gipa = nullptr;
    void (*qlock)(int) = nullptr;
    struct { GT5M_VK_FNS(GT5M_VK_DECL) } f;
    VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties mem = {};
    // the overlay: the menu's own picture, the swap chain's size, drawn on the window's thread
    VkRenderPass rp_overlay = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImage ov_img = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkDeviceMemory ov_mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImageView ov_view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkFramebuffer ov_fb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    uint32_t ow = 0, oh = 0;              // its size
    uint32_t laid_w = 0, laid_h = 0;      // the size the menu's layout was last told (the window's thread)
    VkCommandPool pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkCommandBuffer cb[RING] = {};
    VkFence fence[RING] = {};
    bool busy[RING] = {};
    unsigned ring = 0;
    // the composite pass over a swap chain image
    VkFormat sc_fmt = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
    uint32_t sc_w = 0, sc_h = 0, sc_n = 0;
    VkImage sc_img[MAX_IMAGES] = {};
    VkImageView sc_view[MAX_IMAGES] = {};
    VkFramebuffer sc_fb[MAX_IMAGES] = {};
    VkRenderPass rp_comp = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkPipeline pipe_comp = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkPipelineLayout layout_comp = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkDescriptorSetLayout dsl = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkDescriptorPool dpool = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkDescriptorSet set = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkSampler samp = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    SRWLOCK lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;          // the overlay's and the swap chain's objects: used (shared) against made again (exclusive)
    volatile LONG visible = 0;            // the overlay holds something to put over the picture
};
Vk s;

#define VKF s.f

bool fail(const char* what, VkResult r)
{
    fprintf(stderr, "[menu] Vulkan: %s failed (VkResult %d)\n", what, (int)r);
    return false;
}

bool memory_type(uint32_t bits, VkMemoryPropertyFlags want, uint32_t* out)
{
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < s.mem.memoryTypeCount; i++)
        if ((bits & (1u << i)) && (s.mem.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & want) == want) { *out = i; return true; }
    return false;
}

// Waits for every command buffer of the menu's own that may still run (the overlay's draws).
void wait_own()
{
    for (int i = 0; i < RING; i++)
        if (s.busy[i]) { VKF.vkWaitForFences(s.dev, 1, &s.fence[i], VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX); s.busy[i] = false; }
}

// ---- the overlay -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Cleared to transparent, drawn by Dear ImGui, then read by the composite pass (any later submission:
// the dependencies to and from "outside" cover the other threads' command buffers too).
bool overlay_pass_create()
{
    VkAttachmentDescription a = {};
    a.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    a.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    a.loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR;
    a.storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
    a.stencilLoadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE;
    a.stencilStoreOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE;
    a.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    a.finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
    VkAttachmentReference ref = { 0, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL };
    VkSubpassDescription sp = {};
    sp.pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
    sp.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
    sp.pColorAttachments = &ref;
    VkSubpassDependency dep[2] = {};
    dep[0].srcSubpass = VK_SUBPASS_EXTERNAL;   // after the last composite read it
    dep[0].dstSubpass = 0;
    dep[0].srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    dep[0].dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    dep[0].srcAccessMask = 0;
    dep[0].dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT;
    dep[1].srcSubpass = 0;                     // before the next composite reads it
    dep[1].dstSubpass = VK_SUBPASS_EXTERNAL;
    dep[1].srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    dep[1].dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT;
    dep[1].srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    dep[1].dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
    VkRenderPassCreateInfo ci = {}; ci.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO;
    ci.attachmentCount = 1; ci.pAttachments = &a;
    ci.subpassCount = 1; ci.pSubpasses = &sp;
    ci.dependencyCount = 2; ci.pDependencies = dep;
    const VkResult r = VKF.vkCreateRenderPass(s.dev, &ci, nullptr, &s.rp_overlay);
    return r == VK_SUCCESS || fail("the overlay's render pass", r);
}

void overlay_destroy()
{
    if (s.ov_fb) VKF.vkDestroyFramebuffer(s.dev, s.ov_fb, nullptr);
    if (s.ov_view) VKF.vkDestroyImageView(s.dev, s.ov_view, nullptr);
    if (s.ov_img) VKF.vkDestroyImage(s.dev, s.ov_img, nullptr);
    if (s.ov_mem) VKF.vkFreeMemory(s.dev, s.ov_mem, nullptr);
    s.ov_fb = VK_NULL_HANDLE; s.ov_view = VK_NULL_HANDLE; s.ov_img = VK_NULL_HANDLE; s.ov_mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    s.ow = s.oh = 0;
}

bool overlay_create(uint32_t w, uint32_t h)
{
    VkImageCreateInfo ii = {}; ii.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    ii.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    ii.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    ii.extent = { w, h, 1 };
    ii.mipLevels = 1; ii.arrayLayers = 1;
    ii.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    ii.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    ii.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT;
    ii.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    ii.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    VkResult r = VKF.vkCreateImage(s.dev, &ii, nullptr, &s.ov_img);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) return fail("the overlay image", r);
    VkMemoryRequirements req;
    VKF.vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(s.dev, s.ov_img, &req);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = {}; ai.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO;
    ai.allocationSize = req.size;
    if (!memory_type(req.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT, &ai.memoryTypeIndex) &&
        !memory_type(req.memoryTypeBits, 0, &ai.memoryTypeIndex)) { overlay_destroy(); return fail("the overlay's memory type", VK_ERROR_UNKNOWN); }
    r = VKF.vkAllocateMemory(s.dev, &ai, nullptr, &s.ov_mem);
    if (r == VK_SUCCESS) r = VKF.vkBindImageMemory(s.dev, s.ov_img, s.ov_mem, 0);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) { overlay_destroy(); return fail("the overlay's memory", r); }
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = {}; vi.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO;
    vi.image = s.ov_img;
    vi.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    vi.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    vi.subresourceRange = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    r = VKF.vkCreateImageView(s.dev, &vi, nullptr, &s.ov_view);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) { overlay_destroy(); return fail("the overlay's view", r); }
    VkFramebufferCreateInfo fi = {}; fi.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER_CREATE_INFO;
    fi.renderPass = s.rp_overlay;
    fi.attachmentCount = 1; fi.pAttachments = &s.ov_view;
    fi.width = w; fi.height = h; fi.layers = 1;
    r = VKF.vkCreateFramebuffer(s.dev, &fi, nullptr, &s.ov_fb);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) { overlay_destroy(); return fail("the overlay's framebuffer", r); }
    s.ow = w; s.oh = h;
    // the composite pass reads it through the one descriptor set
    VkDescriptorImageInfo di = { s.samp, s.ov_view, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL };
    VkWriteDescriptorSet wr = {}; wr.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET;
    wr.dstSet = s.set; wr.dstBinding = 0; wr.descriptorCount = 1;
    wr.descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER;
    wr.pImageInfo = &di;
    VKF.vkUpdateDescriptorSets(s.dev, 1, &wr, 0, nullptr);
    return true;
}

// ---- the composite pass ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool composite_objects_create()
{
    VkSamplerCreateInfo si = {}; si.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO;
    si.magFilter = si.minFilter = VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
    si.mipmapMode = VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_NEAREST;
    si.addressModeU = si.addressModeV = si.addressModeW = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
    si.maxLod = 0.0f;
    VkResult r = VKF.vkCreateSampler(s.dev, &si, nullptr, &s.samp);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) return fail("the overlay's sampler", r);
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b = { 0, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, nullptr };
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo li = {}; li.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO;
    li.bindingCount = 1; li.pBindings = &b;
    r = VKF.vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(s.dev, &li, nullptr, &s.dsl);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) return fail("the composite's set layout", r);
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo pli = {}; pli.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO;
    pli.setLayoutCount = 1; pli.pSetLayouts = &s.dsl;
    r = VKF.vkCreatePipelineLayout(s.dev, &pli, nullptr, &s.layout_comp);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) return fail("the composite's pipeline layout", r);
    VkDescriptorPoolSize ps = { VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 1 };
    VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo dpi = {}; dpi.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
    dpi.maxSets = 1; dpi.poolSizeCount = 1; dpi.pPoolSizes = &ps;
    r = VKF.vkCreateDescriptorPool(s.dev, &dpi, nullptr, &s.dpool);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) return fail("the composite's descriptor pool", r);
    VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo ai = {}; ai.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO;
    ai.descriptorPool = s.dpool; ai.descriptorSetCount = 1; ai.pSetLayouts = &s.dsl;
    r = VKF.vkAllocateDescriptorSets(s.dev, &ai, &s.set);
    return r == VK_SUCCESS || fail("the composite's descriptor set", r);
}

// The pass over a swap chain image: it comes from the frame's copy (TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL), keeps what
// is there, takes the overlay over it, and is left ready to present.
bool composite_pass_create(VkFormat fmt)
{
    VkAttachmentDescription a = {};
    a.format = fmt;
    a.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    a.loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD;
    a.storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
    a.stencilLoadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE;
    a.stencilStoreOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE;
    a.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
    a.finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR;
    VkAttachmentReference ref = { 0, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL };
    VkSubpassDescription sp = {};
    sp.pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
    sp.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
    sp.pColorAttachments = &ref;
    VkSubpassDependency dep[2] = {};
    dep[0].srcSubpass = VK_SUBPASS_EXTERNAL;   // after the frame's copy into the image and the overlay's draw
    dep[0].dstSubpass = 0;
    dep[0].srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    dep[0].dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT;
    dep[0].srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    dep[0].dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
    dep[1].srcSubpass = 0;
    dep[1].dstSubpass = VK_SUBPASS_EXTERNAL;
    dep[1].srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    dep[1].dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT;
    dep[1].srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    dep[1].dstAccessMask = 0;
    VkRenderPassCreateInfo ci = {}; ci.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO;
    ci.attachmentCount = 1; ci.pAttachments = &a;
    ci.subpassCount = 1; ci.pSubpasses = &sp;
    ci.dependencyCount = 2; ci.pDependencies = dep;
    VkResult r = VKF.vkCreateRenderPass(s.dev, &ci, nullptr, &s.rp_comp);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) return fail("the composite's render pass", r);

    VkShaderModule vs = VK_NULL_HANDLE, fs = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo mi = {}; mi.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO;
    mi.codeSize = sizeof k_composite_vs; mi.pCode = k_composite_vs;
    r = VKF.vkCreateShaderModule(s.dev, &mi, nullptr, &vs);
    if (r == VK_SUCCESS) {
        mi.codeSize = sizeof k_composite_fs; mi.pCode = k_composite_fs;
        r = VKF.vkCreateShaderModule(s.dev, &mi, nullptr, &fs);
    }
    if (r == VK_SUCCESS) {
        VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo st[2] = {};
        st[0].sType = st[1].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO;
        st[0].stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT; st[0].module = vs; st[0].pName = "main";
        st[1].stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT; st[1].module = fs; st[1].pName = "main";
        VkPipelineVertexInputStateCreateInfo vin = {}; vin.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VERTEX_INPUT_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
        VkPipelineInputAssemblyStateCreateInfo ia = {}; ia.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_INPUT_ASSEMBLY_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
        ia.topology = VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST;
        VkPipelineViewportStateCreateInfo vp = {}; vp.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VIEWPORT_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
        vp.viewportCount = 1; vp.scissorCount = 1;
        VkPipelineRasterizationStateCreateInfo rs = {}; rs.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RASTERIZATION_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
        rs.polygonMode = VK_POLYGON_MODE_FILL; rs.cullMode = VK_CULL_MODE_NONE; rs.frontFace = VK_FRONT_FACE_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE;
        rs.lineWidth = 1.0f;
        VkPipelineMultisampleStateCreateInfo ms = {}; ms.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_MULTISAMPLE_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
        ms.rasterizationSamples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
        VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState ba = {};
        ba.blendEnable = VK_TRUE;
        ba.srcColorBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE; ba.dstColorBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA; ba.colorBlendOp = VK_BLEND_OP_ADD;
        ba.srcAlphaBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE; ba.dstAlphaBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA; ba.alphaBlendOp = VK_BLEND_OP_ADD;
        ba.colorWriteMask = VK_COLOR_COMPONENT_R_BIT | VK_COLOR_COMPONENT_G_BIT | VK_COLOR_COMPONENT_B_BIT | VK_COLOR_COMPONENT_A_BIT;
        VkPipelineColorBlendStateCreateInfo cb = {}; cb.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_COLOR_BLEND_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
        cb.attachmentCount = 1; cb.pAttachments = &ba;
        const VkDynamicState dyn[2] = { VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_VIEWPORT, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_SCISSOR };
        VkPipelineDynamicStateCreateInfo ds = {}; ds.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_DYNAMIC_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
        ds.dynamicStateCount = 2; ds.pDynamicStates = dyn;
        VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo pi = {}; pi.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO;
        pi.stageCount = 2; pi.pStages = st;
        pi.pVertexInputState = &vin; pi.pInputAssemblyState = &ia; pi.pViewportState = &vp;
        pi.pRasterizationState = &rs; pi.pMultisampleState = &ms; pi.pColorBlendState = &cb; pi.pDynamicState = &ds;
        pi.layout = s.layout_comp; pi.renderPass = s.rp_comp; pi.subpass = 0;
        r = VKF.vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(s.dev, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 1, &pi, nullptr, &s.pipe_comp);
    }
    if (vs) VKF.vkDestroyShaderModule(s.dev, vs, nullptr);
    if (fs) VKF.vkDestroyShaderModule(s.dev, fs, nullptr);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) return fail("the composite's pipeline", r);
    s.sc_fmt = fmt;
    return true;
}

void composite_pass_destroy()
{
    if (s.pipe_comp) VKF.vkDestroyPipeline(s.dev, s.pipe_comp, nullptr);
    if (s.rp_comp) VKF.vkDestroyRenderPass(s.dev, s.rp_comp, nullptr);
    s.pipe_comp = VK_NULL_HANDLE; s.rp_comp = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    s.sc_fmt = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
}

void swapchain_release()
{
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < MAX_IMAGES; i++) {
        if (s.sc_fb[i]) VKF.vkDestroyFramebuffer(s.dev, s.sc_fb[i], nullptr);
        if (s.sc_view[i]) VKF.vkDestroyImageView(s.dev, s.sc_view[i], nullptr);
        s.sc_fb[i] = VK_NULL_HANDLE; s.sc_view[i] = VK_NULL_HANDLE; s.sc_img[i] = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    s.sc_n = 0;
}

// ---- Dear ImGui -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PFN_vkVoidFunction imgui_loader(const char* name, void*) { return s.gipa(s.inst, name); }
void vk_new_frame() { ImGui_ImplVulkan_NewFrame(); }
void check_result(VkResult r) { if (r < 0) fprintf(stderr, "[menu] Vulkan: Dear ImGui's backend got VkResult %d\n", (int)r); }

void objects_destroy()
{
    swapchain_release();
    composite_pass_destroy();
    overlay_destroy();
    for (int i = 0; i < RING; i++) if (s.fence[i]) VKF.vkDestroyFence(s.dev, s.fence[i], nullptr);
    if (s.pool) VKF.vkDestroyCommandPool(s.dev, s.pool, nullptr);
    if (s.dpool) VKF.vkDestroyDescriptorPool(s.dev, s.dpool, nullptr);
    if (s.layout_comp) VKF.vkDestroyPipelineLayout(s.dev, s.layout_comp, nullptr);
    if (s.dsl) VKF.vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(s.dev, s.dsl, nullptr);
    if (s.samp) VKF.vkDestroySampler(s.dev, s.samp, nullptr);
    if (s.rp_overlay) VKF.vkDestroyRenderPass(s.dev, s.rp_overlay, nullptr);
}

}  // namespace
}  // namespace gt5m

using namespace gt5m;

// ---- the API (gt5_menu_vk.h) ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

extern "C" int gt5_menu_vk_init(const gt5_menu_vk_init_info* info)
{
    if (s.inited) return 1;
    if (core_inited()) return 0;              // the menu is already drawn by the other renderer
    if (!info || !info->hwnd || !info->instance || !info->physical_device || !info->device || !info->queue ||
        !info->get_instance_proc_addr || !info->queue_lock) return 0;
    s.inst = info->instance; s.phys = info->physical_device; s.dev = info->device;
    s.queue = info->queue; s.family = info->queue_family;
    s.gipa = info->get_instance_proc_addr; s.qlock = info->queue_lock;
    bool ok = true;
#define GT5M_VK_LOAD(name) if (!(s.f.name = (PFN_##name)s.gipa(s.inst, #name))) { fprintf(stderr, "[menu] Vulkan: no " #name "\n"); ok = false; }
    GT5M_VK_FNS(GT5M_VK_LOAD)
#undef GT5M_VK_LOAD
    if (!ok) { s = Vk(); fprintf(stderr, "[menu] Vulkan: the settings menu is off\n"); return 0; }
    VKF.vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(s.phys, &s.mem);
    core_begin((HWND)info->hwnd, info->width, info->height, info->version, info->title);
    s.laid_w = info->width; s.laid_h = info->height;

    VkCommandPoolCreateInfo pci = {}; pci.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
    pci.flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT;
    pci.queueFamilyIndex = s.family;
    ok = VKF.vkCreateCommandPool(s.dev, &pci, nullptr, &s.pool) == VK_SUCCESS;
    if (ok) {
        VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo cai = {}; cai.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO;
        cai.commandPool = s.pool; cai.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; cai.commandBufferCount = RING;
        ok = VKF.vkAllocateCommandBuffers(s.dev, &cai, s.cb) == VK_SUCCESS;
    }
    VkFenceCreateInfo fci = {}; fci.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO;
    for (int i = 0; ok && i < RING; i++) ok = VKF.vkCreateFence(s.dev, &fci, nullptr, &s.fence[i]) == VK_SUCCESS;
    ok = ok && overlay_pass_create() && composite_objects_create();
    if (!ok) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[menu] Vulkan objects could not be made: the settings menu is off\n");
        objects_destroy();
        s = Vk();
        return 0;
    }

    core_context();
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_InitInfo ii = {};
    ii.ApiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_0;       // the renderer's (it uses Vulkan 1.0 only)
    ii.Instance = s.inst;
    ii.PhysicalDevice = s.phys;
    ii.Device = s.dev;
    ii.QueueFamily = s.family;
    ii.Queue = s.queue;
    ii.DescriptorPoolSize = 16;               // the font atlas (and any atlas it grows into)
    ii.MinImageCount = 2;
    ii.ImageCount = RING;                     // its vertex buffers turn over with the menu's command buffers
    ii.PipelineInfoMain.RenderPass = s.rp_overlay;
    ii.PipelineInfoMain.Subpass = 0;
    ii.PipelineInfoMain.MSAASamples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    ii.CheckVkResultFn = check_result;
    if (!ImGui_ImplVulkan_LoadFunctions(VK_API_VERSION_1_0, imgui_loader, nullptr) || !ImGui_ImplVulkan_Init(&ii)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[menu] Dear ImGui's Vulkan backend did not start: the settings menu is off\n");
        core_context_abort();
        objects_destroy();
        s = Vk();
        return 0;
    }
    s.inited = true;
    core_finish(vk_new_frame, "Vulkan");
    return 1;
}

extern "C" void gt5_menu_vk_shutdown(void)
{
    if (!s.inited) return;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s.lock);
    s.inited = false;
    InterlockedExchange(&s.visible, 0);
    core_shutdown_begin();
    wait_own();
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_Shutdown();
    core_shutdown_end();
    objects_destroy();
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s.lock);
    s = Vk();
}

extern "C" void gt5_menu_vk_swapchain(VkFormat format, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t count, const VkImage* images)
{
    if (!s.inited) return;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&s.lock);        // no composite and no draw into the overlay while this runs
    wait_own();
    swapchain_release();
    if (!count || !images || !width || !height) {
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s.lock);
        return;
    }
    if (count > MAX_IMAGES) count = MAX_IMAGES;
    bool ok = true;
    if (format != s.sc_fmt) {
        composite_pass_destroy();
        ok = composite_pass_create(format);
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; ok && i < count; i++) {
        VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = {}; vi.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO;
        vi.image = images[i];
        vi.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
        vi.format = format;
        vi.subresourceRange = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
        VkResult r = VKF.vkCreateImageView(s.dev, &vi, nullptr, &s.sc_view[i]);
        if (r == VK_SUCCESS) {
            VkFramebufferCreateInfo fi = {}; fi.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER_CREATE_INFO;
            fi.renderPass = s.rp_comp;
            fi.attachmentCount = 1; fi.pAttachments = &s.sc_view[i];
            fi.width = width; fi.height = height; fi.layers = 1;
            r = VKF.vkCreateFramebuffer(s.dev, &fi, nullptr, &s.sc_fb[i]);
        }
        if (r != VK_SUCCESS) ok = fail("the swap chain image's view", r);
        s.sc_img[i] = images[i];
    }
    if (ok && (width != s.ow || height != s.oh)) {
        InterlockedExchange(&s.visible, 0);  // the new overlay holds nothing until it is drawn
        overlay_destroy();
        ok = overlay_create(width, height);
    }
    if (ok) { s.sc_w = width; s.sc_h = height; s.sc_n = count; }
    else    { swapchain_release(); fprintf(stderr, "[menu] Vulkan: nothing put over the picture until the next swap chain\n"); }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&s.lock);
}

extern "C" int gt5_menu_vk_frame(void)
{
    if (!s.inited) return 0;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&s.lock);
    if (!s.ov_img) {
        // Nothing to draw into (no swap chain yet, or its overlay couldn't be made): the menu doesn't stay
        // open unseen with the game's input held.
        ReleaseSRWLockShared(&s.lock);
        InterlockedExchange(&s.visible, 0);
        if (gt5_menu_is_open()) gt5_menu_set_open(0);
        return 0;
    }
    // The layout is in the window's pixels and drawn at the overlay's: tell the shared part when the
    // overlay's size changed (a new swap chain, made on whichever thread presented).
    if (s.ow != s.laid_w || s.oh != s.laid_h) { core_set_size(s.ow, s.oh); s.laid_w = s.ow; s.laid_h = s.oh; }
    if (!core_build_frame()) { ReleaseSRWLockShared(&s.lock); InterlockedExchange(&s.visible, 0); return 0; }
    ImDrawData* dd = ImGui::GetDrawData();

    const unsigned k = s.ring++ % RING;
    if (s.busy[k]) { VKF.vkWaitForFences(s.dev, 1, &s.fence[k], VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX); s.busy[k] = false; }
    // New glyphs: Dear ImGui's backend copies them into its atlas with a submission of its own and waits
    // for the queue. The queue is the renderer's, so that happens here, under its lock (the draw below
    // then finds every texture up to date).
    if (dd->Textures) {
        bool any = false;
        for (ImTextureData* tex : *dd->Textures) if (tex->Status != ImTextureStatus_OK) any = true;
        if (any) {
            s.qlock(1);
            for (ImTextureData* tex : *dd->Textures) if (tex->Status != ImTextureStatus_OK) ImGui_ImplVulkan_UpdateTexture(tex);
            s.qlock(0);
        }
    }
    VkCommandBuffer cb = s.cb[k];
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi = {}; bi.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO;
    bi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    bool ok = VKF.vkResetCommandBuffer(cb, 0) == VK_SUCCESS && VKF.vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &bi) == VK_SUCCESS;
    if (ok) {
        VkClearValue clear = {};
        VkRenderPassBeginInfo rb = {}; rb.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_BEGIN_INFO;
        rb.renderPass = s.rp_overlay;
        rb.framebuffer = s.ov_fb;
        rb.renderArea.extent = { s.ow, s.oh };
        rb.clearValueCount = 1; rb.pClearValues = &clear;
        VKF.vkCmdBeginRenderPass(cb, &rb, VK_SUBPASS_CONTENTS_INLINE);
        ImGui_ImplVulkan_RenderDrawData(dd, cb);
        VKF.vkCmdEndRenderPass(cb);
        ok = VKF.vkEndCommandBuffer(cb) == VK_SUCCESS;
    }
    if (ok) {
        VkSubmitInfo si = {}; si.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO;
        si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
        VKF.vkResetFences(s.dev, 1, &s.fence[k]);
        s.qlock(1);
        const VkResult r = VKF.vkQueueSubmit(s.queue, 1, &si, s.fence[k]);
        s.qlock(0);
        ok = r == VK_SUCCESS;
        if (ok) s.busy[k] = true; else fail("the menu's submission", r);
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&s.lock);
    InterlockedExchange(&s.visible, ok ? 1 : 0);
    return ok ? 1 : 0;
}

extern "C" int gt5_menu_vk_composite(VkCommandBuffer cb, uint32_t image_index)
{
    if (!cb || !s.visible) return 0;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&s.lock);
    const bool can = s.inited && s.visible && s.pipe_comp && image_index < s.sc_n && s.sc_fb[image_index] &&
                     s.ow == s.sc_w && s.oh == s.sc_h;
    if (can) {
        VkRenderPassBeginInfo rb = {}; rb.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_BEGIN_INFO;
        rb.renderPass = s.rp_comp;
        rb.framebuffer = s.sc_fb[image_index];
        rb.renderArea.extent = { s.sc_w, s.sc_h };
        VKF.vkCmdBeginRenderPass(cb, &rb, VK_SUBPASS_CONTENTS_INLINE);
        const VkViewport vp = { 0.0f, 0.0f, (float)s.sc_w, (float)s.sc_h, 0.0f, 1.0f };
        const VkRect2D sc = { { 0, 0 }, { s.sc_w, s.sc_h } };
        VKF.vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, s.pipe_comp);
        VKF.vkCmdSetViewport(cb, 0, 1, &vp);
        VKF.vkCmdSetScissor(cb, 0, 1, &sc);
        VKF.vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, s.layout_comp, 0, 1, &s.set, 0, nullptr);
        VKF.vkCmdDraw(cb, 3, 1, 0, 0);
        VKF.vkCmdEndRenderPass(cb);
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&s.lock);
    return can ? 1 : 0;
}
```

`GT5/src/native/gen_cad00_f6c0.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cut w018CAD00's routine 0xF6C0 (the batch cull for mirror records) out of the job's lifted source, for
native_cad00.c.

native_cad00.c runs 0xF6C0 as one native call: the routine's own statements from this copy's lift, with its
hot loops -- the vertex transform 0xF970, the bounding box 0xFA78 and the vertex-in-record test 0xFD60 (about
85 % of the routine's time on real batches) -- taken by native code when they can be. This script copies the
lifted function's statements unchanged but for:
  * the interrupt checks at labels are dropped (the native call only starts with no interrupt pending; one
    that arrives later is taken when the call returns, as for every native function of this image);
  * the function is renamed cad_f6c0_lift(ctx) (static, in native_cad00.c);
  * just before each of those loops' label a line CAD_F6_LOOPn is inserted (the way in; the loop's own branch
    goes to the label), and CAD_F6_LOOPn_DONE after the loop's closing branch where the loop falls out:
    native_cad00.c defines them (the loop's groups natively, its last passes lifted, see there);
  * after every label, CAD_AT(address) (nothing in the game; the harness's time per region).
The statements are found by the function's name and labels, not by line numbers; the shape the native code
relies on (the labels, each loop entered only from before it and closed by its one branch back) is checked,
and the script fails if it is not there.

Usage: gen_cad00_f6c0.py <spu_recomp.c> <out_dir>      writes <out_dir>/cad00_f6c0_lift.inc
"""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

FUNC = re.compile(r"^SPU_SV void gt5_w018CAD00_spu_func_0000F6C0(?:_orig)?_sv\(spu_context\* ctx\) \{\s*$")
INTR = re.compile(r"^\s*if \(ctx->int_enable && \(ctx->event_status & ctx->event_mask\)\) \{.*return; \}\s*$")
LABEL = re.compile(r"^loc_([0-9A-F]{8}):\s*$")
# (label, its closing branch, macro on the way in, macro after the loop or None)
LOOPS = [
    ("loc_0000F970", re.compile(r"^\s*if \(spu_h0\(r47\) != 0\) \{ goto loc_0000F970; \}\s*$"), "CAD_F6_LOOP2", "CAD_F6_LOOP2_DONE"),
    ("loc_0000FA78", re.compile(r"^\s*if \(spu_w0\(r21\) != 0\) \{ goto loc_0000FA78; \}\s*$"), "CAD_F6_LOOP3", None),
    ("loc_0000FD60", re.compile(r"^\s*if \(spu_w0\(r45\) != 0\) \{ goto loc_0000FD60; \}\s*$"), "CAD_F6_LOOP4", "CAD_F6_LOOP4_DONE"),
]
NEED = ["loc_0000F828", "loc_0000F970", "loc_0000FA78", "loc_0000FB40", "loc_0000FD60", "loc_0000FE78", "loc_0000FF00",
        "loc_00010050"]


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        raise SystemExit(__doc__)
    src = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="latin-1").splitlines()
    out_dir = Path(sys.argv[2])
    start = next((i for i, l in enumerate(src) if FUNC.match(l)), None)
    if start is None:
        raise SystemExit("gen_cad00_f6c0: the lifted function for 0xF6C0 is not in " + sys.argv[1])
    end = next(i for i in range(start + 1, len(src)) if src[i] == "}")
    body = src[start + 1:end]
    labels = [m.group(0).strip()[:-1] for m in (LABEL.match(l) for l in body) if m]
    for n in NEED:
        if n not in labels:
            raise SystemExit(f"gen_cad00_f6c0: label {n} missing in the lifted 0xF6C0: the lift is not the one this was written for")
    for lab, close, _, _ in LOOPS:
        if sum(1 for l in body if close.match(l)) != 1 or sum(1 for l in body if f"goto {lab};" in l) != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f"gen_cad00_f6c0: the loop at {lab} is not entered and closed as expected")
    out = ["/* generated by gen_cad00_f6c0.py from " + Path(sys.argv[1]).name + ": w018CAD00 0xF6C0, lifted statements */",
           "static SPU_SV void cad_f6c0_lift(spu_context* ctx) {"]
    dropped = 0
    for l in body:
        if INTR.match(l):
            dropped += 1
            continue
        m = LABEL.match(l)
        for lab, close, enter, done in LOOPS:
            if m and lab == "loc_" + m.group(1):
                out.append(f"        {enter};")
        out.append(l)
        if m:
            out.append(f"        CAD_AT(0x{m.group(1)});")
        for lab, close, enter, done in LOOPS:
            if done and close.match(l):
                out.append(f"        {done};")
    out.append("}")
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (out_dir / "cad00_f6c0_lift.inc").write_text("\n".join(out) + "\n", encoding="latin-1")
    print(f"gen_cad00_f6c0: {len(body)} lines, {dropped} interrupt checks dropped -> {out_dir / 'cad00_f6c0_lift.inc'}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`GT5/src/native/gen_ppu_leaf.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Native PPU leaf functions, made at build time from this copy's own lift (scripts/ppu_native_patch.py
imports this; nothing of the lifted code is shipped).

A leaf is a lifted function that calls no other guest function: no func_XXXXXXXX call, no indirect call,
no syscall, no HLE import, no trampoline. Its lifted text keeps every guest register in the context
structure in memory (ctx->gpr[3], ctx->vr[18] ...), and the compiler has to load and store them around
every guest memory access, because a guest access goes through a byte pointer it cannot tell apart from
the context. The native form is the same statements with each register the function uses held in a C
local: read from the context once at entry, written back at every return. The operations, their order,
every guest load and store (the same gated scalar paths, the same raw vector paths) and every value are
the lifted ones, so the result is the same by construction: guest memory is never the context.

Refused (the function stays lifted, the build says why): anything but a leaf, a register indexed by a
variable, a context field other than gpr/fpr/vr/cr/xer/vscr/lr/ctr, `ctx` passed whole to a helper, or a
call to a helper not in the list below (each one checked to touch no guest register but through the
pointer it is given).

The compare form (GT5_PPU_NATIVE=2) is the same text again with its guest loads and stores sent to a
shadow log (src/native/ppu_native.h), so it can run on a copy of the registers before the lifted
function runs for real; a function with a guest access of another shape has no compare form (counted).
"""
import re

FIELDS = ("gpr", "fpr", "vr", "cr", "xer", "vscr", "lr", "ctr")
CTYPE = {"gpr": "uint64_t", "fpr": "double", "vr": "ppu_vr", "cr": "uint32_t", "xer": "uint32_t",
         "vscr": "uint32_t", "lr": "uint64_t", "ctr": "uint64_t"}
# Helpers of the lifted code's preamble, ppu_recomp.h and ppu_vmx.h that a leaf may call: each works on
# its arguments (values, or pointers to the registers it is given) and guest memory only.
CALLS = {
    "vm_read8", "vm_read16", "vm_read32", "vm_read64", "vm_write8", "vm_write16", "vm_write32", "vm_write64",
    "vm_raw_ld16", "vm_raw_st16", "VM_RAW_LD", "VM_RAW_ST",
    "ppu_fadd", "ppu_fsub", "ppu_fmul", "ppu_fdiv", "ppu_fp_bin", "ppu_fmadd_core", "ppu_fp_single", "ppu_frsp",
    "ppu_fp_quiet", "ppu_fp_default_qnan", "ppu_f2i32", "ppu_f2i64",
    "ppu_vbswap32", "ppu_vldf4", "ppu_vstf4", "ppu_vldu4", "ppu_vstu4",
    "ppc_rlw64", "ppc_rlwinm", "ppc_rlwimi", "ppc_rotl64", "ppc_mask64", "ppc_rldicl", "ppc_rldicr", "ppc_rldic",
    "ppc_rldimi", "ppc_sraw", "ppc_srad", "ppc_mulhd", "ppc_mulhdu",
    "memcpy", "memset", "sqrt", "sqrtf", "fabs", "fabsf", "fma", "fmaf", "nearbyint", "nearbyintf", "trunc",
    "truncf", "floor", "floorf", "ceil", "ceilf", "copysign", "copysignf",
    "ppu_timebase_now", "PPU_FENCE",
}
CALL_PREFIXES = ("vmx_", "__builtin_")
KEYWORDS = {"if", "for", "while", "switch", "return", "sizeof", "do", "else", "goto", "case"}


def find_function(text, name):
    """(start, end) of `void <name>(ppu_context* ctx) {` .. the closing `}` line, or None."""
    m = re.search(r"^void %s\(ppu_context\* ctx\) \{[^\n]*\n" % re.escape(name), text, re.M)
    if not m:
        return None
    e = re.compile(r"^\}[ \t]*\r?$", re.M).search(text, m.end())
    if not e:
        return None
    end = text.find("\n", e.start())
    return m.start(), (end + 1 if end >= 0 else len(text))


def fn_sha1(ftext):
    import hashlib
    return hashlib.sha1(ftext.replace("\r\n", "\n").encode("latin-1")).hexdigest()


def analyse(ftext):
    """(registers used [(field, index or None)], reason refused or None) for one lifted function."""
    body = ftext.split("\n", 1)[1]
    if re.search(r"\bfunc_[0-9A-F]{8}\b", body):
        return None, "calls a guest function"
    for bad in ("g_trampoline_fn", "ps3_indirect_call", "lv2_syscall", "ps3_hle_call", "DRAIN_TRAMPOLINE", "longjmp"):
        if bad in body:
            return None, "not a leaf (%s)" % bad
    if re.search(r"\bctx\b(?!->)", body):
        return None, "passes the whole context to a helper"
    regs = set()
    for f, rest in re.findall(r"\bctx->(\w+)(\[[^\]]*\])?", body):
        if f not in FIELDS:
            return None, "uses ctx->%s" % f
        if f in ("gpr", "fpr", "vr"):
            m = re.fullmatch(r"\[(\d+)\]", rest or "")
            if not m or int(m.group(1)) > 31:
                return None, "ctx->%s%s is not a fixed register" % (f, rest)
            regs.add((f, int(m.group(1))))
        else:
            if rest:
                return None, "ctx->%s%s" % (f, rest)
            regs.add((f, None))
    for c in set(re.findall(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(", body)):
        if c in KEYWORDS or c in CALLS or c.startswith(CALL_PREFIXES):
            continue
        if re.fullmatch(r"u?int(8|16|32|64)_t|float|double|char|unsigned|int|long|short|bool", c):
            continue   # a cast written as a call
        return None, "calls %s()" % c
    order = {f: i for i, f in enumerate(FIELDS)}
    regs = [r for r in regs if r[0] != "fpr"]          # kept in the context (see _localize)
    return sorted(regs, key=lambda r: (order[r[0]], r[1] or 0)), None


def _local(f, i):
    return "R_%s%d" % (f[0] if f in ("gpr", "fpr", "vr") else f, i) if i is not None else "R_" + f


def _localize(body):
    body = re.sub(r"\bctx->gpr\[(\d+)\]", r"R_g\1", body)
    # Floating-point registers stay in the context: the compiler folds a float-double-float round trip
    # (lfs then stfs) held in a local, which leaves a signaling NaN unquieted where the lifted code,
    # through the context in memory, quiets it. Through memory the native is compiled as the lift is.
    body = re.sub(r"\bctx->fpr\[(\d+)\]", r"ctx_->fpr[\1]", body)
    body = re.sub(r"\bctx->vr\[(\d+)\]", r"R_v\1", body)
    body = re.sub(r"\bctx->(cr|xer|vscr|lr|ctr)\b", r"R_\1", body)
    return body


def _shadow(body):
    """The guest accesses of a localized body sent to the shadow log, or None (an access of another shape)."""
    for w in ("8", "16", "32", "64"):
        body = re.sub(r"\bvm_read%s\(" % w, "gt5_sh_r%s(_sh, " % w, body)
        body = re.sub(r"\bvm_write%s\(" % w, "gt5_sh_w%s(_sh, " % w, body)
    body = re.sub(r"\bvm_raw_ld16\(", "gt5_sh_ld16(_sh, ", body)
    body = re.sub(r"\bvm_raw_st16\(", "gt5_sh_st16(_sh, ", body)
    body = re.sub(r"\bVM_RAW_LD\(\s*(\w+)\s*,", r"gt5_sh_rawld<\1>(_sh,", body)
    body = re.sub(r"\bVM_RAW_ST\(\s*(\w+)\s*,", r"gt5_sh_rawst<\1>(_sh,", body)
    # lvlx / lvrx read the aligned quadword through a host pointer
    body = re.sub(r"(\bvmx_lv[lr]x\(&R_v\d+, )vm_base \+ \(uint32_t\)\(([^()]*)\)", r"\1gt5_sh_p16(_sh, (uint32_t)(\2))", body)
    # stvlx / stvrx: a byte loop through a host pointer to the aligned quadword
    body = re.sub(r"uint8_t\* m = vm_base \+ \(uint32_t\)\(ea & ~0xFULL\); (const uint8_t\* s = \(const uint8_t\*\)&R_v\d+; "
                  r"for \([^;]*;[^;]*;[^)]*\)) m\[([^\]]+)\] = s\[i\];",
                  r"const uint32_t m_ = (uint32_t)(ea & ~0xFULL); \1 gt5_sh_write(_sh, m_ + (uint32_t)(\2), &s[i], 1, 1);", body)
    # dcbz: a raw 128-byte clear
    body = re.sub(r"memset\(vm_base \+ \(uint32_t\)ea, 0, (\d+)\);", r"gt5_sh_zero(_sh, (uint32_t)ea, \1);", body)
    if re.search(r"\bvm_base\b|\b_mm\b", body):
        return None
    return body


def _written(text):
    """Locals a text may write: assigned, incremented, or with their address taken."""
    w = set(re.findall(r"\b(R_[a-z]+\d*)\s*(?:<<|>>|[-+*/%&|^])?=(?!=)", text))
    w |= set(re.findall(r"&(R_[a-z]+\d*)\b", text))
    w |= set(re.findall(r"(?:\+\+|--)\s*(R_[a-z]+\d*)\b", text))
    w |= set(re.findall(r"\b(R_[a-z]+\d*)\s*(?:\+\+|--)", text))
    return w


# ---- the vector pass: VMX registers as host-order float vectors (ppu_vmx.h's own four-lane operations) ----
# A register's value lives in R_vN (guest byte order, the lifted form) and/or H_vN (__m128, each word in host
# order: what vmx_ld4 gives). The common VMX statements work on H_vN directly, so a value is converted once
# when it comes from memory or the context, not on every operation; any other statement gets its registers
# in R_vN form (converted back first) and runs as lifted. Every guest load and store stays the lifted call.
# A value an operation has already flushed (VSCR[NJ]: denormals to zero) is not flushed again on its next
# use (flushing is idempotent). Labels, gotos and returns are joins: R_vN is made current before them, and
# after a label nothing is assumed about H_vN.
_BIT = {"a^b": "_mm_xor_ps({A}, {B})", "a|b": "_mm_or_ps({A}, {B})", "a&b": "_mm_and_ps({A}, {B})",
        "a&~b": "_mm_andnot_ps({B}, {A})", "~(a|b)": "_mm_xor_ps(_mm_or_ps({A}, {B}), _mm_castsi128_ps(_mm_set1_epi32(-1)))",
        "(a&~c)|(b&c)": "_mm_or_ps(_mm_andnot_ps({C}, {A}), _mm_and_ps({B}, {C}))"}


def _vector_pass(loc):
    """(new body text, set of vector registers written) or None when the body has no vector statement it takes."""
    hv, rv, fl, out = set(), set(range(32)), set(), []
    wrote = set()
    taken = 0

    def need(n):
        if n not in hv:
            out.append("        H_v%d = gt5_nat_h(&R_v%d);" % (n, n))
            hv.add(n); fl.discard(n)
        return "H_v%d" % n

    def fv(n):                                     # a float operand: flushed when NJ is on, unless known flushed
        h = need(n)
        return h if n in fl else "gt5_nat_fl(%s, nj_)" % h

    def define(n, expr, flushed):
        out.append("        H_v%d = %s;" % (n, expr))
        hv.add(n); rv.discard(n); wrote.add(n)
        (fl.add if flushed else fl.discard)(n)

    def sync(n):
        if n in hv and n not in rv:
            out.append("        gt5_nat_r(&R_v%d, H_v%d);" % (n, n))
            rv.add(n)

    def sync_all():
        for n in sorted(hv):
            sync(n)

    for line in loc.split("\n"):
        s = line.strip()
        if re.fullmatch(r"loc_[0-9A-F]+:", s):
            sync_all(); out.append(line); hv.clear(); fl.clear(); continue
        if re.search(r"\bgoto\b|\breturn\b", s):
            sync_all(); out.append(line); continue
        if not re.search(r"\bR_v\d", s) or s.startswith("uint64_t _cs_"):
            out.append(line)
            if re.search(r"\bR_vscr\s*(?:[|&^]?=)(?!=)", s):
                out.append("        nj_ = (R_vscr & 0x00010000u) != 0;")
                fl.clear()
            continue
        z = s.replace(" ", "")
        m = re.fullmatch(r"\{uint64_tea=(.*)&~0xFULL;vm_raw_ld16\(&R_v(\d+),ea\);\}", z)
        if m:                                       # lvx
            d = int(m.group(2))
            out.append(line.replace("vm_raw_ld16(&R_v%d, ea);" % d, "ppu_vr t_; vm_raw_ld16(&t_, ea); H_v%d = gt5_nat_h(&t_);" % d))
            hv.add(d); rv.discard(d); fl.discard(d); wrote.add(d); taken += 1
            continue
        m = re.fullmatch(r"\{uint64_tea=(.*)&~0xFULL;vm_raw_st16\(ea,&R_v(\d+)\);\}", z)
        if m:                                       # stvx: from R_vN, made current
            n = int(m.group(2))
            if n not in hv and n not in rv:
                need(n)
            sync(n); out.append(line); taken += 1
            continue
        m = re.fullmatch(r"\{uint32_t\*d=\(uint32_t\*\)&R_v(\d+);uint32_tval=\(\(uint32_t\*\)&R_v(\d+)\)\[([0-3])\];"
                         r"d\[0\]=d\[1\]=d\[2\]=d\[3\]=val;\}", z)
        if m:                                       # vspltw
            d, a, k = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
            src = need(a); f = a in fl
            define(d, "_mm_castsi128_ps(_mm_shuffle_epi32(_mm_castps_si128(%s), 0x%02X))" % (src, k * 0x55), f)
            taken += 1
            continue
        m = re.fullmatch(r"vmx_v(madd|nmsub)fp\(&R_v(\d+),&R_v(\d+),&R_v(\d+),&R_v(\d+),R_vscr\);", z)
        if m:                                       # vmaddfp / vnmsubfp (= ppu_vmx.h's four-lane form)
            d, a, b, c = (int(x) for x in m.group(2, 3, 4, 5))
            x, y, w = fv(a), fv(b), fv(c)
            core = ("_mm_fmadd_ps(%s, %s, %s)" % (x, w, y) if m.group(1) == "madd" else
                    "_mm_xor_ps(_mm_fmsub_ps(%s, %s, %s), _mm_castsi128_ps(_mm_set1_epi32((int)0x80000000u)))" % (x, w, y))
            out.append("        { __m128 r_ = vmx_fix4(%s); H_v%d = nj_ ? vmx_flush4(r_) : r_; }" % (core, d))
            hv.add(d); rv.discard(d); fl.add(d); wrote.add(d); taken += 1
            continue
        m = re.fullmatch(r"vmx_v(add|sub)fp\(&R_v(\d+),&R_v(\d+),&R_v(\d+),R_vscr\);", z)
        if m:                                       # vaddfp / vsubfp
            d, a, b = (int(x) for x in m.group(2, 3, 4))
            x, y = fv(a), fv(b)
            out.append("        { const __m128 x_ = %s, y_ = %s; __m128 r_ = _mm_%s_ps(x_, y_); if (vmx_anynan4(r_)) r_ = vmx_nan2_4(r_, x_, y_);"
                       " H_v%d = nj_ ? vmx_flush4(r_) : r_; }" % (x, y, m.group(1), d))
            hv.add(d); rv.discard(d); fl.add(d); wrote.add(d); taken += 1
            continue
        m = re.fullmatch(r"\{uint64_t\*d=\(uint64_t\*\)&R_v(\d+);uint64_t\*a=\(uint64_t\*\)&R_v(\d+);uint64_t\*b=\(uint64_t\*\)&R_v(\d+);"
                         r"(?:uint64_t\*c=\(uint64_t\*\)&R_v(\d+);)?(.*)\}", z)
        if m:                                       # vxor vor vand vandc vnor vsel
            body = m.group(5)
            e = None
            mm = re.fullmatch(r"d\[0\]=(.*);d\[1\]=(.*);", body)
            if mm and mm.group(1).replace("[0]", "") == mm.group(2).replace("[1]", "") and "[1]" not in mm.group(1):
                e = mm.group(1).replace("[0]", "")
            mm = re.fullmatch(r"for\(inti=0;i<2;i\+\+\)d\[i\]=(.*);", body)
            if mm:
                e = mm.group(1).replace("[i]", "")
            if e in _BIT and (("c" in e) == (m.group(4) is not None)):
                d, a, b = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
                c = int(m.group(4)) if m.group(4) else None
                if e == "a^b" and a == b:
                    define(d, "_mm_setzero_ps()", True)
                elif e in ("a|b", "a&b") and a == b:
                    src = need(a); define(d, src, a in fl)
                else:
                    A, B = need(a), need(b); C = need(c) if c is not None else None
                    define(d, _BIT[e].format(A=A, B=B, C=C), False)
                taken += 1
                continue
        m = re.fullmatch(r"\{uint32_t\*d=\(uint32_t\*\)&R_v(\d+);uint32_t\*a=\(uint32_t\*\)&R_v(\d+);uint32_t\*b=\(uint32_t\*\)&R_v(\d+);"
                         r"uint32_tt\[4\];t\[0\]=a\[([02])\];t\[1\]=b\[\4\];t\[2\]=a\[([13])\];t\[3\]=b\[\5\];memcpy\(d,t,16\);\}", z)
        if m and int(m.group(5)) == int(m.group(4)) + 1:     # vmrghw / vmrglw
            d, a, b = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
            A, B = need(a), need(b)
            define(d, "_mm_unpack%s_ps(%s, %s)" % ("lo" if m.group(4) == "0" else "hi", A, B), a in fl and b in fl)
            taken += 1
            continue
        m = re.fullmatch(r"vmx_vperm\(&R_v(\d+),&R_v(\d+),&R_v(\d+),&R_v(\d+)\);", z)
        if m:
            d, a, b, c = (int(x) for x in m.groups())
            define(d, "gt5_nat_vperm(%s, %s, %s)" % (need(a), need(b), need(c)), False)
            taken += 1
            continue
        m = re.fullmatch(r"vmx_vsldoi\(&R_v(\d+),&R_v(\d+),&R_v(\d+),(\d+)\);", z)
        if m:
            d, a, b, k = (int(x) for x in m.groups())
            define(d, "gt5_nat_vsldoi(%s, %s, %u)" % (need(a), need(b), k), False)
            taken += 1
            continue
        m = re.fullmatch(r"\{uint32_tv\[4\];for\(inti=0;i<4;i\+\+\)v\[i\]=\(uint32_t\)\(int32_t\)(-?\d+);ppu_vstu4\(&R_v(\d+),v\);\}", z)
        if m:                                       # vspltisw
            define(int(m.group(2)), "_mm_castsi128_ps(_mm_set1_epi32((int32_t)(%s)))" % m.group(1), False)
            taken += 1
            continue
        # anything else: as lifted, on the registers' R_vN form
        regs = sorted(set(int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\bR_v(\d+)\b", s)))
        for n in regs:
            sync(n)
        out.append(line)
        for n in regs:
            hv.discard(n); fl.discard(n); rv.add(n)
        wrote |= set(regs)
        # ppu_vmx.h helpers given &vscr only set SAT; an assignment (mtvscr) may change NJ
        if re.search(r"\bR_vscr\s*(?:[|&^]?=)(?!=)", s):
            out.append("        nj_ = (R_vscr & 0x00010000u) != 0;")
            fl.clear()
    sync_all()
    if not taken:
        return None
    return "\n".join(out), wrote


def generate(ftext, name, sym_native, sym_shadow):
    """C++ text of the native (and compare) form of lifted function `name` (its full text `ftext`), or
    (None, reason)."""
    regs, why = analyse(ftext)
    if why:
        return None, why
    head, body = ftext.split("\n", 1)
    body = body.rstrip()
    assert body.endswith("}")
    body = body[:-1]                                   # the function's closing brace
    loc = _localize(body)
    if re.search(r"\bctx\b(?!_)", loc):
        return None, "context left after localizing"
    decl = "\n".join("    %s %s = ctx_->%s;" % (CTYPE[f], _local(f, i), f if i is None else "%s[%d]" % (f, i))
                     for f, i in regs)

    def wb_for(written):
        return " ".join("ctx_->%s = %s;" % (f if i is None else "%s[%d]" % (f, i), _local(f, i))
                        for f, i in regs if _local(f, i) in written)

    def with_wb(b, wb):
        return re.sub(r"\breturn;", "{ " + wb + " return; }", b) + "\n    " + wb + "\n}\n"

    plain_wb = wb_for(_written(loc))
    vec = _vector_pass(loc) if any(f == "vr" for f, i in regs) else None
    vdecl = ""
    if vec:
        vtext, vw = vec
        vwb = wb_for((_written(vtext) - {"R_v%d" % n for n in range(32)}) | {"R_v%d" % n for n in vw})
        vdecl = ("\n    __m128 " + ", ".join("H_v%d" % i for f, i in regs if f == "vr") + ";"
                 + "\n    int nj_ = (R_vscr & 0x00010000u) != 0; (void)nj_;")
        if not any(f == "vscr" for f, i in regs):
            vdecl = "\n    uint32_t R_vscr = ctx_->vscr;" + vdecl

    def emit(sym, args, text_plain, text_vec):
        o = []
        if text_vec is not None:
            o += ["#if VMX_SIMD_FMA", "void %s(%s) {" % (sym, args), decl + vdecl, with_wb(text_vec, vwb), "#else"]
        o += ["void %s(%s) {" % (sym, args), decl, with_wb(text_plain, plain_wb)]
        if text_vec is not None:
            o.append("#endif")
        return o

    out = ["/* %s: native (registers in C locals%s), made from this lift's text by gen_ppu_leaf.py */"
           % (name, ", VMX values in host order" if vec else "")]
    out += emit(sym_native, "ppu_context* ctx_", loc, vec[0] if vec else None)
    sh = _shadow(loc)
    shv = _shadow(vec[0]) if vec else None
    if sh is not None and (shv is not None or not vec):
        out += emit(sym_shadow, "ppu_context* ctx_, gt5_ppu_shadow* _sh", sh, shv)
    else:
        sh = None
    return "\n".join(out), (None if sh is not None else "no compare form")

```

`GT5/src/native/gen_w01606C00_7DC8.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Make blk_7DC8.inc: the body of the lifted 0x7DC8, verbatim, with one line added.

The native 0x7DC8 is the lifted function itself (every statement, every interrupt check, the same
exits) plus a fast-forward at the head of its inner loop (label 0x7F10): NX7_FAST_FORWARD, a macro of
native_w01606C00.c, runs all but the last pass of the row natively and leaves what those passes
leave -- the local-store lines stored and the loop-carried registers r13, r15, r16 -- after which
the lifted statements do the last pass, which assigns every other register of the pass.

This script copies the function's body out of the job's spu_recomp.c and inserts the macro after the
interrupt check of loc_00007F10, followed by the twins of the three registers it changed (the lift
keeps a twin _uN beside some registers). It checks the shape the macro relies on: the statements of
the pass that carry state from one pass to the next, and that nothing else does.

EXPECT_SHA1 pins the lift this was tested against: after a re-lift, run the harness again and
then update it.

Usage: gen_7DC8.py <spu_recomp.c> <out_dir>
"""
import hashlib
import re
import sys

EXPECT_SHA1 = "a2e29c5b3a6c97cc09fd0d7ea66e1a119a8ec69d"
FUNC = "SPU_SV void gt5_w01606C00_spu_func_00007DC8_sv(spu_context* ctx) {"
LABELS = ["loc_00007E58", "loc_00007F10", "loc_00007FC4"]
INTR = re.compile(r"^\s*if \(ctx->int_enable && \(ctx->event_status & ctx->event_mask\)\) \{.*return; \}\s*$")

# The pass 0x7F10 .. 0x7FC4, statement by statement, without the twin bookkeeping (" _uN = ...;")
# and the register reloads: what the fast-forward was written against.
PASS = """r52 = spu_ai(r15, 1);
r6 = spu_ls_lq(ctx, _ls, _rd, spu_w0(r13) + 0x0);
r51 = spu_cgt(r15, r17);
r7 = spu_ls_lq(ctx, _ls, _rd, spu_w0(r13) + 0x10);
r50 = spu_cgt(r52, r17);
r10 = spu_ls_lq_fwd(ctx, _ls, _rd, spu_w0(r20) + 0x0, _fa, _fv);
r47 = spu_ah(r18, r16);
r48 = spu_gb(r51);
r45 = spu_ahi(r16, 2);
r46 = spu_gb(r50);
r9 = spu_xshw(r47);
r8 = spu_fm_lz(r6, r22, r6, r22, &_u8);
r5 = spu_fm_lz(r7, r22, _u7, r22, &_u5);
r44 = spu_rotqby(r14, r48);
r4 = spu_xshw(r45);
r43 = spu_rotqby(r14, r46);
r66 = spu_shli(r9, 3);
r65 = spu_cgt(r21, r4);
r42 = spu_ceqbi(r44, 0);
r41 = spu_ceqbi(r43, 0);
r40 = spu_xsbh(r42);
r39 = spu_xsbh(r41);
r38 = spu_ceqhi(r40, 0);
r37 = spu_ceqhi(r39, 0);
r13 = spu_ai(r13, 32);
r3 = spu_fsm(r38);
r15 = spu_ai(r15, 2);
r2 = spu_fsm(r37);
r16 = spu_ai(r16, 2);
r74 = spu_selb(r6, r8, r3);
r72 = spu_selb(r7, r5, r2);
r78 = spu_cflts(r74, 149);
r79 = spu_cflts(r74, 161);
r76 = spu_cflts(r72, 149);
r77 = spu_cflts(r72, 161);
r75 = spu_fa_lz(r10, r74, r10, _u74, &_u75);
r73 = spu_shufb(r78, r79, r19);
r71 = spu_shufb(r76, r77, r19);
r70 = spu_fa_lz(r75, r72, _u75, _u72, &_ud);
r68 = spu_shufb(r73, r74, r24);
r69 = spu_shufb(r71, r72, r23);
spu_ls_sq(ctx, _ls, _wd, spu_w0(r20) + 0x0, r70); _fa = (spu_w0(r20) + 0x0) & (SPU_LS_MASK & ~0xFu); _fv = r70;
r67 = spu_ah(r68, r69);
spu_ls_sq(ctx, _ls, _wd, spu_w0(r66) + spu_w0(r25), r67); _fa = (spu_w0(r66) + spu_w0(r25)) & (SPU_LS_MASK & ~0xFu); _fv = r67;
if (spu_w0(r65) != 0) { goto loc_00007F10; }
"""


def strip(s):
    """A statement line without twin assignments, register reloads and what the branch writes back."""
    s = s.strip()
    s = re.sub(r"r\d+ = ctx->gpr\[\d+\]; ", "", s)
    s = re.sub(r"ctx->gpr\[\d+\] = r\d+; ", "", s)
    s = re.sub(r" _u\d+ = [^;]*;", "", s)
    s = re.sub(r"^_u\d+ = [^;]*; ", "", s)
    return s


def main():
    src, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    raw = open(src, "rb").read()
    h = hashlib.sha1(raw).hexdigest()
    if h != EXPECT_SHA1:
        sys.exit("spu_recomp.c changed (sha1 %s): rebuild and re-run the harness against it, then update "
                 "EXPECT_SHA1 in gen_7DC8.py" % h)
    lines = raw.decode("latin-1").replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n")
    start = [i for i, s in enumerate(lines) if s == FUNC]
    assert len(start) == 1, "0x7DC8 not found exactly once"
    start = start[0]
    end = next(i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)) if lines[i] == "}")
    body = lines[start + 1:end]
    labs = [s[:-1] for s in body if re.match(r"^loc_[0-9A-F]{8}:$", s)]
    assert labs == LABELS, "labels of 0x7DC8 changed: %s" % labs
    i10 = body.index("loc_00007F10:")
    ic4 = body.index("loc_00007FC4:")
    assert INTR.match(body[i10 + 1]), body[i10 + 1]
    got = [strip(s) for s in body[i10 + 2:ic4] if strip(s) and not strip(s).startswith("/*")]
    want = [s for s in PASS.split("\n") if s]
    assert got == want, "the pass at 0x7F10 changed:\n" + "\n".join("%s\n   != %s" % (a, b) for a, b in zip(got, want) if a != b)
    decl = " ".join(s for s in body if s.strip().startswith("u128 "))
    twins = [n for n in (13, 15, 16) if re.search(r"\b_u%d\b" % n, decl)]
    out = body[:i10 + 2]
    out.append("        NX7_FAST_FORWARD;" + "".join(" _u%d = r%d;" % (n, n) for n in twins))
    out += body[i10 + 2:]
    with open(outdir + "/blk_7DC8.inc", "w", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write("/* Generated by gen_7DC8.py: the body of the lifted 0x7DC8 with NX7_FAST_FORWARD added -- do not edit. */\n")
        f.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")
    print("blk_7DC8.inc: %d lines, twins set after the fast-forward: %s" % (len(out), twins))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```
