`GT5/src/native/native_common.h`:

```h
/*
 * native_common.h -- shared by the native_<image>.c files: register and local-store access as
 * __m128i, the float pieces, and the rules they rest on.
 *
 * Included after the job's spu_recomp.h, spu_helpers.h, spu_context.h and native_geo.h. Everything is
 * static.
 *
 * FLOAT RULES (lifted code built with SPU_X86_RZ_ALWAYS, MXCSR = round toward zero + FTZ + DAZ)
 *   spu_fa/fs/fm/fma/fnms(x..) = t = the host operation; if every lane of t has |t| < FLT_MAX
 *   (ordered compare: Inf and NaN fail, and so does +-FLT_MAX itself) the result is flush(t) =
 *   t with -0 replaced by +0; otherwise the failing lanes are redone exactly, out of line.
 *   So a native function may use the bare host operation for an operation wherever it then
 *     (a) proves, or checks, that every lane of t is below FLT_MAX in magnitude, and
 *     (b) applies flush, or proves t cannot be -0.
 *   n4_chk() accumulates the largest |t| bit pattern seen (as integers: NaN and Inf patterns
 *   are above 0x7F7FFFFF); n4_chk_bad() is the single test at the end. A function that fails it
 *   has stored nothing to local store yet and redoes the operations exactly (the n4x_ pieces
 *   below): real data has vectors whose last lane is not a float at all, so "give the call to
 *   the lifted function" would be most calls.
 *   flush(t) is t + (+0): under round toward zero (-0) + (+0) = +0 and x + 0 = x for every other
 *   x, NaN payloads included. It must stay a separate add: fused into a*b + 0 it would return -0
 *   for a product that underflows from below. clang does not fuse across intrinsics (contraction
 *   "on" is per source expression); the pragma below says so again, the disassembly was checked,
 *   and the harness feeds underflowing products.
 *   Only values that are STORED (registers, local store) need the flush. Two values that differ
 *   only in the sign of a zero ("~") give ~ results in every add, multiply and fused
 *   multiply-add, have the same magnitude for the range check, compare the same in the host's
 *   float compares, and flush to the same word. So a chain is computed on the unflushed values
 *   and each stored value is flushed on the side, off the chain.
 *   spu_fcgt(a, b): the host compare when neither side holds a NaN pattern, else the integer
 *   "key" compare. Against a positive normal constant C and a value v that is never negative
 *   (or is a flushed in-range float) both are the signed integer compare of the bit patterns.
 */
#ifndef NATIVE_COMMON_H
#define NATIVE_COMMON_H
#include <immintrin.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#if !SPU_X86 || !defined(__AVX2__) || !defined(__FMA__) || !defined(SPU_X86_RZ_ALWAYS) || defined(SPU_X86_FAST_FLOAT)
#error "native code must be built like the lifted SPU code: -mavx2 -mfma -DSPU_X86_RZ_ALWAYS=1, no SPU_X86_FAST_FLOAT"
#endif
#pragma clang fp contract(off)

#define N4_LSM (SPU_LS_MASK & ~0xFu)
#define N4_LIKELY(x)   __builtin_expect(!!(x), 1)
#define N4_UNLIKELY(x) __builtin_expect(!!(x), 0)
#define N4_INLINE static inline __attribute__((always_inline))
#define N4_NOINLINE __attribute__((noinline))

#ifdef NATIVE_STATS
#define N4_STAT(arr, i) ((arr)[i]++)
#else
#define N4_STAT(arr, i) ((void)0)
#endif

N4_INLINE __m128i n4_bswap(__m128i x) {
    return _mm_shuffle_epi8(x, _mm_setr_epi8(3, 2, 1, 0, 7, 6, 5, 4, 11, 10, 9, 8, 15, 14, 13, 12));
}
/* register n of the context */
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_g(const spu_context* ctx, int n) { return _mm_loadu_si128((const __m128i*)&ctx->gpr[n]); }
N4_INLINE void n4_p(spu_context* ctx, int n, __m128i v) { _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)&ctx->gpr[n], v); }
N4_INLINE uint32_t n4_g0(const spu_context* ctx, int n) { return ctx->gpr[n]._u32[0]; }   /* preferred word */
/* quadword load / store, as lqd/lqx/stqd do: the address masked to the 16-byte line */
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_lq(const uint8_t* ls, uint32_t a) { return n4_bswap(_mm_loadu_si128((const __m128i*)(ls + (a & N4_LSM)))); }
N4_INLINE void n4_sq(uint8_t* ls, uint32_t a, __m128i v) { _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)(ls + (a & N4_LSM)), n4_bswap(v)); }
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_from(u128 v) { return _mm_loadu_si128((const __m128i*)&v); }
N4_INLINE u128 n4_to(__m128i v) { u128 r; _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)&r, v); return r; }
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_splat(uint32_t w) { return _mm_set1_epi32((int)w); }

/* rotqbyi 4 / 8 / 12: word i of the result is word i+1 / i+2 / i+3 of the source */
#define n4_rot4(x)  _mm_shuffle_epi32((x), _MM_SHUFFLE(0, 3, 2, 1))
#define n4_rot8(x)  _mm_shuffle_epi32((x), _MM_SHUFFLE(1, 0, 3, 2))
#define n4_rot12(x) _mm_shuffle_epi32((x), _MM_SHUFFLE(2, 1, 0, 3))
/* shufb(x, x, 0x00010203 in every word): the preferred word in every lane */
#define n4_splat0(x) _mm_shuffle_epi32((x), 0)

N4_INLINE __m128 n4_f(__m128i x) { return _mm_castsi128_ps(x); }
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_i(__m128 x) { return _mm_castps_si128(x); }
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_mul(__m128i a, __m128i b) { return n4_i(_mm_mul_ps(n4_f(a), n4_f(b))); }
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_add(__m128i a, __m128i b) { return n4_i(_mm_add_ps(n4_f(a), n4_f(b))); }
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_sub(__m128i a, __m128i b) { return n4_i(_mm_sub_ps(n4_f(a), n4_f(b))); }
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_fmadd(__m128i a, __m128i b, __m128i c) { return n4_i(_mm_fmadd_ps(n4_f(a), n4_f(b), n4_f(c))); }
#ifdef N4_MUT_NOFLUSH   /* mutation test of the harness: must produce mismatches */
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_flush(__m128i t) { return t; }
#elif defined(N4_FLUSH_INT)
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_flush(__m128i t) { return _mm_andnot_si128(_mm_cmpeq_epi32(t, _mm_set1_epi32((int)0x80000000u)), t); }
#else
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_flush(__m128i t) { return n4_i(_mm_add_ps(n4_f(t), _mm_setzero_ps())); }
#endif
/* the range check: acc = max(acc, |t|) as integers */
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_chk(__m128i acc, __m128i t) { return _mm_max_epu32(acc, _mm_and_si128(t, _mm_set1_epi32(0x7FFFFFFF))); }
N4_INLINE int n4_chk_bad(__m128i acc) {
#ifdef N4_MUT_NOCHK     /* mutation test of the harness: must produce mismatches */
    return 0;
#endif
    return _mm_movemask_epi8(_mm_cmpgt_epi32(acc, _mm_set1_epi32(0x7F7FFFFE))) != 0;
}
/* any lane with exponent 255 (what the host reads as Inf or NaN)? */
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_exp255(__m128i x) {
    const __m128i e = _mm_set1_epi32(0x7F800000);
    return _mm_cmpeq_epi32(_mm_and_si128(x, e), e);
}

/* frsqest, every lane, exact (integer work on the bit fields, as spu_frsqest): the table lookups
 * as four scalar loads in place of the helper's eight permutes and seven blends. The table's
 * entries are below 2^23, so the helper's mask is not needed. *fr gets the fractions alone. */
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_frsqest_fr(__m128i x, __m128i* fr) {
    const __m128i idx = _mm_and_si128(_mm_srli_epi32(x, 18), _mm_set1_epi32(0x3F));
    const __m128i exp = _mm_and_si128(_mm_srli_epi32(x, 23), _mm_set1_epi32(0xFF));
    const uint64_t lo = (uint64_t)_mm_cvtsi128_si64(idx), hi = (uint64_t)_mm_extract_epi64(idx, 1);
    const __m128i f01 = _mm_insert_epi32(_mm_cvtsi32_si128((int)spu_frsqest_fraction_lut[(uint32_t)lo]), (int)spu_frsqest_fraction_lut[lo >> 32], 1);
    const __m128i f23 = _mm_insert_epi32(_mm_cvtsi32_si128((int)spu_frsqest_fraction_lut[(uint32_t)hi]), (int)spu_frsqest_fraction_lut[hi >> 32], 1);
    const __m128i frac = _mm_unpacklo_epi64(f01, f23);
    /* exponent 190 - (exp + 1) / 2, or 255 for exp 0 (190 | 255 = 255) */
    __m128i rexp = _mm_sub_epi32(_mm_set1_epi32(190), _mm_srli_epi32(_mm_add_epi32(exp, _mm_set1_epi32(1)), 1));
    rexp = _mm_or_si128(rexp, _mm_and_si128(_mm_cmpeq_epi32(exp, _mm_setzero_si128()), _mm_set1_epi32(0xFF)));
    *fr = frac;
    return _mm_or_si128(_mm_slli_epi32(rexp, 23), frac);
}
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_frsqest(__m128i x) { __m128i fr; return n4_frsqest_fr(x, &fr); }
/* fi(a, est), every lane, exact: spu_fi's formula. The one multiply, (est & 0x3FF) * (a & 0x7FFFF)
 * (below 2^29), is done as two 32x32->64 multiplies of the even and the odd lanes: half the
 * latency of a 32-bit lane multiply on the path of the preferred word. */
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_fi(__m128i a, __m128i est) {
    const __m128i y = _mm_and_si128(a, _mm_set1_epi32(0x7FFFF)), s = _mm_and_si128(est, _mm_set1_epi32(0x3FF));
    const __m128i sy = _mm_or_si128(_mm_mul_epu32(s, y), _mm_slli_epi64(_mm_mul_epu32(_mm_srli_epi64(s, 32), _mm_srli_epi64(y, 32)), 32));
    const __m128i exp = _mm_and_si128(_mm_srli_epi32(est, 23), _mm_set1_epi32(0xFF));
    const __m128i b19 = _mm_slli_epi32(_mm_and_si128(_mm_srli_epi32(est, 10), _mm_set1_epi32(0x1FFF)), 19);
    const __m128i big = _mm_cmpeq_epi32(_mm_max_epu32(b19, sy), b19);           /* magnitude >= 1.0 */
    const __m128i d = _mm_sub_epi32(b19, sy);
    const __m128i frac = _mm_and_si128(_mm_blendv_epi8(_mm_srli_epi32(d, 8), _mm_srli_epi32(d, 9), big), _mm_set1_epi32(0x7FFFFF));
    const __m128i e2 = _mm_sub_epi32(exp, _mm_andnot_si128(big, _mm_set1_epi32(1)));   /* normalised: exp - 1 */
    const __m128i r = _mm_or_si128(_mm_or_si128(_mm_and_si128(est, _mm_set1_epi32((int)0x80000000u)), _mm_slli_epi32(e2, 23)), frac);
    const __m128i zero = _mm_or_si128(_mm_cmpeq_epi32(exp, _mm_setzero_si128()), _mm_cmpeq_epi32(e2, _mm_setzero_si128()));
    return _mm_andnot_si128(zero, r);
}
/* rotqby(x, sh): SPU byte j of the result is SPU byte (j + sh) & 15 of x; host byte h holds SPU
 * byte h ^ 3. One shuffle with the control from a table (the helper builds the control). */
#define N4_RB(h, s) (char)(((((h) ^ 3) + (s)) & 15) ^ 3)
#define N4_ROTROW(s) { N4_RB(0, s), N4_RB(1, s), N4_RB(2, s), N4_RB(3, s), N4_RB(4, s), N4_RB(5, s), N4_RB(6, s), N4_RB(7, s), \
                       N4_RB(8, s), N4_RB(9, s), N4_RB(10, s), N4_RB(11, s), N4_RB(12, s), N4_RB(13, s), N4_RB(14, s), N4_RB(15, s) }
static const __declspec(align(16)) char n4_rot_ctl[16][16] = {
    N4_ROTROW(0), N4_ROTROW(1), N4_ROTROW(2), N4_ROTROW(3), N4_ROTROW(4), N4_ROTROW(5), N4_ROTROW(6), N4_ROTROW(7),
    N4_ROTROW(8), N4_ROTROW(9), N4_ROTROW(10), N4_ROTROW(11), N4_ROTROW(12), N4_ROTROW(13), N4_ROTROW(14), N4_ROTROW(15),
};
N4_INLINE __m128i n4_rotqby(__m128i x, uint32_t sh) {
    return _mm_shuffle_epi8(x, _mm_load_si128((const __m128i*)n4_rot_ctl[sh & 15]));
}

/* ---- lanes outside the host float range, exactly ----------------------------------------------
 * Two tools, both exact for every bit pattern (they give what spu_fm / spu_fma / spu_fa give):
 *
 * n4x_fm / n4x_fma / n4x_fa: the runtime's own helpers on __m128i. One host operation and, for
 *   lanes that left the host range, the helper's exact out-of-line routine. For operations that
 *   are redone one at a time.
 *
 * n4x_sumsq: the chain  a = v*v;  b = v'*v' + a;  c = v"*v" + b  (v' = v rotated one word, v" two
 *   words: the sum of squares both functions here start with) for all four lanes in double
 *   precision, with one widening for the three operations. Under MXCSR round toward zero:
 *     - an SPU single widens exactly to a double: biased exponent 0 -> +0.0, anything else the
 *       double with the same sign, power of two and fraction, so exponent 255 is one more binade
 *       (n4x_wide; cvtps2pd would read it as Inf/NaN);
 *     - a square of a 24-bit significand is exact in a double, and the squares of v' and v" are
 *       the squares of v, rotated;
 *     - a sum of a square and an SPU single is truncated once at 53 bits by the double add, and
 *       truncating that at 24 bits gives the exact sum truncated at 24 bits (the 24-bit numbers
 *       are 53-bit numbers, and truncation toward zero is monotone);
 *     - n4x_round_pos makes a double >= 0 the SPU result: the 29 low significand bits cleared
 *       (truncation at 24 bits), clamped to Smax, +0 below Smin = 2^-126. That value, still a
 *       double, is the next step's addend; n4x_narrow_pos gives its bits as a single.
 *   Everything is >= 0, so there is no sign and no -0 to handle. No value is a denormal double or
 *   overflows one (squares lie in [2^-252, 2^258)), so FTZ/DAZ never act. */
N4_INLINE __m128i n4x_fm(__m128i a, __m128i b) { return n4_from(spu_fm(n4_to(a), n4_to(b))); }
N4_INLINE __m128i n4x_fa(__m128i a, __m128i b) { return n4_from(spu_fa(n4_to(a), n4_to(b))); }
N4_INLINE __m128i n4x_fma(__m128i a, __m128i b, __m128i c) { return n4_from(spu_fma(n4_to(a), n4_to(b), n4_to(c))); }

N4_INLINE __m256d n4x_wide(__m128i x) {
    /* sign-extended and moved up 29 bits: sign at bit 63 (bits 60-62 are copies of it, masked off),
     * the 8 exponent bits at 52, the fraction at 29; then the exponent rebiased (1023 - 127) */
    const __m256i u = _mm256_and_si256(_mm256_slli_epi64(_mm256_cvtepi32_epi64(x), 29), _mm256_set1_epi64x((long long)0x8FFFFFFFE0000000ull));
    const __m256i nz = _mm256_cmpgt_epi64(_mm256_add_epi64(u, u), _mm256_set1_epi64x(0x001FFFFFFFFFFFFFll));   /* biased exponent != 0 */
    return _mm256_castsi256_pd(_mm256_and_si256(_mm256_add_epi64(u, _mm256_set1_epi64x(896ll << 52)), nz));
}
/* d >= 0 as the SPU would leave it, still a double; *keep = the lanes that are not +0 */
N4_INLINE __m256d n4x_round_pos(__m256d d, __m256i* keep) {
    const __m256d t = _mm256_and_pd(d, _mm256_castsi256_pd(_mm256_set1_epi64x(~0x1FFFFFFFll)));
#ifdef N4X_MUT_NOSMIN   /* mutation test of the harness: must produce mismatches */
    *keep = _mm256_castpd_si256(_mm256_cmp_pd(t, _mm256_setzero_pd(), _CMP_GT_OQ));
#else
    *keep = _mm256_castpd_si256(_mm256_cmp_pd(t, _mm256_castsi256_pd(_mm256_set1_epi64x(0x3810000000000000ll)), _CMP_GE_OQ));   /* 2^-126 */
#endif
    return _mm256_and_pd(_mm256_min_pd(t, _mm256_castsi256_pd(_mm256_set1_epi64x(0x47FFFFFFE0000000ll))),      /* Smax */
                         _mm256_castsi256_pd(*keep));
}
/* the bits of such a value as a single: moved down 29 bits and rebiased; 0 where it is +0 */
N4_INLINE __m128i n4x_narrow_pos(__m256d r, __m256i keep) {
    const __m256i w = _mm256_and_si256(_mm256_sub_epi64(_mm256_srli_epi64(_mm256_castpd_si256(r), 29), _mm256_set1_epi64x(896ll << 23)), keep);
    return _mm256_castsi256_si128(_mm256_permutevar8x32_epi32(w, _mm256_setr_epi32(0, 2, 4, 6, 0, 2, 4, 6)));
}
/* a = fm(v, v), b = fma(rot4(v), rot4(v), a), c = fma(rot8(v), rot8(v), b), every lane exact.
 * Out of line, so that the functions using it hold no 256-bit state themselves (inlined, every
 * exit of theirs got a vzeroupper, also on the path with all floats in range); the argument and
 * the three results travel in registers (__vectorcall: a struct of three vectors comes back in
 * xmm0-xmm2). */
typedef struct n4x_sumsq_t { __m128i a, b, c; } n4x_sumsq_t;
static N4_NOINLINE n4x_sumsq_t __vectorcall n4x_sumsq(__m128i v) {
    const __m256d w = n4x_wide(v);
    const __m256d p = _mm256_mul_pd(w, w);                                   /* exact */
    __m256i ka, kb, kc;
    const __m256d da = n4x_round_pos(p, &ka);
#ifdef N4X_MUT_NOROUND  /* mutation test of the harness: must produce mismatches */
    const __m256d db = n4x_round_pos(_mm256_add_pd(_mm256_permute4x64_pd(p, _MM_SHUFFLE(0, 3, 2, 1)), p), &kb);
#else
    const __m256d db = n4x_round_pos(_mm256_add_pd(_mm256_permute4x64_pd(p, _MM_SHUFFLE(0, 3, 2, 1)), da), &kb);
#endif
    const __m256d dc = n4x_round_pos(_mm256_add_pd(_mm256_permute4x64_pd(p, _MM_SHUFFLE(1, 0, 3, 2)), db), &kc);
    n4x_sumsq_t r;
    r.a = n4x_narrow_pos(da, ka); r.b = n4x_narrow_pos(db, kb); r.c = n4x_narrow_pos(dc, kc);
    return r;
}

/* ---- GT5_NATIVE_GEO=2: run both and compare ---------------------------------------------------
 * For a function whose possible stores are a few known lines: keep the registers and those lines;
 * run the native function and keep its result; put the entry state back; run the lifted function;
 * compare all registers, those lines, pc and the successor; log a difference
 * ("[native-geo] MISMATCH <image>:<addr> ..."); the LIFTED result stays. Both runs are made to
 * return in place of tail-calling their successor by clearing ctx->steps for their duration
 * (SPU_DIRECT_SV then leaves the successor pending in g_spu_trampoline_fn and returns; SPU_RET
 * returns anyway): the drain loop this call sits under carries on from there.
 * Returns 0 when it did nothing (the caller then runs the lifted function as usual). */
typedef struct n4_range { uint32_t a, n; } n4_range;                /* LS bytes [a, a + n), inside local store */
#define N4_CMP_CAP 256u
static N4_NOINLINE int n4_compare(spu_context* ctx, const char* image, unsigned addr, SPU_SV void (*native)(spu_context*),
                                  SPU_SV void (*orig)(spu_context*), const n4_range* r, int nr) {
    uint8_t ls0[N4_CMP_CAP], ls1[N4_CMP_CAP];
    u128 g0[128], g1[128];
    uint32_t bytes = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nr; i++) { if (r[i].a > SPU_LS_SIZE || r[i].n > SPU_LS_SIZE - r[i].a) return 0; bytes += r[i].n; }
    if (bytes > N4_CMP_CAP || (g_spu_ls_rdiag | g_spu_ls_wdiag) != 0) return 0;
    const uint32_t steps = ctx->steps, pc0 = ctx->pc;
    for (uint32_t i = 0, o = 0; i < (uint32_t)nr; o += r[i].n, i++) memcpy(ls0 + o, ctx->ls + r[i].a, r[i].n);
    memcpy(g0, ctx->gpr, sizeof g0);
    ctx->steps = 0;
    g_spu_trampoline_fn = 0;
    native(ctx);
    void (* const succ1)(spu_context*) = g_spu_trampoline_fn;
    const uint32_t pc1 = ctx->pc;
    memcpy(g1, ctx->gpr, sizeof g1);
    for (uint32_t i = 0, o = 0; i < (uint32_t)nr; o += r[i].n, i++) memcpy(ls1 + o, ctx->ls + r[i].a, r[i].n);
    memcpy(ctx->gpr, g0, sizeof g0);                                 /* back to the entry state */
    for (uint32_t i = 0, o = 0; i < (uint32_t)nr; o += r[i].n, i++) memcpy(ctx->ls + r[i].a, ls0 + o, r[i].n);
    ctx->pc = pc0;
    g_spu_trampoline_fn = 0;
    orig(ctx);                                                       /* the result that stays */
    ctx->steps = steps;
    for (uint32_t i = 0, o = 0; i < (uint32_t)nr; o += r[i].n, i++) memcpy(ls0 + o, ctx->ls + r[i].a, r[i].n);
    native_geo_compared();
    if (memcmp(g1, ctx->gpr, sizeof g1) != 0 || memcmp(ls0, ls1, bytes) != 0 || pc1 != ctx->pc || succ1 != g_spu_trampoline_fn) {
        int reg = -1; uint32_t off = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        char d[160];
        for (int i = 0; i < 128 && reg < 0; i++) if (memcmp(&g1[i], &ctx->gpr[i], 16) != 0) reg = i;
        for (uint32_t i = 0, o = 0; i < (uint32_t)nr && off == 0xFFFFFFFFu; o += r[i].n, i++)
            for (uint32_t b = 0; b < r[i].n; b++) if (ls0[o + b] != ls1[o + b]) { off = r[i].a + b; break; }
        snprintf(d, sizeof d, "first register r%d, first LS byte 0x%05X, pc %05X/%05X (native/lifted)", reg, off, pc1, ctx->pc);
        native_geo_mismatch(image, addr, d);
    }
    return 1;
}
#endif

```

`GT5/src/native/native_geo.h`:

```h
/*
 * native_geo.h -- the one switch shared by the native x86 replacements of lifted SPU functions in
 * GT5's worker job images (native_w01606C00.c, native_w0163C080.c, ...).
 *
 * GT5_NATIVE_GEO, read once from the environment:
 *     0   lifted code only
 *     1   native replacements (default)
 *     2   run both, compare every register, pc and local store, log
 *         "[native-geo] MISMATCH <image>:<addr> ..." and keep the lifted result (slow: debugging)
 *
 * This header and native_geo_switch.c include no spu_recomp.h, so one copy serves every image.
 * Compile native_geo_switch.c ONCE per program (the copies in the natives' folders are identical).
 */
#ifndef NATIVE_GEO_H
#define NATIVE_GEO_H

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* -1 = GT5_NATIVE_GEO not read yet, else 0 / 1 / 2. A test harness may set it directly. */
extern int g_native_geo;
/* Compare mode: calls compared, calls that differed (all images together). */
extern unsigned long long g_native_geo_cmp_calls, g_native_geo_cmp_mismatches;

/* Reads GT5_NATIVE_GEO, prints "[native-geo] GT5_NATIVE_GEO=n" once, returns the mode. */
int native_geo_init(void);
/* Compare mode found a difference: counts it and logs the first 20,
 * "[native-geo] MISMATCH <image>:<addr> <detail>". */
void native_geo_mismatch(const char* image, unsigned addr, const char* detail);
/* Compare mode compared one call. */
void native_geo_compared(void);

/* Interrupts. The lifted code looks for a pending, enabled event at every label and leaves through
 * the interrupt path when there is one. GT5's worker jobs run with interrupts enabled all the time
 * (the job manager's stall-and-notify handler), so "only with interrupts off" would mean never. A
 * native function runs when no enabled event is pending as it starts. One raised while it runs (by
 * another thread: a lost reservation, a signal) is taken at the next label of the lifted code that
 * follows, some microseconds later than the lifted function would have taken it; an interrupt has
 * no fixed place in the instruction stream, so both are executions the hardware allows. With none
 * pending, the lifted function's checks do nothing, so the results are the same. */
#define NATIVE_GEO_IRQ_PENDING(ctx) ((ctx)->int_enable != 0 && ((ctx)->event_status & (ctx)->event_mask) != 0)

static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) int native_geo_mode(void) {
    const int m = g_native_geo;
    return __builtin_expect(m >= 0, 1) ? m : native_geo_init();
}

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
#endif

```

`GT5/src/native/native_geo_switch.c`:

```c
/*
 * native_geo_switch.c -- GT5_NATIVE_GEO, the switch of the native SPU replacements (native_geo.h).
 * Includes no spu_recomp.h: compile it once, whatever number of images have native files.
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include "native_geo.h"

int g_native_geo = -1;
unsigned long long g_native_geo_cmp_calls, g_native_geo_cmp_mismatches;

__attribute__((noinline)) int native_geo_init(void)
{
    static volatile long said;
    const char* e = getenv("GT5_NATIVE_GEO");
    int m = 1;
    if (e && e[0] >= '0' && e[0] <= '2' && e[1] == 0) m = e[0] - '0';
    /* several SPU threads may get here together: all compute the same value, one prints */
    if (__atomic_exchange_n(&said, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST) == 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[native-geo] GT5_NATIVE_GEO=%d\n", m);
        fflush(stderr);
    }
    g_native_geo = m;
    return m;
}

void native_geo_compared(void)
{
    const unsigned long long n = __atomic_add_fetch(&g_native_geo_cmp_calls, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    /* a sign of life in the game's log: how many calls were compared so far, and how many differed */
    if ((n & (n - 1)) == 0 ? n >= 1024 : (n % 1000000) == 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[native-geo] compared %llu calls, %llu differed\n", n,
                __atomic_load_n(&g_native_geo_cmp_mismatches, __ATOMIC_RELAXED));
        fflush(stderr);
    }
}

#ifdef NATIVE_STATS
/* A test build (cmake -DGT5_NATIVE_STATS=ON): what the native functions did, every 5 seconds. The
 * counters are plain increments from several threads, so the numbers are approximate. */
#include <windows.h>
unsigned long long g_native_geo_why[16];
extern unsigned long long g_native8038_stat[8], g_native5BA8_stat[3], g_native7DC8_stat[5];
extern unsigned long long g_n4_66A8_stat[4], g_n4_6418_stat[6], g_n4_66A8_exact[2], g_n4_6418_exact[2];
static DWORD WINAPI native_geo_stat_thread(LPVOID p)
{
    (void)p;
    for (;;) {
        Sleep(5000);
        const unsigned long long* w = g_native_geo_why; const unsigned long long* a = g_native8038_stat;
        if (!w[0] && !g_n4_66A8_stat[0]) continue;
        fprintf(stderr, "[native-geo-stat] 8038: calls %llu (cells %llu) | left to lifted: event pending %llu (calls with interrupts enabled %llu), diag %llu, "
                "mxcsr %llu, shape %llu, small %llu | native calls %llu, fast cells %llu, lifted-statement cells %llu, deopts %llu, redone %llu\n",
                w[0], w[6], w[1], w[7], w[2], w[3], w[4], w[5], a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4]);
        fprintf(stderr, "[native-geo-stat] 5BA8: calls %llu, fast %llu, lines %llu | 7DC8: calls %llu, fast-forwards %llu, passes %llu, helper ops %llu, "
                "conversions redone %llu | 66A8: calls %llu, to lifted %llu (guard %llu, range %llu) | 6418: calls %llu, to lifted %llu "
                "(guard %llu, range %llu), left for 6CA4 %llu, normalised %llu | done exactly in native code: 66A8 %llu + %llu, 6418 %llu + %llu\n",
                g_native5BA8_stat[0], g_native5BA8_stat[1], g_native5BA8_stat[2],
                g_native7DC8_stat[0], g_native7DC8_stat[1], g_native7DC8_stat[2], g_native7DC8_stat[3], g_native7DC8_stat[4],
                g_n4_66A8_stat[0], g_n4_66A8_stat[1], g_n4_66A8_stat[2], g_n4_66A8_stat[3],
                g_n4_6418_stat[0], g_n4_6418_stat[1], g_n4_6418_stat[2], g_n4_6418_stat[3], g_n4_6418_stat[4], g_n4_6418_stat[5],
                g_n4_66A8_exact[0], g_n4_66A8_exact[1], g_n4_6418_exact[0], g_n4_6418_exact[1]);
        fflush(stderr);
    }
    return 0;
}
/* GT5_NATIVE_GEO_DUMP=<folder>: real inputs of calls a native function left to the lifted one, for the
 * test harness: <folder>\<name>_<n>.bin = the 128 registers, then the whole local store. Every 2048th
 * such call of a name, 48 files a name at most. */
void native_geo_dump(const char* name, const void* gpr, unsigned gpr_bytes, const void* ls, unsigned ls_bytes)
{
    static const char* dir; static int init;
    static const char* names[8]; static volatile long seen[8], wrote[8];
    if (!init) { dir = getenv("GT5_NATIVE_GEO_DUMP"); init = 1; }
    if (!dir || !dir[0]) return;
    int k = 0;
    while (k < 8 && names[k] && names[k] != name) k++;
    if (k == 8) return;
    names[k] = name;
    const long n = __atomic_add_fetch(&seen[k], 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if ((n & 2047) != 1) return;
    const long w = __atomic_add_fetch(&wrote[k], 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (w > 48) return;
    char p[600];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\%s_%02ld.bin", dir, name, w);
    FILE* f = fopen(p, "wb");
    if (!f) return;
    fwrite(gpr, 1, gpr_bytes, f); fwrite(ls, 1, ls_bytes, f); fclose(f);
}
__attribute__((constructor)) static void native_geo_stat_start(void)
{
    CloseHandle(CreateThread(NULL, 0, native_geo_stat_thread, NULL, 0, NULL));
}
#endif

void native_geo_mismatch(const char* image, unsigned addr, const char* detail)
{
    const unsigned long long n = __atomic_add_fetch(&g_native_geo_cmp_mismatches, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (n <= 20) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[native-geo] MISMATCH %s:%04X %s\n", image, addr, detail ? detail : "");
        fflush(stderr);
    }
}
```

`GT5/src/native/native_jEB79FDFC.c`:

```c
/* Native x86 fast paths for the FFT loops of GT5's EQ / loudness SPU job (socepdideq, lifted
 * image jEB79FDFC).  native_snd.h has the scheme, the float rules and the GT5_NATIVE_SND switch.
 *
 * Build: the game's flags for this job (GT5 CMakeLists.txt), i.e. the default sound-module flags
 * plus SPU_X86_FAST_DOUBLE, and the hooked wiring (natives.txt):
 *   -O2 /w /GS- -mavx2 -mfma -ffp-contract=off -DSPU_X86_RZ_ALWAYS=1 -DSPU_X86_FAST_DOUBLE=1 -DSPU_USE_DISPATCH_MT -DNATIVE_HOOKED
 * Include directories: this job's folder, ps3recomp's runtime/spu, this file's folder.
 * The fast blocks reproduce the job's doubles AS BUILT WITH SPU_X86_FAST_DOUBLE (below); a job
 * built without it rounds its doubles to nearest and these functions would not match it, so this
 * file refuses to build without the macro.
 *
 * The four butterfly loops share one shape.  Per pass:
 *     (c, s) = the twiddle w, a pair of doubles, rounded to singles (frds) and splatted
 *     w      = (w*alpha + w) + beta * (swap(w) ^ mask)      two dfma: the rotation recurrence
 *     two or four line pairs:  sum = a + b,  dif = a - b    (fa / fs)
 *     the differences are rotated by (c, s)                  (fm, then fma / fms)
 * Doubles under SPU_X86_FAST_DOUBLE are the host fma / cvtsd2ss in the thread's mode (round
 * toward zero, FTZ, DAZ) on values that are not NaN; a NaN operand gives the default NaN
 * 0x7FF8000000000000, which is not what the host instruction gives.  With finite operands the
 * host result is finite (round toward zero cannot overflow) and is the lifted result bit for bit,
 * so the fast block requires w, alpha, beta and swap(w)^mask finite and otherwise leaves the pass
 * to the lifted code.  Singles: see native_snd.h (every result of a pass is range-checked before
 * anything of the pass is stored).
 * All loads of a pass come before its stores and the stores keep the lifted order, so the streams
 * may overlap in any way.
 */
#include "spu_recomp.h"
#include "spu_helpers.h"
#include "native_snd.h"
#ifndef NATIVE_HOOKED
#  error "this file defines the lifted functions' own names: build it with -DNATIVE_HOOKED (natives.txt: hooked)"
#endif
#ifndef SPU_X86_FAST_DOUBLE
#  error "native_jEB79FDFC.c matches the EQ job only as built with -DSPU_X86_FAST_DOUBLE=1"
#endif

/* GT5_NATIVE_SND=2 (native_snd.c): the lines a lifted loop stores to: up to four streams of
 * `bytes_per_pass` bytes a pass for `n` passes, each starting at word 0 of the register named
 * (-1 = no stream); -1 for a count the fast blocks do not take (the lifted function then runs
 * alone, uncompared). */
NS_INLINE int ns_streams_rng(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r, uint32_t n, uint32_t bytes_per_pass,
                             int ra, int rb, int rc, int rd) {
    if (n < 2 || n > 0x4000) return -1;
    const int regs[4] = { ra, rb, rc, rd };
    int k = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4 && regs[i] >= 0; i++) k = ns_add_range(r, k, ctx->gpr[regs[i]]._u32[0], bytes_per_pass * n);
    return k;
}

#define CTL_SPLAT0(r) ns_is(r, 0x00010203u, 0x00010203u, 0x00010203u, 0x00010203u)

typedef struct ns_tw { __m128d w, alpha, beta; __m128i mask; __m128 c, s; } ns_tw;
NS_INLINE int ns_tw_init(ns_tw* t, u128 w, u128 alpha, u128 beta, u128 mask) {
    t->w = ns_dreg(w); t->alpha = ns_dreg(alpha); t->beta = ns_dreg(beta);
    /* the mask is applied to swap(w) as a register xor: bring it into the host doubles' layout */
    t->mask = _mm_castpd_si128(ns_dreg(mask));
    return ns_dfinite(t->w) && ns_dfinite(t->alpha) && ns_dfinite(t->beta);
}
/* c, s of this pass and the next w; 0 when the pass has to be left to the lifted code */
NS_INLINE int ns_tw_step(ns_tw* t, __m128d* wn) {
    const __m128 cs = _mm_cvtpd_ps(t->w);                                   /* frds: c, s, 0, 0 */
    t->c = _mm_shuffle_ps(cs, cs, _MM_SHUFFLE(0, 0, 0, 0));
    t->s = _mm_shuffle_ps(cs, cs, _MM_SHUFFLE(1, 1, 1, 1));
    const __m128d sw = _mm_castsi128_pd(_mm_xor_si128(_mm_castpd_si128(_mm_shuffle_pd(t->w, t->w, 1)), t->mask));
    const __m128d w1 = _mm_fmadd_pd(t->w, t->alpha, t->w);
    *wn = _mm_fmadd_pd(t->beta, sw, w1);
    return ns_dfinite(sw);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 0x3C6C: forward FFT, the stages after the first; in place on four streams.
 *     A = LS[r19] (2 lines)  B = LS[r17]  C = LS[r20]  D = LS[r18]
 *     C' = C + D   A' = A + B   D' = (C-D)*c - (A-B)*s   B' = (A-B)*c + (C-D)*s
 * twiddle w = r21, alpha = r24, beta = r26, mask = r23; splat control r25; count r22.
 * Carried: r17 r18 r19 r20 r21 r22.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static void ns_fast_00003C6C(spu_context* ctx)
{
    u128* const g = ctx->gpr;
    uint8_t* const ls = ctx->ls;
    const uint32_t n = g[22]._u32[0];
    ns_tw t;
    if (n < 2 || n > 0x4000 || !CTL_SPLAT0(g[25]) || !ns_tw_init(&t, g[21], g[24], g[26], g[23])) {
        NS_STAT(NS_EB_3C6C, bail_precond, 1); return;
    }
    const uint32_t pa = g[19]._u32[0], pb = g[17]._u32[0], pc = g[20]._u32[0], pd = g[18]._u32[0];
    uint32_t k = 0;
    for (; k < n - 1; k++) {
        __m128d wn;
        if (__builtin_expect(!ns_tw_step(&t, &wn), 0)) break;
        const uint32_t o = 32u * k;
        uint8_t* const a0p = ns_line(ls, pa + o), * const a1p = ns_line(ls, pa + o + 16);
        uint8_t* const b0p = ns_line(ls, pb + o), * const b1p = ns_line(ls, pb + o + 16);
        uint8_t* const c0p = ns_line(ls, pc + o), * const c1p = ns_line(ls, pc + o + 16);
        uint8_t* const d0p = ns_line(ls, pd + o), * const d1p = ns_line(ls, pd + o + 16);
        const __m128 A0 = ns_ldq(a0p), A1 = ns_ldq(a1p), B0 = ns_ldq(b0p), B1 = ns_ldq(b1p);
        const __m128 C0 = ns_ldq(c0p), C1 = ns_ldq(c1p), D0 = ns_ldq(d0p), D1 = ns_ldq(d1p);
        const __m128 ab0 = _mm_sub_ps(A0, B0), ab1 = _mm_sub_ps(A1, B1), sa0 = _mm_add_ps(A0, B0), sa1 = _mm_add_ps(A1, B1);
        const __m128 cd0 = _mm_sub_ps(C0, D0), cd1 = _mm_sub_ps(C1, D1), sc0 = _mm_add_ps(C0, D0), sc1 = _mm_add_ps(C1, D1);
        const __m128 m0 = _mm_mul_ps(ab0, t.s), m1 = _mm_mul_ps(ab1, t.s), m2 = _mm_mul_ps(cd0, t.s), m3 = _mm_mul_ps(cd1, t.s);
        const __m128 dn0 = _mm_fmsub_ps(cd0, t.c, m0), dn1 = _mm_fmsub_ps(cd1, t.c, m1);
        const __m128 bn0 = _mm_fmadd_ps(ab0, t.c, m2), bn1 = _mm_fmadd_ps(ab1, t.c, m3);
        __m128i acc = ns_mag(ab0);
        NS_ACC(acc, ab1); NS_ACC(acc, sa0); NS_ACC(acc, sa1); NS_ACC(acc, cd0); NS_ACC(acc, cd1); NS_ACC(acc, sc0); NS_ACC(acc, sc1);
        NS_ACC(acc, m0); NS_ACC(acc, m1); NS_ACC(acc, m2); NS_ACC(acc, m3);
        NS_ACC(acc, dn0); NS_ACC(acc, dn1); NS_ACC(acc, bn0); NS_ACC(acc, bn1);
        if (__builtin_expect(ns_bad(acc), 0)) break;
        ns_stq(c0p, ns_flush(sc0)); ns_stq(c1p, ns_flush(sc1));
        ns_stq(a0p, ns_flush(sa0)); ns_stq(a1p, ns_flush(sa1));
        ns_stq(d0p, ns_flush(dn0)); ns_stq(d1p, ns_flush(dn1));
        ns_stq(b0p, ns_flush(bn0)); ns_stq(b1p, ns_flush(bn1));
        t.w = wn;
    }
    if (k) {
        g[17] = ns_splat_add(g[17], 32u * k); g[18] = ns_splat_add(g[18], 32u * k);
        g[19] = ns_splat_add(g[19], 32u * k); g[20] = ns_splat_add(g[20], 32u * k);
        g[21] = ns_du128(t.w);
        g[22] = ns_splat_add(g[22], 0u - k);
        NS_STAT(NS_EB_3C6C, fast_calls, 1); NS_STAT(NS_EB_3C6C, fast_iters, k);
        NS_FAULT(ns_line(ls, pb + 32u * (k - 1) + 16) + 15);
    }
    if (k != n - 1) NS_STAT(NS_EB_3C6C, bail_range, 1);
}
static int ns_ranges_00003C6C(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) {
    return ns_streams_rng(ctx, r, ctx->gpr[22]._u32[0], 32, 20, 19, 18, 17);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 0x3ADC: forward FFT, first stage: reads two streams (r17 forwards 4 lines a pass, r18 backwards),
 * writes four (r22, r21, r20, r23, 2 lines a pass each).
 *     P = LS[r17], LS[r17+16]   Q = LS[r18], LS[r18+16]   R = LS[r17+32], +48   T = LS[r18+32], +48
 *     LS[r22] = P + Q     LS[r21] = R - T
 *     LS[r20] = (P-Q)*c - (R+T)*s     LS[r23] = (R+T)*c + (P-Q)*s
 * twiddle w = r19, alpha = r28, beta = r26, mask = r25; splat control r27; count r24.
 * Carried: r17 r18 r19 r20 r21 r22 r23 r24.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static void ns_fast_00003ADC(spu_context* ctx)
{
    u128* const g = ctx->gpr;
    uint8_t* const ls = ctx->ls;
    const uint32_t n = g[24]._u32[0];
    ns_tw t;
    if (n < 2 || n > 0x4000 || !CTL_SPLAT0(g[27]) || !ns_tw_init(&t, g[19], g[28], g[26], g[25])) {
        NS_STAT(NS_EB_3ADC, bail_precond, 1); return;
    }
    const uint32_t p17 = g[17]._u32[0], p18 = g[18]._u32[0], p20 = g[20]._u32[0], p21 = g[21]._u32[0],
                   p22 = g[22]._u32[0], p23 = g[23]._u32[0];
    uint32_t k = 0;
    for (; k < n - 1; k++) {
        __m128d wn;
        if (__builtin_expect(!ns_tw_step(&t, &wn), 0)) break;
        const uint32_t i17 = p17 + 64u * k, i18 = p18 - 64u * k, o = 32u * k;
        const __m128 R0 = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, i17 + 0x20)), R1 = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, i17 + 0x30));
        const __m128 T0 = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, i18 + 0x20)), T1 = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, i18 + 0x30));
        const __m128 P0 = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, i17)), P1 = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, i17 + 0x10));
        const __m128 Q0 = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, i18)), Q1 = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, i18 + 0x10));
        const __m128 rt0 = _mm_add_ps(R0, T0), rt1 = _mm_add_ps(R1, T1), dr0 = _mm_sub_ps(R0, T0), dr1 = _mm_sub_ps(R1, T1);
        const __m128 pq0 = _mm_sub_ps(P0, Q0), pq1 = _mm_sub_ps(P1, Q1), sp0 = _mm_add_ps(P0, Q0), sp1 = _mm_add_ps(P1, Q1);
        const __m128 m0 = _mm_mul_ps(rt0, t.s), m1 = _mm_mul_ps(rt1, t.s), m2 = _mm_mul_ps(pq0, t.s), m3 = _mm_mul_ps(pq1, t.s);
        const __m128 e0 = _mm_fmsub_ps(pq0, t.c, m0), e1 = _mm_fmsub_ps(pq1, t.c, m1);
        const __m128 f0 = _mm_fmadd_ps(rt0, t.c, m2), f1 = _mm_fmadd_ps(rt1, t.c, m3);
        __m128i acc = ns_mag(rt0);
        NS_ACC(acc, rt1); NS_ACC(acc, dr0); NS_ACC(acc, dr1); NS_ACC(acc, pq0); NS_ACC(acc, pq1); NS_ACC(acc, sp0); NS_ACC(acc, sp1);
        NS_ACC(acc, m0); NS_ACC(acc, m1); NS_ACC(acc, m2); NS_ACC(acc, m3);
        NS_ACC(acc, e0); NS_ACC(acc, e1); NS_ACC(acc, f0); NS_ACC(acc, f1);
        if (__builtin_expect(ns_bad(acc), 0)) break;
        ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p22 + o), ns_flush(sp0)); ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p22 + o + 16), ns_flush(sp1));
        ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p21 + o), ns_flush(dr0)); ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p21 + o + 16), ns_flush(dr1));
        ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p20 + o), ns_flush(e0));  ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p20 + o + 16), ns_flush(e1));
        ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p23 + o), ns_flush(f0));  ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p23 + o + 16), ns_flush(f1));
        t.w = wn;
    }
    if (k) {
        g[17] = ns_splat_add(g[17], 64u * k); g[18] = ns_splat_add(g[18], 0u - 64u * k);
        g[20] = ns_splat_add(g[20], 32u * k); g[21] = ns_splat_add(g[21], 32u * k);
        g[22] = ns_splat_add(g[22], 32u * k); g[23] = ns_splat_add(g[23], 32u * k);
        g[19] = ns_du128(t.w);
        g[24] = ns_splat_add(g[24], 0u - k);
        NS_STAT(NS_EB_3ADC, fast_calls, 1); NS_STAT(NS_EB_3ADC, fast_iters, k);
        NS_FAULT(ns_line(ls, p23 + 32u * (k - 1) + 16) + 15);
    }
    if (k != n - 1) NS_STAT(NS_EB_3ADC, bail_range, 1);
}
static int ns_ranges_00003ADC(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) {
    return ns_streams_rng(ctx, r, ctx->gpr[24]._u32[0], 32, 22, 21, 20, 23);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 0x4158: inverse FFT, the stages after the first; in place on two streams, 4 lines a pass each.
 *     U = LS[r18 .. +0x30]   V = LS[r17 .. +0x30]         d_j = U_j - V_j
 *     U_j' = U_j + V_j
 *     V0' = d0*c - d2*s   V1' = d1*c - d3*s   V2' = d2*c + d0*s   V3' = d3*c + d1*s
 * twiddle w = r19, alpha = r22, beta = r24, mask = r21; splat control r23; count r20.
 * Carried: r17 r18 r19 r20.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static void ns_fast_00004158(spu_context* ctx)
{
    u128* const g = ctx->gpr;
    uint8_t* const ls = ctx->ls;
    const uint32_t n = g[20]._u32[0];
    ns_tw t;
    if (n < 2 || n > 0x4000 || !CTL_SPLAT0(g[23]) || !ns_tw_init(&t, g[19], g[22], g[24], g[21])) {
        NS_STAT(NS_EB_4158, bail_precond, 1); return;
    }
    const uint32_t pu = g[18]._u32[0], pv = g[17]._u32[0];
    uint32_t k = 0;
    for (; k < n - 1; k++) {
        __m128d wn;
        if (__builtin_expect(!ns_tw_step(&t, &wn), 0)) break;
        const uint32_t o = 64u * k;
        uint8_t* up[4]; uint8_t* vp[4];
        __m128 U[4], V[4], d[4], sum[4];
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) { up[j] = ns_line(ls, pu + o + 16u * j); vp[j] = ns_line(ls, pv + o + 16u * j); }
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) U[j] = ns_ldq(up[j]);
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) V[j] = ns_ldq(vp[j]);
        __m128i acc = _mm_setzero_si128();
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) { d[j] = _mm_sub_ps(U[j], V[j]); sum[j] = _mm_add_ps(U[j], V[j]); NS_ACC(acc, d[j]); NS_ACC(acc, sum[j]); }
        const __m128 m0 = _mm_mul_ps(d[0], t.s), m1 = _mm_mul_ps(d[1], t.s), m2 = _mm_mul_ps(d[2], t.s), m3 = _mm_mul_ps(d[3], t.s);
        const __m128 v3 = _mm_fmadd_ps(d[3], t.c, m1), v2 = _mm_fmadd_ps(d[2], t.c, m0);
        const __m128 v0 = _mm_fmsub_ps(d[0], t.c, m2), v1 = _mm_fmsub_ps(d[1], t.c, m3);
        NS_ACC(acc, m0); NS_ACC(acc, m1); NS_ACC(acc, m2); NS_ACC(acc, m3);
        NS_ACC(acc, v0); NS_ACC(acc, v1); NS_ACC(acc, v2); NS_ACC(acc, v3);
        if (__builtin_expect(ns_bad(acc), 0)) break;
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) ns_stq(up[j], ns_flush(sum[j]));
        ns_stq(vp[3], ns_flush(v3)); ns_stq(vp[2], ns_flush(v2)); ns_stq(vp[0], ns_flush(v0)); ns_stq(vp[1], ns_flush(v1));
        t.w = wn;
    }
    if (k) {
        g[17] = ns_splat_add(g[17], 64u * k); g[18] = ns_splat_add(g[18], 64u * k);
        g[19] = ns_du128(t.w);
        g[20] = ns_splat_add(g[20], 0u - k);
        NS_STAT(NS_EB_4158, fast_calls, 1); NS_STAT(NS_EB_4158, fast_iters, k);
        NS_FAULT(ns_line(ls, pv + 64u * (k - 1) + 16) + 15);
    }
    if (k != n - 1) NS_STAT(NS_EB_4158, bail_range, 1);
}
static int ns_ranges_00004158(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) {
    return ns_streams_rng(ctx, r, ctx->gpr[20]._u32[0], 64, 18, 17, -1, -1);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 0x4008: inverse FFT, first stage: reads two streams (r15, r14, 2 lines a pass), writes two
 * (r12, r11, 4 lines a pass).
 *     d = LS[r15] - LS[r14]    (two lines)
 *     LS[r12] = LS[r15] + LS[r14] (2 lines);  LS[r12+0x20], LS[r12+0x30] = r19 (a constant register)
 *     LS[r11], +0x10 = d*c     LS[r11+0x20], +0x30 = d*s
 * twiddle w = r13, alpha = r21, beta = r18, mask = r17; splat control r20; count r16.
 * Carried: r11 r12 r13 r14 r15 r16.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static void ns_fast_00004008(spu_context* ctx)
{
    u128* const g = ctx->gpr;
    uint8_t* const ls = ctx->ls;
    const uint32_t n = g[16]._u32[0];
    ns_tw t;
    if (n < 2 || n > 0x4000 || !CTL_SPLAT0(g[20]) || !ns_tw_init(&t, g[13], g[21], g[18], g[17])) {
        NS_STAT(NS_EB_4008, bail_precond, 1); return;
    }
    const uint32_t p15 = g[15]._u32[0], p14 = g[14]._u32[0], p12 = g[12]._u32[0], p11 = g[11]._u32[0];
    const __m128 fill = ns_reg(g[19]);
    uint32_t k = 0;
    for (; k < n - 1; k++) {
        __m128d wn;
        if (__builtin_expect(!ns_tw_step(&t, &wn), 0)) break;
        const uint32_t i = 32u * k, o = 64u * k;
        const __m128 E0 = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, p15 + i)), E1 = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, p15 + i + 16));
        const __m128 G0 = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, p14 + i)), G1 = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, p14 + i + 16));
        const __m128 d0 = _mm_sub_ps(E0, G0), d1 = _mm_sub_ps(E1, G1), s0 = _mm_add_ps(E0, G0), s1 = _mm_add_ps(E1, G1);
        const __m128 c0 = _mm_mul_ps(d0, t.c), c1 = _mm_mul_ps(d1, t.c), z1 = _mm_mul_ps(d1, t.s), z0 = _mm_mul_ps(d0, t.s);
        __m128i acc = ns_mag(d0);
        NS_ACC(acc, d1); NS_ACC(acc, s0); NS_ACC(acc, s1); NS_ACC(acc, c0); NS_ACC(acc, c1); NS_ACC(acc, z0); NS_ACC(acc, z1);
        if (__builtin_expect(ns_bad(acc), 0)) break;
        ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p12 + o + 0x20), fill); ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p12 + o + 0x30), fill);
        ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p12 + o), ns_flush(s0)); ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p12 + o + 0x10), ns_flush(s1));
        ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p11 + o), ns_flush(c0)); ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p11 + o + 0x10), ns_flush(c1));
        ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p11 + o + 0x30), ns_flush(z1)); ns_stq(ns_line(ls, p11 + o + 0x20), ns_flush(z0));
        t.w = wn;
    }
    if (k) {
        g[11] = ns_splat_add(g[11], 64u * k); g[12] = ns_splat_add(g[12], 64u * k);
        g[14] = ns_splat_add(g[14], 32u * k); g[15] = ns_splat_add(g[15], 32u * k);
        g[13] = ns_du128(t.w);
        g[16] = ns_splat_add(g[16], 0u - k);
        NS_STAT(NS_EB_4008, fast_calls, 1); NS_STAT(NS_EB_4008, fast_iters, k);
        NS_FAULT(ns_line(ls, p11 + 64u * (k - 1) + 0x20) + 15);
    }
    if (k != n - 1) NS_STAT(NS_EB_4008, bail_range, 1);
}
static int ns_ranges_00004008(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) {
    return ns_streams_rng(ctx, r, ctx->gpr[16]._u32[0], 64, 12, 11, -1, -1);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 0x3D80: forward FFT, last stage (no twiddle): pairs of 2 lines, in place.
 *     LS[r9+0x20] = LS[r9] - LS[r9+0x20]   LS[r9+0x30] = LS[r9+0x10] - LS[r9+0x30]
 *     LS[r9]      = LS[r9] + LS[r9+0x20]   LS[r9+0x10] = LS[r9+0x10] + LS[r9+0x30]
 * r9 += 64; r10 += 2 while r81 > r10 (unsigned).  Carried: r9 r10.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static void ns_fast_00003D80(spu_context* ctx)
{
    u128* const g = ctx->gpr;
    uint8_t* const ls = ctx->ls;
    const uint32_t i0 = g[10]._u32[0], lim = g[81]._u32[0];
    /* passes: the loop adds 2 and goes on while lim > i (unsigned) */
    if (lim > 0x8000 || i0 >= lim) { NS_STAT(NS_EB_3D80, bail_precond, 1); return; }
    const uint32_t n = (lim - i0 + 1) / 2;
    if (n < 2) { NS_STAT(NS_EB_3D80, bail_precond, 1); return; }
    const uint32_t p = g[9]._u32[0];
    uint32_t k = 0;
    for (; k < n - 1; k++) {
        uint8_t* const q0 = ns_line(ls, p + 64u * k), * const q1 = ns_line(ls, p + 64u * k + 0x10);
        uint8_t* const q2 = ns_line(ls, p + 64u * k + 0x20), * const q3 = ns_line(ls, p + 64u * k + 0x30);
        const __m128 a = ns_ldq(q0), b = ns_ldq(q1), c = ns_ldq(q2), d = ns_ldq(q3);
        const __m128 d0 = _mm_sub_ps(a, c), d1 = _mm_sub_ps(b, d), s0 = _mm_add_ps(a, c), s1 = _mm_add_ps(b, d);
        __m128i acc = ns_mag(d0);
        NS_ACC(acc, d1); NS_ACC(acc, s0); NS_ACC(acc, s1);
        if (__builtin_expect(ns_bad(acc), 0)) break;
        ns_stq(q2, ns_flush(d0)); ns_stq(q3, ns_flush(d1)); ns_stq(q0, ns_flush(s0)); ns_stq(q1, ns_flush(s1));
    }
    if (k) {
        g[9] = ns_splat_add(g[9], 64u * k);
        g[10] = ns_splat_add(g[10], 2u * k);
        NS_STAT(NS_EB_3D80, fast_calls, 1); NS_STAT(NS_EB_3D80, fast_iters, k);
        NS_FAULT(ns_line(ls, p + 64u * (k - 1) + 0x10) + 15);
    }
    if (k != n - 1) NS_STAT(NS_EB_3D80, bail_range, 1);
}
static int ns_ranges_00003D80(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) {
    const uint32_t i0 = ctx->gpr[10]._u32[0], lim = ctx->gpr[81]._u32[0];
    if (lim > 0x8000 || i0 >= lim) return -1;
    return ns_streams_rng(ctx, r, (lim - i0 + 1) / 2, 64, 9, -1, -1, -1);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 0x43C0: inverse FFT, the final scale by 1/N: 4 lines a pass, in place, LS[r6 ..] *= r7 (fm),
 * r8 passes.  Carried: r6 r8.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static void ns_fast_000043C0(spu_context* ctx)
{
    u128* const g = ctx->gpr;
    uint8_t* const ls = ctx->ls;
    const uint32_t n = g[8]._u32[0];
    if (n < 2 || n > 0x4000) { NS_STAT(NS_EB_43C0, bail_precond, 1); return; }
    const uint32_t p = g[6]._u32[0];
    const __m128 sc = ns_reg(g[7]);
    uint32_t k = 0;
    for (; k < n - 1; k++) {
        uint8_t* const q0 = ns_line(ls, p + 64u * k), * const q1 = ns_line(ls, p + 64u * k + 0x10);
        uint8_t* const q2 = ns_line(ls, p + 64u * k + 0x20), * const q3 = ns_line(ls, p + 64u * k + 0x30);
        const __m128 t1 = _mm_mul_ps(ns_ldq(q1), sc), t0 = _mm_mul_ps(ns_ldq(q0), sc);
        const __m128 t3 = _mm_mul_ps(ns_ldq(q3), sc), t2 = _mm_mul_ps(ns_ldq(q2), sc);
        __m128i acc = ns_mag(t0);
        NS_ACC(acc, t1); NS_ACC(acc, t2); NS_ACC(acc, t3);
        if (__builtin_expect(ns_bad(acc), 0)) break;
        ns_stq(q1, ns_flush(t1)); ns_stq(q0, ns_flush(t0)); ns_stq(q3, ns_flush(t3)); ns_stq(q2, ns_flush(t2));
    }
    if (k) {
        g[6] = ns_splat_add(g[6], 64u * k);
        g[8] = ns_splat_add(g[8], 0u - k);
        NS_STAT(NS_EB_43C0, fast_calls, 1); NS_STAT(NS_EB_43C0, fast_iters, k);
        NS_FAULT(ns_line(ls, p + 64u * (k - 1) + 0x20) + 15);
    }
    if (k != n - 1) NS_STAT(NS_EB_43C0, bail_range, 1);
}
static int ns_ranges_000043C0(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) {
    return ns_streams_rng(ctx, r, ctx->gpr[8]._u32[0], 64, 6, -1, -1, -1);
}
```

`GT5/src/native/native_jFE031AF6.c`:

```c
/* Native x86 fast paths for the hot loops of GT5's reverb SPU job (socetverb, lifted image
 * jFE031AF6).  native_snd.h has the scheme, the float rules and the GT5_NATIVE_SND switch.
 *
 * Build: the game's flags for this job (the default sound-module flags, GT5 CMakeLists.txt) and
 * the hooked wiring (natives.txt):
 *   -O2 /w /GS- -mavx2 -mfma -ffp-contract=off -DSPU_X86_RZ_ALWAYS=1 -DSPU_USE_DISPATCH_MT -DNATIVE_HOOKED
 * Include directories: this job's folder, ps3recomp's runtime/spu, this file's folder.
 *
 * Each function has its fast block ns_fast_<ADDR> and ns_ranges_<ADDR>: the local-store lines the
 * LIFTED function can store to from the entry state, for GT5_NATIVE_SND=2 (native_snd.c); -1 for a
 * state the fast block does not take anyway (then the lifted function runs alone, uncompared).
 */
#include "spu_recomp.h"
#include "spu_helpers.h"
#include "native_snd.h"
#ifndef NATIVE_HOOKED
#  error "this file defines the lifted functions' own names: build it with -DNATIVE_HOOKED (natives.txt: hooked)"
#endif

/* shufb controls the loops take from the image (LS 0x9060..0x90A0) */
#define CTL_9060(r) ns_is(r, 0x04050607u, 0x08090A0Bu, 0x0C0D0E0Fu, 0x1C1D1E1Fu)   /* a1 a2 a3 b3 */
#define CTL_9070(r) ns_is(r, 0x0C0D0E0Fu, 0x10111213u, 0x14151617u, 0x18191A1Bu)   /* a3 b0 b1 b2 */
#define CTL_9080(r) ns_is(r, 0x08090A0Bu, 0x0C0D0E0Fu, 0x10111213u, 0x14151617u)   /* a2 a3 b0 b1 */
#define CTL_9090(r) ns_is(r, 0x00010203u, 0x10111213u, 0x14151617u, 0x18191A1Bu)   /* a0 b0 b1 b2 */
#define CTL_90A0(r) ns_is(r, 0x00010203u, 0x04050607u, 0x10111213u, 0x14151617u)   /* a0 a1 b0 b1 */

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 0x3720 / 0x3568: comb filter with a one-pole low-pass in the feedback path, a line (4 samples)
 * per pass, in place on the delay line.
 *
 *     a   = buf * g                                   (fm, 4 lanes)          g = feedback gain
 *     y_i = y_(i-1) * d + a_i     i = 0..3            (fma, one after the other; d = damping)
 *     S'  = [y_-1 y0 y1 y2] * d + a                   = [y0 y1 y2 y3] when d's lanes are equal
 *     buf = S' * w + in                               (fma, 4 lanes)         w = wet/output gain
 *     S   = S'                                        (y_-1 of the next pass = lane 3 of S')
 *
 * The lifted loop builds y0..y2 in lane 3 of three four-lane fmas, shifting the state vector with
 * a register-controlled shufb in between: fma + flush + shufb on the chain, four times a line.
 * Here the chain is four scalar fmas (y3 = lane 3 of S', same operation on the same values); the
 * four-lane work hangs off it.  Lanes 0..2 of the three intermediate fmas are junk lanes.
 * (The scalar fmas take the constant as their first operand: the upper lanes of an fmadd_ss result
 * come from that operand, and with the running value there the compiler put a blend on the chain.)
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
NS_INLINE void ns_comb(spu_context* ctx, int rS, int rBuf, int rIn, int rCnt, int rD, int rCtl, int rW, int rG, int stat)
{
    u128* const g = ctx->gpr;
    uint8_t* const ls = ctx->ls;
    const uint32_t n = g[rCnt]._u32[0];
    if (n < 2 || n > 0x4000 || !CTL_9060(g[rCtl])) { NS_STAT(stat, bail_precond, 1); return; }
    const uint32_t pb = g[rBuf]._u32[0], pi = g[rIn]._u32[0];
    const __m128 d = ns_reg(g[rD]), w = ns_reg(g[rW]), gain = ns_reg(g[rG]);
    const __m128 d3 = _mm_shuffle_ps(d, d, _MM_SHUFFLE(3, 3, 3, 3));
    __m128 S = ns_reg(g[rS]);
    __m128 ym = _mm_shuffle_ps(S, S, _MM_SHUFFLE(3, 3, 3, 3));          /* y_-1 in lane 0 */
    uint32_t k = 0;
    for (; k < n - 1; k++) {
        uint8_t* const bp = ns_line(ls, pb + 16u * k);
        const __m128 X = ns_ldq(bp), I = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, pi + 16u * k));
        const __m128 A = _mm_mul_ps(X, gain);
        const __m128 y0 = _mm_fmadd_ss(d3, ym, A);
        const __m128 y1 = _mm_fmadd_ss(d3, y0, _mm_shuffle_ps(A, A, _MM_SHUFFLE(1, 1, 1, 1)));
        const __m128 y2 = _mm_fmadd_ss(d3, y1, _mm_movehl_ps(A, A));
        const __m128 y3 = _mm_fmadd_ss(d3, y2, _mm_shuffle_ps(A, A, _MM_SHUFFLE(3, 3, 3, 3)));
        const __m128 V = _mm_movelh_ps(_mm_unpacklo_ps(ym, y0), _mm_unpacklo_ps(y1, y2));   /* y_-1 y0 y1 y2 */
        const __m128 Sn = _mm_fmadd_ps(V, d, A);
        const __m128 O = _mm_fmadd_ps(Sn, w, I);
        __m128i acc = ns_mag(A);
        NS_ACC(acc, V); NS_ACC(acc, Sn); NS_ACC(acc, O);
        if (__builtin_expect(ns_bad(acc), 0)) break;
        ns_stq(bp, ns_flush(O));
        S = Sn; ym = y3;
    }
    if (k) {
        g[rS] = ns_u128(ns_flush(S));
        g[rBuf] = ns_splat_add(g[rBuf], 16u * k);
        g[rIn] = ns_splat_add(g[rIn], 16u * k);
        g[rCnt] = ns_splat_add(g[rCnt], 0u - k);
        NS_STAT(stat, fast_calls, 1); NS_STAT(stat, fast_iters, k);
        NS_FAULT(ns_line(ls, pb + 16u * (k - 1)) + 15);
    }
    if (k != n - 1) NS_STAT(stat, bail_range, 1);
}
/* mode 2: a lifted loop that stores one line per pass at LS[dst], dst += 16, count passes */
NS_INLINE int ns_lines_rng(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r, int rDst, int rCnt) {
    const uint32_t n = ctx->gpr[rCnt]._u32[0];
    if (n < 2 || n > 0x4000) return -1;
    return ns_add_range(r, 0, ctx->gpr[rDst]._u32[0], 16u * n);
}
/* 0x3720: S=r7 buf=r8 in=r9 count=r10 d=r11 ctl=r12 w=r15 g=r16.  Carried: r7 r8 r9 r10. */
static void ns_fast_00003720(spu_context* ctx) { ns_comb(ctx, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 15, 16, NS_FE_3720); }
static int ns_ranges_00003720(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) { return ns_lines_rng(ctx, r, 8, 10); }
/* 0x3568: S=r12 buf=r7 in=r8 count=r9 d=r10 ctl=r11 w=r15 g=r16.  Carried: r7 r8 r9 r12. */
static void ns_fast_00003568(spu_context* ctx) { ns_comb(ctx, 12, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 15, 16, NS_FE_3568); }
static int ns_ranges_00003568(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) { return ns_lines_rng(ctx, r, 7, 9); }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 0x4680 / 0x4840: biquad (direct form I) with an output clamp, a line per pass.
 *
 *     F   = x*b0 + x[n-1]*b1 + x[n-2]*b2                (fm, fma, fma on four lanes; x[n-1], x[n-2]
 *                                                        = the line shifted by one / two samples,
 *                                                        filled from the previous line Q)
 *     y_i = y_(i-2)*a2_i + (y_(i-1)*a1_i + F_i)          i = 0..3 (two fmas a sample; a1, a2 hold
 *                                                        the negated feedback coefficients)
 *     out = min(max(y, lo), hi)                          (fcgt + selb twice); the state keeps y
 *
 * The lifted loop does the recursion as 8 four-lane fmas with 6 register-controlled shufbs
 * between them; lane i of the last pair is y_i, the other lanes of the first three pairs are
 * junk.  Here: the same two fmas per sample as scalars.  Carried: the index, Q (the previous
 * input line, r12) and Y (r13, the last four y; only lanes 2 and 3 are read back).
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
NS_INLINE void ns_biquad(spu_context* ctx, int rIdx, uint32_t in_base, uint32_t out_base, int rA1, int rCtlA, int rCtlB,
                         int rLo, int rHi, int stat)
{
    u128* const g = ctx->gpr;
    uint8_t* const ls = ctx->ls;
    const uint32_t i0 = g[rIdx]._u32[0], span = g[23]._u32[0] - i0;
    if ((span & 15) || span < 32 || span > 0x10000 || !CTL_9070(g[21]) || !CTL_9080(g[22]) || !CTL_9090(g[rCtlA]) ||
        !CTL_90A0(g[rCtlB])) { NS_STAT(stat, bail_precond, 1); return; }
    const uint32_t n = span / 16;
    const __m128 b0 = ns_reg(g[19]), b1 = ns_reg(g[20]), b2 = ns_reg(g[24]), a1 = ns_reg(g[rA1]), a2 = ns_reg(g[7]);
    const __m128 a1_1 = _mm_shuffle_ps(a1, a1, _MM_SHUFFLE(1, 1, 1, 1)), a1_2 = _mm_movehl_ps(a1, a1),
                 a1_3 = _mm_shuffle_ps(a1, a1, _MM_SHUFFLE(3, 3, 3, 3));
    const __m128 a2_1 = _mm_shuffle_ps(a2, a2, _MM_SHUFFLE(1, 1, 1, 1)), a2_2 = _mm_movehl_ps(a2, a2),
                 a2_3 = _mm_shuffle_ps(a2, a2, _MM_SHUFFLE(3, 3, 3, 3));
    const u128 lo = g[rLo], hi = g[rHi];
    __m128 Q = ns_reg(g[12]), Y = ns_reg(g[13]);
    __m128 p2 = _mm_movehl_ps(Y, Y), p3 = _mm_shuffle_ps(Y, Y, _MM_SHUFFLE(3, 3, 3, 3));     /* y_-2, y_-1 */
    uint32_t k = 0;
    for (; k < n - 1; k++) {
        const __m128 X = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, in_base + i0 + 16u * k));
        const __m128 X1 = _mm_castsi128_ps(_mm_alignr_epi8(_mm_castps_si128(X), _mm_castps_si128(Q), 12));  /* q3 x0 x1 x2 */
        const __m128 X2 = _mm_castsi128_ps(_mm_alignr_epi8(_mm_castps_si128(X), _mm_castps_si128(Q), 8));   /* q2 q3 x0 x1 */
        const __m128 t0 = _mm_mul_ps(X, b0);
        const __m128 t1 = _mm_fmadd_ps(X1, b1, t0);
        const __m128 F = _mm_fmadd_ps(X2, b2, t1);
        const __m128 u0 = _mm_fmadd_ss(a1, p3, F);
        const __m128 y0 = _mm_fmadd_ss(a2, p2, u0);
        const __m128 u1 = _mm_fmadd_ss(a1_1, y0, _mm_shuffle_ps(F, F, _MM_SHUFFLE(1, 1, 1, 1)));
        const __m128 y1 = _mm_fmadd_ss(a2_1, p3, u1);
        const __m128 u2 = _mm_fmadd_ss(a1_2, y1, _mm_movehl_ps(F, F));
        const __m128 y2 = _mm_fmadd_ss(a2_2, y0, u2);
        const __m128 u3 = _mm_fmadd_ss(a1_3, y2, _mm_shuffle_ps(F, F, _MM_SHUFFLE(3, 3, 3, 3)));
        const __m128 y3 = _mm_fmadd_ss(a2_3, y1, u3);
        const __m128 U = _mm_movelh_ps(_mm_unpacklo_ps(u0, u1), _mm_unpacklo_ps(u2, u3));
        const __m128 Yn = _mm_movelh_ps(_mm_unpacklo_ps(y0, y1), _mm_unpacklo_ps(y2, y3));
        __m128i acc = ns_mag(t0);
        NS_ACC(acc, t1); NS_ACC(acc, F); NS_ACC(acc, U); NS_ACC(acc, Yn);
        if (__builtin_expect(ns_bad(acc), 0)) break;
        /* the clamp, with the lifted code's own helpers */
        const u128 yv = ns_u128(ns_flush(Yn));
        const u128 c1 = spu_selb(lo, yv, spu_fcgt(yv, lo));
        const u128 c2 = spu_selb(hi, c1, spu_fcgt(hi, c1));
        ns_stq(ns_line(ls, out_base + i0 + 16u * k), ns_reg(c2));
        Q = X; Y = Yn; p2 = y2; p3 = y3;
    }
    if (k) {
        g[12] = ns_u128(Q);
        g[13] = ns_u128(ns_flush(Y));
        g[rIdx] = ns_splat_add(g[rIdx], 16u * k);
        NS_STAT(stat, fast_calls, 1); NS_STAT(stat, fast_iters, k);
        NS_FAULT(ns_line(ls, out_base + i0 + 16u * (k - 1)) + 15);
    }
    if (k != n - 1) NS_STAT(stat, bail_range, 1);
}
/* 0x4680: in = LS[r11 + r30], out = LS[r11 + r18], r11 up to r23; b0=r19 b1=r20 b2=r24 a1=r9 a2=r7;
 * controls r21 r22 r10 r15; bounds lo=r16 hi=r17.  Carried: r11 r12 r13. */
static void ns_fast_00004680(spu_context* ctx) {
    ns_biquad(ctx, 11, ctx->gpr[30]._u32[0], ctx->gpr[18]._u32[0], 9, 10, 15, 16, 17, NS_FE_4680);
}
/* 0x4840: in place, LS[r14 + r15], r14 up to r23; a1=r10 a2=r7; controls r21 r22 r11 r17; bounds
 * lo=r9 hi=r18.  Carried: r12 r13 r14. */
static void ns_fast_00004840(spu_context* ctx) {
    ns_biquad(ctx, 14, ctx->gpr[15]._u32[0], ctx->gpr[15]._u32[0], 10, 11, 17, 9, 18, NS_FE_4840);
}
/* mode 2: what the lifted biquads store: the output lines, and after the loop four words of the
 * filter's record (the last two inputs and outputs, each inserted into its line: LS[rec + 20],
 * + 24, + 28, + 32), rec = r14 for 0x4680 and r16 for 0x4840. */
NS_INLINE int ns_biquad_rng(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r, int rIdx, uint32_t out_base, int rRec) {
    const uint32_t i0 = ctx->gpr[rIdx]._u32[0], span = ctx->gpr[23]._u32[0] - i0;
    if ((span & 15) || span < 32 || span > 0x10000) return -1;
    const int n = ns_add_range(r, 0, out_base + i0, span);
    return ns_add_range(r, n, ctx->gpr[rRec]._u32[0] + 20u, 28u);
}
static int ns_ranges_00004680(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) { return ns_biquad_rng(ctx, r, 11, ctx->gpr[18]._u32[0], 14); }
static int ns_ranges_00004840(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) { return ns_biquad_rng(ctx, r, 14, ctx->gpr[15]._u32[0], 16); }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Plain line loops: no float is carried from pass to pass.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* 0x37D8: LS[r8 + r19] += LS[r29 + r8 + r10]  (fa), r8 += 16 up to r9.  Carried: r8.
 * (adds one comb's output buffer into the sum of the combs) */
static void ns_fast_000037D8(spu_context* ctx)
{
    u128* const g = ctx->gpr;
    uint8_t* const ls = ctx->ls;
    const uint32_t i0 = g[8]._u32[0], span = g[9]._u32[0] - i0;
    if ((span & 15) || span < 32 || span > 0x10000) { NS_STAT(NS_FE_37D8, bail_precond, 1); return; }
    const uint32_t n = span / 16, d0 = i0 + g[19]._u32[0], s0 = g[29]._u32[0] + i0 + g[10]._u32[0];
    uint32_t k = 0;
    for (; k < n - 1; k++) {
        uint8_t* const dp = ns_line(ls, d0 + 16u * k);
        const __m128 t = _mm_add_ps(ns_ldq(dp), ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, s0 + 16u * k)));
        if (__builtin_expect(ns_bad(ns_mag(t)), 0)) break;
        ns_stq(dp, ns_flush(t));
    }
    if (k) {
        g[8] = ns_splat_add(g[8], 16u * k);
        NS_STAT(NS_FE_37D8, fast_calls, 1); NS_STAT(NS_FE_37D8, fast_iters, k);
        NS_FAULT(ns_line(ls, d0 + 16u * (k - 1)) + 15);
    }
    if (k != n - 1) NS_STAT(NS_FE_37D8, bail_range, 1);
}
static int ns_ranges_000037D8(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) {
    const uint32_t i0 = ctx->gpr[8]._u32[0], span = ctx->gpr[9]._u32[0] - i0;
    if ((span & 15) || span < 32 || span > 0x10000) return -1;
    return ns_add_range(r, 0, i0 + ctx->gpr[19]._u32[0], span);
}

/* 0x38C8: LS[r7] = LS[r6] - LS[r5]  (fs), all three += 16, r8 passes.  Carried: r5 r6 r7 r8.
 * (all-pass: delayed sample minus the feed-forward buffer) */
static void ns_fast_000038C8(spu_context* ctx)
{
    u128* const g = ctx->gpr;
    uint8_t* const ls = ctx->ls;
    const uint32_t n = g[8]._u32[0];
    if (n < 2 || n > 0x4000) { NS_STAT(NS_FE_38C8, bail_precond, 1); return; }
    const uint32_t a0 = g[6]._u32[0], b0 = g[5]._u32[0], d0 = g[7]._u32[0];
    uint32_t k = 0;
    for (; k < n - 1; k++) {
        const __m128 t = _mm_sub_ps(ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, a0 + 16u * k)), ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, b0 + 16u * k)));
        if (__builtin_expect(ns_bad(ns_mag(t)), 0)) break;
        ns_stq(ns_line(ls, d0 + 16u * k), ns_flush(t));
    }
    if (k) {
        g[5] = ns_splat_add(g[5], 16u * k); g[6] = ns_splat_add(g[6], 16u * k); g[7] = ns_splat_add(g[7], 16u * k);
        g[8] = ns_splat_add(g[8], 0u - k);
        NS_STAT(NS_FE_38C8, fast_calls, 1); NS_STAT(NS_FE_38C8, fast_iters, k);
        NS_FAULT(ns_line(ls, d0 + 16u * (k - 1)) + 15);
    }
    if (k != n - 1) NS_STAT(NS_FE_38C8, bail_range, 1);
}
static int ns_ranges_000038C8(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) { return ns_lines_rng(ctx, r, 7, 8); }

/* 0x3900: LS[r5] = LS[r5] * r12 + LS[r9]  (fma), both += 16, r10 passes.  Carried: r5 r9 r10.
 * (all-pass: the delay line takes delayed * gain + input) */
static void ns_fast_00003900(spu_context* ctx)
{
    u128* const g = ctx->gpr;
    uint8_t* const ls = ctx->ls;
    const uint32_t n = g[10]._u32[0];
    if (n < 2 || n > 0x4000) { NS_STAT(NS_FE_3900, bail_precond, 1); return; }
    const uint32_t c0 = g[9]._u32[0], d0 = g[5]._u32[0];
    const __m128 gain = ns_reg(g[12]);
    uint32_t k = 0;
    for (; k < n - 1; k++) {
        uint8_t* const dp = ns_line(ls, d0 + 16u * k);
        const __m128 c = ns_ldq(ns_line(ls, c0 + 16u * k));
        const __m128 t = _mm_fmadd_ps(ns_ldq(dp), gain, c);
        if (__builtin_expect(ns_bad(ns_mag(t)), 0)) break;
        ns_stq(dp, ns_flush(t));
    }
    if (k) {
        g[5] = ns_splat_add(g[5], 16u * k); g[9] = ns_splat_add(g[9], 16u * k);
        g[10] = ns_splat_add(g[10], 0u - k);
        NS_STAT(NS_FE_3900, fast_calls, 1); NS_STAT(NS_FE_3900, fast_iters, k);
        NS_FAULT(ns_line(ls, d0 + 16u * (k - 1)) + 15);
    }
    if (k != n - 1) NS_STAT(NS_FE_3900, bail_range, 1);
}
static int ns_ranges_00003900(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) { return ns_lines_rng(ctx, r, 5, 10); }

/* 0x36F0 / 0x3538: copy r6 lines from LS[r3] to LS[r4] (a comb's delay-line chunk into the work
 * buffer, before the comb loop rewrites the delay line).  Carried: r3 r4 r6.  No arithmetic: a
 * line is loaded whole and stored whole, one after the other, so any overlap behaves the same. */
NS_INLINE void ns_copy(spu_context* ctx, int stat)
{
    u128* const g = ctx->gpr;
    uint8_t* const ls = ctx->ls;
    const uint32_t n = g[6]._u32[0];
    if (n < 2 || n > 0x4000) { NS_STAT(stat, bail_precond, 1); return; }
    const uint32_t s0 = g[3]._u32[0], d0 = g[4]._u32[0], k = n - 1;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < k; i++)
        _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i*)ns_line(ls, d0 + 16u * i), _mm_loadu_si128((const __m128i*)ns_line(ls, s0 + 16u * i)));
    g[3] = ns_splat_add(g[3], 16u * k); g[4] = ns_splat_add(g[4], 16u * k);
    g[6] = ns_splat_add(g[6], 0u - k);
    NS_STAT(stat, fast_calls, 1); NS_STAT(stat, fast_iters, k);
    NS_FAULT(ns_line(ls, d0 + 16u * (k - 1)) + 15);
}
static void ns_fast_000036F0(spu_context* ctx) { ns_copy(ctx, NS_FE_36F0); }
static void ns_fast_00003538(spu_context* ctx) { ns_copy(ctx, NS_FE_3538); }
static int ns_ranges_000036F0(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) { return ns_lines_rng(ctx, r, 4, 6); }
static int ns_ranges_00003538(const spu_context* ctx, ns_range* r) { return ns_lines_rng(ctx, r, 4, 6); }

NS_ENTRY(jFE031AF6, 00003720, NS_FE_3720)
NS_ENTRY(jFE031AF6, 00003568, NS_FE_3568)
NS_ENTRY(jFE031AF6, 00004680, NS_FE_4680)
```
