`GT5/src/native/native_wgen.h`:

```h
/* native_wgen.h -- the run-time half of a generated native WWS job (scripts: src/native/wgen_gen.py, which writes
 * wgen_<image>_gen.inc at build time from this copy's own game files). Included by src/native/wgen_<image>.c,
 * which defines WG_IMG / WG_IMG_NAME / WG_ENV and then WG_HOOK(...) for the job's entry.
 *
 * Switch, per image, read once: GT5_WGEN_<IMAGE> (else GT5_WGEN, else 1)
 *   0  the lifted job (as before)
 *   1  the generated native job (default)
 *   2  native, and every 64th call (GT5_WGEN_CMP_EVERY) of a procedure that never touches the runtime is run
 *      again by the runtime's SPU interpreter from a copy of the state before it: registers and local store
 *      must be the same (counted; the first mismatches are logged with the procedure and the address)
 * Log: "[wgen] <image> runs as native code (...)" once; then every 30 s while it runs:
 *   "[wgen] <image>: jobs run as native code N, of them handed back N (interrupt N, jump N, instruction N), lifted
 *    stretches inside native jobs N (...), runtime calls N[, compared N, MISMATCH N]"
 * Handed back: the native code could not finish the job; the lifted code ran the rest of it. A lifted stretch: the
 * lifted code ran part of a procedure (from an address the native code has no label for) and the job went on natively.
 * GT5_WGEN_STAT=1 prints the line every 5 s and the first addresses handed back. */
#ifndef NATIVE_WGEN_H
#define NATIVE_WGEN_H
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include "spu_recomp.h"          /* the image's own lifted header (its folder is on the include path) */
#include "spu_helpers.h"

#ifndef SPU_THREAD_LOCAL
#  define SPU_THREAD_LOCAL _Thread_local
#endif

enum { WG_HB_IRQ = 0, WG_HB_JUMP = 1, WG_HB_INSN = 2, WG_HB_N = 3 };
static int wg_mode = -1;             /* -1 unread */
static int wg_cmp = 0;               /* mode 2 */
static int wg_stat = 0;
static unsigned wg_cmp_every = 64;    /* GT5_WGEN_CMP_EVERY: compare every n-th call of a procedure */
static long long wg_jobs, wg_hb[WG_HB_N], wg_rtcalls, wg_cmp_n, wg_cmp_bad, wg_cmp_skip;
static long long wg_printed_jobs = -1;
static uint32_t wg_hb_pc[8];
static unsigned wg_hb_pcn;
static SPU_THREAD_LOCAL int t_wg_why;
static SPU_THREAD_LOCAL uint32_t t_wg_pc;
static SPU_THREAD_LOCAL long long t_wg_rt;

#define WG_HB(ctx, why, pc) do { t_wg_why = (why); t_wg_pc = (pc); } while (0)
/* a hand-back inside the job: the lifted code runs from pc until the procedure's return, then native again */
static long long wg_hb_in[WG_HB_N];
#define WG_HB_IN(ctx, why, pc) do { __atomic_add_fetch(&wg_hb_in[(why)], 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); WG_HB_TRACE(pc); \
        if (wg_hb_pcn < 8) wg_hb_pc[__atomic_fetch_add(&wg_hb_pcn, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) & 7] = (pc) | 0x80000000u; } while (0)
#ifdef WGEN_HARNESS
static int wg_trace = -1;
#define WG_HB_TRACE(pc) ((wg_trace < 0 ? (wg_trace = getenv("WGEN_TRACE") != NULL) : wg_trace) ? fprintf(stderr, "[wgen-hb] 0x%05X\n", (unsigned)(pc)) : 0)
#define WG_RT(ctx) (t_wg_rt++, (wg_trace < 0 ? (wg_trace = getenv("WGEN_TRACE") != NULL) : wg_trace) ? fprintf(stderr, "[wgen-rt] call 0x%05X lr 0x%05X\n", ctx->pc & SPU_LS_MASK, ctx->gpr[0]._u32[0] & SPU_LS_MASK) : 0)
#else
#define WG_RT(ctx) (t_wg_rt++)
#define WG_HB_TRACE(pc) ((void)0)
#endif

static void wg_read_mode(void)
{
    const char* e = getenv(WG_ENV);
    if (!e || !*e) e = getenv("GT5_WGEN");
    int m = (e && *e) ? atoi(e) : 1;
    if (m < 0 || m > 2) m = 1;
    const char* s = getenv("GT5_WGEN_STAT");
    wg_stat = s && *s && *s != '0';
    { const char* c = getenv("GT5_WGEN_CMP_EVERY"); if (c && atoi(c) > 0) wg_cmp_every = (unsigned)atoi(c); }
    wg_cmp = m == 2;
    __atomic_store_n(&wg_mode, m, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

static double wg_now(void) { struct timespec t; timespec_get(&t, TIME_UTC); return (double)t.tv_sec + t.tv_nsec / 1e9; }

static void wg_print(FILE* f)
{
    fprintf(f, "[wgen] %s: jobs run as native code %lld, of them handed back %lld (interrupt %lld, jump %lld, instruction %lld), "
            "lifted stretches inside native jobs %lld (interrupt %lld, jump %lld, instruction %lld), runtime calls %lld",
            WG_IMG_NAME, wg_jobs, wg_hb[0] + wg_hb[1] + wg_hb[2], wg_hb[0], wg_hb[1], wg_hb[2],
            wg_hb_in[0] + wg_hb_in[1] + wg_hb_in[2], wg_hb_in[0], wg_hb_in[1], wg_hb_in[2], wg_rtcalls);
    if (wg_cmp || wg_cmp_n) fprintf(f, ", compared %lld, MISMATCH %lld (not comparable %lld)", wg_cmp_n, wg_cmp_bad, wg_cmp_skip);
    if (wg_stat && wg_hb_pcn) {
        fprintf(f, " | first hand-backs at");
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < wg_hb_pcn && k < 8; k++) fprintf(f, " 0x%05X", wg_hb_pc[k]);
    }
    fprintf(f, "\n");
    fflush(f);
}

static void wg_tick(void)
{
    static double next;
    static volatile int lock;
    const double now = wg_now();
    if (now < next || __atomic_exchange_n(&lock, 1, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) return;
    if (next == 0) next = now;
    if (now >= next) {
        next = now + (wg_stat ? 5.0 : 30.0);
        if (wg_jobs != wg_printed_jobs) { wg_printed_jobs = wg_jobs; wg_print(stderr); }
    }
    __atomic_store_n(&lock, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

/* mode 2: a call of a procedure that never touches the runtime (no channel, no DMA, no call into the job
 * manager or lifted code) runs natively on the real state, then the runtime's SPU interpreter runs the same
 * call from a copy of the state as it was before; registers, local store and where it went are compared.
 * The copy runs as no image at all (image id -1, no resident code, no policy services): the interpreter then
 * never looks up or enters lifted code, so nothing on the copy reaches the real run's dispatcher, drain or
 * driver (in the game the dispatch caches answered for the job's own code: v1 stopped at the first lifted
 * entry, every call "not comparable"). A `stop` planted at the return address in the COPY's local store ends
 * the interpreted run there (and is taken out again before the compare). Only calls the native code returned
 * from normally are compared: the interpreter then follows the same path, inside the procedure. */
uint32_t spu_interp_run_until(spu_context* ctx, uint32_t start_lsa, uint32_t stop_lsa);   /* spu_interp.c */
static SPU_THREAD_LOCAL spu_context* t_wg_scratch;
static SPU_THREAD_LOCAL unsigned t_wg_tick;
static SPU_THREAD_LOCAL int t_wg_incmp;
typedef SPU_SV uint32_t wg_fn_t(spu_context*, uint32_t);
#define WG_CMP_STOP 0x00003FFEu          /* stop 0x3FFE */
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint32_t wg_compare(spu_context* ctx, wg_fn_t* fn, uint32_t entry, uint32_t ret)
{
    if (t_wg_incmp || ++t_wg_tick < wg_cmp_every) return fn(ctx, ret);
    t_wg_tick = 0;
    spu_context* s = t_wg_scratch;
    if (!s) { s = (spu_context*)malloc(sizeof *s); if (!s) return fn(ctx, ret); t_wg_scratch = s; }
    memcpy(s, ctx, sizeof *s);
    s->ls = s->ls_store;
    if (ctx->ls != ctx->ls_store) memcpy(s->ls_store, ctx->ls, SPU_LS_SIZE);
    t_wg_incmp = 1;                         /* the procedures it calls are not compared on their own meanwhile */
    const uint32_t r = fn(ctx, ret);
    t_wg_incmp = 0;
    if (((r ^ ret) & SPU_LS_MASK) || (ret & 3u) || ret + 4u > SPU_LS_SIZE) {
        __atomic_add_fetch(&wg_cmp_skip, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        return r;
    }
    s->int_enable = 0; s->irq_frame = 0; s->irq_saved = 0;
    memset(s->resident_code, 0, sizeof s->resident_code); s->resident_ovl = 0; s->resident_task = 0;
    s->image_id = -1; s->policy_mode = 0; s->status = SPU_STATUS_RUNNING; s->stop_code = 0;
    uint8_t keep[4];
    memcpy(keep, s->ls + ret, 4);
    s->ls[ret] = (uint8_t)(WG_CMP_STOP >> 24); s->ls[ret + 1] = (uint8_t)(WG_CMP_STOP >> 16);
    s->ls[ret + 2] = (uint8_t)(WG_CMP_STOP >> 8); s->ls[ret + 3] = (uint8_t)WG_CMP_STOP;
    spu_interp_run_until(s, entry & SPU_LS_MASK, 0);
    memcpy(s->ls + ret, keep, 4);
    const int reached = (s->status & SPU_STATUS_STOPPED_BY_STOP) && s->stop_code == (WG_CMP_STOP & 0x3FFFu) &&
                        (s->pc & SPU_LS_MASK) == ((ret + 4u) & SPU_LS_MASK);
    if (!reached) {                         /* the interpreted run ended elsewhere: a stop of its own, a halt */
        __atomic_add_fetch(&wg_cmp_skip, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        return r;
    }
    __atomic_add_fetch(&wg_cmp_n, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    int reg = -1;
    for (int g = 0; g < 128 && reg < 0; g++) if (memcmp(&s->gpr[g], &ctx->gpr[g], 16)) reg = g;
    long ls = -1;
    if (memcmp(s->ls, ctx->ls, SPU_LS_SIZE))
        for (long x = 0; x < SPU_LS_SIZE && ls < 0; x++) if (s->ls[x] != ctx->ls[x]) ls = x;
    if (reg >= 0 || ls >= 0) {
        const long long n = __atomic_add_fetch(&wg_cmp_bad, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        if (n <= 8) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[wgen] MISMATCH %s 0x%05X (return 0x%05X): first register r%d, first local-store byte 0x%05lX%s\n",
                    WG_IMG_NAME, entry, ret, reg, ls, reg >= 0 ? "" : "");
            if (reg >= 0)
                fprintf(stderr, "[wgen]   r%d native %08X %08X %08X %08X, interpreter %08X %08X %08X %08X\n", reg,
                        ctx->gpr[reg]._u32[0], ctx->gpr[reg]._u32[1], ctx->gpr[reg]._u32[2], ctx->gpr[reg]._u32[3],
                        s->gpr[reg]._u32[0], s->gpr[reg]._u32[1], s->gpr[reg]._u32[2], s->gpr[reg]._u32[3]);
            fflush(stderr);
        }
    }
    return r;
}
/* --debug builds of the generated file: WGEN_LIFT=<lo>-<hi>[,...] runs the procedures with entries in those
 * ranges as lifted code (to find a procedure that differs, by halving). */
static uint32_t wg_force[64][2]; static int wg_nforce = -1;
static int wg_forced(uint32_t pc)
{
    if (wg_nforce < 0) {
        wg_nforce = 0;
        const char* e = getenv("WGEN_LIFT");
        while (e && *e && wg_nforce < 64) {
            char* q; const unsigned long lo = strtoul(e, &q, 16), hi = *q == '-' ? strtoul(q + 1, &q, 16) : lo;
            wg_force[wg_nforce][0] = (uint32_t)lo; wg_force[wg_nforce][1] = (uint32_t)hi; wg_nforce++;
            e = *q == ',' ? q + 1 : NULL;
        }
    }
    for (int k = 0; k < wg_nforce; k++) if (pc >= wg_force[k][0] && pc <= wg_force[k][1]) return 1;
    return 0;
}
static uint32_t wg_lifted_call(spu_context* ctx, uint32_t ret)
{
    int32_t si = (int32_t)ctx->image_id;
    ctx->host_depth++; spu_indirect_branch(ctx); spu_drain_call(ctx, ret); ctx->host_depth--; spu_img_restore(ctx, si);
    return ret;
}
#define WG_CALL(fn, entry, ctx, ret) (__builtin_expect(wg_cmp, 0) ? wg_compare((ctx), (fn), (entry), (ret)) : fn((ctx), (ret)))

/* The job's entry: WG_HOOK(w01695680, 00004030) defines gt5_w01695680_spu_func_00004030_sv (natives.txt
 * `hooked`): the native job, or the lifted one (..._orig_sv). WG_HOOK_LIFTED: the lifted one only (no generated
 * code in this copy). wgen_<image>.c picks one AFTER it has included the generated file (WGEN_PROCS defined there):
 * a choice made here, when this header is read, could not see what that file says.
 * The generated file also says how the job ends (WGEN_CHAIN, WGEN_END_PC): a WWS job returns to the address the
 * manager's call left in r0; a job-chain job (src/native/wgen_gen.py JIMAGES, entered at LS 0 by the runtime's
 * driver with 0x3FF00 in r0) returns there or branches to LS 0 (WGEN_END_PC), and the runtime's drain ends the run
 * at either, as for the lifted job. The lifted job-chain job's first transfer is the run's step 0 (spu_drain.c: a
 * branch to LS 0 ends a job only after it): the native job has taken it (WG_ENTER). */
#define WG_CAT4(a, b, c, d) a##b##c##d
#define WG_HOOK_LIFTED(img, addr) \
    SPU_SV void WG_CAT4(gt5_, img, _spu_func_, addr##_orig_sv)(spu_context* ctx); \
    SPU_SV void WG_CAT4(gt5_, img, _spu_func_, addr##_sv)(spu_context* ctx) { \
        if (__builtin_expect(wg_mode < 0, 0)) { wg_read_mode(); \
            fprintf(stderr, "[wgen] %s stays lifted code (%s)\n", WG_IMG_NAME, WGEN_NOT_BUILT); fflush(stderr); } \
        WG_CAT4(gt5_, img, _spu_func_, addr##_orig_sv)(ctx); }
#define WG_IS_END(R, E) ((R) == (E) || (R) == WGEN_END_PC)
#define WG_ENTER(ctx) do { if (WGEN_CHAIN && !(ctx)->steps) (ctx)->steps = 1; } while (0)
/* (a WWS job) back to the manager, running: a stop-and-signal in a manager call left STOPPED_BY_STOP behind (the
 * lifted job's interpreted stretches set RUNNING again; a lingering STOPPED would end the manager's run at its next
 * unwind) */
#define WG_BACK_RUNNING(ctx) do { if (!WGEN_CHAIN && (ctx)->status == SPU_STATUS_STOPPED_BY_STOP) (ctx)->status = SPU_STATUS_RUNNING; } while (0)
#define WG_HOOK(img, addr) \
    SPU_SV void WG_CAT4(gt5_, img, _spu_func_, addr##_orig_sv)(spu_context* ctx); \
    SPU_SV void WG_CAT4(gt5_, img, _spu_func_, addr##_sv)(spu_context* ctx) { \
        if (__builtin_expect(wg_mode < 0, 0)) { wg_read_mode(); \
            fprintf(stderr, "[wgen] %s runs as %s (generated: %d procedures)\n", WG_IMG_NAME, \
                    wg_mode == 0 ? "lifted code (GT5_WGEN 0)" : wg_mode == 2 ? "native code, compared with the lifted code" \
                    : "native code", WGEN_PROCS); fflush(stderr); } \
        if (wg_mode == 0) { WG_CAT4(gt5_, img, _spu_func_, addr##_orig_sv)(ctx); return; } \
        const uint32_t E = ctx->gpr[0]._u32[0] & SPU_LS_MASK & ~3u; \
        t_wg_rt = 0; \
        WG_ENTER(ctx); \
        const long long nj = __atomic_add_fetch(&wg_jobs, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); \
        uint32_t R = WGEN_ENTRY_FN(ctx, E); \
        for (int _k = 0; !WG_IS_END(R, E) && wg_is_entry(R) && _k < 64; _k++) R = wg_call(ctx, R, E);   /* went on in another procedure */ \
        __atomic_add_fetch(&wg_rtcalls, t_wg_rt, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); \
        ctx->pc = R; \
        if (__builtin_expect(WG_IS_END(R, E), 1)) { \
            WG_BACK_RUNNING(ctx); \
            if (ctx->host_depth == 0) g_spu_trampoline_fn = spu_indirect_branch; \
        } else { \
            const long long n = __atomic_add_fetch(&wg_hb[t_wg_why < WG_HB_N ? t_wg_why : WG_HB_INSN], 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); \
            if (wg_hb_pcn < 8) wg_hb_pc[__atomic_fetch_add(&wg_hb_pcn, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) & 7] = t_wg_pc; \
            (void)n; g_spu_trampoline_fn = spu_indirect_branch; \
        } \
        if ((nj & 1023) == 0 || wg_stat) wg_tick(); \
    }

/* The stand-alone harness (WGEN_HARNESS): set the mode, print the counters. */
#ifdef WGEN_HARNESS
int wgen_harness_mode(int m) { wg_read_mode(); wg_mode = m; wg_cmp = m == 2; return m; }
void wgen_harness_report(FILE* f) { wg_print(f); }
#endif
#endif
```

`GT5/src/native/natives.txt`:

```txt
# Native replacements of lifted SPU functions: <image> <address> <native symbol or -> <source> [pure] [hooked]
# hooked = the source itself defines the function's name (built with NATIVE_HOOKED) and calls ..._orig_sv
# The sound mixer (socisynth, jD58063CD): biquads, resampler, mix, ADPCM block loop. GT5_NATIVE_MIXER=0/1/2.
jD58063CD 00004720 - native_mixer.c hooked
jD58063CD 00004C80 - native_mixer.c hooked
jD58063CD 000044CC - native_mixer.c hooked
jD58063CD 00004E58 - native_mixer.c hooked
jD58063CD 00001908 - native_mixer.c hooked
# The reverb (socetverb, jFE031AF6) and the EQ's FFT (socepdideq, jEB79FDFC). GT5_NATIVE_SND=0/1/2.
jFE031AF6 00003720 - native_jFE031AF6.c hooked
jFE031AF6 00003568 - native_jFE031AF6.c hooked
jFE031AF6 000036F0 - native_jFE031AF6.c hooked
```

`GT5/src/native/ppu_native.cpp`:

```cpp
/* Native PPU functions: switch, counters and compare mode (see ppu_native.h). */
#include "ppu_native.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <mutex>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

extern "C" int g_gt5_ppu_native = 1;
PPU_THREAD_LOCAL gt5_ppu_nat_tls* g_gt5_ppu_nat_t;

namespace {
struct nat_fn { char addr[12]; int no_compare_form; };
nat_fn s_fn[GT5_PPU_NAT_MAX];
int s_nfn;                                       /* written at start-up only */
std::mutex s_mu;
gt5_ppu_nat_tls* s_tls[256];
std::atomic<int> s_ntls{0};
std::atomic<int64_t> s_last_print{0};
std::atomic<int> s_differ_logged{0};

int64_t now_ms()
{
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}
}

int gt5_ppu_native_register(const char* addr, int no_compare_form)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(s_mu);
    if (s_nfn == 0) {
        const char* e = getenv("GT5_PPU_NATIVE");
        g_gt5_ppu_native = (e && e[0] == '0') ? 0 : (e && e[0] == '2') ? 2 : 1;
    }
    if (s_nfn >= GT5_PPU_NAT_MAX) return GT5_PPU_NAT_MAX - 1;   /* shares the last counter */
    snprintf(s_fn[s_nfn].addr, sizeof s_fn[s_nfn].addr, "%s", addr);
    s_fn[s_nfn].no_compare_form = no_compare_form;
    return s_nfn++;
}

gt5_ppu_nat_tls* gt5_ppu_nat_tls_new(void)
{
    gt5_ppu_nat_tls* t = (gt5_ppu_nat_tls*)calloc(1, sizeof(gt5_ppu_nat_tls));
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(s_mu);
    const int i = s_ntls.load();
    if (i < 256) { s_tls[i] = t; s_ntls.store(i + 1); }          /* past 256 threads: not in the log line */
    g_gt5_ppu_nat_t = t;
    return t;
}

void gt5_ppu_nat_tick(void)
{
    const int64_t t = now_ms(), last = s_last_print.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (last != 0 && t - last < 10000) return;
    int64_t expect = last;
    if (!s_last_print.compare_exchange_strong(expect, t)) return;
    if (last == 0) return;                                          /* the first 10 s start now */
    uint64_t sum[6][GT5_PPU_NAT_MAX] = {};
    const int nt = s_ntls.load(), nf = s_nfn;
    for (int i = 0; i < nt; i++) {
        const gt5_ppu_nat_tls* c = s_tls[i];
        for (int k = 0; k < nf; k++) {
            sum[0][k] += c->native[k]; sum[1][k] += c->lifted[k]; sum[2][k] += c->compared[k];
            sum[3][k] += c->differed[k]; sum[4][k] += c->skipped[k]; sum[5][k] += c->nanquiet[k];
        }
    }
    uint64_t tot[6] = {};
    for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) for (int k = 0; k < nf; k++) tot[j] += sum[j][k];
    char top[1024]; int n = 0; top[0] = 0;
    for (int shown = 0; shown < 10; shown++) {                     /* the ten most called */
        int best = -1;
        for (int k = 0; k < nf; k++) {
            const uint64_t v = sum[0][k] + sum[1][k] + sum[2][k] + sum[4][k];
            if (v && (best < 0 || v > sum[0][best] + sum[1][best] + sum[2][best] + sum[4][best])) best = k;
        }
        if (best < 0) break;
        n += snprintf(top + n, sizeof top - n, " %s %llu", s_fn[best].addr,
                      (unsigned long long)(sum[0][best] + sum[1][best] + sum[2][best] + sum[4][best]));
        sum[0][best] = sum[1][best] = sum[2][best] = sum[4][best] = 0;
        if (n >= (int)sizeof top - 40) break;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[ppu-native] mode %d, %d functions: native %llu calls, lifted %llu, compared %llu, differed %llu,"
                    " not compared %llu, same but a signaling NaN quieted %llu |%s\n", g_gt5_ppu_native, nf, (unsigned long long)tot[0],
            (unsigned long long)tot[1], (unsigned long long)tot[2], (unsigned long long)tot[3], (unsigned long long)tot[4],
            (unsigned long long)tot[5], top);
    fflush(stderr);
}

void gt5_ppu_nat_lifted(int k)
{
    gt5_ppu_nat_tls* t = g_gt5_ppu_nat_t;
    if (!t) t = gt5_ppu_nat_tls_new();
    t->lifted[k]++;
    if ((++t->calls & 0xFFFFu) == 0) gt5_ppu_nat_tick();
}

/* ---- compare mode ---- */
struct gt5_ppu_shadow {
    enum { HBITS = 18, HSIZE = 1 << HBITS, MAXB = 1 << 16 };
    uint32_t gen;
    int special, overflow, nlist;
    uint32_t list[MAXB];              /* each byte address stored to, once */
    uint32_t hkey[HSIZE], hgen[HSIZE];
    uint8_t hval[HSIZE];
    alignas(16) uint8_t p16[16];
};
static PPU_THREAD_LOCAL gt5_ppu_shadow* t_shadow;

static inline uint32_t sh_slot(const gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint32_t a, int* found)
{
    uint32_t h = (a * 0x9E3779B1u) >> (32 - gt5_ppu_shadow::HBITS);
    for (;;) {
        if (s->hgen[h] != s->gen) { *found = 0; return h; }
        if (s->hkey[h] == a) { *found = 1; return h; }
        h = (h + 1) & (gt5_ppu_shadow::HSIZE - 1);
    }
}

void gt5_sh_read(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint32_t ea, void* dst, uint32_t n, int raw)
{
    if (!raw) {
        const ppu_mm m = ppu_mm_take();
        if (!vm_mm_in(m.ld_span, ea, n) || (n == 4 && ea == m.poll)) { s->special = 1; memset(dst, 0, n); return; }
    }
    uint8_t* d = (uint8_t*)dst;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int f; const uint32_t a = ea + i, h = sh_slot(s, a, &f);
        d[i] = f ? s->hval[h] : vm_base[a];
    }
}

void gt5_sh_write(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint32_t ea, const void* src, uint32_t n, int raw)
{
    if (!raw) {
        const ppu_mm m = ppu_mm_take();
        if (!vm_mm_in(m.st_span, ea, n)) { s->special = 1; return; }
    }
    const uint8_t* p = (const uint8_t*)src;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int f; const uint32_t a = ea + i, h = sh_slot(s, a, &f);
        if (!f) {
            if (s->nlist >= gt5_ppu_shadow::MAXB) { s->overflow = 1; return; }
            s->hgen[h] = s->gen; s->hkey[h] = a; s->list[s->nlist++] = a;
        }
        s->hval[h] = p[i];
    }
}

const uint8_t* gt5_sh_p16(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint32_t ea)
{
    gt5_sh_read(s, ea, s->p16, 16, 1);
    return s->p16;
}

static void reg_name(size_t off, char* out, size_t cap, const ppu_context* a, const ppu_context* b)
{
    const size_t g = offsetof(ppu_context, gpr), f = offsetof(ppu_context, fpr), v = offsetof(ppu_context, vr);
    if (off >= g && off < g + sizeof a->gpr) {
        const int i = (int)((off - g) / 8);
        snprintf(out, cap, "r%d native=%016llX lifted=%016llX", i, (unsigned long long)a->gpr[i], (unsigned long long)b->gpr[i]);
    } else if (off >= f && off < f + sizeof a->fpr) {
        const int i = (int)((off - f) / 8); uint64_t x, y; memcpy(&x, &a->fpr[i], 8); memcpy(&y, &b->fpr[i], 8);
        snprintf(out, cap, "f%d native=%016llX lifted=%016llX", i, (unsigned long long)x, (unsigned long long)y);
    } else if (off >= v && off < v + sizeof a->vr) {
        const int i = (int)((off - v) / 16);
        snprintf(out, cap, "v%d native=%08X%08X%08X%08X lifted=%08X%08X%08X%08X", i,
                 __builtin_bswap32(a->vr[i].w[0]), __builtin_bswap32(a->vr[i].w[1]), __builtin_bswap32(a->vr[i].w[2]), __builtin_bswap32(a->vr[i].w[3]),
                 __builtin_bswap32(b->vr[i].w[0]), __builtin_bswap32(b->vr[i].w[1]), __builtin_bswap32(b->vr[i].w[2]), __builtin_bswap32(b->vr[i].w[3]));
    } else {
        snprintf(out, cap, "context byte %u (cr %08X/%08X xer %08X/%08X vscr %08X/%08X lr %llX/%llX ctr %llX/%llX)", (unsigned)off,
                 a->cr, b->cr, a->xer, b->xer, a->vscr, b->vscr, (unsigned long long)a->lr, (unsigned long long)b->lr,
                 (unsigned long long)a->ctr, (unsigned long long)b->ctr);
    }
}

/* A signaling NaN that only one side quieted (its quiet bit the one difference): the lifted code itself quiets
 * one on a float-double-float round trip or not, depending on whether the compiler kept the value in a
 * register, so the compare form (guest accesses as calls) can differ there alone. Counted, not a difference. */
static int nan_q32(uint32_t x, uint32_t y)
{
    return (x ^ y) == 0x00400000u && (x & 0x7F800000u) == 0x7F800000u && (x & 0x003FFFFFu) != 0;
}
static int nan_q64(uint64_t x, uint64_t y)
{
    return (x ^ y) == 0x0008000000000000ull && (x & 0x7FF0000000000000ull) == 0x7FF0000000000000ull &&
           (x & 0x0007FFFFFFFFFFFFull) != 0;
}
static int ctx_nan_quiet_only(size_t off, const ppu_context* a, const ppu_context* b)
{
    const size_t f = offsetof(ppu_context, fpr), v = offsetof(ppu_context, vr);
    if (off >= f && off < f + sizeof a->fpr) {
        const int i = (int)((off - f) / 8); uint64_t x, y; memcpy(&x, &a->fpr[i], 8); memcpy(&y, &b->fpr[i], 8);
        return nan_q64(x, y);
    }
    if (off >= v && off < v + sizeof a->vr) {
        const int i = (int)((off - v) / 16), l = (int)((off - v) % 16) / 4;
        return nan_q32(__builtin_bswap32(a->vr[i].w[l]), __builtin_bswap32(b->vr[i].w[l]));
    }
    return 0;
}
static int mem_nan_quiet_only(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint32_t ad)
{
    for (uint32_t n = 4; n <= 8; n += 4) {             /* the aligned float or double holding the byte */
        const uint32_t w = ad & ~(n - 1);
        uint8_t mine[8], real[8]; int all = 1;
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            int f; const uint32_t h = sh_slot(s, w + j, &f);
            all &= f; mine[j] = f ? s->hval[h] : 0; real[j] = vm_base[w + j];
        }
        if (!all) continue;
        if (n == 4) { uint32_t x, y; memcpy(&x, mine, 4); memcpy(&y, real, 4); if (nan_q32(__builtin_bswap32(x), __builtin_bswap32(y))) return 1; }
        else { uint64_t x, y; memcpy(&x, mine, 8); memcpy(&y, real, 8); if (nan_q64(__builtin_bswap64(x), __builtin_bswap64(y))) return 1; }
    }
    return 0;
}

void gt5_ppu_native_compare(ppu_context* ctx, gt5_ppu_shadow_fn shadow, void (*lifted)(ppu_context*), int k)
{
    gt5_ppu_nat_tls* t = g_gt5_ppu_nat_t;
    if (!t) t = gt5_ppu_nat_tls_new();
    if ((++t->calls & 0xFFFFu) == 0) gt5_ppu_nat_tick();
    gt5_ppu_shadow* s = t_shadow;
    if (!s) { s = (gt5_ppu_shadow*)calloc(1, sizeof(gt5_ppu_shadow)); t_shadow = s; }
    if (!shadow || !s) { t->skipped[k]++; lifted(ctx); return; }
    if (++s->gen == 0) { memset(s->hgen, 0, sizeof s->hgen); s->gen = 1; }
    s->special = s->overflow = 0; s->nlist = 0;
    ppu_context in, mine;
    memcpy(&in, ctx, sizeof in);
    memcpy(&mine, ctx, sizeof mine);
    shadow(&mine, s);
    lifted(ctx);
    if (s->special || s->overflow) { t->skipped[k]++; return; }
    char what[256]; what[0] = 0;
    int nanq = 0;
    /* The registers only: gpr fpr vr cr lr ctr xer fpscr vscr (everything before cia). A native is made only for
     * a function that names no other field, so neither side writes cia, thread_id, the reservation or vrsave;
     * the reservation is host bookkeeping that other threads clear (ppu_resv_break_*) at any moment. */
    const uint8_t* a = (const uint8_t*)&mine; const uint8_t* b = (const uint8_t*)ctx;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < offsetof(ppu_context, cia); i++)
        if (a[i] != b[i]) {
            if (ctx_nan_quiet_only(i, &mine, ctx)) { nanq = 1; continue; }
            reg_name(i, what, sizeof what, &mine, ctx); break;
        }
    if (!what[0]) {
        for (int i = 0; i < s->nlist; i++) {
            int f; const uint32_t ad = s->list[i], h = sh_slot(s, ad, &f);
            if (vm_base[ad] != s->hval[h]) {
                if (mem_nan_quiet_only(s, ad)) { nanq = 1; continue; }
                snprintf(what, sizeof what, "guest byte %08X native=%02X lifted=%02X (%d bytes stored)", ad, s->hval[h], vm_base[ad], s->nlist);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    t->compared[k]++;
    if (!what[0]) { if (nanq) t->nanquiet[k]++; return; }
    t->differed[k]++;
    if (s_differ_logged.fetch_add(1) < 16) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[ppu-native] differ %s: %s | in r1=%llX r2=%llX r3=%llX r4=%llX r5=%llX r6=%llX r7=%llX r8=%llX"
                        " lr=%llX vscr=%08X f1=%a\n", s_fn[k].addr, what,
                (unsigned long long)in.gpr[1], (unsigned long long)in.gpr[2], (unsigned long long)in.gpr[3],
                (unsigned long long)in.gpr[4], (unsigned long long)in.gpr[5], (unsigned long long)in.gpr[6],
                (unsigned long long)in.gpr[7], (unsigned long long)in.gpr[8], (unsigned long long)in.lr, in.vscr, in.fpr[1]);
        fflush(stderr);
    }
}

```

`GT5/src/native/ppu_native.h`:

```h
/* Native PPU functions: the run-time half (scripts/ppu_native_patch.py, src/native/ppu_natives.txt).
 *
 * Included at the end of each lifted PPU source the build copies with native functions in it (after the
 * lifted code, so with its ppu_recomp.h), and by ppu_native.cpp.
 *   GT5_PPU_NATIVE=1 (default)  the native functions
 *   GT5_PPU_NATIVE=0            the lifted ones, as before
 *   GT5_PPU_NATIVE=2            compare: on every call the native's compare form runs on a copy of the
 *                               registers with its guest stores held in a log, then the lifted function
 *                               runs for real; registers and stored bytes are compared and the first
 *                               differences are logged ("[ppu-native] differ ...")
 * Every 10 s while calls are made: "[ppu-native] ..." with the counts. */
#pragma once
#include "ppu_recomp.h"
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

#define GT5_PPU_NAT_MAX 256

extern "C" int g_gt5_ppu_native;

/* At start-up, once per native function: its index for the counters. */
int gt5_ppu_native_register(const char* addr, int no_compare_form);

/* Per-thread counters (summed by the log line; no lock and no shared line on the call path). */
struct gt5_ppu_nat_tls {
    uint64_t calls;
    uint64_t native[GT5_PPU_NAT_MAX];
    uint64_t lifted[GT5_PPU_NAT_MAX];
    uint64_t compared[GT5_PPU_NAT_MAX];
    uint64_t differed[GT5_PPU_NAT_MAX];
    uint64_t skipped[GT5_PPU_NAT_MAX];    /* compare mode, not compared: see gt5_ppu_native_compare */
    uint64_t nanquiet[GT5_PPU_NAT_MAX];   /* compared, the same but for a signaling NaN's quiet bit */
};
extern PPU_THREAD_LOCAL gt5_ppu_nat_tls* g_gt5_ppu_nat_t;
gt5_ppu_nat_tls* gt5_ppu_nat_tls_new(void);
void gt5_ppu_nat_tick(void);

static inline void gt5_ppu_nat_count(int k)
{
    gt5_ppu_nat_tls* t = g_gt5_ppu_nat_t;
    if (__builtin_expect(t == nullptr, 0)) t = gt5_ppu_nat_tls_new();
    t->native[k]++;
    if (__builtin_expect((++t->calls & 0xFFFFFu) == 0, 0)) gt5_ppu_nat_tick();
}
void gt5_ppu_nat_lifted(int k);

/* Compare mode. The compare form of a native is its text with each guest access sent here:
 * loads see the bytes it stored before (then guest memory), stores go to the log only. */
struct gt5_ppu_shadow;
typedef void (*gt5_ppu_shadow_fn)(ppu_context*, gt5_ppu_shadow*);
void gt5_ppu_native_compare(ppu_context* ctx, gt5_ppu_shadow_fn shadow, void (*lifted)(ppu_context*), int k);

/* raw: the lifted code's raw access (no range check: vector and byte-reversed forms); otherwise the
 * gated scalar path, and an address that path sends out of line (null page, raw SPU windows, the gcm
 * poll word) makes the call not compared. */
void gt5_sh_read(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint32_t ea, void* dst, uint32_t n, int raw);
void gt5_sh_write(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint32_t ea, const void* src, uint32_t n, int raw);
const uint8_t* gt5_sh_p16(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint32_t ea);
static inline void gt5_sh_zero(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint32_t ea, uint32_t n)     /* dcbz (n = 128) */
{
    static const uint8_t z[256] = {0};
    gt5_sh_write(s, ea, z, n <= 256 ? n : 256, 1);
}

static inline uint8_t gt5_sh_r8(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint64_t a) { uint8_t v; gt5_sh_read(s, (uint32_t)a, &v, 1, 0); return v; }
static inline uint16_t gt5_sh_r16(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint64_t a) { uint16_t v; gt5_sh_read(s, (uint32_t)a, &v, 2, 0); return __builtin_bswap16(v); }
static inline uint32_t gt5_sh_r32(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint64_t a) { uint32_t v; gt5_sh_read(s, (uint32_t)a, &v, 4, 0); return __builtin_bswap32(v); }
static inline uint64_t gt5_sh_r64(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint64_t a) { uint64_t v; gt5_sh_read(s, (uint32_t)a, &v, 8, 0); return __builtin_bswap64(v); }
static inline void gt5_sh_w8(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint64_t a, uint8_t v) { gt5_sh_write(s, (uint32_t)a, &v, 1, 0); }
static inline void gt5_sh_w16(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint64_t a, uint16_t v) { v = __builtin_bswap16(v); gt5_sh_write(s, (uint32_t)a, &v, 2, 0); }
static inline void gt5_sh_w32(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint64_t a, uint32_t v) { v = __builtin_bswap32(v); gt5_sh_write(s, (uint32_t)a, &v, 4, 0); }
static inline void gt5_sh_w64(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint64_t a, uint64_t v) { v = __builtin_bswap64(v); gt5_sh_write(s, (uint32_t)a, &v, 8, 0); }
static inline void gt5_sh_ld16(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, void* dst, uint64_t ea) { gt5_sh_read(s, (uint32_t)ea, dst, 16, 1); }
static inline void gt5_sh_st16(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint64_t ea, const void* src) { gt5_sh_write(s, (uint32_t)ea, src, 16, 1); }
/* The generated natives' VMX values in host order (gen_ppu_leaf.py's vector pass): each word as
 * ppu_vmx.h's vmx_ld4 reads it; the operations are ppu_vmx.h's own four-lane ones. */
#if defined(VMX_SIMD_FMA)
static inline __m128 gt5_nat_h(const void* r) { return vmx_ld4(r); }
static inline void gt5_nat_r(void* r, __m128 h) { vmx_st4(r, h); }
static inline __m128 gt5_nat_fl(__m128 v, int nj) { return nj ? vmx_flush4(v) : v; }
static inline __m128i gt5_nat_bsw(__m128 v)
{
    return _mm_shuffle_epi8(_mm_castps_si128(v), _mm_setr_epi8(3, 2, 1, 0, 7, 6, 5, 4, 11, 10, 9, 8, 15, 14, 13, 12));
}
static inline __m128 gt5_nat_unbsw(__m128i v)
{
    return _mm_castsi128_ps(_mm_shuffle_epi8(v, _mm_setr_epi8(3, 2, 1, 0, 7, 6, 5, 4, 11, 10, 9, 8, 15, 14, 13, 12)));
}
static inline __m128 gt5_nat_vperm(__m128 a, __m128 b, __m128 c)          /* vmx_vperm */
{
    return gt5_nat_unbsw(vmx_perm16(gt5_nat_bsw(a), gt5_nat_bsw(b), gt5_nat_bsw(c)));
}
static inline __m128 gt5_nat_vsldoi(__m128 a, __m128 b, unsigned sh)        /* vmx_vsldoi */
{
    const __m128i sel = _mm_add_epi8(vmx_iota16(), _mm_set1_epi8((char)(sh & 15u)));
    return gt5_nat_unbsw(vmx_perm16(gt5_nat_bsw(a), gt5_nat_bsw(b), sel));
}
#endif

template <class T> static inline T gt5_sh_rawld(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint64_t ea) { T v; gt5_sh_read(s, (uint32_t)ea, &v, sizeof(T), 1); return v; }
template <class T, class V> static inline void gt5_sh_rawst(gt5_ppu_shadow* s, uint64_t ea, V val) { T v = (T)val; gt5_sh_write(s, (uint32_t)ea, &v, sizeof(T), 1); }
```

`GT5/src/native/spu_native.c`:

```c
/* The switch and the compare mode for native SPU functions (spu_native.h). */
#include "spu_native.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static int native_mode(void)
{
    const char* e = getenv("GT5_SPU_NATIVE");
    const int m = e && *e ? atoi(e) : 1;
    fprintf(stderr, "[spu-native] %s (GT5_SPU_NATIVE=%d: 1 native, 0 lifted, 2 compare)\n",
            m == 1 ? "native functions on" : m == 2 ? "comparing native against lifted" : "lifted functions only", m);
    return m;
}
/* Read before any SPU code runs: a constructor in this translation unit. */
int g_gt5_spu_native = 1;
#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
__attribute__((constructor)) static void native_init(void) { g_gt5_spu_native = native_mode(); }
#endif

static volatile long s_calls, s_bad;

void gt5_spu_native_compare(spu_context* ctx, void (*native)(spu_context*),
                            void (SPU_SV *lifted)(spu_context*), const char* name)
{
    /* The reference runs on a copy, the native function on the real context; the reference's
     * result is what the game keeps. The local store is part of the context unless ls points
     * elsewhere, and then it is copied too. */
    static SPU_THREAD_LOCAL spu_context* ref;
    static SPU_THREAD_LOCAL uint8_t* ref_ls;
    if (!ref) {
        ref = (spu_context*)_aligned_malloc(sizeof *ref, 64);
        ref_ls = (uint8_t*)_aligned_malloc(SPU_LS_SIZE, 64);
        if (!ref || !ref_ls) { lifted(ctx); return; }
    }
    const int inside = ctx->ls == ctx->ls_store;
    memcpy(ref, ctx, sizeof *ctx);
    if (inside) ref->ls = ref->ls_store;
    else { memcpy(ref_ls, ctx->ls, SPU_LS_SIZE); ref->ls = ref_ls; }
    lifted(ref);
    native(ctx);
    const long n = _InterlockedIncrement(&s_calls);
    int bad_reg = -1; long bad_ls = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 128 && bad_reg < 0; i++)
        if (memcmp(&ctx->gpr[i], &ref->gpr[i], 16)) bad_reg = i;
    if (memcmp(ctx->ls, ref->ls, SPU_LS_SIZE))
        for (long i = 0; i < SPU_LS_SIZE; i++) if (ctx->ls[i] != ref->ls[i]) { bad_ls = i; break; }
    if (bad_reg >= 0 || bad_ls >= 0 || ctx->pc != ref->pc) {
        const long b = _InterlockedIncrement(&s_bad);
        if (b <= 20) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[spu-native] MISMATCH %s call %ld:", name, n);
            if (bad_reg >= 0)
                fprintf(stderr, " r%d native %08X %08X %08X %08X lifted %08X %08X %08X %08X;", bad_reg,
                        ctx->gpr[bad_reg]._u32[0], ctx->gpr[bad_reg]._u32[1], ctx->gpr[bad_reg]._u32[2], ctx->gpr[bad_reg]._u32[3],
                        ref->gpr[bad_reg]._u32[0], ref->gpr[bad_reg]._u32[1], ref->gpr[bad_reg]._u32[2], ref->gpr[bad_reg]._u32[3]);
            if (bad_ls >= 0) fprintf(stderr, " local store 0x%05lX native %02X lifted %02X;", bad_ls, ctx->ls[bad_ls], ref->ls[bad_ls]);
            if (ctx->pc != ref->pc) fprintf(stderr, " pc native %05X lifted %05X;", ctx->pc, ref->pc);
            fputc('\n', stderr);
        }
        /* keep the reference's result */
        memcpy(ctx->gpr, ref->gpr, sizeof ctx->gpr);
        memcpy(ctx->ls, ref->ls, SPU_LS_SIZE);
        ctx->pc = ref->pc;
    }
    if ((n & 0xFFFF) == 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "[spu-native] compared %ld calls, %ld differed\n", n, (long)s_bad);
}
```
